AI.method: 作者将因果可解释性发现内化到模型权重中。首先识别出一个"停止向量"：第18层上的一类均值差方向，其引导（steering）强度可控制模型思考时长，而一个与之平行的复制值轴则无效。将这一干预写入权重时，直接最大化该方向上的标量投影会破坏冻结下游读取器所依赖的离轴维度，反而使生成变长；有效做法是重构整个被引导的激活，并将这些维度固定为自然值。该方法仅从24个问题拟合，且不使用强化学习。
AI.result: 在五个未见基准上，该方法以保持准确率为前提移除了约四分之一的思维链长度；削减量与每个问题自身的可移除冗余的相关系数为0.70。此外，它还修复了一种随难度增长而出现的非终止病理，而解码时的置信度钩子（confidence hook）反而会加剧该病理。作者不主张在原始权衡上胜过精心调优的长度惩罚或解码时早期退出，贡献在于该"停止"机制的获取方式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于可解释性找到的干预方向可以通过权重内化的方式可靠地控制推理模型的思考终止，关键在于以固定自然维度的方式重构整个被引导激活，而非简单最大化目标方向的投影。这种方法能以极小的拟合代价带来可泛化、且逐问题自适应的思考削减，并改善非终止病理，为推理效率和停止机制的获取提供了新的思路。

title: Spillover Effects under Network Interference When Neighbours' Treatment Effects Are Heterogeneous
summary: Optimizing budget-constrained network interventions requires evaluating not just who is connected, but predicting how strongly individual recipients will propagate the treatment's benefits. Existing models predict spillover from neighbors' treatments and attributes. We argue that spillover also depends on how strongly each neighbor responded to its own treatment. We prove that models summarizing neighbor treatments and attributes independently cannot capture this interaction, and we introduce SpilloverNet, a graph neural network designed to preserve neighbor-level response dynamics. Because a neighbor's response is unobserved, a natural approach is to estimate it from covariates and plug it in. However, we prove that any predictor relying solely on standard network data faces an irreducible error floor set by unobserved personal responsiveness. Empirically, the plug-in's error climbs to 51.9% as heterogeneity grows - worse than using no responsiveness estimate at all - while its overall correlation still looks acceptable. A per-unit estimate from a direct-response measurement, collected in a small pilot before spillover arrives, escapes this bound and recovers up to 14 percentage points of oracle-optimal welfare in a budgeted targeting problem. On two real social graphs, SpilloverNet reaches 7.7-8.4% error, outperforming standard GNNs as well as specialized causal-representation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预算约束下的网络干预优化问题，提出溢散效应不仅取决于邻居的处理与属性，还取决于每个邻居对自身处理的响应强度。作者证明独立汇总邻居处理与属性的模型无法捕捉这种交互，并设计图神经网络SpilloverNet以保留邻居级响应动态。由于邻居响应不可观测，作者证明仅依赖标准网络数据的预测存在由个人响应性异质性导致的不可约误差下界；而通过小规模试点直接测量得到的单位级响应估计可突破该下界，在预算目标分配中恢复至多14个百分点的最优福利。在两个真实社交网络上，SpilloverNet达到7.7%-8.4%的误差，优于标准GNN与专门的因果表征基线。
AI.motivation: 预算约束下的网络干预不仅需判断谁被连接，还需预测个体将处理收益传播给他人（溢散）的强度。现有模型仅从邻居的处理与属性预测溢散，忽略了邻居对自身处理的响应强度这一关键因素，导致预测不准确。
AI.method: 作者先通过理论证明：独立汇总邻居处理与属性的模型无法捕捉邻居级响应交互；任何仅依赖标准网络数据的预测器都存在由不可观测个人响应性设定的不可约误差下界。据此提出SpilloverNet（一种保留邻居级响应动态的图神经网络），并对比两种响应估计方式：从协变量估计的“插入法”与基于小规模试点直接响应测量的单位级估计。
AI.result: 实验表明，插入法的误差随异质性上升最高达51.9%，比完全不估计响应性更差，但其总体相关性仍看似可接受；基于试点直接测量的估计可突破误差下界，在预算目标分配中恢复至多14个百分点的最优福利。在两个真实社交网络上，SpilloverNet误差仅7.7%-8.4%，优于标准GNN及专门因果表征基线。
AI.conclusion: 溢散预测应显式建模邻居的个体响应动态而非仅使用汇总特征；仅靠标准网络数据的预测存在不可约误差，需要借助试点直接测量获取单位级响应信息来突破该局限，从而在真实社交网络中实现更优的预算化干预效果。

title: From Question-First to Analyst-First: Domain-Expert Skills and Verified Knowledge Compilation for Proactive Enterprise Analytics
summary: Conversational analytics systems assume the user already has a well-formed question, leaving a non-expert facing a blank query box on an unfamiliar enterprise schema. Commercial 'proactive' tools narrow this gap only by detecting statistical anomalies over analyst-curated metric layers, and academic next-question recommenders depend on query logs that a fresh dataset lacks. We describe a production analytics system that inverts the interaction model from question-first to analyst-first through two coupled architectural ideas. First, a pluggable domain-expert 'skill' abstraction: a folder-based, database-free subject-matter pack (a manifest, per-stage prompt facets, keyword-routed references, report templates, and optional compute) auto-selected per (client, dataset) by deterministic schema matching and spliced as a cross-cutting concern into every stage of an agentic pipeline, the schema explorer, and the report engines, degrading to a strict no-op when absent. Because a skill is a self-contained folder resolved deterministically, the catalogue is open-ended: an extensible marketplace of domain experts. Second, an offline knowledge-compilation loop: an agent probes the dataset's parquet via DuckDB (zero load on production), runs critic-gated per-table convergence with self-healing retries, and data-validates joins by value overlap, producing durable schema knowledge that drives standing expert reports whose every published metric is re-verified by re-executing its evidence SQL, plus suggested questions that mirror the report agenda. These close a proactive loop: reports surface numbers, the numbers seed questions, and a click launches a verified deep dive, all before the query box is used. We give a formal model and report illustrative single-tenant evidence. We make no user-study or benchmark claims; the contribution is the architecture and its defensibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个生产级会话分析系统，将交互模式从"先问问题"逆转为"分析师优先"：通过可插拔的领域专家"技能"（skill）抽象和离线知识编译循环，在用户使用查询框之前自动生成并验证专家报告与建议问题，从而弥合非专家面对陌生企业数据集的空白查询框差距。
AI.motivation: 现有会话分析系统假设用户已有成型问题，导致非专家面对陌生企业模式时无从下手；商业"主动式"工具仅依赖分析师精心维护的指标层做统计异常检测，学术界的下一问题推荐器则依赖新数据集不具备的查询日志。作者希望构建无需查询日志、无需预先排演问题的生产系统，主动为分析师型用户生成可验证的报告与问题线索。
AI.method: 两个耦合的架构思想：(1) 可插拔的领域专家"技能"抽象——基于文件夹、免数据库的主题包（含清单、各阶段提示面、关键字路由参考、报告模板和可选计算），通过确定性模式匹配按（客户,数据集）自动选择，并作为横切关注点织入智能体流水线、模式探索器与报告引擎的每个阶段，缺失时严格退化为no-op；该目录开放、可扩展为领域专家市场。(2) 离线知识编译循环——智能体通过DuckDB探测数据集的parquet文件（对生产零负载），运行带评论家门控的逐表收敛与自愈重试，按值重叠做数据验证连接，产出持久化的模式知识，驱动常驻专家报告（每个发布的指标通过重执行其证据SQL重新验证）及镜像报告议程的建议问题。两者形成主动闭环：报告呈现数字→数字催生问题→点击启动已验证的深入分析。
AI.result: 给出形式化模型，并报告了说明性的单租户证据。作者明确不做用户研究或基准测试声明，贡献在于架构本身及其可辩护性（defensibility）。
AI.conclusion: 该架构证明了"分析师优先"的主动分析系统在无需查询日志的前提下可落地：以确定性、可组合的领域技能保持可扩展性与可辩护性，以离线编译+证据SQL重验证保证报告可信度，从而在查询框被使用之前就形成报告→问题→深挖的主动闭环。

title: Improving Randomized Metric Distortion to 2.3282
summary:
In metric social choice, each voter ranks a set of $m$ candidates by her distance to them in an unknown metric space. The cost of a candidate is its average distance to the voters. A randomized voting rule must use only the rankings to choose a lottery over candidates. Its distortion is the worst-case ratio between the expected cost under the lottery it returns and the cost of the best candidate. Charikar, Ramakrishnan, Wang, and Wu [JACM 2024] prove an upper bound of $2.753$, establishing a constant separation from deterministic rules, for which the best achievable distortion is $3$. Independently, Frank [arXiv:2608.17863] and Ye [arXiv:2608.21202] improve the bound to $2.5$, using an equal mixture of maximal lottery and Integrated Veto. The existing arguments do not yield a better bound with any mixture of these rules.
  We break this barrier with a new ingredient, a random-size stable lottery. Let $D$ be a random variable over the domain of positive integers. A random-size stable lottery $\mathrm{RSL}_D$ guarantees that the probability of a random voter preferring any fixed candidate $c$ to her favorite of $D$ i.i.d. draws from $\mathrm{RSL}_D$ is at most $\mathbb{E}[1/(D+1)]$, where the probability also averages over $D$. When $D=k$ deterministically, this reduces to the stable $k$-lottery of Charikar, Ramakrishnan, Tan, and Wang [EC 2025]; the case $k=1$ is precisely a maximal lottery. Their minimax argument for a fixed $k$ easily generalizes to a random $D$. Our main contribution is to show how stability with respect to a random $D$ can be used to bound distortion. By mixing a suitably chosen random-size stable lottery with Integrated Veto, we get distortion at most $11641/5000=2.3282$. The proof combines infinite-dimensional conic linear-programming duality, heuristic nonlinear optimization, and exact rational verification via the Bernstein basis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究度量社会选择中的随机投票规则的失真（distortion）下界问题。作者引入“随机规模稳定彩票”（random-size stable lottery, RSL_D）这一新工具，将其与 Integrated Veto 混合，将失真上界从现有最好的 2.5 改进到 11641/5000 = 2.3282，从而打破了此前 Charikar 等人 [JACM 2024] 的 2.753 界限所开启的、由 Frank 和 Ye 独立改进到的 2.5 这一“用任意固定混合比例无法再改进”的屏障。证明结合了无限维锥线性规划对偶、启发式非线性优化与基于 Bernstein 基的精确有理验证。
AI.motivation: 在度量社会选择中，随机投票规则仅依据选民对候选人的排序（rankings）来选择候选人的抽签（lottery），其失真度量最坏情况下彩票期望代价与最优候选代价之比。此前已知确定性规则的最佳失真为 3，Charikar 等证明随机规则可达 2.753，随后 Frank 与 Ye 用最大彩票（maximal lottery）与 Integrated Veto 的等权混合改进到 2.5；但现有分析表明，任意固定混合比例的这两种规则都无法突破 2.5。因此需要全新的机制设计思想来打破这一屏障。
AI.method: 作者提出并形式化“随机规模稳定彩票”RSL_D：设 D 为取值于正整数域的随机变量，RSL_D 保证随机选民偏好任意固定候选 c 胜过她从 RSL_D 的 D 个 i.i.d. 抽样中选出的最优候选的概率至多为 E[1/(D+1)]（该概率同时对 D 取平均）。当 D 恒等于 k 时它退化为此前的 stable k-lottery，k=1 时即最大彩票；作者指出针对固定 k 的 minimax 论证可以自然推广到随机 D。核心贡献在于证明：将适当选择的 RSL_D 与 Integrated Veto 混合，即可用随机 D 的稳定性来界住失真。证明技术路线包括无限维锥线性规划对偶、启发式非线性优化以寻找参数，以及借助 Bernstein 基的精确有理验证来完成严格的数值证明。
AI.result: 通过混合一个精心选取的随机规模稳定彩票与 Integrated Veto，作者得到失真上界至多 11641/5000 = 2.3282，显著低于此前由 Frank 和 Ye 独立得到的 2.5 以及 Charikar 等人的 2.753，首次打破了现有固定混合论证无法突破 2.5 的屏障。
AI.conclusion: 随机规模稳定彩票提供了比固定规模稳定彩票更强的稳定性杠杆，可用于推导更紧的失真上界。本文将已知最优随机投票规则失真上界从 2.5 压缩到 2.3282，表明随机性在降低失真方面仍有进一步空间，并为度量社会选择中的失真分析提供了一种新的、可验证的证明框架（对偶+启发式优化+精确有理验证）。

title: Transmissive RIS-Assisted Vehicular Direct-to-Satellite Communications: Opportunities, Limitations, and Comparison with Phased Arrays
summary: This article studies transmissive reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted architectures. It compares them with electronically steered phased arrays for the deployment of vehicular direct-to-satellite (D2S) communications in future satellite networks. Rather than treating RIS as a direct replacement for phased arrays, we clarify the operating regimes in which RIS can serve as a low-power wavefront-shaping aperture and those in which phased arrays remain preferable because of their high gain and mature beam-tracking capability. Moreover, phased arrays can support multi-beam operation, which is particularly beneficial for dual connectivity and seamless handover. We distinguish analog, digital, and hybrid phased arrays, discuss the relationship between transmissive RIS and reconfigurable transmitarrays, and highlight practical profile, tracking, and link-budget constraints for mobile terminals. The comparison shows that passive RIS offers attractive power efficiency and aperture scalability, active RIS can partially improve the link budget, and phased arrays remain preferable for high-throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了透射式可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助架构，并将其与电子扫描相控阵进行比较，以评估二者在未来卫星网络中用于车载直接对卫星（D2S）通信的适用性。研究表明，被动式RIS在功耗效率与孔径可扩展性方面具有吸引力，主动式RIS可部分改善链路预算，而相控阵在高吞吐量场景下仍具优势。
AI.motivation: 直接对卫星（D2S）通信中的车载终端需要兼顾链路性能与功耗约束，而RIS被视为相控阵的低成本/低功耗替代方案。然而现有讨论常将RIS简单地视为相控阵的直接替代品，缺乏对二者适用场景的清晰界定，因此有必要明确RIS作为低功耗波前整形孔径与相控阵各自占优的工作区间。
AI.method: 通过架构对比分析方法，将透射式RIS辅助架构与模拟、数字、混合三种相控阵进行系统比较；讨论了透射式RIS与可重构发射阵列（transmitarray）之间的关系，并从终端剖面尺寸、波束跟踪能力与链路预算等移动终端约束角度展开分析。
AI.result: 对比结果表明：被动式RIS在功耗效率和孔径可扩展性方面具有吸引力；主动式RIS可部分改善链路预算；而相控阵凭借高增益、成熟的波束跟踪能力及多波束支持（有利于双连接与无缝切换），在高吞吐量场景下仍然更优。
AI.conclusion: RIS与相控阵并非简单的替代关系，二者各有适用的运行区间：RIS适合作为低功耗波前整形孔径，而相控阵在高增益、多波束与高吞吐量需求下仍是首选，未来系统设计应结合具体约束选择或混合使用这两类架构。

title: Measuring Similarity between Artistic and AI Generated Images using Siamese Neural Networks
comment: Accepted to LatinX in AI Research Workshop at Neurips 2025
summary: AI-generated art has sparked debates around potential plagiarism, as these images may closely resemble existing artworks. This research quantifies the similarity between original pieces and AI-generated counterparts, particularly those produced by the Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0. We use Siamese Networks with frozen CLIP encoders and cosine similarity optimized through triplet loss. A dataset of paired original and generated images was built using image-to-image generation and custom prompts, enriched with semantic descriptors and BLIP-2 captions. Prior studies report up to 81\% style replication and 90\% visual similarity. Our results show high discriminative performance: training accuracy reached 99.9\%, and the best model configuration achieved 99.4\% test accuracy with strong inter-class separation ($δμ$ = 0.677), demonstrating the effectiveness of our semantic-visual embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了人类原创艺术作品与AI生成图像（Stable Diffusion XL Refiner 1.0）之间的相似度，利用冻结CLIP编码器的孪生网络结合三元组损失进行判别，最终测试准确率达99.4%，证明语义-视觉嵌入能有效区分原创与AI生成作品。
AI.motivation: AI生成艺术可能高度模仿现有作品，引发抄袭争议，因此需要定量评估AI生成图像与原创作品之间的相似程度，以明确抄袭风险。
AI.method: 采用带有冻结CLIP编码器的孪生网络，通过三元组损失优化余弦相似度；通过图生图（image-to-image）生成与自定义提示词构建原创-生成图像配对数据集，并补充语义描述符与BLIP-2字幕来丰富数据。
AI.result: 训练准确率达99.9%，最佳模型配置的测试准确率为99.4%，类间分离度δμ=0.677，表现出较强的判别性能。
AI.conclusion: 该语义-视觉嵌入方案能够高精度地将原创作品与AI生成图像区分开来，为量化AI艺术抄袭与相似性检测提供了有效手段。

title: Looking Again: Measuring Sycophancy in the Reasoning Chains of Multimodal Models Under Pressure
summary: Large multimodal reasoning models (LMRMs) are getting increasingly capable, primarily through generating explicit chain-of-thought reasoning before answering. In language models it has been observed that this performance often comes with sycophancy, the tendency of a model to agree with the user over the evidence. However, for LMRMs no reliable method to measure sycophancy yet exists. We bridge this gap by introducing a benchmark and dataset for evaluating LMRM sycophancy when confronted with a wrong answer from a user. Our benchmark pairs four visually grounded datasets spanning mathematical, clinical, temporal, and demographic reasoning with five pressure conditions in single-turn and multi-turn settings. We evaluate sycophancy in the final answer as well as its emergence within the reasoning chain. We find that sycophancy is prevalent under pressure, with Statement pressure eliciting the highest rates and Conviction the lowest for all models except Mistral-Small-4, and under multi-turn pressure reasoning-level sycophancy intensifies sharply in clinical visual judgement, reaching 95.7% for the most affected model. We further introduce a failure taxonomy separating reasoning-chain from answer-level sycophancy, and a complementary sentence-level taxonomy locating where in the chain drift first emerges. Our results show that sycophancy can corrupt the reasoning chain independently of the final answer, so answer-level evaluation alone is insufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个用于评估大型多模态推理模型（LMRM）谄媚行为（sycophancy）的基准与数据集，将数学、临床、时间与人口统计四类视觉推理任务与五种压力条件相结合，在单轮和多轮对话设置下同时评估最终答案与推理链层面的谄媚表现，并引入两级失败分类法。
AI.motivation: LMRM通过生成显式思维链（CoT）推理来提升能力，但语言模型研究表明这种性能提升往往伴随谄媚行为——即模型倾向于认同用户而非依据证据。然而目前尚无可靠方法衡量LMRM的谄媚程度，这一测量缺口阻碍了对模型可靠性的评估。
AI.method: 构建一个基准数据集：将数学、临床、时间、人口统计四类视觉推理数据集与五种压力条件（如Statement、Conviction等）配对，覆盖单轮与多轮对话场景。评估分别在最终答案层面和推理链内部进行，并设计了区分"推理链层面谄媚"与"答案层面谄媚"的失败分类法，以及用于定位推理链中谄媚漂移起点的句子级分类法。
AI.result: 压力条件下谄媚普遍存在：Statement压力诱发的谄媚率最高，Conviction最低（Mistral-Small-4除外）；多轮压力下临床视觉判断的推理级谄媚急剧上升，受影响最严重的模型达到95.7%。且谄媚可独立于最终答案而污染推理链。
AI.conclusion: 推理链谄媚可独立于最终答案发生，仅评估答案层面的谄媚不足以全面反映模型行为，需要同时检查推理链内容；本研究提供的基准、数据集与分类框架为LMRM谄媚的标准化测量奠定了基础。

title: Conservative Hybrid Graph Networks for Process Systems with Learned Routing
summary: Industrial process networks do not maintain a single effective topology while operating: streams are throttled or bypassed, and units move between idle, transition, and active regimes. Models of such systems are typically trained on measured state trajectories while the operating mechanisms that generated them remain latent, and an unconstrained graph network can fit such a trajectory without assigning stable physical meaning to the recovered routing. We address both problems with the Conservative Hybrid Graph Network (CHGN), which learns routing, regime assignment, and removal rates as data-driven surrogates and inserts them into a fixed transport equation, so that the mass balance holds by construction for any predicted routing. CHGN trained on networks of 10-20 nodes transfers zero-shot to unseen graphs of 25-40 nodes without retraining, reaching an RMSE of 2.1e-3 against 6e-2 to 9e-2 for GNN baselines under the same protocol, with a gate MAE of 7.9e-3 and regime accuracy of 94.3% (1.2e-2 and 96.4% respectively on the fixed training topology). On a fluid-mixing pilot plant, CHGN improves on a persistence baseline for held-out physical faults but does not predict manual interventions, for which the governing valve actions are unobserved. The model therefore transfers across process topologies without retraining and exposes the latent mechanisms governing plant behaviour to inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出保守混合图网络（CHGN），将路由、工况分配和移除速率作为数据驱动代理学习，并嵌入固定输运方程，使质量平衡在构造上恒成立。CHGN在10-20节点网络上训练后可零样本迁移到25-40节点未见图，RMSE达2.1e-3（GNN基线为6e-2至9e-2），门控MAE为7.9e-3、工况准确率94.3%；在流体混合中试装置上对留出物理故障优于持久性基线，但无法预测观测不足的手动干预。
AI.motivation: 工业过程网络在运行时并不保持单一有效拓扑：流股被节流或旁路，单元在空闲、过渡和活动工况间切换。此类系统通常仅在测量状态下轨迹上训练模型，而生成轨迹的运行机制是潜在（不可观测）的；无约束的图网络虽能拟合轨迹，却无法给恢复的路由赋予稳定的物理意义，因此需要一种能同时学习潜在路由并保持质量守恒的模型。
AI.method: CHGN将路由（routing）、工况分配（regime assignment）和移除速率（removal rates）作为数据驱动的替代模型进行学习，并将其插入固定的输运方程中，从而对任意预测的路由，质量平衡都通过构造自动成立，无需额外约束。
AI.result: 在10-20节点网络训练后，CHGN零样本迁移到25-40节点的未见图，RMSE为2.1e-3，远超同协议下RMSE为6e-2至9e-2的GNN基线；固定训练拓扑上门控MAE为7.9e-3、工况准确率94.3%（对应迁移场景分别为1.2e-2和96.4%）。在流体混合中试装置上，CHGN对留出的物理故障优于持久性基线，但无法预测手动干预（因为其阀门动作未观测）。
AI.conclusion: CHGN无需重新训练即可跨过程拓扑迁移，并把控制工厂行为的潜在机制（路由、工况、移除速率）暴露出来供检查，在保持物理一致性的同时提升了可解释性与泛化能力。

title: The PUR-1 Cyber-Physical Digital Twin
summary: Digital twin technologies have the potential to improve operational flexibility and responsiveness capabilities of nuclear systems. To provide decision support, cyber event characterization, state estimation, predictive control, and real-time dynamic processing of operational data, however, an efficient digital twin needs to integrate multiple models (data-driven as well as physics-based) with explainability while at the same time maintain two-way synchronization with the physical facility at a time constant less than its operational cycle. In this work, we present the Purdue University Reactor One Digital Twin (PUR-1 DT), a cyber-physical digital twin with a complete high-fidelity physics-based and AI-driven virtual model stack (neutronics, thermal-hydraulics, point kinetics) which provides closed-loop explainable diagnostics, forecasting, predictive control, and action recommendation back to the reactor via two-way communications and a cyber-physical testbed. We demonstrate real-time synchronized state estimation and short-term forecasting over a full reactor operational cycle and conduct a series of benchmarking experiments to validate accuracy and latency. Our results show good agreement with experimental results and lay the groundwork for further development and experimental demonstration of DT-enabled functionalities in real-world facilities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了普渡大学反应堆一号数字孪生（PUR-1 DT），一个融合高保真物理模型（中子学、热工水力、点动力学）与AI驱动模型的网络物理数字孪生系统，通过双向通信与物理设施同步，实现闭环可解释诊断、预测、预测性控制与行动建议，并在完整反应堆运行周期内验证了实时同步状态估计与短期预测的准确性和延迟。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生技术有潜力提升核系统的运行灵活性和响应能力，但高效的核系统数字孪生需要集成数据驱动与物理模型并具备可解释性，同时要在小于运行周期的时间常数内与物理设施保持双向同步，以支持决策、网络事件表征、状态估计、预测控制和实时动态数据处理。
AI.method: 构建PUR-1 DT网络物理数字孪生系统：1）采用完整的、高保真的物理与AI驱动的虚拟模型栈（中子学、热工水力、点动力学）；2）通过双向通信和网络物理测试平台向反应堆提供闭环可解释诊断、预测、预测控制及行动建议；3）在完整反应堆运行周期上进行实时同步状态估计和短期预测演示，并开展一系列基准实验以验证精度与延迟。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该数字孪生系统与实验结果高度吻合，实时同步状态估计和短期预测在整个反应堆运行周期内表现良好，精度与延迟均满足要求，验证了系统的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了多模型融合、可解释、双向同步的数字孪生架构在核反应堆中的可行性，为在实际设施中进一步开发和实验演示数字孪生赋能功能奠定了基础。

title: The Signal in the Noise: An Auditable Reliability Layer for Biomedical Text Classification
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 2026 14th International Conference on Bioinformatics and Computational Biology (ICBCB 2026), Kitakyushu, Japan; to appear in IEEE Conference Proceedings (IEEE Xplore). Code: https://github.com/MoustafaMohamedMoustafaHassan/the_signal_in_the_noise_CORD19_project
summary: Biomedical NLP pipelines routinely presuppose clean input text, yet large-scale corpora assembled through automated PDF parsing harbour pervasive OCR-like artifacts, token splits and merges, hyphenation remnants, and character-level corruption, that systematically erode lexical evidence and degrade downstream classifiers. We introduce a conservative, fully auditable spell-correction reliability layer conceived as a safety-oriented preprocessing module rather than a maximal-accuracy corrector: under conditions of uncertainty, the system abstains from editing, in accordance with a medical do-no-harm philosophy. The deterministic architecture couples bounded edit-distance candidate generation with corpus-derived n-gram scoring and a suite of biomedical safety gates that protect domain-critical terminology. We evaluate the layer both intrinsically, on a manually curated benchmark of 2,104 token-level cases, and extrinsically, on a tri-class CORD-19 topic classifier (Prevention, Treatment, Epidemiology) spanning 10,000 examples under a principled four-run protocol (Clean, Noisy, Restored, Safety). Intrinsically, the layer attains 94.61% error-fix recall on synthetic errors with zero harmful edits on negative controls. Downstream, it recovers approximately 80.45% of the noise-induced macro-F1 degradation, elevating macro-F1 from 0.7654 (Noisy) to 0.7717 (Restored) while preserving near-clean performance (Safety: 0.7721). A supplementary case study on 103 real-world OCR-extracted abstracts classified with BioBERT confirms that transformer encoders appeared relatively robust to mild noise, motivating a future grey-box architecture that integrates bounded neural signals and UMLS lexicons without compromising auditability. The system is fully deterministic, artifact-driven, and designed with deployment and auditability in mind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向生物医学NLP管线的、保守且完全可审计的拼写纠正可靠性层：在不确定时放弃编辑（遵循医学"不伤害"原则），通过有界编辑距离候选生成、语料n-gram评分和生物医学安全门来修复PDF解析引入的OCR类噪声，从而在不产生有害编辑的前提下恢复下游分类器性能。
AI.motivation: 生物医学NLP管线通常假设输入文本是干净的，但通过自动化PDF解析构建的大规模语料普遍存在OCR类伪影、token分裂/合并、连字符残留和字符级损坏，这些噪声会系统性削弱词汇证据并降低下游分类器性能，因此需要一个安全、可审计的预处理纠错模块。
AI.method: 提出一个保守型拼写纠正可靠性层，定位为面向安全性的预处理模块而非追求最大准确率的纠正器。其确定性架构结合有界编辑距离候选生成、语料库导出的n-gram评分，以及一组保护领域关键术语的生物医学安全门；在不确定条件下系统主动放弃编辑（do-no-harm）。
AI.result: 内在评测：在含2,104个token级案例的手工基准上，对合成错误达到94.61%的错误修复召回率，且在负对照上实现零有害编辑。外在评测：在三类CORD-19主题分类器（预防、治疗、流行病学）的10,000样本、四轮协议（Clean/Noisy/Restored/Safety）下，恢复了约80.45%的噪声所致macro-F1下降，将macro-F1从0.7654（Noisy）提升至0.7717（Restored），Safety为0.7721，接近干净性能。附加案例研究（103篇真实OCR摘要，BioBERT）显示Transformer编码器对轻度噪声相对稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该系统完全确定性、由伪影驱动，设计上面向部署与可审计性。鉴于变压器对轻度噪声的鲁棒性，未来将探索集成有界神经信号和UMLS词表的灰盒架构，在保持可审计性的前提下进一步提升修复能力。

title: Fair Division Under Boolean Valuations: Beyond Normalization
summary:
We study fair division of indivisible items when agents have arbitrary two-level preferences: the value of each agent for any set of items is Boolean, which need not be monotone or additive. Notably, we do not impose the standard assumption of normalization, i.e., different agents may value the empty set at different Boolean levels. Since the preferences are nonmonotone, envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) and envy-freeness up to any item (EFX) each admit several variants, depending on which items are tested for removal and whether they are removed from the envious agent's bundle or the envied agent's bundle. This paper investigates the existence of these variants of EF1 and EFX, on their own and together with economic efficiency, incentive compatibility, feasibility constraints, and lottery-based randomization. Our results highlight that the existence landscape depends crucially on the number of normalized agents, who value the empty bundle at the lower Boolean level.
  The authors used significant assistance from GPT-5.6-Sol for deriving theoretical results, verified any AI-generated proofs for correctness, and expanded on the exposition and simplified arguments, with the aid of GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude Opus 5.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不可分割物品的公平分配问题，其中每个智能体对任意物品集合的效用为布尔值（二值），且不必满足单调性或可加性；特别地，不施加归一化假设，即不同智能体对空集的估值可能取不同的布尔层级。由于偏好非单调，EF1 与 EFX 各自依据被移除的物品对象以及移除发生在嫉妒者或被嫉妒者束中而衍生出多种变体。论文考察这些变体的存在性，并进一步结合经济效率、激励相容、可行性约束以及基于抽签的随机化进行讨论，最终揭示存在性图景关键取决于“归一化智能体”（对空集取较低布尔值）的数量。
AI.motivation: 经典公平分配研究通常假设偏好单调、可加且归一化；而现实或组合场景中偏好可能是任意二值且非单调的，打破这些假设后标准公平性概念（EF1、EFX）的定义不再唯一。需要厘清在无归一化且非单调的布尔偏好下，各种公平性变体能否保证存在。
AI.method: 通过理论刻画与构造性论证，系统分析非单调布尔偏好下 EF1、EFX 的多种变体（按移除物品对象及移除来源区分）的可满足性；并将这些公平性概念与帕累托有效性、激励相容性（如实报机制）、可行性（如束大小/基数约束）以及随机化（抽签机制）综合考察，以归一化智能体的数量为关键参数划分存在性结果。
AI.result: 揭示公平性变体的存在性并非统一成立，而是显著依赖于归一化智能体的数量：该数量决定哪些 EF1/EFX 变体可与效率、激励相容、可行性约束或随机化同时满足。研究给出了一幅随归一化智能体数量变化的存在性“图景”，并说明了不同变体之间的强弱关系与折衷。
AI.conclusion: 在任意非单调、非归一化的布尔偏好下，公平分配的表现比传统单调可加偏好情形更为复杂且高度敏感于归一化智能体数量；不存在对所有情形都成立的统一公平性保证，需依据归一化智能体数目选择合适的 EF1/EFX 变体以及是否附加效率、激励相容、可行性与随机化要求。

title: Generalized Hamming Weights of AJ-Gorenstein One-Point Codes
summary:
We study generalized Hamming weights along the one-point code flag of an AJ-Gorenstein curve. We organize these weights in a graded array, the zero diagram, whose entries are generalized coweights: the largest numbers of evaluation points on which subcodes of prescribed dimensions vanish simultaneously. Twisted and Wei duality show that each row of the zero diagram determines both the generalized Hamming weights of a lower block of short codes and the missing weights of a reflected upper block of long codes in the GHW diagram of the complete flag. Our main quantitative result is a uniform coverage theorem. For an AJ-Gorenstein curve of genus $g$ and evaluation length $n>2g$, the proportion of generalized-weight positions determined exactly throughout the complete flag satisfies $\operatorname{Cov}_{\mathrm{full}} \ge \frac{n(n-1)+4g}{n(n+2g-1)}>\frac12$.
  Thus more than half of all generalized-weight positions in the complete flag are determined uniformly. For the smallest Suzuki curve, the general and Castle-specific mechanisms together determine $2{,}280$ of the $2{,}912$ positions, giving an exact coverage of $78.30\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AJ-Gorenstein曲线上单点码旗（完整旗）的广义Hamming权重，引入“零图”（zero diagram）这一分级数组，其条目为广义对权重（余权重）。利用扭曲对偶与Wei对偶，证明零图的每一行既能确定下方短码块的广义Hamming权重，也能确定上方长码块在GHW图中缺失的权重。主要定量结果是一个均匀覆盖定理：对亏格g、求值长度n>2g的AJ-Gorenstein曲线，完整旗中能被精确确定的广义权重位置占比满足Cov_full ≥ n(n-1)+4g / n(n+2g-1) > 1/2，即超过一半的权重位置被统一确定。以最小的Suzuki曲线为例，一般机制与Castle特有机理共同确定了2912个位置中的2280个，精确覆盖率达78.30%。
AI.motivation: 广义Hamming权重是码理论中刻画纠错能力与安全性的核心不变量，但对完整码旗中所有子码的广义权重进行全面确定十分困难。作者希望建立一种系统工具（零图），通过扭曲/Wei对偶关系，从高阶余权重信息统一地恢复完整旗中各层码块的广义Hamming权重，并给出可定量保证的覆盖比例。
AI.method: 作者沿AJ-Gorenstein曲线的单点码旗构造分级数组“零图”，其条目是被同一子码同时消没的最大求值点个数（广义对权重）。基于扭曲对偶与Wei对偶，推导出零图中每行与GHW图中两类码块（下方短码、上方长码缺失权重）的对应关系，从而将权重确定问题转化为零图的覆盖计数；并在Castle码（含Suzuki曲线）情形补充特定机制以提升覆盖率。
AI.result: 对亏格g、求值长度n>2g的AJ-Gorenstein曲线，给出了均匀覆盖定理：完整旗中广义权重位置被精确确定的比例不小于Cov_full ≥ n(n-1)+4g / n(n+2g-1) > 1/2，即统一确定超过一半的权重位置。对最小Suzuki曲线，一般机制与Castle特定机制合计确定2912个位置中的2280个，精确覆盖率达78.30%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，借助零图和对偶关系，可以在不逐一枚举子码的情况下高效确定完整码旗中大部分广义Hamming权重，且覆盖率有严格大于1/2的普适下界；在Castle曲线上可进一步显著提升。这为广义权重结构、MDS/近MDS性质及安全参数分析提供了统一而有力的定量工具。

title: FrameScope: Temporal Data Valuation for Stream Active Learning in Autonomous Vehicle Systems
summary: Autonomous vehicles operate in dynamic, ever-changing environments where new scenarios and edge cases constantly emerge. As a result, static learning models are inadequate for ensuring safe and reliable operation. Continuous learning is essential for adapting to these evolving conditions and maintaining robust performance across diverse real-world settings. However, autonomous vehicles generate massive streams of visual data during operation, and existing continuous learning approaches typically rely on heuristic sampling methods that fail to capture temporal dynamics, often overlooking critical learning opportunities or selecting redundant frames. In this paper, we introduce FrameScope, a temporal data valuation framework for continuous learning in autonomous vehicles. FrameScope extends neural tangent kernel theory to temporal domains, enabling principled valuation of streaming visual data. Unlike cloud-centric methods that transmit all video data for processing, our approach performs principled, local frame selection on the vehicle and queries a cloud-based oracle model only for labels of those high-value frames. Extensive experiments across multiple domain shifts show that FrameScope consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher sample efficiency and significantly reducing catastrophic forgetting in autonomous vehicle perception. By valuing data on the vehicle and querying only labels for selected frames, FrameScope reduces bandwidth requirements, enabling scalable operation with a lightweight cloud labeling service.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FrameScope，一个面向自动驾驶持续学习的时序数据价值评估框架。它扩展神经正切核理论到时序域，在车端对视频流帧进行有原则的本地筛选，仅向云端标注模型请求高价值帧的标签，从而在多种域偏移场景下提升样本效率、减少灾难性遗忘并降低带宽需求。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶运行在动态、持续变化的环境中，会不断遇到新场景和边缘情况，静态学习模型难以保证安全可靠，因此持续学习至关重要。然而车辆运行时会产生海量视觉数据流，现有持续学习方法依赖启发式采样，未能捕捉时序动态，常遗漏关键学习机会或选中冗余帧，导致学习效率低下。
AI.method: FrameScope 将神经正切核（NTK）理论扩展到时序领域，从而对流式视觉数据进行有原则的价值评估。与将所有视频数据上传云端处理的方法不同，FrameScope 在车辆本地执行帧选择，仅将高价值帧查询云端 oracle 模型获取标签，实现本地化、原则性的帧筛选与轻量级云端标注协作。
AI.result: 在多个域偏移场景的大量实验中，FrameScope 一致优于现有方法，实现了更高的样本效率，显著降低了自动驾驶感知中的灾难性遗忘；同时通过在车端评估数据价值并仅查询选中帧的标签，降低了带宽需求，实现了可扩展的轻量级云端标注服务。
AI.conclusion: FrameScope 通过在车端进行时序数据价值评估并按需标注，为自动驾驶持续学习提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案，能够更好地适应不断变化的环境并保持感知性能的长期稳定。

title: MA-RAG: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Query-Driven Summarization of Longitudinal Parkinson's Disease Assessments
summary: Accurate interpretation of single-visit and longitudinal clinical assessments for Parkinson's disease is time-consuming and often depends on specialist expertise. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate natural language summaries, they frequently lack domain-specific clinical grounding and struggle to produce factually correct and temporally consistent responses for structured longitudinal assessment data. To address these limitations, we propose MA-RAG, a query-driven multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that decomposes clinical reasoning into domain-specialized agents, combines structured fact extraction, and synthesizes clinically grounded summaries through a final verification stage. The framework supports four clinical analysis tasks: single-session, trajectory, comparison, and cohort summarization. We evaluate MA-RAG using objective metrics, namely Fact Precision, Hallucination Rate, Temporal Fidelity, and Semantic Similarity, together with subjective evaluations conducted by clinical experts. Compared to Traditional, RAG-only, and Single-agent RAG baselines, MA-RAG substantially improves factual correctness, achieving up to a 122% relative increase in Fact Precision (from 0.436 to 0.990) and reducing the Hallucination Rate by up to 98% (from 0.564 to 0.010), while consistently receiving top ratings from clinical experts for organization and clinical usefulness. These results demonstrate that domain-specialized multi-agent reasoning enables reliable query-driven summarization of structured longitudinal clinical assessment data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MA-RAG，一种面向帕金森病结构化纵向临床评估数据的查询驱动多智能体检索增强生成框架，通过领域专用智能体分解临床推理、结构化事实抽取与最终验证，支持单次、轨迹、比较和队列四类总结任务，显著提升事实准确性与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 单次及纵向帕金森病临床评估的准确解读耗时且依赖专科医生经验。尽管大语言模型可生成自然语言摘要，但常缺乏领域特定的临床依据，难以针对结构化纵向评估数据生成事实正确且时间一致的响应，因此需要一种兼具临床知识引导与可靠事实生成的方案。
AI.method: 提出MA-RAG，一个查询驱动的多智能体检索增强生成框架：将临床推理分解为多个领域专门化智能体，结合结构化事实抽取，并通过最终验证阶段综合生成具有临床依据的摘要；框架支持单次会话、轨迹、比较和队列总结四类临床分析任务，并以客观指标（事实精确率、幻觉率、时间保真度、语义相似度）及临床专家主观评估进行评测。
AI.result: 与传统、仅RAG和单智能体RAG基线相比，MA-RAG大幅提升事实正确性：事实精确率相对提升最高达122%（0.436升至0.990），幻觉率相对降低最高达98%（0.564降至0.010），并在组织性与临床实用性方面持续获得临床专家的最高评分。
AI.conclusion: 领域专门化的多智能体推理能够实现结构化纵向临床评估数据的可靠查询驱动摘要生成，验证了MA-RAG在临床文本生成中兼顾事实准确性与时间一致性的有效性，为临床自然语言总结任务提供了可行范式。

title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?
summary: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering requires enumerating item/leaf masses that a code-only decoder does not directly expose. (iii) Resolution depth is the operative knob - coarser under scarce support - and a conditional bias bound links the coarsening bias to the quantizer's worst-case reconstruction residual and the target-logging divergence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生成式推荐系统在离线策略评估（OPE）中，能否直接利用模型自身的语义ID（SID）树作为动作抽象。作者发现：在近argmax日志策略下逐商品OPE不可行，而将商品边缘化为代码前缀簇（coarsening）可恢复可估计支持并降低误差；增益源于粗化而非层级本身，但SID树使粗化在生成式系统中变得可行（簇质量可由解码器精确廉价获得）；分辨率深度是调控旋钮，并给出了将粗化偏差与量化器重建残差及目标-日志分布散度相关联的条件偏差界。
AI.motivation: 团队在投入稀缺的A/B测试资源前，需要离线判定哪些解码器或重排变体值得上线，这依赖离线策略评估（OPE）。核心问题是：模型自身的SID树能否充当该OPE的动作抽象？
AI.method: 该工作提出三部分分析：(i) 在真实推荐常用的近argmax日志策略下，单商品（逐item）OPE因有效样本量过小而不可行，将商品边缘化为码前缀簇（code-prefix clusters）可恢复可估计支持并降低误差；(ii) 该增益来自粗化本身而非层级结构，但SID树使粗化在生成式系统中可行——每个簇的质量可由解码器精确且廉价地返回，而扁平聚类需要枚举只有code解码器不直接暴露的商品/叶子质量；(iii) 分辨率深度是关键旋钮（支持不足时取更粗），并给出条件偏差界，将粗化偏差与量化器最坏情形重建残差及目标-日志分布散度联系起来。
AI.result: 模型自身的SID树可以作为OPE的动作抽象：基于码前缀簇的边缘化在近argmax日志下显著降低OPE误差；粗化的可行性来自解码器可直接提供簇质量；粗化偏差受量化器重建残差和目标-日志散度的约束，分辨率深度为实际调控参数。
AI.conclusion: SID树是生成式推荐系统离线评估中可行且有效的动作抽象方案：通过粗化（码前缀簇边缘化）克服逐商品有效样本量不足的问题，并以分辨率深度作为偏差-方差权衡的调节手段；该方案使团队能在A/B测试之前更可靠地筛选候选解码器/重排变体。

title: Redefining Stablecoins from Nominal to Real Value: A Maximum Likelihood Approach
summary: Stablecoins, typically pegged to fiat currencies, cannot achieve true stability because they inherit fluctuations in the underlying unit of account. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a stablecoin pegged to the Maximum Likelihood Value (MLV), a newly defined unit of account derived as the most probable configuration of latent real-value movements that explains observed nominal-value (price) changes. Grounded in inferential statistics and modern portfolio theory, MLV represents the most stable unit of account, as it enforces a zero real return on the minimum-variance portfolio. Empirical results confirm the operational viability of an MLV-pegged stablecoin: MLV can be computed in real time from 500 asset price series and improves annualized returns and Sharpe ratios while substantially reducing turnover in portfolio optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种锚定"最大似然值（MLV）"的新型稳定币，不再锚定法币，而是从500个资产价格序列中实时推断最能解释名义价格变动的潜在真实价值构型，从而实现更本源的稳定性，并在实证中提升组合年化收益、夏普比率并大幅降低换手率。
AI.motivation: 传统稳定币锚定法定货币，但法币本身作为记账单位存在波动，因此这种稳定币无法实现真正意义上的价值稳定，只是把波动来源转移到了基础计价单位上。作者希望构建一种不依赖法币、在更底层会计单位层面具有稳定性的稳定币。
AI.method: 作者定义了"最大似然值（MLV）"这一新记账单位，其含义为能解释观测名义价格变化的最可能潜在真实价值运动配置。该方法以推断统计学和现代组合理论为基础：MLV通过对最小方差组合施加零实际收益约束，从而成为最稳定的记账单位。实证中作者利用500条资产价格序列进行实时MLV计算并用于组合优化与稳定币定价。
AI.result: 实证结果表明MLV可以在实时条件下由500个资产价格序列计算得出；在使用MLV的稳定币/组合框架中，年化收益与夏普比率均得到改善，且组合换手率显著降低，证明了MLV锚定稳定币的运营可行性。
AI.conclusion: MLV锚定稳定币在操作上是可行的，并且比锚定法币的传统稳定币具有更根本的稳定性优势，能够在不增加换手成本的情况下获得更优的风险调整后收益，为稳定币设计提供了新的理论框架。

title: Paper Pilot: A Human-in-the-Loop Expert System for Evidence-Traceable Scientific Manuscript Generation in Applied Sciences
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly embedded in scientific workflows for literature analysis, drafting, and review. Existing systems advance autonomous discovery and manuscript generation, but do not resolve the governance problem that arises when ideas, methods, results, and claims propagate through AI-assisted workflows without mandatory human approval or artifact-level traceability. This paper proposes Paper Pilot, a human-in-the-loop expert system for evidence-traceable scientific manuscript generation in applied sciences. It adapts the Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE) methodology to manuscript development through manuscript-owner approval gates, explicit no-pass criteria, claim classification, audit logging, advisory LLM review, and evidence-locked revision control. The framework defines eight approval gates across the idea-to-claim pipeline and distinguishes literature-grounded from artifact-grounded claims, requiring reported numbers and interpretations to remain traceable to approved evidence; its system prompt is openly released for deployment in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or institutional LLM environments. As a first empirical validation, we evaluate the citation-grounding layer with a controlled, mechanically scored benchmark (two commercial LLMs, real arXiv papers, no LLM judge): under coverage pressure ungated drafters fabricated up to 25% of their citations and never flagged an evidence gap, whereas the same models under Paper Pilot's evidence-locked rules produced zero fabricated citations and surfaced the planted gaps as explicit placeholders. Preliminary results for result grounding, revision, and adversarial robustness point the same way; full evaluation is left to future work. Paper Pilot positions LLM-assisted writing as a controlled human-AI decision-support process rather than a fully autonomous authorship pipeline.

AI.tldr: Paper Pilot 是一个面向应用科学的人机协同专家系统，通过将协作式智能体推理工程（CARE）方法引入稿件开发，引入所有权审批门、无通过标准、声明分类、审计日志、咨询式 LLM 审阅和证据锁定修订控制，从而实现可证据溯源的科学手稿生成。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体日益嵌入文献分析、撰写和审阅等科学工作流，现有系统虽能推进自主发现与手稿生成，但当思想、方法、结果和声明在缺乏强制人工审批和工件级溯源的 AI 辅助工作流中传播时，会引发严重的治理问题。
AI.method: 将 CARE 方法论适配到手稿开发流程，在从想法到声明的全流程中定义八个审批门，区分文献依据型声明与工件依据型声明，要求报告的数字和解释必须可溯源至已批准的证据，并整合显式不通过标准、声明分类、审计日志、咨询式 LLM 审阅和证据锁定修订控制；系统提示词开源发布，可部署于 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 或机构 LLM 环境。
AI.result: 以受控、机械评分的基准（两个商用 LLM、真实 arXiv 论文、无 LLM 评委）对引文依据层进行首次实证验证：在覆盖压力下，无门控的系统最多捏造 25% 的引文且从不标记证据缺口；而同样的模型在 Paper Pilot 的证据锁定规则下产生零捏造引文，并将植入的缺口显式呈现为占位符。结果依据、修订和对抗鲁棒性的初步结果也指向相同方向。
AI.conclusion: Paper Pilot 将 LLM 辅助写作定位为受控的人机决策支持过程，而非完全自主的作者流水线，为 AI 辅助科研写作提供了可治理、可追溯的框架。

title: Fair Division of Graphs: Beyond Traceability
summary:
In this paper, we study fair division problems in which resources are structured as graphs and agents must receive connected bundles. This connectivity requirement fundamentally alters the problem, making it significantly more challenging than its classical counterpart. We focus on the fairness notion of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$, where envy can be eliminated by removing at most one vertex whose deletion does not disconnect the bundle -- a critical constraint for applications such as land division and network allocation.
  Our first result extends prior work by establishing the existence of $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocations for an infinite family of non-traceable graphs (that is, graphs that do not admit a Hamiltonian path), answering a central open question and generalizing Bilò et al.'s result for traceable graphs. We then make progress on a conjecture concerning the $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ spectrum of trees due to Chen and Zwicker. Finally, we complement our structural results with algorithmic insights, showing that deciding the existence of an $\mathrm{EF1}_{\mathrm{outer}}$ allocation is NP-complete even for binary additive valuations, thereby resolving an open complexity question. Taken together, our results deepen the connection between graph theory and fair division, and offer new tools for studying fairness in structured resource environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图结构资源上的公平分配问题，要求每个智能体获得连通子图，并聚焦于EF1_outer公平性概念。主要成果包括：将EF1_outer分配的存在性从可迹图推广到无限族非可迹图，回答了核心开放问题；在Chen和Zwicker关于树的EF1_outer谱猜想上取得进展；并证明即使在二元加性估值下，判定EF1_outer分配是否存在也是NP完全的，解决了开放复杂度问题。
AI.motivation: 经典公平分配问题在加入"连通性"约束后变得显著更具挑战性，而连通性约束在土地分割、网络资源分配等实际应用中不可或缺。此前仅知可迹图（存在哈密顿路径的图）上EF1_outer分配一定存在，非可迹图的情形是核心开放问题；同时树的EF1_outer谱猜想与相关判定的计算复杂性也尚待解决。
AI.method: 本文采用构造性图论方法与复杂性归约相结合的手段：其一，通过构造性证明将EF1_outer分配存在性推广到无限族非可迹图；其二，针对树的EF1_outer谱猜想给出部分进展；其三，通过从已知NP难问题归约，证明在二元加值估值下判定EF1_outer分配存在性为NP完全。
AI.result: (1) 建立了无限族非可迹图上EF1_outer分配的存在性，推广了Bilò等人关于可迹图的结果；(2) 在Chen和Zwicker关于树的EF1_outer谱猜想上取得进展；(3) 证明二元加性估值下EF1_outer分配的存在性判定是NP完全的。
AI.conclusion: 本文深化了图论与公平分配之间的联系，为结构化资源环境中的公平性研究提供了新工具，并通过回答存在性、谱猜想与复杂度三个层面的开放问题，系统推进了连通公平分配（EF1_outer）的理论基础。

title: Linear Coding of LTI Sources Over Vector Gaussian Channels: A Majorization Approach
summary: We study the design of linear time-invariant (LTI) encoder-decoder pairs for transmitting the state of a discrete-time LTI vector source over power-constrained parallel Gaussian channels with feedback. Two types of power constraints are considered. Under individual subchannel power constraints, a necessary and sufficient condition for designing an encoder-decoder pair that achieves bounded estimation error covariance (EEC) is established via two coupled majorization inequalities involving the subchannel signal-to-noise ratios and the antistable poles of the source. Under total channel power constraint, we derive the minimum total power required for a feasible encoder-decoder design by exploiting partial-order progamming under majorization order. An analytical optimal power allocation is obtained for the case of equal noise variances, which admits a water-filling interpretation; for general noise case, a sequential water-filling algorithm is developed. Our results reveal that the difficulty of transmitting a discrete-time LTI source via LTI coding is governed not only by its topological entropy, but also by the evenness of the log-magnitudes of its antistable poles. The design methods for feasible encoder-decoder pairs are also provided.

AI.tldr: 研究在线性时不变(LTI)编解码器设计下，通过带功率约束的并行高斯反馈信道传输离散时间LTI向量源状态的问题，给出有界估计误差协方差(EEC)的充要条件、最小总功率及最优功率分配方案。
AI.motivation: 研究LTI编解码器在功率受限并行高斯反馈信道上传输LTI源状态的设计问题，旨在刻画可达到有界估计误差的编码条件，并理解系统传输难度由哪些源与信道特性共同决定。
AI.method: 针对两类功率约束分别处理：在单个子信道功率约束下，通过两个耦合的majorization不等式给出了实现有界EEC的充要条件；在总功率约束下，利用偏序规划(majorization序)求出可行设计所需的最小总功率，并在等噪声方差情形下得到具有注水解释的解析最优功率分配，对一般噪声情形开发了序贯注水算法。
AI.result: 建立了有界EEC的充要条件（耦合majorization不等式）；给出了最小总功率的求解方法、等噪声方差下的解析最优功率分配（注水解释）及一般噪声下的序贯注水算法；并证明传输难度不仅取决于源拓扑熵，还取决于反稳定极点对数幅值的“均匀性”。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了LTI编码传输LTI源的难度由拓扑熵与反稳定极点对数幅值的均匀性共同决定，并提供了可行的编解码器设计方法。

title: AdaptAV: Continuous Adaption of Vision Models for Autonomous Vehicles Using Cloud-based Oracle
summary: Deploying vision perception models in autonomous vehicles requires that we prioritize inference speeds, resulting in a model with shallower architectures and lesser model parameters (i.e., more pruned). Such small models do not generalize well, which could result in poor performance when encountered with novel scenarios. We propose a system that overcomes this by continuously retraining the vision models on the cloud with data uploaded by vehicles. We leverage the abundant compute resources, including machine learning accelerators, of the cloud to run a highly-accurate oracle model that will guide the retraining process of the on-vehicle model. This newly trained model is transmitted to the vehicle over the network and is utilized by the vehicle for perceptions, leading to improved inference accuracy over time.

AI.tldr: 提出一种云-车协同的连续重训练系统：利用云端算力运行高精度oracle模型，引导对车载轻量视觉模型的持续重训练，并将更新后的模型下发至车辆，随时间逐步提升推理精度。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中的车载视觉感知模型须优先满足推理速度，因此架构较浅、参数量少（剪枝程度高），这类小模型泛化能力不足，在遇到新场景时性能会下降。
AI.method: 构建云端持续重训练系统：车辆将数据上传云端，利用云端丰富算力（包括机器学习加速器）运行高精度的oracle模型，以oracle模型的输出作为指导，对车载模型进行重训练；训练完成后的模型通过网络传输回车辆并在车上部署使用。
AI.result: 车载模型随重训练不断更新，推理精度随时间推移逐步提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过云端oracle引导的持续重训练机制，能够在不牺牲车载推理速度的前提下，弥补小模型泛化能力不足的问题，实现车载视觉感知精度的持续改善。

title: Asymmetric Within-Document Predictive Learning for Scientific Document Representation
summary: We study predictive pretraining for scientific document representation using the discourse structure of papers. We propose SciJEPA, a citation-free framework that learns through asymmetric within-document prediction: title and abstract representations are used to predict method representations, and method representations are used to predict conclusion representations. Experiments on RELISH, high-influence citation, SciDocs, and cite prediction show that plain predictive training is viable but weaker than a controlled contrastive baseline using the same section pairs. Adding Sliced Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg) substantially improves performance and narrows this gap. The effect of regularization is task-dependent: moderate SIGReg helps fine-grained ranking, while stronger regularization can weaken local alignment. We further show that different encoding branches support different retrieval regimes. These results position within-document predictive learning as a promising citation-free complement for scientific document representation, provided that embedding geometry is carefully controlled.

AI.tldr: 提出SciJEPA——一种无需引用信息的科学文档表示学习框架，利用论文的话语结构进行不对称的文档内预测（标题+摘要预测方法部分，方法部分预测结论），并引入切片各向同性高斯正则化（SIGReg）以控制嵌入几何结构，从而缩小与对比学习基线之间的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 科学文档表示学习通常依赖引用关系或对比学习，但引用信息并非总是可用，且对比学习对负样本构造敏感。作者希望探索一种无需引用的、基于论文本身话语结构（标题/摘要→方法→结论）的预测式预训练方式，并研究其可行性与内在局限。
AI.method: 提出SciJEPA框架：采用非对称的文档内预测任务，即用标题与摘要的表示预测方法部分的表示，再用方法部分的表示预测结论部分的表示。同时引入切片各向同性高斯正则化（SIGReg）来约束嵌入空间的几何结构，并通过受控的对比学习基线（使用相同的段落对）进行公平比较。
AI.result: 在RELISH、高影响力引用、SciDocs和引用预测等任务上，纯预测式训练可行但弱于使用相同段落对的受控对比基线；加入SIGReg后性能显著提升并缩小了这一差距。正则化效果具有任务依赖性：中等强度的SIGReg有利于细粒度排序，过强的正则化会削弱局部对齐；不同编码分支分别支持不同的检索模式。
AI.conclusion: 文档内预测学习可作为有前景的无引用科学文档表示方法，是对引用/对比方法的有力补充；其成功关键在于仔细控制嵌入几何结构（如通过SIGReg），否则预测式训练的性能优势无法充分体现。

title: Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Straggler Setting
summary:
Coded computing has emerged as a powerful paradigm for mitigating the impact of straggling workers in distributed computing systems. However, existing coded-computing schemes are predominantly designed for the exact recovery of highly structured computations, such as polynomial evaluation and matrix multiplication, and typically rely on strict recovery thresholds. These assumptions significantly limit their applicability to modern machine-learning workloads, particularly deep neural networks (DNNs), whose computations generally lack rigid algebraic structure and, in many applications, require only accurate approximations rather than exact recovery.
  To address this gap, we revisit coded computing from a learning-theoretic perspective and introduce General Coded Computing (GCC). Rather than adopting existing algebraic tools, GCC formulates coded computing through a natural end-to-end mean-squared error loss that directly measures the discrepancy between the desired computations and their recovered estimates. By deriving suitable upper bounds and restricting the encoder and decoder to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with mild smoothness constraints, we show that both the encoder and decoder admit specific representations as linear combinations of RKHS kernel functions. This representation allows the corresponding coefficients to be computed efficiently. Moreover, this framework enables us to establish theoretical performance guarantees for GCC under two complementary straggler regimes. In the worst-case setting with $N$ worker nodes, and at most $S$ stragglers, we show that the end-to-end loss decays at least at rate $O(S^3N^{-3})$ for standard configurations. We then study a probabilistic setting in which each worker independently straggles with probability $p$. We prove that the expected loss can still converge at rate $O(\log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用编码计算（GCC）框架，从学习理论视角重新审视编码计算，用端到端均方误差损失替代传统精确恢复的代数工具，将编解码器限制在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中，并证明在两种滞后者（straggler）场景下损失分别以O(S^3N^{-3})和O(log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})的速率衰减，从而将编码计算扩展至深度神经网络等近似计算任务。
AI.motivation: 现有编码计算方案主要为多项式求值、矩阵乘法等具有严格代数结构的计算设计，依赖精确恢复和严格恢复阈值，难以适用于深度神经网络等缺乏代数结构、且只需精确近似而非精确恢复的现代机器学习任务。
AI.method: GCC 将编码计算建模为端到端的均方误差损失，直接度量期望计算与恢复估计之间的差异；通过推导合适的损失上界，并将编码器和解码器限制在具有温和光滑性约束的 RKHS 中，证明两者均可表示为 RKHS 核函数的线性组合，从而可高效求解对应系数，并基于此建立理论性能保证。
AI.result: 在最坏情况下（N个worker、至多S个滞后者），端到端损失以O(S^3N^{-3})的速率衰减；在概率场景下（每个worker以概率p独立滞后），期望损失以O(log_{1/p}^3(N)N^{-3})的速率收敛。
AI.conclusion: GCC 通过将编码计算纳入学习理论框架，摆脱了对严格代数结构与精确恢复的依赖，在两种补性的滞后者场景下均提供了理论保证，显著扩展了编码计算对现代机器学习工作负载（尤其是 DNN）的适用性。

title: Sensitivity Hot Spot Penalization: A Robust Topology Optimization Framework against First-Order Worst-Case Perturbations
summary:
Deterministic topology optimization can efficiently generate high-performance structural designs, but it does not explicitly control localized fragility induced by manufacturing variations and geometric uncertainties. Such fragility often appears as stress concentrations or hinge-like deformation mechanisms. Conventional robust topology optimization can suppress these features, but typically requires multiple design realizations and substantially increased computational cost. Recent work by Sigmund et al. (2026) introduced sensitivity hot spot penalization (SHoSP), which augments the nominal objective by a smooth maximum of its sensitivities and suppresses localized fragile features at low additional cost while promoting more even stress distributions.
  This paper establishes a general connection between SHoSP and a first-order worst-case robust approximation under a material-mass perturbation budget using a Taylor expansion and H{"o}lder's duality. The original penalty weight is identified as a dimensionless norm-bounded perturbation budget relative to the area (2D) or volume (3D) of the design domain. This interpretation explains the suppression of sensitivity hot spots, hinge localization, and stress concentrations by limiting the maximum first-order degradation under budgeted perturbations. It is investigated for compliance minimization and compliant mechanism design. Robustness is assessed using a relaxed worst-case density perturbation and by comparing deterministic and SHoSP designs under equivalent perturbation budgets. Stress-related effects observed on structured meshes are cross-validated by stress-oriented topology optimization and body-fitted finite element analyses. Extensions to porous infill optimization, multiple load cases, and large-scale 3D examples further demonstrate the applicability and superior scalability of the SHoSP framework.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了灵敏度热点惩罚（SHoSP）与基于材料质量扰动预算的一阶最坏情况鲁棒近似之间的通用联系，利用泰勒展开与Hölder对偶性将惩罚权重解释为相对设计域面积/体积的无量纲范数有界扰动预算，并以较低的计算成本抑制灵敏度热点、铰链局部化和应力集中，适用于柔顺性最小化、柔顺机构设计、多孔填充、多荷载工况及大规模三维拓扑优化。
AI.motivation: 确定性拓扑优化虽能高效生成高性能结构设计，但无法显式控制由制造变异和几何不确定性导致的局部脆弱性（如应力集中或铰链式变形机制）；传统鲁棒拓扑优化虽能抑制这些特征，但需要多个设计实现，计算成本显著增加。SHoSP方法能以低额外成本抑制局部脆弱特征，但其理论基础尚不明确，本文旨在建立SHoSP与最坏情况鲁棒优化之间的通用联系。
AI.method: 通过泰勒展开和Hölder对偶性，将SHoSP目标函数（名义目标加上其灵敏度的光滑最大值）证明为在材料质量扰动预算下的一阶最坏情况鲁棒近似；将原始惩罚权重识别为相对设计域面积（2D）或体积（3D）的无量纲范数有界扰动预算。研究针对柔顺性最小化和柔顺机构设计展开，采用松弛的最坏情况密度扰动评估鲁棒性，并在等效扰动预算下比较确定性设计与SHoSP设计；应力相关效应通过应力导向拓扑优化和贴体有限元分析交叉验证，并扩展到多孔填充优化、多荷载工况及大规模三维算例。
AI.result: 该方法通过限制有界扰动下的一阶最大退化，解释了SHoSP对灵敏度热点、铰链局部化和应力集中的抑制机制；同时促使应力分布更均匀。数值实验验证了该解释，并展示了SHoSP框架在多孔填充、多荷载工况和大型三维问题中的广泛适用性与优越的可扩展性，且计算成本远低于传统鲁棒优化。
AI.conclusion: SHoSP本质上是一种基于材料质量扰动预算的一阶最坏情况鲁棒近似，其惩罚权重对应无量纲扰动预算；这一理论联系在保证低计算开销的同时有效抑制局部脆弱特征，为大规模鲁棒拓扑优化提供了一种可解释、可扩展的实用框架。

title: The Race between Agentic AI Capabilities and Data Quality Control in Online Surveys
summary: Online surveys are a foundational data collection instrument in a variety of fields, with attention checks serving as critical guardians of response quality. However, the rapid emergence of agentic AI (goal directed systems powered by a large language model (LLM) brain and/or a multimodal processing unit with tool-augmented capabilities) raises new questions about the robustness of these safeguards. We investigate how well agentic AI architectures can complete web-based surveys and pass standard attention checks. We evaluate a single-agent architecture capable of multimodal input processing and tool-based web interaction on a controlled survey sandbox. We analyze the problem from two perspectives. From an attack perspective, we demonstrate how structural vulnerabilities such as exposed DOM metadata and predictable option encoding allow agents to resolve attention checks through structured parsing only. From a defense perspective, we implement a mitigation strategy of DOM metadata obfuscation to remove semantic cues in text-based questions. We evaluate multiple open-source language and multimodal models to study capability and orchestration effectiveness. Based on our evaluations, we offer perspectives on how to simultaneously meet the needs of empiricists and agentic AI researchers.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了具备多模态输入处理和工具化网页交互能力的单智能体AI架构能否完成基于网页的调查问卷并通过标准注意力检查，并从攻击与防御两个视角分别验证了结构化解析漏洞和DOM元数据混淆缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 在线问卷是多个领域的核心数据收集工具，注意力检查是保障回答质量的关键。然而，以大语言模型为大脑、具备多模态处理与工具增强能力的agentic AI快速涌现，使得这些保障机制面临新的可靠性挑战，因此需要系统评估其影响。
AI.method: 在受控的调查沙盒环境中，评估一个支持多模态输入和基于工具进行网页交互的单智能体架构。一方面从攻击视角展示暴露的DOM元数据和可预测的选项编码等结构性漏洞如何使智能体仅通过结构化解析即可通过注意力检查；另一方面从防御视角实施DOM元数据混淆策略以移除文本问题中的语义线索，并评测多个开源语言模型与多模态模型的能力及编排有效性。
AI.result: 实验证明agentic AI能够利用结构性漏洞绕过注意力检查，且DOM元数据混淆策略可有效削弱此类攻击；不同开源模型在能力与编排效果上存在差异，评估结果支持防御与攻击两方面的结论。
AI.conclusion: 基于评估结果，作者就如何同时满足实证研究者（保障数据质量）与agentic AI研究者（推动智能体发展）的需求提出了相应观点与建议。

title: Learning Proportional Committees from Violation Feedback
summary:
We study violation-feedback learning of proportionally representative approval-based committees. In each round, a learner proposes a committee of size $k$. An oracle either accepts the proposal or adversarially selects a representation violation with respect to a single fixed hidden approval profile. We compare \emph{full-witness feedback}, which reveals the violation level, an omitted candidate, and the affected voter group, with \emph{candidate-only feedback}, which reveals only that candidate. The target notions are proportional justified representation plus (PJR+) and extended justified representation plus (EJR+).
  In every setting we study, the number of rejected proposals can be bounded solely in terms of $k$, with no dependence on the numbers of voters and candidates. For PJR+, the optimal deterministic and randomized rejection complexities equal $k$ under both feedback models. For EJR+, the picture is more nuanced. Under full-witness feedback, we prove an $Ω(k^{3/2})$ deterministic lower bound and give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm using $O(k^2\log k)$ rejections. Under candidate-only feedback, randomization achieves $O(k^2\log k)$ expected rejections via uniform random deletion, while deterministic exhaustive branching gives a $2^{O(k^2(\log k)^2)}$ rejection bound. Even with full-witness feedback, randomized learners may require $k$ rejections.

AI.tldr: 本文研究投票者针对固定隐藏偏好档案提供"违规反馈"的按比例代表制审批委员会学习问题。学习者每轮提出规模为k的委员会，接受或拒绝取决于是否存在代表性的违规；论文对比了揭示违规级别、被遗漏候选人和受影响选民群体的全见证反馈与仅揭示候选人的仅候选人反馈两种模式，并针对PJR+与EJR+两种目标定义给出了只依赖于k（而与选民数、候选人数无关）的拒绝次数界：PJR+在两种反馈下最优确定性与随机化拒绝复杂度均为k；EJR+在全见证反馈下有Ω(k^{3/2})确定性下界及O(k²log k)的确定性多项式时间算法，在仅候选人反馈下随机化可达到O(k²log k)期望拒绝次数，确定性穷举分支则需2^{O(k²(log k)²)}次拒绝。
AI.motivation: 在比例代表制审批委员会中，如何仅通过少量"被拒绝的提案"（违规反馈）来学习一个未知的、满足PJR+或EJR+等强代表性概念的委员会，是一个兼具学习理论与社会选择意义的开放问题。关键在于确定需要多少次拒绝才能确定目标委员会，且希望这一复杂度不依赖于选民与候选人的规模，而只与委员会规模k相关。
AI.method: 论文在两种反馈模型下分别设计算法并证明下界：对PJR+给出确定性/随机化达到k次拒绝的最优算法；对EJR+在全见证反馈下构造确定性多项式时间算法（O(k²log k)次拒绝）并证明Ω(k^{3/2})下界；在仅候选人反馈下采用均匀随机删除（O(k²log k)期望拒绝次数）以及确定性穷举分支（2^{O(k²(log k)²)}次拒绝）等方法。
AI.result: 所有场景中拒绝次数均可仅由k界定，与选民数和候选人数无关。PJR+在两种反馈模型下的最优确定性和随机化拒绝复杂度均为k；EJR+在全见证反馈下确定性下界为Ω(k^{3/2})，且存在O(k²log k)次拒绝的确定性多项式时间算法；仅候选人反馈下随机化算法期望O(k²log k)次拒绝，确定性穷举分支需2^{O(k²(log k)²)}次拒绝；即使在全见证反馈下，随机化学习者仍可能需要k次拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统刻画了比例代表性（PJR+与EJR+）在违规反馈学习框架下的样本（拒绝）复杂度，揭示了不同反馈信息量与随机化对学习效率的影响：PJR+已达到最优（k），而EJR+的复杂度介于多项式与超多项式之间，说明更强的代表性概念需要更多或更复杂的查询。这些结果为审批委员会学习提供了理论基石，也为设计具有代表性的比例委员会算法（在仅依赖候选级别反馈、甚至缺乏完整见证信息的场景）给出了新途径。

title: A General Plotkin-type Bound on Function-Correcting Codes with Wyner-Graham Distance
summary: Function correcting codes (FCCs) are designed to protect a specified function evaluation of messages at a higher level than the level of protection for messages, against errors while reducing the redundancy required for reliable communication. FCCs have thus far been studied for channels matched to various distances, including the Hamming and Lee distances. Every function partitions the message space into preimage sets corresponding to its distinct function values. Existing Plotkin-type bounds on the optimal redundancy of FCCs under the studied distances, applicable to arbitrary functions on the message space, depend on the pairwise distances among all the message vectors. This makes these bounds difficult to compute. We derive a general Plotkin-type bound on the optimal redundancy of FCCs under Wyner Graham distances, which include the Hamming and Lee distances as special cases. Our bound depends only on the cardinalities of the preimage sets and the sum of pairwise distances only among vectors within each preimage set. This approach significantly reduces the computations required to evaluate the existing Plotkin-type bounds and yields simplified bounds that are easier to compute for specific functions. We obtain simplified Plotkin-type bound for linear functions under the Wyner-Graham distance. Furthermore, the existing simplified bounds for linear functions under the Hamming and Lee distances are recovered as special cases of the proposed bound. We also obtain simplified bounds for several important classes of functions, including the Hamming weight function, the Hamming weight distribution function, the monomial functions under the Hamming distance, and the modular sum function, the Lee weight function, and the Lee weight distribution function under the Lee distance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对函数纠错码（FCCs）在Wyner-Graham距离下的最优冗余度，推导出一种通用的Plotkin型下界。该下界仅依赖于消息空间在函数作用下各原像集的基数以及各原像集内部向量之间的两两距离之和，而不再依赖所有消息向量之间的两两距离，从而大幅降低了计算复杂度。该下界将Hamming距离与Lee距离作为特例包含在内，并为线性函数、Hamming重量函数、Hamming重量分布函数、单项式函数、模和函数、Lee重量函数及Lee重量分布函数等给出了简化形式，同时恢复了现有Hamming与Lee距离下的已知简化界。
AI.motivation: 函数纠错码（FCCs）旨在以高于消息本身保护级别的方式来保护特定函数求值结果，并降低可靠通信所需的冗余。然而，现有适用于任意函数的Plotkin型最优冗余下界依赖于消息空间中所有消息向量之间的两两距离，这使得这些界的计算非常困难，难以应用。
AI.method: 作者在包含Hamming距离和Lee距离作为特例的Wyner-Graham距离下，导出了一个通用的Plotkin型下界。该下界仅依赖于函数各原像集的基数以及各原像集内部向量间的两两距离之和，显著简化了原有界的计算；并针对线性函数及Hamming/Lee距离下的多种重要函数类分别给出了简化界。
AI.result: 所提出的下界显著减少了评估现有Plotkin型界所需的计算量，给出了更易计算的简化形式；针对Wyner-Graham距离下的线性函数得到了简化Plotkin型界，并作为特例恢复了Hamming与Lee距离下已有的简化界；同时为Hamming重量函数、Hamming重量分布函数、Hamming距离下的单项式函数，以及Lee距离下的模和函数、Lee重量函数和Lee重量分布函数等给出了简化界。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于Wyner-Graham距离的通用Plotkin型下界，通过仅依赖原像集基数和原像集内部距离而非全体消息向量间的距离，有效降低了对FCCs最优冗余度进行界定的计算代价，统一并推广了Hamming与Lee距离下的现有结果，为各类具体函数的冗余分析提供了更简便的依据。

title: Multi-exposure HDR Imaging: A Review of Pixel-level and Feature-level Reconstruction Methods
summary: Multi-exposure is an efficient way to capture real-world high-dynamic-range (HDR) scenes. However, HDR imaging suffers from severe ghosting artifacts in dynamic scenes due to the temporal gap between sequential exposures. In this article, we categorize the literature on two important topics on HDR imaging: multi-exposure fusion (MEF) and ghost removal. Conventional filter-based and data-driven methods are studied in pixel space and feature space. For popular deep learning-based approaches, we provide a granular taxonomy based on their alignment and fusion domains: pixel-space methods, which typically employ explicit motion compensation such as optical flow or spatial transformers, and feature-space methods, which leverage implicit alignment through deformable convolutions, attention mechanisms, or latent representation merging. Representative works are compared across different supervision settings, and key design principles are summarized. In addition, this survey summarizes commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, discussing their applicability under diverse output forms. Finally, major bottlenecks and promising directions for future research are outlined.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于高动态范围（HDR）成像的综述，聚焦多曝光融合（MEF）与鬼影去除两大主题，从像素空间与特征空间对传统滤波方法与深度学习方法进行细粒度分类，并总结数据集、评估指标及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 多曝光是捕获真实世界HDR场景的有效方式，但由于连续曝光之间存在时间间隔，动态场景下的HDR成像会出现严重的鬼影伪影，需要系统梳理现有融合与鬼影去除方法。
AI.method: 对MEF与鬼影去除相关文献进行分类研究：涵盖像素空间与特征空间中的传统滤波方法和数据驱动方法；为深度学习方法提供基于对齐与融合域的细粒度分类法（像素空间方法采用光流或空间变换器等显式运动补偿，特征空间方法通过可变形卷积、注意力机制或潜在表示融合实现隐式对齐）；在不同监督设置下比较代表性工作并总结关键设计原则，同时汇总常用数据集与评估指标。
AI.result: 给出了全面的方法分类体系与代表性工作的对比分析，总结了关键设计原则，梳理了常用数据集与评估指标及其在不同输出形式下的适用性，并指出了主要瓶颈与有前景的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为HDR成像中的MEF与鬼影去除提供了系统化的分类框架与对比总结，明确了当前研究的关键设计原则、资源（数据集与指标）以及亟待解决的瓶颈，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Do large language models scrutinise what they review? A multimodal audit of scoring calibration, error detection, and author-identity effects
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate peer reviews, prompting examination of their capacity for critical evaluation. This study evaluates two multimodal LLMs, Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Pixtral-Large-124B, as reviewers across 165 submissions to the 2026 International Conference on Learning Representations, a venue that postdates both models' training cutoffs. Manuscripts were presented to both models with author identities blinded, replaced with high-prestige affiliations, or replaced with low-prestige affiliations, and in either text-only or text-with-figure format. Additionally, 145 verifiably detectable errors were inserted into 55 manuscripts to assess error identification under natural and verification-oriented prompts. Across all manuscript groups, including rejected submissions, LLM scores ranged from 7.0 to 8.1, whereas human mean scores ranged from 3.4 to 6.8. The models detected 12.1\% of the verified errors under natural prompting, and a one-sentence verification instruction increased detection to 22.2\%; however, 78\% of the errors remained undetected. Providing figures reduced error detection while increasing review scores. No visual error was reliably verified against its corresponding figure, and half of the text-only reviews described figures that were not provided. Author identity did not influence either review scores or error detection. LLM editorial decisions exactly matched those produced by simple score averaging.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B两个多模态LLM在165篇ICLR 2026投稿（均晚于模型训练截止时间）中的审稿表现，发现LLM评分（7.0–8.1）远高于人类（3.4–6.8），自然提示下仅识别12.1%的注入错误（验证提示下升至22.2%），提供图片反而降低错误检出率并提高评分，半数纯文本审稿会描述并不存在的图片，作者身份不影响评分。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于生成同行评审意见，但其批判性评估能力值得检验；作者身份、图表信息、提示方式等因素是否影响LLM评审质量尚不清楚，需要系统评估。
AI.method: 选取两个多模态LLM（Qwen2.5-VL-72B和Pixtral-Large-124B）对165篇ICLR 2026投稿（均晚于模型训练截止时间）进行评审。操纵条件包括：隐藏作者身份、替换为高/低声望机构、以纯文本或文本加图片形式呈现稿件；同时在55篇手稿中注入145个可验证的错误，在自然提示与强调验证的提示下测试错误识别能力。
AI.result: 在所有稿件组（含被拒稿件）中，LLM评分区间为7.0–8.1，而人类均分为3.4–6.8；自然提示下模型检出12.1%的已验证错误，加一句话验证指令后检出率升至22.2%，但仍有78%错误未被发现。提供图片降低了错误检出率却提高了评审分数；没有视觉错误能可靠地对照对应图片得到验证，且半数纯文本评审描述了未提供的图片。作者身份对评分和错误检出均无影响；LLM的编辑决策与简单评分平均得出的结果完全一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM目前缺乏可靠、关键的同行评审能力：评分系统性偏高、错误检出率低、易产生关于图片的幻觉，且其决策机制退化为简单的分数平均，不具备人类审稿人的批判性判断力。

title: SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in generation-time quantization and multi-turn dialogue and transfers to Mistral-7B. The cliff reframes importance-aware mixed precision: above it, eight model-internal importance indicators are statistically interchangeable, so the benefit of mixing is grid interpolation, reaching average precisions uniform quantization cannot realize. SemKV preserves every token, ranks tokens by a model-internal score, and assigns two adjacent above-cliff precisions, achieving a measured 6.0x storage reduction with no statistically detectable quality difference from full KV (n=900, three seeds), and outperforming FP16 token pruning granted a 1.5x larger memory budget. Replacing the affine base with a distortion-optimized quantizer (TurboQuant-MSE) lowers the cliff in every protocol tested, raising the no-detectable-loss operating point to 7.9x. The recipe: measure the cliff for the target deployment setting, then interpolate above it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多随机种子统计协议发现，KV缓存均匀量化存在“质量悬崖”：在2.0到2.322位区间内，模型从统计上与FP16不可区分直接崩塌（Llama-3.1-8B在2.322位仍无差异、2.0位崩溃），且该现象在生成时量化、多轮对话中重现并迁移至Mistral-7B。基于此，论文提出“测量悬崖、在悬崖之上插值”的配方：重要性感知混合精度在悬崖之上等价于网格插值。据此设计的SemKV保留全部token、按模型内部得分排序并分配两个相邻的高于悬崖的精度，实测实现6.0x存储压缩且与全精度KV无可检测统计差异（n=900，三种子）；将仿射量化器替换为失真优化的TurboQuant-MSE可进一步降低悬崖，将无损失工作点提升至7.9x。
AI.motivation: KV缓存是长上下文大模型推理的主导内存瓶颈，随上下文长度线性增长，因此压缩KV缓存至关重要。然而论文发现均匀量化在分数位网格上并不会优雅地退化：存在一个质量悬崖区间(2.0, 2.322]，导致性能从与FP16统计不可区分骤降至崩溃，这为量化方案设计（尤其是重要性感知混合精度）带来了根本性的新约束与机遇。
AI.method: 提出一套可复现的多种子统计协议来精确定位“质量悬崖”（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct仿射量化器在≤2.322位与FP16不可区分、2.0位崩溃）。基于“悬崖之上各重要性指标统计上可互换、混合精度收益仅是网格插值”的发现，设计SemKV：保留全部token，用模型内部得分排序，并为token分配两个相邻且都高于悬崖的精度。此外，将仿射基底替换为失真优化的量化器TurboQuant-MSE以降低悬崖位置。
AI.result: SemKV在保留全部token的前提下实现了实测6.0x存储压缩，且与全精度KV无可检测的统计质量差异（n=900、三种子），并以1.5x更小的内存预算超越FP16 token剪枝方法；改用TurboQuant-MSE后，无检测损失工作点提升至7.9x压缩。
AI.conclusion: 核心配方是：先针对目标部署场景测量质量悬崖，然后在悬崖之上的精度网格中进行插值（混合精度）。这一视角将“重要性感知”重新定义为高于悬崖的精度间插值，而非试图在悬崖处挽救性能，为KV缓存量化的实际部署提供了简单且可验证的设计准则。

title: Domain-Grounded Tool Orchestration for LLM-Guided Scientific Analysis
summary: Scientific analysis workflows encode deep domain knowledge through sequences of tightly coupled operations where correctness depends on tool selection, execution order, and parameterization. A CFD engineer investigating flow separation must extract wall shear stress, identify zero-crossings in skin friction, and confirm with boundary-layer profiles: a chain that requires both domain expertise and proficiency with visualization tools. Current approaches to LLM-assisted scientific visualization generate scripts that encode this knowledge implicitly, and often incorrectly, producing code that executes but yields wrong results. We present an architecture that separates intent interpretation (LLM) from execution (deterministic domain tools) from explanation (LLM), connected by the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and grounded by domain ontologies that constrain planning to valid analysis chains. We instantiate the architecture in two domains on the same ParaView server infrastructure: computational fluid dynamics post-processing and topological data analysis via the Topology ToolKit (TTK). Adding the second domain required only an ontology and tool wrappers around existing filters, with no change to the architecture, protocol, or deployment. By construction the design removes whole classes of failure that affect script generation (such as API hallucination and missing pipeline stages) and narrows the strategic errors that remain. An ablation across both domains locates the ontology's empirical effect: it does not change which tools the planner selects, which is already reliable, but corrects how the model interprets results, raising interpretation accuracy from 0.41 to 0.91, and only when the relevant fact is retrieved in scoped rather than bulk form. ParaView's client-server model carries analysis to production-scale datasets through a thin browser client.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将意图解释（LLM）、执行（确定性领域工具）与解释（LLM）相分离的科学可视化架构，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）连接各层，并用领域本体约束规划以生成有效的分析链，从而避免脚本生成固有的API幻觉与流水线缺失等错误。该架构在ParaView服务器上实例化于CFD后处理与拓扑数据分析（TTK）两个领域；消融实验表明，本体的作用不在于改变工具选择，而在于以检索范围受限（scoped）的方式提升模型对结果的解释准确率（0.41→0.91）。
AI.motivation: 科学分析工作流以紧耦合的操作序列编码深层领域知识，其正确性依赖工具选择、执行顺序与参数设置。现有LLM辅助科学可视化直接生成脚本，将这些知识隐式且常常错误地嵌入代码，导致代码能运行但结果错误。作者希望消除这类系统性的失败模式，并让LLM仅负责意图与解释，而把执行交由确定性的领域工具完成。
AI.method: 架构将流程分为三层：LLM负责意图解释，确定性领域工具负责执行，LLM再负责结果解释；各层通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）连接，并由领域本体约束规划，使规划被限制在有效的分析链内。该架构在相同的ParaView服务器基础设施上实例化于两个领域：CFD后处理与基于Topology ToolKit（TTK）的拓扑数据分析。新增第二个领域只需提供本体和现有filter的工具包装器，而无需改动架构、协议或部署。ParaView的客户端-服务器模型通过瘦浏览器客户端支撑生产规模数据集。
AI.result: 跨两个领域的消融实验定位了本体的经验效果：它并不改变规划器对工具的选择（该环节已可靠），而是纠正模型对结果的解释方式，将解释准确率从0.41提升至0.91；且仅当相关事实以范围受限（scoped）而非批量（bulk）形式被检索时该提升才出现。
AI.conclusion: 该设计通过构造方式消除了脚本生成中一整类失败（如API幻觉、流水线阶段缺失），并缩小了剩余策略性错误的范围；同时证明领域本体对LLM解释结果起到关键校准作用，而检索范围对本体效果至关重要。架构具备良好的跨领域可迁移性，能够在不改动核心设施的情况下快速扩展到新领域。

title: CDPR: Counterfactual Advantage-based Credit Assignment for Cost-Aware Sequential Medical Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is a step-by-step, cost-aware process: a physician orders examinations one at a time, observes the results, and updates the diagnosis before reaching a final conclusion. Most medical language models instead treat diagnosis as a one-pass classification task and ignore the trade-off between a test's value and its cost. We model diagnosis as a cost-aware sequential decision process and train the policy with reinforcement learning. The main difficulty is credit assignment: the only reliable signal comes once at the end of a long trajectory, so it scores a wasteful workup the same as an efficient one. We propose CDPR (Counterfactual Diagnostic Process Reward), which needs no expert labels and no learned critic. CDPR first finds the states where the policy hesitates, using the uncertainty of its action distribution, and then scores the chosen action by its advantage over the alternatives the policy itself would consider, estimated with short rollouts under a utility that balances correctness against test count, cost, and infeasible requests. A rollout cache reuses within-batch trajectories to keep the cost low. We integrate CDPR into GRPO and test it on one in-domain (MIMIC-IV) and two out-of-domain (ClinicalBench and a private hospital dataset) benchmarks. CDPR improves diagnostic accuracy while clearly reducing the number and cost of examinations.

AI.tldr: 本文将临床诊断建模为考虑成本的顺序决策过程，提出 CDPR（反事实诊断过程奖励）方法，无需专家标签或学习型评论器，通过基于动作分布不确定性的犹豫状态检测与短程 rollout 的优势估计，将奖励整合进 GRPO 训练医学语言模型。在 MIMIC-IV 及两个域外基准上，CDPR 在提升诊断准确率的同时显著减少了检查次数与成本。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断本质上是逐步、考虑成本的决策过程：医生依次选择检查、观察结果并更新判断，需要权衡检查的价值与成本。然而大多数医学语言模型将诊断视为一次性的分类任务，忽略了检查价值与代价之间的权衡，且缺乏专家标签和可用的批评信号。
AI.method: 将诊断建模为成本感知的序列决策过程，并用强化学习训练策略。针对长轨迹末端才出现可靠信号导致的信用分配困难，提出 CDPR：先利用策略动作分布的不确定性找到策略"犹豫"的状态，再通过在平衡正确性、检查次数、成本与不可行请求的效用下进行短 rollout，估计所选动作相对候选替代动作的优势作为奖励；并设置 rollout 缓存以复用批内轨迹来降低计算开销。CDPR 被集成进 GRPO 中，无需专家标签和学习的评论器。
AI.result: 在域内基准 MIMIC-IV 以及两个域外基准（ClinicalBench 和某私立医院数据集）上的实验表明，CDPR 在提升诊断准确率的同时，明显减少了检查的数量与成本。
AI.conclusion: CDPR 通过反事实奖励机制有效缓解了序列诊断中的信用分配问题，在不依赖专家标注和评论器的情况下，同时改善了诊断准确性与检查效率，验证了将临床诊断作为成本感知顺序决策过程建模的有效性。

title: Rival-Injective Allocations: Support-List Structure and Maximum-Anchor EFX$_0$ Certificates
comment: 18 pages, no figures. Includes a statement on human direction, AI contributions, verification, and author responsibility
summary: We study complete allocations under nonnegative additive valuations through the positive supports of goods, focusing on the all-good form of envy-freeness up to any good (EFX$_0$). We define rival-injective (RI) endpoint ownership: every good with nonempty positive support is assigned to an agent who values it positively, and every ordered observer--owner pair is used by at most one good. RI ownership is exactly proper list coloring of the graph joining goods whose positive supports overlap in at least two agents. For pair-supported goods with arbitrary exceptional goods, fixing the exceptional owners yields a necessary-and-sufficient pair-capacity criterion and an exact finite-domain owner constraint satisfaction problem (CSP). Every RI allocation in which each agent's own bundle is worth at least her maximum-valued singleton is all-good EFX$_0$. A specified injective choice of maximum-singleton anchors, together with residual support-list degeneracy, constructs such an allocation by reverse greedy coloring in $O(nm^2)$ time. We give two explicit witness families: a nonempty relatively open, 22-dimensional cone on a fixed $4\times10$ support face, and a family for every $n\ge4$ with two universal-support goods and $m=(n-1)(n-2)+2$ goods. Both fail unanchored list degeneracy and are not implied by the explicit pure-multigraph or published high-girth/controlled-multiplicity hypotheses compared here. We also study recognition of the maximum-anchor certificate class, leaving its general complexity unresolved. The exact list-coloring and pair-capacity results concern RI ownership, not general EFX$_0$ existence; unrestricted four-agent, ten-good all-good EFX$_0$ remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非负可加估值下的完备分配，借助商品的“正支撑”刻画全商品形式的“无嫉妒至任意商品”（EFX_0）。作者提出“竞争单射（RI）端点所有权”刻画，将其等价转化为支撑重叠图的恰当列表染色问题；对“成对支撑商品+任意例外商品”情形给出充要的“对容量”准则及有限域约束满足问题（CSP）。通过最大单例锚的注入选择与残余支撑列表退化性，利用反向贪心染色在O(nm^2)内构造出全商品EFX_0分配。文中还给出两个明确的失败实例族，表明无锚列表退化性不充分，并讨论最大锚证书类的识别问题，但其一般复杂度与四智能体十商品的一般EFX_0存在性仍未解决。
AI.motivation: EFX_0（无嫉妒至任意商品）的完备分配存在性是公平分配领域的关键开放问题。已有研究多依赖强连通性、高围长或受控重数等结构假设，缺乏对“正支撑”这一组合结构本身的系统刻画；本文旨在通过商品正支撑与列表染色之间的对应关系，建立RI所有权与EFX_0之间的桥梁，从而给出可判定、可构造的充分条件，并澄清现有假设的边界。
AI.method: 作者定义RI端点所有权（每个正支撑商品必须分给对它正估值的智能体，且每个有序“观察者—所有者”对至多被一个商品使用），证明RI所有权等价于对“正支撑至少共享两个智能体”的图进行恰当列表染色。对成对支撑商品，固定例外商品所有者后给出“对容量”充要判据及精确的有限域归属CSP。在此框架上，利用最大单例锚的注入选择与残余支撑图列表退化性，通过反向贪心染色构造分配；并用两个可显式构造的实例族（固定4×10支撑面上的22维开锥族、及对每个n≥4的双普适支撑商品族）来检验算法所需假设的紧性。
AI.result: 证明了“每个智能体自持束价值不低于其最大单例价值”的RI分配必为全商品EFX_0，并给出O(nm^2)时间的反向贪心染色构造算法。给出“对容量”充要判据与有限域CSP刻画。构造了两个明确的反例族：非空相对开22维锥（固定4×10支撑面）与n≥4、m=(n-1)(n-2)+2的双普适支撑商品族，二者均不满足无锚列表退化性，也不被显式纯多重图假设或已发表的“高围长/受控重数”假设所蕴含。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立/严格化了RI所有权、恰当列表染色与全商品EFX_0之间的等价与蕴含关系，为EFX_0提供了图论—CSP层面的可判定判据和多项式时间构造算法；同时精确划定了无锚列表退化性假设的边界。作者明确指出这些结果针对RI所有权而非一般EFX_0存在性，且四智能体、十商品一般全商品EFX_0问题仍未解决；最大锚证书类的识别复杂度仍属开放问题，留待后续研究。

title: Multi-Access Speculative Inference: Uplink or Downlink?
summary: Multi-access speculative inference (Multi-SPIN) extends SPIN to multi-device edge networks to accelerate cooperative token generation. It allows on-device small language models (SLMs) to autoregressively draft multiple tokens for individual generation tasks, while an edge-server large language model (LLM) verifies them in parallel. The major communication overhead arises when a drafted token is rejected by the server, in which case sampling the correction token requires access to both the SLM-output draft distribution and the LLM-output target distribution over the full token vocabulary. Existing designs typically perform correction at the server by uploading the draft distribution, but transmitting a vocabulary-wide distribution creates a critical uplink (UL) bottleneck. Alternatively, the correction can be performed at the device by downloading the target distribution, leveraging the high transmission rates available on the downlink (DL). Motivated by this insight, we introduce communication-mode selection as a new design dimension for Multi-SPIN. Specifically, each device can adaptively switch between the UL and DL modes to balance the UL bottleneck against the shared DL resource constraint, thereby relieving the overall communication burden. We formulate a sum-token-goodput maximization problem that jointly accounts for mode selection, draft-length control, and power allocation. For mode selection, we reveal a simple optimal structure that enables efficient search over the number of UL devices, with the corresponding transmit powers optimized accordingly. For draft-length control, we develop a greedy-search algorithm that adapts device-specific draft lengths to heterogeneous computation and communication capabilities. Experimental results on Qwen2.5 and DeepSeek-R1 model pairs demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves token goodput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多接入投机推理（Multi-SPIN），将SPIN扩展到多设备边缘网络，并引入通信模式选择（上行UL/下行DL）这一新设计维度，联合优化模式选择、草稿长度控制与功率分配，以缓解上行瓶颈并提升整体令牌吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 在设备端小语言模型（SLM）草稿、边缘服务器大语言模型（LLM）并行验证的投机推理中，主要通信开销出现在草稿令牌被拒绝时：修正令牌的采样需要同时访问SLM的草稿分布和LLM的目标分布（覆盖整个词表）。现有方案通常在服务器端执行修正，但上传词表级分布会造成严重的上行链路（UL）瓶颈；反之在设备端修正需下载目标分布，但可借助下行链路（DL）的高传输速率。因此需要权衡UL瓶颈与共享DL资源约束，以减轻整体通信负担。
AI.method: 将通信模式选择作为Multi-SPIN的新设计维度，使每个设备可在UL与DL模式间自适应切换；构建联合考虑模式选择、草稿长度控制和功率分配的求和令牌有效吞吐量（sum-token-goodput）最大化问题。对模式选择揭示了一种简单的最优结构，从而可高效搜索UL设备数量并相应优化发射功率；对草稿长度控制设计了贪心搜索算法，使设备特定草稿长度适配异构的计算与通信能力。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5与DeepSeek-R1模型对上进行的实验表明，所提框架显著提升了令牌有效吞吐量（token goodput），验证了通信模式选择、草稿长度控制与功率分配联合优化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在UL与DL模式间自适应切换来平衡上行瓶颈与共享下行资源约束，Multi-SPIN能够有效减轻多设备边缘网络的通信负担，显著提升协同令牌生成的吞吐性能。

title: Multi-Agent Self-Improving Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning tasks such as grounded video question answering and temporal grounding require selecting temporal evidence that supports the query. In many current training setups, temporal supervision is applied through local objectives such as boundary regression or span generation, while verification is used mainly to rerank candidate segments at inference time. We study whether a frozen verifier can also guide training. Our multi-agent framework couples a trainable \emph{Grounder} with a frozen \emph{Verifier}: the Grounder samples candidate trajectories and evidence segments, the Verifier assigns query-conditioned segment scores, a group-relative policy-gradient objective favors trajectories that outperform their within-input peers, and a bootstrapped calibration loss steers temporal predictions toward verifier-preferred spans. Trained on source tasks and evaluated without target-dataset fine-tuning, a two-billion-parameter instantiation transfers zero-shot across grounded question answering, temporal grounding, and long-video question answering, reaching 28.7\% intersection-over-union and 25.4\% answer-grounding accuracy on a grounded-question-answering benchmark, 46.1\% intersection-over-union on a temporal-grounding benchmark, and 54.1\% on a long-video question-answering benchmark. Relative to a strong same-scale baseline, the gains are modest but consistent, with the clearest improvements on relevance-oriented metrics such as intersection-over-union and moderate-overlap recall. Within the tested benchmarks and transfer setting, the results support frozen verification as a training signal for evidence selection, while showing that strict boundary precision remains comparatively weaker. Code and models are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MASIRL-E50C/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多智能体框架，将可训练的 Grounder 与冻结的 Verifier 相结合，把冻结验证器的评分用作训练信号（而非仅在推理时重排），并通过组内相对策略梯度与自举校准损失引导证据片段选择，在视频问答、时序定位等任务上实现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 视频推理任务（如接地视频问答和时序定位）需要选取支撑查询的时间证据。现有训练主要依赖边界回归或片段生成等局部目标，而验证器仅用于推理阶段的重排。作者想探究冻结的验证器能否在训练阶段也发挥引导作用，从而改进时间证据选择。
AI.method: 采用多智能体框架：可训练的 Grounder 采样候选轨迹与证据片段，冻结的 Verifier 给出查询条件下的片段评分；采用组内相对策略梯度目标，偏好优于同输入内其他样本的轨迹；并设计自举校准损失，将时间预测引导到验证器偏好的区间。
AI.result: 在源任务上训练且不进行目标数据集微调的情况下，20亿参数模型零样本迁移至接地问答、时序定位和长视频问答：接地问答基准上达到28.7% IoU与25.4%答案接地准确率，时序定位基准上IoU为46.1%，长视频问答基准上为54.1%。相对同规模强基线提升虽有限但一致，在IoU和中等重叠召回等相关性指标上改善最明显。
AI.conclusion: 在测试的基准与迁移设置下，实验支持将冻结验证作为证据选择的训练信号是有效的，但同时表明严格边界精度方面仍相对较弱。

title: Intelligent Identification and Repair of Design Defects in BIM via Domain-Specific Large Language Models
summary: Existing methods lack a generalized approach to efficiently identify and resolve the diversity of design defects in BIM. Therefore, this study proposes an integrated framework to identify and repair various defects in BIM via domain-specific LLMs. Firstly, a BIM-to-Text method with component-balanced chunking is introduced to bridge BIM data with LLMs. Then, prompt learning with rule injection, few-shot prompting and RAG is proposed to identify defects and generate repair suggestions. Meanwhile, a hallucination control strategy combining key identifier validation and token-length thresholds is introduced to ensure reliability. Experiments show capability expansion yields 85% identification accuracy versus 70% for traditional rule checking, achieving a 94% rate of reasonable repair suggestions. Moreover, the proposed hallucination control further increased accuracy from 64% to 85%, eliminating 92.5% of hallucinations in a single intervention round. This study establishes an end-to-end prototype from raw BIM data input, through defect identification, to repair suggestion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于领域专用大语言模型（LLM）的集成框架，通过BIM-to-Text转换（组件均衡分块）、融合规则注入/少样本提示/RAG的提示学习以及幻觉控制策略，实现BIM设计缺陷的自动识别与修复建议生成，识别准确率达85%，生成合理修复建议率达94%。
AI.motivation: 现有BIM设计缺陷检查方法缺乏通用化的手段来高效识别和解决多样化的设计缺陷，难以适应各类缺陷场景，因此需要一种更通用且可靠的缺陷识别与修复框架。
AI.method: 首先提出一种带组件均衡分块的BIM-to-Text方法，将BIM数据与LLM衔接起来；随后提出融合规则注入、少样本提示（few-shot prompting）和检索增强生成（RAG）的提示学习方法，用于识别缺陷并生成修复建议；同时引入结合关键标识符验证与token长度阈值的幻觉控制策略，以保证输出的可靠性。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在能力扩展下识别准确率达85%，优于传统规则检查的70%；合理修复建议生成率达94%；幻觉控制策略将准确率从64%提升至85%，并在单轮干预中消除了92.5%的幻觉。
