GRaCE surpasses RaDE and Original Features across diverse datasets, including textual and image collections, excelling in retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks, considering state-of-the-art Transformer models as feature descriptors and Graph Convolutional Networks models in classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GRaCE（Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings），一种完全无监督的图嵌入框架，通过基于秩的稳健度量进行代表性节点子集选取和节点嵌入，生成可解释的低维表示，在检索、分类和聚类任务上优于 RaDE 和原始特征。
AI.motivation: 图方法在建模对象关系中应用广泛，但常面临高内存和空间计算成本；图嵌入将图编码为低维表示以缓解该问题，然而传统方法缺乏可解释的维度。RaDE 利用基于秩的信息与代表性子集选取来提供可解释性，但其原始方案未充分探索代表性子集选取在不同类别下的有效性，也未在分类和聚类任务中评估嵌入效果。
AI.method: 受 RaDE 启发，GRaCE 提出一个完全无监督的框架，采用稳健的基于秩的度量来完成代表性节点子集选取和节点嵌入，从而生成带有可解释维度的嵌入；同时结合 Transformer 模型作为特征描述符以及图卷积网络用于分类。
AI.result: 在包含文本和图像的多类数据集上，GRaCE 在检索、分类和聚类任务上均优于 RaDE 与原始特征。
AI.conclusion: GRaCE 通过基于秩的稳健度量实现了可解释且高效的图嵌入，在多项下游任务上取得了优于基线方法的性能，验证了其有效性。

title: RegDivergence-101: An LLM Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdiction Regulatory Contradiction Detection in Life Sciences
summary: Pharmaceutical sponsors developing a drug for both the United States and the European Union must reconcile guidance issued independently by the FDA and the EMA. Where the two agencies require substantively the same thing, a sponsor can file once; where they diverge, a single trial design risks rejection in one region; where one agency is silent on a point the other regulates, the sponsor must infer obligations. Today this reconciliation is performed manually by regulatory-affairs experts. We introduce cross-jurisdiction regulatory divergence detection: given an FDA requirement and an EMA requirement on the same topic, classify their relationship as AGREE, DIVERGE, or SILENT. SILENT is inherently directional (SILENT_FDA vs. SILENT_EMA); we record direction per pair and report per-direction F1 alongside the collapsed label. We release RegDivergence-101, a 101-pair expert-grounded pilot evaluation benchmark (labels grounded in three peer-reviewed FDA/EMA comparison studies and primary FDA/EMA/ICH guidance text; dual-annotation inter-annotator kappa = 0.85), and systematically characterise a four-method baseline hierarchy: lexical heuristic (0.511 macro-F1, 95% CI [0.411-0.605]), NLI cross-encoder (0.233), obligation-level Graph-RAG (0.663 [0.570-0.747]), and flat LLM judge / Claude Haiku (0.830 [0.747-0.908]). Three directional observations emerge at pilot scale (n = 101): SILENT is semantically detectable but invisible to entailment-only formulations; pair-level obligation graphs improve over lexical methods but trail flat-LLM context (CIs partially overlapping); and corpus-level graph construction is the indicated architectural target for large-scale silent-detection. RegDivergence-101 is a pilot release establishing the task formulation and baseline hierarchy; four unrepresented regulatory domains and an expansion roadmap are described in Section 7.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"跨辖区监管分歧检测"新任务：给定FDA与EMA对同一主题的监管要求，分类其关系为AGREE（一致）、DIVERGE（分歧）或SILENT（一方沉默，且方向敏感）。作者发布专家标注的试航基准RegDivergence-101（101对，标注一致性κ=0.85），并系统比较四种方法，发现扁平LLM评判器（Claude Haiku，0.830 macro-F1）优于词法启发式（0.511）、NLI交叉编码器（0.233）与义务级Graph-RAG（0.663）。
AI.motivation: 制药申办方需为美国和欧盟同时开发药物，必须协调由FDA和EMA各自独立发布的指南。若两机构要求实质相同可一次提交；若存在分歧，单一试验设计可能在某区域被拒；若一方未规定而另一方监管，申办方需自行推断义务。目前这类协调工作由监管事务专家手工完成，缺乏自动化方法，因此需要引入跨辖区监管分歧检测任务。
AI.method: 定义三分类任务（AGREE/DIVERGE/SILENT），其中SILENT具有方向性（SILENT_FDA vs. SILENT_EMA），按方向记录并报告各方向F1及合并标签F1。构建RegDivergence-101基准：101对由专家标注，标签以三篇同行评审的FDA/EMA对比研究及FDA/EMA/ICH原始指南文本为依据，双标注者间kappa=0.85。系统刻画四方法基线层级：词法启发式、NLI交叉编码器、义务级Graph-RAG、扁平LLM评判器（Claude Haiku）。
AI.result: 基线结果：词法启发式macro-F1=0.511（95% CI [0.411-0.605]）、NLI交叉编码器=0.233、义务级Graph-RAG=0.663（[0.570-0.747]）、扁平LLM评判器/Claude Haiku=0.830（[0.747-0.908]）。试航规模（n=101）下三个方向性观察：SILENT可被语义检测但对仅蕴含式表述不可见；成对义务图优于词法方法但落后于扁平LLM上下文（置信区间部分重叠）；语料级图构建是面向大规模静默检测的架构目标。
AI.conclusion: RegDivergence-101作为试航发布，确立了任务形式和基线层级；四种未被代表的监管领域及扩展路线图在论文第7节中描述，为后续更大规模研究与领域扩展奠定基础。

title: Reaching Fairness by Reallocating Goods
summary: Fair allocation of indivisible goods has largely been studied under the assumption that no prior allocation exists. Motivated by practical settings with pre-existing (and possibly unfair) allocations, we study how to achieve fairness through limited reallocations. Building on recent work on reformability/reallocations, we consider three fairness notions---envy-freeness (EF), envy-freeness up to one good (EF1), and envy-freeness up to any good (EFX)---and optimize the number of goods reallocated. We analyze both the classical and parameterized complexity of these problems, providing a comprehensive analysis across multiple fairness notions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在已有（可能不公平的）初始分配下，如何通过有限的物品再分配实现公平性，针对EF、EF1、EFX三种公平概念，以再分配物品数量为优化目标，并对相关问题的经典复杂性与参数化复杂性进行了全面分析。
AI.motivation: 可分割物品的公平分配研究大多假设不存在初始分配，但实际场景中往往存在先前已建立的（可能不公平的）分配。因此需要在有限再分配的约束下实现公平性，这一现实动机促使了对该问题的研究。
AI.method: 基于近期关于可改革性/再分配的研究工作，考虑三种公平概念（无嫉妒EF、至多一个物品的无嫉妒EF1、至多任意物品的无嫉妒EFX），以最小化被再分配的物品数量为优化目标，并采用经典复杂性与参数化复杂性两种分析框架对其进行研究。
AI.result: 给出了这些问题在经典复杂性与参数化复杂性两个维度下的全面分析结果，覆盖了多种公平概念，刻画了不同公平概念下实现有限再分配公平的计算难度。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性的复杂性分析，阐明了在已有分配背景下以最少再分配数量达成不同公平标准（EF/EF1/EFX）的计算边界，为实际场景中公平性修复提供了理论依据。

title: Marker-Delimited Codes for Short-Blocklength, High-Rate Coding over Multi-Read Edit Channels
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, This paper has been accepted in IEEE ITW'26
summary: The read process of DNA-based data storage systems generates multiple noisy copies of the stored DNA sequences, affected by edit errors consisting of substitutions, deletions, and insertions. Motivated by the challenge of ensuring reliable data retrieval in the presence of edit errors, we present a concatenated coding scheme that accounts for practical design constraints in DNA storage. We introduce and apply the marker-delimited code (MDC) as the inner code, which enables fast and reliable computation of symbolwise a posteriori probabilities (APPs). We combine MDC with an outer LDPC code. The LDPC is decoded via belief propagation using the soft information generated by MDC. Our results show that, in comparison with prior work, this construction provides more efficient error correction over multi-read edit channels in the short-blocklength and high-rate regime.

AI.tldr: 面向 DNA 存储中多读编辑信道（替换、删除、插入错误），提出以标记定界码（MDC）为内码、LDPC 码为外码的级联编码方案；MDC 快速可靠地计算符号级后验概率（APP），供外码 LDPC 通过置信传播利用软信息译码，在短块长、高码率场景下比先前工作纠错更高效。
AI.motivation: DNA 数据存储的读取过程会产生多个带编辑错误（替换、删除、插入）的噪声拷贝，需要可靠的编码方案以确保数据检索的准确性，同时要兼顾实际 DNA 存储的设计约束。
AI.method: 提出级联编码方案：以标记定界码（MDC）作为内码，实现快速可靠的符号级后验概率（APP）计算；以 LDPC 码作为外码，利用 MDC 生成的软信息通过置信传播（BP）进行译码。
AI.result: 与先前工作相比，该构造在多读编辑信道的短块长（short-blocklength）和高码率（high-rate）场景下提供了更高效的纠错性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提 MDC+LDPC 级联编码方案能够针对多读编辑信道实现高效纠错，尤其适用于短块长和高码率的实际 DNA 存储系统。

title: Data Diversity, Not Frequency Invariance: A Controlled and Self-Audited Study of Compression-Robust Deepfake Detection
comment: 38 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code, per-video predictions and a claims-to-artifacts map: https://github.com/Capta1n-n9m0/cafrl-negative (v1.0.0); archival deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22032529
summary: Frequency features and compression-invariant representation learning are widely assumed to be key to deepfake detection that survives video compression. We test this with CAFRL - block-DCT and FFT-phase streams, compression-level-conditioned band attention, and adversarial (gradient-reversal) compression invariance - and report a controlled negative. Under a pre-registered protocol with capacity- and augmentation-matched controls, a plain EfficientNet-B0 on multi-quality data beat CAFRL as specified at every compression level on the FaceForensics++ test split, by 3.66 AUC points at CRF 40 (paired, single seed). A self-audit of our own negative found four defects biased against the frequency hypothesis, and pre-specified re-tests repairing all four showed the deficit to be a recipe artifact, not an architecture failure: the baseline recipe recovered 3.96 points over the matching shipped-recipe variant. The frequency path made no detectable difference: discriminative alone (standalone validation AUC 0.91-0.98 late in training) but of no marginal value under this fusion, at two feature widths of one 4.0 M trunk, every seed-pooled interval for the intra-dataset compression contrasts including zero; on the single held-out manipulation tested, the fair variants sat below the plain backbone. The adversarial branch, as specified, added nothing and degraded its own conditioning estimator; at the fair recipe it is untested. Robustness under single-pass H.264 re-encoding came instead from data diversity: real constant-rate-factor variants beat synthetic JPEG augmentation by 7.3 points (single runs, non-overlapping intervals). The evidence is FaceForensics++-family, GAN-era and single-codec. Match controls on training recipe as well as capacity, and buy compression robustness with codec diversity before architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册协议、能力与增强方式匹配的对照实验，检验频域特征与压缩不变表示学习对鲁棒深度伪造检测的价值。结果呈受控阴性：普通 EfficientNet-B0 在所有压缩级别上均优于作者提出的 CAFRL 模型；自审计揭示四个偏向频率假说的缺陷，修复后差距源于训练配方而非架构；频域路径无增量价值，对抗分支无贡献，真正的鲁棒性来自数据多样性（真实码率因子变体优于合成 JPEG 增强）。
AI.motivation: 频域特征和压缩不变表示学习被广泛认为是对抗视频压缩、提升深度伪造检测鲁棒性的关键，但缺乏严格控制下针对该假说的严谨检验。作者希望通过预注册的受控实验，验证频域通路在深度伪造检测中的真实边际价值。
AI.method: 提出 CAFRL 框架（block-DCT 与 FFT 相位两路流、压缩级别条件化频带注意力、基于梯度反转的对抗压缩不变性），并在 FaceForensics++ 测试集上采用预注册协议，与能力及数据增强匹配的普通 EfficientNet-B0 基线进行对比；随后对阴性结果进行自审计，发现四个偏向频率假说的缺陷，并预先指定实验逐一修复后复测。
AI.result: 在每档压缩级别上普通 EfficientNet-B0（多种质量数据训练）均优于 CAFRL，CRF 40 处 AUC 高出 3.66 个点；修复四个配方缺陷后基线收益达 3.96 个点，说明差距源于配方而非架构。频域通路判别力尚可（验证 AUC 0.91–0.98）但融合后无边际价值，所有压缩对比区间含零；对抗分支不仅无增益还损害自身条件估计器。真实码率因子变体比合成 JPEG 增强高出 7.3 个点。
AI.conclusion: 在 FaceForensics++ 家族、GAN 时代、单一编解码器的证据范围内，压缩鲁棒性主要来自数据多样性而非架构性频域/压缩不变设计；建议在引入复杂架构前，先用真实编解码器多样性匹配训练配方与容量，并基于对照实验重新审视频率特征假说的适用边界。

title: Redesigning and Auditing Deep Research Writing for Faithful Reports
summary: Rubric-based evaluations of deep-research (DR) systems often obscure fine-grained factual failures in generated reports. We introduce CLAIMPROBE, a claim-level audit that decomposes DR reports into claims and measures hallucination, misattribution, citation hygiene, and necessary-fact recall against retrieved evidence. Using CLAIMPROBE, we find that strong DR pipelines can omit key evidence and misattribute claims even when their rubric scores remain stable. We then propose CLAIMWRITER, a hierarchical claim-based writer that extracts source facts, maps them to a query-derived outline, and drafts each section from a source-linked claim representation. Across three prior DR frameworks, replacing only the report writer with CLAIMWRITER reduces hallucination by 2.6 to 4.5 times and improves necessary-fact recall by 1.2 to 1.7 times, while largely preserving overall report quality. CLAIMWRITER also enables localized revision: when sources change, it propagates changed source facts into revised reports at the highest rate among update methods, while also being more cost-effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLAIMPROBE，一种基于声明（claim）级别的审计方法，将深度研究（DR）报告拆解为单个声明，衡量幻觉、错误归因、引用卫生和必要事实召回率。作者发现强DR流水线在评分稳定时仍会遗漏关键证据或错误归因，并据此提出CLAIMWRITER——一种分层、基于声明的报告生成器，通过提取源事实、映射到查询派生大纲、从源关联的声明表示起草各章节。在三个DR框架中仅替换报告撰写模块，幻觉降低2.6~4.5倍，必要事实召回提升1.2~1.7倍，且整体报告质量基本保持。CLAIMWRITER还支持局部修订，在源变化时以最高效率且更具成本效益地传播变更。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的深度研究报告评估常常掩盖细粒度的事实性错误，例如幻觉、错误归因、引用卫生问题和必要事实遗漏，因此需要更细粒度的声明级审计来揭示这些缺陷。
AI.method: 1) CLAIMPROBE：将DR报告分解为声明，并针对检索到的证据测量幻觉、误归因、引用卫生和必要事实召回。2) CLAIMWRITER：分层声明式写作器，从源中提取事实，将其映射到查询派生的提纲，并基于源关联的声明表示逐节起草报告；同时支持源变化时的局部修订传播。
AI.result: 在三个前沿DR框架中，仅用CLAIMWRITER替换报告撰写模块，幻觉减少2.6至4.5倍，必要事实召回提升1.2至1.7倍，同时基本保持整体报告质量；在源变化的更新场景下，CLAIMWRITER以最高的变更传播率和更低的成本完成局部修订。
AI.conclusion: 声明级审计（CLAIMPROBE）能暴露评分掩盖的细粒度事实失败，而声明级写作（CLAIMWRITER）是改善深度研究事实可靠性与可更新性的有效且经济的通用替换方案。

title: Context-Aware Interpretable Representations for Retrieval and Graph Convolutional Network Classification
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval (ICMR 2026)
summary: The advances in visual information modeling and representation during the last decades are remarkable, mainly supported by Convolutional Neural Networks, Transformer-based, and Foundation Models. Despite this progress, critical challenges regarding the nature of similarity assessment and model transparency have been neglected. A primary concern is the Geometric Gap, where traditional pairwise measures fail to capture the intrinsic geometry of the dataset manifold. Furthermore, the Interpretability Gap persists, as representations often lack alignment with human cognition. Therefore, how to provide interpretability to representations while maintaining low dimensionality and high effectiveness in downstream tasks remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose a novel unsupervised framework that integrates Manifold Learning strategies with Rank-based Interpretable Graph Embeddings. Our approach effectively bridges these gaps by first characterizing the contextual information of the dataset through manifold analysis and subsequently generating sparse, self-explainable embeddings. The proposed approach employs a flexible formulation, allowing different Manifold Learning and Representation Learning strategies. Extensive experimental evaluation across diverse datasets and features demonstrates that our Context-Aware representations not only provide intrinsic interpretability and dimensionality reduction but also maintain or enhance effectiveness in downstream tasks, specifically in image retrieval and semi-supervised classification using Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督框架，将流形学习与基于排序的可解释图嵌入相结合，通过流形分析刻画数据集上下文信息，生成稀疏、自可解释的嵌入，在降维的同时保持或提升图像检索与半监督GCN分类等下游任务的性能，弥合了几何鸿沟与可解释性鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉表示学习（CNN、Transformer、基础模型）取得了显著进展，但相似性评估的本质与模型透明性问题仍被忽视：传统成对度量无法捕捉数据集流形的内在几何结构（几何鸿沟），且表示往往与人类认知不一致（可解释性鸿沟）。因此，如何在不牺牲低维性和下游任务有效性的前提下为表示提供可解释性，仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个无监督框架，融合流形学习策略与基于排序的可解释图嵌入。首先通过流形分析刻画数据集的上下文信息，然后生成稀疏、自可解释的嵌入；该框架采用灵活的公式化设计，可适配不同的流形学习与表示学习策略。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与特征上的广泛实验表明，所提出的上下文感知表示不仅具备内在可解释性和降维能力，还能在图像检索以及基于图卷积网络（GCN）的半监督分类等下游任务中保持或提升有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过同时解决几何鸿沟与可解释性鸿沟，验证了将流形学习与可解释图嵌入结合的有效性，为兼顾透明度、低维性与下游性能的表示学习提供了一条可行路径。

title: TPvG: A Moral Decision Framework for Large Language Models from One-Shot to Sequential Feedback
summary: Existing LLM moral evaluations typically present models with isolated moral vignettes and elicit a single-shot decision, neglecting a factor known to profoundly influence human moral behavior: consequence feedback. We introduce TPvG (Text-based Pain-versus-Gain), adapted from a human moral paradigm, which embeds consequence feedback into an everyday moral dilemma of not harming others versus maximising self-gain. TPvG comprises five moral decision tasks, progressing from minimal-context one-shot choices to sequential decisions with explicit consequence feedback. Our results show that LLM moral decisions were strongly affected by decision format (one-shot versus sequential), and explicit receiver feedback produced heterogeneous effects across models. Furthermore, LLM responses to explicit receiver feedback diverged from the human reference pattern, suggesting potentially different decision processes. These findings highlight the need to evaluate whether LLM moral behavior remains stable in high-stakes interactive settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TPvG（基于文本的“痛苦vs获益”）基准，将后果反馈嵌入日常道德困境中，考察大语言模型（LLM）的道德决策。研究覆盖五种任务，从最小上下文的一次性选择逐步进阶到带显式后果反馈的顺序决策。结果表明LLM的道德决策受决策格式（一次性vs顺序）强烈影响，显式反馈在不同模型间产生异质性效应，且与人类参照模式存在分歧，凸显了在高风险交互场景中评估LLM道德行为稳定性的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估通常只给模型呈现孤立的道德小故事并要求一次性决策，忽略了“后果反馈”这一对人类道德行为有深远影响的因素，导致评估生态效度不足。
AI.method: 引入从人类道德范式改编而来的TPvG基准，将后果反馈嵌入“不伤害他人vs最大化自身收益”的日常道德困境中。TPvG包含五项道德决策任务，难度逐步递进：从最小上下文的一次性选择，到带显式后果反馈的顺序决策。
AI.result: 实验发现：1）LLM的道德决策受决策格式（一次性vs顺序）强烈影响；2）显式接收者反馈在模型间产生异质性效应；3）LLM对显式接收者反馈的响应模式与人类参照模式存在分歧，暗示其决策过程可能与人类不同。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调有必要评估LLM道德行为在高风险、互动性强的真实场景下是否保持稳定，即超越了孤立一次性判断的评估框架。

title: Bidding Games with Rewards: Taming Infinite Configuration Space
summary: Bidding games are graph games in which a token is placed on a vertex, each player starts with an initial budget, and a simultaneous auction determines which player moves the token; the players' budgets are then updated accordingly. Motivated by scenarios such as resource-allocation systems in which agents receive periodic rewards (e.g., credits, energy) while competing for control, we introduce and study bidding games with rewards, in which, at each vertex, players may receive additional budget, incentivizing desired behaviors. We focus on reachability discrete poorman bidding games with rewards (DPBGr). The main challenge when compared to discrete bidding games without rewards is that the configuration graph is infinite. To this end we introduce a novel technique to eliminate plays with suboptimal infixes. This enables focusing on a finite part of the infinite configuration graph in order to solve the game via approximation to continuous bidding games with overall complexity in EXP. Finally, we discuss a new type of strategy, usable on a subclass of DPBGr, which guarantee a winning strategy for the reachability player. Membership in this subclass is shown to be in NP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究带奖励的离散穷人式投标博弈（DPBGr）：在顶点上玩家可额外获得预算以激励期望行为。针对其配置图无限的问题，提出消除次优中缀的新技术，将博弈近似为连续投标博弈，以EXP复杂度求解；并对一个可通过新策略保证可达性玩家获胜的子类给出NP成员判定。
AI.motivation: 传统投标博弈假设预算总量固定，但在现实场景（如资源分配系统）中，智能体在争夺控制权的同时会周期性获得奖励（积分、能量等）。为建模这一场景，作者引入带奖励的投标博弈，其中玩家在每个顶点可能获得额外预算，从而激励期望行为，这为研究资源再补给下的博弈策略提供了动机。
AI.method: 针对配置图无限这一核心挑战，作者提出一种新颖的技术：消除包含次优中缀（suboptimal infixes）的博弈路径，从而可将无限配置图中的关注范围压缩到有限部分；在此基础上，通过对连续投标博弈进行近似来求解博弈。此外，针对DPBGr的一个子类提出了一类新策略，可用于保证可达性玩家的胜利。
AI.result: 利用消除次优中缀的技术与对连续投标博弈的近似，求解DPBGr的整体复杂度为EXP；同时定义了一个可用新策略保证可达性玩家获胜的子类，并证明该子类的成员判定问题属于NP。
AI.conclusion: 本文为带奖励的投标博弈建立了首个求解框架：通过创新性地将无限配置图简化为有限处理对象，并以连续博弈近似的方式在EXP内解决可达性DPBGr问题；同时通过新策略类型刻画了一个可由NP判定的可获胜子类，为后续相关博弈（如一般化的奖励机制）研究奠定了基础。

title: Intelligent Reflecting Surface Deployment for Low-Altitude Coverage: Illumination Geometry, Directional Characteristics, and Optimization
comment: Submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication
summary: Terrestrial base stations (BSs) are typically configured with fixed downtilt to serve ground users, resulting in weak illumination of low-altitude airspace even under line-of-sight (LoS) propagation. In this paper, we establish a channel model that incorporates BS and intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) radiation patterns for three-dimensional (3D) low-altitude coverage while preserving the existing BS configuration. We formulate a budget-constrained IRS deployment problem that jointly determines candidate-site selection, IRS orientations, and phase shifts to maximize the worst-case signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) over the 3D low-altitude airspace. The selected sites and optimized IRS parameters remain fixed after deployment, yielding a quasi-static IRS configuration. We characterize the illumination geometry between the fixed-downtilt BS and rooftop candidates by deriving the nonnegative installation-height range satisfying the BS main-lobe condition. The separation between the mapped main-lobe height boundaries grows linearly with horizontal BS-to-site distance and decreases inversely with the number of BS antennas. We further derive an analytical lower bound on the regional worst-case normalized array gain achievable through IRS phase design over served directions with different direction spans. The resulting sufficient direction span decreases inversely with the square root of the number of IRS elements when the same worst-case normalized gain guarantee is maintained. We develop a mixed-integer alternating optimization (AO) algorithm to solve the resulting problem. Simulation results validate the analytical characterizations and show that the proposed scheme achieves higher worst-case SNR than benchmarks across different deployment budgets.

AI.tldr: 针对地面基站因固定下倾角导致低空空域覆盖弱的问题，本文建立了融入基站与智能反射面（IRS）辐射方向图的三维低空信道模型，并研究了预算约束下的IRS部署问题，联合优化候选站址选择、IRS朝向和相移以最大化三维低空空域的最差情况信噪比（SNR）。文中刻画了固定下倾角基站与屋顶候选位置间的照射几何关系，推导了最差情况归一化阵列增益的下界，并提出混合整数交替优化（AO）算法求解。仿真验证了理论分析并表明所提方案在不同部署预算下均优于基准方案。
AI.motivation: 地面基站通常为服务地面用户而配置固定下倾角，即使存在视距（LoS）传播，其对低空空域的照射也较弱；而已有研究较少针对这种固定下倾角配置下借助IRS提升三维低空覆盖的问题，因此需要在不改变现有基站配置的前提下建立相应信道模型并设计IRS部署方案。
AI.method: 建立包含基站与IRS辐射方向图的三维低空信道模型；将问题建模为预算约束下的IRS部署优化（联合候选站址选择、IRS朝向与相移，最大化三维低空空域最差SNR）；通过推导非负安装高度范围刻画固定下倾角基站与屋顶候选点之间的照射几何关系；推导区域最差情况归一化阵列增益的解析下界；设计混合整数交替优化（AO）算法求解该问题。
AI.result: 映射主瓣高度边界之间的间距随基站到站点水平距离线性增大、随基站天线数反比减小；在保持相同最差情况归一化增益保证的前提下，所需方向跨度随IRS单元数的平方根反比减小；仿真表明所提方案在不同部署预算下均比基准方案获得更高的最差SNR，且分析结论得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的联合部署方案能够在不改变现有基站固定下倾角配置的情况下，通过优化IRS站址、朝向与相移（准静态配置）显著提升三维低空空域的最差情况覆盖性能，且理论推导揭示了照射几何与增益保证随系统参数的变化规律，为后续低空IRS部署提供了可解析的设计准则。

title: FLM: Frequency-Aware Language Models for Generative Image Compression
summary: Generative models have significantly improved the performance ceiling of image lossy compression at low bitrates by exploiting learned priors. However, the generated textures and semantic details may deviate from the source content, thereby affecting the fidelity of image reconstruction. To solve these challenges, we propose FLM, a frequency-aware language model that improves compression efficiency through frequency-domain probabilistic modeling while retaining deterministic reconstruction. At the encoder, the input image is transformed into quantized DCT coefficients, which are organized into discrete sequences using macroblock-based coefficient tokenization. FLM then performs next-coefficient prediction to autoregressively estimate token-wise conditional probability distributions for arithmetic coding, thereby generating a compact bitstream. At the decoder, the LLM and arithmetic decoder jointly recover the frequency-domain data, followed by inverse transformations for image reconstruction. A task-specific frequency-domain dataset and a two-stage fine-tuning strategy are further developed to enable the model to operate across multiple bitrate settings. FLM is a versatile compressor that is compatible with both lossy compression and lossless JPEG recompression frameworks. Experiments show that FLM exceeds conventional and generative lossy compression methods in rate-distortion performance. FLM achieves BD-PSNR gains of 3.30 dB, 3.83 dB, and 3.80 dB than JPEG baseline on Kodak, Tecnick, and CLIC2020, respectively. Better qualitative quality of FLM can be achieved in improving semantically high fidelity and suppressing blocking artifacts. FLM is also validated to be applicable to the lossless recompression task with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: FLM是一种频率感知语言模型，将图像编码为量化DCT系数序列，利用大语言模型自回归预测系数概率分布以驱动算术编码，在实现高保真确定性重建的同时提升率失真性能，并兼容有损压缩与无损JPEG重压缩任务。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型虽通过学习先验提升了低码率下图像有损压缩的性能上限，但其生成的纹理和语义细节可能与源内容产生偏差，损害重建保真度。
AI.method: 编码端将输入图像变换为量化DCT系数，通过基于宏块的系数分词组织成离散序列；FLM使用LLM进行逐系数预测，自回归估计逐词条的条件概率分布用于算术编码生成紧凑码流。解码端由LLM与算术解码器联合恢复频域数据，再经逆变换重建图像。此外构建了任务特定的频域数据集，并采用两阶段微调策略使模型支持多种码率设置。
AI.result: FLM在率失真性能上超越传统及生成式有损压缩方法，相比JPEG基线在Kodak、Tecnick和CLIC2020上分别取得3.30 dB、3.83 dB和3.80 dB的BD-PSNR增益，并展现出更高的语义保真度和更少的块效应；在无损重压缩任务上也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FLM通过将频率域概率建模与确定性重建相结合，提供了一种兼顾压缩效率与重建保真度的通用图像压缩方案，并验证了LLM在图像压缩中的适用性与扩展性。

title: Cross Lingual Transfer in Tulu Legal Comprehension: Script-Dependent Improvement and RAG-Induced Knowledge Conflict
summary: Low-resource languages without an adequate training corpus often use a related, higher-resource language as a scaffold for comprehension. Still, there is a need to develop rigorous evaluation methods to identify when models fail in cross lingual low-resource environments. Using the legal domain as a backdrop, three models (Llama3, Hex-1, Sarvam) were tested on the ability to classify legal complaints written in a low resource Dravidian language (Tulu). Transliterating queries across Dravidian scripts allowed models to gain a preliminary understanding of speakers' complaints without the use of wide scale training, though the level of comprehension was heavily script dependent (with Kannada - another relatively low-resource language - producing the strongest positive trend). Retrieving from a corpus of Kannada legal papers across a RAG framework caused mixed results. Some models had a weak positive trend in comprehension under certain conditions, but when models failed, it was often across two axes: fact substitution (fixating on specific passage excerpts that skewed reasoning) and confabulation (hallucination that had no basis in either query or corpus). Within low resource domains, results identify the model's parsing of information and subsequent reasoning as the source of reasoning failure, rather than corpus contents. Script-dependent comprehension and RAG robustness also seem to travel together. This is further supported by the reasoning-trace analysis and a statistical-honesty framework deployed - techniques that are more broadly applicable to low-resource multilingual RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言（达罗毗荼语系图鲁语）在跨语言法律投诉分类任务上的模型表现，提出了一套严格的评估方法。作者测试了三个模型（Llama3、Hex-1、Sarvam），发现跨达罗毗荼文字的音译查询能让模型获得初步理解，但理解高度依赖脚本（卡纳达语效果最佳）；在RAG框架下检索卡纳达语法律语料结果好坏参半，失败主要源于事实替换与虚构（confabulation）两类推理缺陷，且问题根源在于模型的信息解析与推理能力而非语料本身。脚本依赖的理解能力与RAG鲁棒性呈现正相关，并通过推理轨迹分析与统计诚实性框架得到验证。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言常借助相关的较高资源语言作为理解支架，但缺乏严格的评估方法来识别模型在跨语言低资源环境下的失败模式。作者以法律领域为背景，希望系统性地评估模型在低资源达罗毗荼语言（图鲁语）上的分类表现，并定位失败根源，从而为低资源多语言RAG评估提供可推广的方法。
AI.method: 以法律领域为场景，测试三个模型（Llama3、Hex-1、Sarvam）对图鲁语法律投诉的分类能力。方法包括：跨达罗毗荼文字的音译查询（不进行大规模训练）、基于卡纳达语法律语料的RAG检索框架、推理轨迹（reasoning-trace）分析，以及用于评估可靠性的统计诚实性框架。
AI.result: 音译查询使模型获得对投诉的初步理解，但理解水平高度依赖脚本，其中卡纳达语（同为低资源语言）呈现最强的正向趋势。RAG检索结果好坏参半：部分模型在特定条件下有弱正向提升，但失败时主要沿两条轴线——事实替换（过度关注特定段落摘录而歪曲推理）与虚构（产生无查询或语料依据的幻觉）。分析表明推理失败源自模型的解析与推理环节而非语料内容，且脚本依赖的理解能力与RAG鲁棒性具有一致性，推理轨迹分析和统计诚实性框架进一步支持了这一结论。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源跨语言RAG环境中，模型的理解与鲁棒性受脚本选择影响显著，且失败机理归结为模型的解析与推理缺陷而非语料质量。研究所用的推理轨迹分析与统计诚实性框架具有通用性，可推广至更广泛的低资源多语言RAG评估场景。

title: Hybrid Semantic Context-Enhanced Ensemble Learning for Wind Power Ramp-Event Forecasting and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation
summary: Wind power ramp events which are sudden, large swings in turbine output over short windows are difficult to estimate, and standard models often miss them. Hybrid forecasting approach is built which augments semantic context to ramp-event forecast. Rather than applying an extensive language model directly to predict turbine operating data, we have implemented a pipeline where turbine operating data is converted to simplified text, which is then converted to dense embeddings to be used as inputs for ensemble models incorporated with other features. Testing runs are performed at multiple intervals within the SDWPF dataset, including 10-minute, 30-minute, and 60- minute horizons, with ramp events constituting the highest change in future power output. We check robustness against autoregressive, LSTM, and GRU baselines plus several ensemble configurations, using Diebold-Mariano tests and bootstrap confidence intervals, and we vary the ramp threshold, compress the embeddings with PCA, and validate externally on Kaggle SCADA and NREL data with uncertainty-aware scoring. The semantic-context features produce negligible yet statistically significant gains over the baselines in multiple paired ensemble runs, most clearly at the 30- and 60-minute horizons where these gains hold across different ramp-threshold definitions, and PCA compression helps in some longer-horizon cases. The best context- augmented ensembles rank near the top overall, though the GRU model still posts the lowest ramp-event RMSE at 30 and 60 minutes. External tests confirm the error reduction generalizes across datasets, but the size of the gain depends on both model and dataset. Prediction intervals cover most test cases well but weaken during ramp events, pointing to a localized shift in the data distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合预测框架，将风力发电机运行数据转换为简化文本并生成稠密嵌入（语义上下文特征），与集成模型结合以提升风电爬坡事件预测精度。在SDWPF数据集上针对10/30/60分钟预测窗口进行测试，语义特征带来了统计显著但幅度很小的提升，在30/60分钟窗口及不同爬坡阈值下最为稳健；PCA压缩在部分长时窗口有效，外部数据集验证了误差降低的泛化性，但预测区间在爬坡事件期间覆盖能力减弱。
AI.motivation: 风电爬坡事件是短时间内风电输出突然发生大幅波动的情形，难以估计，标准模型经常漏报这类事件，因此需要更有效的预测方法。
AI.method: 采用混合预测方法：不直接用大型语言模型预测风机运行数据，而是构建流水线——先将风机运行数据转换为简化文本，再转换为稠密嵌入，作为集成模型的输入并与其他特征结合。在SDWPF数据集上以10分钟、30分钟和60分钟为预测窗口进行测试，爬坡事件定义为未来功率输出的最大变化。对比自回归、LSTM、GRU基线及多种集成配置，使用Diebold-Mariano检验和bootstrap置信区间评估；变化爬坡阈值、用PCA压缩嵌入，并在Kaggle SCADA与NREL数据上结合不确定性感知评分进行外部验证。
AI.result: 语义上下文特征在多个配对集成运行中相比基线产生幅度很小但统计显著的增益，在30和60分钟窗口及不同爬坡阈值定义下最为明显；PCA压缩在部分长时窗口有帮助。最佳上下文增强集成排名总体靠前，但GRU模型在30和60分钟仍取得最低爬坡事件RMSE。外部测试确认误差降低可泛化到其他数据集，但增益大小取决于模型和数据集。预测区间在大多数测试用例覆盖良好，但在爬坡事件期间减弱，表明数据分布出现局部偏移。
AI.conclusion: 语义上下文特征能为爬坡事件预测带来虽小但统计稳健的改进，尤其是在中等及较长时间窗口，且该改进可跨数据集泛化；但该方法尚无法全面超越强基线（如GRU），且爬坡事件期间预测区间覆盖能力下降，提示未来需要针对局部分布偏移进行专门建模。

title: InternReviewer & InternAdvocate: Objective Reward and Evaluation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Peer Review and Rebuttal
summary: Generating professional scholarly content, such as peer reviews and rebuttals, requires an intricate synergy between domain reasoning and factual grounding. This work presents a comprehensive framework for the development and evaluation of specialized scholarly agents, InternReviewer and InternAdvocate. We first establish a large-scale, high-quality scholarly dataset and integrate a high-efficiency arXiv retrieval tool to enable active evidence gathering. To optimize these agents, we implement an agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm driven by a unified objective metric and reward system. This system avoids the biases of subjective model-based judging by employing multi-dimensional criteria, including reference-anchored semantic alignment, structural compliance, and a strict verification mechanism that cross-checks citations against real-time interaction logs to eliminate hallucinations. Experimental results demonstrate that agents trained within this closed-loop framework exhibit significant improvements in reasoning depth and citation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于开发与评估专业学术代理（InternReviewer 与 InternAdvocate）的综合框架，通过构建大规模高质量学术数据集并集成 arXiv 高效检索工具，结合以统一目标指标与奖励系统驱动的智能体强化学习（RL）范式，实现评审与反驳等专业学术内容的生成；实验表明该闭环框架显著提升了推理深度与引用准确性。
AI.motivation: 生成专业的学术内容（如同行评审与反驳）需要领域推理与事实依据之间的复杂协同，而现有方法在这一任务上缺乏系统性框架，难以同时保证推理质量与引用的真实可靠性。
AI.method: 首先构建大规模、高质量的学术数据集，并集成高吞吐的 arXiv 检索工具以支持主动证据收集；随后设计基于统一目标指标与奖励系统的智能体强化学习（RL）优化范式，采用多维评估准则，包括基于参考锚定的语义对齐、结构符合性，以及通过交叉核对实时交互日志来消除幻觉的严格引用验证机制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在该闭环框架内训练的智能体在推理深度与引用准确性方面均表现出显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了结合领域推理、主动证据检索与客观多维奖励的智能体强化学习范式，能够有效推动专业学术内容生成代理的发展。

title: Constrained Fair Allocations via Partition Matroid Reductions
summary:
We study fair allocation of indivisible goods under additive valuations and matroid constraints. A challenging open question is whether a complete and feasible envy-free up to one good (EF1) allocation exists under every matroid that admits a complete and feasible allocation. The state-of-the-art result by Biswas and Barman [2018] positively resolves this question for partition matroids.
  Our first result positively resolves it for laminar matroids, which generalize partition matroids, when there are three agents. Our technique reduces this general existence question to finding an EF1 allocation satisfying a mild additional condition under a single finite-sized key laminar matroid, and we establish the required allocation by case analysis. We show that our technique somewhat extends to four agents, reducing the analogous problem to finding EF1 allocations under two finite-sized laminar matroids, although we are unable to establish their existence. We also use recent matroid decomposition results to establish EF1 existence under broader classes of matroids. Specifically, we show that EF1 allocations always exist under transversal matroids whenever a complete allocation is feasible, and obtain existence results for graphic matroids and gammoids under stronger assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可加效用与拟阵（matroid）约束下不可分割物品的公平分配，证明三智能体情形下层状拟阵（laminar matroid）上完备且可行的 EF1 分配总存在，将 Biswas 与 Barman 关于分区拟阵的结果推广到更广类别；该方法可部分推广到四智能体（化归为两个有限拟阵上的存在性问题，但未能证明），并借助拟阵分解结果证明横贯拟阵上完备可行 EF1 分配总存在，且在更强假设下对图拟阵与 gammoid 也获得存在性。
AI.motivation: 核心开放问题是：在任意允许完备可行分配的拟阵约束下，是否总存在完备且可行的 EF1（envy-free up to one good）分配。此前仅对分区拟阵（partition matroids）有肯定结论，作者希望推广这一结果到更一般的拟阵类别。
AI.method: 提出一种归约技术：将一般存在性问题化归到在单个有限规模的“关键层状拟阵”上寻找满足一个温和额外条件的 EF1 分配，再通过案例分析构造该分配；对四智能体情形，该技术将问题约化为两个有限层状拟阵上的 EF1 存在性；对更广类别则利用近期的拟阵分解（matroid decomposition）结果进行证明。
AI.result: ① 三智能体下层状拟阵（推广分区拟阵）上完备可行 EF1 分配必然存在；② 该方法可部分扩展到四智能体，但仅将原问题化归为两个有限拟阵上的开放子问题，未证明其存在性；③ 横贯拟阵（transversal matroids）上只要完备分配可行，EF1 分配总存在；④ 对图拟阵（graphic matroids）与 gammoid，在更强假设下获得存在性结果。
AI.conclusion: 文章显著推广了拟阵约束下 EF1 分配的存在性结论，提出并验证了有限的“关键拟阵”归约技术，同时明确了四智能体与更一般拟阵类别的遗留开放问题，为该方向后续研究提供了方法与参照。

title: On Diagonalizable Delay-Doppler Channels and Their Diagonalizing Waveforms
summary: In doubly selective channels, the joint delay and Doppler dispersion generally induces coupling among transmitted symbols, thereby increasing receiver equalization complexity. Nevertheless, by using appropriately designed waveforms, channels with certain delay-Doppler (DD) supports can be diagonalized for one-tap equalization. The whole picture of such DD supports and their corresponding waveforms is still unclear, except for several examples identified in literature. In this paper, under cyclic-prefix (CP)-based block transmission and assuming that the modulation waveforms form an orthonormal basis, we identify all such channel supports by an elementary expression, and derive the corresponding waveforms in closed form.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双选择性信道中由延迟-多普勒（DD）扩展导致的符号间耦合问题，在基于循环前缀（CP）的块传输且调制波形构成正交基的假设下，完整刻画了所有能够被对角化（支持单抽头均衡）的信道支持集合，并给出对应波形的闭式解析表达式。
AI.motivation: 双选择性信道中联合的时延和多普勒色散通常会在发送符号间引入耦合，导致接收端均衡复杂度显著增加。虽然已有文献指出借助恰当设计的波形可对某些特定DD支持的信道实现对角化与单抽头均衡，但此类DD支持及其对应波形的全貌尚不清晰，仅有一些孤立的例子。因此作者希望给出这一问题的完整刻画。
AI.method: 在CP-based块传输框架下，假设调制波形构成正交基，作者通过一个初等（elementary）表达式完整刻画所有可被对角化的信道DD支持集合，并据此推导出对应波形的闭式形式。
AI.result: 作者识别出了全部满足对角化条件的信道DD支持，并用初等数学表达式统一描述；同时为每种支持导出了相应波形的闭合形式解，弥补了此前仅有个别示例的空白。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了可支持单抽头均衡的双选择性信道的完整理论刻画及对应波形的显式构造，为波形设计与均衡复杂度权衡提供了系统性的理论依据和设计指导。

title: Projection-Aware End-to-End Learned Video Compression for 360-Degree Video
summary:
360-degree video supports immersive applications such as virtual reality, autonomous driving, and education. Because spherical content cannot be processed directly by conventional video codecs, it must first be mapped to a two-dimensional projection. Projection choice affects spatial continuity, sampling uniformity, motion estimation, and compression efficiency.
  This thesis investigates how projection format influences end-to-end neural compression of 360-degree video. Seven formats supported by JVET 360Lib are evaluated using the scale-space flow model, JVET test sequences, and common test conditions. Each sequence is converted from its source equirectangular projection to a coding projection, compressed at multiple rate points, reconstructed, and converted back. Performance is assessed using PSNR, spherical PSNR, weighted spherical PSNR, and Bjøntegaard delta rate. A differentiable pipeline combining projection conversion, neural compression, and inverse projection is also compared with 360Lib.
  Results show that equirectangular and padded equirectangular projections provide the highest compression efficiency with the scale-space flow model, while cubemap-based and rhombic dodecahedron projections are less effective. This differs from the conventional HM-16.16 codec, for which cubemap-based formats, particularly equi-angular and adjusted cubemap projections, outperform equirectangular formats. Neural models based on optical flow benefit from the spatial continuity of single-face projections, whereas block-based hybrid codecs better accommodate multi-face layouts. These findings show that projection efficiency is codec-dependent and provide guidance for selecting projections for learning-based 360-degree video compression.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了投影格式对360度视频端到端神经压缩性能的影响，使用scale-space flow模型与JVET 360Lib支持的七种投影格式进行评测，发现等距柱状（equirectangular）及其填充变体在神经编解码器中压缩效率最高，这与传统混合编解码器HM-16.16中立方体图投影更优的结论相反，表明投影效率具有编解码器依赖性。
AI.motivation: 360度视频支持VR、自动驾驶、教育等沉浸式应用，但其球面内容无法被传统视频编解码器直接处理，必须映射为二维投影。投影选择会影响空间连续性、采样均匀性、运动估计和压缩效率，因此需要明确投影格式对新兴的神经压缩方法的影响，以指导编解码设计。
AI.method: 采用scale-space flow神经压缩模型，评估JVET 360Lib支持的七种投影格式；使用JVET测试序列和通用测试条件，将每个序列从源等距柱状投影转换到编码投影、在多个码率点压缩、重建后再转换回原投影。性能通过PSNR、球面PSNR、加权球面PSNR和Bjøntegaard delta rate评估；同时将投影转换、神经压缩与逆投影结合的可微流水线与360Lib进行对比。
AI.result: 等距柱状和填充等距柱状投影在scale-space flow模型下压缩效率最高，而立方体图类和菱形十二面体投影效率较低。这与传统HM-16.16编解码器（其中等角立方体图和调整立方体图等格式优于等距柱状）的结果相反。基于光流的神经模型受益于单面投影的空间连续性，而基于块的混合编解码器更能适应多面布局。
AI.conclusion: 投影效率是编解码器依赖的，神经压缩与传统混合编解码器对投影格式的偏好不同，本研究为学习型360度视频压缩的投影选择提供了指导。合适的投影取决于底层编解码架构，而非存在普适最优的投影格式。

title: Can Large Language Models Identify Meaningful Touchpoints in Conversion Attribution?
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; accepted as a short paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Touchpoint selection in conversion attribution, namely identifying meaningful touchpoints contributing to conversions, is essential for e-commerce recommendation and online advertising. Current selection methods rely heavily on collaborative-filtering-based heuristics, which fail to align with user-perceived semantic intent. Through human annotation, we reveal a significant semantic gap: many implicitly-related, semantically relevant touchpoints remain undetected by existing rules. Therefore, we systematically evaluate the capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in identifying these hidden associations. Our evaluation shows that while LLMs effectively uncover a substantial portion of implicitly-related touchpoints, significant room for improvement remains in their selection performance. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of different prompting strategies and foundation model choices on identification performance, providing valuable insights into their reasoning patterns and effectiveness. These insights offer a new roadmap for transitioning conversion attribution from mechanical rule-matching to human-aligned semantic reasoning. Moreover, we leverage the LLM-attributed conversion labels for enhancing industrial CVR model training and achieve significant offline performance gains, showing the potential of LLMs in conversion attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究转化归因中的触点选择问题，指出现有基于协同过滤的启发式规则无法捕捉与用户语义意图相关的隐式触点。通过人工标注揭示语义鸿沟后，系统评估了LLM识别隐式相关触点的能力，发现LLM能发现大部分隐式触点但仍有提升空间。作者还分析了提示策略和基础模型选择的影响，并将LLM标注的转化标签用于工业CVR模型训练，取得显著的离线性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有转化归因中的触点选择方法依赖协同过滤类启发式规则，这些规则与用户感知的语义意图不一致。通过人工标注发现，许多隐式相关、语义相关的触点在现有规则下无法被检测到，存在显著的语义鸿沟，因此需要探索更符合人类语义理解的选择方法。
AI.method: 首先通过人工标注揭示语义鸿沟；然后系统评估LLM在识别隐式相关触点方面的能力，并比较不同提示策略与基础模型选择对识别性能的影响；最后将LLM标注的转化标签用于增强工业CVR（转化率）模型的训练。
AI.result: LLM能够有效地发现大部分隐式相关触点，但选择性能仍有较大提升空间；不同提示策略和基础模型选择对识别效果有显著影响；利用LLM标注的转化标签训练工业CVR模型，在离线评估中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为转化归因从机械规则匹配向人类对齐的语义推理过渡提供了新的路线图，并展示了LLM在转化归因任务中的实际应用潜力。

title: Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown strong potential for learning compact predictive representations, and LeWorldModel (LeWM) extends this paradigm to reconstruction-free latent world modeling from pixels. However, its deterministic autoregressive predictor generates future states through repeated one-step transitions, which can accumulate errors and remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations. In this work, we propose Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a conditional flow matching dynamics model that jointly generates a sequence of future latent states conditioned on the current observation and actions. A Gaussian distribution serves as the flow source, exposing the vector field to perturbed latent trajectories as it learns to transport them toward clean future representations. This formulation retains the reconstruction-free JEPA framework while replacing point-wise transition regression with stochastic trajectory-level prediction. F-JEPA raises mean success from $86\%$ to $92\%$ under clean observations and from $67\%$ to $86\%$ under noisy conditions, suggesting that conditional flow matching provides a promising alternative to deterministic autoregressive dynamics in JEPA world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Flow-JEPA（F-JEPA），一种基于条件流匹配的动态模型，用于联合生成未来潜在状态序列。与 LeWorldModel 的确定性自回归逐帧预测不同，F-JEPA 以高斯分布作为流源，学习将（可能被扰动的）潜在轨迹输送到干净的未来表示，从而在保留无重建 JEPA 框架的同时实现随机轨迹级预测，并在干净与噪声观测下均显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: JEPA 类方法（如 LeWorldModel）虽能实现从像素到潜在空间的无重建世界建模，但其确定性自回归预测器通过重复单步转移来生成未来状态，容易累积误差，且对任务无关的视觉扰动敏感。
AI.method: 提出 Flow-JEPA（F-JEPA），即条件流匹配动态模型：以高斯分布为流源，在给定当前观测和动作的条件下联合生成未来潜在状态序列；通过在训练中将矢量场暴露于受扰动的潜在轨迹并学习将其输送到干净的未来表示，用随机轨迹级预测替代逐点回归的确定性转移。
AI.result: F-JEPA 在干净观测下将平均成功率从 86% 提升到 92%，在噪声条件下从 67% 提升到 86%。
AI.conclusion: 条件流匹配为 JEPA 世界模型中的确定性自回归动态提供了一种有前景的替代方案，能够提升预测的鲁棒性与成功率。

title: Preference Elicitation for Policy Optimization and Application to Aligning Heart Transplantation with Human Values
summary: Preference elicitation is essential for aligning AI systems with human values. Prior approaches (e.g., for organ allocation) often ask stakeholders to compare the decisions of an algorithm (e.g., patient A vs. patient B). Such a decision-level approach conflates the means with the ends. Instead, we elicit preferences directly over allocation outcomes to learn a utility function for policy optimization. We construct a novel preference elicitation algorithm for linear utilities that outperforms prior techniques in practice. Our algorithm has two phases. The first phase learns cutting planes through pairwise comparisons to rapidly shrink the space of possible attribute weights and warm-starts the second phase by eliminating dominated regions. The second phase then provably converges to the user's utility function. We apply our technique to heart transplant allocation where a policy must balance competing objectives such as post-transplant outcomes, waitlist mortality, geographic ease, and equity. Using our algorithm, we conduct a user study to learn and aggregate a community-aligned utility function, and use it to optimize heart transplant policies that are significantly better aligned with human values. Compared to the hindsight optimum, the status quo policy achieves a competitive ratio of just 0.54, while our method is near-optimal with a competitive ratio of 0.95.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向分配结果的偏好elicitation（偏好诱导）算法，通过在结果层面而非决策层面进行成对比较来学习线性效用函数，并将其用于优化心脏移植分配政策。该算法采用两阶段设计：第一阶段通过切割平面法快速缩小属性权重空间并消除支配区域，第二阶段可证明地收敛到用户的效用函数。用户研究表明该方法学到的社区一致效用函数可使移植政策与人类价值高度对齐，竞争比达到0.95（接近事后最优），而现状政策的竞争比仅为0.54。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好诱导方法（如器官分配场景）通常让利益相关者比较算法的决策（如患者A vs 患者B），这种决策层面的比较将手段（算法决策）与目的（最终结果）混为一谈。因此需要一种直接对分配结果进行偏好elicitation的方法，以学习用于政策优化的效用函数。
AI.method: 提出一个针对线性效用函数的两阶段偏好elicitation算法。第一阶段：通过成对比较学习切割平面，快速缩小可能的属性权重空间，并通过消除被支配区域为第二阶段提供热启动；第二阶段：可证明地收敛到用户的真实效用函数。算法被应用于心脏移植分配任务，通过用户研究学习并聚合社区一致的效用函数，用于优化权衡移植后结局、等待名单死亡率、地理便利性与公平性等目标的政策。
AI.result: 与事后最优相比，现状政策（status quo）的竞争比仅为0.54，而所提方法的竞争比接近最优，达到0.95，表明优化后的心脏移植政策与人类价值显著更好地对齐。
AI.conclusion: 直接对分配结果（而非算法决策）进行偏好诱导能够更有效地学习反映人类价值的效用函数，所提出的两阶段算法在实践中优于现有技术，并能在高风险的医疗资源分配（如心脏移植）中生成与社区价值观高度一致、接近最优的政策。

title: PokaiTrainer: Scaling Belief-State Search to Competitive Pokémon VGC
summary: Decision-time equilibrium search carried poker to superhuman play, but it has so far relied on tractable subgames: a handful of actions per decision, chance confined to card deals, one player moving at a time. Competitive Pokémon in its official doubles format (VGC) breaks all three assumptions at once. Both players act simultaneously from joint menus in the hundreds, each joint action resolves to hundreds of stochastic outcomes, and the opponent's reserves and stat allocations are hidden. We set out to build a strong VGC agent and report what that took. PokaiEngine, our Rust battle engine, enumerates a joint action's full weighted outcome distribution in one pass, at ${\sim}99\%$ parity with Pokémon Showdown and a fraction of the cost of sampling it. On top of the engine, PokaiTrainer adapts Student of Games to this scale, solving every decision as a Bayesian matrix game over public belief states and growing subgames under an explicit compute budget. On the live Showdown best-of-three ladder, the agent wins 59% of 150 sets against a human field averaging ${\sim}1320$ Elo. It settles into a 1350-1400 Elo band, and at its peak briefly entered the format's top 500.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 PokaiEngine 与 PokaiTrainer：一个面向官方双打规则（VGC）《宝可梦》对战的强 AI 智能体。PokaiEngine 用单次遍历完整枚举联合动作的加权结果分布（与 Pokémon Showdown 约 99% 一致，成本远低于采样）；PokaiTrainer 将 Student of Games 扩展到该规模，在每个公共信念状态下把决策建模为贝叶斯矩阵博弈，并在显式算力预算下生长子博弈。该智能体在 Showdown 实时三局两胜天梯上对约 1320 Elo 的人类玩家取得 150 局中 59% 的胜率，稳定在 1350–1400 Elo，峰值一度进入该模式前 500 名。
AI.motivation: 传统的决策时均衡搜索（如扑克超人类水平所采用的）依赖可处理的子博弈：每步决策动作少、随机性局限于发牌、且玩家轮流行动。而官方双打 VGC 格式同时打破这三条假设：双方从多达数百项的联合菜单中同时行动、每个联合动作对应数百种随机结果、对手的备用宝可梦与努力值分配均处于隐藏状态。作者的目标是构建一个强 VGC 智能体，并如实报告做到这一点所需的方法与工程。
AI.method: 方法分两层：(1) PokaiEngine 是一个用 Rust 编写的对战引擎，能在单次遍历中枚举某个联合动作的完整加权结果分布，以极低计算成本达到与 Pokémon Showdown 约 99% 的一致性，替代了昂贵的采样。(2) PokaiTrainer 在引擎之上把 Student of Games 算法适配到该规模：每个决策都作为公共信念状态上的贝叶斯矩阵博弈来求解，并在显式计算的预算约束下逐步生长子博弈，从而处理同时行动、大规模联合动作和高随机分支的问题。
AI.result: 在实时 Showdown 三局两胜天梯上，该智能体对平均约 1320 Elo 的人类玩家在 150 局中取得 59% 胜率；稳定落于 1350–1400 Elo 区间，峰值曾短暂进入该格式的全球前 500 名。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用引擎的高效结果分布枚举与可扩展的均衡搜索（Student of Games 的适配），即使在同时行动、联合动作庞大、随机分支极多且信息隐藏的复杂博弈设定下，也能构建达到人类天梯中上水平的 VGC 智能体；同时揭示出将决策时搜索推向此类更现实博弈场景所需的关键工程与算法取舍。

title: Asymptotic Bounds on Generalized Covering Radii of Binary Primitive BCH Codes
summary: Fix integers $e\ge2$ and $r\ge1$. In this paper we study the $r$-th generalized covering radius $ρ_r\left(BCH(e,m)\right)$ of the binary primitive $e$-error-correcting BCH code $BCH(e,m)$. By using an algebraic-geometric reformulation of the covering problem together with an explicit Lang-Weil estimate, we prove that \[ρ_r\bigl(\BCH(e,m)\bigr)\le(r+1)e-1\] for all sufficiently large $m$. For $e\ge7$, this improves a recent result of Belinsky--Zabokritskiy. Our proof gives a substantially simpler geometric approach to this upper bound. In particular it implies that \[ρ_2\bigl(BCH(e,m)\bigr)=3e-1\] for all sufficiently large $m$. Previously it was only known that \[ρ_2\bigl(\BCH(e,m)\bigr) \in \left\{3e-1,3e\right\}\] for all sufficiently large $m$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二元本原 e 纠错 BCH 码的第 r 阶广义覆盖半径 ρ_r，通过将覆盖问题重新表述为代数几何形式并结合显式 Lang-Weil 估计，证明了对所有充分大的 m 有 ρ_r(BCH(e,m)) ≤ (r+1)e−1；该结果改进了 e≥7 时 Belinsky–Zabokritskiy 的近期结论，并确定了 ρ_2 = 3e−1。
AI.motivation: 经典问题在于精确确定 BCH 码的覆盖半径。此前已知对所有充分大的 m，ρ_2(BCH(e,m)) 只能取 {3e−1, 3e} 两个值之一，而该文希望消除这一不确定性并推广到任意 r≥1。
AI.method: 将覆盖问题代数几何化（把覆盖半径上界归结为某类代数簇有限点数的下界估计），再利用显式形式的 Lang-Weil 估计给出系统性的上界证明，从而提供远为简洁的几何途径。
AI.result: 证明对任意 e≥2、r≥1 及所有充分大的 m，成立 ρ_r(BCH(e,m)) ≤ (r+1)e−1；特别地由此推出 ρ_2(BCH(e,m)) = 3e−1，从而排除了此前遗留的 3e 情形，并在 e≥7 时改进了 Belinsky–Zabokritskiy 的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该几何方法成功将广义覆盖半径的上界问题转化为可显式估计的代数簇问题，不仅统一并改进了已有结果，还精确确定了 r=2 时渐近意义上的覆盖半径。

title: Defending Wearable VLMs Against Private Attribute Inference
summary: Wearable VLM pipelines promise continuous multimodal assistance from egocentric visual capture: a user asks a task-driven question about the surrounding scene, and the system uses compact visual tokens to support language reasoning. The challenge motivating this work is that the same egocentric evidence needed for useful assistance can also reveal private attributes about the wearer or nearby bystanders. We investigate this as a joint privacy-utility problem for split VLM inference, where visual encoding occurs within a trusted device boundary but intermediate visual tokens may be transmitted to downstream reasoning components. This exposes an understudied leakage surface: even when final textual responses are benign, external attackers or untrusted downstream components can recover private attributes from transmitted visual tokens. To evaluate this tension, we construct a paired privacy-utility benchmark with 3,221 image-question records, each paired with a utility question and privacy labels covering location, income, sex, and interests. We further propose Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP), a pre-LLM token disentangler that learns a residual transformation of visual tokens before they leave the trusted boundary. TGAP combines utility preservation, identity regularization, semantic privacy suppression, and image-driven representation suppression, avoiding the utility loss caused by coarse hard or attention masking. On the benchmark used for source-model evaluation, TGAP reduces privacy accuracy from 56.7\% to 7.4\%, a 49.3\% absolute drop, while maintaining relaxed utility at 74.4\%. These results suggest that securing the compact token interface is a practical path toward privacy-preserving wearable multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可穿戴视觉语言模型（VLM）管线中的隐私-效用联合问题：在拆分式VLM推理中，即使最终文本回复无害，传输中的中间视觉令牌仍可能泄露佩戴者或旁观者的私有属性。作者构建了含3,221条图像-问题记录的配对基准，并提出令牌引导属性隐私保护（TGAP）——一种在LLM之前的令牌解缠器，通过残差变换在令牌离开可信边界前压制隐私信息，将隐私识别准确率从56.7%降到7.4%（绝对下降49.3%），同时维持74.4%的宽松效用，表明保护紧凑令牌接口是实现隐私保护可穿戴多模态AI的可行路径。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴VLM依赖第一视角（egocentric）视觉捕获实现持续多模态辅助，但所需的同一份第一视角证据也可能暴露佩戴者及旁观者的私有属性。现有研究多关注最终文本输出，而中间视觉令牌被传输到下游推理组件时构成了一个未被充分研究的泄露面：即使文本回复无害，攻击者或不可信下游组件仍可从视觉令牌中恢复私有属性。
AI.method: 作者构建了包含3,221条图像-问题记录的配对隐私-效用基准，每条记录同时配有效用问题和覆盖位置、收入、性别、兴趣四类属性的隐私标签。在此基础上提出TGAP（Token-Guided Attribute Privacy），一种作用于LLM之前的令牌解缠器：在视觉令牌离开可信边界前学习一个残差变换，联合优化效用保持、身份正则化、语义隐私抑制和图像驱动表征抑制，从而避免粗粒度硬掩码或注意力掩码带来的效用损失。
AI.result: 在用于源模型评估的基准上，TGAP将隐私属性识别准确率从56.7%降至7.4%（绝对下降49.3%），同时将宽松效用维持在74.4%，在隐私保护与任务效用之间实现了明显优于粗粒度掩码的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在视觉令牌离开可信边界前对其进行解缠与隐私压制，能够有效防范中间令牌传输带来的属性泄露；保护紧凑令牌接口是走向隐私保护可穿戴多模态AI的一条实用路径。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Scientific Equation Discovery
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves language model reasoning by allocating additional test-time compute, but prior work mainly studies closed-ended tasks such as math and coding. We study TTS for automated equation discovery, an open-ended setting where models search over candidate equations and rely on observed datapoints for feedback. We formulate LLM-driven equation discovery as an iterative search process that unifies Best-of-N, sequential refinement, tree search, and evolution-style methods under a common compute-allocation view. To isolate allocation effects from prompt engineering and other heuristics, we compare minimal parallel controllers under fixed budgets. On LLM-SRBench equation-discovery tasks, we find that search width is the dominant allocation parameter: the best width in our sweep generally increases with the compute budget, while the population--branching split and controller choice matter less. Appropriate width selection also improves wall-clock efficiency by increasing parallelism. These results suggest that, given an informative verifier, controlling exploration and exploitation is central to scaling LLM-based equation discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时扩展（TTS）在开放式任务——自动方程发现中的应用，将LLM驱动的方程发现形式化为统一的计算分配视角下的迭代搜索过程，并通过固定预算下的最小并行控制器对比，发现搜索宽度是主导的分配参数，其最优值随计算预算增大而增大，而种群-分支划分与控制器选择影响较小。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（TTS）通过分配额外的测试时计算来提升语言模型的推理能力，但已有工作主要聚焦于数学和代码等封闭式任务。本文希望将TTS推广到自动方程发现这一开放式场景，其中模型在候选方程空间中搜索并依赖观测数据进行反馈，从而探索TTS在开放式设定下的作用机制。
AI.method: 将LLM驱动的方程发现建模为迭代搜索过程，在统一的计算分配视角下将Best-of-N、顺序精炼、树搜索和进化式方法统一起来。为隔离计算分配效应与提示工程等启发式因素，在固定预算下比较多种最小并行控制器（并行搜索控制器），并在LLM-SRBench方程发现任务上进行扫描实验。
AI.result: 实验发现搜索宽度是最主要的分配参数：扫描中最优宽度通常随计算预算增加而增大；种群-分支的拆分比例和控制器选择的影响较小。此外，合适的宽度选择还能通过增加并行度提升墙钟时间效率。
AI.conclusion: 在具备信息量充分的验证器前提下，控制探索与利用的权衡（即计算分配中的宽度选择）是扩展基于LLM的方程发现能力的关键要素。

title: NVE: A Separability and Coverage-Aware Internal Validation Metric for Biclustering
summary: Biclustering, or co-clustering, aims to discover coherent submatrices by grouping rows and columns of a data matrix simultaneously. This local two-dimensional structure makes validation more difficult than in ordinary clustering, where internal indices usually rely on compactness and separation in a single shared feature space. Existing popular internal biclustering measures such as Mean Squared Residue (MSR), and Virtual Error (VE) mainly evaluate within-bicluster coherence. Although useful, these measures do not directly assess whether the extracted biclusters are mutually distinct or whether they explain a meaningful portion of the data matrix. This paper investigates Normalised Virtual Error (NVE), an internal validation metric that extends VE using a super-bicluster normalization strategy. By comparing the VE of each bicluster with the VE obtained after merging it with other biclusters, NVE introduces a relative notion of separability and redundancy. We also study a coverage-adjusted variant, NVE\textsubscript{cov}, which penalizes solutions that obtain low error by selecting only very small submatrices. Through controlled synthetic benchmarks and yeast gene-expression datasets, we examine whether NVE and NVE\textsubscript{cov} provide information beyond standard coherence-based metrics. The results show that NVE is sensitive to redundant and poorly separated biclusters, while NVE\textsubscript{cov} changes solution rankings when low-error biclusters cover only a negligible part of the matrix. These findings suggest that NVE-based measures are useful complementary criteria for internal co-clustering validation, especially when coherence, separability, and coverage must be considered jointly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双聚类（协同聚类）的内部验证指标，提出并系统评估了归一化虚拟误差（NVE）及其覆盖率调整变体NVEcov。NVE通过将每个双聚类的虚拟误差（VE）与合并其他双聚类后的VE进行比较，引入相对的可分离性与冗余性概念；NVEcov则惩罚那些通过选取极小子矩阵获得低误差的解。通过合成基准和酵母基因表达数据实验，发现NVE对冗余和分离不良的双聚类敏感，NVEcov能在低误差双聚类覆盖率极低时改变解排名，可作为传统一致性指标的互补验证标准。
AI.motivation: 双聚类的局部二维结构使其验证比普通聚类更困难，而现有流行的内部双聚类度量（如均值平方残差MSR和虚拟误差VE）主要评估双聚类内部的一致性，无法直接衡量提取的双聚类之间是否相互区分（可分离性）或是否解释了数据矩阵的有意义部分（覆盖率）。因此需要引入能联合考虑一致性、可分离性和覆盖率的新验证指标。
AI.method: 提出归一化虚拟误差（NVE）内部验证指标：将每个双聚类的VE与其合并其他双聚类后得到的VE相比较，从而引入相对的可分离性与冗余性度量。此外还提出覆盖率调整变体NVEcov，对通过仅选择极小子矩阵获得低误差的解施加惩罚。通过受控合成基准和酵母基因表达数据集进行实验，检验NVE与NVEcov是否提供超越标准一致性度量（如MSR、VE）的额外信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，NVE对冗余且分离不良的双聚类表现敏感；NVEcov能够在低误差双聚类仅覆盖矩阵极小部分时改变解的排名。两者均提供了超越标准一致性指标的信息。
AI.conclusion: NVE类指标可作为内部协同聚类验证的有效互补准则，尤其在需要联合考虑一致性、可分离性与覆盖率时具有重要意义。

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Tabu Search for Tactical Wireless Network Design
summary: Designing high-performance tactical wireless networks under realistic operational constraints gives rise to challenging combinatorial optimization problems, where the evaluation of candidate solutions relies on detailed physical and traffic-aware models. Although classical metaheuristics such as Tabu Search offer effective mechanisms for exploring large search spaces, their computational cost remains high because numerous candidate moves must be evaluated at every iteration. In this paper, we propose a data-driven framework that improves the efficiency of Tabu Search by learning to guide its move selection process. Rather than altering the neighborhood structure, our approach exploits the information contained in the search trajectories generated during the optimization process. At each iteration, we record both improving and non-improving edge-based transformations together with a set of descriptive features capturing the structural, geometric, and performance characteristics of the network. This information is used to train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that predicts the impact of candidate moves on the objective function. The trained model is then integrated into the Tabu Search algorithm to rank candidate transformations according to their predicted quality, thereby reducing the number of costly objective evaluations while maintaining an effective exploration of the search space. Experimental results on synthetic benchmark instances demonstrate that the proposed learning-assisted Tabu Search notably reduces computation time while consistently producing higher-quality solutions than the standard algorithm. These findings highlight the potential of combining machine learning with metaheuristics by leveraging the implicit knowledge embedded in search trajectories, paving the way for more efficient solution methods for large-scale network design problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的学习辅助Tabu Search框架，利用搜索轨迹训练图神经网络（GNN）来预测候选移动对目标函数的影响，从而对候选变换进行排序，减少昂贵的目标函数评估次数，在合成基准实例上显著降低计算时间并持续生成更高质量的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 高性能战术无线网络设计在现实约束下会产生具有挑战性的组合优化问题，候选解的评估依赖于详细的物理模型和流量感知模型。经典元启发式算法（如Tabu Search）虽能有效探索大规模搜索空间，但由于每轮迭代需评估大量候选移动，计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出一个数据驱动框架：不改动邻域结构，而是利用优化过程中生成的搜索轨迹信息。每次迭代记录改进与非改进的基于边的变换，并采集描述网络结构、几何与性能特征的属性；用这些数据训练一个GNN，用于预测候选移动对目标函数的影响；将训练好的模型集成到Tabu Search中，对候选变换按预测质量排序，从而减少昂贵的客观评估次数，同时保持有效的搜索空间探索。
AI.result: 在合成基准实例上的实验表明，所提出的学习辅助Tabu Search相比标准算法显著缩短了计算时间，并且持续产生更高质量的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了将机器学习与元启发式方法相结合的潜力——通过利用搜索轨迹中蕴含的隐式知识，为大规模网络设计问题开辟了更高效求解方法的道路。

title: Fully Distributed GNE Algorithms for Multi-Robot Placement without Consensus on Multipliers
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Published in the 2026 American Control Conference (ACC), pp. 3633--3638
summary: Recent machine learning research has increasingly focused on equilibrium analysis in non-cooperative games rather than solely on optimal solutions. Many such problems involve shared constraints and can be formulated as Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems (GNEPs). For strongly monotone games, existing methods compute consensus-based variational GNEs (v-GNEs) by exchanging Lagrange multipliers. We propose a fully distributed continuous-time algorithm for shared linear equality constraints that converges without multiplier exchange and reaches any GNE, reducing communication overhead and improving privacy. Discrete-time schemes are also provided, and the method is validated on a multi-robot placement task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非合作博弈中的广义纳什均衡问题（GNEP），提出一种无需乘子交换的全分布式连续时间算法，可求解共享线性等式约束下的任意广义均衡，并通过离散时间方案与多机器人布局实验验证其收敛性、通信开销降低与隐私性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在强单调博弈中通过交换拉格朗日乘子来计算基于共识的变分广义纳什均衡（v-GNE），但乘子交换会带来较大的通信开销并损害隐私。同时，许多实际问题具有共享约束，需要更高效、更安全的分布式均衡求解方法。
AI.method: 针对共享线性等式约束，设计了一种完全分布式的连续时间算法，无需交换拉格朗日乘子即可收敛到任意广义纳什均衡；同时给出了相应的离散时间方案，以保证实际实现中的可行性。
AI.result: 该算法在无需乘子交换的情况下收敛到任意GNE，显著降低通信开销并增强隐私保护；通过多机器人布局任务验证了方法的有效性与收敛性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无需乘子交换的全分布式算法为解决强单调博弈中的GNEP提供了一种通信高效、隐私友好的新途径，并可通过离散化方案直接应用于多机器人等实际场景。

title: Fast Fault-Tolerant Decoders for Hypergraph Product and Lifted-Product Codes
summary: We design low-complexity, fault-tolerant decoders for quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes with the goal of reducing decoding latency. We target two major bottlenecks of decoding under the \emph{circuit-level} noise model: (i) post-processing via order-statistics decoding (OSD), and (ii) the large number of auxiliary variable nodes commonly introduced to represent CNOT-induced correlations during syndrome extraction. Our key observation is that propagating CNOT faults (\emph{hook errors}) create \emph{stabilizer-induced} trapping sets (TSs) that are intrinsic to hypergraph-product (HGP) and lifted-product (LP) constructions. Therefore, instead of modeling each such fault with an explicit correlation node and relying on OSD to clean up the resulting failures, we design message-passing decoders that resolve the corresponding \emph{stabilizer-induced} TSs directly. We obtain these decoders by deriving QLDPC decoders from decoders for the parent classical LDPC codes and using them collectively to correct broad families of \emph{stabilizer-induced} TSs. For CNOT faults that manifest primarily as syndrome errors, we show that their effect is equivalent to a data error together with syndrome-bit measurement errors. Consequently, given repeated measurements and a decoding graph that already includes nodes representing syndrome-bit errors, no distinct variable node is needed for each CNOT fault. Using a \emph{phenomenological} Tanner graph with nodes representing only data errors and syndrome-bit errors, simulations on the LP codes show a reduction in, or comparable, logical error rates relative to BP+OSD, at substantially lower decoding complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对量子LDPC码在电路级噪声模型下的译码延迟问题，提出低复杂度、容错的译码器。核心发现是CNOT故障（钩错误）在超图乘积（HGP）和提升乘积（LP）码中会产生"稳定子诱导的陷阱集（TS）"，因此无需为每个CNOT故障引入显式相关变量节点并依赖OSD后处理，而是设计能直接消解这类陷阱集的置信传播式（消息传递）译码器。CNOT故障等效为数据错误加综合征比特测量错误，故仅需包含数据错误与综合征比特错误节点的"表观（phenomenological）Tanner图"。仿真表明在LP码上逻辑错误率相比BP+OSD降低或相当，而译码复杂度显著降低。
AI.motivation: 目标是降低量子LDPC码在电路级噪声模型下的译码延迟。作者针对两大瓶颈：(i) 序统计译码（OSD）所需的后处理；(ii) 为表示CNOT诱导的相关性而大量引入的辅助变量节点。这些瓶颈导致译码复杂度和延迟过高。
AI.method: 关键观察是：CNOT故障（钩错误）的传播会形成超图乘积（HGP）与提升乘积（LP）构造所固有的"稳定子诱导陷阱集"。因此，作者不采用显式相关节点加OSD清理的方式，而是从父类经典LDPC码译码器推导出QLDPC译码器，并用它们集体纠正此类稳定子诱导陷阱集。对主要表现为综合征错误的CNOT故障，证明其效果等价于一个数据错误叠加综合征比特测量错误；因此利用重复测量及已含综合征比特错误节点的译码图，无需为每个CNOT故障单独设立变量节点。最终采用仅含数据错误与综合征比特错误节点的表观（phenomenological）Tanner图进行消息传递译码。
AI.result: 在LP码上的仿真显示，所提方案相对BP+OSD在逻辑错误率上有所降低或相当，且译码复杂度显著更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将CNOT故障归约为稳定子诱导陷阱集并直接消解，而非依赖OSD和大量辅助变量节点，可以大幅降低QLDPC码电路级译码的复杂度与延迟，同时保持甚至改善逻辑错误率，为低延迟容错量子译码提供了可行途径。

title: Growing a Stand, Not a Tree: Joint Canopy Generation Reproduces Crown Shyness
summary: In closed forests, neighboring tree crowns often stop short of touching, leaving a network of narrow gaps known as crown shyness. The pattern belongs to the stand rather than to any single tree, which makes it a natural probe of a question in generative modeling: can a learned model produce a set of objects whose defining structure exists only between them? We formulate stand-level canopy generation as set generation with a flow-matching model, in which attention between trees is the only channel through which coupling can arise. Trained on stands grown by a resource-competition simulation that is provably not reducible to per-tree geometry, the joint model halves the clearance distribution error of an identical-capacity model that generates each tree alone, and the advantage persists at stem densities outside the training range. Against field measurements of a tropical oak forest, a single calibrated scalar yields held-out agreement in gap magnitude and crown asymmetry. The directional statistics of the gaps are controlled by stem placement rather than by the growth rule, and match the field once stem jitter is calibrated. Crown shyness, in both the simulation and the learned model, is a property of the stand and not of the tree.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"树冠羞避"这一仅存在于群体之间的结构，提出以流匹配模型进行林分冠层的集合生成，借助树间注意力机制实现树间耦合；相比独立生成单棵树的同容量模型，联合模型将间隙分布误差减半，并在训练范围外的立木密度与热带栎林实地数据上均保持优势，证明树冠羞避属于林分而非单株树木的性质。
AI.motivation: 树冠羞避形成的间隙网络属于林分整体而非任何单棵树，这为生成建模提出了一个核心问题：一个学习模型能否生成一组对象，使其定义性结构仅存在于对象之间？此外，资源竞争模拟已被证明无法简化为单棵树的几何，因此需要在对象间层面构建生成模型。
AI.method: 将林分冠层生成建模为集合生成问题，采用流匹配模型；树间注意力是产生耦合的唯一通道。模型在由资源竞争模拟生成的林分上训练，并用单一校准标量对热带栎林实地测量数据进行对比验证，同时校准立木抖动以匹配间隙的方向统计。
AI.result: 联合模型将间隙分布误差相比逐树生成的同容量模型减半，且在训练范围外的立木密度下优势依然存在；对热带栎林实地数据，单一校准标量即可取得间隙幅度与冠层不对称性的一致；间隙方向统计由立木位置而非生长规则控制，经立木抖动校准后与实地一致。
AI.conclusion: 无论在模拟还是在学习模型中，树冠羞避都是林分层面的涌现属性而非单棵树的属性；基于注意力的集合级流匹配生成能够捕捉仅存在于对象之间的结构，为建模群体交互性对象集提供了有效范式。

title: GreenBench: Benchmarking Energy Efficiency and Carbon Footprint of Open-Source LLM Inference on Apple Silicon
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Accepted at IEEE ICCUBEA 2026
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns about their environmental impact during inference. While Green AI research has focused on datacenter GPUs and embedded platforms, the energy profile of LLM inference on Apple Silicon, with its unified memory architecture, remains unstudied. This paper presents GreenBench, a benchmarking framework that evaluates the energy efficiency, throughput, and carbon footprint of five open-source LLMs (3-9B parameters) across three NLP tasks on an Apple M4 Pro with 48 GB unified memory. Using macOS powermetrics for direct power measurement and Ollama's nanosecond-precision timing, we find that the M4 Pro draws only 0.47 W of CPU+GPU package power during sustained inference, with total system power of 8-12 W, achieving 30-40x better energy efficiency per token than datacenter GPUs in single-user deployment. Smaller models (3-3.8B) deliver 2.6-4.2x higher throughput and up to 62% less energy per token than larger models (7-9B). Pareto analysis identifies Qwen 2.5 (7B) as the optimal accuracy-efficiency trade-off at 57% MMLU and 59 tokens/s, while Llama 3.2 (3B) suits latency-critical applications at 175 tokens/s. We provide per-token energy at package and system levels with CO2 estimates for India and US grids.

AI.tldr: GreenBench是一个基准测试框架，用于评估Apple Silicon（Apple M4 Pro，48GB统一内存）上LLM推理的能耗、吞吐与碳足迹；实测5个开源模型（3-9B参数）在3个NLP任务上的表现，发现M4 Pro推理时CPU+GPU封装功耗仅0.47W、系统功耗8-12W，单用户部署下每token能效比数据中心GPU高30-40倍，并通过Pareto分析给出精度-能效权衡的最优模型选择。
AI.motivation: LLM的快速普及引发了对推理阶段环境影响的担忧，但现有Green AI研究集中于数据中心GPU和嵌入式平台，Apple Silicon统一内存架构下的LLM推理能耗特征尚未被研究。
AI.method: 作者提出GreenBench基准框架：在Apple M4 Pro（48GB统一内存）上，使用macOS powermetrics直接测量功率、借助Ollama的纳秒级精度计时，评估5个开源LLM（3-9B参数）在3个NLP任务上的能效、吞吐和碳足迹，并进行Pareto前沿分析。
AI.result: M4 Pro在持续推理时CPU+GPU封装功耗仅0.47W、总系统功耗8-12W，单用户部署下每token能效比数据中心GPU高30-40倍；小模型（3-3.8B）比大模型（7-9B）吞吐高2.6-4.2倍、每token能耗最多低62%；Pareto分析显示Qwen 2.5（7B）在57% MMLU、59 tokens/s下为精度-能效最优权衡，Llama 3.2（3B）以175 tokens/s适合延迟敏感应用；并给出封装级和系统级每token能耗及印度和美国电网的CO2估算。
AI.conclusion: GreenBench填补了Apple Silicon平台LLM推理能耗研究的空白，证明统一内存架构的边缘设备在单用户部署中具有显著能效优势，为绿色AI的硬件选择和模型规模决策提供了数据支撑与实用工具。

title: Sparse Koopman Autoencoders Identify Local Dynamical Regimes in Multibasin Systems
summary: Koopman autoencoders (KAEs) seek a higher-dimensional latent representation in which nonlinear dynamics evolve linearly. However, many interesting systems have multiple basins of attraction, and both theoretical and empirical work has shown these multibasin systems cannot generally admit a single finite-dimensional global Koopman embedding under standard assumptions. We posit that encoders with a sparsity-inducing objective encouraging few active latent coefficients will provide latent supports as an inspectable basin-modeling principle for Koopman autoencoders. We use these encoders producing sparse latents in training Sparse Koopman Autoencoders (SKAEs) without basin labels or other regime annotations, and treat the learned latent supports as model-produced regime variables after training. Across a range of procedurally generated multibasin systems and chaotic flows, we show that SKAEs have superior forecasting performance compared to dense-latent KAEs. We also perform a mechanistic study that shows latent supports produced by SKAEs are both essential for the quality of the representation and useful for identifying basins on held-out basin interior states, whereas dense-latent KAEs collapse to an uninformative single family. These results identify sparse latents and their corresponding supports as label-free, interpretable regime variables for Koopman learning in nonlinear systems with multiple local dynamical laws.

AI.tldr: 本文提出稀疏Koopman自编码器（SKAEs），通过引入稀疏性激励目标使编码器产生少量活跃的潜在系数，从而在没有流域标签的情况下，将学习得到的潜在支持（latent supports）作为可检查的、无标签的盆地建模机制，用于多吸引子非线性系统的可解释Koopman学习和预测。
AI.motivation: Koopman自编码器（KAEs）试图在高维潜在表示中将非线性动力学线性化，但许多重要系统具有多个吸引盆地，理论与实证均表明这类多盆地系统在标准假设下通常无法承认单一有限维全局Koopman嵌入。因此，需要一种无需流域标签或区域标注、可解释的盆地建模原则来改进KAEs在多盆地系统中的表现。
AI.method: 提出使用带稀疏性激励目标的编码器（鼓励少数活跃潜在系数），训练时无需流域标签或任何区域标注，从而得到稀疏Koopman自编码器（SKAEs）；训练后将学习到的潜在支持视为模型产生的流域变量，并在程序生成的多盆地系统与混沌流上评估其预测性能，同时进行机制性研究以检验潜在支持在表示质量与流域识别中的作用。
AI.result: 在一系列程序生成的多盆地系统和混沌流中，SKAEs的预测性能优于稠密潜在KAEs；机制性研究表明，SKAEs产生的潜在支持对表示质量至关重要，并能有效识别保留的盆地内部状态，而稠密潜在KAEs则坍缩为无信息量的单一族。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏潜在及对应的支持可作为无标签、可解释的流域变量，用于具有多个局部动力学定律的非线性系统中的Koopman学习，为多盆地系统提供可检查的盆地建模与预测框架。

title: CDEP Agent: Connecting Meteorologically Detected Temporal Compound Events to Real-World Documentary Evidence
summary: Compound drought-to-extreme-precipitation (CDEP) events are recognized in climate science as a growing driver of extreme impact, but whether this recognition carries over into real-world early warning and post-event documentation is unknown, so a meteorologically real CDEP event may pass with neither advance warning nor any later record. Here we present CDEP Agent, an auditable LLM-agent framework that tests this mismatch directly by linking CDEP candidates detected from meteorological reanalysis to real-world hazard and impact evidence across sources with different spatial scales, temporal resolutions, and reporting conventions. Using California as a case study, we identify 408 candidate CDEP events from ERA5 observations during 2021-2025 and evaluate each against the U.S. Drought Monitor, NOAA Storm Events, and public webpages along five dimensions: antecedent drought, extreme rainfall, local impact, hazard-impact attribution, and explicit drought-to-rainfall linkage. Only 34.3% of candidates are corroborated on both hazard components, and just 1.5% are ever explicitly linked to their antecedent drought, indicating that most meteorologically detected CDEP events go undocumented and their compound nature almost never enters the record at all. Our framework gives climate scientists a way to test physical event definitions against what actually gets documented, and gives social scientists, economists, and disaster-response agencies a provenance-linked evidence base for compound events that current warning and reporting systems largely fail to capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CDEP Agent，一个可审计的 LLM 智能体框架，用于检验气象学上检测到的复合干旱-极端降水（CDEP）事件是否在真实世界的预警与灾后记录中得到体现。以加州 2021–2025 年 ERA5 数据识别出的 408 个候选事件为对象，仅有 34.3% 的两个灾害分量均获佐证，仅 1.5% 被明确关联到前期干旱，表明大多数气象 CDEP 事件未被记录、其复合属性几乎从未进入档案。
AI.motivation: 气候变化科学界已公认复合干旱-极端降水（CDEP）事件是日益加剧的极端影响驱动因素，但这一认识是否真正进入现实世界的早期预警和灾后记录尚属未知；一个气象上真实存在的 CDEP 事件可能在既无预警也无后续记录的情况下被完全遗漏。作者希望直接检验这种"科学认知"与"实际记录"之间的错位。
AI.method: 构建 CDEP Agent，一个可审计的 LLM 智能体框架，将气象再分析数据中检测到的 CDEP 候选事件与跨不同空间尺度、时间分辨率和报告惯例的多种现实危害与影响证据源相链接。以加州为案例，从 2021–2025 年 ERA5 观测中识别出 408 个候选 CDEP 事件，并对照美国干旱监测（U.S. Drought Monitor）、NOAA 风暴事件数据库（NOAA Storm Events）及公开网页，沿五个维度进行核验：前期干旱、极端降雨、局地影响、危害-影响归因、以及干旱到降雨的显式关联。
AI.result: 在 408 个候选 CDEP 事件中，仅 34.3% 的两个灾害分量（干旱与极端降雨）均获得文档佐证；只有 1.5% 被显式地与其前期干旱相关联。这表明大多数气象学上检测到的 CDEP 事件在真实记录体系中未被记载，且其复合性质几乎从不进入事件档案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为气候科学家提供了一种将物理事件定义与实际文档记录相对照的检验手段，同时为社会科学家、经济学家和灾害响应机构提供了具有溯源链接的复合事件证据基础，弥补了当前预警与报告体系对复合事件严重覆盖不足的缺陷。

title: Constant Individual Regret in General Games
summary: Uncoupled no-regret dynamics provide a decentralized route to equilibrium, but prior guarantees for individual regret retain a polylogarithmic dependence on the horizon. We remove this dependence for every finite $N$-player normal-form game under full-information feedback. We introduce \emph{ECHO-OFTRL}: optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader (OFTRL) equipped with an EMA cascade for high-order optimism (ECHO), where EMA denotes exponential moving average. The algorithm is deterministic and fully uncoupled. If $m_{\max}$ denotes the largest action-set size, then, simultaneously for every horizon $T\geq1$, it guarantees that each of the $N$ players in the game incurs regret upper bounded by $O(\textrm{poly}(N, \log m_{\max}))$. Our algorithm leverages a new form of optimism inspired by modern filter design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECHO-OFTRL 算法，通过将指数移动平均（EMA）级联作为高阶乐观项注入乐观 FTRL（OFTRL），在有限 N 人一般式和完全信息反馈下，同时对所有博弈时长 T 将每个玩家的遗憾上界降至 O(poly(N, log m_max))，完全消除了对时长的多对数依赖，且算法是确定性的、完全非耦合的。
AI.motivation: 非耦合的无遗憾动力学为分布式收敛到均衡提供了途径，但先前对个体遗憾的保证仍保留了对时间水平 T 的多对数（polylogarithmic）依赖。作者希望消除这种依赖，实现与时长无关的、同时对所有 T 成立的最优遗憾保证。
AI.method: 提出 ECHO-OFTRL：在乐观 FTRL（OFTRL）框架上配备一种 EMA 级联（exponential moving average cascade）以构造高阶乐观项（ECHO，即 high-order optimism）。该算法是确定性的、完全非耦合的（uncoupled），其乐观项的设计灵感来自现代滤波器设计。
AI.result: 对于任意有限 N 人一般式博弈，设 m_max 为最大动作集大小，算法同时保证所有 T≥1 下每个玩家的遗憾上界为 O(poly(N, log m_max))，即遗憾与时长 T 完全无关（无对 T 的对数依赖）。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于滤波器设计思想的高阶乐观机制，作者在完全信息反馈下首次实现了对任意有限博弈中个体遗憾的时长无关保证，表明非耦合动力学在不依赖时长多对数因子的前提下即可收敛到近似均衡。

title: Minimax bounds for watermarked and masked recursive discrete distribution estimation
comment: Shorter version to be published at the IEEE Information Theory Workshop 2026
summary: Watermarking has been proposed as a way to identify synthetic samples in estimation settings where no metadata is available to distinguish them from real samples, but its precise effects remain unexplored. In the absence of a distinguishing mechanism, it has been shown that adding synthetic samples significantly reduces the marginal efficacy of new real samples. In this work, we study the minimax loss of such recursive discrete distribution estimation in the presence of watermarks in contrast to the unassisted and oracle-assisted losses. When the fraction of real samples vanishes asymptotically, we provide a lower bound that shows that it is impossible to improve performance by adding watermarks unless the false negative rate of detection also vanishes. Additionally, we show that in most regimes, the worst-case losses of a sequence of simple deterministic estimators match the corresponding lower bounds up to constants. Finally, we propose masking, a randomization procedure that narrows the gap in the remaining regimes to a Jensen gap. We conjecture that a tighter lower bound argument can close this gap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成样本水印对递归离散分布估计极小极大风险的影响，给出了性能不可能提升的充分条件（假阴性率须趋于零），证明简单确定性估计器在多数情形下可达最优（常数因子内），并提出随机化掩蔽（masking）过程以缩小剩余情形的“Jensen 间隙”。
AI.motivation: 水印被提出来用于在缺乏元数据时区分合成样本与真实样本，但其精确影响尚未被探索；已有研究表明，在无区分机制时，加入合成样本会显著降低新增真实样本的边际效用，因此需要从极小极大意义上量化水印带来的收益或限制。
AI.method: 针对带水印的递归离散分布估计建立极小极大损失分析框架，与无辅助（unassisted）和有神谕辅助（oracle-assisted）两种基准对比；推导当真实样本比例渐近消失时的下界，分析一族简单确定性估计器的逐情形最坏情况损失，并提出名为掩蔽（masking）的随机化方案以缩小与下界之间的差距。
AI.result: 证明除非检测的假阴性率同时趋于零，否则在真实样本比例渐近消失时添加水印无法改进性能；在大多数情形下，简单确定性估计器的最坏情况损失与对应下界在常数因子内匹配；掩蔽过程可将剩余情形的差距缩小到一个 Jensen 间隙，并猜想更紧的下界论证可闭合该间隙。
AI.conclusion: 水印的效用受检测假阴性率的严格制约，简单确定性估计器在多数情形已接近最优，而掩蔽随机化可作为弥补剩余间隙的可行手段；Jensen 间隙的闭合留作开放问题。

title: SNF-Bench: Separating Static Drift from Natural Flow in Long-Horizon Fixed-Camera Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation is evaluated with whole-frame metrics that reward motion and temporal consistency. For fixed-camera nature scenes this creates an ambiguity: motion of water, fire, smoke, or rain is desirable, whereas motion of the background is an error. A system can therefore score well on motion while its scene drifts, or on consistency while its flow stagnates. We introduce SNF-Bench, an evaluation framework for long-horizon fixed-camera generation that partitions each scene into static support and dynamic flow and reports static fidelity, flow persistence with absolute magnitude, and drift leakage separately, never as one score. Drift leakage is interpretive context rather than a headline measurement. Each factor is validated mechanistically rather than by correlation with preference: we inject global translation, rotation, and scale drift and progressive late freezing at known severity into real generations, and require each factor to respond in its stated direction and to remain selective against corruptions it does not target. Auditing publicly released long-horizon text-conditioned checkpoints under one recorded common inference configuration, plus an image-conditioned track with released-pipeline references and a deployment-sensitivity panel, we find that whole-frame motion and static-region drift induce near-opposite orderings of the same outputs. At maximum controlled translation, fBD and NBF rise to $1.86\times$ and $1.32\times$ baseline, but whole-frame Dynamic Degree reaches only $1.07\times$---rewarding the corruption. SNF-Bench measures where motion occurs and whether it persists; it does not measure physical realism. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/snfbench/.

AI.tldr: SNF-Bench 是一个针对长时程固定机位视频生成的评估框架，将场景划分为静态支撑与动态流，并分别报告静态保真度、流持续性（含绝对幅度）与漂移泄漏，避免整帧指标在"期望的运动"与"背景漂移"之间的歧义。
AI.motivation: 整帧级别的评估指标同时奖励运动与时间一致性，但在固定机位的自然场景中存在歧义：水、火、烟、雨的运动是期望的，而背景的运动是错误。这导致系统可能因场景漂移而得分高，或因流动停滞而得分高，单个数无法区分二者。
AI.method: 将每个场景划分为静态支撑（static support）与动态流（dynamic flow），分别报告静态保真度、带绝对幅度的流持续性以及漂移泄漏，且从不合并为单一分数；漂移泄漏仅作为解释性上下文而非主要指标。每个因子通过机制化注入验证：对真实生成结果注入已知严重程度的全局平移、旋转、缩放漂移及渐进式后期冻结，要求各因子朝设定方向响应，并对非目标退化保持选择性。此外在统一推理配置下审计公开的长时程文本条件检查点，并包含图像条件轨道与部署敏感性面板。
AI.result: 整帧运动与静态区域漂移对同一批输出产生了近乎相反的排序。在最大受控平移下，fBD 和 NBF 升至基线的 1.86 倍和 1.32 倍，而整帧 Dynamic Degree 仅达 1.07 倍——即整帧指标会奖励该退化。
AI.conclusion: SNF-Bench 度量的是运动发生的位置及其是否持续，而非物理真实性；它提供分离的、机制化验证的多因子评估，能揭示整帧指标掩盖的漂移与流动混淆问题。

title: ReVA: A Region-Aware Visual Assistant for Visually Grounded Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in Visual Question Answering (VQA), yet they continue to struggle with questions requiring precise spatial reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. These limitations often manifest as object, attribute, and spatial hallucinations, where models generate confident but visually unsupported responses due to insufficient region-level and fine-grained visual grounding. To address this challenge, we propose ReVA, a region-aware VQA model that employs a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 Vision Transformer (ViT) and a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct large language model (LLM) connected through a dual bridge that aligns both whole-image and region-level representations with the LLM's embedding space. The image bridge maps final transformer block features into image tokens. The region bridge maps cropped features from enriched intermediate features across ViT blocks so early texture and later object cues are more evident, into K region tokens for every bounding box. ReVA uses a detector stack that supplies automatic zero-shot bounding boxes that are both question-agnostic and question-dependent, using RAM++ (Recognize Anything Model), spaCy, and Grounding DINO. The image tokens and region tokens are concatenated as an LLM prompt prefix to jointly encode scene-level context and fine-grained regional evidence when answering questions. Evaluated on VQAv2, MMBench, POPE, and SEED-Bench, ReVA achieves 82.85% mean F1 on POPE, compared with 81.14% for an image-token baseline without region tokens. These results demonstrate that explicit region-aware visual representations reduce object hallucination and improve the factual grounding of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: ReVA 是一个区域感知的视觉问答（VQA）模型，通过双桥接结构将冻结的 CLIP ViT 视觉编码器与 Qwen2.5 大语言模型对齐，同时注入整图级与区域级视觉表征，以缓解 MLLM 在细粒度视觉理解中的对象、属性和空间幻觉问题；在 POPE 上取得 82.85% 的平均 F1，优于无区域 token 的基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在 VQA 任务上虽有显著进步，但在需要精确空间推理和细粒度视觉理解的问题上仍表现不佳，常产生对象、属性和空间层面的幻觉——即模型在缺乏区域级、细粒度视觉依据的情况下给出自信但不准确的回答。
AI.method: ReVA 采用冻结的 CLIP ViT-L/14 视觉编码器与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 大语言模型，通过“双桥”（dual bridge）连接：图像桥将最终 Transformer 块的特征映射为图像 token；区域桥从多个 ViT 块中增强的中间特征裁剪出区域特征，为每个边界框生成 K 个区域 token，以凸显早期纹理与后期对象线索。检测器栈（RAM++、spaCy、Grounding DINO）自动提供零样本的、既与问题无关也与问题相关的边界框。图像 token 与区域 token 拼接为 LLM 提示前缀，联合编码场景级上下文与细粒度区域证据。
AI.result: 在 VQAv2、MMBench、POPE 和 SEED-Bench 上进行评估，ReVA 在 POPE 上达到 82.85% 的平均 F1，优于不含区域 token 的图像 token 基线（81.14%）。结果表明，显式的区域感知视觉表征能减少对象幻觉并增强 MLLM 的事实性依据。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入区域感知的视觉表征可有效降低 MLLM 的对象幻觉并提升其事实性视觉依据，从而改善细粒度视觉问答的效果；ReVA 验证了区域级 token 对缓解幻觉的重要价值。

title: PathBridger: Subgoal Bridges for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) aims to learn policies for reaching diverse goals entirely from fixed trajectory data. Long-horizon offline GCRL remains challenging because sparse goal-reaching signals must be propagated over many steps, while execution errors cannot be corrected through additional environment interaction. Existing methods address these challenges by improving long-range value estimation or reducing the effective decision horizon through subgoals, options, and action chunks. In several hierarchical methods, however, a selected subgoal specifies where to go, while the intervening state-space path remains implicit in an endpoint-conditioned low-level policy. To address this interface, we propose PathBridger, a hierarchical offline GCRL method that explicitly connects subgoal selection to short-horizon execution. PathBridger constructs a state-space bridge toward the selected intermediate endpoint and decodes it into a short executable action chunk using an inverse dynamics model. Experiments across the evaluated OGBench tasks demonstrate strong aggregate performance, with particularly large gains on the multi-object Cube manipulation tasks. Code: https://github.com/SChoish/PathBridger

AI.tldr: PathBridger是一种分层离线目标条件强化学习方法，通过显式构建通往所选子目标的状态空间桥接（state-space bridge），并利用逆动力学模型将其解码为短程可执行动作块，从而弥合了子目标选择与短视执行之间的接口，在OGBench任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 长程离线GCRL面临两大挑战：稀疏的目标到达信号需在多步间传播，且执行误差无法通过额外环境交互来纠正。现有分层方法虽然通过子目标、选项和动作块缩短有效决策时域，但存在接口问题：所选子目标只指定了“去哪里”，中间的状态空间路径在端点条件的底层策略中仍是隐式的，导致高层规划与低层执行不一致。
AI.method: PathBridger采用分层离线GCRL框架，显式地将子目标选择与短视执行联系起来。具体而言，它构建一条朝向所选中间端点的状态空间桥接路径，并利用逆动力学模型将该路径解码为一段可执行的动作块（action chunk），从而使得高层子目标能转化为可直接执行的低层动作序列。
AI.result: 在评估的OGBench任务上，PathBridger展现出较强的综合性能，尤其在多物体Cube操作任务上获得了显著的大幅提升。
