AI.tldr: 本文研究指令微调大语言模型在系统指令与用户指令直接冲突时如何进行仲裁。作者构建了包含41组配对约束与确定性验证器的基准，在匹配基线、冲突和同通道控制条件下评估了八种模型，将模型行为分为三类：层级尊重型、反层级型和无效果型。针对最强的反层级案例Llama-3.1-8B，作者发现用户偏好式的冲突仲裁并非源于内部冲突解决信号的缺失——其冲突结果可从残差流激活中以0.97的平衡准确率线性解码，且利用按冲突单独训练的logistic回归方向进行引导可将真实系统遵从率从0.132提升至0.530。这表明用户偏好的冲突解决可以与可读的内部仲裁信号共存，干预成败取决于读出方向的几何性质而非探针准确率。
AI.motivation: 指令微调模型在面对系统指令与用户指令直接冲突时如何仲裁尚不清楚，已有工作未系统区分"通道身份"与"指令内容"对遵从行为的影响；同时，用户偏好系统指令的行为是否意味着模型内部缺乏冲突解决的仲裁信号，这一问题有待回答。
AI.method: 构建41组配对约束且具有确定性验证器的冲突基准，在匹配基线、冲突及同通道控制三种条件下评估八种模型，引入System Authority Delta度量通道敏感性；使用Logistic回归在残差流激活上线性解码冲突结果，并与仅含元数据的基线对比；利用按每个冲突单独训练的方向与按合并可分性训练的方向进行激活引导（steering）干预实验。
AI.result: 八种模型被划分为层级尊重、反层级和无效果三类；Llama-3.1-8B为最强反层级模型，冲突试次中仅0.10遵从系统。但其冲突结果在残差流激活上可被线性解码（平衡准确率0.97，较仅元数据基线高17个百分点），Qwen2.5-7B与gpt-oss-20b上也有类似信号。使用每冲突logistic方向在layer-12的均值进行引导，将真实系统遵从率从0.132提升到0.530；而主要面向合并可分性选取的方向引导效果差。
AI.conclusion: 用户偏好的冲突解决可与可读的内部仲裁信号共存，内部并不缺乏冲突解决信号；成功干预的关键在于读出方向的几何特性（按冲突分别拟合而非合并可分性），而非探针准确率本身。

title: Inter-3D VQA: A Roadside Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Spatiotemporally Grounded Visual Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in visual question answering (VQA) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled natural-language reasoning over traffic scenes. However, existing benchmarks are largely built from ego-vehicle views or 2D roadside videos, limiting their ability to evaluate 3D-grounded reasoning over real-world distances, trajectories, infrastructure topology, and safety-critical interactions. We introduce Inter-3D VQA, a large-scale roadside multimodal benchmark for 3D spatiotemporally grounded VQA at intersections. Built from synchronized point clouds and multi-view images, Inter-3D VQA contains 407K QA pairs covering lane-level positions, object relationships, motion patterns, and near-miss-oriented interaction reasoning. We further propose Inter-Geo, an MLLM baseline that integrates object- and scene-level aligned LiDAR representations, and Inter-Metrics, a unified evaluation framework for textual consistency, numerical accuracy, and semantic correctness. Experiments show that Inter-Geo outperforms image-based VLMs, especially on grounded spatial and temporal reasoning tasks. Our benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/ASU-Suo-Lab/Inter-3D-VQA .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 Inter-3D VQA，一个用于路口场景的 3D 时空基准 VQA 大规模路边多模态基准（含 407K 问答对），并给出集成对齐 LiDAR 表示的 MLLM 基线 Inter-Geo 和统一评测框架 Inter-Metrics，实验表明其在空间与时间推理任务上优于基于图像的 VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有 VQA 与 MLLM 基准大多基于自车视角或 2D 路边视频构建，无法评估基于真实世界距离、轨迹、基础设施拓扑和交通安全关键交互的 3D 接地推理能力，因此需要新的 3D 时空接地基准。
AI.method: 从同步点云和多视角图像构建大规模路边多模态基准 Inter-3D VQA，覆盖车道级位置、对象关系、运动模式和近碰撞倾向交互推理；提出 MLLM 基线 Inter-Geo，融合对象级与场景级对齐的 LiDAR 表示；提出统一评测框架 Inter-Metrics，衡量文本一致性、数值准确性与语义正确性。
AI.result: 实验表明 Inter-Geo 在接地空间与时间推理任务上优于基于图像的 VLM，验证了 LiDAR 表征与 3D 接地推理在路口场景中的有效性，基准与代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: Inter-3D VQA 有效补充了现有基准在 3D 时空接地推理上的空白，所提基线与方法展示了多模态 3D 推理的可行性，并为交通场景 VQA 研究提供了统一评测与可复现资源。

title: The Hallucination Signal Is a Mean Shift: Why Simple Probes Suffice
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix
summary: Hidden-state probes effectively detect LLM hallucinations, but the geometry of the signal remains poorly characterized, driving increasingly complex probe architectures. Across three 7B-scale models and three datasets in a paired-example paradigm, we find the signal overwhelmingly dominated by a single mean-shift component, and removing this direction collapses detection to chance. Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis closes about 73% of the gap between 1D and full-dimensional classifiers, so apparent architectural complexity largely reflects high-dimensional covariance estimation difficulty rather than exploitable non-linearity. A simple L2-regularized logistic regression (0.952 AUROC) bounds or outperforms twelve controlled architectural alternatives, and our multi-layer aggregation exceeds CLAP cross-layer attention probing under matched paradigm. Because the signal spans a contiguous layer band, LayerMix aggregates it to match oracle-layer performance without oracle access. Our claims characterize the geometry within the controlled paired-example paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/LayerMix.

AI.tldr: 本文在三类7B规模模型与三个数据集的配对样本范式下，系统刻画了LLM幻觉检测中隐藏状态探针的几何结构，发现信号几乎完全由单一均值平移方向主导；通过收缩线性判别分析与L2正则化逻辑回归表明，复杂探针架构的增益主要来自高维协方差估计而非可挖掘的非线性，并据此提出仅需聚合连续层带的轻量方法LayerMix，可在无需oracle层信息的情况下匹配oracle层的探测性能。
AI.motivation: 隐藏状态探针能有效检测LLM幻觉，但该信号的几何结构尚不明确，导致探针架构日益复杂；作者旨在厘清信号的实际几何特性，以判断架构复杂性是否必要，并简化探测方法。
AI.method: 在三个7B级模型和三个数据集的配对样本范式下，先通过消融验证单一均值平移方向的主导性；使用收缩线性判别分析（Shrinkage LDA）量化1D分类器与全维分类器之间的差距；将简单L2正则化逻辑回归与十二种受控架构替代方案对比；提出LayerMix通过聚合覆盖信号的连续层带来达到oracle层性能，无需oracle访问，并与CLAP跨层注意力探测在匹配范式下比较。
AI.result: 信号几乎完全由单一均值平移分量主导，去除该方向后检测能力降至随机水平；收缩LDA填补了1D与全维分类器之间约73%的差距；简单的L2正则化逻辑回归（AUROC 0.952）达到或优于十二种受控架构；多层聚合在匹配范式下超越CLAP跨层注意力探测；LayerMix在无oracle访问时匹配oracle层性能。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉信号的几何结构本质上是单一均值平移加高维协方差估计困难，而非可利用的非线性结构；因此简单线性探针已足够强，复杂架构收益有限。该结论局限于受控配对样本范式，代码已开源。

title: A Generalized Optimization Engine (GOE) for Edge AI Inference Acceleration
comment: 14 pages, compressed version is under review in IEEE MILCOM 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various domains, yet their widespread deployment is impeded by significant computational costs, particularly on resource-constrained devices. This paper explores the theoretical underpinnings of various AI model optimization techniques, algorithms, and abstractions, discussing their potential to reduce computational complexity, memory footprint, latency, and power consumption. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive hardware (HW) and model-agnostic generalized optimization architecture that integrates these techniques for improved efficiency. Our study underscores the critical role of such a generalized optimization system in preparing model deployment over resource-constrained heterogeneous hardware in a tactical environment. As a concrete demonstration, we show that GOE-compressed language models deploy and run on a GPU-less edge CPU, and that the choice of compression method, not merely its nominal bit-width, determines whether task accuracy survives deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI模型优化技术的理论基础，并提出了一种与硬件和模型无关的通用优化架构（GOE），该架构整合多种优化技术以降低计算复杂度、内存占用、延迟和功耗。通过在无GPU的边缘CPU上部署GOE压缩的语言模型，证明了该方法在资源受限异构硬件上的实用性，并指出压缩方法的选择（而非名义位宽）决定了部署后任务精度的保留程度。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI模型在多个领域展现出强大能力，但其广泛部署受到高昂计算成本的阻碍，尤其是在资源受限设备上。现有优化技术零散且缺乏统一框架，亟需一种通用的、与硬件和模型无关的优化体系来支撑战术环境中异构硬件上的模型部署。
AI.method: 论文首先从理论层面研究各类AI模型优化技术、算法与抽象，探讨其降低计算复杂度、内存占用、延迟和功耗的潜力；随后提出一个全面的、与硬件（HW）和模型无关的广义优化架构（GOE），将多种优化技术整合为统一系统，并通过在GPU-less边缘CPU上部署GOE压缩的语言模型进行具体验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GOE压缩的语言模型能够在无GPU的边缘CPU上成功部署并运行；同时发现，影响任务精度是否在部署后得以保留的关键因素是压缩方法本身的选择，而非其名义位宽。
AI.conclusion: 通用优化系统在资源受限的异构硬件环境中对模型部署具有关键作用；压缩方法的选择比位宽更决定性地影响部署后的模型精度，这为实际部署中的优化决策提供了重要指导。

title: FairReL: Deepfake Detection using Fairness-Aware Representation Learning
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at BMVC 2026. Code: https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL
summary: Although recent deepfake detectors achieve high overall accuracy, their errors remain unevenly distributed across demographic subgroups, with real faces from certain groups more often misclassified as fake. Existing fairness-aware detectors typically regularise the entire feature representation, without identifying or controlling the specific components that drive unfair predictions. Such coarse intervention can over-suppress useful forgery cues while leaving demographic structure in component-specific subspaces. To address this, we identify two subgroup-sensitive components: multi-scale spatial features, which encode local facial and forgery patterns, and fine-tuning-induced residual features, which adapt the backbone to the unfair training distribution. We propose FairReL, a fairness-aware representation-learning framework that targets both components with dedicated demographic supervision. FairReL uses an SVD-decomposed foundation-model backbone to isolate the fine-tuning-induced residual representation, and introduces two complementary losses. Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation (GCWD) suppresses subgroup-imbalanced structure across spatial wavelet sub-bands, while Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment (SLMA) aligns subgroup means within each real/fake class in the residual representation. Experiments on FF++, Celeb-DF, DFD and DFDC show that, against the state-of-the-art fairness-aware detector, FairReL improves unseen-dataset AUC by 3.9% while reducing subgroup FPR disparity by 10.2%. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL .

AI.tldr: 提出 FairReL，一种针对深度伪造检测中人口统计子群体偏差的公平性感知表示学习框架。它通过 SVD 分解的基础模型骨干隔离微调残余特征，并利用 Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation（GCWD）与 Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment（SLMA）两个互补损失，分别约束多尺度空间特征与残余特征中的人口统计结构，在提升未见数据集 AUC 的同时显著降低子群体 FPR 差异。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器整体准确率高，但错误在不同人口统计子群体间分布不均，某些群体的真实人脸更易被误判为伪造。已有的公平性感知检测器通常对整个特征表示做粗粒度正则化，既未识别也未控制导致不公平预测的具体特征成分，这类干预会过度抑制有用的伪造线索，同时让人口统计结构残留在特定子空间中。
AI.method: 识别两类子群体敏感成分：编码局部人脸与伪造模式的多尺度空间特征，以及使骨干网络适应非公平训练分布的微调残余特征。FairReL 使用 SVD 分解的基础模型骨干来隔离微调诱导的残余表示，并引入两个互补损失：GCWD 在空间小波子带上抑制子群体失衡结构，SLMA 在残余表示中按真实/伪造类别对齐子群体均值。
AI.result: 在 FF++、Celeb-DF、DFD 和 DFDC 数据集上，与最先进的公平性感知检测器相比，FairReL 在未见数据集上的 AUC 提升 3.9%，同时将子群体 FPR 差异降低 10.2%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: FairReL 通过对不同特征成分施加针对性的人口统计监督，在保持甚至提升检测性能的同时显著改善跨子群体的公平性，验证了细粒度组件级干预优于整体特征正则化的有效性。

title: VocalAffectBench: Evaluating Vocal Emotion Recognition in AI Audio Models
comment: 6 pages, 6 tables. Benchmark, baseline predictions, and aggregate results are publicly available
summary: Voice products increasingly need affective cues that are present in speech but absent from transcripts. We introduce VocalAffectBench, a public, test-only benchmark for evaluating whether AI audio models can identify expressed vocal emotion from raw audio. The benchmark contains 273 human-recorded English WAV clips from 51 speaker accounts totaling 1.95 hours across seven labels: angry, disgusted, fearful, happy, neutral, sad, and surprised, with 39 clips per class. All baselines are evaluated from audio alone, without transcripts or contextual metadata. Across six released baselines, average accuracy is 35.5%. The strongest baseline, gemini_3_5_flash, reaches 46.5% on the seven-way task, above the 14.3% random baseline but far from robust emotion recognition. A secondary valence-bucket analysis maps labels into positive, neutral, and negative classes, excluding surprised because its valence is ambiguous. Aggregate accuracy under this coarser view is 50.9%. Performance is highly uneven across classes. By recall, neutral is identified most reliably at 75.6% averaged across baselines, while surprised and fearful reach only 10.7% and 15.4%, respectively. These results show that the evaluated baselines can extract some affective signal from speech, but discrete expressed-emotion recognition remains fragile, especially for non-neutral emotions that are often most important in voice agent workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VocalAffectBench，一个仅含测试集的公开基准，用于评估 AI 音频模型从原始语音中识别情绪的能力。该基准包含 273 条人工录制的英语 WAV 音频、51 位说话人、共 1.95 小时、七个情绪标签（每类 39 条）。六个基线模型仅凭音频评估的平均准确率为 35.5%，最强基线 gemini_3_5_flash 达 46.5%（随机基线为 14.3%）；粗粒度效价分桶下聚合准确率为 50.9%。中性情绪召回率最高（75.6%），而惊讶（10.7%）和恐惧（15.4%）识别很差，说明离散情绪识别仍很脆弱。
AI.motivation: 语音产品越来越需要音频中存在的、但转录文本中缺失的情感线索；然而现有模型对离散的、表达出来的情绪识别能力不足，尤其是对话式语音代理工作流中最关键的非中性情绪。
AI.method: 构建并发布 VocalAffectBench：一个公开的、仅含测试集的基准，包含来自 51 个说话人账户的 273 条人工录制英语 WAV 片段、共 1.95 小时，覆盖愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、中性、悲伤、惊讶七个标签（每类 39 条）。所有基线仅凭音频评估，不使用转录文本或上下文元数据；此外还进行了将标签映射为正面、中性、负面（排除效价模糊的惊讶）的二级效价桶分析。
AI.result: 六个已发布基线在七分类任务上的平均准确率为 35.5%，最强基线 gemini_3_5_flash 达到 46.5%（随机基线为 14.3%），距离稳健的情绪识别仍有很大差距。效价桶粗粒度视图下聚合准确率为 50.9%。各类别表现极不均衡：中性召回率最高（各基线平均 75.6%），而惊讶和恐惧仅分别达到 10.7% 和 15.4%。
AI.conclusion: 评估表明，现有基线能够从语音中提取一定的情感信号，但离散表达情绪的识别仍然脆弱，尤其对语音代理工作流中往往最重要的非中性情绪而言，其性能远未达到稳健可靠的水平。

title: RL-FAT: Reinforcement Learning for Fair Adversarial Training
summary: Deep neural networks remain highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, and adversarial training (AT) has become a widely used approach for improving robustness. However, improvements in average robust accuracy often mask substantial class-wise disparities: while some classes become more robust, others may remain disproportionately vulnerable under attack. This imbalance raises an important adversarial fairness concern, particularly in vision tasks where reliable robustness is expected across all categories. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{RL-FAT}, a reinforcement-learning-inspired fair adversarial training framework that uses policy-gradient based feedback from adversarial predictions. RL-FAT interprets the prediction distribution as a policy and combines correctness-based prediction rewards with class-wise value estimates to compute class-specific advantages for policy-gradient optimization. This enables the model to adaptively focus on class-wise misclassification. Furthermore, we introduce a fairness-emphasis adversarial loss that assigns stronger training pressure to classes with high adversarial loss, thereby mitigating class-wise robustness disparity. By combining reinforcement-driven adaptation with fairness-emphasis regularization, RL-FAT improves adversarial robustness while promoting a more balanced robustness distribution across classes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive robust accuracy and substantially reduces class-wise robustness imbalance compared with standard adversarial training baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RL-FAT，一种受强化学习启发的公平对抗训练框架。它通过策略梯度从对抗预测中获取反馈，将预测分布视为策略，结合正确性奖励与类别级价值估计计算类专属优势，并引入公平强调对抗损失，对高对抗损失类别施加更强训练压力，从而在保持竞争性鲁棒精度的同时显著减小类别间鲁棒性差距。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络仍易受对抗扰动影响，对抗训练虽能提升鲁棒性，但平均鲁棒精度的提升往往掩盖了显著的类别间差异：部分类别变得更鲁棒，另一些类别在攻击下仍异常脆弱。这种不平衡引发了对抗公平性问题，尤其在要求所有类别都具有可靠鲁棒性的视觉任务中更为突出。
AI.method: RL-FAT将模型的预测分布解释为策略，结合基于正确性的预测奖励与类别级价值估计，计算类别专属优势值用于策略梯度优化，使模型自适应地聚焦于类别级误分类；同时引入公平强调对抗损失，对具有高对抗损失的类别施加更强的训练压力，从而缓解类别间鲁棒性差异。整体框架结合了强化驱动自适应与公平强调正则化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RL-FAT在取得具有竞争力的鲁棒准确率的同时，与标准对抗训练基线相比显著降低了类别间鲁棒性不平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化驱动的自适应调整与公平强调正则化的结合，RL-FAT在提升对抗鲁棒性的同时促进了跨类别更均衡的鲁棒性分布，为对抗训练中的公平性挑战提供了有效解决方案。

title: FRAC-MAS: A Safe and Explainable Multi-Agent System for Fracture Diagnosis
comment: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI) 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI for Medicine (AgenticMed)
summary: Fracture detection and its clinical interpretability see notable improvements when deep vision models are integrated with agentic AI architectures. While deep learning models achieve high diagnostic performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. We propose FRAC-MAS, an agentic AI system for automated, explainable, and safe bone fracture detection. The framework combines a stacked ensemble of four vision models with conformal prediction to produce statistically grounded differential diagnoses, while a multi-agent workflow performs independent verification, retrieves clinical guidelines, and generates patient-friendly reports. A pipeline-depth ablation study confirms that our multi-agent critic triages 86.6% of cases into a high-confidence auto-confirmed cohort while escalating uncertain cases, outperforming a single-agent baseline. Patient preference studies against Llama, MedGemma, and Gemini further demonstrate significantly more comprehensible clinical reports. These results suggest that integrating multi-agent critics with conformal guarantees enables safer radiology triage while preserving clinician oversight. More broadly, FRAC-MAS demonstrates how cooperative agentic architectures can serve as auditable, human-in-the-loop decision support systems for safety-critical healthcare. Our code is available at https://github.com/hardik1712/FRAC-MAS, and the website is available at https://frac-mas.vercel.app.

AI.tldr: 提出FRAC-MAS，一个面向骨骼骨折检测的可解释、安全的智能体AI系统，结合四模型堆叠集成与保形预测生成具有统计依据的鉴别诊断，并通过多智能体工作流进行独立验证、临床指南检索和患者友好报告生成，在自动分诊安全性和报告可理解性上优于单智能体基线及多个大模型。
AI.motivation: 深度视觉模型在骨折检测中虽有较高诊断性能，但黑箱特性限制了临床采用；同时缺乏统计可靠性保证和临床可解释性，需要一种既准确又安全、可审计的人工在环决策支持系统。
AI.method: 构建FRAC-MAS：1) 堆叠式集成四个视觉模型并结合保形预测，产生具有统计保证的鉴别诊断；2) 多智能体工作流执行独立验证、检索临床指南并生成患者友好报告；3) 通过管道深度消融实验评估多智能体评论者（critic）的分诊能力。
AI.result: 多智能体评论者将86.6%的病例分诊到高置信度自动确认队列，同时将不确定病例升级，优于单智能体基线；在患者偏好研究中，生成的临床报告比Llama、MedGemma和Gemini显著更易理解。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体评论者与保形保证相结合，可在保留临床医生监督的前提下实现更安全的放射学分诊；FRAC-MAS展示了协作式智能体架构可作为安全关键医疗场景中可审计、人工在环的决策支持系统。

title: ClearText-Video: A Large-Scale Text-Centric Video Dataset Bridging Video Restoration and Scene-Text Enhancement
comment: This paper is accepted by 2026 Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made strong progress in visual--linguistic understanding. However, their performance on text-centric video reasoning remains highly sensitive to input quality. Real-world user-provided videos often contain motion blur, compression artifacts, noise, and low-resolution text, which impair reliable text reading and downstream reasoning. Whether MLLMs can robustly read and reason about real-world scene text under diverse quality conditions remains a fundamental open question. We introduce ClearText-Video (CTVid), a large-scale, scene-text-aware benchmark for studying text-centric video understanding under controlled quality variation. CTVid contains 4,639 real-world text-rich egocentric videos, 550K+ frames, 1.6M human-verified scene-text annotations, and 220K+ spatial/temporal question--answer pairs in Chinese and English. For each high-quality video, CTVid provides content-matched Degraded-Quality and Restored-Quality variants, supporting two task families: Text-Centric Video Restoration and Multi-Quality VideoQA. We evaluate 18 representative restoration methods and 16 state-of-the-art MLLMs on CTVid. The results show that visual enhancement does not guarantee textual fidelity or downstream reasoning gains: blur is more damaging than low resolution, restored videos can alter the textual evidence used by MLLMs, and OCR-only pipelines remain far below direct multimodal reasoning. CTVid exposes the gap between video restoration and text-grounded understanding, providing a rigorous foundation for restoration-aware, quality-robust text-centric video systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClearText-Video (CTVid)，一个大规模、场景文本感知的中英文基准，用于在受控质量退化（模糊、压缩伪影、噪声、低分辨率）下评测多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的文本中心视频理解能力。该基准包含 4639 个真实文本丰富的第一视角视频、550K+ 帧、160 万条人工验证的场景文本标注及 22 万+ 时空问答对，并配有内容匹配的退化与恢复版本，支持文本中心视频恢复和多质量视频问答两类任务。评测 18 种恢复方法与 16 个 SOTA MLLM 后发现：视觉增强并不保证文本保真度或下游推理增益，模糊比低分辨率危害更大，恢复视频可能改变 MLLM 使用的文本证据，且纯 OCR 管线远逊于直接多模态推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言理解上取得显著进展，但其文本中心视频推理性能对输入质量高度敏感。真实用户视频常含运动模糊、压缩伪影、噪声和低分辨率文本，损害可靠文本读取与下游推理。MLLM 能否在多样化质量条件下稳健地读取和推理真实世界场景文本，仍是一个根本性未解问题。
AI.method: 构建 CTVid 基准：从真实文本丰富的第一视角（egocentric）视频出发，收集 4639 个视频、550K+ 帧和 160 万条人工验证场景文本标注，并生成 22 万+ 中英文时空问答对。对每个高质量视频提供内容匹配的退化质量（Degraded-Quality）与恢复质量（Restored-Quality）变体，支持两类任务：文本中心视频恢复（Text-Centric Video Restoration）和多质量视频问答（Multi-Quality VideoQA）。在此基础上系统评测 18 种代表性恢复方法和 16 个 SOTA MLLM。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：视觉增强并不保证文本保真度或下游推理增益；模糊比低分辨率更具破坏性；恢复后的视频可能改变 MLLM 所依赖的文本证据；纯 OCR 管线远低于直接多模态推理的效果。这些发现揭示了视频恢复与文本接地理解之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: CTVid 暴露了视频恢复与文本接地理解之间的鸿沟，为开发恢复感知的、质量稳健的文本中心视频系统提供了严格的基础与评测平台。

title: CoVA-SFT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Chain of Visual Abstractions
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has dramatically improved large language models (LLMs) by allowing them to decompose problems into intermediate steps. While CoT is widely effective for linguistic tasks, text-only CoT forces models to serialize visual problems into awkward prose. Although architectural solutions exist to process visual inputs, the community lacks a massive, multi-step, self-corrected dataset to teach models how to build and maintain internal visual workspaces when solving purely textual reasoning problems. To address this limitation, we introduce CoVA-SFT, a highly structured corpus of 51.9K samples containing over 222K multimodal reasoning steps across 5 distinct layout families and 17 complex tasks, and CoVA-Bench, a companion benchmark of 1,700 held-out test samples spanning the same tasks for reproducible evaluation. By providing explicit rationale formulations, agentic renderings, and verification loops, CoVA-SFT teaches multimodal language models to interleave text and visual abstractions. We validate the dataset by demonstrating that models fine-tuned on CoVA-SFT outperform all interleaved CoT baselines by more than 2x on average on CoVA-Bench, though they still fall short of strong text-only CoT baselines, highlighting open challenges for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 CoVA-SFT，一个包含 51.9K 个样本、超过 222K 多模态推理步骤的大规模自校正数据集，以及配套的评测基准 CoVA-Bench（1,700 个测试样本）。该数据集通过显式推理公式、代理渲染和验证循环，教会多模态语言模型在解决纯文本推理问题时构建和维持内部视觉工作区，从而将文本与视觉抽象交织在一起。实验表明，基于 CoVA-SFT 微调的模型在 CoVA-Bench 上平均优于所有交织式 CoT 基线 2 倍以上，但仍弱于强文本-only CoT 基线，指出了未来研究的开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 文本形式的链式思维（CoT）虽能显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但在处理视觉问题时被迫将视觉问题序列化为别扭的文本，缺乏有效的内部视觉工作区。尽管存在处理视觉输入的架构方案，社区仍缺少一个大规模、多步骤、自校正的数据集来教会模型在解决纯文本推理问题时构建并维持内部视觉表征。
AI.method: 构建 CoVA-SFT 数据集，包含 51.9K 样本、222K+ 多模态推理步骤，覆盖 5 种不同布局族和 17 个复杂任务，并配有 1,700 个保留测试样本的 CoVA-Bench 基准。数据集提供显式的推理公式、代理（agentic）渲染以及验证循环，据此对多模态语言模型进行监督微调，使其学会交织文本推理与视觉抽象。
AI.result: 在 CoVA-Bench 上，经 CoVA-SFT 微调的模型在所有交织式 CoT 基线上平均优出 2 倍以上；但相比强文本-only CoT 基线仍存在差距，说明当前方法尚未完全超越纯文本推理。
AI.conclusion: CoVA-SFT 作为首个大规模、多步骤、自校正的视觉工作区推理数据集，能够有效教会多模态模型在文本推理中生成和利用内部视觉表征，并显著超越交织式 CoT 基线。然而其与强文本 CoT 基线间的差距揭示了开放挑战：如何让视觉化推理真正超越纯文本 CoT，仍需进一步探索。

title: Adaptive Multi-Branching for Shallow Decision Tree Induction
summary: Decision trees are attractive for tabular prediction tasks because each prediction follows an interpretable sequence of feature-threshold tests. Under a strict maximum-depth budget, however, conventional binary trees can be under-expressive, since each internal node makes only a single threshold decision. We study shallow-depth tree induction, where the goal is to improve accuracy while keeping root-to-leaf paths short. We propose the Multi-Branch Neural Decision Tree with Adaptive Pruning (MBNDT), a single axis-aligned tree trained end-to-end with differentiable multi-way splits. Each internal node learns ordered thresholds over a selected feature and a branch mask that adapts its effective arity, and the trained model is converted to a deterministic single-path tree for inference. Across 21 OpenML binary-classification benchmarks, MBNDT achieves the best average rank and mean balanced accuracy among depth-constrained single-tree baselines; a controlled ablation isolates multi-way splitting as the source of the gain. These gains come with an explicit trade-off: MBNDT realizes more leaves than the other single-tree baselines, making it best suited when accuracy under short, bounded decision paths is prioritized over minimal global tree size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MBNDT（带自适应剪枝的多分支神经决策树），一种端到端训练的轴对齐树模型，通过可微的多路分裂让每个内部节点一次做出多个阈值决策，从而在严格深度预算下提升浅层决策树的表达能力与精度，并可在推理时转换为确定性的单路径树。
AI.motivation: 决策树因每次预测都遵循可解释的特征-阈值测试序列，在表格预测任务中颇具吸引力。但在严格最大深度预算下，传统二叉树的表达能力不足，因为每个内部节点仅能做出单一的阈值决策，导致浅层树的表达能力受限、精度受限。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Branch Neural Decision Tree with Adaptive Pruning（MBNDT）：一棵端到端训练的单棵轴对齐树，采用可微的多路分裂。每个内部节点在所选特征上学习有序阈值，并通过一个分支掩码自适应地调节其有效分支数（arity）；训练完成后模型被转换为确定性的单路径树用于推理。
AI.result: 在21个OpenML二分类基准上，MBNDT在深度受限的单树基线中取得了最佳的平均排名和平均平衡准确率；受控消融实验证实多路分裂是性能提升的来源。该增益伴随明确的权衡：MBNDT的叶子数量多于其他单树基线。
AI.conclusion: MBNDT最适用于以短且有界的决策路径下的精度为首要目标、而不过分追求全局树规模最小化的场景。

title: ORDDAR: Observation-Driven Reasoning for Distortion-Resilient Decision, Action, and Cognitive Recovery
summary: AI agents increasingly perform long-term reasoning, planning, tool use, memory integration, and autonomous decision making, yet erroneous intermediate states can propagate and cause inconsistent decisions and unreliable outputs. Existing reasoning approaches mainly rely on iterative planning, self-reflection, augmented memory, or verification, but rarely localize and selectively repair faulty reasoning. We present ORDDAR (Observation-Driven Reasoning for Distortion-Resilient Decision, Action, and Cognitive Recovery), a reasoning framework that models reasoning as cognitive state transitions, detects localized distortions, retrieves related reasoning from prior experiences, and repairs only the affected states. ORDDAR therefore performs recovery at the local reasoning-transition level rather than regenerating the complete trajectory. Experiments across mathematical, commonsense, multi-hop, and clinical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved reasoning quality, recovery ability, and interpretability over multiple evaluated reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: ORDDAR 是一种以观察驱动的推理框架，将推理建模为认知状态转移，通过定位局部扭曲、从先前经验检索相关推理并仅修复受影响状态，在局部推理转移层面进行恢复，而非重新生成完整轨迹，从而在数学、常识、多跳和临床推理基准上提升推理质量、恢复能力和可解释性。
AI.motivation: AI代理日益需要执行长期推理、规划、工具使用、记忆整合及自主决策，但错误的中间状态会传播并导致不一致的决策和不可靠输出。现有推理方法主要依赖迭代规划、自我反思、增强记忆或验证，鲜有方法能够定位并选择性修复有缺陷的推理。
AI.method: ORDDAR 将推理建模为认知状态转移，检测局部扭曲，从先前经验中检索相关推理，并仅修复受影响的认知状态。其在局部推理转移层面执行恢复，而非重新生成完整推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在数学、常识、多跳和临床推理基准上的实验表明，与多个评估的推理基线相比，ORDDAR 在推理质量、恢复能力和可解释性方面均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 以局部定位与选择性修复为核心的推理恢复机制（而非整体重新生成）能有效抑制错误中间状态的传播，提升推理的可靠性与可解释性。

title: Beyond Representation Learning: A Systematic Study of Joint-Embedding Predictive Generation for 3D Brain MRI
comment: Preprint, code will be released after review
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have primarily been developed for self-supervised representation learning. Denoising JEPA (D-JEPA) recently demonstrated strong generative capabilities on natural images, yet the applicability to 3D medical imaging remains unexplored. Building on the D-JEPA framework, we present Med-D-JEPA, a systematic adaptation and evaluation of joint-embedding predictive generation for 3D brain MRI. Med-D-JEPA operates on continuous latent tokens produced by a 3D KL-regularized adversarial variational autoencoder, and combines masked context prediction, representation-level alignment, per-token diffusion, and iterative next-set-of-token sampling. We evaluate unconditional and class-conditional generation quality on BraTS2019 and OASIS-1 datasets; downstream classification utility; and preliminary whole-tumor segmentation on BraTS2020. Across different generation settings, Med-D-JEPA achieves superior or competitive performance compared to several strong baselines on fidelity and diversity metrics. Compared to training with real samples, Med-D-JEPA-based synthetic pretraining improves classification AUC from 0.63 to 0.85 on BraTS2019 and from 0.78 to 0.87 on OASIS-1. In the segmentation study, pretraining on Med-D-JEPA samples improves Dice from 0.74 to 0.80 and reduces HD95 from 13.40 to 9.56 mm. These findings establish joint-embedding predictive generation as a promising direction for 3D medical image synthesis and encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Med-D-JEPA，将去噪联合嵌入预测架构（D-JEPA）系统性地适配到3D脑部MRI生成任务，在3D KL正则化对抗VAE的连续潜变量token上结合掩码上下文预测、表征对齐、逐token扩散与迭代式下一组token采样，并在BraTS/OASIS数据集上验证了其在无条件和类别条件生成、分类预训练及分割预训练中的有效性与优势。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）此前主要被用于自监督表征学习，虽然D-JEPA已在自然图像上展现出强大的生成能力，但其在3D医学影像生成领域的适用性尚未被探索，因此需要对其进行针对性的适配与系统评估。
AI.method: Med-D-JEPA基于D-JEPA框架，在3D KL正则化对抗变分自编码器产生的连续潜变量token上运行，融合了掩码上下文预测、表征层面对齐、逐token扩散以及迭代式下一组token采样四种机制，并据此进行无条件与类别条件生成。
AI.result: 在BraTS2019、OASIS-1和BraTS2020上的实验中，Med-D-JEPA在保真度与多样性指标上与多个强基线相比取得更优或相当的性能；基于Med-D-JEPA合成样本的预训练将BraTS2019分类AUC从0.63提升到0.85、OASIS-1从0.78提升到0.87；分割预训练将Dice从0.74提升到0.80，并将HD95从13.40 mm降至9.56 mm。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明联合嵌入预测生成是3D医学图像合成的一个有前景的方向，值得进一步研究探索。

title: The Illusion of Replacement: Rethinking Specialized Machine Learning Models in the Foundation Model Era
summary: Can the specialized architectures that machine learning has traditionally built for structured data be replaced by language-based models? This question is examined through a review of 159 papers (2016--2026) across nine modalities, with predictive accuracy considered alongside structural representation and computation. A distinction is made between performing a task and preserving and computing the structure that makes the task tractable, and existing approaches are organized into eight representational regimes, ranging from language-only systems to fully specialized architectures. Language-mediated models are found to be highly competitive in specific settings, including extreme few-shot prediction, discretized symbolic tasks, textually annotated knowledge graphs, and large-scale single-modality pretraining. However, whenever structural representation or computation is directly evaluated rather than accuracy alone, no evidence of general architectural replacement is found. Instead, a recurring pattern is observed across independent research communities: when language alone is insufficient, the missing structure is reintroduced through a graph module, structural tokens, specialized attention, or another non-linguistic component. In this sense, specialization more often relocates than disappears. Moreover, although performance of language-based models is improved by scaling, whether the gap to a structure-aware architecture can eventually be eliminated remains untested.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述2016至2026年间159篇论文、覆盖九种模态，考察语言模型能否替代专为结构化数据设计的专用架构。研究发现，语言中介模型在极端少样本预测、离散化符号任务、文本标注的知识图谱和大规模单模态预训练等特定场景中极具竞争力；但一旦直接评估结构表示与结构计算而非仅看准确率，则没有任何证据表明语言模型能实现普遍的架构替代。反复出现的模式是：当语言本身不足时，缺失的结构会通过图模块、结构token、专用注意力等非语言组件被重新引入——专门化更多是“迁移”而非“消失”。此外，缩放虽能提升语言模型性能，但其与结构感知架构之间的差距能否最终消除仍属未验证问题。
AI.motivation: 传统上机器学习为结构化数据构建专用架构（如图神经网络、Transformer变体），而语言模型如今声称能处理多样任务。作者希望检验一个根本性问题：语言模型能否在保持结构表示与计算的前提下，真正替代这些专用架构，而不仅仅是表面上完成任务。
AI.method: 对2016—2026年间159篇论文进行系统综述，覆盖九种模态；将“执行任务”与“保持并计算使任务可行的结构”区分开，并把现有方法组织为从纯语言系统到完全专用架构的八种表示体制（representational regimes）。评估维度除预测准确率外，还纳入结构表示与结构计算。
AI.result: 语言中介模型在极端少样本预测、离散化符号任务、文本标注知识图谱和大规模单模态预训练等特定场景中表现高度竞争；但在直接评估结构表示或结构计算时，未发现任何普遍架构替代的证据。各独立研究社区中反复出现同一规律：当语言不足时，以图模块、结构token、专用注意力或其他非语言组件重新引入缺失的结构，即专门化更多是发生迁移而非消失。缩放虽能提升语言模型性能，但能否最终消除与结构感知架构的差距仍未得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型不能全面替代结构专用架构；结构需求在架构设计中会以各种形式重新出现，说明“结构”与“专门化”是学习系统中不可回避的要素。关于缩放能否彻底弥合差距的问题仍悬而未决，需要未来实验来检验。

title: When Do Larger Batches Help Scale LLM Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Larger batches reduce the variance of stochastic gradients per update and are therefore often expected to accelerate training. Yet whether this statistical benefit translates into lower wall-clock time-to-target remains unclear, because each update consumes more samples and may take longer to execute. We study this tradeoff in reinforcement learning for large language models. We separate its algorithmic and systems effects by comparing learning and execution along their natural axes. At the algorithmic level, we compare configurations at equal cumulative sample counts while retuning batch-dependent hyperparameters. Over a bounded range of batch sizes, this procedure yields an approximately batch-size-invariant family whose members follow similar sample-indexed learning trajectories. At the systems level, we exploit the computational asymmetry between rollout generation and training: autoregressive generation is often memory-bandwidth-bound at low concurrency, whereas training work scales approximately with the number of processed tokens. Combining these two views yields a direct decision rule: a larger-batch configuration reduces time-to-target only when its throughput gain exceeds its samples-to-target penalty. Experiments with GRPO and PPO support both sides of this decomposition. At the algorithmic level, square-root learning-rate scaling with Adam produces approximately batch-size-invariant learning curves over a bounded range of batch sizes. At the systems level, larger batches improve generation throughput by up to 2.29x on fixed hardware. In GRPO, combining higher throughput with learning-rate retuning reduces time-to-target by up to 29%, whereas increasing the batch without retuning is slower despite its higher throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大规模语言模型强化学习（RLHF）中批大小对训练效率的影响，将算法效应与系统效应分离。在算法层面，通过重调与批大小相关的超参数（如对Adam采用平方根学习率缩放），在相同的累计样本数下，不同批大小配置可产生近似批大小不变的样本-学习轨迹；在系统层面，利用自回归生成（受内存带宽限制、并发度低）与训练（随处理token数扩展）的计算不对称性，提出了一个直接决策准则：更大批大小仅在吞吐增益超过样本到目标惩罚时才能降低到达目标总时间。GRPO与PPO实验验证了该分解，更大批大小在固定硬件上实现最高2.29x生成吞吐提升；在GRPO中，结合更高的吞吐与学习率重调可将收敛总时间降低最多29%，而未经重调地增大批大小反而更慢。
AI.motivation: 直觉上更大的批大小会降低随机梯度更新的方差、从而加速训练，但其统计收益是否能转化为更低的墙钟时间（time-to-target）尚不明确，因为每次更新消耗更多样本且执行耗时更长。作者希望在LLM的强化学习训练中系统地厘清这一权衡，避免因算法与系统效应交织而导致错误结论。
AI.method: 作者将批大小的影响沿自然轴分解为两个层面：算法层面，在相同累计样本数下比较不同批大小配置，并对批相关的超参数（如学习率，采用平方根缩放配合Adam优化器）进行重调，构建近似的批大小不变族；系统层面，利用rollout生成（自回归解码在低并发时受内存带宽限制）与训练（计算量随处理token数近似线性扩展）之间的计算不对称性，测量更大批大小带来的吞吐增益。二者结合形成决策规则：仅当更大批配置的吞吐增益超过其样本到目标惩罚时，才值得采用。
AI.result: 实验表明：在算法层面，对Adam采用平方根学习率缩放可在有界批大小范围内产生近似批大小不变的采样学习曲线；在系统层面，更大批大小在固定硬件上将生成吞吐提升最多2.29倍。在GRPO中，将更高吞吐与学习率重调结合可将time-to-target降低最多29%，而仅增大批大小不进行重调，尽管吞吐更高，收敛反而更慢。
AI.conclusion: 批大小在LLM强化学习中的影响必须同时考虑算法与系统两方面：算法上的方差降低需通过重调学习率等超参数才能转化为同等数量样本下的等价学习进度，系统上的吞吐提升则来自生成阶段与训练阶段的计算不对称。二者需结合吞吐增益与样本惩罚的权衡来判断是否使用更大批大小，仅凭吞吐提升或方差降低之一不足以预测更低的墙钟收敛时间。

title: Beyond the Answer Key: Robustness Evaluation of Large Language Models for Step-Level Mathematical Verification
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as graders, verifiers, and process auditors, but most mathematical evaluations still emphasize final-answer accuracy. This can obscure whether a model can verify a non-canonical but valid solution trace. We introduce a controlled linear-equation benchmark for evaluating LLMs in the evaluator role. Each instance asks the model to judge final-answer correctness, step-level trace correctness, and the first incorrect step. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art open LLMs reveals a significant robustness gap: models that accurately evaluate canonical solutions often fail when presented with perturbed but logically equivalent variants. Across GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen3-14B, and Phi-4-Reasoning, base models perform well on canonical traces but degrade substantially on perturbed traces, especially for error localization. On valid perturbed traces, base-model false-rejection rates reach 75.6-85.3%, showing strong sensitivity to canonical solution form. Supervised fine-tuning, distillation, and test-time compute improve robustness in some settings, but gains are model dependent and can trade off against canonical performance. The results show that reliable process-level verification remains challenging, and evaluator robustness should be measured separately from solver accuracy, even in a simple algebraic domain with exact ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大多数数学评测只关注最终答案正确性，掩盖了LLM能否验证非规范但有效的解题过程的问题。作者提出一个受控的线性方程基准，让模型判断最终答案正确性、分步过程正确性及首个错误步骤。实验发现，即便在简单代数域且有精确真值，SOTA开源模型在规范解法上表现良好，但在逻辑等价但被扰动的解法上大幅退化，错误拒绝率高达75.6-85.3%，说明过程级验证的鲁棒性仍需单独评测。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作评分器、验证器和过程审计者，但多数数学评测仍强调最终答案准确率，无法反映模型是否能验证非规范但有效的解题过程。为填补这一空缺，需要专门评测模型作为评估者时的过程级验证能力与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建一个受控的线性方程基准，每个实例要求模型分别判断：最终答案正确性、分步轨迹正确性、以及首个错误步骤；对GPT-OSS 20B、Qwen3-14B、Phi-4-Reasoning等模型在规范轨迹与扰动但逻辑等价的轨迹上进行对比，并考察监督微调、蒸馏和测试时计算的作用。
AI.result: 模型在处理规范解法时准确，但面对扰动变体时显著退化，尤其在错误定位上；在有效的扰动轨迹上，基础模型的错误拒绝率达到75.6-85.3%，对规范解法形式高度敏感。监督微调、蒸馏和测试时计算在某些设置下能提升鲁棒性，但收益因模型而异，并可能与规范轨迹上的性能产生权衡。
AI.conclusion: 即使在拥有精确真值的简单代数领域，可靠的过程级验证仍然具有挑战性；评估者鲁棒性应作为独立于求解准确率的指标单独衡量。

title: Blind Stereoscopic Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment Using Predictive Coding Hierarchy
summary: Stereoscopic omnidirectional images (SOIs) have provided users with newly immersive quality of experience in virtual reality environments. However, developing efficient and accurate perceptual quality assessment metrics for SOIs remains challenging due to many factors such as freely changeable field of views and binocular vision. In this paper, based on the characteristics of the human visual system (HVS), we propose a Predictive Coding Hierarchy-inspired metric (PCH) for blind/no-reference stereoscopic omnidirectional image quality assessment. Motivated by the viewing process of SOIs, the proposed PCH includes a local cyclopean perception module, a global predictive perception module, and a visual quality regressor. First, observers browse different spherical sceneries from viewports, and aggregate the local visual information to infer the perceptual quality of SOIs. Therefore, we extract various viewports, followed by cyclopean conversion and saliency detection to approach the perception and attention of the human brain. After the local aggregation, viewers then infer the global scene in their minds. Based on the binocular mechanism, we fuse left and right views to perform predictive coding hierarchy modelling. Finally, the visual quality regressor is exploited to obtain the ultimate quality score related to both local and global perceptual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PCH achieves competitive and consistently improved performance compared with state-of-the-art quality assessment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预测编码层级（Predictive Coding Hierarchy, PCH）思想的无参考立体全方位图像质量评估指标，通过局部双眼竞争（cyclopean）感知模块和全局预测感知模块模拟人类视觉系统（HVS）的观看过程，实现对立体全景图像质量的高效评估。
AI.motivation: 立体全方位图像（SOIs）在虚拟现实环境中提供了沉浸式体验，但因其视场可自由变化、双眼视觉机制复杂等因素，开发高效准确的感知质量评估指标仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 该方法包含三个模块：1）局部双眼竞争感知模块——从视口提取图像，进行cyclopean转换和显著性检测以模拟人脑感知与注意力；2）全局预测感知模块——基于双眼机制融合左右视图进行预测编码层级建模，模拟观者在脑中推理全局场景的过程；3）视觉质量回归器——结合局部与全局感知线索输出最终质量分数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的PCH方法与最先进的质量评估方法相比，取得了有竞争力且持续改进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了借鉴HVS的预测编码层级思想能够有效提升立体全方位图像质量评估的准确性和鲁棒性，为VR场景下的盲图像质量评估提供了新思路。

title: Detecting and Guiding LLM-Generated Korean Poetry with Interpretable Form-level Features
summary: LLMs often struggle with modern Korean poetry, producing outputs that resemble "line-broken prose." We address two coupled tasks: detecting whether a Korean poem is human- or LLM-authored, and guiding LLMs to generate poetry closer in form to human writing. We quantify the human-LLM gap along four form-level linguistic dimensions: output length (Volume), the diversity and connective use of line-final forms (Structure Variation), the irregularity of line lengths (Rhythmic Irregularity), and adherence to standard orthography (Normative Adherence). We operationalize these dimensions as five interpretable features. For detection, a logistic regression classifier over these five features attains an average AUC-ROC of 83.60 in zero-shot out-of-distribution detection across seven unseen LLMs, versus 75.84 for the strongest baseline in our comparison, KatFishNet, an absolute gain of 7.76 AUC points and a 10.23% relative improvement; one generator-specific punctuation pattern outside our taxonomy remains a boundary case. For generation, expert evaluation on GPT-5.2 prefers feature-guided poems over the unconstrained baseline, and analyses across GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3 show that targeted length, rhythm, and ending statistics move toward the human distribution. These results suggest that interpretable, language-specific features can bridge the diagnosis and guidance of LLM-generated poetry.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM生成现代韩语诗歌时"像换行散文"的问题，定义了四个形式维度（长度、行末形式多样性、节奏不规则性、正字法规范性）并量化为五个可解释特征，同时用于两种耦合任务：人类/LLM诗歌检测与LLM诗歌生成引导。检测上，基于这五个特征的逻辑回归在7个未见LLM上的零样本分布外检测中达到83.60的平均AUC-ROC，比最强基线KatFishNet高7.76个点；生成上，GPT-5.2与Gemini-3上的专家评估和统计分析均表明特征引导的诗歌更接近人类分布。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的现代韩语诗歌在形式上常退化为"换行散文"，缺乏韩语诗歌特有的形式特质，因此需要：(1)识别人类与LLM诗歌之间可量化的形式差距；(2)将这种差距的诊断能力转化为引导LLM生成更接近人类形式的诗歌的能力。现有模型（如KatFishNet）检测精度不足，且缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 将人类与LLM诗歌的差距沿四个形式层面量化：输出长度（Volume）、行末形式的使用多样性与连接性（Structure Variation）、行长的不规则性（Rhythmic Irregularity）、标准正字法的遵循程度（Normative Adherence），并将其具体化为5个可解释特征。检测任务使用基于这5个特征的逻辑回归分类器进行零样本分布外检测；生成任务则利用这些特征作为引导信号，结合专家评估与统计分析（GPT-5.2与Gemini-3）验证效果。
AI.result: 检测方面：逻辑回归在7个未见LLM上达成83.60的平均AUC-ROC，较最强基线KatFishNet（75.84）绝对提升7.76点、相对提升10.23%；仅有一个生成器特有的标点模式超出特征分类体系而构成边界案例。生成方面：对GPT-5.2的专家评估更偏好特征引导的诗歌；对GPT-5.2与Gemini-3的分析表明，目标化的长度、节奏与行末统计均向人类分布移动。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的、语言特定的形式特征能够同时服务于LLM诗歌的"诊断"（检测）与"引导"（生成），弥合两者之间的鸿沟；这提示形式层面的细粒度分析是提升LLM诗意输出质量且保持可解释性的有效途径。作者还指出未来工作需补充对生成器特有标点等超出当前分类体系模式的研究。

title: A Spectral Identifiability Threshold for Dissipative Rate Recovery from Truncated Liouvillian Spectra
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Data and code are available at Zenodo, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22160077
summary: Open quantum systems lose energy and phase coherence through different dissipative processes, but these processes can produce overlapping dynamical signatures. The Liouvillian spectrum summarizes how such a system relaxes, yet it is not obvious how much of that spectrum is needed to distinguish the underlying dissipation rates. We study this question for amplitude damping and dephasing in a six-qubit Lindblad model whose spectrum can be derived analytically. We retain only the slowest non-steady spectral modes and ask how many are required before each dissipative rate becomes recoverable. We show that population modes contain no dephasing information, which creates a lower bound of D = 2^n retained modes for uniform dephasing identifiability in the relevant rate regime. The measured recovery threshold reaches this bound at n = 4,5,6, while n = 3 remains above it. At n = 6, least squares achieves a mean joint absolute error of order 10^-9, compared with 4.355 x 10^-4 for four tabular learning methods. Robustness tests show that this advantage weakens when the spectra are perturbed and when a transverse field breaks the commuting structure. These results show that the amount and structure of retained spectral information can determine whether dissipative parameters are recoverable, independently of the estimator used. The present conclusions apply to noise-free simulator spectra rather than measurement-derived spectra.

AI.tldr: 本文研究六量子比特 Lindblad 开放量子系统中，需要保留多少慢速非稳态 Liouville 谱模式才能从谱中恢复幅度阻尼与退相位速率。作者发现布居数模式不含退相位信息，从而给出均匀退相位可辨识性的下界 D=2^n；在 n=4,5,6 时最小二乘估计达到该下界，而 n=3 时高于下界。在 n=6 时最小二乘的联合平均绝对误差约 10^-9，远优于四种表格学习方法的 4.355×10^-4，但该优势在谱受扰动或横向场破坏对易结构时减弱。结论适用于无噪声的模拟器谱。
AI.motivation: 开放量子系统会通过不同的耗散过程（如幅度阻尼和退相位）损失能量与相位相干性，而这些过程可能产生重叠的动力学特征。Liouvillian 谱虽能汇总系统的弛豫行为，但尚不清楚需要保留谱的多少信息才能区分底层耗散率。作者希望回答：在给定由幅度阻尼和退相位构成的六量子比特 Lindblad 模型中，保留多少最慢的非稳态谱模式才能使得各个耗散率可恢复，并探究这一可恢复性与所用估计器是否相关。
AI.method: 作者选取谱可解析推导的六量子比特 Lindblad 模型，同时包含幅度阻尼与退相位。研究中仅保留最慢的非稳态谱模式，逐步增加保留模式数量，考察各耗散率何时变得可恢复；通过解析分析布居数模式的结构确定可辨识性下界，并对比最小二乘与四种表格学习方法在恢复误差上的表现，同时进行扰动谱和引入横向场破坏对易结构下的鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: 结果表明布居数模式不含退相位信息，这给出均匀退相位可辨识性的下界 D=2^n（n 为量子比特数）。在相关速率区间，测得的恢复阈值在 n=4,5,6 时恰好达到该下界，而 n=3 时高于下界。在 n=6 时，最小二乘实现约 10^-9 量级的平均联合绝对误差，四种表格学习方法的误差为 4.355×10^-4。当谱被扰动或横向场破坏对易结构时，该优势减弱。
AI.conclusion: 保留谱信息的数量与结构决定了耗散参数是否可恢复，且这一结论独立于所使用的估计器。作者指出，这些结论基于无噪声的模拟器谱而非测量得到的谱，意味着实际测量中谱噪声会削弱估计优势，仍需进一步研究。

title: Pro-Router: Token-Aware Progressive Model Routing with Adaptive Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
summary: The remarkable performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) comes at the cost of substantial computational overhead, posing significant challenges to real-time deployment and cost effectiveness. Existing model routing approaches either decide from coarse request-level features alone or spend one or several extra language model passes to inspect the generated response, leaving the token-level uncertainty signals that emerge during generation unused. To address these limitations, we propose Pro-Router, a token-aware progressive model routing method with adaptive edge-cloud collaboration for efficient multimodal LLM inference. Pro-Router employs a two-stage progressive decision mechanism. First, a lightweight prompt pre-scorer module performs rapid pre-screening before token generation begins, guiding apparently simple requests to small models. Second, a token-aware verifier reads the sampling probability distribution of each token the small model generates, estimating the model's confidence in its own output to determine, per request, whether the answer ships or escalates to the cloud-based high-precision model. Furthermore, we design an adaptive edge-cloud serving pipeline that sizes every dispatch to each device's measured service rate, so both the edge and the cloud tiers stay fully utilized without manual parameter tuning and are not impacted by the network latency. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets and models demonstrate the effectiveness of Pro-Router. Compared to other methods, it achieves the highest routing accuracy and improves routing speed by more than 10x. Its serving pipeline also reaches more than 75% higher end-to-end throughput than the existing model routing pipeline. Our code is available at https://github.com/xinyuangui2/pro-router.

AI.tldr: 提出Pro-Router，一种基于token感知的两阶段渐进式模型路由方法，并结合自适应边云协作流水线，实现多模态大语言模型推理的高效路由与高吞吐服务。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型性能优异但计算开销巨大，妨碍实时部署与成本效益。现有模型路由方法要么仅依赖粗粒度的请求级特征，要么额外耗费一次或多次语言模型前向来检查生成结果，未能利用生成过程中自然涌现的token级不确定性信号，导致路由决策不准确且耗时。
AI.method: Pro-Router采用两阶段渐进式决策机制：第一阶段由轻量级prompt预评分器在token生成前快速预筛，将明显简单的请求导向小模型；第二阶段由token感知验证器读取小模型每个生成token的采样概率分布，评估模型对自身输出的置信度，据此逐请求决定答案是直接交付还是升级至云端高精度模型。此外，设计自适应边云服务流水线，根据每台设备的实测服务速率调整每次分派规模，使边缘与云端两个层级保持满载，无需手动调参且不受网络延迟影响。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集和模型上的大量实验表明：相比其他方法，Pro-Router达到最高路由准确率，路由速度提升超过10倍；其服务流水线相比现有模型路由流水线，端到端吞吐量提升超过75%。
AI.conclusion: Pro-Router通过利用生成过程中token级置信度信号并结合自适应边云协作流水线，解决了现有路由方法决策粗糙、开销大的问题，在路由准确性、路由速度与端到端吞吐量上均取得显著提升，代码已开源。

title: A Large-scale Evaluation of Text-guided Models for Facial Editing
summary: Facial appearance editing powers popular applications like FaceApp and Photoshop. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs) have been widely used for facial editing. GANs can perform varied facial edits (e.g., changing hair color, hairstyle), but often produce unstable edits. 3DMMs produce stable edits, but can only alter pose and facial expression. Recently, text-guided diffusion models like Nano Banana have become popular for image editing. Text-guided models are a compelling alternative to GANs and 3DMMs since they can produce both stable and varied image edits. While text-guided models have been widely tested for whole-scene edits (e.g., ``make the woman play a guitar''), they have not been comprehensively tested for facial editing. We conducted the first large-scale evaluation ($\sim1$M images evaluated) of six popular text-guided models on a sequential facial editing task. We present Face-Edit-Attributes, the largest collection of $169$ facial editing attributes focused on hair, accessories, and pose edits. We compared model performance using two popular celebrity face datasets: CelebA and CelebSET. Our results show that most models performed hair and accessory edits well, but struggled with editing pose. All models over-edit (e.g., changing hair color when asked only to change the hairstyle). We also evaluated demographic biases in each model. Our results show surprising biases in overediting: almost all models created more overedits for dark-skinned male faces and old faces. The code and data for our results (including our repository of $\sim 1$M images) can be accessed \href{https://github.com/rahul1801/Face-Edit-Bench}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对六种主流文本引导扩散模型在面部编辑任务上进行了大规模评估（约100万张图像），提出了包含169种面部编辑属性的Face-Edit-Attributes数据集，发现多数模型在头发和配饰编辑上表现良好但在姿态编辑上存在困难，且所有模型存在过度编辑问题及人口统计学偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有的面部编辑方法存在局限：GANs能进行多样化编辑（如改变发色、发型）但编辑不稳定；3DMMs编辑稳定但仅能改变姿态和表情。文本引导扩散模型（如Nano Banana）既能产生稳定又能产生多变的编辑，是GANs和3DMMs的有力替代方案，但此前虽在整场景编辑中被广泛测试，却未被系统性地评估于面部编辑任务，缺乏大规模、全面的评测。
AI.method: 作者开展了首个大规模评估（约100万张图像），在顺序面部编辑任务上测试了六种流行的文本引导模型。为此构建了Face-Edit-Attributes数据集——目前最大的包含169种面部编辑属性（聚焦头发、配饰和姿态编辑）的集合，并使用CelebA和CelebSET两个流行名人脸数据集比较模型性能，同时评估了各模型的人口统计学偏差。
AI.result: 结果显示：多数模型在头发和配饰编辑上表现良好，但在姿态编辑上表现困难；所有模型均存在过度编辑现象（例如仅要求改变发型时却连带改变了发色）；在人口统计学偏差方面，几乎所有模型对深肤色男性面孔和年老面孔产生了更多的过度编辑。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导扩散模型是面部编辑的有力工具，但在姿态编辑、过度编辑和人口统计学偏差方面仍存在明显不足。作者公开了代码、数据以及约100万张图像的仓库，为后续面部编辑模型的研究和评估提供了基准资源。

title: A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: A wide range of methods have been proposed for interpreting language models, delivering important insights into their inner workings. However, different methods and their resulting insights stand in relative isolation: what could the underlying structure of language models be, such that they give rise to all our interpretations? In this work, we propose using Tensor Product Representations (TPRs) as a unifying hypothesis. TPRs give a concrete proposal for how compositional structure could be represented in vector space --- as filler-role bindings. We show, both mathematically and empirically, that TPRs can unify several prior interpretability methods: additive analogies, linear probing, sparse autoencoders, and activation patching. Mathematically, we show that these methods can all be derived from TPRs. Empirically, we apply the derivations to a range of different models --- from small toy models to LLMs --- to construct instances of each of the above interpretability methods; these constructed variants perform comparably to their standard variants. We view this work as a step toward what interpretability will ideally provide: a unified account of the nature of neural networks, corroborated not just by individual observations but also by an explanation of the connections between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将张量积表示（TPR）作为解释语言模型内部机制的统一假设，并从数学上与经验上证明其能够统一加性类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器和激活修补等多种可解释性方法，表明这些方法均可由 TPR 推导得出。
AI.motivation: 现有大量语言模型可解释性方法虽然带来了重要洞见，但各自之间相互孤立。作者希望回答：语言模型底层存在怎样的结构，才能同时催生所有这些不同的解释方法？因此提出用一个统一假设来整合零散的解释性发现。
AI.method: 以张量积表示（TPR）为统一假设，其核心思想是组合结构可在向量空间中表示为“填充子-角色”绑定（filler-role binding）。在数学上证明加性类比、线性探针、稀疏自编码器和激活修补均可由 TPR 推导出来；在经验上，将这些推导应用于从玩具模型到大语言模型的一系列模型，构造上述每类可解释性方法的 TPR 变体。
AI.result: 数学上证明了多种可解释性方法都能从 TPR 统一导出；经验上构造的 TPR 变体在性能上与对应标准变体相当，说明 TPR 确实能够统一这些看似不同的方法。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作朝可解释性理想目标迈进一步：为神经网络的本质提供统一解释，不仅由个别观察佐证，还通过阐明各观察之间的联系加以支撑。

title: MEL: Coordinate-Preserving EEG Tokenization for fMRI Translation
summary: Translating electroencephalography (EEG) into functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is important for medical neuroimaging, clinical brain-state monitoring, and multimodal neural decoding, because it aims to infer spatially organized hemodynamic activity from fast and accessible electrophysiological recordings. Existing EEG-to-fMRI studies mainly pursue stronger decoders, but the problem is also constrained by a representation-interface mismatch: fMRI responses are delayed, temporally integrated, and spatially distributed, whereas generic EEG encodings often entangle temporal lag, channel identity, and frequency-band structure. We propose Multi-band EEG Latent-state Tokenization (MEL), a coordinate-preserving EEG representation framework that anchors each target fMRI response to its preceding EEG history and organizes it into lag-channel-frequency neural-state tokens. By explicitly capturing hemodynamic latency and spectral-spatial dynamics, MEL aligns fMRI-pertinent EEG representations with capacity-controlled readouts without depending entirely on model scaling. Experiments on VU EEG-fMRI benchmarks and external Oddball data show that MEL improves prediction over strong NeuroBOLT baselines. Ablations and controls further indicate that the gains come from structured EEG representation rather than leakage, shortcut statistics, or decoder capacity.

AI.tldr: 作者提出多频带EEG隐状态分词（MEL）框架，通过将每个目标fMRI响应锚定到其先前的EEG历史并组织成滞后-通道-频率神经状态令牌，解决了EEG到fMRI翻译中EEG表示与fMRI响应之间的表征界面不匹配问题；实验表明其预测性能优于NeuroBOLT基线，且增益来自结构化表示而非模型容量或数据泄漏。
AI.motivation: EEG到fMRI的翻译对医学神经影像、临床脑状态监测和多模态神经解码很重要，但现有研究主要追求更强的解码器，忽视了表示界面不匹配问题：fMRI响应具有延迟、时间积分和空间分布特性，而通用EEG编码常纠缠时间滞后、通道身份和频带结构，限制了翻译性能。
AI.method: 提出Multi-band EEG Latent-state Tokenization (MEL)，一种坐标保持（coordinate-preserving）的EEG表示框架。它将每个目标fMRI响应锚定到其前序EEG历史，并组织为滞后-通道-频率（lag-channel-frequency）神经状态令牌，显式捕获血流动力学延迟与频谱-空间动态，从而在容量受控读出条件下对齐fMRI相关的EEG表示。
AI.result: 在VU EEG-fMRI基准和外部Oddball数据上，MEL相比强NeuroBOTL基线提升了预测性能；消融实验和控制实验表明增益来自结构化的EEG表示，而非数据泄漏、捷径统计信息或解码器容量。
AI.conclusion: MEL证明，通过显式建模fMRI相关的滞后、频谱与空间结构，可以在不依赖模型规模扩展的情况下有效对齐EEG与fMRI表示，为EEG到fMRI的翻译提供了新的表示层面的解决思路。

title: PermitGPT: A Unified Generative-AI Pipeline for Construction Hazard Forecasting, Permit Prediction, and Community Impact
comment: 1 figure, 3 tables, Accepted at 2026 International Conference on Power, Electronics, Communications, Computing, and Intelligent Infrastructure (PECCII)
summary: Urban construction governance requires early decisions that connect workplace safety, permitting requirements, and community impact, yet the relevant evidence is often scattered across separate municipal and regulatory data sources. This paper presents PermitGPT, a unified generative artificial intelligence framework for converting unstructured construction permit descriptions into structured decision-support outputs across three domains: safety hazard identification, permit requirement specification, and community impact assessment. To address data fragmentation, we spatially and temporally align records from the New York City Department of Buildings, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, and NYC 311 service requests, producing 90,000 structured prompt-response pairs derived through rule-based alignment and domain-informed spot checking. We fine-tune three open-weight language models using parameter-efficient adaptation and evaluate them on 2,833 held-out test cases. The results show complementary model behavior: Gemma-3-1B provides the most efficient inference at 3.07 samples per second with low memory usage, Llama-3.2-3B gives the highest lexical overlap for regulatory-style outputs with a BLEU score of 0.0091, and 4-bit Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 achieves the strongest semantic alignment with a BERTScore-F1 of 0.7747. Because the task involves open-ended structured generation, low BLEU values are interpreted alongside semantic metrics and qualitative output structure rather than as standalone indicators of utility. Overall, PermitGPT provides an initial step toward AI-assisted construction governance while identifying directions for stronger task-level evaluation and real-world validation.

AI.tldr: PermitGPT 是一个统一的生成式人工智能框架，将非结构化的建筑许可描述转换为三类决策支持输出（安全危害识别、许可要求规定、社区影响评估），通过对纽约市多个分散数据源进行时空对齐构建 90,000 个提示-响应对，采用参数高效微调三种开源语言模型，并在 2,833 个测试案例上评估，发现 Gemma-3-1B 推理效率最高、Llama-3.2-3B 在词法重叠上最佳、4-bit Mistral-7B 在语义对齐上最优。
AI.motivation: 城市建筑施工治理需要在早期阶段做出连接工作场所安全、许可要求和社区影响的决策，但相关证据分散在多个市政和监管数据源中，形成数据碎片化问题，缺乏一个统一的框架将零散的非结构化许可描述转换为结构化决策支持输出。
AI.method: 论文提出 PermitGPT 框架：首先对纽约市建筑局、职业安全与健康管理局和 NYC 311 服务请求的数据进行空间和时间对齐，通过基于规则的匹配和领域驱动的抽查构建 90,000 个结构化提示-响应对；随后使用参数高效微调（parameter-efficient adaptation）微调三个开放权重语言模型（Gemma-3-1B、Llama-3.2-3B、4-bit Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3），并在 2,833 个保留测试样本上评估；评估采用 BLEU、BERTScore-F1 等词法与语义指标并结合定性输出结构分析。
AI.result: 实验显示三种模型呈现互补行为：Gemma-3-1B 推理最高效（3.07 samples/s，内存占用低）；Llama-3.2-3B 在监管风格输出上的词法重叠最高（BLEU 0.0091）；4-bit Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 的语义对齐最强（BERTScore-F1 0.7747）。由于任务是开放式结构化生成，低 BLEU 值需结合语义指标和定性结构解释，而非作为独立的实用性指标。
AI.conclusion: PermitGPT 为人工智能辅助建筑施工治理提供了初步步骤，验证了整合多源市政数据并微调开源语言模型以生成结构化决策支持输出的可行性，同时指出了在更强任务级评估和真实世界验证方面仍需推进的方向。

title: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror
summary: Converting scientific figures into executable code has gained increasing attention, yet existing methods primarily focus on reproducing the reference figure itself. A more practical setting is to plot new data while preserving the visual style of a reference figure (e.g., color scheme and typography). Prior approaches mimic the reference through pixel-level optimization and struggle to carry its style to new data. We show that the key to this task lies in the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities present in modern computer-use models. We propose FigMirror, an agentic framework that unlocks these capabilities through Grounded Measurement, which locates visual elements by coordinates and measures their properties through executable code. We further introduce PlotTwin-Bench, an expert-curated benchmark with fine-grained code and image-level style metrics. Experiments show that FigMirror consistently outperforms existing methods on reference-conditioned style transfer. All plots in this paper are generated by FigMirror, except those produced by other methods for comparison. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FigMirror，一个基于 computer-use 模型的智能体框架，用于将参考图的视觉风格迁移到新数据上，并引入专家构建的 PlotTwin-Bench 基准进行评测。
AI.motivation: 现有将科学图表转换为可执行代码的方法主要关注复现参考图本身，而更实际的场景是用新数据绘图并保留参考图的视觉风格（如配色、排版）。此前方法通过像素级优化来模仿参考图，难以将风格迁移到新数据上。作者认为该任务的关键在于现代 computer-use 模型具备的坐标定位与编码能力。
AI.method: 提出 FigMirror 智能体框架，通过 Grounded Measurement（落地测量）方式解锁这些能力：先用坐标定位视觉元素，再通过可执行代码测量其属性，从而实现参考图风格的迁移。同时引入 PlotTwin-Bench，一个由专家构建的、包含细粒度代码级与图像级风格指标的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，FigMirror 在参考条件风格的迁移任务上持续优于现有方法；文中所有图表（除对比方法产生的图外）均由 FigMirror 生成，并开源了代码与数据。
AI.conclusion: FigMirror 证明坐标落地与编码能力是参考图风格迁移的关键，为将科学图表转换为可复用、可扩展代码提供了一条有效路径，并在新数据上稳定保留参考图的视觉风格。

title: RouteSparse: Input-Conditional Pattern Routing for Budgeted Long-Context Prefilling
summary: Dynamic sparse attention can reduce the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling without changing model weights. MInference assigns each attention head one pattern offline and estimates that pattern's sparse indices for every prompt. This design is efficient, but it assumes that a head's preferred pattern and sparsity budget remain suitable across inputs. We introduce RouteSparse, which routes each head and prompt segment among a small library of GPU-efficient sparse patterns. A low-cost probe estimates pattern utility and uncertainty; a latency-aware router then selects a pattern and budget, while uncertain cases fall back to a denser mask. We formulate routing as constrained risk minimization, derive an attention-output error certificate from omitted probability mass, and evaluate the method on long-context retrieval, question answering, summarization, and language modeling. On Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with 128K-token prompts, RouteSparse achieves $6.5\times$ dense prefill speed with a 0.2-point RULER drop relative to dense attention, compared with $7.3\times$ speed and a 1.6-point drop for fixed per-head routing. Ablations confirm that input-conditional routing, hardware profiling, and selective dense fallback each contribute to the quality--latency tradeoff.

AI.tldr: RouteSparse 提出一种面向长上下文预填充的输入自适应动态稀疏注意力方法：为每个注意力头与提示段从稀疏模式库中按需路由，并通过不确定性检测在必要时回退到稠密掩码，从而在保持生成质量的同时显著加速预填充。
AI.motivation: 动态稀疏注意力可降低长上下文预填充的二次方成本且无需改动模型权重。现有方法（如 MInference）为每个注意力头离线指定一种固定稀疏模式并在每轮提示中估计其稀疏索引，效率高但假设头的偏好模式与稀疏预算在所有输入下都保持合适，这一假设在不同输入上并不成立，导致质量与延迟的权衡次优。
AI.method: RouteSparse 在小型 GPU 高效稀疏模式库中为每个头和提示段做路由。它先用低开销探针估计各模式下被省略概率质量对应的模式效用与不确定性；再由延迟感知路由器选择模式与稀疏预算，对不确定性高的情形回退到更稠密的掩码。整体被建模为约束风险最小化，并从被省略的概率质量推导出注意力输出误差的可证明上界（误差证书）。
AI.result: 在 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct 的 128K token 提示上，RouteSparse 相比稠密注意力获得 6.5 倍预填充加速，RULER 得分仅下降 0.2 分；而固定逐头路由在 7.3 倍加速下 RULER 下降 1.6 分。消融实验表明输入条件路由、硬件性能剖析与选择性稠密回退均对质量-延迟权衡有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 输入条件式的模式与预算路由结合基于不确定性的稠密回退，能够在保持接近稠密注意力质量的同时显著加速长上下文预填充，比固定逐头路由取得更优的质量-延迟权衡，为动态稀疏注意力的部署提供了更稳健的方案。

title: Information-Based Calibration of Uncertainty Quantification in Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models
comment: Published in the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research, Volume 86 (2026)
summary: Gaussian process (GP) regression with a single global GP (GP-glo) incurs cubic computational cost, limiting scalability to large datasets. Product-of-experts GP models (GP-pro), which combine local GP models to capture global correlations, alleviate this computational burden. However, training local experts on disjoint data subsets can lead to overestimated posterior variances. We propose GP-pro-c, a product-of-experts GP model that calibrates these variances using an information-based method. The method exploits the monotonicity and submodularity of information gain in GPs to define a calibration ratio that reduces the posterior variance of individual local GP models. We evaluate GP-pro-c using negative log-likelihood (NLL), root mean squared error (RMSE), and expected normalised calibration error (ENCE). Experiments on four synthetic functions and six regression datasets show that GP-pro-c achieves average reductions of 2.3% in NLL and 12.0% in ENCE compared with the uncalibrated GP-pro model. The proposed method mitigates posterior variance overestimation while maintaining predictive accuracy and reducing computational complexity. GP-pro-c provides a promising approach for uncertainty estimation in scalable GP models and may serve as a useful surrogate model for Bayesian optimisation with high-dimensional and large-scale data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GP-pro-c，一种基于信息度量的后验方差校准方法的产品专家高斯过程（PoE-GP）模型，利用信息增益的单调性与次模性定义校准比率，缓解局部专家模型在不相交数据子集上训练导致的后验方差高估问题，在保持预测精度的同时降低计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 全局单GP回归（GP-glo）的立方级计算成本限制了其在大规模数据上的可扩展性；而产品专家GP模型（GP-pro）虽可通过组合局部模型降低计算负担，但在不相交数据子集上训练局部专家会导致后验方差被高估，影响不确定性估计的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出GP-pro-c校准框架，利用高斯过程中信息增益的单调性和次模性，构造一个校准比率来缩小各个局部GP模型的后验方差，从而在不改变预测均值的前提下修正过度估计的方差；评估指标包括负对数似然（NLL）、均方根误差（RMSE）和期望归一化校准误差（ENCE）。
AI.result: 在四个合成函数和六个回归数据集上的实验表明，与未校准的GP-pro模型相比，GP-pro-c在NLL上平均降低2.3%、在ENCE上平均降低12.0%，有效缓解了后验方差高估问题，同时保持了预测精度并降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: GP-pro-c为可扩展GP模型提供了一种有前景的不确定性估计方案，尤其适用于高维、大规模数据的贝叶斯优化替代模型，展现出良好的实用价值。

title: Efficient Geothermal Well-Control Optimization via Diffusion-Surrogate Reinforcement Learning
summary: Real-time decision-making for enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) is challenging because long-term production periods involve high-dimensional control spaces and a large number of time-consuming high-fidelity hydrothermal simulations. Reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for state-dependent sequential control, but direct policy training with numerical simulators is computationally expensive. To address this issue, we propose a diffusion-surrogate guided reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon EGS well-control optimization. The reservoir temperature and pressure fields are used as system states, while injection rates are selected as control actions. A learned surrogate environment is constructed using conditional diffusion models to predict the evolution of reservoir temperature and pressure fields and a separate reward model to estimate the corresponding economic return. The surrogate environment is then integrated with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for efficient policy training. Experiments on a fractured EGS benchmark show that the diffusion surrogate can accurately reproduce reservoir-state evolution over multiple control stages. The resulting surrogate-assisted PPO policy achieves competitive well-control performance compared with direct simulator-based PPO and existing optimization methods, while substantially reducing the dependence on expensive high-fidelity simulations. These results demonstrate the potential of diffusion-based surrogate environments for efficient reinforcement learning in geothermal well-control optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型代理环境的强化学习框架（扩散代理引导的PPO），用于增强型地热系统（EGS）的长时序井控优化。以储层温度和压力场为状态、注入速率为动作，用条件扩散模型预测状态演化并构建代理环境，与PPO结合进行高效策略训练，在降低对高保真仿真依赖的同时实现了与直接基于仿真器的PPO相近的井控性能。
AI.motivation: EGS的实时决策面临双重挑战：长期生产期导致控制空间维度高，且高保真水热数值模拟数量大、耗时长。强化学习虽适合状态依赖的序贯控制，但直接用数值模拟器进行策略训练计算成本过高，因此需要构建计算高效的代理环境来加速策略学习。
AI.method: 提出扩散代理引导的强化学习框架：1）以储层温度场和压力场作为系统状态，注入速率作为控制动作；2）用条件扩散模型构建学习代理环境，预测温度场和压力场的演化；3）训练独立奖励模型估计对应的经济收益；4）将该代理环境与Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)结合进行高效策略训练。
AI.result: 在裂缝性EGS基准测试上的实验表明：扩散代理能在多个控制阶段准确复现储层状态演化；代理辅助的PPO策略相比直接基于仿真器的PPO和现有优化方法达到了有竞争力的井控性能，同时显著减少了对昂贵高保真仿真的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 证明了基于扩散模型的代理环境能够为地热井控优化中的强化学习提供高效替代方案，在保持决策性能的同时大幅降低计算成本，展现出在地热井控优化中应用扩散代理强化学习的潜力。

title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings
summary: Artists coordinate human pose, illumination, and camera placement to convey narrative and emotion, but existing generative methods typically model these elements independently. We introduce text-to-editable 3D staging, a task that jointly generates human poses, a dominant light, and a camera configuration from an affective description. We construct 11,911 text--staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings by reconstructing SMPL bodies, estimating low-frequency illumination, recovering camera parameters, and pairing each scene with ArtEmis descriptions. We train a flow-matching transformer that supports variable numbers of figures and produces multiple staging alternatives for each prompt. On held-out descriptions, the model achieves 32.2\% retrieval R@1, compared with 16.6\% for CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while approximately preserving corpus-level diversity. These results demonstrate the feasibility of generating editable, emotionally conditioned 3D staging references from text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"文本到可编辑3D舞台调度"（text-to-editable 3D staging）任务，从情感化文本描述联合生成人体姿态、主光源和相机配置；通过从2,328幅具象绘画中重建SMPL人体、估计低频光照与相机参数并配对ArtEmis描述构建了11,911个文本-舞台配对，并用流匹配Transformer（支持可变人物数量、可生成多个备选方案）进行训练，在保留语料库多样性的同时显著优于CLIP最近邻检索基线。
AI.motivation: 艺术家通过协调人体姿态、光照与相机机位来传达叙事和情感，但现有生成方法通常将这些要素独立建模，忽略了它们在表达情感上的协同作用。因此需要一种能从情感描述中联合生成这些三维舞台要素的方法。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：从2,328幅具象绘画中重建SMPL人体、估计低频照明、恢复相机参数，并与ArtEmis情感描述配对，得到11,911个文本-舞台样本；2) 模型：训练一个流匹配Transformer（flow-matching transformer），支持可变数量的人物并可为每个提示生成多个舞台备选方案。
AI.result: 在留出测试描述上，模型达到32.2%的检索R@1，显著高于基于CLIP的最近邻检索（16.6%），同时大致保持语料库级别的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了从文本生成可编辑的、情感条件化的3D舞台参考的可行性，为文本驱动三维场景布局与光影设计提供了新的方向。

title: Not All or None: Dynamic Construction of Target-aware Memory Graph for Conversational Stance Detection
summary: Stance detection is crucial for understanding the underlying attitude of an expression towards a target. Conversational stance detection is a more challenging stance detection task in real-world social media scenarios, as it involves detecting the user's stance by leveraging the target-related historical statements across conversational sessions. In this paper, we propose target-aware Memory Graph TamGraph, a novel method that dynamically leverages target-related statements for conversational stance detection. Instead of considering all preceding historical conversations or using no prior conversation information for stance detection, our TamGraph employs a stepwise, entropy-guided backtracking mechanism to selectively activate memory from historical conversations and dynamically constructs a target-aware graph to model the stance relations among utterances. This allows the exploitation of target-related information from the conversation history for stance detection while preventing the introduction of noise. Experimental results on both English and Chinese benchmarks demonstrate that our TamGraph substantially improves LLM performance on conversational stance detection.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 TamGraph 的目标感知记忆图方法，通过熵引导的逐步回溯机制从历史对话中有选择地激活与目标相关的陈述，并动态构建目标感知图来建模话语间的立场关系，从而显著提升 LLM 在对话立场检测上的性能。
AI.motivation: 对话立场检测需要利用跨会话中与目标相关的历史陈述来判断用户立场，比一般立场检测更具挑战性。现有方法要么考虑全部历史对话（引入噪声），要么不使用历史信息（丢失关键上下文），缺乏对目标相关历史信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 提出 TamGraph 方法，采用逐步的、熵引导的回溯机制，从历史对话中选择性地激活记忆；同时动态构建目标感知图，用以建模话语之间的立场关系，从而在利用目标相关信息的同时抑制噪声引入。
AI.result: 在英文和中文基准数据集上的实验表明，TamGraph 能够显著提升大语言模型（LLM）在对话立场检测任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性回溯与目标感知构图，TamGraph 能够在不引入噪声的前提下有效利用历史对话中的目标相关信息，为对话立场检测提供了一种更优的解决方案。

title: Spatial Entropy based Partitioning for Spatiotemporal Graph Unlearning
comment: Accepted at SIAM International Conference on Data Mining (SDM 2026)
summary: Spatiotemporal graphs underpin applications such as traffic forecasting, weather forecasting, and healthcare monitoring. Privacy regulations such as the GDPR and the CCPA require the complete removal of unauthorized data from trained models, but achieving this on a spatiotemporal graph is difficult: because information propagates globally through both spatial and temporal message passing, fully erasing a node's influence forces costly full-graph retraining. ST-graph unlearning requires both exactness and efficiency. We propose IsleNet, which uses spatial-entropy-guided partitioning to create balanced, locally coherent subgraphs and reconnects them with lightweight virtual edges. Upon an unlearning request, only the affected subgraph encoder and virtual-edge layer are retrained, ensuring exact removal with low cost. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that IsleNet attains up to 94% of full-graph accuracy while reducing unlearning time by up to an order of magnitude. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/STGraphUnlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IsleNet，一种用于时空图机器遗忘（unlearning）的框架。它通过空间熵引导的图划分，将全局时空图拆分为局部连通的子图，并用轻量级虚拟边连接。收到遗忘请求时，仅重训练受影响的子图编码器和虚拟边层，即可在低成本下实现精确的数据移除。在四个真实基准上，IsleNet 在达到全图训练准确率约 94% 的同时，将遗忘时间最多降低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 时空图广泛用于交通、天气预测及医疗监控等场景，而 GDPR、CCPA 等隐私法规要求从已训练模型中彻底移除未授权数据。然而，由于时空图在空间与时间两个维度上全局传播信息，完全擦除某个节点的影响通常需要昂贵的全图重训练。因此，时空图遗忘需要同时满足精确性（exactness）与高效性（efficiency），现有方法难以两全。
AI.method: IsleNet 采用空间熵引导的划分（spatial-entropy-guided partitioning）将全图拆分成平衡且局部连通的子图，并通过轻量级虚拟边（virtual edges）将这些子图重新连接起来。当产生遗忘请求时，只重训练受影响的子图编码器和虚拟边层，即可保证精确移除数据，而无需重训练整个图。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准数据集上的实验表明，IsleNet 在全图精度的 94% 水平上仍能保持性能，同时将遗忘时间最多缩短一个数量级（约 10 倍）。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: IsleNet 通过“划分-重连-局部重训练”的策略，在保证时空图数据精确移除的前提下显著降低了遗忘成本，证明显著提升了时空图机器遗忘的效率和实用性，为隐私合规需求下的时空图应用提供了可行方案。

title: Enhancing SAE-based Steering via Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) disentangle model activations into interpretable features and are widely used for steering large language models. Most existing SAE-based steering methods select features by applying a top- filter based on statistical scores, assuming that higher-scoring features yield stronger steering effects. In this paper, we show that this assumption is often invalid, leading to suboptimal feature selection. Our analysis reveals that effective steering features may be distributed among representationally adjacent, semantically similar groups induced by feature splitting in SAEs. Within such groups, features may exhibit disparate statistical scores despite having comparable steering influence, causing score-based selection to overlook important features. Based on these observations, we propose \textsc{Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection} (\textsc{NIFS}), a plug-and-play strategy that leverages representation similarity to improve feature selection for steering. We evaluate \textsc{NIFS} across multiple SAE-based steering methods and tasks, and demonstrate consistent performance gains over conventional top-$k$ selection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SAE（稀疏自编码器）驱动的大语言模型steering特征选择问题，指出基于统计分数进行top-k选择的传统假设常常失效，并提出一种即插即用的“邻域集成特征选择”（NIFS）策略，利用表示相似性改进特征选择，在多种SAE-based steering方法和任务上取得一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有SAE-based steering方法大多依赖统计分数进行top-k特征筛选，默认分数越高的特征steering效果越强。论文揭示该假设常不成立，导致特征选择次优；同时发现有效的steering特征往往分布在由特征分裂（feature splitting）导致的表示相邻、语义相似的簇中，簇内特征统计分数可能差异悬殊但steering影响力相当，因此单纯按分数选取会遗漏重要特征。
AI.method: 提出NIFS（Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection），一种即插即用的特征选择策略：利用表示相似性（representation similarity）来定位特征分簇并整合相邻语义相似的特征，从而弥补基于统计分数top-k选取的缺陷，可与多种现有SAE-based steering方法结合使用。
AI.result: 在多种SAE-based steering方法和多个任务上的评估表明，NIFS相比传统top-k选择在steering效果上带来一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 统计分数并非steering效果的可靠代理指标；借助表示相似性可将SAE特征分裂造成的语义邻近特征整合进来，显著改善steering特征选择的鲁棒性与效果。NIFS作为即插即用模块，为SAE-based steering提供了一种更优的特征选择范式。

title: BlobBoards: Robust Markers for Accurate Pose
summary: We propose BlobBoards, a fiducial marker system comprising a dense, multi-scale field of Gaussian blobs and a feature-based pipeline for joint detection, identification, and pose estimation. Each board is registered from hundreds of blob features whose dense spatial coverage constrains pose, while multiple scales preserve detectability across large changes in focal length, distance, and obliquity. Learned local descriptors are matched to the reference pattern and spatially verified, so the correspondences determine pose and certify identity. Against motion-capture ground truth, BlobBoards achieve median translation errors of 3.6-5.0 mm, reducing AprilTag's median translation error by 89% on small boards and 70% on large ones. They also produce far fewer large-rotation failures than state-of-the-art tag systems. BlobBoards achieve the highest detection rate, 80% versus 74% for AprilTag and 58% for ArUco, with the largest margin on the smallest markers. Under 50% occlusion, they still detect 69% of boards with essentially unchanged median translation error, while AprilTag and ArUco detect none. In experiments BlobBoards give state-of-the-art detection rate, pose accuracy and occlusion robustness.

AI.tldr: BlobBoards 是一种新型基准标记系统，利用稠密多尺度的类高斯斑点场，通过特征匹配流水线一次性完成检测、识别与位姿估计，在检测率、位姿精度和遮挡鲁棒性上全面超越 AprilTag 与 ArUco。
AI.motivation: 现有主流标签系统（如 AprilTag、ArUco）在遮挡、大倾角、焦距变化等场景下位姿误差较大、易发生大幅度旋转失败，且小型标记检测率低。作者旨在设计一种在尺度变化与遮挡条件下仍能保持高检测率、高精度位姿估计和身份认证的标记系统。
AI.method: 提出 BlobBoards：由稠密、多尺度的类高斯斑点构成的标记场，配合基于特征的流水线实现联合检测、识别与位姿估计。每个板由数百个斑点特征注册，密集空间覆盖约束位姿；多尺度设计保证在不同焦距、距离和倾角下均可检测。利用学习得到的局部描述子与参考图案匹配并做空间验证，从而由对应关系确定位姿并认证身份。
AI.result: 以运动捕捉地面真值为基准，BlobBoards 的中位平移误差为 3.6–5.0 mm，相比 AprilTag，小标板误差降低 89%、大标板降低 70%；大幅度旋转失败的次数远少于现有最优标签系统。检测率达 80%（AprilTag 74%、ArUco 58%），在最小标记上优势最大；在 50% 遮挡下仍可检测 69% 的板且中位平移误差基本不变，而 AprilTag 和 ArUco 完全无法检测。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明 BlobBoards 在检测率、位姿精度和遮挡鲁棒性方面达到了当前最优水平，是一种比传统标签系统更可靠、更稳健的基准标记方案。

title: Recognition-Refusal Misalignment in LLMs: Why Models Answer Structurally Unanswerable Questions
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 29 pages, 6 figures
summary: Large language models often answer structurally unanswerable questions, such as computing cot(-540°) or evaluating (1).startswith("1"), instead of abstaining. We ask whether this failure reflects missing recognition or failed routing from recognition to abstention. Across instruction-tuned models from 1.7B to 70B parameters, a single linear direction in the hidden state separates answerable from structurally impossible math and code prompts, showing that models represent impossibility before generation. Yet this recognition direction is nearly orthogonal to the canonical safety-refusal direction that mediates trained harmful-content refusal. An in-domain behavior-defined invalidity-aware direction is closer to recognition, but only partially aligned with it, and remains near-orthogonal to safety refusal. Generation-time steering along the recognition direction changes invalidity-aware behavior bidirectionally and dose-responsively on structural math and code cells, while random directions do not. Base/instruct comparisons further show that the low-cosine geometry is already present at the pretraining endpoint. The confident-on-impossible failure is therefore better explained as a routing failure than as an encoding failure: the model has a usable "no admissible answer" signal, but the safety-refusal pathway is not aligned to use it.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在面对结构上不可回答的问题（如 cot(-540°)）时往往强行作答而非弃权。本文通过探测隐藏状态中的线性方向发现，模型在生成前已经编码了"不可回答"的识别信号，但该识别方向与用于有害内容拒答的安全拒绝方向几乎正交，且两者在预训练阶段就已存在。因此该失败是路由失败而非编码失败：模型拥有可用的"无合法答案"信号，但安全拒绝通路未能与之对齐。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常对结构上不可回答的问题（如数学计算或代码求值类提示）给出自信的错误答案，而不是放弃作答。作者希望弄清这一失败的根本原因：是模型根本没有识别出问题不可回答（编码失败），还是模型识别到了但未能将这一认知转化为弃权行为（路由失败）。
AI.method: 对1.7B到70B参数的指令微调模型，在隐藏状态中寻找单个线性方向以区分可回答与结构上不可回答的数学/代码提示；将该识别方向与既有安全拒绝方向进行余弦相似度对比；构造行为定义的"无效感知"方向并分析其与识别方向及安全拒绝方向的关系；在生成时沿识别方向进行剂量依赖的干预（steering），并与随机方向对照；比较基座模型与指令微调模型以考察几何关系的起源。
AI.result: 模型隐藏状态中存在单一线性方向，可准确区分可回答与不可回答的提示，说明模型在生成前就表征了不可能性；该识别方向与安全拒绝方向几乎正交；行为定义的无效感知方向更接近识别方向但仅部分对齐，且仍与安全拒绝方向近正交；沿识别方向的生成期干预能以双向、剂量依赖方式改变无效感知行为，而随机方向无效；这种低余弦几何在预训练终点即已存在。
AI.conclusion: 模型对结构不可回答问题自信作答的失败，更应被解释为路由失败而非编码失败：模型内部存在可用的"无合法答案"信号，但安全拒绝通路并未与该信号对齐，因而无法触发弃权。

title: Unlearning on Spatio-Temporal Graphs through Subgraph Virtual Edge Reconstruction
comment: Accepted as a short paper at ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026. 4 pages
summary: Spatio-temporal graphs are widely used in modeling complex dynamic processes such as temporal forecasting, molecular dynamics, and healthcare monitoring. Recently, stringent privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA have introduced significant new challenges for existing spatio-temporal graph models, requiring complete unlearning of unauthorized data. Since each node in a spatio-temporal graph diffuses information globally across both spatial and temporal dimensions, existing unlearning methods primarily designed for static graphs and localized data removal cannot efficiently erase a single node without incurring costs nearly equivalent to full model retraining. To address this, we propose CallosumNet, a spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework biologically inspired by the corpus callosum structure. CallosumNet makes two key technical contributions: (1) it reconstructs subgraphs using biologically-inspired virtual edges; and (2) it restores interlinked spatio-temporal dependencies among subgraphs via a lightweight meta-graph integration layer. Empirical results on four diverse real-world datasets show that CallosumNet achieves complete unlearning while maintaining accuracy very close to the gold model. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/STGraphUnlearning.

AI.tldr: CallosumNet 是一个受胼胝体结构启发的时空图去学习（unlearning）框架，通过生物启发的虚拟边重构子图，并利用轻量级元图集成层恢复子图间的时空依赖，在四个真实数据集上实现了彻底的去学习效果且精度接近完整重训的黄金模型。
AI.motivation: GDPR、CCPA 等隐私法规要求对未经授权的数据进行彻底去学习。由于时空图中每个节点的信息会沿空间和时间两个维度全局扩散，现有主要针对静态图、只做局部数据移除的去学习方法无法高效地擦除单个节点，其成本几乎等同于全模型重训练，难以满足实际需求。
AI.method: 提出生物启发的 CallosumNet 框架，包含两项关键技术贡献：(1) 利用生物启发的虚拟边重构子图，将全局扩散的去学习问题分解为局部子问题；(2) 通过轻量级元图集成层恢复各子图之间相互关联的时空依赖关系，在保证去学习完整性的同时避免全量重训练。
AI.result: 在四个不同的真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，CallosumNet 能够实现完整的去学习效果，同时保持与黄金模型（完整重训模型）非常接近的精度；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: CallosumNet 证明了通过生物启发的子图重构与轻量级集成机制，可以在时空图上实现高效且彻底的节点级去学习，其效果（准确率）接近完整重训的黄金模型，为隐私合规下的时空图模型提供了一种实用解决方案。

title: Capability-Stratified Degradation in Ternary Language Models
summary: Extreme low-bit inference offers a route toward smaller models and constrained deployment. Ternary language models restrict weights to $\{-1,0,+1\}$, approaching the limit of $\log_2 3 \approx 1.585$ bits/weight. The practical question for a pretrained model is not simply whether weights can be quantised but which capabilities survive and whether it remains useful for adaptation. We explore this by converting Qwen3.5-0.8B (752M parameters) to ternary weights using 72.4M tokens of quantisation-aware training (QAT). The resulting model, Cloe, is evaluated across 29 benchmarks, representation diagnostics, and downstream fine-tuning. The evidence shows non-uniform degradation. A linear probe recovers 43.76% of MMLU answers from the full-precision teacher's representations but only 26.19% from Cloe (near chance), indicating specialist factual information is lost. However, Cloe retains measurable performance on ten tasks, averaging 77.1% of teacher performance. Crucially, fine-tuning raises Cloe to 89.8% on SST-2 (95.6% of the matched teacher) and reaches 79.4% teacher retention on XSum. We attribute degradation to a combination of quantisation-induced information loss and incomplete recovery due to the limited QAT budget. We also highlight an evaluation pitfall: standard answer-letter scoring failed (Cloe emitted "A" on 98.6% of MMLU questions), necessitating continuation scoring. Ultimately, ternary conversion is unsuitable as a drop-in general replacement yet remains valuable as a compact substrate for task-specific models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量化感知训练（QAT），使用7240万token将Qwen3.5-0.8B（7.52亿参数）转换为三值权重模型Cloe（权重限于{-1,0,+1}，约1.585 bits/weight），并在29个基准、表示诊断与下游微调中评估其能力。结果显示退化呈非均匀性：线性探针从全精度教师表示中可恢复43.76%的MMLU答案，而Cloe仅恢复26.19%（接近随机），表明专家事实信息丢失；但Cloe在10项任务上仍保留平均77.1%的教师性能，且微调后SST-2达到89.8%（教师的95.6%）、XSum保留79.4%教师性能。退化归因于量化信息损失与有限QAT预算导致的恢复不完整；此外发现标准字母计分在MMLU上失效（Cloe对98.6%问题输出"A"），需改用续写计分。结论：三值转换不适合作为通用替代品，但可作为紧凑的面向任务模型基座。
AI.motivation: 探索极端低比特推理（三值权重，逼近1.585 bits/weight的理论下限）在预训练模型上的实用性边界：关键问题不是权重能否量化，而是哪些能力在量化后得以保留、模型是否仍可用于微调适配。
AI.method: 将Qwen3.5-0.8B（752M参数）通过72.4M tokens的量化感知训练（QAT）转换为三值权重模型Cloe，并在29个基准、表示诊断（线性探针）和下游微调（如SST-2、XSum）三个层面进行评估；同时检验了标准字母计分与续写计分两种评估方式。
AI.result: 退化呈非均匀性：线性探针在MMLU上的恢复率从教师的43.76%降至Cloe的26.19%（接近随机），说明专业知识信息丢失；但Cloe在10项任务上平均保留77.1%的教师性能，且微调后SST-2可达89.8%（教师性能的95.6%）、XSum保留79.4%。此外标准字母计分不可用（98.6%输出"A"），需采用续写计分。
AI.conclusion: 三值转换在通用场景下不适合作为即插即用的模型替代方案，但作为紧凑的、面向特定任务微调的基础模型仍具价值；退化主要由量化信息丢失和有限QAT预算下的恢复不完整共同导致，评估协议（计分方式）是解读结果时需要警惕的陷阱。

title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
