AI.method: nMAS 是一个可配置的肿瘤信息抽取工作流，将临床医生定义的字段规范与模型执行分离，结合了复杂度感知的抽取、报告级整合以及来源接地（source-grounded）验证。抽取任务基于临床医生制定的包含 328 个属性的 schema，涵盖报告元数据、诊断、分期及癌症类型特定信息。评估采用回顾性研究设计，聚焦于临床医生确认在源文档中存在的字段，而非穷举标注全部 328 个字段。
AI.result: 回顾性评估包含来自 40 名患者的 230 份去标识肿瘤文档，以及 418 个经临床医生审查的文档-字段对，共 1,126 个非空参考值。nMAS 的等级加权值级精度为 82.6%，召回率为 87.5%，F1 为 85.0%；而独立实现的 UMA 风格 MiniMax M2.5 对照系统 F1 仅为 66.4%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，采用可配置、来源接地的抽取工作流将碎片化肿瘤文档转换为可复用的结构化数据是可行的，且其性能显著优于对照系统，为降低肿瘤登记的人工摘要负担提供了有效的可扩展方案。

title: Towards Fully Automated Medical Imaging Code Generation via Validation-based Context Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in program generation for small-scale and conventional application development; however, they remain limited when applied to complex, domain-specific tasks such as medical image processing. General-purpose models lack explicit domain knowledge and robust validation mechanisms to ensure correctness, often requiring substantial human intervention to produce reliable processing pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework for fully automated medical image processing code generation. AutoMedImg orchestrates specialised agents across two phases: a Planning Phase that performs dataset analysis and architecture design with semantic and formal verification, and a Coding Phase that generates modules in parallel with static checking, execution testing, and assembly validation. This multi-stage validation mitigates error propagation throughout generation, while comprehensive auto-context engineering combining domain-specific knowledge bases, shared memory, and validation feedback automates context construction without manual prompting. A cross-project adaptive pipeline synthesis mechanism further accumulates validated pipelines and retrieves proven components for new tasks based on project similarity, enhancing generation efficiency through cross-project learning. Extensive evaluation across six diverse and well-established medical imaging datasets with five backbone LLMs demonstrates that AutoMedImg achieves zero human intervention, with Dice scores of up to 0.90 for segmentation tasks and 99% accuracy for classification.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoMedImg，一个多智能体框架，通过规划与编码两个阶段的多级验证机制（语义/形式验证、静态检查、执行测试、组装验证）以及自动上下文工程和跨项目自适应管线合成，实现零人工干预的医学影像处理代码自动生成。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在常规小规模程序生成上表现良好，但面对医学图像处理等复杂领域特定任务时能力不足。通用模型缺乏显式领域知识和可靠的正确性验证机制，往往需要大量人工干预才能产出可靠的流水线，因此亟需一个能自动化生成并验证医学图像处理代码的框架。
AI.method: 提出 AutoMedImg 多智能体框架，分为两个阶段：(1) 规划阶段——执行数据集分析与架构设计，并进行语义与形式化验证；(2) 编码阶段——并行生成模块，配合静态检查、执行测试和组装验证。此外采用综合自动上下文工程（结合领域知识库、共享记忆和验证反馈）实现无需手动提示的上下文构建；并设计跨项目自适应管线合成机制，基于项目相似性积累已验证的管线并复用可靠组件，提升生成效率。
AI.result: 在六个多样化且成熟的医学影像数据集、五种骨干 LLM 上进行广泛评估，AutoMedImg 实现零人工干预，分割任务的 Dice 分数高达 0.90，分类任务准确率达 99%。
AI.conclusion: AutoMedImg 通过多阶段验证与自动上下文工程有效缓解了生成过程中的错误传播，在无需人工干预的情况下显著提升了复杂医学图像处理代码生成的正确性与效率，展现出跨项目学习的泛化能力。

title: SHADOWBENCH: Toward Reliable Automatic Evaluation of Semantic Alignment in Autoformalization
summary: Autoformalization translates informal mathematical theorems into code for proof assistants such as Lean. A central challenge is that current evaluation metrics can accept type-correct but misaligned statements or reject correct statements written in a different formulation. Inspired by Pass@$k$, we propose SA-Pass (*Semantic Alignment Pass*), which tests formal statements using auxiliary statements called *shadows* that characterize the intended statement. A generated statement receives full credit only when it compiles, implies each shadow (forward check), and is implied by their conjunction (backward check). We instantiate SA-Pass in ShadowBench, a Lean 4 full autoformalization benchmark of 178 postgraduate- to research-level problems spanning eight mathematical areas. Claude Code (Opus 4.8) with Numina-Lean-Agent reaches $61.8\%$ compile rate and $11.2\%$ SA-Pass. Across outputs generated by six agentic configurations, SA-Pass achieves $98.8\%$ binary agreement with expert judgments. An early version of ShadowBench served as the benchmark for Track 4 of the ICML 2026 AI4Math Challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-Pass（语义对齐通过率）这一全新的自动形式化评估指标，利用称为"影子"（shadows）的辅助语句来刻画目标陈述的语义等价类：生成语句须同时通过编译、正向蕴含（推出每个影子）与反向蕴含（被影子合取推出）才获得满分。作者将其实例化为ShadowBench——一个涵盖八个数学领域、178道研究生至研究级问题的Lean 4自动形式化基准。在六个智能体配置上，SA-Pass与专家判断的二元一致性达98.8%；Claude Code (Opus 4.8)+Numina-Lean-Agent取得61.8%编译率与11.2%的SA-Pass。该基准早期版本已被用作ICML 2026 AI4Math挑战赛Track 4。
AI.motivation: 现有自动形式化评估指标存在核心缺陷：一方面可能接受"类型正确但语义错位"的语句（statement编译通过却与原始定理含义不符）；另一方面可能错误拒绝语义正确但表述形式不同的语句（同一数学命题可以用多种等价方式编码）。因此需要一种不依赖单一目标公式、而是检验语义等价类的评估方法。
AI.method: 受Pass@k启发，提出SA-Pass（Semantic Alignment Pass）。核心思想是用一组辅助语句——"影子"（shadows）——刻画目标陈述的语义特征。评估时生成语句须满足三重条件：(1)可编译通过；(2)正向检查——能蕴含每一个影子；(3)反向检查——能被所有影子的合取所蕴含。只有同时满足才得满分。该方法实例化为ShadowBench：Lean 4基准，含178道覆盖八个数学领域的难题；并基于六种agentic配置（含Claude Code Opus 4.8 + Numina-Lean-Agent）进行实验验证。
AI.result: Claude Code (Opus 4.8)搭配Numina-Lean-Agent在ShadowBench上达到61.8%的编译率与11.2%的SA-Pass得分。在六种agentic配置的全部输出上，SA-Pass与专家人工判断的二元一致性达到98.8%。ShadowBench早期版本被选为ICML 2026 AI4Math挑战赛Track 4的官方基准。
AI.conclusion: SA-Pass通过"影子语句"的双向蕴含检验，为自动形式化提供了比单纯编译检查或单一参考对齐更可靠的语义级评估，显著缓解了"假阳性接受"与"假阴性拒绝"两大问题；ShadowBench作为具有挑战性的高难度基准，可有效区分不同agentic系统的语义对齐能力，并已被国际竞赛采纳。

title: Knowledge Distillation under Teacher Misspecification: An Order-Parameter Analysis of the Gap between Teacher Mimicry and Task Performance
summary: Knowledge distillation trains a small student model to reproduce the outputs of a large teacher model, and its progress is typically monitored through the teacher--student discrepancy. The quantity of ultimate interest, however, is the student's error with respect to the true task. We study the relation between these two objectives in a minimal three-party model, a true teacher (generative model), a teacher, and a student, all soft committee machines, in which the true teacher contains a shared latent factor that the teacher cannot represent, with mismatch strength controlled by a single scalar $\dmiss$. Within an order-parameter description of online distillation, and exploiting closed-form (arcsine-type) expressions for all errors under error-function activations, we prove that the learning dynamics and the distillation error $\Ets$ are exactly invariant to $\dmiss$, whereas the true error $\Etzs$ and the gap $Δ=\Etzs-\Ets$ are strictly increasing in $\dmiss$, with a rate that is amplified linearly by the complexity $M_0$ of the true teacher. Numerical phase diagrams over the plane spanned by true-teacher complexity and student capacity confirm the predicted deformation: the contours of $\Ets$ do not move while the landscape of $\Etzs$ rises systematically, and a teacher-miss regime, where mimicry succeeds but the task fails, expands with $\dmiss$. The results give a quantitative warning against evaluating distillation solely through teacher-mimicry metrics and identify the gap $Δ$ as a minimal diagnostic for distinguishing teacher-miss from capacity-limited failure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知识蒸馏中"师生差异"这一常用监控指标与"学生真实任务误差"之间的关系。在一个由真实教师（生成模型）、教师和学生组成的三方软委员会机器模型中，作者证明蒸馏误差对教师不可表示的真实共享潜变量的失配强度δ完全不变，而学生真实误差及二者之差Δ随δ严格递增且被真实教师复杂度线性放大，从而警示仅凭教师模仿指标评估蒸馏的误区，并提出Δ作为区分"教师失配"与"容量受限"失败的极简诊断量。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏中，训练过程的进展通常用师生差异（teacher-student discrepancy）来监控，但真正关心的指标是学生相对于真实任务的误差。这两者之间是否存在一致关系是未解问题，尤其在教师模型本身无法完全表征真实任务的情况下，仅依赖教师模仿指标可能产生误导性评估。
AI.method: 构建最小三方模型：真实教师（生成模型）、教师和学生均为软委员会机器（soft committee machines）。真实教师包含一个教师无法表示的共享潜因子，失配强度由单一标量δ控制。基于在线蒸馏的序参量（order-parameter）描述，并利用误差函数激活下所有误差的闭式（反正弦型）表达式，对学习动力学、蒸馏误差与真实误差进行严格解析推导，并在"真实教师复杂度-学生容量"平面上绘制数值相图。
AI.result: 证明学习动力学和蒸馏误差E_ts对δ精确不变，而真实误差E_tzs及间隙Δ=E_tzs-E_ts随δ严格递增，且递增速率被真实教师复杂度M_0线性放大。数值相图证实了预测的形变：E_ts的等值线不移动，而E_tzs的景观系统性抬升；"教师失配"区（模仿成功但任务失败）随δ扩大。
AI.conclusion: 该结果定量警示：不应仅以教师模仿类指标评估蒸馏效果；间隙Δ是区分"教师失配失败"与"容量受限失败"的最小诊断量，可作为评估蒸馏质量的可靠补充指标。

title: The Role of Network Topology and Opponent Information in Shaping Cooperation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Systems
summary: Several works have investigated the influence of graph topology on cooperation among artificial agents, while the majority of the literature has focused on modelling agents' adaptation through strategy imitation, which relies solely on the cumulative payoffs of others. This paper investigates scenarios in which each agent learns to play the two-player Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) using deep reinforcement learning. Each agent is represented as a node in a graph, where its neighbours constitute the pool of opponents with whom it can interact. During each IPD episode, agents are provided with different types of information about their opponent, consisting of action history and opponent identity. Experimental results across different graph topologies show that the number of neighbours per node and the average path length are the main factors affecting the emergence of cooperation. We also show that, while partner selection fosters mutual cooperation by limiting the diversity of the opponent pool, providing agents with the identity of their opponent hinders the proliferation of cooperative strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在深度强化学习驱动的智能体群体中，图拓扑结构如何影响两人迭代囚徒困境（IPD）中合作行为的涌现。智能体作为图中节点，与邻居对手进行IPD博弈，并在博弈中获得不同类型的对手信息（行动历史与对手身份）。实验表明，每节点的邻居数量与平均路径长度是影响合作涌现的主要因素；伙伴选择能通过限制对手池多样性促进相互合作，而提供对手身份信息则会阻碍合作策略的扩散。
AI.motivation: 现有关于图拓扑对人工智能体合作影响的研究大多假设智能体通过策略模仿（仅依赖对方累计收益）来适应环境，缺乏对更复杂学习机制（如深度强化学习）的探讨。本文旨在探究在基于深度强化学习的智能体群体中，图拓扑结构及对手信息类型对合作涌现的影响。
AI.method: 将每个智能体表示为图中的节点，邻居构成其可交互的对手池；智能体通过深度强化学习学习玩两人迭代囚徒困境（IPD）。在每个IPD回合中，为智能体提供不同类型的信息（行动历史和对手身份），并在多种图拓扑结构下进行实验对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，每节点的邻居数量和图的平均路径长度是影响合作涌现的主要因素；伙伴选择机制通过限制对手池多样性促进相互合作，而向智能体提供对手身份信息则会阻碍合作策略的传播与扩散。
AI.conclusion: 图拓扑结构与信息供给方式共同决定深度强化学习智能体群体中合作的涌现：适度限制对手池多样性（伙伴选择）有利于合作，而过多的对手身份信息会抑制合作策略的增殖；研究为设计促进合作的群体智能系统提供了依据。

title: Explainable Multi-Loss Distillation Framework for Efficient and Interpretable Shrimp Disease Text Classification
comment: Accepted at Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
summary: Shrimp disease classification has become an urgent issue due to its significant impact on the import-export output of producing countries, particularly Vietnam. Most existing studies focus on image-based classification, which typically operates at the late stage of disease manifestation. Therefore, text-based classification has the potential to enable early and timely disease detection. To address this limitation, we introduce the SALT (Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation) framework, which incorporates explainability analysis using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to evaluate model predictions and interpret the learned linguistic features. Experimental results demonstrate that SALT achieves competitive performance across multiple distillation objectives, outperforming supervised baselines while providing a favorable trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. Moreover, it exhibits strong explainability, accurately identifying key linguistic features and semantic patterns relevant to disease descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of knowledge distillation-based text classification for future applications in early shrimp disease diagnosis and related research directions.

AI.tldr: 提出 SALT 框架，通过多损失知识蒸馏进行虾类疾病文本分类，并结合 LIME 与 SHAP 可解释性分析，实现疾病的早期检测，在预测性能与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 虾类疾病严重冲击越南等生产国的进出口经济，现有研究大多基于图像分类，但该方法通常只能在疾病症状明显显现的晚期阶段生效，难以实现早期及时检测。因此，亟需一种基于文本的分类方法，以便在疾病早期阶段通过养殖户描述等症状信息进行快速诊断。
AI.method: 引入 SALT（Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation）框架，采用多损失知识蒸馏目标进行文本分类训练；同时引入 LIME 与 SHAP 两种可解释性分析方法，用于评估模型预测并解释模型所学习的语言学特征。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SALT 在多种蒸馏目标下均取得具有竞争力的性能，优于有监督基线；同时实现了预测性能与计算效率之间的有利权衡。此外，模型展现出较强的可解释性，能够准确识别与疾病描述相关的关键语言特征和语义模式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于知识蒸馏的文本分类方法在早期虾类疾病诊断及相关研究方向上的巨大应用潜力，为超越传统图像分类的早期疾病检测提供了新思路。

title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
summary: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. Built from $273$ human-verified tri-modal examples from Social-IQ, OmniBench, and VALOR, SCEval evaluates $15$ proprietary and open-source omni-modal systems. The results show that structural corruption lowers clean accuracy, text--vision damage forms the most stable shared fault line, and multi-modal degradation is non-additive rather than a simple function of the number of corrupted modalities. Clean omni-modal accuracy therefore does not establish that a model will remain reliable when cross-modal evidence becomes structurally unreliable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCEval（结构破坏评估）诊断协议，通过在不移除模态、不改变问题和答案空间的前提下，对文本、视觉、音频通道施加受控的结构性破坏，来区分多模态大模型在纯净输入上的高分究竟源于鲁棒的跨模态融合还是仅依赖于完整输入中的表面线索。基于273个经人工验证的三模态样本评估15个专有及开源系统，结果显示结构破坏会降低纯净准确率、文本-视觉损伤构成最稳定的共享"断层线"，且多模态退化呈非加性特征——纯净的多模态准确率并不能保证模型在跨模态证据结构不可靠时依然可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有评估通常在干净的文本-视觉-音频输入上进行（所有模态存在、同步且可解释），但这类纯净评测无法判断模型成功依赖的究竟是稳定的跨模态结构，还是仅存在于完整输入中的线索，因此存在评估盲区。作者希望定义并探测一条"模态断层线"——即当模态仍然存在且人类可解释、但其内部证据结构被扰动时，模型行为变得不稳定的边界。
AI.method: 作者定义"模态断层线"概念，并构建SCEval（Structure-Corruption Evaluation）诊断协议：保持问题、答案空间和模态通道不变，仅对文本、视觉、音频分别及联合施加受控的结构性破坏。数据集由来自Social-IQ、OmniBench和VALOR的273个人工验证的三模态样本构成，用于评估15个专有和开源的全模态（omni-modal）系统。
AI.result: 实验发现：结构性破坏会降低纯净评测下的准确率；文本-视觉损伤构成了最稳定的共享断层线；多模态退化呈非加性特征，而非简单地取决于被破坏模态的数量。这意味着纯净的全模态准确率并不能预示模型在跨模态证据结构变得不可靠时仍保持可靠。
AI.conclusion: 纯净环境下的多模态评测分数不宜直接作为跨模态融合鲁棒性的证据；评估者需要将结构破坏诊断（如SCEval）纳入标准流程，以识别模型在跨模态证据结构退化时可能出现的稳定性边界（断层线）。

title: Learning Human Health and Diseases from 24-hour Wrist Movement
summary: Much of human health and function unfolds beyond the clinic, through the movements of everyday life. Wrist-worn accelerometers capture these movements continuously, yet their rich signals are often reduced to a small set of predefined behavioural summary measures. Here, we present Sensori, a self-supervised foundation model that learns general-purpose health representations directly from 24 hours of raw tri-axial wrist movement. We developed and evaluated the model across four population-based cohorts from the United Kingdom, China and the United States, comprising 122,640 participants contributing 683,617 person-days of free-living recordings. Sensori condensed each day of movement into a representation that captured diverse movement behaviours, demographic characteristics, health axes and physical function. Evaluation in independent cohorts showed that these representations generalised across populations and measurement settings without retraining. When added to common clinical covariates, Sensori significantly improved prevalent disease classification for 52 of 102 eligible conditions (median delta AUROC, 0.060; range, 0.012-0.242) and incident disease risk prediction for 26 of 87 eligible conditions (median delta Uno's C-index, 0.064; range, 0.025-0.172), with the largest gains for neurological and psychiatric disorders. These findings establish 24-hour wrist movement as a rich and scalable source of health information, with the potential to support passive health monitoring and disease prediction at population scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sensori，一个基于自监督学习的腕戴式加速度计基础模型，直接从24小时原始三轴腕部运动数据学习通用健康表征，并在涵盖英国、中国和美国四个队列共122,640名参与者、683,617人日的自由生活记录中验证，证明其表征能泛化至不同人群与测量环境，并在疾病分类与风险预测中显著优于常见临床协变量。
AI.motivation: 人类健康与功能很大程度发生在临床之外，体现在日常生活的运动中。腕戴式加速度计可持续捕捉这些运动，但丰富的信号通常被压缩成少量预定义的行为汇总指标，丢失了大量信息。作者希望从原始信号中直接学习通用、可规模化的健康表征，以支持被动健康监测与人群尺度疾病预测。
AI.method: Sensori采用自监督基础模型架构，直接从24小时原始三轴腕部运动数据学习表征。研究在来自英国、中国和美国的四个人群队列中开发并评估模型，共计122,640名参与者、683,617人日的自由生活记录。模型将每天的运动压缩为一个表征，并评估其捕捉多样化运动行为、人口学特征、健康轴和身体功能的能力；随后在独立队列中测试跨人群与跨测量设置的无重训泛化，并加入常见临床协变量评估疾病分类与风险预测性能。
AI.result: 在独立队列评估中，Sensori的表征无需重训即可跨人群和测量设置泛化。加入常见临床协变量后，Sensori显著改善了102种可评估疾病中52种的患病分类（delta AUROC中位数0.060，范围0.012-0.242）以及87种可评估疾病中26种的发病风险预测（delta Uno's C-index中位数0.064，范围0.025-0.172），其中神经与精神类疾病的增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现确立了24小时腕部运动作为一种丰富且可扩展的健康信息来源的地位，表明其有潜力支持被动健康监测和人群尺度的疾病预测，为可穿戴健康监测提供了新范式。

title: Selective Forgetting: A Graph-Based Memory Framework for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary:
Knowledge graphs have been proposed as a structured alternative to flat retrieval-augmented generation for long-term agent memory, on the assumption that representing conversations as entities and relations improves recall. We evaluate that assumption directly. Our framework extracts each conversational turn into typed nodes and attributed edges, answers questions from a two-hop subgraph, and periodically prunes nodes that score low on a weighted combination of recency, access frequency, degree centrality, and age. On LongMemEval, the graph does not outperform a flat vector baseline at a matched candidate-generation budget of five retrieval roots: token F1 is $0.417$ against $0.468$, and a paired bootstrap over 500 questions gives
$Δ= -0.050$ (95\% CI $[-0.085, -0.016]$). The gap is widest on questions that require recalling a specific prior assistant turn, where judged correctness falls from $0.911$ to $0.607$, suggesting that decomposing a turn into entities discards the surface form these questions depend on. The forgetting module is more successful. Applied once to a persistent 27{,}021-node graph, it removes 9.8\% of nodes and 9.5\% of stored bytes; token F1 is unchanged ($+0.001$, 95\% CI $[-0.015, +0.016]$) and judged correctness falls by $1.6$ points, with the 95\% interval bounding any loss at $3.8$ points ($[-0.038, +0.006]$). Because our extractor is a single small model evaluated on one benchmark, these results characterise this extraction-based pipeline rather than graph-structured memory in general. Code: https://github.com/skhanzad/Selective-Amnesia

AI.tldr: 本文直接评估了将长期智能体记忆表示为知识图谱（实体与关系）相比扁平向量检索是否能提升召回率。实验表明，在匹配5个检索根节点的候选生成预算下，图谱检索在LongMemEval上未超越扁平向量基线（token F1: 0.417 vs 0.468，差异有统计学显著性），尤其在需要回忆具体助手指令轮次的题目上退化严重；而图上的遗忘/剪枝模块则取得了成功，在不损失性能的前提下节省了近10%的存储。作者强调结论仅适用于基于抽取的流水线，不能推广到一般图结构记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设将对话表示为实体和关系可以提升长期智能体记忆的召回率，但这一假设缺乏直接验证。作者希望严谨地检验知识图谱结构替代扁平检索在长期记忆召回中的实际效果，而非想当然地接受其优势。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：1) 抽取器将每轮对话转化为带类型的节点和带属性的边；2) 回答问题时从两跳子图中提取信息；3) 周期性剪枝，根据加权得分（综合新近度、访问频率、度中心性与年龄）删除低分节点。评估上使用LongMemEval基准，与扁平向量基线在匹配5个检索根的预算下对比，并采用500个问题的配对bootstrap计算差异置信区间。
AI.result: 图谱未超越扁平向量基线：token F1为0.417对0.468，差值Δ=-0.050（95% CI [-0.085, -0.016]）。在需要回忆特定助手轮次的题目上差距最大，判定正确率从0.911跌至0.607，说明将轮次分解为实体丢弃了这些题目依赖的表面形式。遗忘模块更成功：在27,021节点图上删除9.8%节点、9.5%存储字节，token F1不变（+0.001, 95% CI [-0.015, +0.016]），判定正确率仅降1.6点（95% CI [-0.038, +0.006]）。
AI.conclusion: 基于抽取的图谱记忆流水线在当前设置下并不优于扁平向量检索，其失败根因在于实体分解破坏了表面形式；而基于重要性打分的选择性遗忘是有效且低风险的存储精简手段。由于仅使用单个小模型和单一基准，结论应限定于该抽取式流水线，而非否定图结构记忆的一般价值。

title: DocIntent: Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration for Real-World Document Visual Question Answering
summary: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Applying restoration tools before Visual Question Answering (VQA) is an intuitive solution. However, existing restoration approaches remain limited, as manually designing and executing restoration strategies is labor-intensive and requires domain expertise. Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics. To this end, we explore the value of agentic restoration for real-world degraded document VQA and propose DocIntent, a training-free Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration framework. DocIntent first assesses question answerability, then identifies task-relevant degradations and selectively invokes restoration tools. A Comparison-Based Rollback mechanism validates each restoration step and reverts it when question-relevant evidence becomes less decipherable. The entire process requires no additional pretrained degradation classifier or image quality assessment model. Extensive experiments on the WildDoc benchmark show that DocIntent consistently improves the average score and consistency of different open- and closed-source MLLMs. The code and experimental data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 DocIntent——一种无需训练、以“可回答性”为导向的智能体修复框架，用于真实场景退化文档的视觉问答。它先评估问题可回答性，识别与任务相关的退化并选择性调用修复工具，再通过基于比较的回滚机制验证每一步修复、在证据可读性下降时还原，最终在 WildDoc 基准上稳定提升多种开源与闭源 MLLM 的平均得分与一致性。
AI.motivation: 现实中的文档退化（模糊、阴影、畸变、摩尔纹等）严重损害多模态大模型（MLLM）的文档问答能力。虽然“先修复后问答”是直观方案，但现有修复方法需要人工设计并执行修复策略，耗时且依赖领域专家知识；智能体修复虽可实现自动化，但现有框架主要面向自然图像并追求感知质量，忽视了修复应服务于下游任务而非优化通用图像质量指标。
AI.method: DocIntent 是一种无需训练的 Answerability-Guided（可回答性引导）智能体修复框架。流程包括：先评估问题的可回答性；识别与任务相关的退化并选择性调用修复工具；通过“基于比较的回滚机制”（Comparison-Based Rollback）验证每一步修复——当问题相关证据变得不易辨识时自动回退该步骤。整个过程无需预训练的退化分类器或图像质量评估模型。
AI.result: 在 WildDoc 基准上的大量实验表明，DocIntent 能够持续提升不同开源和闭源 MLLM 的平均得分与回答一致性；代码与实验数据将公开。
AI.conclusion: 修复不应一味追求通用感知质量，而应服务于下游 VQA 任务需求；DocIntent 通过任务相关的选择性修复与回滚验证机制，为真实退化文档问答提供了一种无需训练、即插即用的自动化修复方案，有效增强各类 MLLM 的文档问答性能与稳定性。

title: Cloud and On-Premises Deployment of Uzbek Legal RAG via Targeted Retriever Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Industry Track). Project home: [https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/](https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/)
summary: Deploying large language models for legal question answering raises challenges that general-purpose leaderboards do not capture, particularly for low-resource languages and under hard operational constraints. We report on building and operating a retrieval-augmented (RAG) legal assistant for Uzbek that must run in two regimes: a managed cloud service that maximizes answer quality within a per-token cost ceiling, and an on-premises deployment for clients whose legal data may not leave their infrastructure, restricting us to open-weight models on limited local hardware under latency constraints. Because no evaluation existed for this setting, we build two domain benchmarks: a retrieval benchmark of 178 expert-annotated legal queries with gold provision spans, and an end-to-end benchmark of 504 expert-curated question--answer pairs scored by an LLM judge whose ratings we validate against human judgments and against an independent-family judge. Applying these benchmarks under each regime, we find the open-versus-proprietary gap is small and cheaply closed by fine-tuning. Therefore, we train UTE-1, which is a state-of-the-art text embedder among open models for Uzbek. We also demonstrate that closing the performance gap via fine-tuning is both impractical due to the intensive hardware demands of long-context legal Q\&A and unnecessary, given that legal acts change frequently. We support this by reporting a negative result from a QLoRA experiment. We distill practical guidance for similar deployments, drawn from a system serving real users in production. We release our benchmarks, evaluation code and the fine-tuned embedder (UTE-1) \href{https://metric-ai-lab.github.io/Uzbek-Legal-RAG/}{at this https URL} to support future work on low-resource legal NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了面向低资源语言乌兹别克语的检索增强（RAG）法律助手在云服务与本地部署两种运行模式下的构建与运营经验：作者构建了两个领域基准（178条专家标注检索查询、504对端到端问答对），通过实验发现开源与专有模型差距很小且可通过微调低成本弥补，据此训练了开源乌兹别克语文本嵌入器UTE-1，同时用QLoRA实验表明通过微调缩小问答性能差距既不现实也无必要，并发布了基准、评测代码与模型。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型榜单无法反映低资源语言法律问答在硬性运维约束下的真实挑战；乌兹别克语法律问答缺乏现成的评测基准与可用模型，且部署面临云服务成本上限与本地数据不出域的约束，因此需要专门构建评测体系并探索可行的模型方案。
AI.method: 构建两套领域基准：含178条专家标注查询及gold条款跨度的检索基准，以及504对专家人工筛选问答对、采用LLM裁判打分（评分经人工判断及跨模型家族裁判验证）的端到端基准；在两种运行模式下分别评测开源与专有模型，并对比微调策略，训练开源嵌入器UTE-1，进行QLoRA长上下文微调实验。
AI.result: 开源与专有模型的性能差距很小，且可通过微调低成本弥补（体现在嵌入器上），由此得到UTE-1——乌兹别克语开源模型中达到当前最优的文本嵌入器；QLoRA实验得到负面结果，表明通过微调弥补长上下文法律问答的性能差距因硬件要求过高而不切实际，且因法律条文频繁更新而无必要。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源语言的法律RAG部署，应优先通过微调嵌入器而非微调生成模型来提升效果；作者从生产系统实践中提炼出可复用的工程建议，并开源基准、评测代码与UTE-1以支持后续低资源法律NLP研究。

title: Target-Aware State-Adaptive $p$-Dirichlet Graph Neural Regression for Non-Invasive Body-Composition Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. The first four authors contribute equally to this work and are listed alphabetically. Corresponding authors: N. Drenska, Y. Wang and S. B. Heymsfield
summary: Accurate estimation of body-composition outcomes, including body fat percentage (BFP), bone mineral density (BMD), and appendicular lean mass (ALM), is important for evaluating metabolic, skeletal, and muscular health. Direct assessment using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), however, requires specialized equipment and involves ionizing radiation. We propose a target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet energy-flow graph neural regression ($p$SADE-GNR) framework for estimating these outcomes from non-invasive anthropometric measurements. A neural encoder maps participant representations to hidden states that are propagated over an outcome-specific participant-similarity graph by a state-adaptive forward-Euler discretization of the graph $p$-Dirichlet energy flow. Graph distances weight each original or latent coordinate by its normalized absolute training-fold correlation with the outcome. Using clinical data from the Pennington Biomedical Research Center and five-fold cross-validation, the correlation-weighted model using the original standardized measurements achieved the lowest root mean squared error in all nine primary outcome-cohort combinations and outperformed previously reported support vector regression or least-squares support vector regression reference values in eight of nine comparisons. Autoencoder, variational-autoencoder, and Gaussian-mixture variational-autoencoder representations generally did not improve primary-outcome prediction or reduce computational cost. In an exploratory age-prediction analysis including ALM, BMD, and BFP as predictors, the correlation-weighted GMVAE model achieved the lowest mean error in all three cohorts. These results support target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet graph neural regression for non-invasive body-composition estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种目标感知、状态自适应的 p-Dirichlet 能量流图神经网络回归框架（pSADE-GNR），用于从无创人体测量数据估计体脂率（BFP）、骨密度（BMD）和四肢瘦体重（ALM）等身体成分指标，在九种主要结局-队列组合中取得最低均方根误差，优于支持向量回归等基准方法。
AI.motivation: 准确估计身体成分指标（BFP、BMD、ALM）对评估代谢、骨骼和肌肉健康十分重要，但金标准双能X射线吸收法（DXA）需要专用设备且涉及电离辐射，因此需要一种仅基于无创人体测量数据的、准确且可替代的估计方法。
AI.method: 该框架由一个神经编码器将参与者表示映射为隐状态，随后在结局特定的参与者相似度图上，通过图 p-Dirichlet 能量流的状态自适应前向欧拉离散化来传播这些隐状态。图距离中的每个原始或潜在坐标按其与结局的训练折归一化绝对相关性进行加权。研究比较了原始标准化数据以及自编码器（AE）、变分自编码器（VAE）和高斯混合变分自编码器（GMVAE）等潜在表示，并使用临床数据与五折交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: 基于原始标准化测量值的相关加权模型在全部九种主要结局-队列组合中获得最低的均方根误差，并在九项比较中的八项优于此前报道的支持向量回归或最小二乘支持向量回归的参考值。AE、VAE 与 GMVAE 表示整体上未改善主要结局预测或降低计算成本。在纳入 ALM、BMD 和 BFP 作为预测因子的探索性年龄预测分析中，相关加权的 GMVAE 模型在三个队列中均取得最低平均误差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，目标感知、状态自适应的 p-Dirichlet 图神经回归方法适用于无创身体成分估计，可作为 DXA 等直接测量的有效替代方案，并为后续相关回归建模提供了可靠的框架基础。

title: Agentic AI uncovers conserved cross-tissue protein co-abundance programs inaccessible to single-dataset analysis
summary: Protein co-abundance clusters preserved across tissues can reveal shared disease mechanisms and candidate therapeutic targets, particularly when proteins implicated in organ-confined diseases converge in peripheral or accessible tissues. However, previous cross-tissue studies have focused on biologically pre-selected tissue pairs, leaving most possible combinations and non-obvious relationships unexplored. We present an LLM-agent framework for large-scale, evidence-grounded comparison of tissue-specific protein co-abundance networks. The framework constructs tissue networks, derives pairwise consensus clusters, and integrates evidence from expression atlases, protein interaction and complex databases, pathway annotations, disease catalogues, and literature. Applied to all 820 pairwise combinations of 41 human tissues and fluids, it identified 1,833 conserved co-abundance clusters across 406 tissue pairs. Colon, synovial fluid, blood, cerebrospinal fluid, and bone marrow were the most broadly connected tissues, while the most cluster-rich pairs were dominated by bone marrow. The analysis also highlighted non-obvious relationships: skin-bone marrow exceeded the anatomically adjacent bone-bone marrow pair, while colon-breast contained cancer-relevant clusters involving extracellular-matrix remodeling, lipid metabolism, and immune modulation. Cluster-level analyses generated further mechanistic hypotheses, including a brain-gut extracellular-vesicle/redox/serotonin-cofactor axis and a liver-bone marrow stress-response axis involving genes linked to white matter disease. These results provide a global, comparable landscape of conserved protein co-abundance and a hypothesis-generating resource for mechanistic and therapeutic exploration. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Gry1005/AgenticAI-conserved-cross-tissue-protein-co-abundance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于LLM智能体的框架，用于大规模、基于证据地比较组织特异性蛋白共表达（共丰度）网络，系统性地分析41个人类组织和体液的全部820个两两组合，识别出406个组织对中的1,833个保守共丰度集群，并发现了皮肤-骨髓、结肠-乳腺、脑-肠、肝-骨髓等非显而易见的组织间关联及其潜在疾病机制和治疗靶点。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质共丰度簇在不同组织间的保守性可揭示共享的疾病机制和潜在治疗靶点，尤其是在器官局限性疾病相关蛋白汇聚于外周或可及组织时。然而，以往的跨组织研究仅聚焦于生物学上预先选择的组织对，导致大多数可能的组织组合和非显而易见的关联未被探索。需要一种能够大规模、基于证据地比较所有组织对蛋白共丰度网络的方法。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个LLM智能体框架，包含三个核心步骤：1) 构建组织特异性蛋白共丰度网络；2) 推导两两组织间的保守共识簇；3) 整合来自表达图谱、蛋白互作与复合物数据库、通路注释、疾病目录和文献的多源证据进行验证与解释。该框架被应用于41个人类组织和流体的全部820个两两组合。
AI.result: 框架在406个组织对中识别出1,833个保守共丰度簇。结肠、滑液、血液、脑脊液和骨髓是连接最广的组织，而骨膜所在组织对在簇数量上占主导。分析揭示了非显而易见的关系：皮肤-骨髓对的保守簇数量超过了解剖上相邻的骨-骨髓对；结肠-乳腺对包含涉及细胞外基质重塑、脂质代谢和免疫调节的癌症相关簇。簇级分析进一步产生机制假设，包括脑-肠细胞外囊泡/氧化还原/血清素辅因子轴，以及涉及白质疾病相关基因的肝-骨髓应激反应轴。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了全球范围内可比较的保守蛋白共丰度图谱，是一个可用于机制探索和治疗学研究的假设生成资源，证明了LLM智能体框架在系统性发现跨组织生物学关联方面的价值。代码和数据已公开。

title: sRGB Real Noise Modeling via Noise-Aware Sampling with Normalizing Flows
summary: Noise poses a widespread challenge in signal processing, particularly when it comes to denoising images. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have exhibited remarkable success in this field, they are predicated upon the belief that noise follows established distributions, which restricts their practicality when dealing with real-world noise. To overcome this limitation, several efforts have been taken to collect noisy image datasets from the real world. Generative methods, employing techniques such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) and normalizing flows (NFs), have emerged as a solution for generating realistic noisy images. Recent works model noise using camera metadata, however requiring metadata even for sampling phase. In contrast, in this work, we aim to estimate the underlying camera settings, enabling us to improve noise modeling and generate diverse noise distributions. To this end, we introduce a new NF framework that allows us to both classify noise based on camera settings and generate various noisy images. Through experimental results, our model demonstrates exceptional noise quality and leads in denoising performance on benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于归一化流（NF）的噪声建模框架，无需相机元数据即可估计底层相机设置，同时实现噪声分类与多样化真实噪声图像生成，从而提升图像去噪性能。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪中，CNN假设噪声服从预设分布，难以泛化到不服从该分布的真实噪声；现有生成方法依赖相机元数据建模噪声，但在采样阶段仍需要元数据，限制了实用性。因此本文旨在估计底层相机设置，以改进噪声建模并生成多样的噪声分布，摆脱对元数据的依赖。
AI.method: 引入一种新的归一化流（NF）框架，利用该框架既能依据相机设置对噪声进行分类，又能生成多种多样的真实噪声图像，从而在无需元数据的情况下估计相机的底层设置。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该模型生成的噪声具有优异的噪声质量，并在基准数据集上的去噪性能中取得领先水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过估计底层相机设置替代对元数据的依赖，本文的归一化流框架能够更准确地建模真实噪声并生成多样的噪声分布，进而显著提升去噪效果，为真实世界图像去噪提供了一种有效方案。

title: Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
comment: Code and data are released at https://github.com/THUNLP-MT/TTED
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks. We also provide key insights in the design of the label-free learning algorithm. As more complex environments are accessed by LLM agents, we believe learning environment decomposition skills at test time will be critical for robust real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM网页智能体在推理阶段将复杂环境观测分解为子模块，并通过无标签学习利用经验自适应行为，从而提升其在真实复杂Web自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在人工构造的环境中表现优异，但迁移到复杂真实世界场景时性能往往会大幅下降。现有研究大多将此归因于LLM在多个简单、良好结构环境组合上的组合泛化差距。作者认为LLM网页智能体可以在测试时学习简单的环境观测，从而应对这一性能退化问题。
AI.method: 提出测试时环境分解（Test-Time Environment Decomposition, TTED）框架：引入试运行步（trial steps），让智能体将复杂环境观测分解为多个子模块；并实现一种无标签（label-free）的测试时学习方法，使智能体在推理过程中利用经验自适应调整行为。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准上的实验表明：（1）在较简单子环境中获得的经验可以有效地组合起来，提升完整环境中的表现；（2）在子环境上进行测试时训练能显著增强智能体在真实Web自动化任务中的组合泛化能力。同时为无标签学习算法的设计提供了关键见解。
AI.conclusion: 随着LLM智能体接触越来越复杂的环境，在测试时学习环境分解技能对于其稳健的真实世界部署至关重要。

title: Adversarial Online Classification with a Preview
summary:
Worst-case online classification is governed by sequential complexity, such as Littlestone dimension, and can be impossible even for statistically simple classes, such as thresholds of VC dimension one. We study a preview model in which an oblivious adversary fixes an entire labeled sequence of length $T$, a uniformly random subset of size $pT$ is revealed before prediction begins, and the remaining $(1-p)T$ examples are then presented in their original adversarial order.
  Against the best full-sequence hypothesis evaluated on the unrevealed examples, we characterize the dependence on the preview rate $p$: for binary classes of VC dimension $d$, the optimal excess loss is $Θ(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$, up to the trivial cap at $T$; for multiclass classes we obtain the corresponding $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ bound with no dependence on the number of labels. Thus a random preview can replace worst-case sequential complexity by classical statistical dimensions without randomizing the online order. To achieve the sharp binary bound, our ChainedPrediction algorithm uses an online analogue of chaining, implemented as a multiscale aggregation algorithm rather than only as an analytic argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带预览（preview）的在线分类模型：对抗者固定长度为 T 的标记序列，其中大小为 pT 的均匀随机子集在预测开始前被揭示，剩余 (1-p)T 个样本按原始对抗顺序在线呈现。作者证明随机预览能将最坏情形下的序贯复杂度（Littlestone 维）替换为经典统计维数：对 VC 维为 d 的二元类，最优超额损失为 Θ(d/p+√(dT))；对多类问题则得到 Õ(d_DS/p+√(d_Nat T)) 且与标签数无关。算法 ChainedPrediction 通过在线版本的 chaining（实现为多尺度聚合算法）达到该锐利界。
AI.motivation: 最坏情形在线分类受序贯复杂度（如 Littlestone 维）支配，即使对 VC 维为 1 的阈值类等统计上极简单的类也可能不可学习（存在灾难性预测错误）。作者希望借助"预览"这种信息获取方式，将在线学习困难度的决定性因素从序贯复杂度转化为经典的统计维数，从而建立可学习性与统计复杂度之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 考虑预览模型：遗忘式对抗者先固定长度为 T 的完整标记序列，随机均匀选取大小为 pT 的子集在预测开始前揭示，剩余样本按原始对抗顺序逐一预测。针对二元类，作者提出 ChainedPrediction 算法，它实现了在线版本的 chaining 论证——不是把它当作纯解析工具，而是实现为多尺度聚合（multiscale aggregation）算法，从而得到与 VC 维 d 和预览率 p 匹配的锐利界 Θ(d/p+√(dT))。对多类情形，作者进一步以 DS 维和 Natarajan 维替代类 VC 维，得到 Õ(d_DS/p+√(d_Nat T)) 界且不依赖标签数。
AI.result: 在预览模型中，针对未揭示样本上的最优全序列假设，二元类（VC 维 d）的最优超额损失被精确刻画为 Θ(d/p+√(dT))（上限不超过平凡上界 T）；多类情形得到 Õ(d_DS/p+√(d_Nat T)) 的上界，且与标签数量无关。这表明随机预览可以在不随机化在线顺序的情况下，将最坏情形序贯复杂度替换为经典统计维数。
AI.conclusion: 随机预览证明是在线分类问题中一种有效的"复杂度转换"机制：它以预览率 p 为代价，把困扰即使在简单类上的序贯可学习性障碍（Littlestone 维）消解为经典统计复杂度（VC 维、DS 维、Natarajan 维）。ChainedPrediction 作为多尺度聚合算法同时提供了统计最优性分析和可实现的算法结构，为后续在线学习与统计学习统一理论提供了新工具。

title: Verification abundance, adjudication scarcity: what happens to mathematical knowledge when proof checking becomes free
summary:
In May 2026 an OpenAI model produced a counterexample to the Erdős unit distance conjecture. Five mathematicians published a human-verified version the same day, and the result entered the literature within weeks. In August 2026 the same laboratory published ten mathematical and theoretical computer science results, each accompanied by a machine-checkable Lean 4 certificate with no unproved steps. Four weeks later, one remained the subject of an unresolved dispute over whether its formalization meant what it claimed.
  We argue that this difference is structural. We distinguish three layers of verification: derivational validity, which a kernel checks; representational fidelity, whether the formal statement means the intended question; and epistemic significance. Only the first is mechanizable. Making it effectively free therefore does not eliminate verification work but shifts the burden to layers dependent on scarce expert attention.
  Measurements of the August corpus illustrate the shift. The kernel-checked proofs total 20.6 MB, while the statements requiring human audit total 55.6 KB, a ratio of 379 to 1. Yet those statements contain 218 bespoke definitions rather than relying on community-vetted ones. The audit surface is therefore small in volume but irreducibly expert. We argue that machine checking produces verification abundance while leaving adjudication scarce. We propose a six-category taxonomy of representational mismatch, a disclosure schema for machine-generated mathematical claims, and implications for software, cryptography, and regulated decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一个设想的未来场景（2026年AI生成数学成果），论证机器证明的验证负担并未消失，而是从可机械化的一层转移到依赖稀缺专家注意力的层次：形式化验证只能保证推导有效性，而表述保真度与认知意义仍需人工审计；衡量数据表明机器核验产生"验证丰裕"而"裁决稀缺"。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到两类事件的结构性差异：2026年5月OpenAI模型给出Erdős单位距离猜想的反例，由五名数学家当日人工验证并迅速进入文献；而同年8月该实验室发布的十项成果均附有Lean 4机器可查证书，其中一项在四周后仍因"形式化是否表达其声称含义"的争议而悬而未决。这一对比说明机器核验并不能消除验证工作，反而将负担转移到依赖稀缺专家注意力的层次，需要加以系统分析。
AI.method: 作者区分三层验证：推导有效性（由内核检查）、表述保真度（形式化陈述是否意味着预期问题）与认知意义，并指出只有第一层可机械化。通过对八月语料的测量（内核验证证明共20.6 MB，而需人工审计的陈述共55.6 KB，比例379:1，且陈述含218个定制定义而非社区审定定义），提出六类表述错配分类学、面向机器生成数学主张的披露模式，以及其在软件、密码学与受监管决策系统中的意义。
AI.result: 结果表明：机器核验使推导验证近乎免费，但验证工作的重心转移到规模虽小却无法还原的专家审计面上；审计面"量小质高"，因而机器检查产生验证丰裕，而裁决依然稀缺。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为该差异是结构性的：只要表述保真度与认知意义仍依赖专家判断，形式化验证的普及就不会消除验证瓶颈，只会重塑其形态；因此必须借助错配分类学与披露机制来管理机器生成数学主张带来的验证负担。

title: Di$^2$CycleSB: Towards High-Quality Unsupervised Nighttime Visibility Enhancement via Schrödinger Bridge Transformer
summary: Light-effect contamination poses a significant challenge to nighttime visibility enhancement. Most methods suppress light effects by estimating and decomposing them through prior-driven regularization, yet they are often limited by hand-crafted priors and ill-posed nature of decomposition. This work proposes Di$^2$CycleSB, a unsupervised Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer framework guided by dynamic integral image priors, for high-quality unsupervised nighttime visibility enhancement. Specifically, a novel light-effect estimator is introduced to parameterize Gaussian-like adaptive priors by aggregating dynamic integral image representations for non-uniform glow estimation. Then, we propose a prior-informed Generator that exploits light-effect representations to guide long-range dependency modeling within our specific Transformer blocks. We formulate light-effect suppression as a Schrödinger bridge problem and construct forward and backward bridges with cycle consistency constraints to achieve visually pleasing enhancement. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the remarkable effectiveness of our Di$^2$CycleSB in enhancing nighttime visibility. In particular, it achieves effective end-to-end light-effect suppression without any regularization constraints and image decomposition. The code and models are available at https://github.com/LHTcode/Di2CycleSB.

AI.tldr: 提出 Di²CycleSB，一种基于动态积分图像先验指导的无监督 Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer 框架，用于夜间可见度增强。它通过光效估计器参数化类高斯自适应先验，利用先验信息引导 Transformer 的长程依赖建模，并将光效抑制建模为 Schrödinger bridge 问题，通过前向/后向 bridge 与循环一致性约束实现端到端增强，无需正则化约束或图像分解。
AI.motivation: 夜间可见度增强中，光效污染（glow/light-effect contamination）是重要挑战。现有方法大多通过先验驱动的正则化来估计并分解光效，但受限于手工设计的先验以及分解问题本身的病态性（ill-posed），难以取得高质量结果。
AI.method: 1) 提出新的光效估计器，通过聚合动态积分图像表示来参数化类高斯自适应先验，用于非均匀光晕估计；2) 提出先验信息引导的生成器（prior-informed Generator），利用光效表示在特定 Transformer 块中引导长程依赖建模；3) 将光效抑制建模为 Schrödinger bridge 问题，构造前向与后向 bridge 并加入循环一致性约束，实现无监督训练。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，Di²CycleSB 能显著提升夜间可见度；尤其能实现端到端的光效抑制，无需任何正则化约束和图像分解，并已开源代码与模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动态积分图像先验与 Schrödinger bridge 建模相结合，Di²CycleSB 提供了一种有效的无监督夜间可见度增强方案，克服了手工先验与病态分解的限制，在真实数据上验证了其有效性。

title: Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to BNAIC/BeNeLearn 2026 as a Type A paper
summary: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers. Every strategy reduces the proportion of answers judged to contain unsupported content, and all three judges agree on the ordering. Deletion achieves the largest reduction while retaining least of the original answer, at 64.3% of the text, whereas rewriting retains 80.1% and reduces least. Repair is not confined to faulty answers: 83.5% of answers annotated clean are edited too. The strategies occupy different points on a grounding preservation trade-off rather than forming a quality ranking, and choosing between them needs evidence about answer usefulness that automatic metrics cannot supply.

AI.tldr: 针对检索增强语言模型生成答案中仍存在未被检索文本支持的陈述的问题，本文不再止步于检测，而是研究修复策略：将标记的答案拆分为事实性声明并逐条对照检索源，比较不修复与三种修复策略（删除、用源文本替换、重写）。三种语言模型对916个修复后答案的评估显示，每种策略都能降低含不支持内容的比例，其中删除效果最大但保留原文最少（64.3%），重写保留最多（80.1%）但降幅最小；修复还会波及83.5%的干净答案。各策略构成“忠实性—保留度”权衡而非质量排序，策略选择需要自动指标无法提供的答案有用性证据。
AI.motivation: 检索增强能让模型依据检索文档作答以减少无依据陈述，但并不能完全消除幻觉，且读者无法区分有依据与编造的句子。现有研究大多止步于检测问题答案，这并不能帮助阅读者，而关于检测后应采取何种修复动作的证据几乎缺失。因此需要系统比较不同修复策略对答案忠实性的影响。
AI.method: 以人工标注了不支持段落基准RAGTruth为数据基础：将每个被标记的答案拆分为独立的事实性声明，逐一与检索来源核对；比较四种处理方式——不做修复、删除不支持的声明、用源文本替换该声明、整句重写；再由三个不同模型家族的LLM作为评判者对916个修复后的答案进行打分。
AI.result: 所有修复策略均降低了被判定含不支持内容的答案比例，且三个评判者在排序上一致。删除策略降幅最大，但仅保留原文的64.3%；重写策略保留80.1%的原文，降幅最小。修复并不仅限于有误答案——83.5%被标注为干净的答案也被改动。各策略差异体现为忠实性与信息保留之间的权衡而非质量高下。
AI.conclusion: 修复策略之间不存在统一的优劣排序，而是在“忠实性提升”与“原答案内容保留”之间占据不同位置。选择何种修复策略需要有关答案对读者实际有用性的证据，而这类证据是当前自动评测指标无法提供的；这提示后续研究应将修复效果与下游使用的价值衡量结合起来。

title: Denoising as Projection: Constrained Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used not only for sampling from learned data distributions, but also for generating samples that optimize task-specific objectives. A common approach is to guide the reverse diffusion process using gradients of an external objective. However, when the data distribution is supported on a structured feasible set, such as a manifold or a constraint set, gradient guidance can move samples away from the learned data geometry. In this paper, we study a simple projected-gradient-guided diffusion update based on the observation that the Stein denoising operator can act as an approximate projection onto the data geometry. The proposed update incorporates the objective gradient inside the denoising step, yielding an inference-time method that uses only a pretrained denoiser and gradient evaluations. We analyze this update as an inexact projected-gradient method for constrained optimization over learned feasible geometries. Our theory covers three settings: linear manifolds, compact convex feasible sets, and compact Riemannian submanifolds. In all these settings, we prove descent and finite-time convergence guarantees. Numerical experiments support the theoretical interpretation and illustrate how the proposed update balances objective descent with preservation of the learned geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于投影梯度的扩散模型推理期引导方法：利用Stein去噪算子作为对数据几何的近似投影，将目标梯度整合进去噪步骤中，从而在优化任务目标的同时保持生成样本位于学习到的可行几何结构内，并给出了三类几何设定下的收敛性理论保证。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型广泛用于采样学习到数据分布之外的目标样本，常用做法是通过外部目标的梯度引导反向扩散过程。但当数据分布支持在结构化可行集（如流形或约束集）上时，梯度引导会使样本偏离学习到的数据几何结构。因此需要一种既能优化目标又能保持数据几何有效性的引导方法。
AI.method: 提出投影梯度引导的扩散更新（projected-gradient-guided diffusion update）。核心观察是Stein去噪算子可近似作为数据几何上的投影算子；该更新将目标梯度合并到去噪步骤内部，属于仅需预训练去噪器和梯度评估的推理期方法。作者将该更新建模为面向学习可行几何约束优化的非精确投影梯度方法（inexact projected-gradient method）。
AI.result: 理论覆盖三种设定：线性流形、紧凸可行集、紧Riemannian子流形。在所有这些设定下证明了下降性质（descent）和有限时间收敛保证（finite-time convergence guarantees）。数值实验支持理论解释，并展示该方法如何在目标下降与保持学习几何之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该投影梯度引导更新是一种既保持数据几何又能引导目标下降的推理期方法；通过Stein去噪算子的近似投影作用，它从理论上被刻画为非精确投影梯度方法，并在多种几何设定下获得收敛保证，为扩散模型在结构化可行集上的引导生成提供了可靠的理论基础。

title: Multi-Step Forecasting of Grape Berry Temperature based on LSTM Model with Feed-Forward Attention
summary: Accurate forecasting of grape berry temperature (Tb) is essential for enabling timely heat stress management in vineyards. In this study, a feed-forward attention mechanism integrated with a Long Short-Term Memory network (FAM-LSTM) was developed and evaluated for multi-step, high-resolution Tb prediction. Models were trained using environmental data from 2023 and 2024 at Prosser, WA, USA, and validated on 2025 summer data. FAM-LSTM was benchmarked against LSTM, GRU, RNN, and Random Forest (RF) across horizons ranging from 15 minutes to 72 hours (288 time steps). Two input scenarios were evaluated: nearest open-field weather station observations and in-vineyard microclimate measurements. FAM-LSTM consistently outperformed all benchmark models across all horizons and input scenarios. Incorporating in-vineyard microclimate data significantly improved forecasting accuracy at longer horizons. Using open-field data, FAM-LSTM achieved MAE and RMSE ranges of 0.58 to 1.70 deg C and 0.65 to 2.07 deg C, respectively. In-vineyard observations further improved performance, with MAE and RMSE in the ranges of 0.51 to 1.55 deg C and 0.71 to 1.87 deg C. Error analysis showed prediction uncertainty was highest during peak daytime periods (11:00 to 18:00) and increased progressively with forecast horizon. Overall, the FAM-LSTM framework offers robust Tb forecasting to support precision heat stress management in vineyards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种将前馈注意力机制与长短期记忆网络相结合的FAM-LSTM模型，用于葡萄浆果温度的多步、高分辨率预测。基于华盛顿州Prosser地区2023-2024年数据训练、2025年夏季数据验证，FAM-LSTM在15分钟至72小时（288个时间步）的所有预测时域内均优于LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林等基准模型；使用园内微气候数据可进一步显著提升长时域预测精度。
AI.motivation: 准确预测葡萄浆果温度（Tb）对于葡萄园热胁迫的及时管理至关重要，然而现有方法在长时域、高分辨率预测上的精度仍有不足，且不同输入数据来源（露天气象站与园内微气候）对预测效果的影响尚需系统评估。
AI.method: 开发了融合前馈注意力机制的LSTM网络（FAM-LSTM），并针对15分钟至72小时（288个时间步）的多步预测任务，将其与LSTM、GRU、RNN及随机森林（RF）进行对比；同时设计了两种输入场景（最近露天气象站观测数据与园内微气候测量数据），采用2023-2024年数据训练、2025年夏季数据验证，并以MAE和RMSE作为评价指标。
AI.result: FAM-LSTM在所有预测时域和输入场景下均一致优于各基准模型。采用露天气象站数据时，MAE和RMSE分别为0.58-1.70°C和0.65-2.07°C；引入园内微气候观测后性能进一步提升，MAE和RMSE分别降至0.51-1.55°C和0.71-1.87°C。误差分析表明，预测不确定性在白天高峰时段（11:00-18:00）最大，且随预测时域延长而逐渐增大。
AI.conclusion: FAM-LSTM框架能够提供稳健的葡萄浆果温度预测，可有效支持葡萄园精准热胁迫管理；同时表明园内微气候数据对长时域预测精度具有重要价值。

title: All You Need Is Non-Commutative Words
summary: We represent lexical tokens as unitary matrices and encode each sentence as their ordered product. The noncommutativity of matrix product captures word order without positional encodings (PEs). The same algebra yields several capabilities, including antisymmetric self-attention with no query, key, or value projections, and parallel composition of variable-length text chunks at a reduced attention cost. Furthermore, it provides a canonical-coset readout layer that encodes all true unitary degrees of freedom compactly, while supporting continual learning through nested group extensions that enlarge the operator space with each new task preserving prior representations exactly. Across standard text-classification benchmarks, the method matches or exceeds bag-of-words baselines. Achieving higher accuracy on IMDB and comparable performance on AG News. Notably, this is accomplished by replacing the conventional $\sim$30,000-dimensional vocabulary space with a dense, 64-parameter real-valued encoding, highlighting the expressive efficiency of our parameterization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以酉矩阵表示词汇、以有序矩阵乘积编码句子的文本表示方法。利用矩阵乘法的非交换性隐式捕捉词序，无需位置编码；同时衍生出无需Q/K/V投影的反对称自注意力、可变长度文本块的并行组合，以及紧凑的canonical-coset读出层。该方法还通过嵌套群扩展支持持续学习，在IMDB上取得更高准确率、在AG News上性能相当，仅用64个实值参数（替代约3万维词表空间）即达到或超过词袋基线。
AI.motivation: 传统词袋模型忽略词序，而基于巨大词汇表（约3万维）的离散编码参数效率低下。作者希望寻找一种既能捕捉词序、又参数紧凑的文本表示方式，同时探索其在注意力机制、长文本并行处理及持续学习中的统一代数框架。
AI.method: 将每个词元表示为酉矩阵，句子编码为这些矩阵的有序乘积；利用矩阵乘法非交换性捕捉词序，无需位置编码。该代数框架统一提供了：(1) 无需查询/键/值投影的反对称自注意力；(2) 变长文本块以降低注意力成本的并行组合；(3) 紧凑编码全部真实酉自由度的canonical-coset读出层；(4) 通过嵌套群扩展实现跨任务的持续学习，新任务扩大算子空间且严格保留旧任务表示。
AI.result: 在标准文本分类基准上，该方法达到或超过词袋基线：在IMDB上取得更高准确率，在AG News上性能相当。关键在于它以稠密的64参数实值编码替代了传统约30,000维的词表空间，凸显了该参数化的表达效率。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，单一的酉矩阵代数足以同时处理词序编码、自注意力、并行文本组合和持续学习，并以极少的参数实现与传统词袋方法相当乃至更优的分类性能，展示了矩阵群表示在文本建模中的高效性与扩展潜力。

title: On the Plasticity Collapse in Continual Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning enables deep neural networks to selectively remove the influence of specific data in response to privacy and regulatory requirements. While prior work largely studies single-shot unlearning, real-world systems must accommodate continual unlearning, where multiple unlearning requests occur sequentially over time. In this work, we identify a fundamental limitation of this setting: plasticity collapse, a progressive breakdown in a model's ability to effectively forget. Through theoretical analysis of continual unlearning dynamics, we show that continual unlearning operations accumulate geometric constraints in parameter space, leading to saturated subspaces that restrict future updates. This structural effect induces two distinct failure modes: (1) Forward failure -- diminishing forgetting quality for subsequent tasks, and (2) Backward failure -- spontaneous re-memorization of previously forgotten information. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures, datasets, and methods in image classification confirm that plasticity collapse is not an artifact of specific implementations, but a pervasive phenomenon inherent to continual unlearning. Our findings reveal a critical barrier to the long-term reliability of machine unlearning systems and motivate the development of plasticity-preserving unlearning algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/TIML-Group/Continual-Machine-Unlearning-Plasticity-Collapse

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究持续机器遗忘（continual unlearning）场景，识别并验证了"可塑性崩塌"（plasticity collapse）这一根本性缺陷：连续的遗忘操作会在参数空间中累积几何约束并形成饱和子空间，进而引发两类失效模式——前向失效（后续遗忘质量下降）和后向失效（先前已遗忘信息被自发重新记忆）。理论和大量实验表明该现象在不同架构、数据集与方法中普遍存在，是持续遗忘内在固有的障碍。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘研究大多关注单次遗忘，但真实系统需要支持顺序到达的多次遗忘请求（持续遗忘）。作者发现该设置存在一个根本性局限——可塑性崩塌：模型在持续遗忘过程中遗忘能力会逐步退化，这严重威胁长期可靠性，需要被系统识别与理解。
AI.method: 作者对持续遗忘动力学进行理论分析，表明持续遗忘操作会在参数空间中累积几何约束，导致饱和子空间并限制后续更新。基于这一结构效应推导出两种失效模式（前向失效与后向失效），并通过跨多种架构、数据集和方法的图像分类实验加以验证。
AI.result: 理论分析与大量实验一致表明，可塑性崩塌不是特定实现的产物，而是持续遗忘固有且普遍存在的现象。具体表现为：前向失效使后续遗忘质量持续下降，后向失效使已遗忘信息发生自发再记忆。该发现揭示了持续机器遗忘长期可靠性面临的关键障碍。
AI.conclusion: 可塑性崩塌是持续机器遗忘场景中普遍存在且不可避免的结构性障碍，它同时损害未来遗忘效能并破坏既往遗忘成果。作者据此呼吁发展保持可塑性的遗忘算法（plasticity-preserving unlearning），以确保机器遗忘系统在长期、动态请求环境下的可靠运行。代码已开源。

title: Frequency Selective Neural Networks as a Foundation Architecture for Time Series Learning
summary: Time-series data across physical and biological domains are fundamentally driven by complex, non-stationary oscillatory modes. While deep learning models, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks, and Transformers, have dominated sequential analysis, they remain fundamentally "spectral-blind". By mapping continuous physical waves into unconstrained spatial or discrete token spaces, these architectures suffer from severe spectral entanglement, acting as opaque black boxes that decouple predictive accuracy from physical reality. In this paper, we introduce the Frequency Selective Neural Network (FSNN), pioneering a foundation architecture guaranteeing physical interpretability without sacrificing expressive power of deep learning. FSNN addresses spectral entanglement by explicitly embedding the rigorous mathematics of advanced signal processing into its neural topology. Through a fully differentiable Wiener-like filter bank optimized via complex-domain backpropagation, FSNN autonomously discovers and isolates the precise physical modes of a given task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FSNN establishes state-of-the-art predictive performance, achieving $77.0\%$ average accuracy on the standard 10 multivariate UEA datasets and leading across all major metrics on the highly imbalanced PTB-XL clinical ECG benchmark. Crucially, in contrast to yielding abstract feature maps, FSNN converges directly on physically meaningful frequency bands, such as isolating the cardiac QRS complex, providing a highly scalable, interpretable paradigm for robust pattern recognition in complex temporal domains. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ad6174hhhh/FSNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率选择性神经网络（FSNN），一种在神经网络拓扑中显式嵌入信号处理数学、通过可微Wiener式滤波器组训练的基础架构，在保持深度学习表达能力的同时实现物理可解释的时间序列建模，并在UEA与PTB-XL基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 物理与生物领域的时间序列由复杂、非平稳的振荡模态驱动，但现有深度学习模型（CNN、RNN、Transformer）本质上是"频谱盲"的：它们将连续物理波映射到无约束的空间或离散token空间，导致严重的频谱纠缠，预测准确性与物理现实脱节，成为不可解释的黑盒。
AI.method: 提出FSNN，将高级信号处理数学显式嵌入神经拓扑，从根本上解决频谱纠缠问题。核心是一个完全可微的Wiener式滤波器组，通过复数域反向传播优化，使网络能够自主发现并分离任务中的精确物理模态。
AI.result: 在10个多元UEA数据集上取得77.0%的平均准确率（SOTA），在高度不平衡的PTB-XL临床ECG基准上多项主要指标领先；与传统抽象特征图不同，FSNN直接收敛于物理上有意义的频带（如心脏QRS波群）。
AI.conclusion: FSNN提供了兼具深度学习表达能力与物理可解释性的基础架构范式，以可扩展的方式实现复杂时域中的稳健模式识别，可作为频谱敏感的时序信号分析与临床诊断的通用解决方案。

title: AdapToPASS: Ambiguity-aware Adaptive Spherical Transformer for Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
summary: Spherical Transformers have emerged as a promising framework for panoramic semantic segmentation (PASS) by operating directly on spherical geometry and alleviating projection-induced distortions. However, existing architectures often assume canonical spherical structure and stable viewpoints, which are frequently violated in real-world imagery due to unconstrained camera motion, introducing contextual and geometric ambiguity. Consequently, they lack adaptive mechanisms to handle such ambiguity, limiting robustness to unseen spherical transformations. In contrast, biological perception is inherently ambiguity-aware, adapting to fluctuations in cue reliability caused by geometric and contextual variations to maintain stable interpretation under complex transformations. Motivated by this, we first systematically analyze existing PASS architectures under various unseen spherical transformations. We then introduce AdapToPASS, a novel bio-inspired Spherical Transformer that adaptively models contextual and geometric ambiguities for robust PASS. At its core, Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) blocks dynamically modulate attention according to local contextual ambiguity, mimicking adaptive, context-driven biological perception. To address geometric ambiguity, AdapToPASS employs Bifocal Spherical Representation to balance field of view and spatial resolution, together with boundary supervision inspired by the boundary-sensitive nature of biological vision. Across indoor and outdoor semantic segmentation, AdapToPASS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. Under unseen spherical transformations, it surpasses the next-best method by +13.38% relative mIoU on Stanford2D3D and +18.77% on WildPASS. We further introduce AdapToPASS-Swift, a lightweight variant with fewer than 2M parameters, which surpasses compact baselines while retaining robustness to spherical transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdapToPASS，一种受生物感知启发的球面 Transformer，专门用于全景语义分割。它通过自适应球面注意力（AdaSpA）动态调节注意力以建模上下文歧义，并结合双焦点球面表示与边界监督处理几何歧义，在未见过的球面变换下显著提升鲁棒性，还提供了参数量小于 2M 的轻量变体 AdapToPASS-Swift。
AI.motivation: 现有球面 Transformer 通常在理想化的标准球面结构与稳定视点假设下设计，但真实图像中的无约束相机运动会引入上下文与几何歧义，而现有模型缺乏自适应机制来处理此类歧义，导致对未见过的球面变换鲁棒性不足。相比之下，生物感知天然具备"歧义感知"能力，能根据线索可靠性波动进行自适应调整，因此作者以此作为设计动机。
AI.method: 首先系统分析了现有 PASS 架构在各种未见过的球面变换下的表现；随后提出 AdapToPASS，其核心是 Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) 模块，可根据局部上下文歧义动态调制注意力，模拟生物感知的自适应机制；针对几何歧义，采用双焦点球面表示（Bifocal Spherical Representation）在视场与空间分辨率之间取得平衡，并结合受生物视觉边界敏感性启发的边界监督；最后推出轻量变体 AdapToPASS-Swift。
AI.result: 在室内与室外语义分割任务上，AdapToPASS 一致优于现有最优方法；在未见过的球面变换下，相对 mIoU 较次优方法在 Stanford2D3D 上提升 +13.38%，在 WildPASS 上提升 +18.77%。AdapToPASS-Swift 参数少于 2M，超过紧凑基线且保持对球面变换的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并自适应处理上下文与几何歧义，AdapToPASS 有效提升了全景语义分割在真实世界无约束相机运动下的鲁棒性，验证了生物启发的歧义感知机制在球面 Transformer 设计中的有效性，并展示了轻量化方案的可行性。

title: Padārtha: Ontology-Grounded Fine-Grained NER Benchmark for Classical Sanskrit
summary: Annotation schemas are not neutral. When applied to classical literature, tag sets developed for modern journalistic texts impose source-culture definitions on texts they were never designed to describe. We instead ground a schema in the tradition of the text itself introducing \textit{Padārtha}, the first ontology-grounded fine-grained Named Entity Recognition (NER) benchmark for Sanskrit, built on the \textit{Mahābhārata} epic. Our tag set derives from \textit{Nyāya-Vaiśesika}, a classical Indian ontological system, yielding 18 fine-grained categories organized under 10 ontological nodes and mapped onto five standard coarse tags, ensuring interoperability with existing benchmarks. Expert annotators label over 12.6K entries from a scholarly index of named entities, linked to corresponding mentions in the \textit{Mahānāma} corpus, producing fine-grained annotations for 108,335 entity mentions across 73,632 verses, along with a 5,000-verse expert-verified test set sampled to stress rare mentions. We present the first systematic benchmarking of generative NER against traditional architectures for Sanskrit, finding that fine-tuned generative models perform comparably to task-specific systems. However, all systems show a sharp decline from coarse to fine granularity and struggle with out-of-entity mentions unseen during training. The limitation is not due to data scarcity alone, as fine-tuned models recall unseen entities far worse than seen ones and tend to default to the majority sense under lexical ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Padārtha，首个基于本体论的梵语细粒度命名实体识别（NER）基准，其标签体系源于古典印度本体论 Nyāya-Vaiśesika，应用于《摩诃婆罗多》史诗（Mahānāma 语料），包含 108,335 个实体提及的细粒度标注与 5,000 颂的专家验证测试集，并首次系统对比了生成式 NER 与梵语传统架构。
AI.motivation: 标注模式并非中立：面向现代新闻文本开发的标签集强加了源文化定义，不适用于古典文献。因此需要一种植根于文本自身传统（古典梵语本体论）的标注模式，以准确描述梵语史诗中的命名实体。
AI.method: 从 Nyāya-Vaiśesika 本体论推导出 18 个细粒度类别，组织在 10 个本体节点下，并映射到 5 个标准粗粒度标签以保证与其他基准的互操作性。专家标注者基于学术命名实体索引，在 Mahānāma 语料中标注 12.6K 条目，生成 73,632 颂中 108,335 个实体提及的细粒度标注，并构建一个侧重稀有提及抽样的 5,000 颂专家验证测试集。随后系统对比了微调生成式模型与任务特定传统架构。
AI.result: 微调的生成式模型表现与任务特定系统相当；但从粗粒度到细粒度所有系统性能均大幅下降，且对训练中未见的实体提及表现困难；问题并非仅由数据稀缺导致：微调模型对未见实体的召回远低于已见实体，并在词汇歧义下倾向于默认多数义项。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 NER 在梵语上可媲美传统架构，但细粒度识别与稀有/未见实体的泛化仍是核心瓶颈，需要超越单纯扩大数据的方法来解决。

title: MedCache: Efficient and Temporally Valid Memory for Longitudinal Clinical Agents
summary: Longitudinal clinical agents must maintain an evolving patient state from evidence distributed across visits, time points, and specialties. However, how agent memory should be designed for this setting remains unclear. We introduce a benchmark of multi-visit, multi-specialty patient records that evaluates long-context evidence retrieval, cross-time evidence aggregation, and cross-specialty clinical reasoning. Using this benchmark, we systematically study four memory design choices: curation, organization, retrieval, and memory-augmented reasoning. We find that temporal validity is more important than simply retaining more history; specialty-factorized memory reduces context but can hide shared evidence; and multiple agents help when specialists must reason together, not merely when evidence comes from multiple memories. Guided by these findings, we propose \textit{MedCache}, a hybrid framework that constructs temporally valid patient memory, organizes evidence into overlapping specialty views, routes each query to relevant memories, and adaptively invokes one or multiple specialists. Experiments show that MedCache improves reasoning accuracy and memory efficiency over strong single-agent and multi-agent baselines, while generalizing across model backbones and external datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纵向临床智能体的记忆设计问题，提出了包含多诊次、多科室患者记录的基准评测集，系统考察了记忆的筛选、组织、检索和记忆增强推理四种设计选择，发现时间有效性比单纯保留更多历史更重要、科室因子化记忆可减少上下文但可能隐藏共享证据、多智能体在专家共同推理时才真正有用。基于这些发现提出MedCache混合框架，通过构建时间有效的患者记忆、组织重叠的科室视图、路由查询并自适应调用单个或多个专家，在推理准确率和记忆效率上超越强基线，并在多模型和多数据集上展现泛化性。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床智能体需要在跨诊次、跨时间点、跨专科的分散证据中持续维护不断演化的患者状态，但智能体记忆应如何设计这一基本问题尚不清楚。现有方法缺乏针对多诊次多科室场景的系统性研究，作者旨在通过统一的基准和消融实验厘清记忆设计各环节的作用与权衡。
AI.method: 首先构建多诊次、多专科患者记录基准，用于评测长上下文证据检索、跨时间证据聚合和跨专科临床推理；其次系统研究四种记忆设计选择：curation（筛选）、organization（组织）、retrieval（检索）、memory-augmented reasoning（记忆增强推理）；最后据此提出MedCache混合框架：构建时间有效的患者记忆、将证据组织为重叠的科室视图、将查询路由到相关记忆、并自适应地调用一个或多个专家智能体进行推理。
AI.result: 实验表明MedCache在推理准确率和记忆效率上优于强单智能体与多智能体基线，并且能够跨不同模型骨干和外部数据集泛化。研究还揭示了关键规律：时间有效性（temporal validity）比保留更多历史更重要；科室因子化记忆虽降低上下文长度但可能隐藏共享证据；多智能体的收益源于专家协同推理，而非仅因证据分散在多个记忆中。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为纵向临床智能体的记忆设计应以时间有效性为核心，而非盲目追求历史长度；记忆组织需在上下文压缩与共享证据可见性之间权衡；多智能体协作应服务于"专家共同推理"的任务需求。MedCache验证了混合架构的有效性，为后续临床智能体记忆系统研究提供了基准与方法参考。

title: Disentangling Representation using Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Medical Sound Diagnosis
comment: 4 figures, 2 tables, code is available at: https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr
summary: Deep learning has a powerful capability of feature extraction. However, the lack of fairness and interpretability in deep neural networks poses limitations to their adoption in the medical domain. This paper proposes a disentangled representation learning (DisenRL) framework, named the Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Disentangled Representation (AGEDR), which incorporates Attribute Mapping Embedding (AME) modules designed to map attributes into vectors and align them with a subset of the latent vectors in a Variational AutoEncoder (VAE). This part of the latent vector will be disentangled from the remaining latent vectors by minimizing mutual information. A classifier is then trained using the mean parameters of the latent vectors from the VAE. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AGEDR outperforms both conventional classification models and existing disentangled representation learning methods. The ablation experiments also indicate the disentangling capability and fairness of AGEDR. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于属性的解耦表征学习框架 AGEDR，通过属性映射嵌入（AME）模块将属性映射为向量并与 VAE 潜变量的子集对齐，再通过最小化互信息实现潜变量解耦，最后利用潜变量均值参数训练分类器，从而在保持深度学习特征提取能力的同时提升模型的公平性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在特征提取方面能力强大，但其缺乏公平性和可解释性，限制了其在医学领域的应用。因此需要一种既能保留强大特征提取能力，又能实现公平且可解释的深度表征学习方法。
AI.method: 提出 AGEDR 框架，包含属性映射嵌入（AME）模块，将属性映射为向量并与 VAE 中部分潜变量对齐；通过最小化互信息使这部分潜变量与其余潜变量解耦；随后使用 VAE 潜变量的均值参数训练分类器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 AGEDR 在性能上优于传统分类模型及现有解耦表征学习方法；消融实验进一步验证了其解耦能力和公平性。源代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: AGEDR 通过属性嵌入与互信息最小化实现了潜变量的解耦，在医学领域中兼顾了分类性能、公平性与可解释性，为深度模型在医学场景下的可信应用提供了有效方案。

title: Elastic Triangle Splatting
summary: While neural rendering methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting achieve remarkable visual fidelity, traditional polygonal meshes remain the backbone of established graphics pipelines. Triangle splatting bridges this gap by optimizing triangle primitives as differentiable splats, producing representations that are closer to mesh-based workflows. Central to these methods is the kernel function that softens triangle boundaries to propagate gradients to vertex positions. Existing triangle splatting methods make inconsistent choices of kernel functions, and analysis of these kernels' optimization behavior has been limited to unstructured triangle soups for novel-view synthesis. In this work, we consider triangle splatting as a generic tool for photometric optimization, comparing kernel properties through two complementary tasks: mesh optimization for shape reconstruction and triangle soup optimization for novel-view synthesis. Along with the analysis, we introduce an elastic kernel function that features bilateral gradient support across the boundary and an adaptive boundary value, which are shown to be essential for robust optimization. Under isolated comparison, our elastic kernel outperforms existing kernels on shape reconstruction and in the majority of novel-view synthesis benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of kernel design in the effectiveness and versatility of triangle splatting.

AI.tldr: 本文将三角形光栅化（Triangle Splatting）视为通用的光度优化工具，系统比较了现有核函数在网格优化（形状重建）与三角形汤优化（新视角合成）两类任务上的表现，并提出一种具有双边梯度支撑和自适应边界值的弹性核函数，其在多数基准上优于现有核函数。
AI.motivation: 三角形光栅化通过将三角形基元作为可微光斑进行优化，弥合了神经渲染（如3D高斯泼溅）与传统多边形网格工作流之间的差距。核函数是软化三角形边界、向顶点位置传播梯度的核心组件，但现有方法对核函数的选择不一致，且对其优化行为的分析仅限于非结构化三角形汤的新视角合成任务，缺乏通用性与系统性比较。
AI.method: 作者将三角形光栅化作为通用的光度优化工具，通过两个互补任务（用于形状重建的网格优化和用于新视角合成的三角形汤优化）来对比核函数特性；同时提出一种弹性核函数，其特点是跨边界的双边梯度支撑与自适应边界值，以保证优化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在隔离对比下，弹性核函数在形状重建任务上优于现有核函数，并在大多数新视角合成基准上取得更优表现，验证了核函数设计对三角形光栅化有效性与通用性的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 核函数设计对于三角形光栅化的鲁棒优化至关重要，所提出的弹性核函数具备更强的任务通用性，能够同时改善网格优化与三角形汤优化性能，为将可微三角形表示整合进传统网格管线提供了更有效的方案。

title: StageWell: A Process-Aligned Chinese Corpus for Positive-Psychology Support Dialogue
summary: Positive psychology dialogue aims to support emotional distress and positive resource building, requiring models to produce not only empathetic replies but also coherent progression through a multi-turn support process. Existing resources often reduce supervision to turn-level strategies or holistic preference labels, leaving process position, support function, and local repair targets implicit. We introduce StageWell, a process-aligned Chinese corpus for positive psychology dialogue, together with HQS, a structured protocol for data construction and evaluation. StageWell organizes support into a six-stage support process and uses a multi-agent whole-dialogue rewriting workflow to construct 12,445 SFT instances, 1,849 DPO preference pairs, and a GroundTruth subset of 120 expert-revised dialogues and 977 QA pairs. Guided by HQS, DPO pairs are built as process-localized repairs: flawed model outputs are used as rejected responses, and targeted rewrites under the same context and stage constraint are used as chosen responses. Across four 9B-14B open-source LLMs, this supervision yields robust gains in process control, response quality, and safety. Averaged across models, BERTScore improves by 0.037, Q-Overall increases by 1.32 points, S-exact increases by 0.236, and the H-critical rate decreases by 0.167. These results highlight the value of modeling supportive dialogue as a structured multi-turn support process rather than as single-turn response generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StageWell，一个面向积极心理学对话的流程对齐中文语料库，并配套HQS结构化数据构建与评估协议。StageWell将支持过程组织为六阶段流程，通过多智能体整篇对话重写工作流构建了12,445条SFT实例、1,849对DPO偏好对以及包含120条专家修订对话和977对QA对的GroundTruth子集。DPO对采用“流程局部化修复”方式构造（缺陷输出作为拒绝样本，同上下文与阶段约束下的定向改写作为选择样本）。在四个9B-14B开源大模型上的实验显示，该监督方式在流程控制、回复质量和安全性上均取得稳健提升，证明了将支持性对话建模为结构化多轮支持过程而非单轮回复生成的价值。
AI.motivation: 积极心理学对话需要模型在给出共情回复的同时，在多轮支持过程中保持连贯的进程推进。然而现有资源往往将监督信号简化为单轮层面的策略标签或整体偏好标注，导致过程位置（support process position）、支持功能（support function）和局部修复目标（local repair targets）等信息是隐式的，缺乏对多轮支持过程的结构化建模。
AI.method: 引入StageWell语料库与HQS结构化协议。StageWell将支持对话组织为六阶段支持过程，并采用多智能体整篇对话重写工作流来构建数据，包括12,445条SFT实例、1,849对DPO偏好对，以及120条专家修订对话和977个QA对的GroundTruth子集。在HQS指导下，DPO对按“流程局部化修复”构造：以有缺陷的模型输出作为拒绝样本，在相同上下文和阶段约束下进行定向重写作为选择样本。
AI.result: 在四个9B-14B开源大模型上，该方法在流程控制、回复质量和安全性方面均取得稳健提升。按模型平均：BERTScore提升0.037，Q-Overall提升1.32分，S-exact提升0.236，H-critical率下降0.167。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果凸显了将支持性对话建模为结构化多轮支持过程而非单轮回复生成的价值。

title: BEACON: Behavioral and Semantic Enrichment of AlphaEarth Embeddings through Tri-Modal Contrastive Learning
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, Accepted by ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026
summary: Geospatial foundation models such as the AlphaEarth Foundation produce compact and globally consistent representations of the Earth's surface that transfer effectively to a wide range of downstream tasks. However, because these models are trained primarily on Earth-observation imagery, their embeddings mainly capture physical and spectral characteristics while encoding human activity and urban function only weakly. To address this limitation, we propose BEACON, a tri-modal contrastive learning framework that aligns three complementary views of urban space: physical representations from AE embeddings, semantic representations from point-of-interest (POI) text, and human behavioral representations from hourly POI visitation, while keeping the deployed representation image-only. Using the Houston Metropolitan Area as a case study area, we evaluated the performance of the BEACON framework on nine downstream tasks, including seven regression and two classification tasks against six baselines (raw coordinates, Space2Vec, SatCLIP, TESSERA, Clay and AlphaEarth), using frozen linear and MLP probes over five seeds. Under a linear probe, BEACON improves relative R^2 over AlphaEarth by up to 43% for obesity prevalence, 34% for poor mental health, and 22% for median household income, while remaining competitive in the prediction of physical and environmental variables. These findings highlight the value of augmenting geospatial foundation models with semantic and behavioral signals, extending their applicability from physical Earth observation to human-centered urban analytics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEACON，一种三模态对比学习框架，将地理空间基础模型（如AlphaEarth）的物理表征、POI文本语义表征和逐小时POI访问的人类行为表征对齐，同时保持部署时仅使用图像嵌入，从而在休斯顿大都会区的九个下游任务上显著提升人类中心城市分析能力（如肥胖率、心理健康、收入预测）。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型（如AlphaEarth）主要基于地球观测影像训练，其嵌入主要捕获物理和光谱特征，而对人类活动和城市功能的编码较弱，限制了其在人类中心城市分析中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出BEACON框架，这是一种三模态对比学习框架，对齐三种互补的城市空间视角：来自AE嵌入的物理表征、来自POI文本的语义表征、来自逐小时POI访问的人类行为表征，且保持部署表征仅为图像模态。在休斯顿大都会区案例上，使用冻结线性探针和MLP探针（五个种子）评估九个下游任务，与六种基线（raw coordinates, Space2Vec, SatCLIP, TESSERA, Clay, AlphaEarth）对比。
AI.result: 在线性探针下，BEACON在肥胖率（R^2相对提升43%）、不良心理健康（34%）和家庭收入中位数（22%）预测上优于AlphaEarth，同时在物理和环境变量预测上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，为地理空间基础模型补充语义和行为信号极具价值，可将应用范围从物理地球观测扩展到以人为中心的城市分析。

title: Facts Without Rules: Boundary Metadata Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often coordinate by compressing an upstream interaction into a handoff artifact that downstream agents treat as shared state. We show that this handoff step is a structural source of privacy leakage: summaries preferentially preserve operational facts while weakening the boundary metadata that governs how those facts may be used---a failure mode we call \emph{summary collapse}. On a controlled multi-agent coordination testbed we measure marker survival with a human-validated judge ($κ= 0.74$), where $σ_b = 1$ means every boundary marker survives verbatim and $σ_b = 0$ means all are lost. Boundary-marker and operational-fact survival are nearly uncorrelated at the handoff level on both GPT-5-mini and DeepSeek-R1-32B (Pearson $r$ near zero): uncompressed free-text handoffs preserve boundaries at $σ_b \approx 0.80$, whereas a $25$-word budget drops $σ_b$ to ${\approx}0.57$ while operational-fact survival stays near ceiling. Controlled downstream tests reveal that protection depends on \emph{boundary explicitness}: vague languages leak in $73\%$ of GPT and $50\%$ of DeepSeek cases, while explicit constraints reduce leakage to under $15\%$ across all three tested models. A no-handoff single-agent control further shows the failure is not reducible to multi-agent topology as direct full-marker access still leaks more often than the operationalized handoff. Prompt-only mitigation and exact-string redaction only partially address the problem, while a gold-derived audience allowlist nearly eliminates leakage across models, showing that correctly identifying audience boundaries is the key factor.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多智能体 LLM 系统中"交接（handoff）"环节存在结构性隐私泄露问题：上游交互被压缩为下游智能体共享状态的交接工件时，摘要倾向于保留操作事实却削弱了约束这些事实使用方式的边界元数据，作者将这一失效模式称为"摘要坍缩（summary collapse）"。实验表明边界标记与操作事实的存活率几乎不相关，且泄露风险取决于边界信息的显式程度，而基于黄金标准的受众白名单能近乎消除泄露。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统常通过将上游交互压缩成手写交接工件（handoff artifact）来协调协作，下游智能体将其视为共享状态。作者指出这一交接步骤是隐私泄露的结构性来源：摘要会优先保留操作事实，同时弱化约束事实使用方式的边界元数据，造成"摘要坍缩"这一此前未被系统刻画的失效模式。
AI.method: 作者在受控的多智能体协调测试床上开展工作：使用经人工验证的评判器（κ=0.74）测量边界标记存活率 σ_b（1 表示所有边界标记逐字存活，0 表示全部丢失）；对比无压缩自由文本交接与 25 词摘要预算两种条件下的标记存活；在 GPT-5-mini 和 DeepSeek-R1-32B 上计算边界标记与操作事实存活率的相关性；并进行下游受控测试，比较模糊语言与显式约束、无交接单智能体对照、仅提示词缓解、精确字符串编辑以及基于黄金标准的受众白名单等多种设置。
AI.result: 交接层面边界标记与操作事实的存活率近似零相关（Pearson r 接近 0）：无压缩自由文本交接保持边界存活率约 0.80，而 25 词预算使 σ_b 降至约 0.57，操作事实存活率仍接近天花板。下游测试显示保护取决于边界显式性：模糊语言在 GPT 的 73% 和 DeepSeek 的 50% 案例中泄露，显式约束将泄露降至三种模型均低于 15%。无交接单智能体对照表明该失效不能仅归因于多智能体拓扑。仅提示词缓解与精确字符串编辑只能部分解决问题，而基于黄金标准的受众白名单在多种模型上几乎消除了泄露。
AI.conclusion: 准确识别受众边界是解决交接隐私泄露的关键因素：交接压缩会在机制上破坏边界元数据而保留操作事实，因此需要通过结构性手段（如显式约束或受众白名单）而非仅靠提示或字符串级过滤来保障多智能体系统中的隐私边界。

title: NFAD: Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
summary: Recent advances in anomaly detection (AD) for industrial inspection have pushed performance on standard benchmarks toward saturation. However, strong benchmark performance does not necessarily translate to real-world deployment, as these benchmarks are primarily collected under controlled acquisition conditions. Changes in illumination, background, viewpoint, and other environmental factors can shift normal samples away from the learned normal distribution and cause false anomaly responses. We address AD under such distribution shifts by explicitly modeling nuisance variation from changing imaging conditions in feature space. Without anomaly labels or target-domain data, our Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD) framework estimates a nuisance subspace from matched feature displacements induced by content-preserving perturbations and suppresses its contribution to anomaly residuals at inference. The same subspace supports two complementary branches: full projection for image-level detection and selective suppression for pixel-level localization, preserving evidence of localized defects. On AeBAD-S, a benchmark specifically designed for AD under acquisition shifts, NFAD achieves 91.0\% image-level AUROC, establishing a new state of the art. Notably, this robustness does not come at the expense of conventional AD performance: NFAD remains competitive on standard benchmarks that do not explicitly evaluate distribution shift, including VisA, Real-IAD, and MVTec AD. These results show that explicitly suppressing such nuisance variation improves AD under distribution shift while preserving strong performance in standard settings.

AI.tldr: 针对工业质检中异常检测（AD）在采集条件变化（光照、背景、视角等）下分布偏移导致的误报问题，本文提出Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection（NFAD）框架，在特征空间中显式建模干扰变化并估计干扰子空间，通过全投影与选择性抑制两个互补分支分别完成图像级检测与像素级定位，在AeBAD-S上达到91.0%的图像级AUROC并取得SOTA，同时在VisA、Real-IAD、MVTec AD等标准基准上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有工业质检异常检测基准性能已趋于饱和，但受控采集条件下获得的强基准表现难以直接迁移到真实部署场景。光照、背景、视角等环境因素会造成分布偏移，使正常样本偏离已学习的正常分布，从而引发虚假异常响应；且该场景下缺少异常标签与目标域数据，需要不需要目标域样本即可抑制干扰的方法。
AI.method: NFAD框架在特征空间中显式建模成像条件变化带来的干扰（nuisance）变化，具体流程为：1) 通过内容保持扰动（content-preserving perturbations）构造匹配的特征位移，据此估计干扰子空间；2) 在推理时抑制该子空间对异常残差的贡献；3) 同一干扰子空间支撑两个互补分支——全投影用于图像级检测，选择性抑制用于像素级定位，以保留局部缺陷证据。该方法无需异常标签或目标域数据。
AI.result: 在专门针对采集偏移设计的AeBAD-S基准上，NFAD取得91.0%的图像级AUROC，刷新SOTA；在未显式评估分布偏移的标准基准（VisA、Real-IAD、MVTec AD）上仍保持竞争力，说明鲁棒性提升不以牺牲常规AD性能为代价。
AI.conclusion: 显式抑制干扰变化能够在采集分布偏移下显著提升异常检测的鲁棒性，同时保持标准设置下的强性能，表明干扰建模是弥合基准性能与真实部署差距的有效途径。

title: When to Adapt: Conditional Memory Adapters for Retention-Preserving Domain Specialization
summary: Large language models deployed in specialized domains must improve in-domain performance without sacrificing general capabilities. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are typically always on: their learned perturbations are applied to every input, which can degrade out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We propose Engram Adapter, a framework that repurposes pretraining-time conditional memory as a post-hoc adapter for frozen LLMs. It uses multi-channel matching over local n-gram patterns with explicit occupancy tracking as a lightweight selectivity prior, making residual injection more likely on in-domain inputs while a learned scalar gate suppresses incoherent OOD retrievals. We evaluate on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with AG-News and MedMCQA as adaptation tasks and OOD benchmarks spanning reasoning, translation, code generation, and legal reasoning. Engram Adapter improves in-domain accuracy while preserving 99.4%--100.1% of average OOD performance; on LegalBench it slightly exceeds the frozen base model on average, whereas comparable always-on baselines degrade sharply. Mechanistic analyses show that although OOD activations are non-zero, gate and projection attenuation reduce residuals to approximately 0.08% of hidden-state norm, yielding small KL drift and negligible accuracy change. These results suggest conditional activation is a promising route toward modular, retention-preserving domain specialization over frozen backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出 Engram Adapter 框架，将预训练时的条件记忆重用作冻结大语言模型的后置适配器，通过基于局部 n-gram 模式的多通道匹配与显式占用追踪实现轻量选择性先验，使残差注入偏向领域内输入，并由学习到的标量门控抑制不连贯的领域外检索，从而在提升领域内精度的同时近乎完全保持领域外性能。
AI.motivation: 部署在专业领域的大语言模型需要在提升领域内性能的同时不牺牲通用能力；现有的参数高效微调方法通常是"始终开启"的，其学习到的扰动被施加到每个输入上，导致领域外（OOD）性能下降。
AI.method: 提出 Engram Adapter：将预训练阶段的条件记忆重用作冻结 LLM 的后置适配器；以局部 n-gram 模式上的多通道匹配并结合显式占用追踪作为轻量选择性先验，使残差注入更可能发生在领域内输入上；同时引入学习到的标量门控来抑制不连贯的 OOD 检索结果。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 上，以 AG-News 和 MedMCQA 作为适配任务、以涵盖推理/翻译/代码生成/法律推理的基准评测 OOD 表现：领域内精度提升，同时保持平均 OOD 性能的 99.4%–100.1%；在 LegalBench 上平均略超冻结基座模型，而始终开启的基线方法显著退化。机理分析显示，尽管 OOD 激活非零，门控与投影衰减使残差降至隐藏状态范数约 0.08%，带来极小的 KL 漂移和可忽略的精度变化。
AI.conclusion: 条件激活是实现基于冻结基座模型的模块化、保持原有能力（retention-preserving）的领域专化的有前景路径。

title: Learning to Follow In-Context Watermark Instructions via Self-Distillation
summary: In-context watermarking (ICW) prepends an instruction to a query asking the model to embed a statistically detectable signal in its response. It thus equips LLMs with a watermarking interface that third parties can invoke without access to model internals. Its reliability hinges on the LLM following the instruction without degrading answer quality, yet how well current LLMs do so has not been measured. We introduce $\mathsf{ICWBench}$, a benchmark of three verifiable ICW instruction families, each scored on both detectability and answer quality. Evaluating 14 frontier proprietary and open-source LLMs, we find that none of the evaluated LLMs achieves both objectives across all three families. To address this, we propose a self-contained two-stage training method, requiring no distillation from a stronger model, no manual annotation, and no pre-existing ICW IF ability. The first stage, self-distillation with logits perturbation (SDLP), uses the same base LLM as both teacher and student: an instruction-equivalent decoding-time logits perturbation makes the teacher follow the ICW instruction, and the student is trained to match the teacher's output distribution.
