The second stage applies reinforcement learning with the automatic verifier as the reward. Applied to Qwen3-14B and GPT-OSS-20B, our method raises average TPR@$1\%$FPR across three ICW instructions from $0.100$ to $0.974$ and from $0.337$ to $0.968$, respectively, while maintaining high response quality under both perplexity evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ICWBench，一个用于评测上下文水印（ICW）的基准，包含三个可验证的 ICW 指令族，从可检测性与回答质量两个维度对 14 个前沿 LLM 进行评测，发现现有模型无法同时满足两个目标；进而提出一种无需强模型蒸馏、无需人工标注的两阶段训练方法（SDLP + RL），将 Qwen3-14B 与 GPT-OSS-20B 的平均 TPR@1%FPR 分别从 0.100 提升至 0.974、从 0.337 提升至 0.968，同时保持较高的回答质量。
AI.motivation: 上下文水印通过在查询前附加指令让模型在回答中嵌入可统计检测的信号，从而为 LLM 提供无需访问模型内部即可由第三方调用的水印接口。其可靠性取决于 LLM 能否在遵循指令的同时不降低回答质量，但现有主流 LLM 在这方面的表现尚未被系统测量；作者基于评测发现模型难以同时兼顾水印可检测性与回答质量，因此需要一种高效的训练方法加以改进。
AI.method: 作者提出 ICWBench 基准（涵盖三个可验证的 ICW 指令族，按可检测性和回答质量打分），并设计了一种自包含的两阶段训练方法：第一阶段为带 logits 扰动的自蒸馏（SDLP），使用同一基础 LLM 同时作为教师和学生，通过指令等价的解码期 logits 扰动使教师遵循 ICW 指令，再训练学生去匹配教师输出分布；第二阶段以自动验证器作为奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: 在 ICWBench 上评测 14 个前沿闭源与开源 LLM，发现没有一个模型能在全部三个指令族上同时实现可检测性与回答质量两个目标。应用所提方法后，Qwen3-14B 上三个 ICW 指令的平均 TPR@1%FPR 从 0.100 提升到 0.974，GPT-OSS-20B 上从 0.337 提升到 0.968，且在困惑度评测与 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估下均保持较高的回答质量。
AI.conclusion: 现有 LLM 的上下文水印能力在可检测性与回答质量的平衡上仍存在明显不足，而所提出的两阶段训练方法（自蒸馏 + 强化学习）能在不依赖更强模型、人工标注或既有 ICW 能力的前提下，显著提升模型遵循 ICW 指令的能力并维持回答质量，为提升第三方可控的 LLM 水印可靠性提供了有效路径。

title: GramLoop: Training-Free Gram-Gated Replay for Robust Dense Prediction
summary: We aim to improve frozen DINOv3 dense-prediction models under distribution shift by adding inference computation inside the visual backbone, without changing model weights, task adapters, or prediction heads. The challenge is that repeated transformer-block computation must refine dense features without disrupting the pairwise patch relations that DINOv3 uses to preserve spatial structure. We introduce GramLoop, a training-free framework that replays a short transformer window and controls each replay through final-layer cosine-Gram consistency. Each proposal is propagated through the frozen suffix, measured against the standard DINOv3 trajectory, and accepted through a patchwise gate at the replay-window endpoint. Across object detection and semantic segmentation under corruptions, perturbations, and natural shifts, GramLoop improves all five shifted benchmarks over the paired DINOv3 baseline. On COCO-O, it improves mAP by +0.252 and Effective Robustness by +0.250, while preserving clean ADE20K performance. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GramLoop，一种无需训练、在推理时向冻结的 DINOv3 骨干网络注入计算以提升分布偏移下密集预测鲁棒性的框架，通过在视觉骨干内部重放短 Transformer 窗口，并利用最终层的余弦-Gram 一致性门控每个重放提议，在不修改权重、任务适配器或预测头的情况下刷新密集特征。
AI.motivation: 冻结的 DINOv3 密集预测模型在分布偏移（如损坏、扰动和自然偏移）下性能下降；现有方法通常需要修改权重或任务头，而直接在推理时为视觉骨干增加计算面临挑战：重复的 Transformer 块计算必须在细化密集特征的同时，不破坏 DINOv3 用来保持空间结构的成对 patch 关系。
AI.method: GramLoop 是训练自由的框架：在视觉骨干内重放一个短 Transformer 窗口；每个候选（proposal）先经冻结的后缀网络传播，再与标准 DINOv3 轨迹进行最终层余弦-Gram 一致性度量，并在重放窗口端点通过 patchwise 门控接受或拒绝，从而确保重放迭代不偏离原始空间结构。
AI.result: 在目标检测与语义分割的损坏、扰动和自然偏移基准上，GramLoop 在所有五个偏移基准上均优于配对的 DINOv3 基线；在 COCO-O 上 mAP 提升 +0.252，有效鲁棒性提升 +0.250，同时保持干净的 ADE20K 性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: 在推理时为冻结骨干增加受 Gram 一致性约束的内部重放计算，是一种无需训练且有效的分布偏移鲁棒性提升手段；该方法在多种偏移类型与任务上带来一致增益且不损失干净性能，未来将开源代码。

title: Arabic Safety Alignment as Selective Refusal: An Empirical Study of SFT, DPO, and Guard Calibration
comment: The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference(ArabicNLP 2026)
summary: Arabic large language models must refuse harmful prompts without over-refusing benign or sensitive prompts, yet a single refusal rate hides this trade-off. We evaluate it using benign refusal B and harmful-prompt refusal H, where H measures refusal rather than harmful compliance. Across five Arabic-capable models and 130 runs on the full human-written AraSafe set, refusal-only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) collapses toward blanket refusal, whereas selected mixed-SFT configurations reach H = 90% to 93% at B = 14% to 23%; four selected configurations exceed the H = 90% target in all three runs, while Fanar does so in two of three. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and inference guards change B and H differently across models rather than acting as uniform upgrades. In a blinded 300-response audit, annotator binary-refusal agreement is 89.0% (kappa = 0.78); Qwen3Guard and Aya Expanse 32B reach 88.7% and 91.0% accuracy, respectively, with no conclusive paired difference. Selected SFT raises H on Arabizi for all five models, but none reaches 90%, showing only partial transfer from Modern Standard Arabic. Overall, the results support model-specific operating-point selection: set a deployment target and retain only interventions that improve it.

AI.tldr: 针对阿拉伯语大语言模型的“安全-可用性”权衡问题，提出用两个指标（良性提示拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H）分别衡量过度拒绝与有害拒绝，并在5个阿拉伯语模型、130次运行和完整人工编写的AraSafe数据集上评估了多种干预手段。结果表明纯拒绝SFT会退化为“一刀切”拒绝，而精选的混合SFT可在B=14%-23%下达到H=90%-93%；DPO和推理护栏并非普适改进；阿拉伯语方言化拼写（Arabizi）只能部分迁移。最终主张按部署目标进行模型特定的操作点选择。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语大语言模型需要拒绝有害提示，同时不能过度拒绝良性或敏感提示，但单一的拒绝率指标掩盖了这一权衡。现有评估无法区分“正确拒绝有害内容”与“错误拒绝良性内容”，因此需要更细致的双指标评估框架来指导安全干预方法的选择。
AI.method: 提出双指标评估框架：良性提示拒绝率B和有害提示拒绝率H（H衡量拒绝而非有害服从）。在5个支持阿拉伯语的模型上进行130次运行，采用完整人工编写的AraSafe数据集；对比纯拒绝SFT、混合SFT、DPO和推理护栏等干预策略；并开展300条响应的盲审，评估标注者一致性与第三方护栏（Qwen3Guard、Aya Expanse 32B）的判定精度，同时检验从现代标准阿拉伯语到Arabizi的迁移效果。
AI.result: 纯拒绝SFT趋向于“一刀切”拒绝；精选混合SFT配置在B=14%-23%时达到H=90%-93%；4个精选配置在3次运行中全部超过H=90%目标，Fanar在3次中达标2次。DPO与推理护栏对不同模型的B和H影响各异，并非统一升级。盲审中标注者二元拒绝判定一致性为89.0%（kappa=0.78）；Qwen3Guard与Aya Expanse 32B的准确率分别达88.7%和91.0%，但无统计显著的成对差异。精选SFT使全部5个模型在Arabizi上的H提升，但均未达到90%，表明仅从MSA部分迁移。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持“模型特定操作点选择”这一结论：应先设定部署目标（目标H和可接受的B），再仅保留能够改进该操作点的干预措施，而不是追求某种通用、普适的安全微调或护栏方案。

title: Asynchronous Cooperative Online Learning for Multi-Robot Control under Computational Delays
summary: Ensuring the safe operation of multi-agent systems (MASs) under uncertain environments is crucial for cooperative robotic, where external disturbances and inaccurate dynamic models can significantly compromise performance and reliability. To address this challenge, calibrated machine learning models, particularly Gaussian process (GP) regression, are extensively employed due to their interpretable performance quantification. As the interconnected communication of MASs facilitates cooperative learning, agents are able to enhance learning performance by exchanging local GP inferences with their neighbors and aggregating the received information via distributed GP strategies. However, variations in computational power and prediction tasks among agents inevitably lead to heterogeneous computational delays and differences in query points, which are often overlooked in existing aggregation methods. To overcome these limitations, this work proposes an asynchronous cooperative learning strategy that explicitly accounts for prediction accuracy, query point variations and delay effects. Additionally, a distributed control law based on an adjoint MAS is developed to ensure the desired control performance. Simulations on unmanned surface vehicles validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, demonstrating substantial improvements in both learning and control performance compared to the state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向多智能体系统（MAS）的异步协同学习策略，通过考虑预测精度、查询点差异与异构计算延迟来改进分布式高斯过程（GP）聚合，并基于伴随 MAS 设计分布式控制律，在无人水面艇仿真中验证了学习和控制性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 不确定环境下多智能体系统的安全运行至关重要，外部扰动和不精确动力学模型会损害性能与可靠性。现有分布式 GP 聚合方法通常忽略智能体间因计算能力与预测任务差异导致的异构计算延迟和查询点差异，从而影响协同学习效果。
AI.method: 提出一种异步协同学习策略，显式建模预测精度、查询点变化和延迟效应；同时基于伴随多智能体系统（adjoint MAS）设计分布式控制律以保证期望的控制性能。
AI.result: 在无人水面艇仿真中验证了所提方法的有效性，相比最先进方法，学习性能和控制性能均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式处理异步延迟和查询点差异，所提出的异步协同学习与伴随 MAS 控制框架能够同时提升多智能体系统的学习准确性与控制性能，为异构智能体系统的可靠协同提供了有效方案。

title: EmoLASP: Emotion Recognition with Language Models and Answer Set Programming
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Emotion recognition in conversations is increasingly tackled with language models, but these models can be unstable and expensive to fine-tune or to prompt with long dialogue histories. We propose EmoLASP, a framework that combines a language model with declarative reasoning via Answer Set Programming (ASP) to predict VAD scores (Valence-Arousal-Dominance) in conversations. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset (IEMOCAP) across six open-source LLMs (3B-120B) and two PLMs (BERT, RoBERTa) show that EmoLASP improves prediction performance compared to using the language model alone, even when the LLMs/PLMs are given no dialogue history in their prompts or input vectors. The gains are largest for prompt-only LLMs, which EmoLASP uses without any fine-tuning. However, for fine-tuned PLMs, the reasoner adds little once dialogue history is available. EmoLASP's LLM pipeline demonstrates the potential advantages of using a reasoning approach to ensure emotion prediction consistency and to reduce both the cost of fine-tuning and the cost of prompting with long dialogue histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmoLASP 框架，将语言模型与基于 Answer Set Programming（ASP）的声明式推理结合，用于对话中的情感识别（预测 VAD 值：效价-唤醒-支配）。在 IEMOCAP 基准上对 6 个开源 LLM（3B-120B）和 2 个 PLM（BERT、RoBERTa）的实验表明，即使不提供对话历史，EmoLASP 也比单独使用语言模型表现更好；其中对仅用提示（prompt）且免微调的 LLM 提升最大，而对微调后的 PLM，若已有对话历史，推理器增益很小。该框架可降低微调成本与长对话历史的提示成本，并提升情感预测一致性。
AI.motivation: 基于语言模型的对话情感识别在微调和用长对话历史进行提示时存在不稳定、成本高的问题，需要一种更廉价且能保证一致性的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 EmoLASP 框架，将语言模型与基于 Answer Set Programming（ASP）的声明式推理相结合，用于预测对话中的 VAD（效价-唤醒-支配）评分；语言模型既可以用提示（prompt-only、免微调）也可以用输入向量（微调）的方式。
AI.result: 在 IEMOCAP 基准上、跨 6 个开源 LLM（3B-120B）和 2 个 PLM（BERT、RoBERTa）的实验中，EmoLASP 相比单独使用语言模型显著提升预测性能，即使提示或输入向量中不含对话历史；提升对仅用提示且免微调的 LLM 最大，而对微调后的 PLM，在已有对话历史时推理器增益很小。
AI.conclusion: EmoLASP 的 LLM 流水线展示了基于推理的方法在保证情感预测一致性、降低微调成本以及降低长对话历史提示成本方面的潜在优势。

title: Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (OV-AVSS) aims to perform pixel-level segmentation of sound-emitting objects from an open set of categories. The previous method relies on a class-agnostic foreground definition, which groups semantically diverse objects into a heterogeneous positive set, causing the model to learn unstable sounding patterns and produce unreliable proposals. To address this, we reformulate the objective to be category-specific and propose a novel Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning (AGCL) framework to transform the static, audio-agnostic visual-text priors into dynamic, audio-grounded cost representations. For intra-category soundingness discovery, we devise Audio-Modulated Cost Generation (AMCG) and Audio-Guided Temporal Aggregation (AGTA) modules to enable both frame-level sounding region highlighting and video-level temporal refinement with a low-intrusive audio injection mechanism. For inter-category distractor discrimination, we introduce a Synergistic Distractor Mining (SDM) strategy, which selectively penalizes acoustically and semantically confusing negative categories to learn more discriminative decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench-OV dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches, particularly on unseen categories. Code is available at https://github.com/spyflying/AGCL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于开放词汇音频-视觉语义分割（OV-AVSS）的新型框架AGCL（声学接地成本学习），通过将任务目标从类不可知的通用前景定义重构为类别特定的预测，借助音频调制成本生成（AMCG）、音频引导时间聚合（AGTA）和协同干扰物挖掘（SDM）策略，将静态的、与音频无关的视觉-文本先验转化为动态的、音频接地的成本表示，从而在AVSBench-OV数据集上显著超越现有最先进方法，尤其在未见类别上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 以往OV-AVSS方法依赖类不可知的通用前景定义，将语义多样的对象归入一个异质的正样本集合，导致模型学习到不稳定的发声模式并产生不可靠的区域提议。为克服这一缺陷，作者将目标重新表述为类别特定的，使模型能够区分"哪个对象在发声"的具体语义类别。
AI.method: 提出AGCL框架，将静态且与音频无关的视觉-文本先验转化为动态且音频接地的代价表示。具体包括：(1) 针对类别内发声性发现，设计了音频调制代价生成（AMCG）与音频引导时间聚合（AGTA）模块，通过低侵入式音频注入机制实现帧级发声区域高亮和视频级时间细化；(2) 针对类别间干扰物判别，提出协同干扰物挖掘（SDM）策略，选择性地惩罚声学上和语义上易混淆的负类类别，以学习更具判别性的决策边界。
AI.result: 在AVSBench-OV数据集上的大量实验表明，AGCL方法在性能上显著优于以往的最先进方法，特别是在未见类别上的表现尤为突出。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过将OV-AVSS目标由类不可知重构为类别特定，并利用音频接地的代价学习机制，AGCL有效解决了异质正样本集合导致的发声模式不稳定与提议不可靠问题，为开放词汇音频-视觉语义分割提供了更具判别力和泛化能力的新范式。

title: AlgoWorlds: Benchmarking Tool Use for Global Optimization in Algorithmic Worlds
summary: Tool-use benchmarks generally evaluate whether an agent completes a workflow using appropriate tools and valid arguments. However, feasibility alone is insufficient in real-world decision settings such as route planning and fleet dispatch. Individual choices interact through shared constraints and costs, so a feasible solution may still be substantially suboptimal. This raises a harder question: can an agent turn information gathered through tools into a globally optimal decision? We introduce AlgoWorlds, a benchmark that transforms formally specified combinatorial optimization problems into partially observed decision environments with verifiable global optima. Each environment contains a hidden instance observed only through task-specific information tools, after which the agent commits to one structured decision evaluated for feasibility and optimality. AlgoWorlds contains 240 environments covering ten combinatorial optimization families and four workload levels. Family-specific deterministic programs generate the instances, exact algorithms certify their optima and determine workload levels, and two structurally different tool interfaces present each underlying instance. We evaluate seven leading LLMs, including Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol. Achieving global optimality remains highly challenging: although leading models produce feasible decisions in most cases, the best-performing model reaches exact optimality in only 38.61% of cases. Even when agents collect sufficient information to reconstruct the hidden instance, most failures end in feasible but suboptimal decisions. The challenge therefore extends beyond information acquisition to information integration, global constraint reasoning, and decision verification. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/AlgoWorlds/, and the code is available at https://github.com/xzx34/AlgoWorlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AlgoWorlds 基准，将形式化组合优化问题转化为部分可观测的决策环境，用来评估 LLM 智能体是否能把通过工具收集的信息转化为全局最优的结构化决策。评估七种领先 LLM 后发现，达到全局最优仍极具挑战，最佳模型准确最优率仅 38.61%。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准只评估智能体能否用正确工具和合法参数完成工作流（即可行性），但在路线规划、车队调度等真实决策场景中，个体选择会通过共享约束与成本相互影响，可行解仍可能严重次优。因此需要回答更难的问题：智能体能否将工具获取的信息转化为全局最优决策。AlgoWorlds 正是为检验这一能力而设计。
AI.method: AlgoWorlds 将形式化定义（formal specification）的组合优化问题转化为带可验证全局最优解的部分可观测决策环境。每个环境包含一个隐藏实例，只能通过任务特定的信息工具观测，随后智能体提交一个结构化决策，并分别从可行性与最优性两方面评估。基准包含 240 个环境，覆盖十个组合优化族和四个工作负载级别；族专用的确定性程序生成实例，精确算法证明最优解并确定工作负载级别；同一底层实例通过两种结构不同的工具接口呈现。
AI.result: 在七个主流 LLM（包括 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.6 Sol）上的评估显示：多数情况下模型能给出可行决策，但最佳模型仅在 38.61% 的情况下达到精确最优。即使智能体收集了足以重建隐藏实例的信息，大部分失败仍以"可行但次优"收场，说明瓶颈不仅在于信息获取。
AI.conclusion: 系统性评估表明，工具使用基准的挑战已从信息获取扩展至信息整合、全局约束推理与决策验证。即便拥有足够信息，智能体仍难以完成从可行到最优的跃迁，凸显了工具型智能体在真实全局优化决策中的核心短板，也为后续研究指明了方向。

title: HoopMind: A Real-Time Neural Game-Tree System for Opponent-Aware Possession Planning
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, 2 algorithms. Submitted to the IEEE ICDM 2026 Teen Research Symposium. Code and live demo: https://github.com/sujo666/hoopmind
summary: School coaches prepare for opponents with game film and intuition. The analytics tools of professional teams stay out of reach. We ask how far public data can close this gap. Professional basketball is our case study, chosen for its data rather than the league. We fuse five public sources into one per-shot dataset of 4.23M shots over 21 seasons. The sources are shot locations, two play-by-play feeds, official matchup tracking, and player biometrics. Alignment across them is 99.5% to 100%. We also report two data pitfalls that are easy to miss. We then model a half-court possession as a sequential game. Shot values come from ShotNet, an embedding multilayer perceptron (MLP). On a held-out season it beats a zone-rate baseline and a logistic baseline, and its probabilities are well calibrated. A depth-limited expectimax search then solves the offensive decision tree, with branch-and-bound pruning to keep it real time. All training runs offline, so the online system stays light. A scouting planner and a playable simulator both run in a single browser page.

AI.tldr: 本文以职业篮球为案例，将五种公开数据源融合为包含423万次投篮（21个赛季）的数据集，将半场进攻建模为序贯博弈：用嵌入多层感知机（ShotNet）估计投篮价值，结合深度受限的带剪枝的expectimax搜索实时求解进攻决策树，最终以单个浏览器页面提供侦察规划器和可玩模拟器，让学校教练借助公开数据获得接近职业队的分析工具。
AI.motivation: 学校教练备战时依赖比赛录像和直觉，职业队的分析工具难以触及。作者想探究仅凭公开数据能在多大程度上缩小这一差距，为资源有限的教练群体提供数据驱动的战术支持。
AI.method: 选取数据丰富的职业篮球作为案例，融合五种公开来源（投篮位置、两组逐回合play-by-play数据、官方对位追踪、球员生物特征）建立每投篮数据集，来源对齐率达99.5%-100%，并指出两个易被忽视的数据陷阱。将半场进攻建模为序贯博弈：由嵌入MLP（ShotNet）估计投篮价值（在留出赛季上优于区域频率基线和逻辑基线，且概率校准良好）；再通过深度受限的expectimax搜索配合分支定界剪枝实时求解进攻决策树。所有训练离线完成，在线系统保持轻量。
AI.result: 系统成功构建了高质量的大规模公开数据管线，ShotNet在留出赛季上超越两种基线并具有良好的概率校准；带剪枝的expectimax搜索在保持实时性的同时求解进攻决策树；侦察规划器和可玩模拟器均能在单个浏览器页面内运行。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，公开数据足以组建接近俱乐部级别的分析能力：通过数据融合与博弈建模，可将职业级的投篮价值评估和进攻决策优化以轻量、可交互的形式交付给学校教练，显著缩小他们与职业队在数据分析上的差距。

title: Let Prompts Bridge Defense Knowledge: Transferable Graph Purification via Vulnerability-Aware GPL
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). 10 pages, 7 figures, and 4 tables. Shuomin Xue and Jingyuan Li contributed equally to this work
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone for representing complex relational dependencies in diverse multimedia tasks, particularly in cross-platform user interest modeling and cross-modal semantic alignment. In the real world, a practical defense against graph adversarial perturbations is needed. However, we observe that the prevailing adversarial purification methods are essentially domain-restricted defenses, which leads to the following shortcomings: (1) single-domain data provides insufficient structural and semantic diversity for learning robust purification criteria; (2) training of domain-specific defense strategies from scratch consumes substantial computational cost. To address the above limitations, we propose a transferable graph purification scheme, named ProGAP, to bridge adversarial defense knowledge via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning. Firstly, to capture universal adversarial patterns, a perturbation-capture edge detector is pretrained on data-rich graphs by jointly modeling topological and semantic information. Subsequently, to achieve more knowledge transfer w.r.t. robustness, vulnerability-aware prompts are designed that inject targeted purification guidance into biased nodes, during which the pretrained detector adapts to distribution shifts in downstream graphs without parameter-laborious updates. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our ProGAP achieves 1%-9% improvement, and reduces the time consumption by up to 2.2x. The code for ProGAP is available at https://github.com/Lieyoufffff/ProGAP.

AI.tldr: 提出了 ProGAP，一种基于漏洞感知图提示学习的可迁移图净化方案，通过预训练扰动捕获边检测器并注入漏洞感知提示，实现跨域对抗防御知识迁移，在提升 1%-9% 性能的同时将时间消耗降低最多 2.2 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗净化方法本质上是域限制的防御，存在两个缺陷：(1) 单一域数据提供的结构和语义多样性不足，难以学习鲁棒的净化准则；(2) 从零训练域特定防御策略消耗大量计算成本。因此迫切需要一种可迁移的图对抗防御方案。
AI.method: 提出可迁移图净化方案 ProGAP，基于漏洞感知图提示学习实现对抗防御知识迁移。首先在数据丰富的图上预训练一个扰动捕获边检测器，联合建模拓扑与语义信息以捕获通用对抗模式；随后设计漏洞感知提示，将针对性的净化引导注入偏置节点，使预训练检测器无需大量参数更新即可适应下游图的分布偏移。
AI.result: 与最先进基线相比，ProGAP 在性能上提升 1%-9%，并将时间消耗减少最多 2.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: ProGAP 通过跨域知识迁移有效解决了域限制防御在数据多样性和计算成本方面的局限，验证了漏洞感知图提示学习在可迁移图对抗防御中的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Dancing Stick Figures: An Introductory Dataset for Training Video Generation Models
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, code, reference models, and Colab notebook are linked from the paper
summary: Training a video-generation model from scratch is hard for reasons that precede model design. The feedback loop is long: a failure that appears only after a training run can make each attempted fix another run. The data are hard to reach: the corpora and recipes behind strong models are large, heterogeneous, and often unreleased. And scoring is blunt: open-ended generation has no single correct output, and an aggregate score does not by itself establish whether a sample succeeds or which property failed. Dancing Stick Figures is a synthetic video dataset built against these three obstacles. For iteration speed, its 64x64, 64-frame reference task is sized for practical repeated training on a single workstation GPU. For accessibility, the release is a 0.79-GB training tier of 4,020 video clips--1,340 six-second source motions, each rendered from three cameras by a deterministic dataset-generation harness--with checkpoints and a Colab workflow that reruns the reference training pipeline at reduced budget on a 16 GB Tesla T4. For scoring, every frame retains its generating state (ARDY cskel27 joint positions, camera, body parameters, and source motion) and per-pixel depth, surface normals, and part labels. These annotations support dataset-specific metrics for visible topology and part-wise motion; corruptions expose their sensitivities and blind spots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dancing Stick Figures，一个旨在克服视频生成模型从头训练三大障碍（反馈循环漫长、数据难以获取、评分粗糙）的合成视频数据集，包含 4020 个 64x64、64 帧的视频片段及完整状态标注（骨骼关节、相机、身体参数、深度、法线、部件标签），并配套提供检查点与 Colab 工作流，同时利用这些标注设计了数据集专属的可见拓扑与部件级运动评估指标。
AI.motivation: 从头训练视频生成模型在模型设计之前就面临重重困难：反馈循环长（训练完成后才显现的失败使每次修复都需重新运行）、数据难以获取（强模型背后的语料和配方规模大、异构且常未公开）、评分方式粗糙（开放生成没有唯一正确答案，聚合分数无法指明样本成败或具体哪项属性失败）。本文即针对这三重障碍构建数据集。
AI.method: 构建合成视频数据集 Dancing Stick Figures：参考任务为 64x64、64 帧，规模适配单块工作站 GPU 的重复训练；发布 0.79GB 训练集，含 4020 个视频片段（1340 个六秒源动作，每个由确定性数据生成管线从三个相机视角渲染），并附检查点和可在 16GB Tesla T4 上以缩减预算重跑参考训练流程的 Colab 工作流；每一帧均保留生成状态（ARDY cskel27 关节位置、相机、身体参数、源动作）及逐像素深度、表面法线和部件标签。
AI.result: 丰富的标注支持数据集专属的评估指标，即可见拓扑（visible topology）与部件级运动（part-wise motion）指标；通过引入破坏/污染（corruptions）实验，揭示了这些指标各自的敏感性与盲区。
AI.conclusion: Dancing Stick Figures 通过精心设计的合成数据、配套工具与细粒度标注，为视频生成模型研究提供了一个反馈快速、数据可及、评分精细的诊断性基准与实验平台，能够帮助研究者定位失败的具体属性。

title: Evaluating the Semantic Specificity of Representation Steering in Language Models
summary: Localized Representation Steering (LRS) is widely used to correct reasoning pathologies in large language models. However, standard benchmark evaluations can easily be fooled by superficial label overrides, creating a false impression of reasoning circuit repairs. In this work, we propose Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT), a diagnostic framework that audits representational interventions by evaluating them on rule families where the model is natively competent. Evaluating late-layer LRS for a widespread logical failure, contradiction blindness, reveals that the intervention merely injects a global label bias: applying the steering vector to rules the model already handles correctly (99.6% baseline) degrades performance to 40.4% by forcing false contradiction predictions. We support this diagnosis with four complementary controls (direct logit bias equivalence, control vector label-flipping, cross-model grafting, and early-layer steering checks), providing a rigorous methodology to distinguish genuine reasoning repairs from superficial label overrides.

AI.tldr: 提出Cross-Rule Transfer (CRT)诊断框架，用于审计表示干预是否真正修复了模型的推理电路；通过对矛盾盲视这一逻辑缺陷进行审计，发现晚期层LRS干预只是注入全局标签偏差，而非真正的推理修复。
AI.motivation: LRS被广泛用于纠正大语言模型的推理病理，但标准基准评估容易被表面性的标签覆盖所欺骗，从而产生推理电路已被修复的假象，因此需要更严格的诊断方法来验证干预的真实效果。
AI.method: 提出CRT诊断框架，在模型原本胜任的规则族上评估表示干预；针对晚期层LRS在矛盾盲视上的应用进行审计，并辅以四个互补对照实验：直接logit偏差等价、控制向量标签翻转、跨模型移植以及早期层转向检查。
AI.result: 实验表明该干预仅仅注入了全局标签偏差：将转向向量应用于模型原本处理正确的规则（99.6%基线）时，由于强制产生虚假的矛盾预测，性能下降到40.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种严格的方法论，能够区分真正的推理电路修复与表面性的标签覆盖，证明了CRT作为干预诊断工具的有效性。

title: Event-triggered Control and Online Learning for Networked Systems under Computational Delays
summary: Online learning-based control is a promising approach to control uncertain systems, where unknown components are identified during operation to improve control performance. However, resource-intensive online learning algorithms introduce non-negligible computational delays, especially when executed on systems with limited local computational resources. To mitigate this, an in-network online learning-based control structure is employed by deploying the learning-based controller on a remote computation node and connecting it via a communication channel. In this paper, control performance guarantee is first established by deriving tracking error bound for the in-network control architecture, while accounting for computational delays. The derived tracking error bound allows for diverse communication and computation strategies under a specific condition, including time-/event-triggered mechanisms. Additionally, the trade-off between communication and computation performances is shown for a given desired control performance. Furthermore, to enhance the efficiency in both communication and computation, an efficient control framework with an asynchronous event-triggered mechanism in both control and online learning is devised under the existence of computational delay. The proposed event-triggered strategy is proven to achieve the same control performance as time-triggered scenario while excluding Zeno behavior. Finally, we derive an explicit expression of the proposed event-trigger condition for exponentially stabilizable systems, and demonstrate its effectiveness through simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对在线学习控制中计算延迟导致的性能退化问题，提出了一种网内（in-network）在线学习控制架构，将学习控制器部署在远端计算节点并经通信信道连接。作者推导了考虑计算延迟的跟踪误差界，证明了在该界下多种通信与计算策略（含时间/事件触发）的性能保障，并揭示了通信与计算性能之间的权衡。进一步提出一种在控制和在线学习两侧均采用异步事件触发的控制框架，在存在计算延迟时达到与时间触发相同的控制性能且无Zeno行为，最后为指数可镇定系统给出显式事件触发条件并通过仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 在线学习控制虽能通过在线辨识未知组件提升控制性能，但资源密集的学习算法会引入不可忽略的计算延迟，尤其在本地计算资源有限的系统上更为严重。为缓解该问题，采用网内结构将学习控制器部署于远端计算节点，但该架构下的控制性能保证尚未建立，且通信与计算资源之间的权衡有待研究。
AI.method: 1) 针对网内控制架构推导考虑计算延迟的跟踪误差界，建立控制性能保证；2) 在该误差界下统一分析时间/事件触发等多种通信与计算策略，并导出给定期望控制性能下的通信-计算性能权衡关系；3) 设计在控制与在线学习两侧均采用异步事件触发机制的高效控制框架，证明其与时间触发具有相同控制性能且排除Zeno行为；4) 针对指数可镇定系统给出事件触发条件的显式表达式。
AI.result: 推导了计入计算延迟的跟踪误差界，证明其在特定条件下可兼容多种通信与计算策略；揭示了通信性能与计算性能之间的权衡；提出的异步事件触发框架在存在计算延迟时达到与时间触发相同的控制性能，且不产生Zeno行为；为指数可镇定系统给出了显式事件触发条件，并通过仿真验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 网内在线学习控制架构能够在给定控制性能要求下有效协调通信与计算资源，异步事件触发机制可在存在计算延迟时在不牺牲控制性能的前提下显著提升通信与计算效率，为资源受限系统上的在线学习控制提供了理论保障与可实现的触发条件。

title: Agent2UCB: Agentic System for Generative Engine Optimization
summary: Large language model driven search engines such as Google AI Overviews and Perplexity have created new opportunities for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) the practice of refining content to increase its likelihood of being cited or summarized by generative systems. We demonstrate Agent2UCB, an agentic GEO system that autonomously improves content visibility through customized, feedback-driven optimization. For each content item, the system evaluates nine GEO strategies, identifies the most effective method, and accelerates selection using a bandit-based Agent2UCB policy that integrates LLM priors with online reward signals. To monitor side effects, the system also provides a lightweight, text-only SEO readiness evaluation covering readability, topical coverage, and EEAT-style credibility. Experiments on GEO-Bench show consistent visibility gains while preserving SEO quality. The demo allows users to choose the websites of interest, observe the optimization workflow, and compare GEO/SEO outcomes across methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agent2UCB，一个基于智能体的生成式引擎优化（GEO）系统，通过基于 bandit 的 Agent2UCB 策略（融合 LLM 先验与在线奖励信号）自动评估九种 GEO 策略并加速选择最佳策略，从而自主提升内容在生成式搜索引擎（如 Google AI Overviews、Perplexity）中的被引用或被总结的可见性，同时提供轻量级纯文本 SEO 就绪度评估以监测副作用。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型驱动的搜索引擎（如 Google AI Overviews、Perplexity）催生了生成式引擎优化（GEO）这一新实践，即调整内容以提升其被生成系统引用或总结的可能性。然而，如何自主、反馈驱动地优化内容可见性，并在优化过程中监测 SEO 质量等副作用，仍缺乏系统性的解决方案。
AI.method: 该系统为每个内容项评估九种 GEO 策略，识别最有效的方法；采用带 bandit 的 Agent2UCB 策略加速策略选择，该策略将 LLM 先验与在线奖励信号相结合；同时提供轻量级、纯文本的 SEO 就绪度评估，覆盖可读性、主题覆盖度和 EEAT 风格的可信度，以监测副作用。系统还提供演示，允许用户选择感兴趣网站、观察优化工作流并比较各方法的 GEO/SEO 结果。
AI.result: 在 GEO-Bench 上的实验显示，该系统在保持 SEO 质量的同时实现了持续的可见性提升。
AI.conclusion: Agent2UCB 作为一种自主、反馈驱动的 GEO 系统，能够在保持内容 SEO 质量的前提下持续提升生成式搜索引擎中的内容可见性，为 GEO 优化提供了一种可监控副作用的有效范式。

title: Efficient Language-to-Vision Feature Injection for Referring Single-Object Tracking
summary: Referring single-object tracking enables language-grounded target initialization and subsequent tracking by jointly leveraging semantic cues and visual templates. The core difficulty is to use language differently across stages: it is indispensable for grounding but can induce semantic drift during tracking when overemphasized. Meanwhile, current methods often require costly vision-language alignment training. We present LVTrack, a pure transformer framework that introduces a mode-conditioned Gated Feature Injector to adaptively regulate textual guidance and alleviate semantic drift. Together with targeted adaptations, it directly harnesses a frozen vision-language pretrained model, greatly reducing training cost and preserving strong language understanding. To further improve temporal localization, LVTrack integrates hybrid relative-absolute positional encodings with a lightweight memory mechanism and optimizes autoregressive box prediction using a Gaussian-smoothed KL loss. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LVTrack achieves strong performance.

AI.tldr: LVTrack 提出一种纯 Transformer 的指代单目标跟踪框架，通过模式条件门控特征注入器自适应调节文本引导以缓解语义漂移，并直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型降低训练成本，同时引入混合相对-绝对位置编码、轻量记忆机制和高斯平滑 KL 损失改进时序定位与框预测。
AI.motivation: 指代单目标跟踪的核心难点在于语言在不同阶段的作用不同：在目标初始化（grounding）阶段语言不可或缺，但在跟踪过程中若过度强调语言则可能引入语义漂移；此外现有方法通常需要昂贵的视觉-语言对齐训练。
AI.method: 提出 LVTrack 纯 Transformer 框架：(1) 模式条件门控特征注入器（Mode-conditioned Gated Feature Injector）自适应调节文本引导以缓解语义漂移；(2) 通过针对性适配直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型，保留强语言理解且大幅降低训练成本；(3) 集成混合相对-绝对位置编码与轻量记忆机制改进时序定位；(4) 使用高斯平滑 KL 损失优化自回归框预测。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，LVTrack 在实现低成本训练的同时取得了强性能（strong performance）。
AI.conclusion: LVTrack 验证了通过门控机制自适应控制语言引导、结合冻结预训练模型与针对性改进，可在避免语义漂移和降低训练开销的前提下实现高性能的指代单目标跟踪。

title: Whose Assessment of Distress? Community Perspectives and LLM Alignment on Well-Being Posts
summary: Judgments about psychological distress are socially situated: what counts as concerning hinges on community norms around emotional expression, vulnerability, and help-seeking. Yet large language models (LLMs) used for distress detection are typically aligned to a single, undifferentiated standard. How well do these models capture the perspectives of the communities whose language they assess? We address this question through a perspectivist annotation study in which 321 participants provided 9,587 judgments on 1,198 Reddit posts spanning six identity-based communities, yielding community-specific labels. Raters in the contextualized in-group condition show a modest tendency to agree more with their community than uncontextualized out-group raters (OR = 1.18), an effect varying significantly across communities. We then evaluate nine open-weight LLM configurations and four frontier configurations against these labels. Open-weight LLMs systematically over-estimate distress: when communities perceive none-to-mild distress, these models achieve only 31-44% accuracy, predominantly producing false positives. GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro show the same none-to-mild inflation even when their full-sample over/under rates are mixed, while Claude Opus 4 is more conservative. This pattern does not simply mirror an outsider reading position: uncontextualized out-group human aggregates were nearly symmetric, with 18% over-estimation versus 19% under-estimation. Instead, the models that inflate none-to-mild cases exhibit a distress prior that exceeds both contextualized in-group and uncontextualized out-group human judgments. These findings have implications for equitable AI deployment in mental health contexts, where miscalibrated distress detection may unevenly affect the communities being assessed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项包含321名参与者、9587条判断、覆盖1198条Reddit帖子及六个基于身份社区的多视角标注研究，评估大型语言模型（LLM）在心理困扰检测中能否捕捉社区特定规范。结果显示，情境化的内群体标注者与社区标签的一致性略高于未情境化的外群体标注者（OR=1.18），且该效应因社区而异。九个开源LLM配置和四个前沿配置普遍高估困扰：当社区判定为无至轻度困扰时，开源模型准确率仅31-44%，以假阳性为主；GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro同样表现出此类通胀，Claude Opus 4则更保守。此种模式并非简单等同外部阅读者视角——未情境化外群体人类判断近乎对称（18%高估对19%低估），说明部分模型具有超出两类人类判断的"困扰先验"，对心理健康领域的公平AI部署构成影响。
AI.motivation: 心理困扰的判断本质上是社会情境化的，取决于社区关于情绪表达、脆弱性和求助的规范；然而用于困扰检测的大语言模型通常被对齐到单一且无差异的标准。作者质疑这些模型在多大程度上能捕捉其所评估语言所属社区的观点，旨在揭示模型判断与社区视角之间的系统性偏差。
AI.method: 采用透视主义（perspectivist）标注研究设计：321名参与者对来自六个身份社区的1198条Reddit帖子提供9587条判断，生成社区特定标签；设置情境化内群体与未情境化外群体两种标注条件。随后在社区标签基准上评估九个开源权重LLM配置及四个前沿配置，比较其过/低估比例，并与两类人类判断的聚合进行对照分析。
AI.result: 情境化内群体标注者比未情境化外群体更倾向于与社区标签一致（OR=1.18），且效应在社区间差异显著。开源LLM系统性高估困扰：在社区判定为无至轻度困扰的案例上准确率仅31-44%，以假阳性为主；GPT-5和Gemini 2.5 Pro在整体过/低估率混合时仍存在无至轻度通胀，Claude Opus 4更为保守。此类通胀不能归因于外群体阅读立场，因为未情境化外群体人类聚合近乎对称（18%高估对19%低估），说明高估模型带有超越两类人类判断的困扰先验。
AI.conclusion: LLM在心理困扰检测中的校准偏差并非源自一般性的外部观察者视角，而是模型自身的系统性"困扰先验"所致，其可能对不同社区产生不均匀影响。这提示在心理健康场景中部署AI时需以社区感知的标签为基准进行校准，否则校准不良的检测可能不公平地影响被评估的社区。

title: Predicting the Unpredictable: LLM-powered Long-term Chaotic Time Series Forecasting under Short-term Observations
summary: Chaotic time series forecasting is a challenging task due to its sensitivity to initial conditions and long-term unpredictability. Traditional methods typically rely on sufficient temporal trajectories to learn long-term dynamics, which limits their applicability when only short-term observations are available. While recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential for time series forecasting, their temporal representations are not explicitly tailored to the phase-space structure and nonlinear evolution of chaotic systems. To address these issues, we propose PAC-LLM, a phase-space-aware adaptive fusion framework for long-term chaotic time series forecasting powered by LLMs. PAC-LLM leverages learned phase-space features and textual information to fully enable LLM's time series forecasting capacity. In particular, we design an auxiliary feature module and a gated weighting mechanism for multivariate coupling information fusion and selection. Extensive experiments on representative chaotic systems demonstrate that our method outperforms existing fine-tuned and zero-shot baselines in both short-term and long-term predictions. Our ablation study further confirms the effectiveness of each key component in PAC-LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAC-LLM，一种由大语言模型驱动的相空间感知自适应融合框架，用于混沌时间序列长期预测。它通过融合学习到的相空间特征与文本信息，并设计辅助特征模块和门控加权机制进行多变量耦合信息融合与选择，在代表性混沌系统上优于现有微调和零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 混沌时间序列预测因对初值敏感、长期不可预测而具挑战性。传统方法依赖足够长的时间轨迹来学习长期动力学，在仅有短期观测时适用性受限；现有LLM虽在时序预测中展现潜力，但其时序表示并未针对混沌系统的相空间结构和非线性演化进行显式定制。
AI.method: 提出PAC-LLM，一个相空间感知的自适应融合框架。它利用学习到的相空间特征与文本信息充分激发LLM的时序预测能力，具体设计了辅助特征模块和门控加权机制，用于多变量耦合信息的融合与选择。
AI.result: 在代表性混沌系统上的大量实验表明，该方法在短期和长期预测中均优于现有的微调和零样本基线；消融研究进一步验证了PAC-LLM中各关键组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PAC-LLM通过将相空间结构感知与LLM能力相结合，有效解决了短期观测下混沌时间序列长期预测的难题，为利用LLM建模复杂非线性系统提供了可行的框架。

title: Revolutionizing Turn-by-Turn Navigation with Cloud-Edge Deep Learning
comment: This paper has accepted by IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Turn-by-turn (TBT) navigation systems are integral to modern driving experiences, providing real-time audio instructions to guide drivers safely to destinations. However, existing audio instruction policy often relies on rule-based approaches that struggle to balance informational content with cognitive load, potentially leading to driver confusion or missed turns in complex environments. To overcome these difficulties, we first model the generation of navigation instructions as a multi-task learning problem by decomposing the audio content into combinations of modular elements. Then, we propose a novel deep learning framework that leverages the powerful spatiotemporal information processing capabilities of Transformers and the strong multi-task learning abilities of Mixture of Experts (MoE) to generate real-time, context-aware audio instructions for TBT driving navigation. A cloud-edge collaborative architecture is implemented to handle the computational demands of the model, ensuring scalability and real-time performance for practical applications. Experimental results in the real world demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces the yaw rate (the proportion of vehicles deviating from navigation routes) compared to traditional methods, delivering clearer and more effective audio instructions. This is the first large-scale application of deep learning in driving audio navigation, marking a substantial advancement in intelligent transportation and driving assistance technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer与混合专家（MoE）的新型深度学习框架，将逐向（TBT）驾驶导航语音指令生成建模为多任务学习问题，通过将音频内容分解为模块化元素的组合来实时生成上下文感知的导航提示，并结合云边协同架构满足实际部署的计算与实时性需求。真实路测表明该方法相比传统基于规则的方法显著降低了偏航率（偏航车辆比例），提供了更清晰有效的语音指令，是深度学习在驾驶音频导航中的首次大规模应用。
AI.motivation: 现有的逐向导航语音指令策略通常依赖基于规则的方法，难以在信息含量与认知负荷之间取得平衡，在复杂环境下容易导致驾驶员困惑或错过转弯。因此需要一种能够实时、上下文感知地生成音频指令的新方法，以提升导航清晰度与驾驶安全性。
AI.method: 首先将导航指令生成建模为多任务学习问题，把音频内容分解为模块化元素的组合；然后提出融合Transformer的时空信息处理能力与MoE强大多任务学习能力的新型深度学习框架，用于生成实时、上下文感知的TBT导航音频指令；最后实现云边协同架构以承载模型计算需求，保证可扩展性与实际应用中的实时性能。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明，与传统方法相比，所提方法显著降低了偏航率（偏离导航路线的车辆比例），交付了更清晰、更有效的音频指令；这是深度学习在驾驶音频导航中的首次大规模应用，标志着智能交通与驾驶辅助技术的重要进步。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer与MoE的多任务深度学习框架结合云边协同架构，能够更优地平衡导航语音的信息内容与认知负荷，减少驾驶员偏航，验证了深度学习驱动音频导航在大规模实际场景中的可行性与有效性，为智能交通和驾驶辅助系统提供了一种先进的技术路线。

title: Chat-Edit-3D++: Interactive 3D and 4D Scene Editing via Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still have certain shortcomings, hindering their further development as interactive design tools. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting flexibility in text input. Furthermore, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose the Hash-Atlas network, which reformulates 3D scene editing as operations on 2D atlas images, thereby achieving a workflow decoupling of the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes. Building on this foundation, we introduce a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed CE3D++, which is centered on a large language model (LLM) that allows arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual models. Additionally, we extend CE3D++ to monocular 4D scenes by imposing motion constraints on moving objects and further fine-tuning the LLM by creating a trajectory dataset related to editing tasks, which enables the smaller LLM to schedule up to 30 different visual tools accurately. Experimental results demonstrate that CE3D++ effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse visual editing effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities. The source codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/Fangkang515/CE3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CE3D++，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式 3D 场景编辑方法。通过 Hash-Atlas 网络将 3D 场景编辑重构为对 2D atlas 图像的操作，实现 2D 编辑与 3D 重建流程的解耦；以 LLM 为核心理解用户的任意文本输入并自主调度多种视觉模型，同时扩展至单目 4D 场景（通过运动约束与轨迹数据集微调），使小型 LLM 能精确调度多达 30 种视觉工具，实现多样化的视觉编辑效果与多轮对话能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉-语言预训练模型的 3D 场景编辑方案仍存在明显不足：一是通常遵循固定的输入模式，限制了文本输入的灵活性；二是编辑能力受限于单个或少量 2D 视觉模型；三是需要设计复杂繁琐的流程才能将这些 2D 模型集成到 3D 重建过程中，阻碍了其作为交互式设计工具的进一步发展。
AI.method: 提出 Hash-Atlas 网络，将 3D 场景编辑转化为对 2D atlas 图像的操作，从而实现 2D 编辑与 3D 重建流程的工作流解耦。在此基础上，提出以 LLM 为核心的对话式 3D 场景编辑方法 CE3D++：LLM 接受用户任意文本输入并理解其意图，自主调用相应视觉模型完成编辑。此外，通过为移动对象施加运动约束将 CE3D++ 扩展到单目 4D 场景，并构建与编辑任务相关的轨迹数据集对 LLM 进行进一步微调，使小型 LLM 能够准确调度多达 30 种不同的视觉工具。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CE3D++ 能有效集成多种视觉模型以实现多样化的视觉编辑效果，具备强大的场景理解能力与多轮对话能力，且小型 LLM 可准确调度多达 30 种视觉工具。源代码与训练模型已开源（https://github.com/Fangkang515/CE3D）。
AI.conclusion: CE3D++ 通过 2D/3D 流程解耦与 LLM 调度机制，有效解决了现有 3D 场景编辑在输入灵活性、模型扩展性与流程复杂度上的局限，并成功拓展至 4D 场景，验证了其作为通用交互式场景编辑工具的可行性。

title: AI Can Be Easily Persuaded in Clinical Decision Making
summary: As AI becomes increasingly integrated into clinical practice, it is playing a growing role in medical decision making. Medicine, however, is a high stakes and evidence based field, where decisions can directly affect patients' lives. It is therefore important to understand whether AI can maintain objective judgment when others try to persuade it. In this paper, we study how easily AI can be persuaded through controlled experiments. We find that professional authority, national background, institutional affiliation, claimed past performance, multiple physicians, supported clinician views, and repeated pressure can all affect AI decisions. Surprisingly, the same persuasive input changes about 10% more cases when it comes from a senior clinician than from a medical student. Simply claiming a better performance history consistently makes the physician more persuasive. More strikingly, a plausible clinician view can persuade AI away from a correct decision even when it is fabricated to support an incorrect answer. This indicates that AI can be strongly influenced by convincing support without reliably determining whether this view from the clinician is correct. Together, these findings suggest that AI can be easily persuaded by what people say, who says it, and how the opinion is presented. Therefore, it is essential for AI to maintain sound judgment under persuasion, enabling its safe and reliable use in high stakes medical decision making.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验研究AI在临床决策中是否容易被说服，发现专业权威、机构背景、声称的过往绩效、多名医生支持、重复施压等方式均能显著影响AI决策，甚至编造的“合理临床意见”也能将AI从正确决策引开，表明AI在高风险医疗场景中易受人际说服影响，需增强其抗说服判断能力。
AI.motivation: AI在临床实践和医疗决策中的作用越来越大，而医学是高风险的循证领域，决策直接影响患者生命。因此必须弄清AI在遭受他人说服时能否保持客观判断，以确保其安全可靠地用于医疗决策。
AI.method: 采用受控实验方法，系统地向AI输入不同类型和来源的说服性信息，比较其对医疗决策的改变程度。实验中操纵的因素包括专业权威层级（如高级临床医生vs医学生）、国籍背景、所属机构、声称的过往绩效、多名医生集合、支持性临床观点以及重复施压等。
AI.result: 专业权威、国家背景、机构归属、声称的过往表现、多位医生、支持的临床观点和重复施压均会影响AI决策；来自高级临床医生的相同说服性输入比来自医学生多改变约10%的案例；单纯声称更优的绩效史就能提升说服力；更惊人的是，即使是编造来支持错误答案的“合理”临床观点，也能将AI从正确决策中说服偏离。
AI.conclusion: AI很容易被“谁说的、说了什么、如何呈现”所左右，无法可靠判断临床意见本身的正确性。因此必须让AI在说服压力下保持稳健判断，才能保障其在高风险医疗决策中的安全可靠应用。

title: On the Resilience of Text-to-Video Diffusion Models to Hardware Faults
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop on From Frames to Stories (F2S)
summary: We present the first systematic study of the resilience of text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models under random hardware-level faults. While T2V models are widely used for automated video generation due to their ability to produce high-quality, temporally coherent, and realistic videos, their iterative denoising process and spatiotemporal dependencies introduce unique failure modes. We perform an extensive fault-injection study covering both computational and memory faults across three T2V models and a representative benchmark. Our results show that (1) a single fault can degrade overall performance by up to 3.7\%, with semantic correctness more affected than perceptual quality; (2) memory faults are more damaging than computational faults, high-order exponent bits are particularly vulnerable, and the widely-used bfloat16 is more susceptible than alternative formats; and (3) 7-28\% of faults cause visible artifacts, including semantic changes such as added objects, suggesting that single faults are sufficient to alter output semantics. Our findings reveal reliability risks in deployed T2V systems and motivate further research on improving fault resilience. Code: \href{https://github.com/ztcoalson/T2V-Resilience}{https://github.com/ztcoalson/T2V-Resilience}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型在随机硬件级故障下的鲁棒性，通过覆盖计算与内存两类故障的广泛故障注入实验，揭示了单个故障即可显著降低语义正确性、内存故障比计算故障更具破坏性、bfloat16 格式更易受攻击等问题，为部署可靠性提供了重要实证依据。
AI.motivation: T2V 模型被广泛用于自动视频生成，其迭代去噪过程和时空依赖关系会引入独特的故障模式；尽管模型在部署环境中可能遭遇硬件随机故障，此前尚无对此类模型的系统鲁棒性研究，因此评估其在硬件故障下的可靠性风险具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者对三种 T2V 模型和一个代表性基准进行了大规模故障注入研究，覆盖计算类故障（如运算单元错误）与内存类故障（如存储位翻转），并系统比较了不同的数据类型格式（如 bfloat16 与替代格式）对故障的敏感性。
AI.result: 实验发现：（1）单个故障可使整体性能下降最高 3.7%，且语义正确性受损程度高于感知质量；（2）内存故障比计算故障危害更大，高阶指数位尤其脆弱，广泛使用的 bfloat16 比其他格式更易受影响；（3）7%–28% 的故障会产生可见伪影，包括新增物体等语义级改变，说明单个故障足以改变输出语义。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了部署中的 T2V 系统面临的实际可靠性风险，指出硬件级故障可能以较低代价破坏生成内容的语义一致性，从而为设计更鲁棒的 T2V 模型与故障防护机制提供了方向与动机。

title: Nested Convex-Body Chasing for Online Optimization with Evolving Feasible Sets
summary:
We study online optimization with nested shrinking feasible regions in two settings: convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets (CONES) and adversarial constrained online convex optimization (COCO). Our algorithms separate loss control from geometric movement: constrained minimizers and cumulative-loss tests preserve regret guarantees, while a deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser limits movement.
  For CONES with a $G$-Lipschitz, $μ$-strongly convex objective on a diameter-$D$ domain, we chase intersections of the current feasible set with adaptive objective sublevel sets. Using the Euclidean chasing ratio $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)})$, we obtain nonpositive regret at every prefix and movement $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)\,GD\log(eT)/μ})$. The bound adapts to the increase in the constrained optimum value. In dimension two, with all other parameters fixed, every randomized algorithm with terminal expected regret $O(T^β)$, $β<1$, suffers $Ω(\sqrt{\log T})$ expected movement on some deterministic nested sequence, proving optimal horizon dependence. Under linear growth away from the constrained minimizer set, Steiner-point tracking yields movement independent of $T$.
  For general convex COCO, one-step-delayed chasing with regularized-leader resets gives regret $O(G_fD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$ and cumulative constraint violation $O(G_gD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$. For strongly convex losses, both are $O(d\log(1+d)\log(eT))$ when other parameters are fixed. These reductions replace the $O(d^{d/2})$ projection-path factor in prior analyses by the polynomial dimension dependence of Euclidean nested convex-body chasing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两类带嵌套收缩可行域的自适应在线优化问题（CONES 与对抗性约束在线凸优化 COCO），通过将损失控制与几何移动解耦，利用欧氏嵌套凸体追逐技术，在 CONES 中获得每一前缀非正悔与次线性移动，并为一般凸/强凸 COCO 取得依赖维数的多项式悔界与约束违反界，取代了以往分析中指数维数因子。
AI.motivation: 在线优化中可行域随时间动态收缩（嵌套可行集）时，算法既要保持后悔界（损失控制），又要控制可行点移动的成本；先前约束在线凸优化的分析带有 O(d^{d/2}) 的投影路径因子，维数依赖是指数级的，需要更高效的几何移动机制。此外，需要刻画移动量在过度危险域（有界域）与线性增长目标情形下的最优地平线依赖。
AI.method: 算法将损失控制与几何移动分离：用约束最小化器与累积损失检验维持后悔保证，用确定性的可重置嵌套凸体追踪器（resettable nested convex-body chaser）控制移动。CONES 情形下追踪当前可行集与自适应目标次水平集的交集，借助欧氏追逐比 O(√(d log(1+d)))；COCO 情形采用一步延迟追逐配合正则化领导者重置；在目标距约束最小化集线性增长的情形采用 Steiner 点追踪。同时给出二维情形下任意随机算法的移动量下界证明。
AI.result: 对 CONES（G-Lipschitz、μ-强凸目标、直径 D 域），得到每一前缀非正后悔，移动量 O(√(d log(1+d) GD log(eT)/μ))，且界自适应于约束最优值增量的变化；在二维、参数固定时，任何终端期望后悔为 O(T^β)(β<1) 的随机算法在某个确定性嵌套序列上须承受 Ω(√log T) 期望移动，说明地平线依赖最优；在线性增长情形下 Steiner 点追踪使移动量不依赖 T。对一般凸 COCO，一步延迟追逐给出后悔 O(G_f D√(d log(1+d)T)) 与累积约束违反 O(G_g D√(d log(1+d)T))；强凸损失下二者均为 O(d log(1+d) log(eT))。这些结果以欧氏嵌套凸体追逐的多项式维数依赖替代了以往 O(d^{d/2}) 投影路径因子。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一套统一的"损失控制 + 几何追逐"框架，证明嵌套可行域在线优化的后悔与移动量可由多项式维数依赖的欧氏追逐技术同时加以控制，并给出移动量在二维情形的匹配下界与线性增长情形的不依赖 T 改进，显著降低了约束在线凸优化分析中的维数复杂度。

title: STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation
summary: The rapid expansion of low Earth orbit satellites such as Starlink is increasingly contaminating astronomical surveys. In practice, contaminated images are often identified through inspection. However, modern surveys generate terabytes of data each night, making manual screening infeasible and necessitating reliable automated methods for satellite trail removal. Unfortunately, existing general-domain line detection methods fail to generalize to astronomical images due to domain mismatch, which are mostly grayscale with sparse bright stars and have a low signal-to-noise ratio. Moreover, training new models from scratch is impractical due to the lack of large-scale annotated astronomical datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce STARLINC, the first ML-based framework for satellite trail removal without requiring tedious pixel-level annotation of astronomical images. STARLINC combines synthetic satellite trail generation for training, inter-frame differential maps from temporally adjacent exposures to highlight transient trails, and heatmaps to provide additional localization cues for pixel-level segmentation. Extensive experiments on real-world data demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines, establishing STARLINC as a scalable solution for next-generation astronomical surveys. Code is available at https://github.com/starioKim/STARLINC.

AI.tldr: STARLINC 是首个无需像素级标注的、基于机器学习的卫星轨迹去除框架，通过合成轨迹生成、帧间差分图与热图定位相结合，在真实天文数据上显著优于基线方法，为下一代大规模巡天提供可扩展解决方案。
AI.motivation: 低地球轨道卫星（如 Starlink）的快速增长日益污染天文观测图像，而现代巡天每晚产生 TB 级数据，人工筛检不可行。现有通用线检测方法因领域不匹配（天文图像多为灰度、恒星稀疏、信噪比低）难以泛化；同时缺乏大规模标注数据集，从头训练新模型不切实际。
AI.method: STARLINC 无需繁琐的像素级天文图像标注，其核心组件包括：(1) 合成卫星轨迹生成用于训练；(2) 利用时间相邻曝光的帧间差分图突出瞬态轨迹；(3) 使用热图提供额外的定位线索以辅助像素级分割。
AI.result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，STARLINC 相比基线方法取得了显著提升，被验证为可扩展的解决方案，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: STARLINC 确立了无需像素级标注即可实现卫星轨迹去除的可行性，并作为可扩展方案支撑下一代天文巡天项目的数据处理。

title: Item-Mean Surrogates: Why Richer Persona Data Fail to Improve LLMs as Human Surrogates
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Includes Supporting Information (main text pages 1-9; SI Appendix pages 1-28)
summary: LLMs are increasingly used as human surrogates, often on the premise that richer persona data could make them substitutes or exploratory tools for specific individuals. We test this premise across four datasets covering more than 400,000 participants and more than 6,000 survey items and experimental outcomes. LLMs perform well at the aggregate level: their average responses closely align with average human responses to the same items. But this success largely reflects predicting each item's average human response. Once each item's human mean is removed, LLM predictions explain only 3.05% of the remaining respondent-specific variation, far below the 53.6% human test-retest benchmark. Richer personas, model variants, and fine-tuning do not close this gap. In variance analyses, once item means are removed, the reliable remaining signal is person-by-item. It captures how a respondent departs from the mean on a particular item and is about 8.9x larger than the stable person effect. Persona data encode the respondent, but not this item-specific deviation. LLM responses also compress human response distributions, using less spread, fewer response categories, and distorted distributional shapes. We call this pattern item-mean surrogacy. Current LLM surrogates can approximate item averages, but not the distributions or respondent-specific deviations needed to replace individual humans. We propose four empirical tests for LLM-based human-surrogate claims.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四个数据集（40多万参与者、6000多项调查题项和实验结果）系统检验了“LLM可替代特定个体”的前提，发现LLM在聚合层面表现良好，但仅是因为能预测每个题项的平均人类反应；一旦去除题项均值，LLM仅能解释3.05%的个体差异（人类重测基准为53.6%）。更丰富的用户画像、模型变体和微调均无法弥合差距，且LLM会压缩人类反应分布。作者将这一模式称为“题项均值替代”（item-mean surrogacy），并提出四项检测LLM人类替代声明的实证测试。
AI.motivation: LLM正越来越多地被用作人类替身（human surrogates），其前提假设是更丰富的用户画像数据能使LLM成为特定个体的替代品或探索工具。作者希望检验这一前提是否成立。
AI.method: 作者在覆盖超过40万名参与者、6000多个调查题项和实验结果的四个数据集上进行实证分析：比较LLM平均响应与人类平均响应的对齐程度；在去除题项均值后，计算LLM对个体间剩余变异的解释比例，并与人类测试-重测基准（53.6%）对比；进行方差分析，分解稳定个体效应与person-by-item效应；考察LLM响应分布（离散程度、类别使用数、分布形状）；测试不同画像数据、模型变体和微调的影响，并提出四项实证测试标准。
AI.result: LLM在聚合水平上表现良好，但其成功主要源于预测每个题项的平均人类响应。去除题项均值后，LLM仅解释3.05%的个体差异，远低于53.6%的人类重测基准；更丰富的画像、模型变体与微调均不能弥合此差距。方差分析显示，去除题项均值后可靠的剩余信号是person-by-item交互（约比稳定个体效应大8.9倍），而画像数据只编码了个体本身，无法捕捉这类题项特异偏差。此外，LLM响应压缩了人类反应分布（更小的离散度、更少类别、形状扭曲）。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM替身只能近似题项平均水平，无法复现人类反应的分布或个体在具体题项上的特异偏离，因此不足以替代个体人类。作者提出“题项均值替代”这一概念，并给出四项实证测试，用以检验未来LLM人类替代声明的有效性。

title: Adaptive Doubly Robust Off-Policy Evaluation for Ranking Policies under Diverse User Behavior
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at CONSEQUENCES 2026 and selected for oral presentation
summary: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) of ranking policies is challenging be- cause selecting and ordering multiple items from a candidate set makes the number of possible rankings grow combinatorially with the number of candidates and the ranking length. Consequently, Inverse Propensity Scoring (IPS), whose importance weight is the full-ranking probability ratio under the evaluation and logging policies, can have excessive variance. Independent IPS (IIPS) and Reward Interaction IPS (RIPS) reduce variance by imposing fixed assumptions on how users browse rankings, but may introduce bias when those assumptions mismatch actual behavior. Adaptive Inverse Propensity Scoring (AIPS) addresses this trade-off by adap- tively marginalizing importance weights over the actions that affect each position-wise reward. It attains minimum variance within a class of unbiased IPS-based estimators when the true user be- havior model is observed. However, its estimation accuracy may still degrade for longer rankings, and AIPS does not use a reward model for residual correction. We propose Adaptive Doubly Robust (ADR), which combines adaptive importance weighting with re- ward regression through a control-variate correction. We establish its unbiasedness when the true user behavior model is observed and characterize a sufficient condition under which it reduces vari- ance relative to AIPS. Across synthetic experiments with 10,000 simulations per condition, ADR improves mean squared error over AIPS and conventional ranking OPE estimators across a range of logged-data sizes and ranking lengths.

AI.tldr: 针对排序策略的离线策略评估（OPE）问题，提出自适应双稳健（ADR）估计器，将自适应逆倾向得分（AIPS）的自适应重要性加权与基于奖励回归的控制变量校正相结合，在观测到真实用户行为模型时保证无偏性，并在一定条件下相比AIPS降低方差，实验表明其在多种日志数据规模与排序长度下优于AIPS及传统OPE方法。
AI.motivation: 排序策略的OPE因候选集与排序长度导致排名数量组合爆炸，全排名概率比的IPS重要性权重方差过大；IIPS和RIPS通过固定浏览假设降方差但可能引入偏差；AIPS通过自适应边际化重要性权重在无偏类中达到最小方差，但其估计精度在较长排序下仍会退化，且未利用奖励模型进行残差校正。
AI.method: 提出自适应双稳健（ADR）估计器：将AIPS的自适应重要性加权与奖励回归结合，通过控制变量（control-variate）校正实现残差修正；理论上在真实用户行为模型可观测时证明其无偏性，并刻画其相对AIPS降低方差的充分条件；通过每个条件下10,000次模拟的合成实验进行验证。
AI.result: 在合成实验中（每条件10,000次模拟），ADR在多种日志数据规模和排序长度下，均方误差（MSE）优于AIPS以及传统排序OPE估计器，验证了其在长排序场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ADR通过自适应重要性加权与奖励回归的控制变量校正，兼顾无偏性与方差降低，在保持AIPS优势的同时借助奖励模型改善残差，从而在更长排序和不同日志规模下取得更优的估计准确性。

title: HANIA: Planner-Guided Multimodal Graph Evidence Selection for Grounded Question Answering
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at Graph-enhanced LLMs for trustwOrthy Web data management (GLOW), ISWC 2026 Workshops, Bari, Italy
summary: Multimodal question answering remains sensitive to noisy, incomplete, and weakly grounded evidence. Long unstructured contexts can introduce redundancy and encourage unsupported generation, while flat retrieval may overlook relations needed for multi-step reasoning. We present HANIA, a planner-guided multimodal graph framework for evidence-grounded question answering. HANIA processes the supplied image and text using a frozen vision-language model to extract concise question-relevant visual evidence with explicit abstention. It then constructs an input-grounded multimodal graph and applies a two-group finite-state planner to coordinate descriptive and relational evidence. Coverage-aware pruning retains a compact evidence set based on relevance, graph confidence, concept coverage, and modality diversity. The selected passages, visual statements, and graph triples are provided to a frozen instruction-tuned decoder. We evaluate HANIA on ScienceQA using answer accuracy, evidence-filtering quality, evidence-budget sensitivity, and efficiency. The results show that structured evidence planning and compact graph-guided retrieval can support competitive multimodal question answering without target-dataset fine-tuning or iterative retrieval. The code is available at https://github.com/Zafar-southeast/HANIA.

AI.tldr: HANIA 提出一种规划器引导的多模态图框架，通过提取带显式弃权的视觉证据、构建输入接地多模态图、使用两组有限状态规划器协调描述性与关系性证据，并配合覆盖感知剪枝，在不进行目标数据集微调和迭代检索的情况下，在 ScienceQA 上取得有竞争力的问答性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态问答对噪声、不完整和弱接地证据高度敏感；冗长非结构化上下文会引入冗余并助长无依据生成，而扁平化检索可能遗漏多步推理所需的关系信息，导致现有方法证据质量不高。
AI.method: HANIA 首先用冻结的视觉-语言模型从给定图像和文本中提取与问题相关的简洁视觉证据（支持显式弃权）；随后构建输入接地的多模态图，并应用两组有限状态规划器来协调描述性证据与关系性证据；再通过覆盖感知剪枝，依据相关性、图置信度、概念覆盖和模态多样性保留紧凑证据集；最后将选中的段落、视觉陈述和图三元组输入冻结的指令微调解码器生成答案。
AI.result: 在 ScienceQA 上从答案准确率、证据过滤质量、证据预算敏感性和效率四个维度评估，结果表明结构化证据规划与紧凑的图引导检索能够在无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索的情况下达到有竞争力的多模态问答效果。
AI.conclusion: 结构化证据规划与紧凑图引导检索相结合，可在避免目标任务微调和迭代检索开销的同时，有效支撑证据接地的多模态问答，为鲁棒、高效的多模态推理提供了可行方案。

title: SGRNet: Spatially Guided Radiology Network for Structured Radiological Reporting of Head and Neck Cancer
summary: Automated radiological report generation can alleviate clinical workloads and eliminate observer variability. However, standard free-text generation models pose hallucination risks in dense regions and fail under data scarcity. We address these challenges in Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) from contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) imaging. To enforce factual safety, we reformulate report generation as an anatomically grounded, multi-label, structured reporting task, predicting localized tumor involvement across a hierarchical clinical schema. To bridge the visual gap from missing metabolic imaging (e.g., PET), we introduce SGRNet (Spatially Guided Radiology Network), incorporating two low-cost spatial priors: automated organ segmentations and weakly supervised tumor localization maps modeled via 3D Gaussian heatmaps. These priors are dynamically integrated via spatial feature modulation to guide the network toward subtle tumor-induced structural alterations. Evaluated on a multi-centric dataset of 184 paired HNC CECT volumes and reports, on five clinically salient, densely packed anatomical subsites, SGRNet achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.60, an 8.8 percentage-point absolute improvement over strong volume-only 3D baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGRNet（空间引导放射学网络），将头颈癌（HNC）放射学报告生成重构为基于解剖结构的多标签结构化报告任务，以规避自由文本生成的幻觉风险和数据稀缺问题。通过融入自动器官分割和弱监督3D高斯热图肿瘤定位两种低成本空间先验，并在空间特征调制下引导网络关注肿瘤引起的细微结构改变，在184例配对CECT数据上于5个密集解剖亚区取得mAP 0.60，较纯3D体素基线提升8.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自动化放射学报告生成虽能减轻临床负担并消除观察者差异，但标准自由文本生成模型在解剖结构密集区域存在幻觉风险，且在数据稀缺场景下性能不佳；同时CT成像缺少代谢信息（如PET）造成视觉信息缺口，需要额外空间线索来弥补。
AI.method: 将报告生成重构为解剖学引导的多标签结构化预测任务，按分层临床模式预测局部肿瘤受累情况；并提出SGRNet，引入两种低成本空间先验——自动器官分割图和经3D高斯热图建模的弱监督肿瘤定位图，通过空间特征调制动态融合这些先验，引导网络捕捉肿瘤诱导的细微结构改变。
AI.result: 在多中心184对头颈癌CECT体数据与报告上，针对5个临床重要且结构密集的解剖亚区，SGRNet取得平均精度（mAP）0.60，较纯体素3D强基线实现8.8个百分点的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 以解剖结构为导向的结构化报告范式结合空间先验调制，能有效缓解自由文本生成的幻觉与数据稀缺问题，在缺乏代谢成像的条件下提升密集解剖区域报告生成的准确性与事实安全性。

title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
comment: 42 pages, 21 figures, Fixed HF links from v1 (otherwise identical)
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACE-Eval，一个包含5,100个样本的评测基准，系统考察链式思维（CoT）监控在偏好线索来自工具返回或原始工件（而非仅用户消息）时的可靠性。评测发现，所有15个开源模型在工具返回和隐式线索下口头承诺（verbalized commitment）更低、而未言语化采纳（unverbalized adoption）更高，且两个转录监控器对高采纳样本的检测能力更差，表明CoT监控在工具与原始工件场景下可能不可靠。
AI.motivation: CoT监控的基本假设是推理痕迹能忠实地记录影响模型答案的信息。但现有忠实性测试通常将明确的偏好线索放在用户消息中，而实际智能体可能通过工具返回或原始工件遭遇偏好。因此需要评估线索位置和显式程度如何影响CoT监控的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建FACE-Eval，包含5,100个样本，操控线索位置（用户消息或工具返回）与显式程度（直接摘要或原始工件）。对8个家族、参数规模从4B到1.60T的15个开源模型，在遵循线索的答案中测量口头承诺，在所有带线索样本中测量未言语化采纳；并使用两个转录监控器（GPT-5.6-Luna和GPT-4o-mini）检测各家族最大模型的偏好采纳。还测试了来源归因提示与"推理将被监控"告知的影响。
AI.result: 所有模型在工具返回线索上的口头承诺均低于用户消息线索，隐式线索低于显式线索；未言语化采纳在工具返回线索上对全部15个模型更高，在隐式线索上对28/30个模型-通道组合更高。来源归因提示在7个模型上缩小了通道差距（有时通过提高用户通道的未言语化采纳实现），而告知推理将被监控不能可靠缩小差距。在32个模型-通道-显式性单元中，更高的未言语化采纳与两个监控器更低的检测能力相关（Pearson r=-0.54和r=-0.78）。
AI.conclusion: 在单次调用、预填充工具设置的测试条件下，当偏好信息经由工具返回或需从原始工件中推断时，CoT监控可能可靠性下降。

title: Wide Learning: Learning to Reach Evidence
summary: Machine learning is usually evaluated after an evidence interface has been fixed. A dataset, sensor suite, query language, action set, or experimental protocol determines which observations can be obtained, and learning is judged by what it extracts from them. We study a complementary capability. A learner's state can determine which evidence-generating experiments it can reliably realise under bounded resources, even when primitive affordances remain fixed. We call this learner-relative experiment family its effective epistemic reach, and use Wide Learning for task-relevant learning-induced changes in that family.We formalise effective reach relative to learner state, deployment budget, reliability threshold, and evaluation distribution. In a controlled construction, two hidden worlds have exactly the same public observation law. An informative diagnostic exists in a fixed five-primitive substrate. Before calibration, one address attempt realises it with probability at most $2^{-10} = 1/1024$, below a pre-specified 0.95 threshold; after calibration, held-out realisation is 1. Public-channel total variation is 0, whereas the realised diagnostic has total variation 1, and sealed binary risk moves from approximately 1/2 to 0. The construction establishes that learning can change effective epistemic reach even when primitive affordances and deployment resources are held fixed. It opens a complementary evaluation question for learning systems: not only what they infer from available evidence, but what informative evidence experience teaches them to bring within reach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效认知范围"（effective epistemic reach）概念：学习者的内部状态决定了其在固定资源与原始能力约束下能可靠实现的证据生成实验家族。通过对五个原始基质的受控构造证明，即使原始能力、公共观测规律与部署资源完全固定，校准（学习）仍能把一个诊断实验的实现概率从 2^-10 提升到 1，从而改变学习者的有效认知范围，为学习系统提出了一种超越"从已有证据中推断"的互补评估框架。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习评估在证据接口固定后进行，即数据集、传感器套件、查询语言、动作集或实验协议决定了可获得哪些观测，学习的效果仅以其从中提取的信息来评判。作者认为这是一种互补且被忽视的能力：学习者的状态本身可能决定它能在有限资源下可靠实现哪些产生证据的实验，即使原始动作能力保持不变。由此希望形式化并验证"学习能改变自身可获得证据的范围"。
AI.method: 形式化地定义了相对于学习者状态、部署预算、可靠性阈值和评估分布的有效认知范围（learner-relative experiment family）。采用 Wide Learning 刻画由任务相关学习引起的该家族变化。构造了一个受控实验：两个隐藏世界具有完全相同的公共观测律，在固定五原始基质（five-primitive substrate）中存在一个有信息量的诊断实验；对比校准前后该诊断的端到端实现成功率，并测量公共信道总变差、实现诊断的总变差以及密封二值风险。
AI.result: 校准前单次地址尝试实现该诊断的概率至多为 2^-10=1/1024，低于预设的 0.95 可靠性阈值；校准后留下的（held-out）实现概率为 1。公共信道上的总变差为 0，而所实现诊断的总变差为 1；密封二值风险从大约 1/2 降到 0。由此证明，在原始能力与部署资源固定不变的情况下，学习仍能改变有效认知范围。
AI.conclusion: 该构造确立了有效认知范围可作为独立于证据接口的学习评价维度：学习不仅能改进对现有证据的推断，经验还能教会学习者把原本够不到的有信息量证据纳入可靠可达范围。这为学习系统的评估开启了一个互补性问题——不仅看它们能从可用证据中推断出什么，还要看它们学会了将哪些有信息量的证据带入可达范围。

title: EviAnchor: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Regional Visual Evidence Compensation
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) frequently generate content unsupported by visual inputs. Preliminary experiments show that visual evidence is primarily incorporated into answer-side representations in early-to-middle decoder layers, while its direct influence progressively weakens in later layers. This attenuation suggests that visual evidence acquired earlier may be insufficiently utilized during subsequent generation. Based on this observation, we propose EviAnchor, a training-free and single-branch inference framework that preserves and reactivates visual evidence throughout generation. EviAnchor introduces Regional Evidence Anchor (REA) slots to progressively aggregate dense visual tokens into spatially structured representations. It then strengthens the current decision state's access to these visual anchors through decision-conditioned evidence routing, mitigating excessive dependence on textual context. Finally, the model resumes its native Transformer computation to integrate the retrieved visual evidence with question semantics and generation history. Experiments across POPE, CHAIR, and MMHal-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviAnchor，一种无需训练、单分支的推理框架，用于缓解大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉问题。它通过区域证据锚（REA）插槽聚合稠密视觉token，并利用决策条件证据路由在生成各阶段持续保留与重新激活视觉证据，最终在POPE、CHAIR和MMHal-Bench基准上显著提升视觉接地能力。
AI.motivation: LVLM经常生成与视觉输入不符的内容（幻觉）。初步实验发现：视觉证据主要在解码器早期至中层被纳入答案侧表示，而在后续层中的直接影响逐渐减弱，导致早期获取的视觉证据在后续生成中未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出EviAnchor训练免费（training-free）单分支推理框架：(1) 引入区域证据锚（REA）插槽，将密集视觉token渐进聚合成空间结构化表示；(2) 通过决策条件证据路由（decision-conditioned evidence routing）增强当前决策状态对视觉锚的访问，缓解对文本上下文的过度依赖；(3) 恢复原生Transformer计算，将检索到的视觉证据与问题语义及生成历史整合。
AI.result: 在POPE、CHAIR和MMHal-Bench三个基准上的实验表明，EviAnchor在视觉接地（visual grounding）方面取得了一致的改进，有效减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 通过保留并重新激活生成过程中的视觉证据，EviAnchor在不进行训练的前提下显著改善了LVLM的视觉接地性能，为缓解多模态幻觉提供了高效且通用的推理阶段方案。

title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
summary: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. Dense and Sparse Token Loop vary the token scope; Sampling-Progress Gating and the loop layer range specify when and where looping is active; loop count and strength control the repeated updates; and Loop Guidance combines ordinary and looped vector-field predictions. Across two Scale-RAE model scales, loop variants improve primary and auxiliary quality metrics with competitive quality--efficiency trade-offs. Loop Guidance further improves both primary metrics across all three tested models; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, it raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的循环框架（looping framework），在冻结的 flow-matching 图像生成器内部、单次降噪调用中对选定的 transformer 层进行重复更新，从而在不改变权重或外部采样器的前提下利用额外推理计算提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有生成器通常通过增加采样步数来消耗测试时计算，但这会反复评估整个降噪器，使质量提升与采样器成本强耦合；作者希望在冻结的 transformer 降噪器内部利用额外计算，同时保持原有生成管线不变。关键挑战在于如何决定哪些 token、层和采样时刻应接受重复更新。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的循环框架：Dense 与 Sparse Token Loop 控制 token 作用范围；Sampling-Progress Gating 与循环层范围决定循环在何时、何处生效；循环次数与强度控制重复更新程度；Loop Guidance 将普通与循环的矢量场预测进行组合。整体流程在每次降噪调用中反复应用选定的 transformer 层。
AI.result: 在两个 Scale-RAE 模型规模上，循环变体提升了主要与辅助质量指标，并具有有竞争力的质量-效率权衡；Loop Guidance 在全部三个测试模型上进一步改善了两项主要指标，其中 Scale-RAE DiT2.4B 的 GenEval 从 0.4471 提升至 0.5691，DPG-Bench 从 0.7656 提升至 0.8053。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的循环框架为冻结的 flow-matching 生成器提供了一种有竞争力的质量提升途径，通过将额外计算投入降噪器内部而非增加采样步数，显著改善质量指标并保持良好效率。

title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
comment: 12 pages. Accepted to the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) workshop at COLM 2026 (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/luoojason/muddle
summary: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MUDDLE，一个受控基准，用于分离文档问答系统中“上下文过长”与“干扰项主题过近”两种失效因素。通过 270 个人工标注问题，每个问题在五种条件下实例化（仅源文档、含 2/4 个主题相似的硬负例、含 2/4 个长度与来源匹配的随机干扰项），并利用 LLM 评判器在三类模型族上评测。结果显示硬负例比长度匹配的随机文档更显著地降低准确率（虽然效应较小），而随机文档接近无干扰基线。
AI.motivation: 文档问答系统日益面向检索到的文档集合作答，而非单一干净来源，因此对干扰上下文的鲁棒性与阅读理解能力同等重要。当系统失败时，常常无法判断是上下文过长还是干扰项离主题太近所致，因为以往工作往往把这两种效应混为一谈。需要一个能区分两者的受控基准。
AI.method: 构建 MUDDLE 基准：包含 270 个人工标注问题，每个问题对应单一源文档，并实例化为五种条件（源文档单独、源文档加 2 或 4 个主题相似硬负例、源文档加 2 或 4 个随机干扰项）。随机干扰项与硬负例在长度和来源上匹配，从而使两臂之间的准确率差异反映主题相似度而非长度。所有五种条件均渲染为 markdown、页面图像和原始 PDF，但干扰项扫描实验在 markdown 下运行（因为源文档加干扰项超出当前图像和 PDF 输入限制）。答案由覆盖三个模型族的 LLM 评判器评分。
AI.result: 在完整 markdown 扫描中，对于 gpt-5-mini，硬负例在两种上下文规模下都比长度匹配的随机文档更显著地降低准确率，而随机文档几乎保持在无干扰基线水平。该效应虽小但方向一致；对 gpt-5-mini 而言，在跨上下文规模汇总时，硬负例的表现显著低于长度匹配的随机干扰项。作者发布了数据与评测代码以支持可复现的上下文退化研究。
AI.conclusion: MUDDLE 成功地将上下文长度效应与主题相似性效应分离开来，表明前者的下降主要源于主题相近的干扰项而非文档长度本身。该基准可作为研究上下文退化、评估检索增强系统鲁棒性的可复现工具。

title: Unsupervised Multi-Scale Gromov-Wasserstein Hypergraph Alignment
summary: We study unsupervised hypergraph alignment, where the goal is to infer node correspondences between two hypergraphs using only structural information, without node features, labels, seed matches, or side information. Direct higher-order formulations can represent hyperedge interactions faithfully, but they can be computationally demanding and cumbersome for non-uniform hypergraphs. Graph-reduction approaches introduce a different challenge: clique expansions keep the alignment problem on the original node set but collapse all hyperedge evidence into one pairwise graph, whereas bipartite expansions preserve incidence structure but enlarge the problem from nodes to nodes plus hyperedges. We introduce FALCON (Filtration-based hypergrAph aLignment via Cross-scale Optimal traNsport), an unsupervised optimal-transport framework for hypergraph alignment. Instead of representing each hypergraph by a single collapsed clique graph, FALCON constructs a filtration-induced sequence of clique-based co-occurrence dissimilarity matrices and jointly aligns all levels through one shared multi-scale Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) objective. The shared transport plan enforces a globally consistent node correspondence across filtration levels while avoiding the auxiliary hyperedge nodes introduced by bipartite expansion. Experiments on perturbation benchmarks derived from real-world hypergraphs show that FALCON is robust to structural noise and in almost all cases outperforms strong graph- and hypergraph-alignment baselines.

AI.tldr: FALCON 是一种无监督超图对齐框架，通过过滤诱导的团扩展共现相异度矩阵序列，利用共享的多尺度 Gromov–Wasserstein 最优传输目标联合对齐所有尺度，在无需节点特征、标签或种子匹配的情况下实现跨超图的节点对应推断，并在真实超图扰动基准上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 无监督超图对齐旨在仅利用结构信息推断两个超图间的节点对应关系。现有方法存在两难：直接的高阶公式能忠实表示超边交互但计算代价高且难以处理非均匀超图；图归约方法中，团展开会将所有超边证据塌缩为一张两两图而丢失结构信息，二部图展开虽保留关联结构却把问题从节点扩展到节点加超边，增大了规模。因此需要一种既能忠实利用超边结构、又不引入额外节点且计算可行的对齐框架。
AI.method: FALCON 提出基于过滤的超图对齐与跨尺度最优传输框架。它不将每个超图表示为单一的塌缩团图，而是构造由过滤（filtration）诱导的团式共现相异度矩阵序列，并通过一个共享的多尺度 Gromov–Wasserstein (GW) 目标联合对齐所有过滤尺度。共享的传输计划在多个过滤层级间强制全局一致的节点对应关系，同时避免了二部图展开所引入的额外超边节点。
AI.result: 在由真实世界超图衍生的扰动基准实验中，FALCON 对结构噪声具有鲁棒性，并且在几乎所有情况下均优于强图对齐与超图对齐基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FALCON 通过过滤诱导的多尺度共现表示与共享最优传输计划，在保真度、计算可行性与尺度适度性之间取得良好平衡，为无监督超图对齐提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案，克服了高阶直接公式和图归约方法各自的局限。

title: SafeAtlas-VL: Beyond Binary Multimodal Safety with Large-Scale Data and Guard Models
summary: Multimodal safety moderation requires distinguishing risks arising from visual content, user intent, and assistant behavior. Existing safeguards, however, are typically trained for a single judgment target and reduce safety assessment to a binary decision. Consequently, risk becomes difficult to compare across a multimodal interaction, and ambiguous cases are obscured. We introduce SafeAtlas-VL, a dataset of 1.5M training instances that places image-, request-, and response-level judgments on a five-level ordered scale. We curate a broad collection of safety-relevant data from both real-world and synthetic sources and apply a disagreement-aware annotation procedure. The resulting dataset spans 15 harm categories and 55 fine-grained subcategories, covering a broad range of multimodal safety scenarios. We also construct SafeAtlas-Bench, a held-out set of 5,000 instances for evaluating five-level predictions and continuous risk scores. Upon this dataset, we train the SafeAtlas Guard series of models via target-conditioned tuning for multimodal safety detection. Our models not only perform five-way classification of safety levels but also map safety to continuous scores through a soft cumulative ordinal head. Experimental results demonstrate that guard models trained on our dataset exhibit strong generalization: even without using the training sets of other benchmarks, they achieve competitive performance on the corresponding test sets. Notably, our 8B model attains the overall best performance, outperforming the previous SOTA by approximately 4% in F1 score. Code, data, and models are released to support further research. Warning: this paper contains example data that may be offensive, harmful, graphic, or disturbing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SafeAtlas-VL，一个包含 150 万条训练样本的多模态安全审核数据集，将图像级、请求级和响应级判断统一到五级有序量表上，并配套 5000 条样本的 SafeAtlas-Bench 评测集；在此基础上通过目标条件微调和软累积序数头训练出 SafeAtlas Guard 系列模型，其 8B 模型在五级分类与连续风险评分任务上超越此前 SOTA 约 4% 的 F1 值。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态安全护栏通常只针对单一判断目标（图像、请求或响应），且将安全评估简化为二元决策，导致风险难以在多模态交互中进行跨层级比较，模糊/歧义案例也难以被刻画。这促使作者设计一个支持多目标、多级粒度统一评估的数据集与方法。
AI.method: 构建 SafeAtlas-VL 数据集：从真实与合成来源汇集安全相关数据，采用不一致性感知（disagreement-aware）标注流程，覆盖 15 个大类与 55 个细分子类的多模态安全场景，并对图像级、请求级、响应级判断统一标定五级有序量表；构造 SafeAtlas-Bench（5000 条）用于五级预测与连续风险评分评测；通过目标条件微调（target-conditioned tuning）训练 SafeAtlas Guard 系列模型，并设计软累积序数头（soft cumulative ordinal head）将安全等级映射为连续风险分数。
AI.result: Guard 模型展现出强泛化能力：即使不使用其他基准的训练集，也能在对应测试集上取得有竞争力表现；其中 8B 模型获得总体最优性能，相比此前 SOTA 在 F1 上提升约 4%。代码、数据与模型均已开源。
AI.conclusion: SafeAtlas-VL 与 SafeAtlas Guard 系列验证了以五级有序量表统一图像、请求与响应三个层面的安全判断，并结合目标条件微调与序数回归头，能有效提升多模态安全审核的细粒度判别能力与跨基准泛化性，为后续多模态安全研究提供了数据与模型基础。

title: Subtraction-Based Tumor Segmentation and Lesion-Centered pCR Prediction for the MAMA-MIA Challenge
summary:
We describe the submission of team FME to the MAMA-MIA Challenge, which evaluated primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) from pretreatment dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI on an external multi-country cohort. For segmentation, we trained a five-fold residual-encoder nnU-Net ensemble using only the first post-contrast minus pre-contrast image, combined with mirroring test-time augmentation and largest-connected-component filtering. For pCR prediction, we ensembled 25 pretrained 3D video classifiers trained on lesion-centred crops from the pre-contrast and first two post-contrast volumes. FME ranked second in both tasks. The segmentation method achieved a combined performance-fairness score of 0.882, with Dice 0.713 and normalized Hausdorff distance 0.099. The pCR method achieved a combined score of 0.664, balanced accuracy of 0.541, and equalized-odds disparity of 0.212. The results indicate that subtraction-based input and ensembling support robust tumor segmentation under cross-site domain shift, whereas pCR prediction from baseline DCE-MRI alone remains limited.
  For the submission repository, see https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/MAMA-MIA-Challenge-FME

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了FME团队在MAMA-MIA挑战赛中的方案：采用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成进行乳腺肿瘤分割（使用首期增强减影图像），并集成25个预训练3D视频分类器进行病理完全缓解（pCR）预测。团队在两个任务中均排名第二，实验表明减影输入与集成方法可提升跨站点域迁移下的分割鲁棒性，而仅凭基线DCE-MRI进行pCR预测仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 在外部多国队列上，评估基于治疗前动态增强乳腺MRI（DCE-MRI）的乳腺原发肿瘤自动分割与病理完全缓解（pCR）预测性能，以考察方法在跨中心域偏移下的泛化与公平性，并探究仅用基线DCE-MRI预测pCR的可行性。
AI.method: 分割任务采用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成，仅使用首期增强减预扫描（subtraction）图像作为输入，并结合镜像测试时增强和最大连通分量过滤。pCR预测任务集成25个预训练3D视频分类器，输入为以病灶为中心的、取自预扫描及前两期增强扫描的三维裁剪块。
AI.result: 两个任务均排名第二。分割任务综合性能-公平性得分为0.882，Dice为0.713，归一化Hausdorff距离为0.099；pCR任务综合得分为0.664，平衡准确率为0.541，等几率差异（equalized-odds disparity）为0.212。
AI.conclusion: 减影输入结合集成策略能够在跨站点域偏移下实现稳健的肿瘤分割；但仅基于基线DCE-MRI进行pCR预测的判别能力仍然有限，可能需要在时间序列信息或补充模态上进一步挖掘。

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
summary: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出面向儿科重症疾病沟通(SIC)训练的基准套件与仿真框架，包括PitfallBench和DialogueBench两个基准，以及一个名为SIC-Agents的自改进框架，通过生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档来引导模拟器行为，实验证明其优于静态专家提示。
AI.motivation: 儿科重症疾病沟通(SIC)至关重要，但面向临床医生的可扩展沟通培训仍然有限。与其他对话仿真场景相比，儿科SIC面临额外挑战：多方交互、需要回应父母情绪困扰、强烈依赖反馈动态。现有基于LLM的仿真器只优化通用对话质量，而非SIC训练所需的课程依从行为，因此需要专门针对儿科SIC训练的仿真框架与评测基准。
AI.method: 与教育者和儿科临床医生合作，构建了首个针对儿科SIC训练的基准套件与仿真框架。基准包括PitfallBench和DialogueBench，分别在回合级别和完整对话级别评估模拟器。提出SIC-Agents自改进框架，该框架生成临床医生可编辑的技能文档以指导模拟器行为。
AI.result: 实验表明SIC-Agents在表现上优于静态专家提示方法。同时，研究团队发布了面向儿科SIC家长仿真的基准供后续研究使用。
AI.conclusion: SIC-Agents通过自改进技能文档机制有效提升了儿科SIC仿真器的训练适配度，超越静态专家提示，并开源基准以推动该领域的可扩展沟通培训研究。

title: LLMODE: Aligning ODEs with LLMs via Gated Token Injection for Irregular Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for spatio-temporal forecasting, but existing approaches often rely on regularly sampled token sequences and struggle with irregular observations because of temporal asynchrony, representation-space misalignment, and limited context windows. We propose LLMODE, a token-efficient framework for irregular spatio-temporal forecasting with a frozen LLM backbone. LLMODE first uses a graph-aware ODE encoder to reconstruct irregular graph observations as a continuous-time latent trajectory. A Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler then compresses this variable-length trajectory into a fixed number of dynamic memory tokens.
