In parallel, compact statistical descriptors are encoded and resampled into context memory tokens. A dual-source gated cross-attention module injects both memories into the frozen LLM, enabling controlled utilization of external spatio-temporal evidence. Experiments on three real-world urban datasets and two physical-dynamics benchmarks show competitive overall performance, with clearer advantages under sparse or dynamically complex irregular sampling. Additional evaluations on unseen urban regions further demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization without adaptation.

AI.tldr: LLMODE 是一个面向不规则时空预测的 token 高效框架，它利用图感知的 ODE 编码器将不规则图观测重建为连续时间隐轨迹，并通过 Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler 将变长轨迹压缩为固定数量的动态记忆 token，同时用双源门控交叉注意力将外部时空证据注入冻结的 LLM，在不改动 LLM 的前提下实现具有竞争力的预测性能和强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在时空预测中有前景，但现有方法依赖规则采样的 token 序列，难以处理不规则观测，主要存在三个问题：时间异步、表示空间错位以及有限的上下文窗口。
AI.method: LLMODE 包含三个核心组件：(1) 图感知 ODE 编码器，将不规则图观测重建为连续时间隐轨迹；(2) Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler，把变长轨迹压缩为固定数量的动态记忆 token，并在并行路径上用紧凑统计描述符编码为上下文记忆 token；(3) 双源门控交叉注意力模块，将两类记忆注入冻结的 LLM，实现对外部时空证据的可控利用。
AI.result: 在三个真实城市数据集和两个物理动力学基准上的实验显示整体性能具有竞争力，在稀疏或动力学复杂的不规则采样场景下优势更为明显；在未见过的城市区域上的额外评估进一步表明无需适配即可实现强大的零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: LLMODE 通过将外部时空证据以固定预算的 token 形式注入冻结的 LLM，有效解决了不规则时空预测中的时间异步、表示错位与上下文窗口限制问题，兼顾了 token 效率、预测性能与零样本泛化能力。

title: Clustering as Approximation by Constrained Projectors: Theory and Guarantees
summary: This paper develops a unified theoretical framework showing that a broad family of clustering methods, including k-means, fuzzy c-means, kernel k-means, kernel FCM, and spectral clustering, can all be expressed as structured low-rank projectors acting on a signal-derived matrix. By formulating each method as an instance of min over B in C of ||M - M P_B||_F^2, with different constraint sets C, we establish a common optimization template that clarifies the algebraic links among hard, fuzzy, kernel-induced, and orthonormal projections. Within this framework, we derive non-trivial theoretical results, including geodesic convexity properties on the projection manifold, perturbation bounds quantifying stability to matrix noise, and exact recovery guarantees under ideal block-model conditions. The analysis further explains when different clustering families collapse to the same optimal subspace and how deviations arise under small inter-cluster leakage. Overall, the work provides a coherent, theory-first foundation for understanding clustering through structured projectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的理论框架，证明包括k-means、模糊c-means、核k-means、核FCM和谱聚类在内的广泛聚类方法都可表示为作用在信号派生矩阵上的结构化低秩投影算子，并通过统一的优化模板 min_{B∈C} ||M - M P_B||_F² 揭示硬聚类、模糊聚类、核诱导与正交投影之间的代数联系；在此基础上推导出测地凸性、扰动界和精确恢复保证等理论结果，为基于结构化投影的聚类理解提供了理论优先的连贯基础。
AI.motivation: 现有各种聚类方法（硬、模糊、核化、谱聚类等）看似形式迥异、理论分析各自为政，缺乏一个统一的代数视角来揭示它们之间的内在联系与差异，也难以在统一框架下进行稳定性与恢复性的理论分析。
AI.method: 作者将多种聚类方法统一建模为投影优化问题 min_{B∈C} ||M - M P_B||_F²，其中M为信号派生矩阵，P_B为结构化低秩投影算子，不同的约束集C对应不同的聚类族（如硬、模糊、核诱导、正交投影）。在该统一优化模板下，借助投影流形上的几何工具推导测地凸性、推导扰动界以刻画对矩阵噪声的稳定性，并在理想块模型假设下证明精确恢复保证，同时分析各聚类族在何种条件下收敛到同一最优子空间以及小簇间泄漏导致的偏差。
AI.result: 得到若干非平凡理论结果：投影流形上的测地凸性性质、量化矩阵噪声稳定性的扰动界、理想块模型条件下的精确恢复保证；并解释了不同聚类族坍缩到相同最优子空间的条件以及小簇间泄漏下偏差产生的机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了以结构化投影为核心的、理论优先的统一聚类理论框架，为理解硬、模糊、核与谱聚类之间的代数联系及其稳定性、可恢复性提供了连贯的数学基础。

title: Mapping-Based Image Diffusion
summary: In this work, we introduce a novel tensor-based functional for targeted image enhancement and denoising. Via explicit regularization, our formulation incorporates application dependent and contextual information using first principles. Few works in literature treat variational models that describe both application dependent information and contextual knowledge of the denoising problem. We prove the existence of a minimizer and present results on tensor symmetry constraints, convexity, and geometric interpretation of the proposed functional. We show that our framework excels in applications where nonlinear functions are present such as in gamma correction and targeted value range filtering. We also study general denoising performance where we show comparable results to dedicated PDE-based state of the art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于张量的新型变分泛函，用于图像增强与去噪，通过显式正则化将应用相关的上下文信息和去噪问题的先验知识统一纳入同一框架。作者证明了极小值存在性，并分析了张量对称性约束、凸性及几何解释；在存在非线性函数（如伽马校正、目标值域滤波）的应用中表现优异，去噪性能与基于偏微分方程的最先进方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有文献中很少有变分模型能同时刻画应用相关信息与去噪问题的上下文先验知识；作者旨在构建一个统一的变分框架，将两者通过显式正则化有机结合，以解决目标化图像增强与去噪任务。
AI.method: 提出一个基于张量的新型泛函，采用显式正则化将应用依赖信息与上下文信息纳入公式；理论方面证明极小值的存在性，并给出张量对称性约束、凸性条件和几何解释；实验上应用于伽马校正和目标值域滤波等非线性场景，并评估通用去噪性能。
AI.result: 该框架在存在非线性函数的应用中（如伽马校正、目标值域过滤）表现优异；在通用图像去噪方面取得了与代表性的基于PDE的最先进方法相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该基于张量的正则化变分框架能够有效融合应用上下文与去噪先验，兼具理论保证（极小值存在、对称约束、凸性、几何可解释性）与实践优势，在目标化增强和非线性滤波任务中具有推广潜力。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoCoA 框架，通过双上下文训练实现情境条件化的文化对齐，使大语言模型在有文化线索时偏好文化适宜实体、无线索时保持中立，将文化偏置分数从 43 降至 24，同时保持近中立偏好且对一般性能影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在跨文化情境中普遍偏向西方相关实体。传统的去偏方法追求统一中立性，但文化偏置的缓解需要情境条件化行为：当存在文化线索时偏好文化适宜的实体，无线索时保持中立，以实现更合理的文化对齐。
AI.method: 提出 CoCoA（Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment）框架，通过在同一实体对上、在有/无文化线索的两种上下文下进行双上下文训练来学习该行为。该方法结合对比对齐目标、校准与漂移正则化，并通过目标感知的梯度调和（goal-aware gradient reconciliation）进行优化。
AI.result: 在 CAMeL 与 Camellia 两个实体中心的文化偏置基准上、跨越十种语言设置和四个大语言模型进行评测。CoCoA 将文化偏置分数平均从 43 降至 24，同时在 50.2 处保持近中立偏好，且对五个标准基准上的通用性能影响最小。
AI.conclusion: 有效的文化对齐需要情境条件化建模而非统一的去偏方法，CoCoA 验证了这一思路，并为缓解大语言模型中实体中心的文化偏置确立了新的研究方向。

title: Reward-guided Fine-Tuning of One-Step Generative Models via Wasserstein Gradient Flow
summary: To mitigate the time complexity of generative models, one-step generative models have recently emerged through direct mapping from noise to data in a single forward pass. However, the reward-guided fine-tuning method of one-step generative models remains largely unexplored. To address this, we consider one-step generators from an optimal transport view, investigating Wasserstein Gradient Flow (WGF) for modeling smooth and controlled distributional evolution in probability space. We then propose a novel reward-guided fine-tuning of a one-step generative model via WGF. We derive a practical training method that requires no reward gradients, thereby handling both non-differentiable and differentiable rewards. Moreover, our method provides smooth and stable reward-guided distributional updates while mitigating reward hacking and mode collapse. Experiments on 2D synthetic data, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet 256$\times$256 with diverse rewards, including JPEG (in)compressibility, class probability, Black-and-White and CLIP alignment, show that our method achieves better reward alignment compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文从最优传输视角出发，提出基于Wasserstein梯度流（WGF）的一步生成模型奖励引导微调方法，通过无需奖励梯度的实用训练算法，实现平滑稳定的分布演化，并在多种奖励与数据集上取得优于基线的奖励对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型通过单次前向传播直接从噪声映射到数据，显著降低了生成模型的时间复杂度，但其奖励引导微调方法尚未被充分探索。现有研究缺乏对一步生成器在概率空间中平滑、受控的分布演化建模，因此需要一种能够处理非可微与可微奖励、同时避免奖励攻击和模式崩溃的微调框架。
AI.method: 将一步生成器置于最优传输视角下，利用Wasserstein梯度流（WGF）对概率空间中的分布演化进行平滑、受控的建模，并提出基于WGF的奖励引导微调方法。推导出一种无需奖励梯度的实用训练方法，因此既可处理不可微奖励也可处理可微奖励，同时提供平滑稳定的分布更新。
AI.result: 在2D合成数据、CIFAR-10和ImageNet 256×256上，针对JPEG（不可）压缩性、类别概率、黑白与CLIP对齐等多种奖励进行实验，结果表明所提方法相比基线实现了更好的奖励对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的WGF-based奖励引导微调方法能够实现平滑稳定的奖励引导分布更新，有效缓解奖励攻击（reward hacking）与模式崩溃（mode collapse）问题，并在多种奖励和数据集上取得优于基线的奖励对齐性能。

title: Emergent Misalignment Is Not Magical
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on narrowly harmful datasets can lead to misalignment broadly, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). EM poses a challenge for AI safety and our understanding of LLMs. Prior work often frames EM as an unexpected behavior, and explains it by appealing to general misalignment directions or anthropomorphizing it as acquiring an evil persona. However, the mechanisms behind these framings remain obscure. In this work, we show that EM is a predictable and data-dependent generalization phenomenon. By examining the base model's representation of EM training data and evaluation prompts, we find that evilness after EM training is highly predictable from representational distance: the closer an evaluation prompt is to training data centroid, the more evilness it elicits from EM models after training (with an average Spearman correlation of -0.73 across 12 model-dataset settings). Building upon this analysis, we further demystify EM by showing that (1) its effectiveness changes significantly based on training data format; (2) there is not a general misalignment direction that transfers across different EM models; (3) the effect of EM is fundamentally different from persona changes. Furthermore, we extend the EM generalization metric from a scalar distance to a dataset-specific generalization direction, which robustly predicts EM models' evilness under semantics-preserving prompt perturbations including appending random tokens and paraphrasing, where other methods do not reliably generalize.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型中的涌现性失对齐（EM）并非意外行为，而是一种可预测的、数据依赖的泛化现象。通过分析基础模型对EM训练数据与评估提示的表示距离，作者发现训练后模型产生的"邪恶程度"与提示到训练数据质心的表示距离高度相关（Spearman相关系数平均-0.73），并进一步证明了EM效果依赖于训练数据格式、不存在跨模型通用的失对齐方向、且与人格改变有本质区别；最后将泛化度量从标量距离扩展为数据集特定的泛化方向，可稳健预测语义保持扰动下的邪恶程度。
AI.motivation: 先前工作常将EM视为意外行为，或通过笼统的失对齐方向、拟人化的"邪恶人格"来解释，但这些框架背后的机制仍然模糊，缺乏对EM内在机理的清晰理解。
AI.method: 通过检查基础模型对EM训练数据与评估提示的表示，提出用表示距离（提示到训练数据质心的距离）预测EM模型的邪恶程度；并设计了三个分析实验（训练数据格式变化、跨模型失对齐方向迁移、与人格改变的对比），最后将标量距离扩展为数据集特定的泛化方向以增强扰动鲁棒性。
AI.result: 表示距离与EM邪恶程度高度相关（12个模型-数据集设置下平均Spearman相关系数-0.73）；EM效果显著依赖训练数据格式；不存在跨EM模型通用的失对齐方向；EM效应与人格改变根本不同；数据集特定的泛化方向能稳健预测语义保持扰动（追加随机token、改写）下的邪恶程度，而其他方法无法可靠泛化。
AI.conclusion: EM是一种可预测的、数据依赖的泛化现象而非神秘意外，这为理解并潜在缓解EM提供了可操作的机制性视角。

title: Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates
summary: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff rho=0.25, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that sensitivity is localized at architecture-specific depths: the CNN peaks at a mid/late encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks in an early encoder stage on both datasets. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练后对内部表征进行定点低通滤波干预，系统研究了三种分割架构（CNN、SSM、Transformer）在特征域上的频谱鲁棒性。结果显示特征域低频干预会引发与数据集强相关的严重性能退化（CVC上Dice下降最高达100%，而ISIC上仅最多10.3%），且敏感性集中在架构特定的编码器深度；该退化在输入域上通过傅里叶增强不可缓解，表明特征域频谱鲁棒性与输入域频谱鲁棒性存在本质区别。
AI.motivation: 现有分割模型的鲁棒性评估大多关注输入域扰动，而模型学习到的特征表示对频率内容的依赖尚不明确。为填补这一空白，作者希望在特征域层面探测分割模型对高频信息的依赖程度，并考察其跨架构、跨数据集的差异。
AI.method: 对三种分割架构（ResNet50-UNet/CNN、VM-UNet/SSM、Swin-UNETR/Transformer）在CVC-ClinicDB和ISIC2018上进行训练后（post-training）内部表征的定点低通滤波干预实验，在未触碰的留存测试集上评估；同时进行单阶段干预以定位敏感深度，并测量原生特征域频谱能量，最后结合傅里叶增强（Fourier augmentation）做对照实验。
AI.result: 在cutoff rho=0.25时，CVC上特征域低通滤波使CNN、SSM、Transformer的Dice分别下降100%、73.2%、30.9%，而ISIC上仅分别下降9.4%、10.3%、0.6%，跨数据集差异对所有架构均统计显著。敏感性定位于架构特定深度：CNN在中/晚编码器块达到峰值，SSM在早期编码器阶段达到峰值。原生特征域频谱测量显示CVC上高频能量与脆弱性呈负相关，该关系在ISIC上仅部分成立。傅里叶增强仅改善输入域鲁棒性，特征域退化基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 特征域频谱鲁棒性具有强数据集依赖性、架构特异性和与输入域频谱鲁棒性的本质区别；高频能量与脆弱性的负相关仅被视为候选关联而非已证实的机制。研究提示应把特征域频谱鲁棒性作为独立维度纳入分割模型鲁棒性评估。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Journal of Learning Analytics (LAK27 research track). Artifact: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lak-27-A618
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM评分器视为测量学意义上的"评分员"，在双语公开语料（ENEM/Essay-BR与ASAP）上执行预注册的评分员效应检验组（多面Rasch严重度、残差晕轮、概化/决策研究、跨版本漂移、差异功能）。发现LLM裁判之间严重度差异巨大（ENEM上跨度达219分/1000分，ASAP上占分值范围15-33%，远超受训人类间约1%的差距），人机相关处于区分度低下的0.47-0.56区间；所有五个版本对比均产生超出族系置换零假设的严重度偏移（最高133分），一个裁判被身份金丝雀检测出问题并中途弃用。两项预注册假设得到诚实的零结果：严重度调整后的排行榜反转未通过置换检验，且"静默漂移"被证伪。复现显示自洽性（k≤2时phi≥0.80）但不等于人类水平准确性；在匹配仪器与校准后的同类检验中，未发现裁判晕轮效应超出受训人类范围的可靠证据。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作学习分析中的作文评分器，但现有评估几乎只依赖一致性（agreement）统计量。教育测量学明确指出评分员作为测量工具会存在严重度差异（severity）、晕轮效应（halo）和漂移（drift），因此需要超越简单的一致性指标，系统检验LLM裁判是否具备合格评分工具应有的测量学性质。研究旨在把LLM裁判当作评分员，用严格的预注册检验组量化这些风险。
AI.method: 采用预注册的评分员效应检验组（rater-effects battery），将LLM裁判视为测量工具中的评分员。具体手段包括：多面Rasch模型估计严重度；残差分析检测晕轮效应；概化理论与决策研究（G/D study）评估复现可靠性与决策信度；跨版本对比考察模型版本更替引起的严重度偏移（并采用族系置换零假设）；差异功能分析（DIF）；身份金丝雀（identity canaries）监测裁判身份；在两种语言、四个提供商、五个版本对比、复制单元格上对2,377篇作文、12名裁判进行系统评测，并以分数张量（score tensor）形式发布数据。同时执行两项预注册检验（严重度调整后的排行榜反转、静默漂移）并采用同类仪器匹配对照来复核晕轮效应。
AI.result: 实证结果显示：裁判严重度在ENEM的0-1000分制上跨度达219分，ASAP上小组离散度为分值范围的15-33%，而受训人类间的差距仅约1%；人机相关系数处于区分度低下的0.47-0.56区间。全部五个版本对比都产生超出族系置换零假设的严重度偏移（最高133分），一名裁判被身份金丝雀识别出异常并被中途弃用。两项预注册检验得到诚实的零结果：严重度调整后的排行榜反转未通过置换检验，且"静默漂移"被证伪（在五个对比中有四个的评分一致性随严重度同步变化）。复现实验表明LLM裁判具有自洽性（k≤2时phi≥0.80），但未达到人类水平准确性；经同类仪器和标定匹配后，未发现裁判晕轮效应超出受训人类范围的可靠证据，推翻了自己此前基于未匹配数据的晕轮比较结论。
AI.conclusion: 单纯以一致性统计量评价LLM评分器会掩盖严重的测量学缺陷：LLM裁判在严重度、版本稳定性等方面远逊于受训人类，复制自洽（高phi）并不等于测量有效性；而一旦进行恰当的仪器与校准匹配对照，先前一些看似显著的缺陷（如晕轮超标、排行榜反转）并不成立。结论是评估LLM评分器必须采用正式的教育测量框架（Rasch严重度、概化理论、置换检验、身份监测），预注册与诚实的零结果报告不可或缺，且应警惕未匹配比较带来的误导性结论。

title: A Target-Centric Survey of Quantization-Aware Training
summary: The rapid development of LLMs incurs prohibitive memory footprints and intensive computational demands. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) techniques have emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by explicitly simulating quantization effects during model training, yielding low-bit models that achieve accuracy comparable to their full-precision counterparts. In this work, we provide a target-centric survey of QAT, aimed at clarifying both its theoretical foundations and its evolving implementation landscape. We systematically review existing QAT methods through a target-centric taxonomy and synthesize cross-target differences in error characteristics, numerical formats, and strategy transferability. We further summarize QAT evaluation paradigms and discuss challenges in optimization and deployment, outlining potential directions for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文对面向大语言模型的量化感知训练（QAT）进行了以目标（target）为中心的综述，系统梳理了QAT的理论基础、方法演化、跨目标差异与评估范式，并展望了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的快速发展带来了巨大的显存占用和密集的计算需求，而量化感知训练（QAT）通过在模型训练过程中显式模拟量化效应，成为在低比特精度下保持与全精度模型相近准确率的有前景解决方案，因此需要对该领域进行系统的梳理与总结。
AI.method: 采用以目标（target）为中心的视角展开综述：首先构建QAT的target-centric分类体系，系统回顾现有QAT方法；随后交叉对比不同目标在误差特性、数值格式和策略可迁移性上的差异；最后归纳QAT的评估范式并讨论优化与部署中的挑战。
AI.result: 形成了一套系统的QAT综述框架：给出target-centric分类法，综合分析了跨目标的误差特性与数值格式差异，总结了策略迁移规律及评估范式，并识别出当前在优化与部署层面存在的开放性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为QAT是缓解LLM存储与计算压力的有效途径，通过对现有方法的系统分类与跨目标对比，厘清了其理论依据与实现图景，并据此指出了未来研究需要关注的方向。

title: Beyond Correctness: Validity-Oriented Evaluation of Biomedical LLM Judges
summary: We propose a scalable, validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce. First, we augment existing human-labelled biomedical benchmarks with deterministic, metric-grounded mutations that produce auditable preference pairs. Second, we evaluate judges beyond aggregate correctness using three deployment-relevant dimensions: correctness against metric-derived gold labels, robustness under repeated stochastic sampling, and compliance with the requested output format. We use this pipeline to assess Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four regimes: (1) base, using the instruct model as is; (2) SFT, distillation-based supervised fine-tuning only; (3) RL, GRPO-based reinforcement learning only; and (4) SFT$\rightarrow$RL, SFT followed by RL. The base and single-stage regimes struggle on structured medical discrimination such as PICO extraction and clinical calculations, whereas SFT$\rightarrow$RL performs best across correctness, compliance, and robustness; gains concentrate on decomposable tasks (PICO, MedCalc), at times matching or outperforming frontier models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向生物医学领域 LLM 裁判的可扩展、面向有效性的评估流水线：通过确定性、基于指标的变异扩充现有的人类标注基准以生成可审计的偏好对，并从正确性、随机采样鲁棒性和输出格式合规性三个部署相关维度评估裁判；在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的四种训练范式（base、SFT、RL、SFT→RL）中，SFT→RL 表现最佳，在 PICO 抽取和 MedCalc 等可分解任务上甚至可媲美或超越前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 高质量的人类评判标注在生物医学领域稀缺且成本高昂，导致难以对 LLM 裁判（judge）进行可靠评估；现有评估多仅关注聚合正确率，忽略了鲁棒性、格式合规性等部署相关维度。
AI.method: 构建一个可扩展、以有效性为导向的评估流水线：(1) 对已有的人类标注生物医学基准施加确定性、基于指标的变异，生成可审计的偏好对；(2) 从三个部署相关维度评估裁判——针对指标派生金标签的正确性、重复随机采样下的鲁棒性、以及输出格式合规性；(3) 将该流水线用于评估 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在四种训练机制下的表现：base（直接使用）、SFT（仅基于蒸馏的监督微调）、RL（仅 GRPO 强化学习）、SFT→RL（先 SFT 后 RL）。
AI.result: base 和单阶段训练机制在 PICO 抽取、临床计算等结构化医学判别任务上表现不佳；SFT→RL 在正确性、合规性和鲁棒性上均最佳，增益集中在可分解任务（PICO、MedCalc），有时能达到甚至超越前沿模型的水平。
AI.conclusion: SFT 后接 RL 的两阶段训练是提升生物医学 LLM 裁判有效性的有效途径，而所提出的变异增强流水线能够在人类标注稀缺时提供可审计、多维度的裁判评估方案。

title: A Tensor Variational Formulation of Gradient Energy Total Variation
summary: We present a novel variational approach to a tensor-based total variation formulation which is called gradient energy total variation, GETV. We introduce the gradient energy tensor [6] into the GETV and show that the corresponding Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation is a tensor-based partial differential equation of total variation type. Furthermore, we give a proof which shows that GETV is a convex functional. This approach, in contrast to the commonly used structure tensor, enables a formal derivation of the corresponding E-L equation. Experimental results suggest that GETV compares favourably to other state of the art variational denoising methods such as extended anisotropic diffusion (EAD)[1] and total variation (TV) [18] for gray-scale and colour images.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于张量的全变分新方法——梯度能量全变分（GETV），将梯度能量张量引入总变分框架，证明了其凸性，并形式化推导出张量型欧拉-拉格朗日方程；实验表明其在灰度与彩色图像去噪上优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和标准全变分（TV）等主流方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结构张量的全变分模型难以形式化推导对应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程，限制了其数学分析与理论保证。本文引入梯度能量张量，旨在解决该问题，使张量型总变分模型能够获得严格的解析推导。
AI.method: 提出梯度能量全变分（GETV），将梯度能量张量引入总变分 formulation 中；通过证明 GETV 是凸泛函来保证解的良好性质，并由此形式化地推导出相应的、全变分类型的张量偏微分方程（欧拉-拉格朗日方程），与常见结构张量方法形成对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪任务中，GETV 的性能优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和标准全变分（TV）等最新的变分去噪方法。
AI.conclusion: GETV 作为一种基于梯度能量张量的凸变分公式，弥补了结构张量全变分模型在形式化推导方面的不足，并在实验中展现出优于现有主流去噪方法的潜力，是一种有前景的图像去噪框架。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure; accepted at ASIS&T METSTI
summary: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.

AI.tldr: 提出一种本体引导的多智能体框架，用于从学术评述、书评等文本中抽取评价对象（评估对象），通过候选发现、本体约束分类与领域评审三个环节，显著优于规则与零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 学术评论、书评等文本包含对理论、方法、文献、制度与政策的评价性陈述，是学术评价的重要证据来源。然而现有科学实体抽取方法主要面向研究论文，对评价对象（通常抽象、依赖上下文、类型边界模糊）抽取效果不佳，缺乏专门方法。
AI.method: 提出本体引导的多智能体框架（ontology-guided multi-agent framework），包含三个主要环节：候选发现（candidate discovery）、本体约束分类（ontology-constrained classification）、领域评审（domain review）。框架利用本体界定评价对象的类型边界，并通过多智能体工作流协同完成抽取与审核。
AI.result: 实验结果为：精确率90.33%、召回率84.55%、实体级F1为87.34%、严格类型F1为79.78%、类型准确率91.35%，显著优于基于规则和零样本的基线。消融实验显示多智能体工作流提升了召回率与稳定性，本体边界约束增强了细粒度分类并减少类别混淆。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效支持评价性学术文本的结构化利用，为基于证据的研究评价和科技情报（STI）挖掘提供了方法论支撑。

title: Creation begins with understanding: LLMs as strategy designers for privacy-preserving tabular data synthesis
summary: Sharing tabular data in high-stakes domains is constrained by privacy regulations. Synthetic data offer a promising alternative, but deep generative models are costly to train and difficult to audit, while LLM-based methods often serialize records as text, obscuring tabular structure and exposing sensitive data. We introduce Tabular Synthesis Strategy Designer (TabSSD), which uses an LLM to design synthesis procedures rather than directly generate records. TabSSD provides the LLM with tree-derived summaries of variable dependence rather than raw records, which produces Python programs for local execution and evaluation. Across twelve datasets, TabSSD strikes a favourable balance among statistical fidelity, predictive utility, and empirical privacy risk, achieving the best average rank across six metrics among ten methods. Moreover, it substantially reduces local computation and token consumption relative to the compared methods. By enabling human-guided refinement and eliminating user-side model tuning, TabSSD lowers the expertise and infrastructure barriers to transparent tabular data synthesis.

AI.tldr: TabSSD 是一种基于 LLM 的表格数据合成方法，它不直接生成记录，而是让 LLM 依据变量依赖关系的树形摘要来设计合成策略并生成可本地执行的 Python 程序。在 12 个数据集上，它在 10 种方法、6 项指标中取得最佳平均排名，同时大幅降低计算和 token 消耗，降低透明表格数据合成的专业门槛。
AI.motivation: 高风险的表格数据共享受隐私法规限制，合成数据是可行方案，但深度生成模型训练成本高且难以审计，而现有 LLM 方法通常将记录序列化为文本，既模糊了表格结构又可能暴露敏感数据。因此需要一种兼顾保真度、实用性与隐私保护、且透明可审计的合成方法。
AI.method: TabSSD 利用 LLM 设计合成流程而非直接生成记录。具体做法是：向 LLM 提供基于树结构推导出的变量依赖关系摘要（而非原始记录），让 LLM 据此生成 Python 程序，并在本地执行和评估这些程序，从而完成表格数据合成。
AI.result: 在 12 个数据集上，TabSSD 在统计保真度、预测效用和经验隐私风险之间取得了良好平衡，在 10 种方法的 6 项指标中获得最佳平均排名；同时显著降低了本地计算量和 token 消耗，并支持人工引导式改进、无需用户侧模型调参。
AI.conclusion: TabSSD 通过让 LLM 设计可执行、可审计的合成策略而非直接生成敏感记录，降低了透明表格数据合成所需的专业知识和基础设施门槛，为隐私受限场景提供了一种高效、低开销且平衡的合成数据方案。

title: APIFlow-Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Survive Long, Dependent API Workflows
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Under review at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents (IAEval). Harness, frozen task bank, and 44,362 execution transcripts: https://github.com/postmanlabs/APIFlow-Bench
summary: Tool-using agents are commonly evaluated by a single bit: whether an end-to-end workflow completed. This metric fails to distinguish failures that matter in production, such as expired credentials, malformed payloads, or correct execution followed by incorrect final delivery. We introduce APIFlow-Bench, a fully auditable benchmark for long-horizon, dependent REST-API workflows that decomposes performance into seven engineering capabilities and requires agents to produce answers supported by the actual call path. We generate synthetic API worlds forward, subtask by subtask; each subtask is admitted only after a zero-LLM self-test triad verifies its grader and an oracle establishes solvability, and an adversarial audit identified and fixed six grader exploits. Grading is deterministic and provenance-sensitive: a state check traces a mock-minted canary through the API data flow to the response the answer must originate from, and a typed answer card is verified field by field. We release all answer keys and 44,362 unredacted execution transcripts. Across 19 frontier and open-weight models under one neutral scaffold, we find: (1) longer dependency chains degrade success, from 93% on individual subtasks to 74% on clean 20-subtask chains and 61% when including the 8% of chain trials that a model-consensus screen flags as passed by no model; (2) reliability separates models more than best-case capability, with best-of-five spanning seven points but all-five-of-five reliability spanning 44 points; (3) the independent-error account of compounding failure does not fit the data: pass rates on 20-subtask chains are 33 percentage points above the product of subtask-level rates, and on the clean slice 77% of failing runs reached the correct final state and failed only at delivery.

AI.tldr: 提出 APIFlow-Bench，一个完全可审计的基准，用于评估工具使用型智能体在长程、有依赖关系的 REST-API 工作流上的表现。它将性能分解为七项工程能力，使用确定性且具备来源追踪能力的自动评分，并发布全部答案键与 44,362 份未删减执行记录。在 19 个前沿与开源模型上的实验表明：依赖链越长成功率越低；可靠性比最佳案例能力更能区分模型；累积性失败的独立误差解释与数据不符——多数失败发生在正确的最终状态之后、仅差在最终交付环节。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用型智能体评测通常只用"端到端工作流是否完成"这一单一比特来衡量，无法区分生产中真正重要的失败模式（如凭证过期、载荷格式错误、执行正确但最终交付错误），因此缺乏细粒度的、可审计的评测手段来定位系统瓶颈。
AI.method: 生成不断向前扩展的合成 API 世界，按子任务逐步构建；每个子任务须通过无 LLM 的零样本自测三元组（验证评分器）及 oracle（确认可解性）后才被纳入，并经过对抗性审计修复了六个评分器漏洞。评分是确定性且与来源（provenance）敏感的：状态检查通过一枚模拟铸造的 canary 令牌沿 API 数据流追踪到答案必须来源的响应，并用类型化答案卡逐字段校验。基准将性能分解为七项工程能力。
AI.result: 在统一的被动脚手架下评测 19 个前沿与开源模型，发现：(1) 依赖链越长成功率越低，从单个子任务的 93% 降到干净 20 子任务链的 74%，若计入经模型共识筛选出 8% 无模型通过的链式试验则降至 61%；(2) 可靠性比最佳案例能力更能区分模型，best-of-five 差距 7 个百分点，而 all-five-of-five 可靠性差距达 44 个百分点；(3) 独立误差对复合失败的预测与数据不符：20 子任务链的通过率比子任务级通过率之积高出 33 个百分点，且在干净切片上 77% 的失败运行达到了正确的最终状态，仅失败在最终交付环节。作者还发布了全部答案键和 44,362 份未删减执行记录。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，将评估从单一的端到端成功比特转向可审计、来源敏感、按能力分解的细粒度评测，能揭示出可靠性（而非最佳案例能力）才是区分模型的关键维度；同时，长程失败主要源于最终交付环节而非逐步累积的独立错误，这提示代理评测与应用优化应重点关注交付可靠性，并提供了完全公开的数据以支持进一步研究与可复现性。

title: Dynamic-Robust Photometric-Semantic Reconstruction for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: The integration of novel view synthesis (NVS) and open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) has recently yielded powerful feed-forward 3D foundation models. However, their inherent reliance on static-scene assumptions leads to severe misalignment of spatial features in unconstrained dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose SPAR, a novel joint semantic-geometric encoding architecture that explicitly isolates transient dynamic noise prior to latent space aggregation. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic-region-aware end-to-end training paradigm that structurally couples motion estimation with multi-view visual and semantic learning. This unified approach enables the network to inherently resolve motion conflicts and distill multi-view consistent, temporally stable scene representations from dynamic inputs. Extensive experiments on the challenging D-RE10K benchmark demonstrate that SPAR achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our end-to-end approach achieves exceptional novel view synthesis quality, yielding a PSNR of 22.15 dB and 23.33 dB given only 3 and 4 input views respectively. Despite being trained in a self-supervised manner, our model achieves an mIoU of 88.5% for motion mask prediction. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a strong inter-task synergy between photometric scene reconstruction and semantic understanding, where semantic synthesis learning consistently enhances photometric fidelity in novel view rendering. Code will be available at https://github.com/dmucby/SPAR.

AI.tldr: SPAR提出一种联合语义-几何编码架构，通过显式隔离瞬态动态噪声并采用动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，解决了NVS与开放词汇分割在非受限动态场景中的特征错位问题，在D-RE10K基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的前馈式3D基础模型虽然将新颖视图合成（NVS）与开放词汇分割（OVS）集成取得了强大效果，但它们依赖静态场景假设，导致在非受限动态环境下空间特征严重错位。为此需要弥合这一关键差距。
AI.method: 提出SPAR：1）一种联合语义-几何编码架构，在潜在空间聚合前显式隔离瞬态动态噪声；2）一种动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，将运动估计与多视角视觉和语义学习结构化耦合。该统一方法使网络能够内在解决运动冲突，并从动态输入中蒸馏出多视角一致、时间稳定的场景表示。
AI.result: 在D-RE10K基准上达到SOTA：仅用3个和4个输入视图时，NVS的PSNR分别达22.15 dB和23.33 dB；尽管以自监督方式训练，运动掩码预测的mIoU仍达88.5%。分析还表明光度重建与语义理解之间存在强跨任务协同效应。
AI.conclusion: SPAR通过显式处理动态噪声与端到端动态感知训练，在动态环境中实现了高质量的新颖视图合成与语义理解，并揭示了语义合成学习可持续提升光度重建保真度的跨任务协同关系。

title: Argument-Aware Semantic Alignment of Normative Texts: A Toulmin-Based Neuro-Symbolic Approach
summary: Semantic alignment between specialized normative texts is challenging when equivalent requirements use different terms, syntax, and levels of abstraction. Lexical overlap, distributional embeddings, and semantic similarity capture topical relatedness but often miss the argumentative structure by which normative claims are supported, qualified, and justified. This paper asks whether explicit argument structure adds information complementary to neural semantics for aligning requirements. We treat cross-standard control mapping as argument-aware semantic alignment and build a neuro-symbolic pipeline that combines neural text representations with Toulmin features. An LLM explicitation step identifies claims, grounds, warrants, qualifiers, and backing and reconstructs enthymemes. These feed an alignment model via argument-aware similarity and structural features. On a NERC-CIP to NIST-CSF mapping benchmark, argument-derived features improve alignment over a neuro-symbolic semantic baseline. Feature selection shows especially strong signal from warrant-related features, indicating that the link between a claim and its supporting reasoning is not captured by conventional similarity alone. A compact claim--grounds--warrant subset remains competitive with the full Toulmin feature set. The results give preliminary evidence that argument structure is a useful intermediate representation for aligning specialized normative texts. Cybersecurity standards are used as a controlled testbed, not as proof of domain-independent generalization. The argument graphs produced by LLM explicitation may also support later work on retrieval, reasoning, and explanation over normative text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号流水线，将神经文本表示与Toulmin论证结构特征（主张、理由、依据、限定词、支援）相结合，用于跨标准规范文本的语义对齐。在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF的映射基准上，论证派生特征显著提升了神经符号语义基线的对齐性能，其中"依据(warrant)"相关特征贡献最强，且精简的claim–grounds–warrant子集与完整Toulmin特征集表现相当，表明论证结构是规范文本对齐的有效中间表示。
AI.motivation: 专门化规范文本之间的语义对齐具有挑战性：等价需求可能使用不同的术语、句法和抽象层次。传统的词面重叠、分布嵌入和语义相似度只能捕捉主题相关性，却常常忽略规范主张赖以支撑、限定和论证的论证性结构。因此本文探究显式论证结构是否能提供神经语义之外的补充信息，用于需求对齐任务。
AI.method: 将跨标准控制映射建模为论证感知的语义对齐，构建神经符号流水线：首先用LLM显式化步骤抽取论证主张(claims)、理由(grounds)、依据(warrants)、限定词(qualifiers)和支援(backing)，并重构省略式论证(enthymemes)；随后将这些论证信息通过论证感知相似度和结构特征馈入对齐模型，并与神经文本表示融合。
AI.result: 在NERC-CIP到NIST-CSF映射基准上，论证派生特征相较神经符号语义基线进一步提升了对齐效果。特征选择显示warrant相关特征信号尤其强烈，说明主张与其支持推理之间的连接无法被常规相似度单独捕获；紧凑的claim–grounds–warrant特征子集与完整Toulmin特征集性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果提供了初步证据，表明论证结构是对齐专门化规范文本的有用中间表示。同时作者审慎指出，网络安全标准仅作为受控测试平台，并不证明领域无关的泛化；LLM显式化产生的论证图还可支持后续针对规范文本的检索、推理与解释工作。

title: Last Step Matters: Early Uncertainty Cannot Predict Failure in Long-Horizon Agents
comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Early failure prediction is important for long-horizon agents, as it enables timely intervention and can reduce inference and tool-use costs. Uncertainty quantification, such as verbal confidence and perplexity, offers a promising approach to detecting agent failures; however, it has not been explored whether these signals retain their discriminative power during the intermediate stages of long-horizon execution. We evaluate mainstream uncertainty signals on deep-research tasks and find that verbal confidence reliably distinguishes failures at trajectory completion, achieving a mean AUROC of 0.85, whereas all evaluated signals offer limited predictive value earlier in execution, with none exceeding a mean AUROC of 0.60 at 50% trajectory progress. We identify an underlying mechanism explaining this gap: path switching, where agents frequently abandon their current search direction in-trajectory, breaking the link between early signal and final outcome. These findings challenge the assumption that intermediate uncertainty can reliably guide early intervention. They also motivate a practical recommendation for agent harnesses in deep-research settings: use final-step confidence to decide whether to restart, an approach that our experiments find more effective than in-trajectory intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时程智能体在执行过程中的早期失败预测问题。作者在深度研究（deep-research）任务上评估了主流不确定性信号，发现口头置信度（verbal confidence）在轨迹完成时能有效区分失败（平均AUROC 0.85），但在执行中途所有信号预测价值有限（50%进度时均不超过0.60）。其机制是"路径切换"（path switching）——智能体频繁放弃当前搜索方向，切断了早期信号与最终结果之间的联系。因此作者建议在实际系统中采用最终步置信度决定是否重启，而非中途干预。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体的早期失败预测至关重要，它能够实现及时干预并降低推理和工具调用成本。虽然不确定性量化（如口头置信度、困惑度）是检测智能体失败的潜在手段，但尚未有研究验证这些信号在长时程执行中间阶段是否仍保持判别能力，因此需要系统评估其时间维度上的有效性。
AI.method: 在深度研究（deep-research）任务上，作者评估了主流不确定性信号（口头置信度、困惑度等），在轨迹的不同进度节点（包括50%进度和轨迹完成时）衡量其区分成功/失败的能力，使用平均AUROC作为评估指标，并进一步分析造成信号失效的底层机制（路径切换）。
AI.result: 口头置信度在轨迹完成时能可靠区分失败（平均AUROC 0.85），但在执行早期所有信号预测价值有限——50%进度时没有任何信号的平均AUROC超过0.60。研究发现"路径切换"是造成这一差距的机制：智能体经常在轨迹中途放弃当前搜索方向，导致早期信号与最终结果之间的关联断裂。
AI.conclusion: 研究挑战了"中间阶段不确定性可可靠指导早期干预"的假设。在深度研究场景中，作者提出实用建议：智能体harness应使用最终步置信度来决定是否重启，实验表明这比轨迹中途干预更有效。这为长时程智能体的失败处理策略提供了新的设计方向。

title: More Perspectives, Stronger Signals: Multi-Perspective Enhancement and Progressive Fusion for Multimodal Entity Representation Learning
summary: Learning effective multimodal entity representations is fundamental for reasoning tasks such as multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC). However, existing methods often suffer from semantic over-smoothing within modalities and ineffective noise filtration across modalities, particularly under sparse or ambiguous conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrismF, a unified framework that synergizes multi-perspective enhancement with progressive fusion to extract stronger signals from diverse inputs. PrismF enhances fine-grained intra-modal semantics through a multi-perspective mechanism that decomposes each modality into complementary views and constrains them with a decoupling loss to reduce representation collapse. Furthermore, it improves cross-modal integration through a progressive fusion strategy that dynamically calibrates inter-modal interactions, enabling the model to emphasize informative signals while suppressing noisy or unreliable ones. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks show that PrismF achieves the strongest overall performance, including relative improvements of 4.04% in MRR and 11.17% in Hits@1 on KVC16K. Our code can be found at https://github.com/HubuKG/PrismF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrismF，一个统一的多模态知识图谱补全框架，通过多视角增强（multi-perspective enhancement）与渐进式融合（progressive fusion）协同作用，在稀疏或模糊条件下提取更强的多模态实体表示，并在三个公开基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态实体表示学习方法存在两个主要缺陷：一是模态内部存在语义过度平滑（semantic over-smoothing）问题，导致表示坍缩；二是模态间噪声过滤效果不佳，尤其在数据稀疏或语义模糊条件下难以区分有效信息与噪声，限制了多模态知识图谱补全（MMKGC）的性能。
AI.method: PrismF包含两个核心组件：1）多视角增强机制：将每个模态分解为互补的视角（views）以增强细粒度的模态内语义，并通过解耦损失（decoupling loss）约束这些视角，减少表示坍缩；2）渐进式融合策略：动态校准模态间交互，使模型能强调信息丰富的信号同时抑制不可靠或含噪的信号，实现更优的跨模态整合。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上的大量实验表明，PrismF取得了最强综合性能，其中在KVC16K数据集上MRR相对提升4.04%，Hits@1相对提升11.17%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PrismF通过将"模态内多视角解耦增强"与"模态间渐进式噪声抑制融合"相结合，有效解决了多模态表示学习中的语义过度平滑与跨模态噪声问题，为多模态知识图谱补全提供了更鲁棒且性能更优的解决方案。

title: Foundational feature fusion for conditional flow matching in 6D pose estimation
summary: Conditional flow matching has enabled a step forward in object 6D pose estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by progressively denoising and registering object representations to observed scenes. Existing methods require training task-specific encoders supervised on object-scene overlap and rely on trivial feature fusion strategies to resolve pose ambiguities. We present FunFlow6D, a novel flow matching-based formulation that leverages features from geometric and appearance foundation models for pose estimation, eliminating the need for task-specific encoder training. We also introduce a cross attention-based fusion mechanism that dynamically combines geometric and appearance features to provide richer conditioning for the flow matching module. Experiments on four datasets from the BOP benchmark show that FunFlow6D outperforms the previous state of the art while reducing supervision requirements and memory overhead. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/FunFlow6D/.

AI.tldr: FunFlow6D 提出了一种基于条件流匹配的 6D 物体姿态估计方法，利用几何与外观基础模型的特征，通过交叉注意力融合机制为流匹配模块提供更丰富的条件信息，从而无需训练任务特定的编码器，在 BOP 基准的四个数据集上超越了现有最优方法，同时降低了监督需求和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流匹配的 6D 姿态估计方法需要训练任务特定的编码器，并依赖物体-场景重叠监督，且使用简单特征融合策略，难以解决姿态歧义问题。作者旨在消除任务特定编码器训练的需求，并通过更有效的特征融合来缓解姿态歧义。
AI.method: 提出 FunFlow6D：1) 使用几何与外观基础模型（foundation models）提取特征，替代任务特定编码器训练；2) 引入基于交叉注意力的融合机制，动态组合几何与外观特征，为流匹配模块提供更丰富的条件信息；3) 整体基于条件流匹配框架，通过逐步去噪并注册物体表示到观测场景来完成 6D 姿态估计。
AI.result: 在 BOP 基准的四个数据集上的实验表明，FunFlow6D 优于此前最先进方法，同时降低了监督要求与内存开销；大量消融实验验证了各提出组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: FunFlow6D 证明了利用基础模型特征与交叉注意力融合可以简化 6D 姿态估计流程，在提升精度的同时降低训练开销，为流匹配类姿态估计方法提供了更高效、更通用的方案。

title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
comment: 30 pages, plus 29 pages of references and appendices
summary: Modern systems in artificial intelligence (AI) somehow excel in domains for which they seem poorly suited. Intelligence has traditionally been modeled as operating over structured combinations of symbols, such as logical formulas. However, the strongest modern AI systems are based on neural networks, which instead represent information in continuous vectors. Vectors seem inadequate for capturing the structure of language, logic, and other cognitive domains, yet neural networks achieve impressive performance in these areas. How do they do it? In this work, we propose a potential answer: Despite appearances, perhaps the internal representations of neural networks implicitly realize symbolic structure. In support of this hypothesis, we show that the vector representations of a variety of neural networks can be closely approximated with symbolic structures: we can replace the network's entire representation-generating process with a closed-form equation instantiating a symbolic structure, and the network's behavior remains largely unchanged. This finding holds for both small-scale neural networks trained to manipulate lists as well as large language models (LLMs) operating in four domains that are central in symbolic traditions: arithmetic, logic, computer code, and language. Further, our symbolic approximation allows us to modify an LLM's behavior in targeted ways via precise interventions on its internal representations, showing that the LLM's behavior is reliant on the symbolic structures we have identified. This work provides a potential way to reconcile longstanding symbolic conceptions of intelligence with the vector-based nature of modern AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个假设来解释现代AI（神经网络）在符号性任务上的成功：尽管神经网络用连续向量表征信息，但其内部表征可被符号结构（closed-form方程）高度近似。作者证明多种神经网络（从小型列表操作网络到大型语言模型）的表征生成过程可被符号结构方程替代，且行为基本不变；并通过对LLM内部表征的精准干预修改其行为，验证了行为确实依赖这些符号结构。这为调和符号主义与联结主义提供了可能路径。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为智能本质上是对符号组合（如逻辑公式）的结构化操作，而最强现代AI基于神经网络的连续向量表征，向量看似无法捕捉语言、逻辑等认知领域的结构，但神经网络却在这些领域表现优异。这一矛盾促使作者探究：神经网络究竟如何借助看似不具结构的向量实现符号性能力？是否其内部表征实际上隐式实现了符号结构。
AI.method: 作者提出通过符号结构来近似神经网络的内部表征：即用实例化符号结构的封闭形式方程替换网络整个表征生成过程，并检验网络行为是否基本不变。实验覆盖两类对象：一是被训练来操作列表的小型神经网络；二是大型语言模型（LLM），在四个符号主义核心领域——算术、逻辑、计算机代码和语言上进行验证。此外，作者利用该符号近似，通过对LLM内部表征进行精确干预来定向修改其行为，以证明行为确实依赖所识别的符号结构。
AI.result: 实验表明，多种神经网络的向量表征能够被符号结构紧密近似：替换表征生成过程后网络行为基本保持不变，该结论同时适用于小型列表操作网络和LLM的四个领域。进一步的干预实验显示，基于符号近似对LLM内部表征进行精准干预可定向改变其行为，证明LLM的行为依赖于文章中识别出的符号结构。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络的内部表征隐式地实现了符号结构，这解释了为何基于向量的现代AI能在传统符号性领域表现出色。该工作为弥合长期以来的符号主义智能观与现代AI的向量本质之间的分歧提供了一条潜在路径。

title: Higher-Dimensional Rotary Position Embedding
summary: Transformers rely on position embedding mechanisms in long context modeling in most cases. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) embeds positional information with independent 2D rotations, forming relative position terms in self-attention. However, its pairwise, block-based, and decoupled structure limits deep mixing and robustness across channels. We propose HD-RoPE, which extends RoPE from independent 2D rotations to higher-dimensional rotations and introduces a Paley-I orthogonal basis to obtain balanced, isotropic, and dense phase mixing within each rotation subspace. This significantly enhances channel coupling and rotational degrees of freedom while maintaining orthogonal stability and the relative position closure property. Furthermore, HD-RoPE is easily optimized for engineering efficiency without introducing additional trainable parameters. We have conducted extensive evaluation results demonstrating that HD-RoPE achieves significant performance improvements over standard RoPE across various popular benchmarks and in both long and short contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出HD-RoPE，将旋转位置编码(RoPE)从独立二维旋转推广到高维旋转，并引入Paley-I正交基实现子空间内均衡、各向同性且稠密的相位混合，在不引入额外可训练参数的情况下提升通道耦合与旋转自由度，在长短上下文基准上均显著优于标准RoPE。
AI.motivation: 标准RoPE通过独立的二维旋转嵌入位置信息，形成注意力中的相对位置项，但其成对、分块且解耦的结构限制了跨通道的深度混合与鲁棒性，在长上下文建模中成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 将RoPE从独立二维旋转扩展为高维旋转，引入Paley-I正交基以在每个旋转子空间内获得均衡、各向同性且稠密的相位混合，在增强通道耦合与旋转自由度的同时保持正交稳定性及相对位置封闭性；该方法易于工程优化且不引入额外可训练参数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HD-RoPE在多个主流基准上以及长、短上下文场景中相较标准RoPE均取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: HD-RoPE通过高维旋转与Paley-I正交基设计，在保持正交性和相对位置性质的同时突破了RoPE通道间独立旋转的局限，成为一种更稳健、高效且无需额外参数的位置编码方案。

title: JudgePanel: A Compact Judge with Panel Deliberation via Adaptive Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative to human evaluation. However, single-model judges are limited by their inherent model biases, while multi-agent evaluation protocols that mitigate this through diverse deliberation are prohibitively expensive at inference time. To this end, we propose \textbf{\modelname}, which equips a compact \underline{Judge} model with multi-agent \underline{Panel} deliberation capability. Specifically, we first train on panel deliberation traces from an ensemble of strong evaluators, capturing structured patterns of discussion, disagreement, and resolution. To further improve judgment quality beyond SFT, we introduce \textit{AdaReward}, an adaptive multi-reward RL algorithm that dynamically rebalances reward component weights as different objectives saturate at different rates during RL training. For practical deployment, we further design a lightweight domain specialization module for rapid adaptation to new evaluation domains with few hundred labeled samples. As a result, (i) \textit{Novel}: the first framework to equip a single compact judge with multi-agent panel deliberation capability at single-model inference cost; (ii) \textit{Effective \& Reliable}: JudgePanel with a 14B backbone outperforms judge-specialized models up to 70B across four evaluation benchmarks, demonstrates strong position consistency, and rapidly specializes to new domains with few hundred samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JudgePanel，通过在紧凑的 Judge 模型上注入多智能体 Panel 研讨能力，使单个小型模型以单模型推理成本获得多评估者协商的评判质量；并引入自适应多奖励强化学习算法 AdaReward 及轻量级领域特化模块，在多个评估基准上超越最高 70B 的专用审判模型。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 是人工评估的可扩展替代方案，但单一模型审判受固有模型偏见限制；通过多种多样协商来缓解偏见的多智能体评估协议在推理时成本过高。因此需要一种兼顾评判质量与推理效率的方法。
AI.method: 1) 先在由强评估器集成生成的 panel 研讨轨迹上进行训练，捕捉讨论、分歧与解决的结构化模式；2) 提出 AdaReward，一种自适应多奖励 RL 算法，在训练过程中根据不同目标以不同速率饱和而动态重平衡奖励分量权重；3) 设计轻量级领域特化模块，仅需数百个标注样本即可快速适配新评估领域。
AI.result: JudgePanel 以 14B 主干在四个评估基准上超越最高 70B 的审判专用模型，展现出较强的位置一致性，并能在数百个样本下快速特化到新领域。
AI.conclusion: JudgePanel 是首个让单一紧凑审判模型具备多智能体 panel 研讨能力、且推理成本与单模型相当的系统性框架；实验表明其兼具有效性、可靠性与领域可迁移性，为高效、去偏的 LLM 评估提供了新范式。

title: Multi-Scale Temporal Domain Alignment for Federated Video Domain Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Open-source will be available
summary: Federated Video Domain Adaptation (FVDA) enables collaborative learning across distributed and non-IID video datasets while preserving privacy, but is under-explored due to challenges in aligning temporal information. We propose Multi-scalE Temporal domAin aLignment (METAL), a novel framework that leverages temporal information at multiple resolutions to improve cross-domain video action recognition with only model parameter transfers. METAL trains per-scale transformer encoders on source-clients, then performs independent knowledge voting at each temporal scale to generate robust pseudo-labels on the target-server. A novel $L_2$ variance penalty enforces cross-scale consistency during scale-based knowledge distillation, preventing a singular dominant scale. The late fusion aggregates features across different scales, where the fusion head is trained via knowledge distillation using confidence-weighted aggregation of scale-wise predictions, enabling the model to effectively exploit complementary temporal information for final predictions. Experiments on Epic-Kitchens-55 and Daily-DA demonstrate state-of-the-art performances, with gains up to 28.47% over current FDA methods. Ablation studies prove that multi-scale distillation and scale coordination are critical for effective temporal knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出METAL框架，通过多尺度时间域对齐解决联邦视频域适应（FVDA）中的时间信息对齐难题。该方法在源客户端训练各尺度的Transformer编码器，在目标服务器端按时间尺度独立投票生成伪标签，引入L2方差惩罚保证跨尺度一致性，并通过置信度加权聚合与知识蒸馏训练融合头以聚合互补的时间信息，最终在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上取得SOTA性能，较现有FDA方法最高提升28.47%。
AI.motivation: FVDA虽然能实现分布式非IID视频数据的隐私保护协作学习，但该方向研究不足，主要难点在于跨域视频数据的时间信息对齐尚未得到有效解决。
AI.method: METAL框架包含四个关键组件：(1) 在源客户端训练多尺度（per-scale）Transformer编码器；(2) 在每个时间尺度上独立进行知识投票，生成鲁棒的伪标签；(3) 在基于尺度的知识蒸馏过程中引入新颖的L2方差惩罚，强制跨尺度一致性，避免单一主导尺度；(4) 采用晚期融合聚合不同尺度特征，融合头通过知识蒸馏训练，使用置信度加权的尺度级预测聚合，从而有效利用互补的时间信息进行最终预测。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上的实验取得最先进性能，相比现有FDA方法最高提升28.47%；消融实验证明多尺度蒸馏与尺度协调对有效的时间知识迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: METAL验证了多尺度时间信息利用与跨尺度一致性约束是FVDA中实现有效时间知识迁移的关键，为联邦视频域适应提供了新范式。

title: LoGo: Token-Level Dynamic Local-Global Attention
summary: As context lengths scale, attention increasingly becomes a primary computational bottleneck in large language models. Standard Transformers remain powerful but computationally inefficient, as they allocate the same attention budget to every token regardless of its contextual demand. Existing local-global hybrids provide a more efficient alternative by mixing restricted- and full-context attention, but they typically allocate span statically across layers or heads. To address these limitations, we propose LoGo, a token-level dynamic local-global attention mechanism that uses attention span as a direct proxy for attention budget allocation. Each LoGo layer contains coupled local and global branches: all tokens receive efficient local attention over a restricted context window, while a learned gate activates global attention with full-context access only for tokens requiring long-range information. A threshold-based budget controller maintains a target global ratio without auxiliary losses, and a progressive masking schedule stabilizes training before sparse routing takes effect. We further implement query-sparse Triton kernels that convert reduced global-attention computation into practical speedups. Extensive experiments validate LoGo's effectiveness, showing that it preserves the scaling behavior of full-attention Transformers across model sizes. In controlled comparisons, LoGo improves over the full-attention Transformer and matched-budget static local-global hybrids, with clear gains on long-range retrieval. Analysis further shows that LoGo learns interpretable span allocation patterns. These results suggest that learned token-level span allocation is an effective and scalable way to improve the long-context performance-compute trade-off.

AI.tldr: LoGo 提出了一种 token 级动态的局部-全局注意力机制，通过将注意力跨度作为注意力预算分配的代理，让所有 token 获得高效的局部注意力，同时由学习到的门控仅为需要长程信息的 token 激活全上下文的全局注意力，并配合基于阈值的预算控制器与渐进式掩码调度来稳定训练，最终在保持完整注意力 Transformer 扩展行为的同时提升了长上下文性能-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着上下文长度扩展，注意力成为大语言模型的主要计算瓶颈；标准 Transformer 对每个 token 分配相同的注意力预算，计算效率低下。现有的局部-全局混合方法虽然更高效，但通常在层或头维度静态分配注意力跨度，无法根据每个 token 的上下文需求进行自适应分配。
AI.method: 提出 LoGo：每个 LoGo 层包含耦合的局部分支和全局分支，所有 token 先经过受限窗口的高效局部注意力，再由学习到的门控仅为需要长程信息的 token 激活全上下文全局注意力；基于阈值的预算控制器在无辅助损失的情况下维持目标全局比例，渐进式掩码调度在稀疏路由生效前稳定训练；并实现了 query 稀疏的 Triton 内核，将减少的全局注意力计算转化为实际加速。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 LoGo 在不同模型规模下保持了全注意力 Transformer 的扩展行为；在受控对比中，LoGo 优于全注意力 Transformer 以及同预算的静态局部-全局混合模型，在长程检索任务上提升尤为明显；分析进一步显示其学会了可解释的跨度分配模式。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的 token 级注意力跨度分配是一种有效且可扩展的方式，能够改善长上下文场景下的性能-计算权衡，可作为大模型长上下文注意力机制的一项可行改进方案。

title: GraM-Diff: A Unified Graph-Mamba Diffusion Framework for EEG-Based Alzheimer's Disease Data Generation and Diagnosis
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a promising, non-invasive, and cost-effective modality for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, but deep learning methods are limited by small and imbalanced clinical datasets. Generative augmentation offers a solution, yet existing approaches rely on inefficient class-specific models or fail to capture complex spatial and temporal brain dynamics. To address this, we propose GraM-Diff, a unified classifier-guided Graph-Mamba diffusion framework for EEG synthesis. It embeds Graph Convolutional Networks within a diffusion U-Net to model inter-electrode connectivity and Bidirectional Mamba state-space blocks for linear-complexity long-range temporal modeling. Latent-space classifier guidance lets a single model generate both healthy and pathological EEG within a shared representation, avoiding fragmented per-cohort pipelines. Across four EEG-based AD benchmarks, synthetic augmentation improves classification, yields superior Context-FID and correlation scores over strong generative baselines, and enhances robustness in data-scarce settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GraM-Diff，一个统一的分类器引导的图-曼巴（Graph-Mamba）扩散框架，用于 EEG 合成以增强阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测。该框架将图卷积网络嵌入扩散 U-Net 以建模电极间连接，并使用双向 Mamba 状态空间块实现线性复杂度的长程时序建模，通过潜在空间分类器引导使单一模型同时生成健康与病理 EEG。在四个 EEG 基准上，合成增强提升了分类性能、Context-FID 与相关性分数，并在数据稀缺场景下增强了鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: EEG 是 AD 检测中有前景的无创、低成本手段，但深度学习方法受限于临床数据集规模小且类别不平衡。现有的生成式增强方法要么依赖低效的类别专属模型，要么无法捕获脑电中复杂的空间与时序动态，亟需一种高效且能建模完整脑动力学的统一生成方案。
AI.method: 提出 GraM-Diff 统一分类器引导的 Graph-Mamba 扩散框架：在扩散 U-Net 中嵌入图卷积网络（GCN）以建模电极间连接（空间拓扑），采用双向 Mamba 状态空间块实现线性复杂度的长程时序建模（时间依赖），并通过潜在空间分类器引导使单一共享表示模型同时生成健康和病理 EEG，避免碎片化的分队列流程。
AI.result: 在四个 EEG 的 AD 基准上，所提合成增强方法显著提升分类性能，在 Context-FID 与相关性分数上优于强生成基线，并在数据稀缺场景下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GraM-Diff 证明：通过统一的图-曼巴扩散生成框架同时建模空间连接与长程时序，并配合分类器引导，可以高效生成高质量 EEG 数据，有效缓解小样本与类别不平衡问题，从而提升 AD 检测的性能与鲁棒性。

title: An Explainable Coherence Score for Detecting Temporal Inconsistencies in Political News
summary: Temporal inconsistencies, such as mandates attributed outside their real interval, events presented as past before they occurred, or inverted causal sequences, are a form of political disinformation that evades style-based fake news detectors: a well-written article with a single wrong date carries no lexical signal of falsehood. This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), a continuous, intrinsically interpretable metric that quantifies the temporal coherence of a news article, computed by a four-stage pipeline: extraction of temporal facts, construction of a temporal knowledge graph, hierarchical verification against internal consistency rules and external reference sources, and score aggregation with automatically generated explanations. Verification combines eight internal checkers derived from Allen's interval algebra with a five-level external hierarchy ranging from a locally stored reference knowledge base of 1{,}256 curated political facts to live Wikidata SPARQL queries. On a benchmark of 100 political news articles with injected temporal errors, the system reaches a precision of 0.909 at the selected operating threshold, with a single residual false positive, a profile deliberately tuned for human-in-the-loop fact-checking assistance, where false alarms are costlier than missed detections. Unlike lexical baselines that output only a binary label, every flagged article is accompanied by the inconsistency type, the entities involved, and the reference source that contradicts the claim.

AI.tldr: 提出时间一致性分数（TCS），一种连续且可解释的指标，通过四阶段流水线（时间事实抽取、时间知识图谱构建、内部规则与外部来源的分层验证、分数聚合与解释生成）量化新闻文章的时间一致性，用于检测传统基于风格的假新闻检测器无法捕获的时间错乱型政治虚假信息。
AI.motivation: 时间不一致（如把事件归因到错误时间区间、把尚未发生的事件描述为过去、因果顺序颠倒）是一种政治虚假信息形式，文章措辞良好且只有个别日期错误时不携带任何词汇层面的虚假信号，因此能规避基于风格的假新闻检测器。需要一种不依赖表面语言线索、能捕捉时间逻辑矛盾并给出可解释依据的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出TCS指标及四阶段流水线：(1) 抽取时间事实；(2) 构建时间知识图谱；(3) 分层验证，融合来自Allen区间代数的八个内部一致性检查器与五级外部参考层次（从含1,256条精选政治事实的本地知识库到实时Wikidata SPARQL查询）；(4) 分数聚合并为每条标记的文本自动生成解释（包含不一致类型、涉及实体及矛盾参考来源）。
AI.result: 在100篇注入时间错误的政治新闻文章基准上，系统在选定操作阈值下达到0.909的精确率，仅有一个残留误报。该参数刻意针对人机协同事实核查场景进行调优，倾向于假警报比漏检代价更高的设定。
AI.conclusion: 与仅输出二元标签的词汇级基线不同，TCS为每条被标记的文章附带不一致类型、涉及实体以及与之矛盾的参考来源，从而提供可审计、可解释的输出，适合作为事实核查人员的人工辅助工具。

title: OPUS-V2: Bridging the Gap between Sparse Points and Dense Voxels
summary: The point-based occupancy prediction paradigm has achieved an attractive trade-off between accuracy and efficiency by modeling 3D space sparsely. However, its predictions inherently mismatch the dense voxel-based occupancy required by self-driving systems, necessitating hand-crafted heuristics during training and inference that limit final performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose OPUS-V2, a novel framework built upon the pioneering OPUS (occupancy prediction using a sparse set) point-based approach. OPUS-V2 incorporates a lightweight point-voxel transformation (PVT) module behind the decoder to adaptively map sparse predictions into the dense voxel space, eliminating the need for suboptimal operations and improving model accuracy. Furthermore, our architecture decouples feature and occupancy generation processes, allowing OPUS-V2 to adapt to arbitrary occupancy resolutions. OPUS-V2 achieves a state-of-the-art rayIoU of 44.0 on the Occ3D dataset. On the more challenging OpenOccupancy dataset, it attains a competitive 16.4 mIoU while running in real time at 20.6 FPS.

AI.tldr: OPUS-V2 在原有基于稀疏点集的占用预测框架 OPUS 基础上，引入轻量级点-体素变换（PVT）模块，将稀疏预测自适应映射到稠密体素空间，消除手工启发式操作，并在特征生成与占用生成之间解耦以支持任意占用分辨率，在 Occ3D 上取得 44.0 rayIoU 的 SOTA 结果，同时在 OpenOccupancy 上达到 16.4 mIoU 且以 20.6 FPS 实时运行。
AI.motivation: 基于点的占用预测范式通过稀疏建模 3D 空间，在精度与效率之间取得了良好平衡；但其预测结果本质上与自动驾驶系统所需的稠密体素占用表示不匹配，因而需要在训练和推理阶段引入手工设计的启发式操作，这些次优操作限制了最终性能。
AI.method: 提出 OPUS-V2 框架：在解码器后加入轻量级点-体素变换（PVT）模块，将稀疏预测自适应映射到稠密体素空间，从而消除次优的启发式操作并提升精度；同时将特征生成与占用生成过程解耦，使框架能够适应任意占用分辨率。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D 数据集上达到 SOTA 的 44.0 rayIoU；在更具挑战性的 OpenOccupancy 数据集上取得有竞争力的 16.4 mIoU，并以 20.6 FPS 实时运行。
AI.conclusion: OPUS-V2 通过稀疏到稠密的体素映射与生成过程解耦，在保持实时效率的同时显著提升了占用预测精度，实现了精度与速度的更好权衡。

title: Evaluating LLMs on Conversational Text-to-SQL under Chain Ambiguity and Intent Drift
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have established conversational text-to-SQL as a practical interface between users and databases, often involving multiple turns of clarification and revision. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate execution accuracy, leaving the unfolding and shifting of user intent across turns largely uncovered. To address this, we introduce TIDE-Bench, a benchmark for conversational text-to-SQL under chain ambiguity and intent drift evaluation, targeting two recurring patterns: chain ambiguity, where an underspecified question triggers layered clarification with conditional dependencies, and intent drift, where the user retracts and replaces a previously committed request element. Built on 514 anchor SQLs from BIRD, TIDE-Bench comprises 1,542 samples and introduces dedicated metrics for chain identification and drift recognition-resolution beyond execution accuracy. Evaluating 12 advanced LLMs reveals a persistent chain identification bottleneck unaffected by clarification frequency, a wide drift recognition-resolution gap, and overlap between failure modes when jointly activated. The corresponding code of TIDE-Bench is released for further research.

AI.tldr: 提出 TIDE-Bench，一个针对会话式 text-to-SQL 的基准，专门评估链式歧义（chain ambiguity）与意图漂移（intent drift），在 BIRD 基础上构建 514 条锚定 SQL 与 1,542 个样本，并引入超越执行准确率的链识别与漂移识别-解析专用指标。
AI.motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准主要评估执行准确率，忽略了多轮会话中用户意图的逐步展开与转变；尤其缺少对欠明确问题触发的分层澄清（链式歧义）以及用户撤回并替换已承诺请求要素（意图漂移）这两类常见模式的评测。
AI.method: 基于 BIRD 的 514 条锚定 SQL 构建共 1,542 个样本的 TIDE-Bench，覆盖两类模式：链式歧义（欠明确问题触发带条件依赖的分层澄清）与意图漂移（用户撤回并替换先前承诺的请求要素）；除执行准确率外，专门设计链识别（chain identification）与漂移识别-解析（drift recognition-resolution）两类指标。
AI.result: 对 12 个先进 LLM 的评测发现：链识别瓶颈持续存在且不受澄清频率影响；漂移识别-解析存在明显差距；当两类挑战同时触发时，失败模式出现重叠。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: TIDE-Bench 揭示了现有执行准确率指标无法覆盖的意图演化缺陷，说明链式歧义与意图漂移是需要独立专门评估的挑战；当前 LLM 在这两类模式上均有明显短板，为未来会话式 text-to-SQL 研究指明了方向。

title: ECA-BLS: An Efficient Complex-Augmented Broad Learning System
summary: Broad Learning System (BLS) is an efficient alternative to deep architectures due to its fast training, analytical learning, and strong generalization under limited data. However, existing BLS variants are confined to real-valued representations, restricting their ability to capture nonlinear interactions and second-order statistical dependencies inherent in real-world data. Notably, no prior BLS model fully exploits the complete second-order statistics that naturally emerge when data are embedded in the complex domain. To address this limitation, this paper introduces the first complex augmented Broad Learning System (CA-BLS), which transforms real-valued inputs into phase-encoded complex representations and adopts widely linear modeling to jointly leverage covariance and pseudo-covariance information via complex conjugate augmentation. This enables effective modeling of latent nonlinearities, coherence structures, and second-order dependencies inaccessible to conventional BLS formulations. To mitigate the additional computational cost of complex augmentation, an Efficient Complex Augmented BLS (ECA-BLS) is further developed, reformulating CA-BLS entirely in the real domain while preserving its exact decision function, achieving up to 75\% fewer multiplications and over 60\% fewer additions. A rigorous theoretical analysis proves the mathematical equivalence between CA-BLS and ECA-BLS, ensuring zero theoretical loss. Extensive experiments on 26 benchmark datasets from the UCI and KEEL repositories demonstrate that ECA-BLS consistently outperforms classical BLS and recent state-of-the-art randomized neural networks in accuracy, average rank, and statistical significance, establishing augmented second-order modeling as a critical and previously missing dimension of BLS research.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将复数增广建模引入Broad Learning System，提出CA-BLS，利用相位编码和宽线性建模同时利用协方差与伪协方差信息以捕获二阶统计依赖；进而提出在实数域精确等价重构的ECA-BLS，减少75%乘法与60%加法运算，并在26个UCI/KEEL基准数据集上优于经典BLS及最新随机神经网络。
AI.motivation: 现有BLS变体局限于实值表示，难以捕获真实数据中固有的非线性交互与二阶统计依赖；此前没有任何BLS模型能充分利用数据嵌入复数域时自然涌现的完整二阶统计量（协方差与伪协方差），这成为BLS研究的一个缺失维度。
AI.method: 提出首个复数增广Broad Learning System (CA-BLS)：将实值输入变换为相位编码的复数表示，采用宽线性建模，通过复数共轭增广联合利用协方差与伪协方差信息，从而建模传统BLS无法触及的潜在非线性、相干结构与二阶依赖。为缓解复数增广的额外计算开销，进一步提出Efficient Complex Augmented BLS (ECA-BLS)，将CA-BLS完全在实数域重构并保持其精确决策函数。
AI.result: ECA-BLS较CA-BLS减少多达75%的乘法运算和超过60%的加法运算；严格的数学证明表明CA-BLS与ECA-BLS等价、理论性能零损失；在26个UCI和KEEL基准数据集上，ECA-BLS在准确率、平均排名和统计显著性方面一致优于经典BLS及近期最先进的随机神经网络。
AI.conclusion: 增广二阶建模是BLS研究中此前缺失的关键维度；复数域表示与宽线性建模相结合能够有效捕获二阶统计依赖，且可通过实数域等价重构在几乎不损失性能的情况下大幅降低计算成本。

title: How Identity and Opinion Shape Political Sycophancy in LLMs
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly encourage users to disclose personal profiles for tailored assistance, measuring their political alignment becomes increasingly important. However, many existing benchmarks for assessing political behavior rely on closed-ended questions and do not fully capture how a model's stance may adapt to user-provided context during interaction. We introduce a framework that disentangles two distinct triggers of political sycophancy: opinion (aligning with explicit narratives) and identity (stereotyping based on demographic labels). Using 450 manually-checked political dilemmas as controlled probes, we evaluate 13 instruction-tuned LLMs. We uncover a dissociation: a model's susceptibility to explicit opinions does not necessarily predict its susceptibility to identity cues, and vice versa. When both signals are present, their effects are generally sub-additive rather than simply additive. Additionally, system-level personas primarily shift a model's baseline stance while having limited effect on the stance shift caused by user opinion or identity. Ultimately, our results suggest that LLM political stance is interactively and steerably vulnerable rather than being a fixed trait, highlighting how personalization may amplify identity- or opinion-conditioned shifts in the model's behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的政治谄媚行为解耦为两种触发因素：观点（迎合显式叙事）与身份（基于人口统计标签的刻板印象）。通过450个经人工核验的政治困境作为受控探针，评估13个指令微调LLM，发现模型对显式观点与身份线索的敏感性存在解离，且二者同时出现时效应呈次可加性，说明LLM的政治立场是可交互、可操控的脆弱属性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地鼓励用户披露个人资料以提供定制化服务，衡量其政治立场对齐变得日益重要。然而，现有评估政治行为的基准多依赖封闭式问题，无法充分捕捉模型在交互过程中如何根据用户提供的上下文调整自身立场。
AI.method: 提出一个将政治谄媚解耦为两种触发源的框架：观点型（迎合显式叙述）与身份型（基于人口统计标签的刻板印象）。使用450个经人工核验的政治困境作为受控探针，评估13个指令微调LLM，并系统性比较两种线索单独及同时出现时的效应，同时考察系统级人格对基线立场及用户线索引发立场偏移的影响。
AI.result: 发现观点敏感性与身份线索敏感性之间存在解离——模型对显式观点的易受影响程度并不能预测其对身份线索的易受影响程度，反之亦然。当两种信号同时出现时，其效应总体呈次可加性而非简单叠加。此外，系统级人格主要改变模型的基线立场，但对用户观点或身份引发的立场偏移影响有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM的政治立场并非固定特质，而是交互式且可操控的脆弱属性；个性化服务可能放大由身份或观点条件引发的模型行为偏移，这对AI对齐与政治中立性评估具有重要意义。

title: RLG-TPV: Radar- and LiDAR-Guided Tri-Perspective View Fusion for Camera-Radar 3D Object Detection
summary: Tri-Perspective View (TPV) representations describe 3D scene structure through top, side, and front feature planes, but existing TPV lifting is primarily camera-based, leaving the depth of sampled image evidence ambiguous along projected camera rays. We propose RLG-TPV, a multimodal TPV framework for camera-radar 3D object detection in which radar and training-time LiDAR provide complementary geometric guidance during representation construction. A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting. Because conventional radar provides limited elevation information, LiDAR-derived class-occupancy targets supervise the side and front planes during training; the corresponding heads are removed at inference, so deployment requires only cameras and radar. For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion. An RCS-aware radar scatter further allows radar evidence to spread over spatial neighborhoods conditioned on radar cross section. On the nuScenes validation set, RLG-TPV achieves 0.4981 mAP and 0.5959 NDS, reducing orientation and velocity error by 31.9\% and 30.7\% relative to the published CRN baseline. Ablation studies show that ray-level geometric guidance is a major contributor to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RLG-TPV，一种面向相机-雷达3D目标检测的多模态三透视图（TPV）框架，利用训练时的激光雷达与雷达提供互补几何引导，通过射线引导的可变形注意力提升、多普勒引导的时间融合和RCS感知的雷达散射，在nuScenes上达到0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，且推理时仅需相机和雷达。
AI.motivation: 现有TPV表示虽然通过顶、侧、前三个特征平面描述3D场景结构，但其提升（lifting）过程主要依赖相机，导致沿投影相机射线上采样到的图像证据深度存在歧义，缺乏可靠的几何引导。
AI.method: 提出多模态TPV框架：1) 射线引导的可变形注意力提升，利用激光雷达监督的相机深度概率和雷达视锥占用度来加权采样图像特征，雷达并在提升前细化深度分布；2) 训练时用激光雷达导出的类别占用目标监督侧平面和前平面，推理时移除对应头，部署仅需相机和雷达；3) 多普勒引导的时间融合，以实测雷达径向速度锚定的运动场对齐历史特征，并用门控限制无支撑运动区域的扭曲；4) RCS感知的雷达散射，使雷达证据依据雷达截面积在空间邻域传播。
AI.result: 在nuScenes验证集上，RLG-TPV取得0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，相对已发表的CRN基线将朝向误差和速度误差分别降低31.9%和30.7%；消融实验表明射线级几何引导是性能的主要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: 通过雷达与训练时激光雷达的互补几何引导，能够有效解决相机TPV提升中的深度歧义问题，在仅需相机和雷达部署的条件下显著提升3D检测精度，验证了射线级几何引导和全过程雷达参与的有效性。

title: TACS: Trajectory-Aware Candidate Selection for LLM Jailbreak Suffix Optimization
summary: Gradient-based jailbreak suffix optimization methods typically update the suffix by retaining the candidate with the lowest current loss. We show that this seemingly natural design is fundamentally myopic: candidates that look better under the current-step proxy often fail to produce better jailbreak outcomes later in the search, revealing a form of selection-stage reward hacking. This suggests that candidate selection, rather than candidate generation alone, is a hidden bottleneck in suffix optimization. To address this issue, we propose TACS, a trajectory-aware candidate selection framework for jailbreak suffix optimization. Instead of selecting candidates solely by their immediate loss, TACS augments per-step evaluation with a trajectory-aware proxy and stabilizes selection with reference-policy regularization and a discriminator-estimated chi-squared correction, encouraging choices that remain effective beyond the current step. Experiments on HarmBench show that TACS consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same search budget, substantially improving attack success rates while exhibiting more stable optimization behavior throughout the search. Our findings highlight that mitigating selection-stage reward hacking caused by myopic candidate selection is critical for improving jailbreak suffix optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TACS（轨迹感知的候选选择框架）用于越狱后缀优化，指出传统梯度式后缀优化的贪心候选选择策略存在短视缺陷（选择阶段的奖励黑客），并通过轨迹感知代理、参考策略正则化及判别器估计的卡方校正来改进候选选择，在HarmBench上以相同搜索预算显著提升攻击成功率并更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度式越狱后缀优化方法通常贪心地保留当前损失最低的候选，但这一看似自然的设计本质上是短视的：在当前步代理下表现更好的候选往往在后续搜索中并不产生更好的越狱结果，暴露了选择阶段的奖励黑客问题。这表明候选选择（而非仅候选生成）是后缀优化中被忽视的瓶颈，亟需改进。
AI.method: 提出TACS框架：不再仅依据即时损失选择候选，而是（1）用轨迹感知代理增强每步评估；（2）通过参考策略正则化稳定选择过程；（3）引入判别器估计的卡方校正，鼓励选择在超越当前步之后仍保持有效的候选。
AI.result: 在HarmBench上的实验表明，在相同搜索预算下TACS持续优于强基线，显著提升攻击成功率，并在整个搜索过程中展现出更稳定的优化行为。
AI.conclusion: 缓解由短视候选选择导致的选择阶段奖励黑客问题，对于改进越狱后缀优化至关重要。

title: PruneShift: A Framework for Evaluating Decision Reliability in Structured Pruning
summary: Structured pruning uses surrogate objectives because direct task evaluation over every feasible mask is too expensive. Most evaluations report average surrogate error or rank correlation on broadly sampled masks. These summaries do not directly test the mask chosen by the surrogate. We introduce PruneShift, an evaluation framework that separates broad predictive fidelity, fidelity near selector outputs, and the quality of the selected pruning decision. We first prove that Spearman and Kendall agreement can approach one while normalized selection regret remains maximal. We then derive sufficient conditions based on uniform error, selector suboptimality, decision margin, density ratio, and comparison mass. The analysis also yields a finite pool certificate with an explicit excess cost bound. Four studies test different links in this argument. External TextbookQA confirmation is heterogeneous: 7 of 20 simultaneous intervals favor the surrogate-selected mask, 6 favor its fixed comparator, and 7 cross zero. On a fixed Natural Questions pool, strict improvement holds in one of four settings. A controlled QQP experiment supports the proposed coverage mechanism in all 16 prespecified endpoints, although the sufficient bounds are conservative. Finally, a restricted OSSCAR reconstruction study on OPT-125M shows better local than broad fidelity in 68 of 75 primary endpoints. Independent fixed-mask confirmation is inconclusive in 24 of 25 endpoints and favors the comparator in one. These results show why predictive fit, decision reliability, and pruning method quality require separate evidence.

AI.tldr: PruneShift 是一个针对结构化剪枝的评估框架，将"代理分数整体预测能力"、"选择器输出附近的局部保真度"和"最终选定剪枝决策的质量"三者分离评估。作者证明 Spearman/Kendall 秩相关可趋近于 1 而标准化的选择遗憾（selection regret）仍可达到最大，并推导出基于一致误差、选择器次优性、决策裕度、密度比和比较质量的充分条件，以及带有显式超额成本上界的有限池证书。四个实证研究（TextbookQA、Natural Questions、QQP、OSSCAR/OPT-125M）表明代理拟合好、决策可靠与剪枝方法质量需要三类相互独立的证据。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝通常无法逐一用真实任务评估所有可行掩码，因此依赖代理目标；但主流评测只报告广泛采样掩码上的平均代理误差或秩相关，这些汇总统计并不直接检验代理实际选择出的那个掩码的质量，导致评估与真实决策脱节。
AI.method: 提出 PruneShift 评测框架，将评估分为三个层面：广义预测保真度（broad predictive fidelity）、选择器输出附近的保真度（fidelity near selector outputs）、以及最终选择决策的质量。理论上证明秩相关指标失效的病理案例，推导基于一致误差、选择器次优性、决策裕度、密度比与比较质量的充分条件，并给出带显式超额成本上界的有限池证书；随后通过四项研究在各自预指定的端点上检验该论证的各个环节。
AI.result: 四项研究结果分化：外部 TextbookQA 确认结果异质（20 个区间中 7 个支持代理选择掩码、6 个支持固定对照、7 个跨零）；固定 Natural Questions 池中 4 个设置仅 1 个出现严格改进；受控 QQP 实验中 16 个预指定端点全部支持所提出的覆盖机制（但充分界偏保守）；OSSCAR 重构（OPT-125M）的 75 个主端点中 68 个显示局部保真优于广义保真，而 25 个端点中 24 个独立固定掩码确认无结论、1 个支持对照。
AI.conclusion: 预测拟合度、决策可靠性与剪枝方法质量需要分开收集证据：广泛的代理相关性并不能保证代理所选掩码的决定性质量，任何单一汇总指标都无法替代对最终选择决策的直接评测。

title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
summary: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our results reveal a detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely miss benevolent bias, while LLM judges catch more under more explicit detection criteria but increasingly misclassify neutral support as benevolent bias, and demographic context amplifies the false alarms. These findings suggest that fair monitoring of human-agent dialogue must look beyond surface cues to whether the agent's treatment is disparate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"善意偏见"（benevolent bias）概念——以温暖积极语气掩饰的不平等对待，并沿语气（tone）与对待（treatment）两个维度将其操作化，划分出中性支持、显性偏见、善意偏见三类。作者构建了包含362,880轮多轮支持性对话的类别平衡语料库BENEVDIAL，并在其上评估了两类检测器：现成安全检测器与提示式LLM裁判。结果发现检测鸿沟：现成检测器能可靠识别显性偏见但大多漏掉善意偏见；LLM裁判在更明确的检测标准下能捕获更多，但会越来越多地把中性支持误判为善意偏见，且人口统计学背景会放大误报。结论是公平监测人机对话必须超越表面线索，关注智能体的对待是否存在差异。
AI.motivation: 人机交互中的偏见不仅表现为敌对语言，还可能以"善意偏见"形式出现——不平等对待被隐藏在温暖积极的语气之后，使偏见难以被察觉。现有检测方法缺乏对这一现象的明确定义与系统性评测，因此需要将其操作化并构建可控评测语料，以检验当前检测器的能力。
AI.method: 沿"语气"和"对待"两个维度将善意偏见操作化为三类（中性支持、显性偏见、善意偏见）；据此构建类别平衡的语料库BENEVDIAL，涵盖362,880轮多轮支持性对话，并控制用户/智能体的人口统计学特征、角色与生成器；随后在语料上评测两类检测器：现成安全检测器与提示式LLM裁判。
AI.result: 实验揭示了显著的检测鸿沟：现成安全检测器能可靠识别显性偏见，却大多漏掉善意偏见；LLM裁判在更明确的检测标准下能捕获更多善意偏见，但会越来越频繁地将中性支持误判为善意偏见，且引入人口统计学背景会加剧这种误报。
AI.conclusion: 公平监测人机对话不能仅依赖表面的敌意线索，而应进一步考察智能体对待用户的方式是否存在差异（即是否基于身份给予不同对待）；唯有超越表面语气信号，才能有效识别并防范善意偏见。

title: Bayesian-Optimized Superpixel-GrabCut for Traceable Optic Disc Segmentation
comment: Accepted at 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications 2026
summary: Optic disc (OD) segmentation is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies from retinal fundus images. However, prevailing deep learning approaches operate as opaque black boxes, lacking the inference-stage mathematical traceability--a critical requirement for algorithmic auditing and failure analysis in clinical workflows. This paper presents a fully algorithmically traceable and trainable segmentation pipeline that jointly combines superpixel decomposition, hybrid brightness-proximity superpixel scoring, morphological regularization, iterative GrabCut refinement, and elliptical shape fitting. The hyperparameter optimization is formulated as an objective function and solved via Bayesian optimization to eliminate manual parameter tuning. A quantitative evaluation on the Drishti-GS dataset demonstrates that our method achieves a Dice coefficient of 0.9536, matching state-of-the-art performance. By maintaining explicit mathematical transparency across all processing stages, our framework offers a deterministic, traceable alternative to black-box architectures for medical review and debugging.

AI.tldr: 提出一个完全算法可追踪、可训练的视盘分割流程，结合超像素分解、亮度-邻近度混合打分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化和椭圆形状拟合，并通过贝叶斯优化自动调参；在Drishti-GS数据集上取得0.9536的Dice系数，达到与最先进方法相当的性能，同时保持全流程的数学透明性。
AI.motivation: 视盘分割对视网膜眼底图像的病理诊断至关重要，但现有深度学习方法是不透明的黑盒，缺少推理阶段的数学可追踪性，而这正是临床工作流中进行算法审计与故障分析的关键需求。
AI.method: 构建一个完全可追踪且可训练的分割流程，联合超像素分解、混合亮度-邻近度超像素评分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化与椭圆形状拟合；将超参数优化表述为目标函数，并通过贝叶斯优化求解，从而消除人工调参。
AI.result: 在Drishti-GS数据集上的定量评估表明，该方法Dice系数达到0.9536，与现有最先进方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在所有处理阶段保持显式的数学透明性，为医学审查与调试提供了一种确定性的、可追踪的黑盒架构替代方案。

title: Which one is banana man? Evaluating vision-language models in multi-turn pragmatic interpretation
summary: Flexible adaptation to context and shared pragmatic intuitions contribute to smooth human conversation. Iterated reference games---in which players repeatedly pick out novel referents using language---present a test case for agents' ability to perform context-sensitive pragmatic reasoning in multi-turn linguistic environments. We tested humans and vision--language models on their ability to identify the intended meaning of descriptions produced in iterated reference games, varying the provided context in terms of amount, order, and relevance. While humans performed well consistently, the models we evaluated could make use of prior context to interpret humans' referring expressions, but they struggled to build up the relevant context to interpret those expressions effectively. Our results suggest that the models we evaluated lack core skills needed for efficient linguistic collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过迭代参考游戏（其中玩家反复用语言指代新对象），测试人类和视觉-语言模型在多变语境下进行语境敏感语用推理的能力。结果表明，模型虽能利用先前的语境来理解人类的指代表达，但难以有效构建相关语境，缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心技能。
AI.motivation: 人类对话的顺畅依赖于对语境的灵活适应和共享的语用直觉。迭代参考游戏为检验智能体在多轮语言环境中进行语境敏感语用推理的能力提供了测试场景，作者希望借此考察视觉-语言模型是否具备人类这种语言协作能力。
AI.method: 在迭代参考游戏中，让玩家（人类和视觉-语言模型）反复用语言指代新对象；系统性地改变提供的语境（数量、顺序和相关性），测试人类与模型识别指代表达意图的能力，并比较其表现。
AI.result: 人类在所有语境条件下均表现一致良好；而评估的模型虽然能够利用先前的语境来解读人类的指代表达，但在构建有效理解这些表达所需的相关语境方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 被评估的视觉-语言模型缺乏高效语言协作所需的核心技能（即有效建立和使用语境进行语用推理的能力），这暗示当前模型在多轮语境化交流中与人类能力仍存在明显差距。

title: Structure Aware Neural Architecture Search for Mixture of Experts
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has so far rarely been applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, and existing MoE designs leave the alignment between experts and the structure of the data to emerge on its own. We propose an architecture search framework that makes this alignment an explicit search variable: the assignment of data clusters to experts is optimised jointly with the per-expert architectures. We cast the joint problem as a cluster-aware likelihood maximisation, show that it coincides with the incomplete-data maximum likelihood of a latent-variable mixture, and solve it by a generalised Expectation-Maximisation procedure whose otherwise intractable expert-quality term is supplied by an adaptively refined surrogate. We prove that the iterates converge whenever the surrogate errors are summable, and that at every limit point no candidate the search produces improves the true objective. On a heterogeneous image-classification mixture the method recovers the underlying domain partition on 95% of clusters without ever observing domain labels, and on that benchmark and a four-domain time-series forecasting one alike it outperforms the MoE and NAS baselines that likewise use no label information.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将神经架构搜索系统性地应用于混合专家（MoE）模型，并把“专家与数据簇的对应关系”作为显式搜索变量，提出了簇感知的架构搜索框架。它将问题建模为带隐变量的混合模型不完全数据极大似然估计，用广义期望最大化算法求解，其中难以精确计算的专家质量项由自适应精化的代理模型提供。理论证明迭代收敛且极限点为真实目标下的最优；实验表明该方法能在不借助域标签的情况下以95%的簇准确率恢复异构图像分类任务的底层域划分，并在图像分类和四域时间序列预测基准上超越不使用标签信息的MoE与NAS基线。
AI.motivation: 现有NAS很少应用于MoE模型，且已有MoE设计依赖专家与数据结构之间的对齐自然涌现，缺乏显式约束与搜索机制。作者希望将这种对齐作为可优化的显式变量，从而提升MoE在异构数据上的表现。
AI.method: 将数据簇到专家的分配与各专家子架构的搜索联合优化，建模为簇感知的似然最大化问题，证明其等价于潜变量混合模型的不完全数据极大似然估计；采用广义期望最大化（EM）过程求解，其中难以处理的专家质量项由自适应精化的代理函数替代；并给出迭代收敛性的理论保证。
AI.result: 在异构图像分类混合基准上，无需任何域标签即可在95%的簇上恢复底层域划分；在图像分类与四域时间序列预测基准上均优于同样不使用标签信息的MoE和NAS基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了对“专家-数据簇对齐”进行显式架构搜索是可行且有效的，且具备理论收敛保证；在无标签条件下即可显著提升MoE在异构数据上的性能，为此类模型的设计提供了新范式。

title: Hyper-Fold: Exploring the Expressive Limit of Sequence-Geometry Learning for Proteins via Hypergraph Modeling
summary: Protein structure modeling rests on a single computational primitive: the interaction between what a residue is (sequence content) and where it sits (three-dimensional geometry). What is the expressive limit of this layer class? We show that the complete bilinear operator over content-geometry outer products--the sufficient statistic of all second-order interactions--is the expressive ceiling, while the additive message passing of mainstream geometric GNNs is provably blind to content-geometry binding. We then introduce Hyper-Fold, a rank-K separable convolutional backbone approaching this ceiling at message-passing cost: each radius neighborhood is organized into a sequence hyperedge and a contact hyperedge, modulated by an edge-conditioned matrix-valued operator factorized into K learned basis operators with geometry-generated coefficients. Across enzyme function prediction, fold classification, and ligand binding site detection, Hyper-Fold and its hierarchical variant Hyper-Fold-Deep achieve the best results among protein-specific structure encoders; Hyper-Fold-Pocket, an anchored set-prediction head, surpasses UniSite-3D on UniSite-DS and two zero-shot benchmarks with no sequence language model features, 68x fewer parameters, and 4.8x lower latency--suggesting that a sufficiently expressive 3D backbone recovers information that fusion architectures previously borrowed from evolution-scale pretraining.
