AI.tldr: 本文从理论层面刻画了蛋白质结构建模中"残基内容-三维几何"交互层的表达能力极限，证明完整双线性算子（内容-几何外积的充分统计量）是表达上限，而主流几何GNN的加性消息传递对此类绑定关系"盲视"。基于此提出Hyper-Fold——一种张成该上限的秩K可分离卷积骨干，以消息传递的计算成本接近上限，并在酶功能预测、折叠分类、配体结合位点检测等任务上超越现有蛋白专用结构编码器；其变体Hyper-Fold-Pocket在不使用序列语言模型特征的情况下，以68倍更少参数和4.8倍更低延迟超越UniSite-3D，表明足够有表达力的3D骨干可复原融合架构此前从进化规模预训练中借用的大部分信息。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质结构建模的核心原语是残基的序列内容与其三维几何之间的交互。作者希望从理论上回答一个基础问题：这一层类的表达极限是什么？既有主流几何GNN采用加性消息传递，作者证明其对此类内容-几何"绑定"关系存在不可弥补的盲区，因此需要一种能够充分捕获二阶交互的表达架构。
AI.method: 首先从理论上证明：内容-几何外积上的完整双线性算子（所有二阶交互的充分统计量）是表达上限，而加性消息传递无法表达该绑定。据此提出Hyper-Fold：一种秩K可分离卷积骨干，将每个半径邻域组织为序列超边与接触超边，由边缘条件化的矩阵值算子调制，该算子分解为K个可学习基算子并以几何生成的系数组合，从而以消息传递级别的计算成本逼近表达上限。同时给出分层变体Hyper-Fold-Deep及锚定集合预测头Hyper-Fold-Pocket。
AI.result: 在酶功能预测、折叠分类和配体结合位点检测任务上，Hyper-Fold及其分层变体Hyper-Fold-Deep在蛋白专用结构编码器中取得最佳结果。锚定集合预测头Hyper-Fold-Pocket在UniSite-DS及两个零样本基准上超越UniSite-3D，且不使用序列语言模型特征，参数减少68倍、延迟降低4.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 足够有表达力的3D结构骨干本身就能恢复此前融合架构依赖进化规模预训练（如序列语言模型）才能获得的信息，提示结构编码器的表达能力而非外部特征融合可能是决定性能的关键瓶颈。同时该工作为几何消息传递层提供了理论上的表达极限刻画，为后续架构设计确立了可逼近的上界标准。

title: Ground-to-Satellite Localization in Unconstrained Image Collections for 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Ground image localization with respect to satellite imagery is a key enabler for metrically-accurate, geo-localized 3D scene reconstruction from unconstrained image collections. Existing cross-view localization methods have strict requirements such as panoramic imagery or known initial locations, limiting their applicability for in-the-wild reconstruction settings. We propose a robust hierarchical cross-view localization framework that leverages geometric constraints from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) models derived from unconstrained ground image collections. Our method generates coarse-to-fine pose hypotheses through a cross-view matching approach and aggregates noisy predictions across SfM model(s) using Kernel Density Estimation to recover consensus alignments while filtering outliers. Experiments demonstrate reliable localization performance from challenging image collections. Empirically we found satellite-referenced alignment enables accurate metric scale estimation, doppelgänger detection, and merging of disjoint SfM reconstructions, resulting in more complete, geo-localized site models than are possible with SfM alone.

AI.tldr: 提出一种鲁棒的层次化跨视角定位框架，利用从无约束地面图像集合重建的SfM模型中的几何约束，将地面图像定位到卫星影像；通过粗到细的姿态假设生成与核密度估计聚合，实现在挑战性图像集合下可靠的定位，并支持度量尺度估计、重复结构检测和多个SfM重建的融合。
AI.motivation: 地面图像相对卫星影像的定位是实现无约束图像集合的度量精确、地理定位3D场景重建的关键。然而现有跨视角定位方法有严格限制（如需要全景图像或已知初始位置），难以适用于野外（in-the-wild）重建场景，因此需要一种能在无约束条件下工作的鲁棒定位方法。
AI.method: 提出一种鲁棒的层次化跨视角定位框架：1) 利用来自无约束地面图像集合的SfM模型的几何约束；2) 通过跨视角匹配方法生成从粗到细的姿态假设；3) 使用核密度估计（Kernel Density Estimation）聚合跨SfM模型的噪声预测，恢复共识对齐并过滤离群值。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在挑战性图像集合上具有可靠的定位性能。经验发现，卫星参考对齐能够实现精确的度量尺度估计、重复结构（doppelgänger）检测以及多个不相交SfM重建的合并，从而得到比单独使用SfM更完整、地理定位的站点模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过卫星影像参考的对齐，克服了现有跨视角定位方法对全景图或初始位置的依赖，能够生成更完整、经地理定位的站点模型，其效果优于仅依赖SfM的方法。

title: SemTrace: Source-Grounded Semantic Signatures for Tracing LLM Exposure to Protected Documents
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to read documents and produce downstream text, creating a provenance problem when the document owner cannot control or inspect the model that performs the generation. We introduce SemTrace, a source-grounded semantic watermark for detecting whether a generated review was influenced by a known protected manuscript copy. Rather than biasing token probabilities or imposing surface-form patterns, SemTrace constructs a document-specific binary signature from factual propositions that are directly supported by the manuscript itself. A protected PDF invisibly carries a content contract that selects one fact from each binary pair and asks an instruction-following reviewer to express those facts in fixed review slots without changing its independent evaluation. A frozen natural language inference model then decodes the resulting semantic evidence with explicit erasures and scores the recovered bits against the codeword assigned to that copy. This design targets model-agnostic, assigned-copy exposure detection while keeping the watermark semantically tied to the source document.

AI.tldr: SemTrace 是一种源文档语义水印方案，通过从受保护稿件中提取事实命题构成二元签名，并将其嵌入审稿提示中的固定槽位，再利用冻结的NLI模型解码语义证据并对恢复比特与分配的码字进行比对，从而实现模型无关的指定副本暴露检测。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型常被用于阅读文档并生成下游文本，而当文档所有者无法控制或检查执行生成的模型时，就产生了溯源（provenance）问题。现有水印方法通常偏向token概率或强加表层形式模式，无法有效关联到具体受保护的稿件副本，因此需要一种能够检测生成文本是否受特定受保护稿件影响的机制。
AI.method: SemTrace 从稿件本身直接支持的事实命题构建文档特定的二元签名。受保护的PDF不可见地携带一个“内容契约”，该契约从每一对二元事实中选择一个事实，并要求遵循指令的审稿人在固定的审阅槽位中表达这些事实，同时不改变其独立评估。之后，一个冻结的自然语言推理（NLI）模型对得到的语义证据进行显式擦除解码，并将恢复出的比特与该副本分配的码字进行计分比对。
AI.result: 该设计实现了模型无关、指定副本暴露检测，同时保持水印在语义上与源文档紧密关联。它避免了偏差token概率或强加表层形式模式，而是利用语义层面的证据恢复与码字匹配来完成检测。
AI.conclusion: SemTrace 提供了一种源文档锚定的语义水印方法，能够在无法控制或检查生成模型的情况下检测LLM生成的审稿文本是否受到已知受保护稿件副本的影响，为文档溯源与版权保护提供了模型无关的解决方案。

title: Designing for the Next Click: Bandits for Real-Time Page Layout
comment: Accepted to The Web Conference 2026 (short paper track), but later withdrawn due to internal prioritization. Subsequently accepted to the Online & Adaptive Recommender Systems Workshop (held in conjunction with the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems, RecSys 2026)
summary: E-commerce platforms increasingly personalize user experiences through machine learning, yet page layout decisions remain dominated by static rules and manual curation. We present a scalable bandit-based system that optimizes product page layouts in real time while preserving human control over design intent. A contextual bandit model dynamically selects the most effective layout for each session using user, item, and category-level features. The system leverages a LinUCB-based policy to balance exploration and exploitation as it learns from live user interactions. The architecture is designed for seamless integration into large-scale web serving stacks, supporting low-latency inference and continuous model updates. The system was first tested on entry product pages. In online A/B deployments on a major retail platform, our approach achieved positive lifts in session-level performance metrics over a strong heuristic baseline. Our results demonstrate that contextual bandits can effectively optimize visual and structural aspects of product discovery for user engagement, providing a scalable path toward learning-to-design the web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于上下文老虎机（LinUCB）的可扩展系统，用于在电商平台上实时优化商品页面布局，同时保留人类对设计意图的控制，并在线上A/B测试中相对强启发式基线取得了正向效果提升。
AI.motivation: 电商平台越来越多地通过机器学习实现个性化体验，但页面布局决策仍主要依赖静态规则和人工编排，缺乏实时、数据驱动的布局优化手段，难以适应大规模动态场景。
AI.method: 采用基于LinUCB策略的上下文老虎机模型，利用用户、商品和品类级别的特征，在每个会话中动态选择最优页面布局；通过探索与利用的平衡从实时用户交互中学习，并设计了支持低延迟推理和持续模型更新的架构，便于无缝集成到大规模Web服务栈中。
AI.result: 在主流零售平台的门户商品页在线A/B部署中，该方法在会话级性能指标上相对于强启发式基线取得了正向提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明上下文老虎机能够有效优化产品发现的视觉与结构方面以提升用户参与度，为“学习式设计网页”（learning-to-design the web）提供了一条可扩展的路径。

title: Imag-Eval: a language-grounded framework for interpretable Text-to-Image instruction following evaluation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet their evaluation remains constrained by benchmarks that are often difficult to interpret and insufficiently diagnostic. Existing skill-based evaluations tend to overlook critical failure modes that strongly impact usability but fall outside standard taxonomies, such as global incoherence arising from missing parts or physically implausible configurations (e.g., floating objects). In addition, prompt difficulty is typically controlled along a single dimension; either prompt length or the number of elements to generate. To address these limitations, we introduce Imag-Eval, a controlled benchmark designed to assess how T2I models ground compositional natural-language instructions into visual outputs. Unlike prior work that conflates surface linguistic complexity with compositional difficulty, Imag-Eval explicitly seeks to disentangles these factors by independently varying both the number of instances and the combination of constraints (rules), while avoiding error propagation. This design enables fine-grained and interpretable analysis of where cross-modal instruction following fails. Our benchmark comprises 1,140 prompts and 8,842 combined rules, and we evaluate it on several state-of-the-art models. Complementing this analysis with an additional study of over 2,000 prompts from a concurrent benchmark, our results suggest that, for structured skills, compositional difficulty is primarily governed by the number of grounded rules and their binding to instances,, rather than by prompt length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Imag-Eval，一个受控基准，用于评估文生图模型将组合式自然语言指令转化为视觉输出的能力。该基准通过独立变化实例数量和约束规则组合数，将表面语言复杂度与组合难度解耦，从而实现细粒度、可解释的跨模态指令遵循失败分析。实验表明，在结构化技能上，组合难度主要取决于规则数量及其与实例的绑定，而非提示长度。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图模型评估存在两个主要缺陷：一是基于技能的评估忽视了标准分类之外的严重失败模式（如部件缺失或物理上不合理配置导致的全局不一致）；二是提示难度通常仅沿单一维度（如提示长度或生成元素数量）控制，混淆了表面语言复杂度与真正的组合难度，导致评估难以解释且诊断性不足。
AI.method: 作者设计 Imag-Eval 受控基准，核心在于独立地变化两个因素：实例数量（the number of instances）与约束/规则组合数（the combination of constraints），同时避免错误传播，从而显式解耦表面语言复杂度与组合难度。基准包含 1,140 条提示和 8,842 条组合规则，并对多种最先进的文生图模型进行评测；此外还利用来自另一并发基准的 2,000 多条提示进行补充研究。
AI.result: 实验结果（含对超过 2,000 条提示的并发基准补充研究）表明：对于结构化技能，组合难度主要由已接地规则（grounded rules）的数量及其与实例的绑定程度决定，而不仅仅是提示长度。
AI.conclusion: Imag-Eval 提供了更细粒度、可解释的文生图指令遵循分析工具。研究结论有助于重新设计评测维度，提示研究者应关注规则数量与实例绑定的影响，而非单纯依赖提示长度或生成元素数量来控制难度，为后续 T2I 模型评估标准的改进提供了依据。

title: SGPDFuse: Semantically-Guided Physics-Disentanglement General Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary sensor data into a single representation that preserves intrinsic scene reality while eliminating environmental interferences. Most existing approaches rely on blind feature aggregation, which excels at signal accumulation but fails to distinguish essential content from physical degradations. We propose SGPDFuse, which bridges this gap by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation via a Semantic-Physical Parametric Bridge (SPPB) built on pretrained vision foundation models, utilizing the Intrinsic-Variation principle to decouple invariant scene attributes from transient environmental factors. To guide this decomposition, we introduce a Semantic Alignment mechanism: we explicitly anchor the fused representation to salient semantic features in the same foundation model feature space via cosine similarity to preserve critical targets, while enforcing physical texture fidelity through Gram-matrix regularization to strictly eliminate unnatural artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGPDFuse achieves state-of-the-art performance across infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure benchmarks using a single architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出SGPDFuse，一种基于语义-物理参数桥（SPPB）和预测练视觉基础模型的多模态图像融合框架，通过内在-变化（Intrinsic-Variation）原则将输入解耦为物理可解释的结构化表示，并利用语义对齐机制（余弦相似度锚定显著语义特征 + Gram矩阵正则化保证物理纹理保真），在单一架构下于红外-可见光、多聚焦和多曝光基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态图像融合（MMIF）方法依赖盲特征聚合，擅长信号累加但无法区分本质内容与物理退化（如噪声、光照变化等环境干扰），导致融合结果保留无关物理伪影而非真实场景语义，难以同时实现场景真实性保持与环境干扰消除。
AI.method: 提出SGPDFuse框架，核心包括：（1）基于预测练视觉基础模型构建语义-物理参数桥（SPPB），将多模态输入映射为物理可解耦的结构化表示；（2）依据内在-变化（Intrinsic-Variation）原则，将不变场景属性与瞬态环境因素解耦；（3）设计语义对齐机制：用余弦相似度将融合表示显式锚定到同一基础模型特征空间中的显著语义特征以保留关键目标，同时通过Gram矩阵正则化约束物理纹理保真度，严格消除非自然伪影。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SGPDFuse在红外-可见光、多聚焦、多曝光三类基准上均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能，且仅使用单一统一架构即可跨任务泛化，无需针对各模态任务单独设计。
AI.conclusion: SGPDFuse验证了在MMIF中引入物理可解耦的结构表示与语义先验对齐的有效性：通过基础模型语义空间锚定和Gram矩阵纹理约束，可同时兼顾关键目标保留与环境伪影消除，为多模态融合提供了一种统一、可解释且高性能的范式。

title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
summary: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). Specifically, DDT is designed to evaluate the model's "one-to-many" disambiguation capability among phenotypically similar cases, while DCT assesses the model's ability to identify "many-to-one" diagnostic patterns across different pathophysiological pathways. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs reveals substantial performance degradation on DDT and DCT compared to baseline tasks, exposing a systemic reliance on statistical shortcuts over genuine causal reasoning. Our findings further highlight a conservative bias toward "healthy" predictions, implying non-trivial risks for missed diagnoses in realistic medical settings. This work establishes a rigorous methodology for quantifying clinical reasoning robustness and provides a roadmap for enhancing the safety of language models in clinical medicine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SUP-MIMIC 框架，基于 MIMIC-IV-v3.1 数据构建多任务基准，用于评估大语言模型在临床诊断中的非双射映射推理能力，涵盖基础评估（BA）、诊断分歧任务（DDT）和诊断汇聚任务（DCT），揭示现有 LLM 在诊断歧义与汇聚场景下性能显著下降，存在依赖统计捷径而非因果推理、以及偏向"健康"预测的保守偏差等系统性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评测主要关注事实知识检索，忽视了临床诊断中指标与诊断之间复杂的"非双射"映射关系这一根本挑战；已有基准未能评估模型在"相同症状对应不同病因"（诊断分歧）与"异质症状指向同一疾病"（诊断汇聚）两种歧义场景下的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 构建基于 MIMIC-IV-v3.1 的多任务框架 SUP-MIMIC，包含三个任务：基础评估（BA）作为基线，诊断分歧任务（DDT）评估"一对多"的表型相似病例消歧能力，诊断汇聚任务（DCT）评估"多对一"的跨病理生理通路诊断模式识别能力；对当前最先进的 LLM 进行系统评测。
AI.result: 综合评测显示，先进 LLM 在 DDT 和 DCT 上与基线任务相比出现显著性能下降，暴露其对统计捷径的依赖而非真正的因果推理；同时发现模型存在偏向"健康"预测的保守偏差，在真实医疗场景中可能带来漏诊风险。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了量化临床推理鲁棒性的严谨方法论，为提升语言模型在临床医学中的安全性提供了路线图，有助于推动 LLM 从统计关联向真实因果诊断推理的转变。

title: Uncertainty-Driven Replay Memory for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Uncertainty estimation provides promising capabilities for reinforcement learning (RL) agents. Notably, estimating uncertainty can reduce the training time and enable agents to obtain greater rewards over time by exploiting information related to whether an action would facilitate exploration of portions of an environment that are well-known versus those that are relatively unknown. In this work, we propose a novel formulation of the experience replay buffer commonly used in RL that we call uncertainty-driven replay memory (UDRM), which entails an update scheme for internally stored memories based on uncertainty estimates obtained by an RL model during training. In contrast to existing forms of RL, which typically use temporal difference error or the distribution of transitions to update the replay memory buffer and train RL controllers, our scheme biases the memory buffer to store more uncertain transitions that will improve an RL agent's generalization throughout training. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed uncertainty-aware replay buffer enables an RL agent to obtain higher rewards during training compared to other existing uncertainty-aware RL frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于不确定性驱动的经验回放记忆（UDRM），通过RL模型在训练过程中获得的不确定性估计来更新内部存储的记忆，使回放缓冲区偏向存储更多不确定的转换，从而提升智能体的泛化能力并在训练中获得更高奖励。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计能为强化学习（RL）智能体带来显著优势，例如缩短训练时间并通过已知/未知环境区域的探索信息获得更高累积奖励。然而现有RL方法通常基于时序差分误差或转换分布来更新回放缓冲区，未充分利用不确定性信息来指导记忆存储，因此需要一种更有效的不确定性驱动缓冲区更新机制。
AI.method: 提出不确定性驱动回放记忆（UDRM）：一种对RL中常用经验回放缓冲区的新颖形式化设计，包含基于RL模型训练期间获得的不确定性估计对内部存储记忆进行更新的方案。该方法使记忆缓冲区偏向存储更多不确定的转换，从而改善RL智能体在整个训练过程中的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与其他现有的不确定性感知RL框架相比，所提出的不确定性感知回放缓冲区能使RL智能体在训练期间获得更高的奖励。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性驱动的回放记忆为RL经验回放提供了新的范式，通过与现有不确定性感知RL框架的对比实验证明了其有效性，表明利用不确定性估计指导缓冲区记忆存储能够显著提升训练阶段的表现。

title: Computational Depth Measurement in Thermographic Video: Overcoming Spatial Overfitting via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling
summary: Accurate through-thickness measurement of subsurface delamination depth in Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) is important for structural assessment because defect location determines affected load-bearing layers. Optical pulsed thermography (OPT) provides a two-dimensional thermal video rather than volumetric measurements, so depth must be inferred from temporal heat-diffusion responses. A challenge is spatial dataset bias: when calibration defects follow regular grids, regression models may memorize their geometry instead of learning physical relationship between thermal decay and depth. This work introduces a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture that separates spatial defect localization from temporal depth measurement. Defect regions are first localized using segmentation methods, after which thermal responses are spatially averaged and converted into sixteen physics-informed temporal, energy, statistical, and geometric features. These features expose the one-dimensional heat-conduction relationship while withholding pixel coordinates from the depth model. Four regression models are evaluated using specimen-level cross-validation: Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Advanced Multi-Layer Perceptron (Adv-MLP), and XGBoost. Unregularized trees and over-parameterized Adv-MLP exhibit calibration collapse under geometric shifts, with errors exceeding 0.5 mm. In contrast, regularized XGBoost with L1/L2 penalties and column sampling maintains cross-specimen calibration, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.056 mm and root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.085 mm. Predicted depths are merged with masks to generate Delaunay-triangulated three-dimensional defect models in three to five seconds per specimen. Results show that mathematical regularization and spatio-temporal decoupling reduce spatial memorization in thermal-video depth regression.

AI.tldr: 针对碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）亚表面分层深度测量问题，提出一种时空解耦架构：先用分割方法定位缺陷区域，再将空间平均后的热响应转化为十六种物理信息特征用于深度回归，并对比四种回归模型。结果表明，带L1/L2正则化与列采样的XGBoost在跨试件验证中保持稳定（MAE 0.056 mm，RMSE 0.085 mm），而正则化不足的模型发生校准崩溃（误差>0.5 mm），验证了时空解耦与数学正则化可抑制热视频深度回归中的空间记忆效应。
AI.motivation: CFRP中亚表面分层深度的准确测量对结构评估至关重要，因为缺陷位置决定受影响的承力层。光学脉冲热成像（OPT）只提供二维热视频而非体测量，深度必须从时间热扩散响应中推断。挑战在于空间数据集偏差：当校准缺陷呈规则网格分布时，回归模型可能记住缺陷几何结构而非学习热衰减与深度之间的物理关系，导致跨试件泛化失败。
AI.method: 提出一种时空解耦架构，将空间缺陷定位与时间深度测量分离。首先用分割方法定位缺陷区域，随后对空间平均的热响应提取十六种基于物理信息的时间、能量、统计和几何特征，这些特征暴露一维热传导关系并隐藏像素坐标以阻断深度模型对空间的记忆。在试件级交叉验证下评估四种回归模型：随机森林（RF）、梯度提升机（GBM）、高级多层感知机（Adv-MLP）和XGBoost；XGBoost采用L1/L2正则化与列采样。预测深度与掩膜融合生成Delaunay三角化的三维缺陷模型（每个试件3-5秒）。
AI.result: 未正则化的树模型和过参数化的Adv-MLP在几何偏移下出现校准崩溃，误差超过0.5 mm；而带L1/L2惩罚和列采样的正则化XGBoost保持跨试件校准，MAE为0.056 mm、RMSE为0.085 mm，并可在每试件3-5秒内生成三维缺陷模型。
AI.conclusion: 数学正则化与时空解耦相结合能显著降低热视频深度回归中的空间记忆效应，实现可靠、泛化的CFRP分层深度测量。

title: Using Channel Representations in Regularization Terms: A Case Study on Image Diffusion
summary: In this work we propose a novel non-linear diffusion filtering approach for images based on their channel representation. To derive the diffusion update scheme we formulate a novel energy functional using a soft-histogram representation of image pixel neighborhoods obtained from the channel encoding. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equation yields a non-linear robust diffusion scheme with additional weighting terms stemming from the channel representation which steer the diffusion process. We apply this novel energy formulation to image reconstruction problems, showing good performance in the presence of mixtures of Gaussian and impulse-like noise, e.g. missing data. In denoising experiments of common scalar-valued images our approach performs competitive compared to other diffusion schemes as well as state-of-the-art denoising methods for the considered noise types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于通道表示（channel representation）的新型非线性扩散滤波方法，通过利用像素邻域的软直方图表示构造新的能量泛函，导出带通道加权项的非线性鲁棒扩散更新方案，用于图像重建与去噪，在混合高斯噪声和脉冲噪声（如数据缺失）场景下表现良好，在常见标量图像去噪实验中与现有扩散方法及先进去噪方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性扩散滤波方法在处理混合噪声（如高斯噪声与脉冲噪声并存、数据缺失）时性能有限，需要一种更具鲁棒性的扩散机制；同时，希望通过引入通道表示这一信息丰富的特征编码来更好地引导扩散过程，从而提升图像重建与去噪效果。
AI.method: 基于图像的通道表示构造像素邻域的软直方图，并据此提出一个新的能量泛函；通过推导其欧拉-拉格朗日方程，得到一种非线性鲁棒扩散更新方案。与传统扩散相比，该方案额外包含由通道表示导出的加权项，用于引导扩散过程，使其能自适应地处理不同噪声类型。
AI.result: 在图像重建问题中，该方法在混合高斯与脉冲噪声（如缺失数据）条件下表现良好；在常见标量图像去噪实验中，该方法与现有扩散方案及同时代先进去噪方法相比性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通道表示结合软直方图能量泛函能够有效构造鲁棒的非线性扩散滤波，为混合噪声下的图像重建和去噪提供了一种有竞争力的新途径。

title: How You Ask Shapes What You Get: A Theory-Seeded Measurement of Articulation in Advice-Seeking LLM Conversations
summary: Users articulate the same advice-seeking request in different ways: some specify detailed constraints, others gesture at a vague need. Prior work treats this variation as noise to be averaged away; we instead treat it as a stable, measurable structure in the input distribution. We ask whether articulation (how people ask) forms latent dimensions separable from topic (what they ask about), and whether it is associated with how language models respond. We extract interpretable features from 16,447 advice-seeking prompts pooled from public chat corpora (WildChat, LMSYS, and ShareChat) and recover a small set of latent articulation factors that replicate across train/test splits and across corpora. Because this structure is largely separable from topic, the populations it defines cut across topics and stay invisible to topic- or task-based evaluation. The factors define a handful of recurring articulation styles, one of which stands out: a long-form but information-poor style, roughly one in six prompts in the largest corpus, where models return shorter, vaguer answers and do not ask for clarification even though under-specification is exactly the condition that warrants it. The contrast holds within every topic group and length quintile, and is not under-specification alone -- a second, equally under-specified style does draw clarifying questions. Two independent human annotators reproduce this contrast. We argue that benchmarks should stratify on articulation, and we offer the extracted structure as a measurement instrument for doing so.

AI.tldr: 本文从16,447条建议求助提示中提取了与主题可分离的潜在“表述方式”（articulation）因子，发现提示的表述方式在跨语料库间稳定复现，并显著影响大模型回复的行为（如回复长度、模糊度与是否追问澄清）。约六分之一的长篇但信息贫乏的表述风格会触发更短、更模糊且缺乏澄清请求的回复，而另一个同样欠指定的风格却会引发澄清提问，表明现有评估忽略了表述这一维度。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将用户如何表述请求的差异视为应当被平均掉的噪声，而本文主张这种“表述方式”是输入分布中稳定、可测量的结构。作者想探究表述（how people ask）是否构成与主题（what they ask about）分离的潜在维度，并考察它是否与语言模型的回复行为相关联，以弥补现有主题/任务导向评估的盲区。
AI.method: 从公共聊天语料库（WildChat、LMSYS、ShareChat）汇总16,447条建议求助提示，提取可解释特征，采用潜在因子分析恢复少数表述因子，并通过train/test划分及跨语料库验证其可复现性。随后控制主题与长度（在每个主题组和长度五分位内）考察各表述风格与大模型回复的关联，并用两位独立人工标注者复现核心对比。
AI.result: 恢复出少量与主题大体可分离的潜在表述因子，其所界定的人群跨越主题，对主题/任务式评估不可见。最主要的发现是约六分之一的最大语料库提示呈现出“长篇但信息贫乏”的表述风格，模型对此给出更短、更含糊的回复且不主动澄清，即便欠指定恰恰需要澄清；而另一同样欠指定的风格却会引发澄清提问。该对比在每个主题组和长度五分位内均成立，且经两位独立人工标注者复现。
AI.conclusion: 提示的表述方式是影响大模型行为的重要且稳定的结构维度，不应被当作噪声。基准测试应在表述方式上进行分层，作者将提取出的因子结构作为用于此目的测量工具公开提供。

title: Partially Linear Autoencoders for Manifold Learning and Dimensionality Reduction
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Preprint also available on HAL: https://hal.science/hal-05646575
summary: Autoencoders are widely used for nonlinear dimensionality reduction and manifold learning. While most common implementations rely on both nonlinear encoders and decoders, we investigate the specific role of the encoder and the extent to which it can be constrained to be linear without reducing accuracy. We conduct a comparative study on four autoencoder architectures: standard fully nonlinear autoencoders (AE), linear-encoder autoencoders (Lenc-AE), linear-decoder autoencoders (Ldec-AE), and fully linear autoencoders (LAE), evaluated on synthetic manifolds, computational mechanics data sets, and real-world image data sets including MNIST. We demonstrate that imposing a linear encoder preserves most of the representational capacity of the autoencoder, provided the decoder remains nonlinear. In particular, Lenc-AE consistently outperforms both Ldec-AE and LAE, and achieves reconstruction quality comparable to fully nonlinear AE, while offering advantages in terms of parsimony and interpretability of the latent representation. These results suggest that the nonlinear decoder is the critical component for manifold learning, rather than the encoder. A geometric interpretation of this finding is developed, which identifies the precise conditions under which a linear encoder is sufficient, and the specific manifold configurations that expose its limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比四种自编码器架构（全非线性AE、线性编码器Lenc-AE、线性解码器Ldec-AE、全线性LAE），发现只要解码器保持非线性，将编码器约束为线性几乎不损失表示能力：Lenc-AE在重构质量上与全非线性AE相当，且优于Ldec-AE和LAE，同时在参数简约性和潜在表示的可解释性上具有优势，表明非线性解码器才是流形学习的关键组件。
AI.motivation: 自编码器广泛用于非线性降维和流形学习，但常见实现同时使用非线性编码器和解码器。作者希望厘清编码器在其中的具体作用，探究编码器在多大程度上可以被约束为线性而不会降低精度，从而在保持性能的同时提升模型的简约性与可解释性。
AI.method: 对四种自编码器架构进行系统比较：标准全非线性自编码器（AE）、线性编码器自编码器（Lenc-AE）、线性解码器自编码器（Ldec-AE）和全线性自编码器（LAE）。在合成流形、计算力学数据集以及包括MNIST在内的真实图像数据集上进行评估，并从几何角度给出理论解释，识别线性编码器充分性的精确条件及其局限性的流形构型。
AI.result: 实验表明，只要解码器保持非线性，线性编码器就能保留自编码器的大部分表示能力。具体而言，Lenc-AE一致优于Ldec-AE和LAE，并达到与全非线性AE相当的重构质量，同时具备参数更少、潜在表示更易解释等优点。
AI.conclusion: 非线性解码器是流形学习中的关键组件，而非编码器；在解码器非线性的前提下，线性编码器通常足以胜任，并兼具简易性与可解释性优势。作者还给出了线性编码器充分性的几何条件，以及会暴露其局限性的具体流形结构。

title: Localizing Emergent Failures in Agentic AI: Recovering Minimal Repair Families via Counterfactual Replay
summary: Failures in agentic AI systems can arise from interactions among messages exchanged by multiple large language model (LLM) agents. Pointwise attribution cannot distinguish a jointly necessary repair from alternative singleton repairs. We formulate Minimal Repair Family Recovery (MRFR): recovering all inclusion-minimal event sets whose counterfactual replay restores task success within a declared size bound. We propose Graph-Constrained Joint Replay (GCJR), which slices failure-relevant events from an execution dependency graph, constructs graph-feasible singleton and pair candidates, and verifies them by replay with paired clean counterparts. For fixed replay outcomes, GCJR is exact within its declared graph domain. On 90 in-scope cases from a 120-DAG controlled benchmark, GCJR achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match while reducing mean replay calls from 56.3 to 25.3 (55.1%) relative to exhaustive search. On a 24-case, four-agent LLM pilot, it again achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match and reduces mean model calls from 21.0 to 10.0 (52.4%); single-event replay misses jointly necessary repairs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多智能体（LLM agent）系统中的交互性失败问题，提出“最小修复族恢复”（MRFR）任务，并设计图约束联合回放（GCJR）方法：在事件依赖图上切片与失败相关的事件、构造图可行的单元素与双元素候选，并通过与干净对照配对回放加以验证。在受控基准与四智能体试点中，GCJR以更少的回放/模型调用实现100%的家族精确匹配，证明其能恢复点级归因所无法识别的联合必要修复。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI系统（agentic AI）的失败可能源于多个LLM智能体间交换消息的交互作用。现有的点级（pointwise）归因无法区分“联合必要的修复”与“可替代的单一事件修复”，即无法刻画哪些事件组合必须同时改变才能恢复任务成功，因此需要一种能恢复所有包含最小修复事件集的方法。
AI.method: 作者提出最小修复族恢复（Minimal Repair Family Recovery, MRFR）任务，目标是恢复所有“包含最小（inclusion-minimal）事件集”且满足声明的尺寸上界、其反事实回放能恢复任务成功的修复族。在此基础上提出图约束联合回放（Graph-Constrained Joint Replay, GCJR）：先从执行依赖图中切分出与失败相关的事件，构造图可行（graph-feasible）的单一事件与成对事件候选，再通过与干净对照（paired clean counterparts）配对回放来验证这些候选。在固定回放结果的前提下，GCJR在其声明的图域内是精确的。
AI.result: 在120-DAG受控基准的90个范围内案例中，GCJR达到1.000的家族精确匹配（Family Exact Match），同时将平均回放调用次数从56.3降至25.3（降低55.1%）；在24个案例的四智能体LLM试点中再次达到1.000家族精确匹配，平均模型调用从21.0降至10.0（降低52.4%），且单事件回放会遗漏联合必要的修复。
AI.conclusion: GCJR通过将修复搜索限制在执行依赖图中可行的联合候选，能够精确、高效地恢复所有最小修复族，有效地弥补了点级归因无法捕捉多事件联合修复的不足，并为多智能体系统的失败诊断提供了可扩展且可证明精确的解决方案。

title: Compact Snapshot Spectral Imaging with Calibration-Free Aperture Diffraction
comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI. Under Review
summary: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

AI.tldr: 提出一种紧凑、低成本、免标定的快照光谱成像方法ADIS，仅由衍射透镜、二元掩膜和Bayer滤波传感器组成，其体积与标准RGB相机相当。ADIS利用理论计算的PSF实现免标定光谱重建，并引入正交衍射感知展开框架ODAUF及Voxel Shift Transformer（VST）求解稀疏约束逆问题，最终在商用相机体积内实现全分辨率且免标定的快照光谱成像。
AI.motivation: 快照光谱成像（SSI）虽能提供高维时-空-谱观测以揭示物体内在物理特性，但其系统复杂且需要重复标定，严重阻碍了其在边缘设备上的应用。因此需要一种紧凑、低成本、免标定的SSI方案。
AI.method: 提出ADIS架构，仅由衍射透镜加二元掩膜与Bayer滤波传感器构成，相比标准RGB相机不增加物理体积。ADIS对波长进行色散与复用，将能量映射到不同传感器位置，实现从超像素级编码恢复全分辨率图像。其直接利用理论计算的PSF实现免标定光谱重建，并容忍不同光学配置下的透镜相关变化，弥合仿真与真实差距。为求解稀疏约束逆问题，提出正交衍射感知展开框架ODAUF，并集成Voxel Shift Transformer（VST）增强正交衍射感知，形成高效模型ODAUVST，兼具优异重建质量与更少参数。
AI.result: 通过理论阐述、系统全面的对比实验以及真实光谱成像演示，验证了ADIS的优越性，在商用相机体积内实现了免标定的全分辨率快照光谱成像；ODAUVST在重建质量与参数量上均表现出高效性。
AI.conclusion: ADIS成功将SSI系统压缩到标准商用相机尺寸，同时消除标定负担，弥合了仿真与真实之间的差距，为光谱成像在边缘设备上的实际应用提供了可行路径。

title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
summary: Memory operations of long-horizon LLM agents are hard to supervise: an operation's value is unobservable when it is taken. But they are special -- they leave machine-readable evidence in the trajectory: retrieval hits and answer-time citations. Hindsight Memory-PRM exploits this audit trail twice: offline to train an operation-conditioned memory-utility critic, and online, where retrievals, citations, and one controlled deletion-and-reanswer per probe settle an intervention-calibrated entry-level presence credit, propagated along version chains as an action-level proxy reward -- no per-operation human labels, no Monte-Carlo replay of continuations. On held-out LoCoMo a local 8B policy reaches 77.5% under a fixed shared reader, surpassing its API teacher (65.1%) and all reproduced external systems, at one eighth the context of Mem0's official operating point; on LongMemEval, 79.0%. Ablations attribute the gain to causal calibration rather than signal density, and the policy converges to a multi-version memory organization whose gains no tested open-loop baseline reproduces.

AI.tldr: 针对长时程LLM智能体中记忆操作难以监督的问题，本文提出Hindsight Memory-PRM：利用轨迹中天然留存的可机读审计痕迹（检索命中与作答时引用），在离线阶段训练以操作为条件的记忆效用评判器，在在线阶段通过检索、引用及受控的“删除-重答”探针，沿版本链传播经干预校准的内存留存信用作为行动级代理奖励，全程无需逐操作人工标注或蒙特卡洛续写回放。在LoCoMo上，本地8B策略在固定共享阅读器下达到77.5%，超过其API教师（65.1%）及所有复现的外部系统，且上下文仅为Mem0官方设置点的八分之一；在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。消融实验表明增益源于因果校准而非信号密度，且策略收敛出多版本记忆组织，其优势无法被任何测试过的开环基线复现。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体的记忆操作（写入、检索、更新、删除等）难以监督，因为单次操作的效用在当时无法直接观测，事后也难以归属；传统方案要么需要逐操作的人工标注，要么依赖昂贵的蒙特卡洛续写回放来估计长期回报。本文的关键洞察是：记忆操作具有特殊性——它们会在轨迹中留下机器可读的审计证据（检索命中与作答时的引用），可以借此构建无需人工标注、因果校准的代理奖励。
AI.method: 提出Hindsight Memory-PRM，双阶段利用审计痕迹：（1）离线阶段，利用轨迹中的检索命中与引用作为监督信号，训练一个“以操作（operation）为条件”的记忆效用评判器（memory-utility critic）；（2）在线阶段，每条记忆条目通过检索、引用，以及每个探针一次受控的“删除-再作答”（deletion-and-reanswer）来结算干预校准的“在场性信用”（presence credit），并沿版本链（version chains）传播，形成行动级代理奖励。该方法不需要逐操作人工标签，也不需要蒙特卡洛续写回放。
AI.result: 在留出的LoCoMo基准上，本地8B策略在固定共享阅读器设置下达到77.5%，超过其API教师模型（65.1%）以及所有被复现的外部系统，且上下文开销仅为Mem0官方运行点的八分之一；在LongMemEval上达到79.0%。消融实验证明增益主要来自因果校准而非信号密度；策略最终收敛到多版本记忆组织形态，其收益无法被任何测试过的开环基线复现。
AI.conclusion: 记忆操作释放的审计痕迹足以支撑高质量、可扩展的记忆操作监督：借助离线效用评判器与在线干预校准的信用结算，本地小模型在不依赖人工标注和昂贵回放的情况下，即可超越其API教师及现有外部系统，并自发形成多版本记忆组织。因果校准是该方法有效性的核心，该范式为长时程智能体记忆策略的自我改进提供了可行的训练信号来源。

title: Towards an Expressivity-Normalized Energy-Demand Comparison of ANNs and SNNs
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are often regarded as energy-efficient alternatives to artificial neural networks (ANNs), yet their advantage depends critically on both network architecture and data properties. We develop an analytical framework to compare fully-connected ReLU ANNs and integrate-and-fire SNNs for time-series data with respect to their theoretical energy efficiency at matched expressive capacity. By relating an inference-energy model to theoretical bounds on representational expressivity, we derive an expressivity-normalized efficiency ratio and explicit thresholds in network width, spike sparsity, and ANN depth scaling. Our analysis characterizes the regimes in which event-driven computation offsets the temporal overhead of SNNs, providing capacity-aware principles for designing energy-efficient temporal networks. It shows that ANNs exceed SNNs in expressivity-normalized efficiency only in specific regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个分析框架，在匹配表达能力的条件下，从理论上比较全连接ReLU人工神经网络（ANN）与整合-发放脉冲神经网络（SNN）在时间序列数据上的能量效率，推导出表达能力归一化的效率比以及宽度、脉冲稀疏性和深度缩放等方面的明确阈值，并刻画了事件驱动计算能够抵消SNN时间开销的适用区间。
AI.motivation: SNN常被视为比ANN更节能的替代方案，但其节能优势高度依赖网络架构和数据特性。已有研究缺乏在匹配表达能力前提下对二者能量效率进行公平、理论化比较的框架，因此难以判断SNN究竟在何种条件下真正优于ANN。
AI.method: 将推理能量模型与表征表达能力（representational expressivity）的理论界相关联，构造一个表达能力归一化的效率比（expressivity-normalized efficiency ratio）；针对时间序列数据、全连接ReLU ANN与整合-发放SNN，推导出网络宽度、脉冲稀疏性以及ANN深度缩放等方面的显式阈值，从而界定事件驱动计算占优的机制区间。
AI.result: 分析刻画了事件驱动计算抵消SNN时间开销的适用机制/区间，并表明ANN仅在特定机制下才能在表达能力归一化效率上超过SNN；同时给出了可供设计参考的容量感知原则及关键阈值条件。
AI.conclusion: ANN在表达能力归一化效率上仅在特定条件下优于SNN，SNN的节能优势需结合网络容量与数据特性来判断；该框架为设计能量高效的时序网络提供了基于表达能力的指导原则。

title: Validating FKG.in: Soundness Assessment in LLM-Augmented Indian Food Knowledge
summary: The online culinary ecosystem is increasingly populated by recipe content generated, modified, or summarized by Large Language Models (LLMs). While often plausible, such outputs may contain hallucinated ingredients, misrepresented quantities, or culturally implausible combinations, limiting their suitability for downstream applications and knowledge graph construction. In this paper, we present a semi-automated soundness assessment workflow for validating structured recipe data extracted and augmented by LLMs from informal culinary sources. Developed as part of FKG(.in), a knowledge graph of Indian food, the pipeline identifies and addresses common failure modes, including structural inconsistencies, semantic and logical incoherence, and deviations from the source text, through a multi-stage process combining formal grammars, vocabulary-based checks, statistical heuristics, Set Transformer-based coherence modeling, and retrieval-based verification. Although evaluated on Indian recipes, the proposed methods are applicable to broader multilingual and multicultural culinary domains. We provide a practical, auditable, and application-agnostic framework for validating LLM-augmented recipe data, thereby strengthening the foundations of machine-readable food knowledge infrastructures in the era of LLM-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种半自动化的"健全性评估"工作流，用于验证由大语言模型（LLM）从非正式烹饪来源中提取和增强的结构化食谱数据。该工作流作为印度食物知识图谱 FKG(.in) 的一部分，通过多阶段流程（形式文法、基于词汇的检查、统计启发式、基于 Set Transformer 的一致性建模以及检索式验证）识别并修复结构性不一致、语义与逻辑不连贯以及偏离原文等常见故障模式，为 LLM 生成时代的机器可读食物知识基础设施提供了可审计、与应用无关的验证框架。
AI.motivation: 在线烹饪生态中充斥着由 LLM 生成、修改或摘要的食谱内容，这类输出虽然表面上看似合理，但可能包含幻觉成分、数量误述或文化上不合理的组合，从而限制其在下游应用和知识图谱构建中的可用性。因此需要一种系统性的验证方法来确保 LLM 增强的食谱数据在结构化后仍然可信。
AI.method: 提出一个多阶段、半自动化的健全性评估流水线，结合形式文法（formal grammars）、基于词汇表的检查、统计启发式、基于 Set Transformer 的连贯性建模以及基于检索的验证，系统性地定位并处理结构不一致、语义/逻辑不连贯以及偏离源文本等故障模式。
AI.result: 虽然实验评估针对印度食谱展开，但所提出的方法可推广到更广泛的多语言、多文化烹饪领域，提供了一个实用、可审计且与应用无关的框架，用于验证 LLM 增强的食谱数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流强化了在 LLM 生成内容时代机器可读食物知识基础设施的基础，为构建可靠的知识图谱提供了可验证、可追溯的食谱数据质量保障机制，并具有跨文化适用性。

title: Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

AI.tldr: 提出B-FOR（Background-Free Objectness Learning），一种无需显式背景监督的密集类无关目标检测框架。它通过预测多尺度目标中心场和位移感知尺度场，将目标检测建模为从局部空间结构中涌现的目标假设，仅对可靠标注区域进行监督，从而在标注不完整时消除背景偏差，并在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO、Open Images上实现+10 AR点的类无关召回提升。
AI.motivation: 现有目标检测器在封闭集监督下训练，将未标注区域隐式视为背景。当标注不完整时，这种假设引入"目标性偏差"：视觉上有效但未被标注的目标被当作负样本，使目标性（objectness）与已标注类别绑定，而非泛化的目标结构。这一局限对类无关检测和开放世界检测尤为严重，因此需要一种不依赖显式背景监督的目标性学习框架。
AI.method: B-FOR将类无关检测重构为密集多尺度目标中心场与尺度场（scale field）的预测任务：目标假设以局部空间结构（局部极大值）的形式从预测场中涌现。监督被限制在可靠的标注区域内，通过空间结构化的软目标（spatially structured soft targets）实现，从而避免前景-背景判别。为支持从涌现的局部极大值解码，论文进一步引入位移感知尺度场（displacement-aware scale fields），将目标范围建模为所学习目标性场的空间变化属性。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上的实验表明，该方法对未见类别和跨数据集目标分布具有强泛化能力；与既有类无关基线相比，召回率提升超过+10个AR点。消融实验证实，局部化的目标性监督与位移感知尺度场对于在不完整标注下实现类无关定位均至关重要。
AI.conclusion: B-FOR证明了不依赖显式背景监督也能学习泛化的目标性表示，为类无关与开放世界检测提供了可靠方案。核心贡献在于：(1) 将检测建模为局部结构的涌现，规避前景-背景判别；(2) 位移感知尺度场使目标范围可作为空间变化属性随目标性场联合解码；(3) 两项设计对类无关定位都不可或缺，且显著超越现有基线。代码已开源。

title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents need durable, faithful memory of everything a user or organization has said and stored, yet most memory systems commit to a single organizing structure (a fact store, a vector index, or a knowledge graph) and inherit its blind spots. We present Agent Zero Memory, a provenance-aware long-term memory system that distils a user's conversations, files, and connected sources into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the same history: an episodic Memory Events timeline that makes when and what changed first-class, an associative entity-event knowledge graph that links people and projects across sessions, and a semantic, curated, citation-locked Hierarchical Documentary Memory (HDM) of durable facts. A retrieval turn runs an intent gate (so self-contained turns add no latency), a source router, and three concurrent agentic searches, one per system, each a tool-using loop over hybrid (embedding + lexical) search under agent-controlled filters; their grounded, cited answers are integrated into one answer with a single confidence. We formalize the reading discipline: every learned item is a provenanced item carrying its origin, timestamp, and evidence pointer, and every answer is read under a citation lock, so it may cite only evidence its reader actually opened; fabrication is structurally excluded and the system abstains rather than guesses. On two public benchmarks the system sets a new state of the art: 95.60% on LongMemEval and 93.60% on LoCoMo, improving over the strongest prior systems by +0.73 and +1.10 points. A controlled study across eight backbone LLMs characterizes the accuracy-cost-latency frontier: accuracy varies by only 3.4 points while per-query cost varies by ~30x, with near-state-of-the-art quality at up to 20x lower cost per query, the signature of memory-driven, rather than model-driven, quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent Zero Memory，一种基于溯源感知的三并行长期记忆系统（事件时间线、实体-事件知识图谱、带引文锁的分层文献记忆），在 LongMemEval 达 95.60%、LoCoMo 达 93.60%，刷新 SOTA，并通过八种骨干模型实验证明质量主要来自记忆系统而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需要持久且忠实的记忆来承载用户/组织的所有陈述与存储内容，但现有记忆系统通常只采用单一组织结构（事实库、向量索引或知识图谱）并继承其盲区；同时生成式回答易出现无根据的臆测（幻觉），缺乏可验证的证据支撑。
AI.method: 将对话、文件及连接源蒸馏为三个并行记忆系统：可追溯"何时/何内容变化"的事件时间线、跨会话关联人物与项目的实体-事件知识图谱、以及带引文锁的语义化分层文献记忆（HDM）。检索时依次经过意图门（自包含轮次零延迟）、源路由器与三路并发的 agent 搜索（在智能体控制过滤器下执行嵌入+词法混合搜索），将带依据的回答以单一置信度整合。形式上规定阅读纪律：每条习得项都携带来源、时间戳与证据指针，每个回答在引文锁下只能引用读者确实打开过的证据，从而结构性排除捏造，宁可弃权也不猜测。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准上取得新 SOTA：LongMemEval 95.60%、LoCoMo 93.60%，较最强先前系统分别提升 +0.73 与 +1.10。对八种骨干 LLM 的受控研究刻画了精度-成本-时延前沿：精度仅波动 3.4 点，而单次查询成本波动约 30 倍；可在每次查询成本降低高达 20 倍的情况下获得接近 SOTA 的质量。
AI.conclusion: 质量由记忆驱动而非模型驱动：通过三类互补记忆结构与严格的溯源/引文纪律，系统能够提供持久、忠实、可验证的长期记忆，并结构性杜绝幻觉；该架构在精度、成本与时延之间展现出优良的权衡。

title: Structural Hierarchy and Geometry in Molecular Representation Learning
summary: Molecular self-supervised learning uses chemical structures to guide which molecular embeddings should be similar. We study whether explicitly encoding a molecule's Bemis-Murcko scaffold and using it to supervise the molecular embedding changes what the model learns. We further test whether this effect depends on the embedding geometry by comparing Euclidean and Lorentz contrastive objectives. Across two augmentation strengths, scaffold-supervised models consistently organize molecules according to both identical and structurally related scaffolds. The resulting embeddings also improve molecular property prediction on several tasks, while the exact gains depend on the predicted property. The effect of scaffold supervision on molecular organization is stronger under Lorentz objectives, but neither geometry provides a consistent overall advantage. These results show that explicitly teaching the relation between a molecule and its structural core can reliably shape the organization of molecular embedding space, while the extent of usefulness of this organization remains task dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在分子自监督学习中显式利用Bemis-Murcko骨架来监督分子嵌入，并比较欧几里得与Lorentz对比目标的影响。实验表明，骨架监督能可靠地让模型按相同或结构相关的骨架组织分子，并在多个性质预测任务上带来提升；Lorentz目标下骨架监督对分子组织的效果更强，但两种几何没有一致的整体优势，效果取决于具体任务。
AI.motivation: 分子自监督学习通常仅依靠化学结构来引导哪些分子嵌入应当相似，很少显式利用分子骨架（scaffold）这一结构核心信息。作者希望探究显式编码Bemis-Murcko骨架并以其监督分子嵌入，是否会改变模型所学到的表征，以及这种影响是否依赖于嵌入空间的几何结构。
AI.method: 在两种增强强度下进行系统性比较：将分子的Bemis-Murcko骨架显式编码并用于监督分子嵌入；同时通过对比欧几里得与Lorentz两种对比学习目标，考察嵌入几何对骨架监督效果的影响。
AI.result: 骨架监督模型一致地按照相同及结构相关的骨架组织分子；在多个分子性质预测任务上取得了改进，但具体收益随预测性质而异。在Lorentz目标下，骨架监督对分子组织的引导作用更强，但两种几何均未带来一致的整体优势。
AI.conclusion: 显式地教授分子与其结构核心之间的关系，能够可靠地塑造分子嵌入空间的组织方式；但这种组织方式在多大程度上对下游任务有用，仍具有任务依赖性。

title: GuardianAgent: Policy-Conditioned Risk-Adaptive Anonymization with Verified Adversarial Escalation
summary: Privacy protection for live web traffic requires more than detecting private spans. Agent-based privacy protection systems must determine whether an outgoing action complies with the destination site's privacy policy, then apply only the level of rewriting or sanitisation justified by the residual disclosure risk. We present GuardianAgent, a policy-conditioned anonymization framework that couples structured risk assessment with verified adaptive rewriting. GuardianAgent computes risk through AMRSF (Adaptive Multi-factor Risk Scoring Formula), an explicit controller that combines policy-violation likelihood with data sensitivity, recipient transmission, purpose legitimacy, contextual basis, and policy transparency, rather than relying on an LLM to assign risk directly. This risk score determines both the allow/transform/deny decision and the initial anonymization level. For efficiency, GuardianAgent uses an evidential fast path for low-uncertainty policy matches and invokes an LLM slow path only for uncertain cases. For rewriting, it applies a five-level hierarchy driven by a verified adversarial guesser: guesses trigger escalation only when supported by the original text, preventing hallucinated attacker confidence from causing unnecessary over-anonymization. Experiments across three benchmarks spanning legal text (TAB), Reddit posts (SynthPAI), and multi-format synthetic PII records (PII-Masking-300k) show that GuardianAgent achieves the strongest privacy-utility trade-off among published baselines and is the only method to reach more than 0.90 privacy in all three domains, remaining robust under a backbone switch. Action-context stress tests further show that the same outgoing text receives different decisions and anonymization strengths under different recipients, purposes, action bases, and policy-transparency conditions.

AI.tldr: GuardianAgent 是一个策略条件化的匿名化框架，通过显式的 AMRSF 多因子风险评分控制器决定放行/转换/拒绝操作及匿名化强度，并采用证据性快速路径与 LLM 慢速路径结合的方式处理策略匹配，同时用五级重写层级和可验证的对抗性猜测器实现隐私与效用的最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 实时网络流量的隐私保护不能仅靠检测敏感片段：基于智能体的隐私保护系统必须判断外发动作是否符合目标站点隐私策略，并仅施加与残余披露风险相匹配的重写或净化级别。现有方法缺乏将策略合规判断与按需匿名化强度相耦合的机制，且若直接依赖 LLM 分配风险可能不可靠。
AI.method: GuardianAgent 将结构化风险评估与可验证的自适应重写相结合。风险由 AMRSF（自适应多因子风险评分公式）显式计算，综合策略违规可能性、数据敏感性、接收方传输、目的合法性、上下文依据和策略透明度，而非交由 LLM 直接打分。风险分数同时决定 allow/transform/deny 决策和初始匿名化级别。效率上采用证据性快速路径处理低不确定性策略匹配，仅在不确定时调用 LLM 慢速路径。重写采用五级层级，由可验证的对抗性猜测器驱动：只有原始文本支持时才允许升级猜测，防止幻觉造成的过度匿名化。
AI.result: 在三个基准（法律文本 TAB、Reddit 帖子 SynthPAI、多格式合成 PII 记录 PII-Masking-300k）上，GuardianAgent 在已发表基线中取得最强的隐私-效用权衡，是唯一在所有三个领域隐私得分均超过 0.90 的方法，且在更换主干模型时保持稳健。动作上下文压力测试还表明，同一外发文本在不同接收方、目的、动作依据和策略透明度条件下会获得不同的决策和匿名化强度。
AI.conclusion: GuardianAgent 表明将显式风险评分与可验证的自适应重写相结合，能够在实时网络流量场景中同时实现强隐私保护和良好效用，并且其决策能正确反映动作上下文（接收方、目的、依据、策略透明度）的影响；显式风险评估与分级重写机制相比纯 LLM 驱动方式更具稳健性和可信度。

title: Generalization over Memorization: Generalization-Aware Diffusion Adaptation for Single-Image Multi-View Synthesis
comment: ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge Track winning paper; presents the 1st-place solution among 293 registered teams. 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: We present the winning solution to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge on Single-Image Guided Multi-Angle Image Synthesis. It ranks first among 293 registered teams; 56 teams obtained at least one scored submission on the public Phase-A leaderboard. With only 40 training scenes, the challenge requires 26 target views from one RGB model and one forward pass per view; it prohibits explicit geometry, external rendering, chained generation, candidate selection, and post-processing. We identify a critical model-selection failure: shared training and validation scenes make memorization appear as transferable view control. We therefore introduce GoM. Short for Generalization over Memorization, the framework combines scene-disjoint validation, exposure-matched selection, and targeted diffusion adaptation. Its synthesis model adapts a 4B rectified-flow DiT using rank-32 LoRA, optimizer restarts, late-checkpoint averaging, and VAE decoder tuning. More than 300 offline experiments and 24 online submissions show that validation design and training-trajectory control can matter as much as architecture scale in small-data generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GoM（Generalization over Memorization，泛化优先于记忆）框架，在ACM Multimedia 2026单图引导多视角图像合成大挑战中以293支注册队伍中第一名的成绩胜出。该框架的核心洞察是：当训练集与验证集共享场景时，模型记忆会被误判为可迁移的视角控制能力，从而造成模型选择的系统性失败。GoM通过场景分离的验证集、曝光匹配的选择策略和针对性的扩散模型适配（4B rectified-flow DiT + rank-32 LoRA、优化器重启、后期检查点平均、VAE解码器微调），在仅40个训练场景、无显式几何/外部渲染/链式生成/候选选择/后处理等严苛约束下实现26个目标视图的生成。
AI.motivation: 挑战设置极为苛刻：仅40个训练场景、每个目标视图一次前向传播即可生成26个视角，同时禁止显式几何、外部渲染、链式生成、候选选择和后处理。作者发现了一个关键的模型选择失败模式：由于训练与验证场景重叠，记忆训练场景的模型在验证集上表现良好，导致记忆被误判为可迁移的视角控制能力。这种验证设计缺陷使得"泛化能力"无法被正确度量，是驱动作者提出GoM的根本动机。
AI.method: GoM框架由三部分组成：(1) 场景分离验证（scene-disjoint validation）：确保验证场景在训练中完全未见，从而真实度量模型的泛化而非记忆；(2) 曝光匹配选择（exposure-matched selection）：在相同数据曝光量下公平比较不同训练轨迹的模型，避免训练步数或迭代次数差异带来的偏差；(3) 靶向扩散适配（targeted diffusion adaptation）：基于4B参数的rectified-flow扩散Transformer（DiT），采用rank-32 LoRA低秩适配，配合优化器重启、后期检查点平均和VAE解码器微调等训练轨迹控制手段。作者进行了300余次离线实验和24次在线提交以系统验证该设计。
AI.result: 在ACM Multimedia 2026大挑战中，GoM在293支注册队伍中排名第一（其中56支队伍在公共Phase-A排行榜上获得至少一次有效提交），以最少的训练数据（40场景）在不使用任何被禁技术的前提下，高质量地完成单图引导的多视角合成任务。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过300余次离线实验与24次在线提交证明：在小数据生成建模中，验证集设计与训练轨迹控制（如优化器重启、检查点平均）对最终性能的影响可与架构规模相当甚至更大。该工作揭示了"验证协议决定模型选择可信度"这一常被忽视的原则，为数据受限条件下的大规模扩散模型适配提供了方法论指导。

title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
comment: PhD Thesis submitted to UChicago (https://knowledge.uchicago.edu/records/5jrnc-nvp13). Update Branching Factor, AI Realtor, and BACo to the latest versions
summary:
The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argues that such surface alignment masks a lack of grounding, creating models that are stylistically confident but situationally brittle. We propose a framework of Grounded Alignment, analyzing how models process context (Input) and structure generation (Output), then aligning these grounded behaviors to human needs.
  First, we evaluate failures in Situational Grounding. SitTest shows that despite large context windows, state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain a consistent "mental model" of a changing environment. ReCode further shows that models rely on surface heuristics rather than deep syntactic dependencies: they "read" extensive histories without truly "understanding" the evolving situation.
  Second, we evaluate Generative Grounding. We introduce the Branching Factor (BF) to map LLM generation, finding that standard alignment tuning constricts this landscape into premature stylistic collapse. Hindsight further shows that models often fail to understand their own generations.
  Finally, we propose Dynamic Control for grounded interaction. AI Realtor demonstrates context engineering to compensate for poor situational grounding. Base-Aligned Model Collaboration decouples exploration from stylistic constraints. We also present Annealed Sampling for verifiable reinforcement learning and apply these ideas to Addiction Support, where model-generated rationalization offers a communication interface for high-stakes domains. Collectively, this work moves beyond surface alignment toward agents anchored in both context and generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"落地对齐"(Grounded Alignment)框架，指出现有对齐调优只追求流畅、安全、语调一致等表层行为，导致模型"风格自信但情境脆弱"；通过情境落地评测(SitTest、ReCode)、生成落地评测(Branching Factor、Hindsight)以及动态控制方法(AI Realtor、Base-Aligned Model Collaboration、Annealed Sampling、Addiction Support)，使LLM同时锚定于上下文理解与生成过程。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的对齐调优范式优先塑造表层行为（流畅性、安全性、语调一致），这掩盖了模型缺乏真正的"落地"(grounding)：尽管上下文窗口很大，SOTA模型仍难以对不断变化的环境维持一致的心理模型；模型依赖表面启发式而非深层句法依赖，"读"了大量历史却不真正"理解"演变中的情境；同时模型常常不理解自己的生成内容。这种表面对齐在闲聊场景下有效，但导致模型情境化脆弱、高利害场景不可靠。
AI.method: 提出Grounded Alignment框架，从"输入(上下文处理)"与"输出(生成结构)"两个维度对齐到人类需求。1)情境落地评测：SitTest考察模型在变化环境中维持一致心理模型的能力；ReCode验证模型是否依赖表面启发式而非深层句法依赖。2)生成落地评测：引入Branching Factor (BF)刻画LLM生成空间，发现标准对齐调优把生成景观压缩成过早的风格坍缩；Hindsight检验模型对自身生成的理解能力。3)动态控制：AI Realtor以上下文工程补偿情境落地不足；Base-Aligned Model Collaboration将探索与风格约束解耦；提出Annealed Sampling用于可验证强化学习；并将上述思想应用于Addiction Support，以模型生成的自圆其说(rationalization)作为高利害领域的沟通界面。
AI.result: SitTest显示即便拥有大上下文窗口，SOTA模型仍难以维持对变化环境的稳定心理模型；ReCode表明模型依赖表面启发式而非深层依赖。Branching Factor揭示标准对齐调优会使生成空间过早风格坍缩；Hindsight显示模型常无法理解自身生成。动态控制方面，上下文工程、探索/风格解耦、退火采样等方法在AI Realtor、可验证强化学习以及成瘾支持等场景中得到了验证与应用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作系统性地论证并弥补了"对齐即表层行为塑造"的缺憾：通过情境落地与生成落地两个维度的评测工具揭示模型的脆弱性，并通过动态控制机制将探索与风格约束分离、将生成锚定于真实上下文。最终目标是超越表面对齐，构建同时在上下文与生成两个层面都真正"落地"的智能体，为高利害领域的安全交互提供新范式。

title: Sensitivity-Constrained Neural Operators for Data-Efficient Forward and Inverse Modeling of Partial Differential Equation Systems
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for partial differential equation (PDE) solvers, but their reliability can degrade for high-dimensional spatial inputs and inverse or repeated inference. State-only training constrains solution values but not the learned input--output response. We study sensitivity-constrained neural operators (SC-NOs), which augment standard training with sampled solver-derived Jacobian supervision. Selected sensitivities from differentiable solvers or discrete adjoints are matched during training, allowing response information to be amortized across minibatches without imposing the full Jacobian at every update. We evaluate SC-NO on advection--diffusion and RANS--Spalart--Allmaras benchmarks, input-dimensionality scaling tests, long-horizon autoregressive rollout, and a shallow-water Tohoku tsunami source-inversion case. Sensitivity supervision improves forward prediction and yields larger gains in gradient-based inverse reconstruction of distributed fields. Scaling experiments show an improved accuracy--cost tradeoff for high-dimensional gridded inputs, while ablations indicate that state values and Jacobian information provide complementary supervision. In the tsunami case, SC-FNO reconstructs gridded seafloor deformation from sparse early gauge observations and forecasts subsequent wave propagation in a near-real-time proof-of-concept workflow. These results support sampled sensitivity supervision as a practical way to improve neural PDE surrogates when forward accuracy, inverse stability, robustness, and computational cost must be considered together.

AI.tldr: 本文提出灵敏度约束神经算子（SC-NO），通过在训练中引入从可微求解器或离散伴随提取的采样雅可比监督，将输入-输出响应信息摊销到小批量训练中，从而提升神经算子前向预测精度与反演稳定性。实验涵盖对流-扩散、RANS-Spalart-Allmaras、高维输入扩展、长时程自回归滚动及浅水方程海啸震源反演，验证了灵敏度监督在权衡精度、反演稳定性、鲁棒性与计算成本时的实际价值。
AI.motivation: 神经算子可作为PDE求解器的快速替代，但其可靠性在高维空间输入以及反演、重复推断等场景下会退化。仅依赖状态值(解值)的训练约束了解值本身，却无法约束学习到的输入-输出响应关系，导致反演和不确定性相关的任务表现不稳定，因此需要引入额外的灵敏度(雅可比)监督。
AI.method: 提出SC-NO框架：在标准状态训练基础上，用从可微求解器或离散伴随中采样的雅可比(灵敏度)信号进行监督。训练时将所选的灵敏度与对应雅可比匹配，从而把响应信息摊销到各个小批量中，而不必在每次更新时施加完整雅可比。
AI.result: 灵敏度监督提升了前向预测精度，并在基于梯度的分布式场反演重建中带来更大增益；高维网格输入的扩展实验显示精度-成本权衡得到改善；消融表明状态值与雅可比信息提供互补监督。在海啸案例中，SC-FNO能够从稀疏早期水位观测重建网格化海床形变并预测后续波浪传播，实现近实时概念验证工作流。
AI.conclusion: 采样灵敏度监督是一种实用且有效的训练策略，可以全面提升神经PDE替代模型在前向精度、反演稳定性、鲁棒性与计算成本组合约束下的性能，支持将雅可比监督作为神经算子训练中的常规增强手段。

title: Dynamic Important Example Mining for Reinforcement Finetuning
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used to strengthen the reasoning abilities of large models, yet its effectiveness is bound by how training data are selected and used. Most data-centric RFT methods rely on static or heuristic sample selection, implicitly assuming a sample's value is fixed over training. This overlooks the non-stationary dynamics of policy learning and can lead to suboptimal updates. We propose Dynamic Important Example Mining (DIEM), a principled and fully automated framework that makes data utilization adaptive throughout RFT. DIEM integrates two components into each optimization step: (i) a gradient-alignment importance estimator that efficiently approximates each sample's marginal contribution to policy improvement; and (ii) a constrained batch reweighting scheme that maximizes aggregate utility while preserving the update's gradient magnitude to stabilize optimization. Across several reasoning benchmarks, DIEM consistently outperforms strong static and dynamic baselines. The code will be released via https://github.com/hrtan/DIEM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIEM（动态重要样本挖掘），一种在强化微调（RFT）过程中自适应利用训练数据的全自动框架，通过梯度对齐的重要性估计器和带约束的批次重加权机制，在每个优化步骤动态调整样本权重，从而提升大模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据中心的 RFT 方法大多采用静态或启发式的样本选择，隐含假设样本价值在训练过程中固定不变，忽略了策略学习的非平稳动态，可能导致次优的参数更新。
AI.method: DIEM 在每个优化步骤中集成两个组件：(i) 梯度对齐重要性估计器，高效近似每个样本对策略改进的边际贡献；(ii) 带约束的批次重加权方案，在最大化整体效用的同时保持更新梯度幅值，以稳定优化过程。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，DIEM 一致优于强静态基线和动态基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过让数据利用在 RFT 全过程中自适应变化，DIEM 能够更有效地挖掘高价值训练样本，稳定优化并提升推理性能，且代码已开源。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation
summary:
Anti-UAV perception systems must remain reliable when sensor streams degrade under occlusion, fast motion, or modality-specific failure. Existing multimodal anti-UAV systems fuse RGB and thermal streams deterministically, without modeling predictive uncertainty, and cannot express doubt when streams disagree. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) produces calibrated per-class uncertainty in a single forward pass. EDTC already exploits this for thermal-only perception, yet cross-modal evidential fusion remains unaddressed.
  This paper extends EDTC to multimodal RGB-Thermal perception via Discounted Belief Fusion (DBF), which converts inter-modal conflict into uncertainty mass before aggregating stream opinions. Bounding boxes are resolved by selecting the lower-uncertainty modality. On the Anti-UAV benchmark, multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either single stream (test Acc 0.670 vs. 0.604 IR, 0.598 RGB) at real-time speed (at least 38 FPS). However, DBF is empirically indistinguishable from undiscounted averaging: near-zero inter-modal conflict on this presence-dominated benchmark leaves the discounting step inert. The fused uncertainty is well-calibrated (ECE 0.057) yet expectedly a weaker localization failure detector than spatial variance (AUROC 0.626 vs. 0.739). The null result is structural: the benchmark's near-universal presence and vacuous miss-encoding jointly suppress inter-modal conflict, a diagnosis that delimits where conflict-aware fusion provides measurable benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于折扣信念融合（DBF）的多模态证据深度学习框架，将EDTC扩展至RGB-热成像反无人机感知，通过融合前将模态间冲突转化为不确定度质量来提升可靠性。虽然多模态融合在精度上优于单一模态（准确率0.670）并保持实时性（≥38 FPS），但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分——该基准中近乎普遍的存在性与空洞的漏检编码共同抑制了模态间冲突，导致折扣步骤失效，形成结构性零结果。
AI.motivation: 现有反无人机多模态系统以确定性方式融合RGB和热成像流，不建模预测不确定性，在流间不一致时无法表达怀疑；EDL虽能在单次前向传播中产生校准的逐类不确定性，且EDTC已用于热成像单模态感知，但跨模态证据融合仍是空白，亟需一种能显式处理模态冲突并表达不确定性的融合方案。
AI.method: 将EDTC扩展至多模态RGB-热成像感知，采用折扣信念融合（DBF）：在聚合各流意见前，先将模态间冲突转换为不确定度质量；边界框通过选择较低不确定性的模态来解析。
AI.result: 在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合持续优于任一单流（测试准确率0.670 vs 红外0.604、RGB 0.598），并达到实时速度（至少38 FPS）。但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分：该以存在性主导的基准上模态间冲突接近零，使折扣步骤失效；融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057），但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。
AI.conclusion: 该零结果是结构性的：基准数据近乎普遍的存在性标签与空洞的漏检编码共同压低了模态间冲突，这一诊断限定了冲突感知融合能够带来可衡量收益的适用条件，为反无人机多模态不确定性融合的实际价值划定了边界。

title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Function vectors (FVs) have recently emerged as a promising mechanism for steering the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by injecting task-specific latent direction representations derived from in-context demonstrations. While prior studies have shown that FVs can recover task behavior in structured in-context learning settings, their effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and their ability to generalize across languages remain underexplored. We investigate the cross-lingual transferability of FVs using multilingual multi-label emotion recognition as a challenging semantic classification benchmark. Specifically, we examine whether FVs extracted from a source language can steer task behavior in another language under both standard clean and perturbed zero-shot settings without providing demonstrations during inference. Across diverse cross-lingual settings, applying FVs substantially improves performance, suggesting that FVs capture language-agnostic, task-relevant signals rather than purely language-specific lexical patterns, and highlighting their potential as a lightweight and transferable mechanism for multilingual task adaptation. We observe that each LLM exhibits a relatively stable optimal range of attention heads for constructing effective FVs, and the pattern remains consistent across languages. In addition, FVs can partially replicate the task-steering effects of standard few-shot in-context learning while avoiding the computational overhead of processing multiple demonstrations, making them effective for large-scale practical applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingjie7/cross_lingual_fvs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了函数向量（FVs）的跨语言迁移能力，以多语言多标签情感识别这一语义复杂任务为基准，检验从源语言提取的FVs能否在无推理演示的零样本（含干净与扰动）设置下引导目标语言的任务行为。实验表明FVs能显著提升跨语言性能，说明其捕获了与语言无关的任务相关信号，且每个LLM存在跨语言一致的最优注意力头范围；FVs还能部分复现少样本上下文学习的任务引导效果并降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 函数向量（FVs）作为一种通过注入任务特定潜在方向表征来引导LLM行为的机制已崭露头角，但此前研究主要验证其在结构化上下文学习场景中的有效性，对于语义复杂任务的有效性以及跨语言泛化能力尚未得到充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 以多语言多标签情感识别作为具有挑战性的语义分类基准，考察从源语言提取的FVs能否在标准干净与扰动的零样本设置下（推理时不提供演示）引导另一语言的任务行为，并在多种跨语言设置与多个LLM上进行系统评估，同时分析注意力头选择对FVs质量的影响。
AI.result: 在多样的跨语言设置下，应用FVs显著提升了任务性能，表明FVs捕获的是与语言无关的任务相关信号而非纯粹的语言特定词汇模式；每个LLM在构造有效FVs时表现出相对稳定且跨语言一致的最优注意力头范围；此外FVs可部分复现标准少样本上下文学习的任务引导效果，同时避免了处理多条演示的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: FVs是一种轻量且可迁移的多语言任务适配机制，能够有效跨语言引导语义复杂的任务行为，具有实用价值与规模化应用潜力，代码已公开。

title: Joint Spatiotemporal Spectral Neural Operators for Learning PDEs on Irregular Domains
summary: Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) on irregular and geometry-dependent domains remains a central challenge in scientific machine learning. While spectral methods provide strong inductive biases for modeling global interactions, they are typically limited to regular domains, and existing neural approaches often require domain warping, interpolation, or costly geometric embeddings. We introduce the \textbf{Graph Spectral Neural Operator (GSNO)}, a neural operator that combines spatial graph spectral decompositions with temporal Fourier transforms through a unified space--time spectral kernel. This formulation enables globally coherent operator learning on non-Cartesian discretizations without domain warping or autoregressive rollouts. By replacing learned geometric embeddings with a graph Laplacian spectral basis, GSNO provides geometry-aware spectral learning with low parameter complexity. Across steady and unsteady PDE benchmarks on irregular and geometry-dependent domains, GSNO achieves strong accuracy with reduced runtime and parameter counts, while demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization across mesh resolutions and geometry families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图谱神经算子（GSNO），通过将空间图拉普拉斯谱分解与时间傅里叶变换结合为统一的时空谱核，在非笛卡尔、不规则及几何相关域上实现了无需域变形、插值或几何嵌入的全局一致神经算子学习，并在稳态与非稳态PDE基准上以更低计算量与参数量取得强精度和良好的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在不规则和几何相关的计算域上学习PDE解算子仍是科学机器学习中的核心难题。谱方法虽为建模全局交互提供了强归纳偏置，但通常局限于规则域；现有神经方法往往需要域扭曲、插值或昂贵的几何嵌入，限制了其在一般非正则离散化上的适用性。作者旨在克服这些局限，在任意几何域上实现全局一致的算子学习。
AI.method: GSNO将空间图谱分解与时间傅里叶变换结合，构建统一的时空谱核；用图拉普拉斯谱基替代学习得到的几何嵌入，从而在非笛卡尔离散化上实现几何感知的谱学习，无需域变形、插值或自回归 rollout，且参数复杂度低。
AI.result: 在不规则和几何相关域上的稳态与非稳态PDE基准中，GSNO在降低运行时间和参数数量的同时取得了较高的精度，并在不同网格分辨率与几何族之间展现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过以图拉普拉斯谱基作为几何先验并结合时空谱核，GSNO为不规则及几何相关域上的算符学习提供了一种高效、低参数、强泛化的方案，展现了谱方法在非正则几何上的推广潜力。

title: RACER: Reinforced Agent Collaboration for Explainable Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs
comment: 15 pages, 1 figures, This paper has been accepted by ICONIP 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from hallucination and struggle with complex reasoning tasks requiring multi-hop domain knowledge. While integrating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provides a structured and verifiable information source, current KG-enhanced LLM paradigms usually rely on single-agent path extraction and fixed prompting, lacking adaptability and facing huge search spaces. To address these challenges, we propose RACER, a Reinforced Agent Collaboration framework for Explainable Reasoning on knowledge graphs. RACER employs a semantic-aware action pruning and teacher-guided reinforcement learning mechanism to efficiently extract high-quality reasoning pathways from large-scale KGs. Furthermore, to mitigate single-path generation pitfalls, we introduce a cross-task accumulated shared memory graph paired with an attention-driven multi-path knowledge refinement module. Finally, RACER orchestrates these components through a four-role multi-agent collaboration system (GraphAgent, TemplateAgent, AnswerAgent, and CriticAgent) to dynamically refine prompts and evaluate answers. Extensive experiments on CommonsenseQA and OpenBookQA datasets demonstrate that RACER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KG-enhanced LLM baselines with an average improvement of 5\%, offering robust and highly interpretable reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RACER，一个基于强化学习的智能体协作框架，用于在知识图谱上进行可解释推理，解决LLM幻觉和多跳推理困难的问题，在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA上平均超越SOTA基线5%。
AI.motivation: LLM常出现幻觉，且难以完成需要多跳领域知识的复杂推理。虽然集成知识图谱（KG）可提供结构化、可验证的信息源，但现有KG增强的LLM范式通常依赖单智能体路径提取和固定提示，缺乏适应性且面临巨大搜索空间。
AI.method: RACER包含三大核心机制：（1）语义感知的动作剪枝与教师引导的强化学习机制，用于从大规模KG中高效提取高质量推理路径；（2）跨任务累积的共享记忆图谱与注意力驱动的多路径知识精炼模块，以缓解单路径生成的缺陷；（3）四角色多智能体协作系统（GraphAgent、TemplateAgent、AnswerAgent、CriticAgent）动态精炼提示并评估答案。
AI.result: 在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA数据集上的大量实验表明，RACER显著优于SOTA KG增强LLM基线，平均提升5%，提供鲁棒且高度可解释的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: RACER通过强化学习、跨任务记忆图谱和多角色智能体协作相结合，有效解决了KG增强LLM在可扩展性、适应性和可解释性方面的不足，展示了优越的性能与可解释性。

title: AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot
summary: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AGRICAM——一种用于大规模保护地作物授粉监测的自动化轨道机器人系统。该系统通过低成本轨道自主移动，集成双RGB摄像头、微气候传感器、GPS/RFID、运动传感器和4G联网，在云端利用计算机视觉模型量化传粉昆虫访问与时空活动。在商业蓝莓农场的80米长工业隧道内30小时部署验证表明，该系统能绘制授粉格局、确认棚内传粉者分布均匀，并揭示活动随时间与微气候的变化，展现出可扩展、自动化的授粉监测能力。
AI.motivation: 昆虫授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但商业农场尺度上的传粉者监测仍是难题。现有计算机视觉与深度学习技术虽能详细分析传粉者行为，但监测需要在细节、空间覆盖以及人力/技术资源之间进行权衡。亟需一种兼顾大规模覆盖、自主运行且不干扰农场作业与昆虫行为的监测系统。
AI.method: 设计并构建AGRICAM自主轨道机器人：在低成本、易于安装的轨道上沿作物行自主移动；集成双RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS与RFID模块、运动传感器及4G蜂窝网络实现数据传输；提供网页界面进行远程配置与调度；自动采集昆虫位置视频/图像与环境数据并上传云端，采用计算机视觉模型量化传粉者访问率及时空活动变化。在商业蓝莓农场进行了系统部署与测试。
AI.result: 系统在商业蓝莓农场80米长工业聚乙烯隧道内成功运行30小时，绘制出昆虫授粉格局；空间分析确认了隧道内传粉者分布均匀（符合农场管理团队期望）；数据还揭示了昆虫活动随一天中时段和微气候的变化。表明AGRICAM是可扩展、自动化的作物授粉监测工具。
AI.conclusion: AGRICAM已被证明是一种可扩展、自动化的作物授粉监测系统，能够为授粉管理提供数据驱动的决策支持，从而提升作物生产力并保障粮食安全。

title: JPO: Juris Policy Optimization for Structured Legal Reasoning in Criminal Judgment Prediction
summary: Criminal judgment prediction requires models to infer statutory articles, charges, and sentencing outcomes from case facts. Unlike standard classification tasks, it involves a structured reasoning process in which statutes should be matched with facts, charges should be justified by statutes, and sentencing outcomes should remain consistent with charges. Existing approaches optimize final labels, and while some have attempted to evaluate reasoning quality, their evaluations are indirect, often relying on LLM-generated rubrics that reflect model-internal preferences rather than the inherent logical structure of legal adjudication. We propose Juris Policy Optimization (JPO), a post-training framework for structured legal reasoning in Chinese criminal judgment prediction. JPO first uses teacher-generated rationales to supervise a standardized four-step reasoning process, and then applies reinforcement learning with a composite reward over legal prediction quality, reasoning structure completeness, and cross-step consistency. JPO further introduces token-level advantage reweighting and adaptive clipping for legally salient reasoning segments. Experiments on multiple open-source language models and three Chinese legal benchmarks show that JPO consistently improves both judgment prediction and reasoning quality over supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Juris Policy Optimization (JPO)，一种面向中文刑事判决预测的结构化法律推理后训练框架，通过教师生成的理由监督标准化的四步推理过程，并结合强化学习与复合奖励来提升判决预测与推理质量。
AI.motivation: 现有刑事判决预测方法主要优化最终标签，即便有工作尝试评估推理质量，其评估也是间接的，通常依赖LLM生成的评分标准，反映的是模型内部偏好而非法律裁判固有的逻辑结构。法律推理应遵循"法条-事实匹配、罪名-法条论证、量刑-罪名一致"的结构化过程。
AI.method: JPO包含两个阶段：(1) 使用教师生成的理由来监督标准化的四步推理过程；(2) 应用强化学习，综合奖励涵盖法律预测质量、推理结构完整性和跨步骤一致性。此外，JPO引入针对法律关键推理片段的token级优势重加权与自适应裁剪技术。
AI.result: 在多个开源语言模型和三个中文法律基准上的实验表明，JPO在判决预测和推理质量两方面均持续优于监督微调和强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: JPO通过显式建模法律裁判的结构化推理过程并配合专门设计的强化学习训练，能够稳定提升刑事判决预测任务中的预测准确性与推理质量，验证了将法律逻辑结构注入模型训练的有效性。

title: INTERVenE: Temporal-Abstraction-Interval Based Transformers for Short-Horizon Medical Event Prediction
summary: Electronic Health Record (EHR) prediction models in the intensive care unit must learn from sparse and irregular measurements while preserving the clinical meaning of time and supporting transparent decision-making. We present INTERVenE, a family of Transformer architectures whose input is an interval-based, knowledge-based temporal abstraction (KBTA), a token stream of named clinical concepts (states, trends, events, contexts) drawn from a curated medical ontology, rather than an unnamed bin index or a raw measurement triplet. This naming layer is what we ask KBTA to do: it makes the model's per-token attributions resolve to clinical concepts by construction. INTERVenE offers two complementary variants: an auto-regressive decoder that generates future abstraction trajectories with a per-step risk readout (localizing \emph{when} and \emph{after which events} risk rises), and a bidirectional encoder for single-pass joint risk and time-to-event prediction. Evaluated on 57,078 MIMIC-IV admissions against GRU-D, STraTS, and KarmaLego, INTERVenE-Enc reaches a support-weighted AUPRC$_w$ of 0.672, improving by 0.041 over the strongest neural baseline with non-overlapping 95\% bootstrap CIs, while also taking the best AUROC$_w$ (0.901) and length-of-stay MAE (44.4\,h). INTERVenE-Ar (AUROC$_w$ $0.854$, AUPRC$_w$ $0.587$ under the same evaluation contract - a strictly harder generative readout) provides a complementary token-level risk trajectory. An input-representation ablation confirms the lift transfers across structured discretizations, positioning KBTA-based intervals as the interpretable substrate that makes per-token attributions resolve to meaningful clinical concepts within the deployed model.

AI.tldr: 提出INTERVenE：一种以基于区间、基于知识的时间抽象（KBTA）为输入的Transformer模型族，通过对ICU不规则稀疏EHR数据进行临床概念化的分词表示，使模型归因直接对应有临床意义的实体，在MIMIC-IV上相对最强神经基线将加权AUPRC提升0.041，并同时支持双向编码（风险+时间事件预测）与自回归解码（逐时间步风险轨迹）两种互补架构。
AI.motivation: ICU中的EHR预测模型必须处理稀疏、不规则的测量数据，同时保留时间的临床含义并支持透明决策。现有方法（如无名箱索引或原始测量三元组）的输入表示缺乏临床语义，导致模型逐token归因难以解析为有意义的临床概念，也无法清晰定位风险上升的时间与触发事件。
AI.method: INTERVenE是一族Transformer架构，其输入为基于区间、基于知识的时间抽象（KBTA）——即来自精选医学本体的一组命名临床概念（状态、趋势、事件、情境）构成的token流。包含两种互补变体：自回归解码器（INTERVenE-Ar）生成未来抽象轨迹并给出逐时间步风险读数，从而定位风险升高的时机及后续事件；双向编码器（INTERVenE-Enc）用于单次通过的联合风险与时间-事件预测。另通过输入表示消融验证了在结构化离散化间的迁移。
AI.result: 在57,078例MIMIC-IV入院记录上与GRU-D、STraTS、KarmaLego对比：INTERVenE-Enc达到支持度加权AUPRC_w 0.672，较最强神经基线提升0.041且95% bootstrap置信区间不重叠，同时取得最优AUROC_w（0.901）和住院时长MAE（44.4小时）；INTERVenE-Ar在更严格的生成式读出合约下取得AUROC_w 0.854、AUPRC_w 0.587，提供互补的token级风险轨迹。输入表示消融证实收益在不同结构化离散化间可迁移。
AI.conclusion: KBTA区间表示作为可解释的底层结构，使部署模型中的逐token归因能够解析为有意义的临床概念，从而在不牺牲预测性能的前提下同时实现出色的风险预测、住院时长估计与时间定位能力，为ICU临床决策支持提供了透明且高性能的建模范式。

title: EpaCache: Error-Propagation-Aware Caching for Accelerating Diffusion-Based Visual Generation
comment: This is a preview version of EpaCache, which is still under review
summary: Diffusion-based visual generative models deliver strong image and video synthesis quality but incur high inference costs because sequential samplers repeatedly evaluate large networks. Caching-based methods reduce inference latency by reusing intermediate computations across adjacent timesteps. However, existing cache controllers rely primarily on local temporal variation and overlook the trajectory-level consequences of cache reuse. We introduce Error-Propagation-Aware Cache (EpaCache), a training-free caching policy that adaptively allocates the reuse budget on timesteps with lower downstream impact. Experiments on image and video synthesis models demonstrate that EpaCache consistently improves the latency--fidelity trade-off over existing caching methods. On FLUX.1-dev, EpaCache outperforms the prior state-of-the-art caching method in both latency and fidelity, reducing inference time from $11.7$ s to $11.3$ s while improving PSNR from $21.4$ to $22.8$. On HunyuanVideo, EpaCache achieves a $2.63\times$ speedup over uncached inference and improves SSIM from $0.891$ to $0.905$ over the prior state-of-the-art method at matched latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EpaCache（误差传播感知缓存），一种无需训练的自适应缓存策略。它针对扩散模型推理成本高、已有缓存调度器只依赖局部时间变化而忽视轨迹级后果的问题，将缓存复用预算分配到下游影响更小的时间步上，在图像和视频生成模型上同时提升延迟与保真度。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的视觉生成模型虽然生成质量高，但顺序采样器需要反复计算大型网络，导致推理成本高昂。已有的缓存方法通过复用相邻时间步的中间计算来降低延迟，但其缓存控制器主要依赖局部时间变化进行决策，忽视了缓存复用带来的轨迹级（跨时间步累积）后果，因此无法在整体生成轨迹上最优地分配缓存预算。
AI.method: EpaCache 是一种无需训练（training-free）的缓存策略，它显式建模缓存误差在下游时间步中的传播效应，从而评估每一步缓存复用的全局影响，并据此将缓存复用预算自适应地分配在具有更低下游影响的时间步上，以最小化整体保真度损失。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成模型上，EpaCache 一致优于现有缓存方法的延迟-保真度权衡。在 FLUX.1-dev 上，相比先前最先进缓存方法，推理时间从 11.7 秒降至 11.3 秒，PSNR 从 21.4 提升到 22.8；在 HunyuanVideo 上，相比未缓存推理实现 2.63 倍加速，且在相同延迟下 SSIM 从 0.891 提升到 0.905。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入误差传播感知的缓存调度策略，EpaCache 在无需训练的前提下显著改善了扩散模型缓存推理的延迟-保真度权衡，证明考虑缓存误差在生成轨迹上的传播效应比仅依据局部时间变化调度更为有效，为扩散模型的高效推理提供了新的思路。

title: DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods provide strong generative capability for low-light image enhancement (LLIE), yet they either rely on paired supervision or lack reliable scene constraints in zero-shot settings, often leading to structural inconsistency and color drift. Motivated by conventional Retinex models, which offer physically interpretable priors that can serve as reliable scene constraints yet struggle with mixed degradations in real-world scenarios, we propose DARD, a zero-shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-guided Diffusion framework for LLIE. DARD first extracts image-specific physical priors from the degraded input through a test-time degradation-aware Retinex decomposition, thereby providing reliable structural guidance for zero-shot restoration. It then injects these priors into reverse diffusion through a timestep-adaptive frequency fusion strategy to balance structural anchoring and detail generation. Finally, a guided reverse refinement process with physical consistency and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based semantic guidance is introduced to suppress structural artifacts and semantic drift during sampling. Extensive experiments show that DARD achieves strong distortion and perceptual performance and consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines across multiple real-world low-light benchmarks. To further validate the practical utility of our method for downstream applications, we evaluated its impact on semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that images enhanced by DARD achieve a 28.10% relative improvement in mIoU over AGLLDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出 DARD，一种零样本的退化感知 Retinex 引导扩散框架，通过测试时 Retinex 分解提取图像特定物理先验，结合时间步自适应频率融合注入逆扩散过程，并利用物理一致性与 CLIP 语义引导进行精炼，从而在无监督条件下实现结构一致、色彩保真的低光图像增强，并在多个真实基准及下游分割任务上超越现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的低光图像增强方法要么依赖成对监督数据，要么在零样本设置下缺乏可靠的场景约束，常导致结构不一致和色彩漂移；而传统 Retinex 模型能提供具有物理可解释性的先验作为可靠场景约束，但在真实世界混合退化场景下表现不佳。为结合两者优势，需要一种能在零样本下利用物理先验约束扩散生成过程的方法。
AI.method: DARD 包含三个核心组件：(1) 通过测试时的退化感知 Retinex 分解，从退化输入中提取图像特异的物理先验，为零样本恢复提供可靠的结构引导；(2) 采用时间步自适应频率融合策略，将这些先验注入逆扩散过程，以平衡结构锚定与细节生成；(3) 引入基于物理一致性和 CLIP 语义引导的引导式逆向精炼过程，抑制采样过程中的结构伪影与语义漂移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 DARD 在失真与感知性能上表现优异，并在多个真实世界低光基准上一致地优于现有零样本方法；在下游语义分割任务中，DARD 增强后的图像相比 AGLLDiff 取得 28.10% 的 mIoU 相对提升，验证了其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: DARD 通过将 Retinex 物理先验以自适应方式融入零样本扩散过程，有效解决了无监督低光增强中的结构一致性与色彩保真难题，同时显著提升了增强结果在下游视觉任务中的可用性，为物理先验与生成模型的融合提供了可行范式。

title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
summary: This paper introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework that integrates Knowledge Graph-based semantic memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning for explainable misinformation detection. The proposed system follows a memory-first, web-fallback architecture, in which input claims are initially evaluated against a dual-index Knowledge Graph through Sentence-BERT-based semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference. When the evidence retrieved from the graph is insufficient to support a reliable decision, the framework collects information from trusted web sources and assesses it using an adversarial tribunal composed of support, contradiction, and judging agents. A graph-aware confidence mechanism combines semantic similarity, NLI confidence, and structural graph evidence to determine whether internal knowledge is sufficient, thereby reducing unnecessary web retrieval. Following verification, validated information is transformed into structured triples and incorporated into the Knowledge Graph, supporting the incremental expansion of the system's semantic memory. Experimental evaluation on a curated COVID-19 misinformation benchmark demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 97.4\% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 92.6% on resolved claims, outperforming a Llama~3.3~70B baseline, which obtains an accuracy of 87.7% and a macro-averaged F1-score of 86.3%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将知识图谱语义记忆与对抗式多智能体推理相结合的混合事实核查框架，采用"记忆优先、网页回退"架构，通过双索引知识图谱、Sentence-BERT语义检索、自然语言推理及支持/反驳/裁判三智能体对抗法庭实现可解释的虚假信息检测。在COVID-19基准上达到97.4%准确率和92.6%宏平均F1，优于Llama 3.3 70B基线。
AI.motivation: 现有虚假信息检测方法在可解释性方面存在不足，且依赖单一知识来源（如纯知识图谱或纯网页检索）难以兼顾准确性与效率。需要一个既能利用结构化语义知识、又能通过外部可信证据补充验证的混合框架。
AI.method: 提出记忆优先、网页回退的混合架构：(1) 输入声明先通过基于Sentence-BERT的语义检索和自然语言推理在双索引知识图谱上进行评估；(2) 当图谱证据不足以支撑可靠决策时，框架从可信网页来源收集信息，并由支持、反驳、裁判三个智能体组成的对抗式仲裁庭进行评估；(3) 图感知置信度机制结合语义相似度、NLI置信度和结构化图谱证据判断内部知识是否充分，以减少不必要的网页检索；(4) 验证后的信息被转化为结构化三元组并纳入知识图谱，实现语义记忆的增量扩展。
AI.result: 在精心整理的COVID-19虚假信息基准上，该框架在已解决声明上取得97.4%的准确率和92.6%的宏平均F1分数，分别优于Llama 3.3 70B基线的87.7%准确率和86.3%宏平均F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合事实核查框架通过知识图谱语义记忆与对抗式多智能体推理的协同，有效提升了对虚假信息的检测准确率与可解释性，同时通过知识图谱自扩展机制不断增强系统的语义记忆能力，证明了该框架在可核查性、效率和准确性上的综合优势。

title: Diffusion-Based Inverse Design of Dielectric Resonator Metasurfaces for Shaping Smart Electromagnetic Environments
summary: Future wireless systems are expected to transform the surrounding space from a passive propagation medium into a smart electromagnetic environment, where engineered surfaces control wave propagation, support wireless sensing, and create programmable electromagnetic fingerprints.
