AI.conclusion: 将功能目标显式编码为可执行DSL程序并结合执行对齐的强化学习，可同时提升功能房间生成的质量与效率，为功能性场景生成提供了一条可行且可扩展的路线。

title: Token Counts Are Not Model Lineage: A Frozen-Threshold Holdout Study of Black-Box LLM API Fingerprinting
summary: Black-box model attribution is increasingly relevant when large language models (LLMs) are served through relay and reseller APIs. A tempting low-cost signal is the prompt-token count returned by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: two models that share a tokenizer and chat template may produce the same count sequence up to a fixed offset. Yet the validity of this signal for broader \emph{model-family} attribution has received little direct holdout testing. We conduct a frozen-threshold study over 24 labeled endpoint pairs, split evenly into a development set and an untouched holdout set, with three temporal repeats and 30 controlled texts per pair. We introduce a validity-gated result contract that distinguishes an observed dissimilarity from an uninformative measurement caused by missing usage data, rate limits, or endpoint policy. The resulting shift-invariant exact-match score perfectly separates the 12 development pairs, yielding a frozen threshold of 0.725. On holdout, however, only 6 of 12 pairs are eligible under the pre-specified three-repeat rule. Among eligible pairs, balanced accuracy is 0.75, sensitivity is 0.50 (95\% Wilson interval 0.15--0.85), and specificity is 1.00 (0.342--1.00). Two same-family pairs---Qwen 3.8 and DeepSeek V4 variants---fall below the frozen threshold. Across 4,320 formal API calls, every log is replayable, while holdout contains 189 non-200 responses and 157 successful responses without prompt-token usage. The study therefore validates token-count consistency as a fingerprint of a shared \emph{tokenization stack}, but rejects its use as a standalone necessary test for model-family lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个包含24个标记端点对（12个开发集+12个留出集）、三次时间重复和每对30个受控文本的冻结阈值研究，检验了基于prompt-token计数的OpenAI兼容端点信号是否可用于LLM模型家族归属。引入有效性门控结果契约后，shift-invariant精确匹配分数能以0.725的冻结阈值完美区分开发集12对，但在留出集中仅6/12对合格，合格对上的平衡准确率为0.75、敏感性0.50、特异性1.00，且Qwen 3.8和DeepSeek V4的两个同家族对低于阈值。结论是token计数一致性可作为共享分词栈的指纹，但不能作为模型家族谱系的独立必要条件。
AI.motivation: 当LLM通过中继和转售API提供时，黑盒模型归属日益重要。一个低成本信号是OpenAI兼容端点返回的prompt-token计数——共享分词器和聊天模板的模型可能在固定偏移内产生相同的计数序列。然而该信号对更广泛的模型家族归属的有效性缺乏直接的留出测试。
AI.method: 在24个带标签的端点对上开展冻结阈值研究，均分为开发集与未触碰的留出集，每对含3个时间重复和30个受控文本。引入有效性门控的结果契约，区分观测到的不相似性与因缺失usage数据、速率限制或端点策略导致的无信息测量。采用shift-invariant精确匹配分数，并预先规定三次重复的合格规则与冻结阈值。
AI.result: 开发集12对的分离达到完美，冻结阈值为0.725。留出集中仅6/12对符合规定的三次重复规则；合格对上平衡准确率0.75、敏感性0.50（95% Wilson区间0.15–0.85）、特异性1.00（0.342–1.00）。Qwen 3.8与DeepSeek V4变体的两个同家族对低于冻结阈值。共4,320次正式API调用，所有日志可重放；留出集含189次非200响应及157次成功但无prompt-token usage的响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了token计数一致性可作为共享分词栈的指纹，但拒绝了将其作为模型家族谱系独立必要条件的使用。该信号在开发集上表现完美，但在留出集上合格样本不足、同家族对失败，表明其适用范围有限。

title: Context Staircase: Signature-Aligned Dynamics of Token Embeddings under Small Initialization
summary: Token embeddings are the basic representational units that connect discrete tokens with continuous computation in language models. Although modern language models learn embeddings from random initialization through gradient-based training, the dynamical mechanism by which meaningful embedding structures emerge remains unclear. In this work, we identify that the evolving embedding structures are closely related to token-conditioned label and contextual distributions, which we formalize as probability signatures. We observe a progressive learning process, which we term Context Staircase: embeddings learn the low-order statistic signatures of the data before the high-order ones. More specifically, we observe that early in training they align with the simplest, context-free signature linking a token to its label, and as training proceeds, they progressively reflect signatures involving more and more context tokens. We then analyze the gradient flow of embeddings under small initialization to explain this phenomenon, deriving embedding evolution equations for feed-forward and self-attention architectures. We further extend these observations to real language-model training. Finally, we show that these embedding structures play an important role in both task learning and the incorporation of semantic structure into the embedding space. Overall, our results provide a dynamic explanation of how data statistics and architecture jointly shape token embeddings in language models, and reveal an implicit bias in the space of data statistics: training proceeds from simpler, low-order statistical relations toward increasingly complex, context-dependent ones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型中token嵌入结构的动态演化机制，发现嵌入结构逐步从简单的上下文无关统计量（token-标签关联）向高阶的上下文相关统计量（涉及更多上下文token）学习，形成一种称为"Context Staircase"的渐进式学习过程，并通过小初始化下的梯度流分析从理论上解释了该现象。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代语言模型通过基于梯度的训练从随机初始化中学习到token嵌入，但嵌入结构如何涌现的动态机制尚不清晰，因此作者希望揭示数据统计与网络架构如何共同塑造token嵌入。
AI.method: 作者将嵌入结构与token条件下的标签分布和上下文分布（称为"概率签名"）联系起来；在小初始化假设下推导了前馈和自注意力架构中嵌入演化的梯度流方程，并结合真实语言模型训练实验进行验证。
AI.result: 观察到"Context Staircase"现象：训练早期嵌入先对齐最简的上下文无关签名（token到其标签），随后逐步反映涉及越来越多上下文token的高阶签名；并进一步展示这些嵌入结构对任务学习以及语义结构融入嵌入空间具有重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为语言模型嵌入结构的涌现提供了动态解释，揭示了数据统计空间中存在隐式偏好：训练从简单的低阶统计关系逐步走向复杂的上下文相关关系，说明架构和数据统计共同塑造了token嵌入。

title: On the Instance Hardness as a Decision Criterion in TinyML Systems
summary: TinyML includes the implementation of machine learning on devices with limited memory and computing resources. With the development of technology, AI systems continue to scale in terms of size and computational requirements. This forces researchers to adapt methods to be environmentally sustainable by designing techniques for reducing computational costs and energy consumption in inferring AI models, even in small devices. In this work, we present preliminary findings on a novel application of the tree depth prune instance hardness method to the TinyML system. The results indicate that threshold control can change energy consumption with limited classification quality changes. This method allows us to adjust classification accuracy, thereby influencing computational complexity and energy consumption for inference. We present a work in progress with initial results as a proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将树深度剪枝的实例硬度（tree depth prune instance hardness）方法初步应用于TinyML系统，通过阈值控制调节分类精度，从而实现推理阶段计算复杂度与能耗的可调权衡，属于概念验证阶段的工作。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在规模和计算需求上不断增大，需要设计环境可持续的方法来降低模型推理（即使在小型设备上）的计算成本与能耗，以应对TinyML设备有限的存储和计算资源限制。
AI.method: 将树深度剪枝实例硬度方法创新性地应用于TinyML系统，通过控制剪枝阈值调节分类精度，进而影响推理时的计算复杂度与能耗。
AI.result: 初步结果表明阈值控制能够改变能耗，同时对分类质量的改变有限；该方法可在分类精度与计算复杂度/能耗之间进行调节，提供了概念验证的初始结果。
AI.conclusion: 这是一项进行中的工作（work in progress），以初步结果作为概念验证，表明树深度剪枝实例硬度方法在TinyML中有潜力作为一种低资源、绿色可持续的推理优化手段，但尚需进一步验证与完善。

title: NepScript Genesis: Neural Architecture Search for Handwritten Devanagari Digit Synthesis
summary: This paper introduces NepScript Genesis, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for automated Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) discovery, applied to conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis. We compare five NAS strategies against a carefully constructed Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) baseline (FID=332.28). Architecture selection utilizes a two-stage pipeline guided by a novel domain-aware evaluation metric (Enhanced Score). Results demonstrate that Adaptive Exploration achieves the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off, attaining an FID of 79.12 -- a 76.19% improvement over the baseline -- and the highest mode coverage among the NAS strategies (Recall=0.531) in under one GPU-hour. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating script-specific structural heuristics into the search phase prevents early-stage mode collapse. In a downstream low-resource evaluation, augmenting 250 real training samples per class with GAN-generated digits from the best NAS model improves CNN classification accuracy from 91.0% to 96.5% (+5.5 percentage points), demonstrating that NAS-optimized synthesis produces digits of sufficient quality to benefit practical recognition pipelines when real data is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NepScript Genesis，一个面向自动 GAN 发现的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，专门用于条件式天城文（Devanagari）手写数字合成。在五种 NAS 策略与 DCGAN 基线（FID=332.28）的对比中，Adaptive Exploration 策略取得最优质量-效率折中（FID=79.12，较基线提升 76.19%，模式覆盖 Recall=0.531，且在一个 GPU 小时内完成）。将脚本特定的结构先验启发式融入搜索阶段可防止早期模式崩溃；在低资源下游任务中，用 NAS 最优模型生成的数字增强每类 250 个真实样本，使 CNN 分类准确率从 91.0% 提升至 96.5%（+5.5 个百分点），证明 NAS 优化合成在真实数据稀缺时能有效支撑实际识别流程。
AI.motivation: 针对低资源语言（如天城文）手写数字合成场景，手工设计 GAN 架构耗时且难以达到最优，现有 NAS 方法也缺乏针对特定文字结构的领域感知评估与搜索引导，导致模式崩溃和生成质量不佳，因此需要一种自动化、领域驱动的 GAN 架构搜索方案。
AI.method: 采用两阶段流水线进行架构选择，并由一种新颖的领域感知评估指标（Enhanced Score）引导；在搜索阶段将脚本特定结构启发式（script-specific structural heuristics）纳入其中以抑制模式崩溃；系统对比五种 NAS 搜索策略，并以精心构建的 DCGAN 作为基线。
AI.result: Adaptive Exploration 策略取得最优质量-效率折中：FID 从基线 332.28 降至 79.12（提升 76.19%），模式覆盖率最高（Recall=0.531），且训练时间不足一个 GPU 小时。生成的数字增强 250 个真实样本/类后，CNN 分类准确率由 91.0% 提高到 96.5%（+5.5 个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: NAS 优化的 GAN 合成能够产生足够高质量的 Devanagari 数字以支持真实场景下的低资源识别任务；融入脚本结构先验可显著缓解早期模式崩溃，验证了领域感知的自动化架构搜索在低资源文字识别方向上的实用价值。

title: Compression-Aware Abstention: Teaching LLMs to Refuse When KV-Compression Masks Remove Answer Evidence
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the GroundLM workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code, adapters, and datasets: https://github.com/mali-kh/compression-aware-abstention
summary: KV-cache compression reduces LLM inference memory by evicting context tokens, but when the evicted tokens contain answer-bearing evidence, the model may hallucinate instead of recognizing that the compressed context is insufficient. We address this failure from a behavioral perspective: to our knowledge, this is the first work to formulate compression-aware abstention as a learning problem, in which a model learns to answer when supporting evidence survives compression and abstain when it does not. We construct supervision from compressor survival masks and tight answer-bearing spans, labeling examples as Confident when evidence survives and Abstain when it is removed. A 10.1M-parameter LoRA adapter trained on ~2.6K MuSiQue 2-hop QA examples reduces base-model hallucinations by 97% under prompt-style truncation while preserving correct answering on evidence-retaining examples. Unlike prompt-only abstention baselines, which over-abstain on many answerable high-retention examples, the trained adapter learns a conditional policy. We also evaluate the method under actual compressed-cache decoding, where multi-compressor training yields a 6-22x relative lift over the unaided base on evidence-retaining examples. Controlled-deletion experiments show that the learned behavior is driven by evidence content rather than input length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将“压缩感知式弃答”（compression-aware abstention）建模为学习问题：训练一个10.1M参数的LoRA适配器，在支持证据在KV-cache压缩后幸存时作答、在证据被驱逐时弃答，从而将幻觉率降低97%，并显著优于仅依赖提示词的弃答基线。
AI.motivation: KV-cache压缩通过驱逐上下文token来减少LLM推理内存，但当被驱逐的token含有答案证据时，模型会因上下文不足而产生幻觉，而不是意识到压缩后的上下文已不足以作答。现有方法未从行为层面让模型学会“在证据缺失时弃答”，因此需要一种让模型感知压缩并主动弃答的机制。
AI.method: 从行为视角将压缩感知式弃答形式化为学习问题：利用压缩器的保留掩码（survival masks）和紧密的答案相关片段（answer-bearing spans）构造监督信号，将样本标注为Confident（证据幸存）或Abstain（证据被移除）；训练一个仅约10.1M参数的LoRA适配器，基于MuSiQue 2-hop QA的约2.6K示例学习条件策略；并在提示词式截断与真实压缩缓存解码两种场景下评估，同时用多压缩器联合训练、受控删除实验验证行为由证据内容而非输入长度驱动。
AI.result: 在提示词式截断下，该适配器将基础模型的幻觉减少97%，同时保留证据存活样本的正确作答能力；相比仅提示词的弃答基线（在可回答的高保留样本上过度弃答），适配器学到的是条件化策略。在实际压缩缓存解码中，多压缩器训练在证据保留样本上带来6-22倍的相对提升；受控删除实验表明学习行为由证据内容驱动而非输入长度。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习式条件弃答策略，LLM能够在压缩保留下保持正确作答、在证据被去除时主动弃答，从而有效缓解KV-cache压缩引发的幻觉；该方法验证了在真实压缩解码下也能带来显著收益，为压缩感知式推理可靠性提供了新思路。

title: AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies
summary: Latent world-action models avoid rendering future pixels by predicting an action-relevant visual subgoal in feature space. LaWAM established this formulation, but its original presentation left the world model, multimodal backbone, and deployment checkpoint tightly coupled. We introduce AcrossWAM1.0, a modularization and scaling study of this latent world-action stack. Rather than presenting latent subgoals as a new algorithm, we make the module boundary explicit: a policy adapter produces latent-action and action-generation contexts; a retained latent world decoder grounds the predicted transition in the current scene;and a flow-matching expert generates continuous action chunks. We further separate training-only teachers from the inference graph and provide a verifiable deployment export. On 2,000 paired LIBERO episodes, replacing a Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with Qwen3.5-0.8B yields 97.45% success versus 98.00% for the 2B model (a-0.55percentage-point difference; exact McNemarp=0.266). This does not prove equivalence, but it meets a prespecified two-point retention criterion. The compact, inference-reachable checkpoint contains 1,472.6M unique parameters, 42.4% fewer than the original 2B policy, while all retained tensors are bitwise identical to the source checkpoint. Cross-family execution is additionally checked with a MiniCPM-V adapter smoke test; closed-loop cross-family transfer remains an open evaluation. AcrossWAM1.0 therefore contributes an auditable software and evaluation boundary for compact latent world-action policies, distinct from LaWAM's original latent-subgoal contribution.

AI.tldr: AcrossWAM1.0 是一项对潜在世界-动作模型（LaWAM）的模块化与规模化研究，将策略适配器、潜在世界解码器和流匹配专家解耦为清晰模块边界，并通过将 2B 骨干替换为 0.8B 骨干实现 97.45% 的成功率（较 98.00% 仅差 0.55 个百分点，满足预设的两点保留标准），同时将推理可达检查点参数压缩 42.4%，所有保留张量与源检查点逐位一致。
AI.motivation: LaWAM 确立了潜在世界-动作模型的框架，但原始呈现将世界模型、多模态骨干和部署检查点紧密耦合，缺乏清晰的模块边界与可审计的评估标准，难以进行模块替换、缩放与部署验证。
AI.method: 将潜在世界-动作栈模块化：策略适配器生成潜在动作与动作生成上下文；保留的潜在世界解码器将预测的转移锚定于当前场景；流匹配专家生成连续动作块。同时将训练专用教师与推理图分离，提供可验证的部署导出；在 2,000 条配对的 LIBERO 轨迹上，把 Qwen3-VL-2B 骨干替换为 Qwen3.5-0.8B，并用 MiniCPM-V 适配器进行跨系列的冒烟测试。
AI.result: 0.8B 模型达到 97.45% 成功率，2B 模型为 98.00%（差值为 -0.55 个百分点，精确 McNemar 检验 p=0.266），虽未证明等价，但满足预设的两点保留标准；紧凑推理检查点含 1,472.6M 唯一参数，比原始 2B 策略少 42.4%，且所有保留张量逐位一致；跨系列封闭回路迁移仍是待评估的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: AcrossWAM1.0 为紧凑的潜在世界-动作策略贡献了可审计的软件与评估边界，区别于 LaWAM 原始的潜在子目标算法贡献，证明了更小骨干在满足保留标准前提下可显著压缩模型体积。

title: MotionSync: Non-Causal Refinement of Causal Tracker for Label-Efficient 3D Perception
summary: Three-dimensional box-and-track annotation is the cost bottleneck in autonomous-driving data engines, and the offline systems built to relieve it replace the online perception stack outright, so a team needing both regimes maintains and reconciles two. MotionSync makes the causal/non-causal boundary an explicit architectural seam instead. A strictly causal tracker, built on a strong published baseline and extended with innovation-driven uncertainty calibration, frame-rate-invariant kinematic association gates, and multi-hypothesis motion with learned mode selection, emits a valid online result. A non-causal pass then revises the buffered trajectories with Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing applied separately to pose, extent and yaw, physics-validated gap completion, and semantic pruning of ghost tracks against LiDAR point labels. The refiner never writes back, so one system serves both regimes and refinement's effect is a delta over an unaltered causal estimate. Used as an auto-labeller, a fixed 3D detector trained on 25% human labels plus MotionSync pseudo-labels reaches 96.9% of its full-supervision mean average precision (mAP) on Waymo, and at a 10% budget the non-causal pass accounts for +3.3 mAP/L2 over pseudo-labels from the same tracker's causal stage. Re-fitting the online tracker on its own refined output recovers 73% of the benefit of human supervision, while its causal output is worse supervision than no re-fitting at all. As a tracker MotionSync is at parity with the leading published offline entries on the headline metric and ahead of them on error composition, which is where a refinement pass can act at all: it reduces misses and fragmentations together, the signature of gap completion rather than of a tuned detector.

AI.tldr: MotionSync 通过在序列化轨迹数据上叠加一个独立的非因果平滑/细化层，将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝，使同一系统同时服务在线感知与离线标注两个场景，并在 Waymo 上证明其作为自动标注器与跟踪器的有效性。
AI.motivation: 三维框-轨迹标注是自动驾驶数据引擎的成本瓶颈；现有离线标注系统完全替换在线感知栈，导致需要同时维护和协调两套系统的团队负担沉重。作者希望让一个系统同时服务于在线（因果）与离线（非因果）两种机制，避免重复建设。
AI.method: 将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝：1) 严格因果跟踪器基于强公开基线，扩展了创新驱动的不确定性校准、帧率不变的动力学关联门控、以及带学习模式选择的多假设运动，输出有效的在线结果；2) 非因果通道对缓冲轨迹执行 Rauch-Tung-Striebel 平滑（分别应用于位姿、尺寸与偏航角）、物理验证的轨迹间隙补全、以及基于 LiDAR 点标签对幽灵轨迹的语义剪枝；3) 细化器从不回写，因此细化只是叠加在未改动因果估计之上的增量（delta）。
AI.result: 作为自动标注器：仅用 25% 人工标签加 MotionSync 伪标签训练的固定 3D 检测器，在 Waymo 上达到全监督 mAP 的 96.9%；在 10% 标注预算下，非因果通道比同跟踪器因果阶段的伪标签提升 +3.3 mAP/L2。用自身细化输出重训练在线跟踪器，可恢复人工监督收益的 73%，而用其因果输出做监督反而比不重训练更差。作为跟踪器，其在核心指标上与领先的公开离线方案持平，在误差构成上更优——同时减少漏检与碎片化，这正是轨迹间隙补全而非调优检测器的标志。
AI.conclusion: MotionSync 用一个统一的系统同时满足在线与离线两种机制：因果跟踪器保证实时可用结果，非因果细化作为不写回的增量提升标注质量，避免了两套系统的维护与调和成本，并在自动标注与跟踪任务上均达到或超越现有离线方法的性能。

title: When Safety Speaks a Language: A Mechanistic Analysis of Safety-Language Identity Entanglement in LLMs
summary: Safety alignment of large language models (LLMs) degrades across languages, yet the internal mechanism driving this asymmetry remains poorly understood. Our work, therefore, presents a systematic mechanistic analysis of multilingual safety using sparse autoencoder (SAE) features, sparse interpretable directions in the residual stream associated with harmful and harmless model behavior across three instruction-tuned LLMs, eight languages, and all model layers. We observe that safety-relevant features are architecture-dependent in terms of where they are located and how they are distributed across layers. Additionally, they are geometrically entangled with language identity and exhibit cross-lingual sharing patterns, i.e., languages share safety features to varying degrees across model depths and architectures. This safety-language entanglement has direct consequences such that ablating safety features impacts not only harmful response rates but also target language, with the degree of intervention predicted by the relationship between safety and language features. Our findings qualify the language-universality of safety alignment as architecture-dependent and offer a mechanistic account of multilingual safety interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征，对三个指令微调大语言模型、八种语言和全部层进行系统性机制分析，发现多语言安全对齐并非语言通用，而是架构依赖的：安全相关特征在模型中的位置与分布因架构而异，并与语言身份几何纠缠，呈现跨语言共享模式，消融这些特征会同时影响有害响应率和目标语言。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的安全对齐在不同语言之间会发生不同程度的退化，但驱动这种跨语言不对称性的内部机制尚不明确，缺乏系统性的机制层面的理解。
AI.method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取残差流中与有害/无害行为相关的稀疏可解释方向，对三个指令微调LLM、八种语言及全部模型层进行系统性机制分析，包括安全特征定位、层间分布、与语言身份的几何纠缠关系、跨语言共享模式，以及通过特征消融进行因果干预验证。
AI.result: 研究发现：安全相关特征的所在位置与跨层分布是架构依赖的；它们与语言身份在几何上纠缠，并呈现不同程度的跨语言共享模式；消融安全特征不仅影响有害响应率，还会改变目标语言，且干预程度可由安全特征与语言特征之间的关系预测。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐并非语言通用，其语言普遍性是架构依赖的；该研究为多语言安全干预提供了机制层面的解释框架，表明跨语言安全治理需要针对不同架构定制干预策略。

title: Generative multi-domain transfer learning for fault detection in data-scarce wind turbines
summary: Normal behavior models have shown promise for reliable fault detection in wind turbines. However, these unsupervised anomaly detection models require sufficient fault-free training data to learn the normal operation behavior of turbines. Under data scarcity, for example in newly deployed wind turbines, these models may result in poor fault detection performance. In this work, we propose a multi-domain generative domain mapping approach based on Star Generative Adversarial Networks (StarGAN) to improve fault detection on data-scarce wind turbines. Our model maps SCADA measurements from a data-scarce turbine to resemble those of several data-rich turbines. By preserving the operational state during translation, faults occurring in a data-scarce domain can be mapped and detected by reliable pre-trained normal behavior models of data-rich domains. Highlighting the benefits of an ensemble fusion strategy, we show that under severe data scarcity our method can produce anomaly scores comparable to models trained on large representative datasets. Our approach can consistently outperform models trained on scarce data when less than 2 weeks of training data are available. With just 2 weeks of accumulated training data, we achieve an anomaly score similarity that is, on average, +16% higher than conventional fine-tuning, and +10% higher than single-source domain mapping. As a step towards unsupervised model selection, we propose a proxy metric that detects poor performance at training time, despite an absence of anomalies. Our study presents the potential and challenges of multi-domain mapping for wind turbine fault detection under unrepresentative training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于StarGAN的多域生成式域映射方法，用于解决风电机组故障检测中的数据稀缺问题。该方法将数据稀缺机组的SCADA测量数据映射为类似多个数据丰富机组的分布，同时保持运行状态，从而使稀缺域中的故障能被数据丰富域中已训练的可靠正常行为模型检测。在少于两周训练数据的严重稀缺条件下，该方法生成的异常分数可与大规模代表性数据集训练的模型相当，平均异常分数相似度比传统微调高16%，比单源域映射高10%。此外还提出一种代理指标，在无异常情况下于训练时检测模型性能不佳，为无监督模型选择提供参考。
AI.motivation: 正常行为模型在风电机组故障检测中表现出色，但这类无监督异常检测模型需要充足的故障-free训练数据来学习机组的正常运行行为。在新部署的风电机组等数据稀缺场景下，这些模型可能表现出较差的故障检测性能。
AI.method: 提出基于StarGAN的多域生成式域映射方法，将数据稀缺机组的SCADA测量数据映射为与多个数据丰富机组相似的数据，在翻译过程中保持运行状态不变，使得稀缺域中的故障可以被数据丰富域中预训练的可靠正常行为模型映射并检测；同时引入集成融合策略，并提出一个代理指标用于无监督模型选择（在无异常情况下于训练时检测性能不佳）。
AI.result: 在严重数据稀缺条件下，该方法产生的异常分数可与基于大规模代表性数据集训练的模型相当；在训练数据少于两周时，该方法的性能持续优于基于稀缺数据训练的模型。仅用两周累积训练数据，异常分数相似度平均比传统微调高16%，比单源域映射高10%。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了多域映射在非代表性训练数据下的风电机组故障检测中的潜力与挑战，为数据稀缺场景下的故障检测和模型选择提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Spatial Matryoshka Training for Multi-Granularity Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Multi-modal late-interaction retrievers achieve strong retrieval on visually rich documents by representing each page as per patch embeddings and matching at the token level. However, this approach incurs high storage costs. Existing compression methods typically fix a single compression level at indexing time, limiting flexibility. We present ColSNAP (Spatial Nested Average Pooling)1, a training method that generates a nested hierarchy of compression levels directly from a backbone's patch grid. By spatially pooling patch embeddings into pro- gressively coarser tiers and training all tiers simultaneously, a single model learns to support retrieval at multiple compression levels without architectural changes. Crucially, a single encoding pass yields every tier, enabling the accuracy-storage trade-off to be configured at indexing time to match avail- able storage budgets, rather than being fixed during training. We demonstrate that models trained using ColSNAP maintain near full-resolution retrieval performance under substantial compression and that ColSNAP transfers effectively across multiple late-interaction backbones, and achieves most of its improvements via a lightweight adaptation stage applied to a pre-trained retriever.

AI.tldr: ColSNAP 是一种针对多模态晚期交互检索器的训练方法，通过对骨干网络生成的 patch 嵌入进行空间嵌套平均池化，生成由粗到细的多级压缩层级，并联合训练所有层级，使单一模型在索引阶段即可按存储预算灵活选择精度-存储权衡。
AI.motivation: 多模态晚期交互检索器（如 ColPali）通过 patch 级嵌入和 token 级匹配在视觉丰富文档上表现优异，但存储开销巨大；现有压缩方法通常在索引时固定单一压缩级别，缺乏灵活性，无法根据实际存储预算动态调整。
AI.method: ColSNAP 通过对骨干网络的 patch 网格进行空间平均池化，生成逐级变粗的嵌套层级，并同时训练所有层级；无需修改架构，一次编码即可得到全部层级，从而将精度-存储权衡的配置从训练阶段转移到索引阶段。
AI.result: 实验表明 ColSNAP 训练的模型在较大压缩下仍能保持接近全分辨率检索的性能，且能有效迁移到多种晚期交互骨干网络；其大部分收益来自对预训练检索器的轻量适配阶段。
AI.conclusion: ColSNAP 提供了一种灵活高效的压缩训练范式，使单一模型支持多级存储压缩，解耦训练与索引时的存储配置，兼顾检索性能与存储成本。

title: TRINITY: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Personal-Style Video Highlight Detection
summary: Traditional video highlight detection relies on a narrow, event-centric definition of saliency, which often fails to generalize to unconstrained personal videos where highlights are heterogeneous and perspective-dependent. To address this, we introduce TRINITY, a multi-perspective benchmark that decomposes highlight saliency into three complementary dimensions, Event, Emotion, and Nature, within a unified temporal framework. Leveraging this multi-faceted view, we propose a shared-backbone multi-branch architecture designed for parallel multi-perspective prediction via view-specific experts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving gains of +7.15/+3.62 mAP (rho=15%/50%) on Mr. HiSum and +10.82 mAP on YouTube Highlights. These results validate that multi-perspective modeling provides a more robust and comprehensive formulation of video saliency, especially for complex real-world scenarios. The benchmark and relevant codes will be released upon acceptance. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY and the code is available at https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRINITY，一个多视角视频高光检测基准，将显著性分解为事件、情感、自然三个互补维度，并设计共享骨干的多分支架构，在多个数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统视频高光检测依赖于狭隘的、以事件为中心的显著性定义，难以泛化到不受约束的个人视频，因为其中的高光具有异质性和视角依赖性。因此需要一种多视角的显著性建模方式来弥补现有定义的不足。
AI.method: 提出TRINITY多视角基准，在统一的时间框架内将高光显著性分解为事件、情感、自然三个互补维度；并基于这一多面视图，提出共享骨干的多分支架构，通过各视角专属专家实现并行的多视角预测。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，该方法在Mr. HiSum上取得+7.15/+3.62 mAP（rho=15%/50%）的提升，在YouTube Highlights上取得+10.82 mAP的提升，显著优于当前最优基线。
AI.conclusion: 多视角建模为视频显著性提供了更稳健、更全面的形式化定义，尤其适用于复杂的真实世界场景。基准与代码将在论文接收后开源。

title: XQDT: eXplainable and Quantitative Data-Text Alignment Metric with Feedback Signals
summary: Evaluating data-text alignment remains challenging: existing metrics often provide limited explanations for the scores, while prompt-based LLM-as-Judge methods can be expensive and unreliable. We present an end-to-end explainable evaluation metric that fine-tunes a language model to identify omitted, extra, incorrect, and correct data units in a data-text pair. These local judgements are aggregated into precision, recall, and F1 scores, providing both fine-grained diagnostic feedback and an interpretable measure of alignment quality. Across benchmarks, our fine-tuned models outperform LLM-as-Judge methods in error prediction and achieve competitive precision, recall, and F1 scores, while maintaining strong correlation with human judgements. Beyond evaluation, our verifier outputs also provide useful feedback signals for downstream correction and refinement, supporting alignment-oriented improvement of data-to-text and text-to-data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/guihuzhang/xqdt.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端的可解释评估指标，通过微调语言模型识别数据-文本对中的遗漏、多余、错误和正确数据单元，并聚合为精确率、召回率和F1分数，在错误预测上优于LLM-as-Judge方法，同时保持与人类判断的高度相关性，并可作为下游纠错与优化的反馈信号。
AI.motivation: 现有评估数据-文本对齐的指标存在两个主要问题：一是传统指标难以解释其得分；二是基于提示的LLM-as-Judge方法成本高且不可靠。因此需要一种既可解释又可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 微调一个语言模型作为评估器，对数据-文本对中的每个数据单元进行局部判断（识别为省略、多余、错误或正确），然后将这些局部判断聚合成精确率、召回率和F1分数。该模型同时提供细粒度的诊断反馈和可解释的对齐质量度量。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，该微调模型在错误预测方面优于LLM-as-Judge方法，精确率、召回率和F1分数具有竞争力，且与人类判断保持强相关性。此外，其验证器输出可作为下游纠错和优化的有效反馈信号。
AI.conclusion: 该可解释评估指标不仅能提供细粒度诊断反馈和可解释的分数，还在数据到文本和文本到数据任务的对齐评估中优于LLM-as-Judge方法，并为对齐导向的改进提供支持，代码与资源已开源。

title: Learning PDE Time-Stepping with Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Classical numerical solvers for partial differential equations (PDEs) are computationally expensive to solve repeatedly across varying initial conditions, motivating the need for learned surrogates. In this paper, we propose a trainable Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) based surrogate model for learning long time PDE dynamics. Rather than mapping an entire initial field to a full trajectory in one shot, our proposed model learns a small, local, homogeneous update rule that is applied identically and repeatedly at every grid cell, mirroring the locality of differential operators. We benchmark this framework against three baselines: PDE - Net, a modified physics-informed neural network (PINN), and a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), on five canonical PDEs (heat, advection, Burgers, Allen - Cahn, and Fisher - KPP), evaluated at temporal domain two times beyond the training temporal domain. The proposed model achieves the lowest long-horizon relative errors on the majority of the experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于可训练神经细胞自动机（NCA）的代理模型用于学习偏微分方程（PDE）的长时程动力学。与一次性将整个初始场映射为完整轨迹不同，该模型学习一个小的、局部的、同质的更新规则，在每个网格单元上相同且重复地应用，以模拟微分算子的局部性。在五个典型PDE（热传导、平流、Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Fisher-KPP）上，与PDE-Net、改进的PINN和FNO三种基线相比，该模型在训练时域两倍之外的长时程外推评估中，在大多数实验中取得了最低的相对误差。
AI.motivation: 经典PDE数值求解器在跨不同初始条件重复求解时计算开销巨大，因此需要学习型代理模型；同时现有方法往往将整个初始场一次映射到完整轨迹，难以高效学习长时程动力学。
AI.method: 提出可训练的神经细胞自动机（NCA）代理模型：学习一个小的、局部的、同质的更新规则，并在每个网格单元上相同且重复地应用，模拟微分算子的局部性，从而迭代生成长时间的PDE解。
AI.result: 在五个典型PDE上（热传导、平流、Burgers、Allen-Cahn、Fisher-KPP），以训练时域两倍之外的时间域进行评估，该模型在大多数实验中取得了最低的长时程相对误差。
AI.conclusion: 基于NCA的局部同质迭代更新机制能够有效捕捉PDE的局部动力学结构，是一种具有竞争力的长时程PDE动力学子图代理建模方案，优于PDE-Net、改进PINN和FNO等基线。

title: SearchWiki: Learning to Build and Navigate Knowledge Wikis for Active Information Seeking
summary: Flat retrieval-augmented generation treats a corpus as a bag of chunks, discarding document hierarchy and cross document structure. We introduce SearchWiki, a harness framework that synthesizes a corpus into a hierarchical, typed, navigable wiki and trains an agent, WikiResearcher-9B, to retrieve information through multi-turn tool use. The wiki organizes knowledge into three layers - document overviews, cross- document topic pages, and page-level source records; enabling progressive refinement of retrieval when initial lookup misses. We optimize the agent's navigation policy with on-policy reinforcement learning with a multi-component reward function balancing answer correctness, retrieval quality and trajectory efficiency. Evaluation on ViDoRe-V3 (8 domains), FinanceBench, and memory benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, PersonaMem-v2) shows that WikiResearcher- 9B which is our RL-tuned Qwen 9B model, significantly outperforms same-size untrained baselines and exceeds or matches larger external models. SearchWiki paired with WikiResearcher-9B demonstrates that learned navigation over structured corpora is a superior alternative to flat retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SearchWiki框架，将语料库合成为分层的、带类型的、可导航的wiki结构，并训练了一个9B参数规模的智能体WikiResearcher-9B，通过多轮工具调用来检索信息。实验表明该模型显著优于同规模基线，并达到或超过更大的外部模型，证明在结构化语料上进行学习式导航优于扁平检索。
AI.motivation: 扁平检索增强生成（Flat RAG）将语料库视为块的集合，忽略了文档的层级结构和跨文档关系，导致检索信息丢失且效率低下。作者希望利用语料库的内在结构化信息来改善检索。
AI.method: SearchWiki将语料库合成为三层知识结构：文档概览、跨文档主题页和页面级来源记录，支持在初次检索未命中时逐步细化检索。同时训练智能体WikiResearcher-9B（基于Qwen 9B强化学习调优）通过多轮工具调用进行信息导航，并使用多组件奖励函数的on-policy强化学习优化导航策略，该奖励函数平衡答案正确性、检索质量和轨迹效率。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe-V3（8个领域）、FinanceBench以及记忆基准（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、PersonaMem-v2）上的评估显示，WikiResearcher-9B显著优于同规模未训练基线，并超过或匹配更大的外部模型。
AI.conclusion: SearchWiki配合WikiResearcher-9B证明，在结构化语料上进行学习式导航是比扁平检索更优越的替代方案。

title: Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: We propose a societal bias evaluation method for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in the era of strong safety guardrails. Existing benchmarks rely on prompts that ask models to infer attributes of people in images (e.g., "Is this person a CEO or a secretary?"). However, we find that LVLMs with strong guardrails, such as GPT and Claude, often refuse these prompts, making evaluations unreliable. To address this, we change the prior evaluation paradigm by decoupling the task from the depicted person: instead of inferring person's attributes, we use prompts that do not ask about the person (e.g., "Write a fictional story about an imaginary person.") and attach the image as provisional user information to implicitly provide demographic cues, then compare outputs across user demographics. Instantiated across three tasks --- story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA --- our method avoids refusals even in guardrailed LVLMs, enabling reliable bias measurement. Applying it to 20 recent LVLMs, both open-source and proprietary, we find that all models undesirably use user demographic information in person-irrelevant tasks; for instance, characters in stories are often portrayed as mechanic for male users and nurse for female users. Although still biased, proprietary models like GPT-5 show lower bias than open-source ones. We analyze potential factors behind this gap, discussing continuous model monitoring and improvement as a possible contributor for reducing bias.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向具备强安全护栏的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的社会偏见评测方法，通过将任务与所描绘人物解耦（如让模型就虚构人物写故事而非推断图中人物的属性），规避护栏模型拒绝回答的问题，从而在20个开源与专有LVLM上实现可靠的偏见测量。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见基准依赖于直接询问模型推断图像中人物属性（如"此人是CEO还是秘书？"）的提示，但具备强安全护栏的模型（如GPT、Claude）常拒绝回答此类提示，导致评测结果不可靠。因此需要一种能绕过拒绝机制、同时仍能揭示模型社会偏见的评测范式。
AI.method: 改变传统评测范式，将任务与图像中的人物解耦：不直接询问与人物相关的属性，而是使用与人物无关的提示（如"写一个关于虚构人物的故事"），并将图像作为临时用户信息附上，以隐式提供人口统计学线索，然后比较不同用户人口统计学条件下的模型输出。该方法实例化为三个任务：故事生成、术语解释和考试式问答。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于20个近期LVLM（包括开源与专有模型）后发现：所有模型都会在与人无关的任务中不当地利用用户的人口统计学信息，例如故事中的角色常被描绘为男性用户为机械师、女性用户为护士。尽管仍然存在偏见，专有模型（如GPT-5）的偏见低于开源模型。分析表明，持续的模型监控与改进可能是降低偏见差距的因素之一。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务与人物解耦的评测方法可以在不触发护栏拒绝的情况下可靠测量LVLM的社会偏见；实验表明当前所有LVLM均存在隐式人口统计学偏见，且开源模型比专有模型偏见更严重，为持续监控、改进模型以减少偏见提供了依据与方向。

title: How Prolific Sellers Self-Present: Dissecting the Communication Patterns of 1.6 Million Reverb Listings
summary: The current paper draws on self-presentation theory and warranting theory to evaluate how the language patterns in an online marketplace reflect seller status (i.e., a prolific seller versus an everyday seller). Using 1.6 million musical instrument listings from Reverb.com in search of content, style, and structural differences in seller product descriptions, the evidence suggested prolific sellers tend to focus more on objective and functional aspects of a product (e.g., its features and specifications) and less on subjective characteristics like tone, relative to everyday sellers. Prolific sellers also communicated in a more narrative-like style, which was driven by an elevated use of personal pronouns, and they used longer descriptions than everyday sellers. Therefore, what prolific sellers focus on tends to be quite technical, but how they communicate this information is typical of a story that is told to potential buyers. Implications for self-presentation theory and warranting theory are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自我呈现理论和担保理论，利用Reverb.com上160万条乐器商品列表，分析在线市场中卖家的语言模式如何反映其卖家身份（高产卖家vs普通卖家）。研究发现高产卖家更侧重产品的客观功能特征（如规格参数），较少使用主观特质描述（如音色）；同时他们采用更具叙述性的文风（更多使用人称代词），且描述更长。简言之，高产卖家侧重技术的"内容"，但采用讲故事式的"表达方式"。
AI.motivation: 在线市场中卖家的身份/地位（如高产卖家与普通卖家）如何通过语言模式体现，是尚未充分研究的领域。作者结合自我呈现理论与担保理论，旨在探究卖家如何通过在线商品描述进行自我呈现，以及语言内容、风格和结构上的差异如何反映其卖家地位。
AI.method: 以自我呈现理论和担保理论为理论框架，采集Reverb.com上160万条乐器商品列表作为数据，从内容（产品功能特征vs主观特征）、风格（叙述性、人称代词使用）和结构（描述长度）三个维度对卖家商品描述进行文本分析，比较高产卖家与普通卖家的语言模式差异。
AI.result: 实证证据表明：高产卖家相较于普通卖家更侧重于产品的客观功能性方面（如特征和规格），较少使用主观特征（如音色）；高产卖家的沟通更具叙述性风格，这一差异源于其更高频率地使用人称代词；同时高产卖家的描述文本更长。即高产卖家"内容"上更技术化，但"表达方式"上更接近向潜在买家讲故事。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明卖家地位与在线商品描述的语言模式存在系统性关联：高产卖家呈现"技术化内容、故事化表述"的独特沟通范式。该发现对自我呈现理论和担保理论具有理论启示意义，揭示了在线市场中语言信号如何作为卖家身份与可信度的线索。

title: Coarse composition suffices: tabular in-context learning for multi-activity antimicrobial peptide profiling
summary: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) often act against multiple pathogen classes, making multi-label activity prediction a more realistic screening target than binary antimicrobial classification. The ESCAPE benchmark formalizes this setting, but leading approaches typically rely on multimodal, structure-conditioned deep models that are costly to train and tune. We show that a simple, sequence-only pipeline can match and surpass these methods by combining 330 interpretable sequence descriptors with TabPFN, a tabular foundation model that performs in-context prediction in a single forward pass without gradient-based training or hyperparameter search. On ESCAPE (82,359 peptides; five labels), a label-powerset TabPFN model achieves mAP-5 = 77.8%, improving on the previously best reported 72.1%. A probabilistic classifier chain is the first method to match or exceed the best published average precision on each of the five labels simultaneously. The gains persist under the prior state-of-the-art single-fold training protocol, indicating they are not a training-set-size artefact, and are largest for remote homologues (+11.2 points below 30% sequence identity). Ablations further show that predicted structure is unnecessary at inference and that performance is not driven by any single descriptor family: ten global physicochemical scalars recover 91% of full-feature performance. Finally, explicitly modelling label dependence yields targeted benefits for scarce activities and supports ranking which activity to assay next from partial positive evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖序列的简单流程用于抗菌肽（AMP）多标签活性预测：将330个可解释序列描述符与表格基础模型TabPFN结合，通过单次前向传播进行上下文预测，无需梯度训练或超参数搜索。在ESCAPE基准（82,359条肽、五个标签）上，标签幂集TabPFN模型取得mAP-5=77.8%，优于此前最优的72.1%；概率分类器链首次在五个标签上同时达到或超过已发表的最佳平均精度。增益在先前SOTA单折训练协议下依然存在，并非训练集规模假象，且在远程同源（序列同一性<30%）上提升最大（+11.2点）。消融实验表明推理时无需预测结构，且性能并非由单一描述符家族驱动——十个全局理化标量即可恢复全特征性能的91%。显式建模标签依赖对稀缺活性带来针对性收益，并支持根据部分阳性证据对下一步待测活性进行排序。
AI.motivation: 抗菌肽常对多类病原体同时具有活性，因此多标签活性预测比二元抗菌分类更符合实际筛选需求，ESCAPE基准正式定义了该设定。然而主流方法多依赖多模态、基于结构条件化的深度模型，训练和调参成本高昂。作者希望探索一种简单、仅需序列、低成本且可解释的流程，能否匹配甚至超越这些复杂方法。
AI.method: 将330个可解释的序列描述符作为特征，结合TabPFN（表格基础模型）：TabPFN在单次前向传播中完成上下文预测，无需梯度训练或超参数搜索。采用两种多标签建模策略：标签幂集（label powerset）与概率分类器链（probabilistic classifier chain），并在ESCAPE基准（82,359条肽、五个活性标签）上评估。
AI.result: 标签幂集TabPFN模型达到mAP-5=77.8%，较此前最优的72.1%有显著提升；概率分类器链首次在全部五个标签上同时达到或超过已发表的最佳平均精度。增益在先前SOTA的单折训练协议下保持，表明并非训练集规模所致；对远程同源（序列同一性<30%）提升最大（+11.2点）。消融显示预测结构在推理时并非必需，且十个全局理化标量即可恢复全特征性能的91%；显式标签依赖建模在稀缺活性上带来针对性收益，并能依据部分阳性证据对下一步待测活性进行排序。
AI.conclusion: 一个仅依赖序列、由可解释描述符加TabPFN构成的简单流程，在ESCAPE多标签AMP活性预测上即可匹配并超越复杂的多模态结构条件化深度模型，兼具低成本、无需训练/调参和可解释性。结果同时表明结构信息在推理时可省略，特征冗余度较高（少量理化标量即可覆盖大部分性能），且显式建模标签依赖有助于稀缺活性的预测与实验优先级排序，为AMP筛选提供了一条高效实用的替代路径。

title: Review Before Trust: Source-Grounded Integrity Gates for AI-Assisted Personal Health Records
summary: Large language models can convert medical documents into structured data, but plausible output may still be unsupported by the source. Persisting such output in a longitudinal health record, a record that accumulates patient information over time, therefore creates an integrity risk: unverified data may influence later summaries, trends, or preventive-care computations. We introduce an evidence-gated trust-promotion model that keeps generated data provisional until a deterministic monitor verifies it against the source document. The monitor admits a candidate for a specified downstream use only when the source contains a unique supporting quotation, the relevant fields occur within the same laboratory row, and the required provenance is preserved. The generator cannot approve its own output, missing or ambiguous evidence causes refusal, and refused candidates remain available for human review rather than being silently discarded. We implement the model in Medical DataCloud, a personal health-record application, and evaluate it through automated tests and a replay of saved extraction outputs. All 22 conformance and mutation tests pass. The replay covers nine historical laboratory PDF reports containing 102 manually labelled rows. The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review. The study evaluates system integrity rather than clinical correctness or clinical safety. The results demonstrate the technical feasibility of an enforceable boundary that prevents generated claims from authorizing their own reuse in a longitudinal health record.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"证据门控信任提升"模型，用于防止大语言模型将医学文档转换为结构化数据时产生的无源输出污染纵向健康档案。模型设定确定性的监视器，仅当源文档中存在唯一支持引文、相关字段位于同一实验室行且保留所需出处时才批准候选数据用于下游用途；生成器不能自审，缺失或模糊证据则拒绝并留待人工复核。作者在个人健康记录应用 Medical DataCloud 中实现，22项一致性和变异测试全部通过；对9份历史实验室PDF报告（102行人工标注）的重放显示，97个数值候选中 schema 校验全部接受、强化后的引文与行级策略仅接纳72个并保留25个供复核，证明了该边界的可行性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能将医学文档转换为结构化数据，但其看似合理的输出可能缺乏源文档支持。若将此类未经验证的数据持久化到随患者信息累积的纵向健康记录中，会造成完整性风险：未核实的数据可能影响后续的摘要、趋势或预防性护理计算。
AI.method: 提出证据门控信任提升模型：引入确定性监视器，在指定下游用途接纳候选数据前，要求源文档包含唯一支持引文、相关字段位于同一实验室行且出处信息被保留；生成器不得批准自身输出，缺失或模糊证据导致拒绝，被拒候选保留供人工复核而非静默丢弃。实现于个人健康记录应用 Medical DataCloud，并通过自动化测试与已保存抽取输出的重放进行验证。
AI.result: 22项一致性和变异测试全部通过；重放覆盖9份历史实验室PDF报告、102行人工标注，产生97个数值候选：schema 校验接受全部97个，早期数据包级证据检查接受94个，强化后的引文与行级策略接纳72个并保留25个供人工复核。
AI.conclusion: 该研究评估的是系统完整性而非临床正确性或临床安全性，结果表明在纵向健康记录中建立可执行的边界以防止生成式声明授权其自身被再利用，在技术上可行。

title: SnapBench: Benchmarking Snap-and-Ask Multimodal Retrieval for Mobile Interactions
comment: 37 pages. Yuanbao Technical Report. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Mobile AI acts as a visual oracle, empowering users to snap a picture of something and ask for information. Snap-and-ask retrieval is now one of the most common entry points for mobile AI, yet photos are often blurry, while text questions may be short or mistyped. Existing benchmarks only test on clean inputs or do not isolate paired robustness in snap-and-ask retrieval. Therefore, we introduce SnapBench, the first paired benchmark for robust snap-and-ask multimodal retrieval, spanning 1,145 queries, 9,085 gallery items under 53 controlled corruption conditions with human annotations. We evaluate 16 multimodal retrievers, covering dual-tower encoders and embedding-based VLMs. Results show that image corruptions substantially degrade retrieval, while text corruptions mainly affect text-only retrieval and have limited impact on joint retrieval. Clean image-only retrieval often outperforms joint retrieval, indicating the coarse-text drag and the lack of cross-modal fallback under noisy inputs. SnapBench provides a controlled testbed for evaluating robust retrieval in snap-and-ask scenarios. We further propose MOOR (Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting), a simple adaptive fusion approach, highlighting the need for reliability-aware modality calibration in snap-and-ask retrieval.

AI.tldr: SnapBench 是首个面向"拍图提问"（snap-and-ask）场景的配对式多模态检索鲁棒性基准，包含 1,145 个查询、9,085 个图库条目、53 种受控损坏条件及人工标注。评测 16 个多模态检索器后发现：图像损坏显著降低检索性能，文本损坏主要影响纯文本检索；并进一步提出自适应融合方法 MOOR（模态锚定、离群感知、最优重加权）以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 移动端 AI 的"拍图提问"检索已成为常见入口，但实际输入往往存在图像模糊、文本简短或拼写错误等问题；现有基准仅测试干净输入，或未在 snap-and-ask 检索中隔离出成对的（图像与文本同时受扰动的）鲁棒性评估，缺乏可控的鲁棒性测试平台。
AI.method: （1）构建 SnapBench：含 1,145 个查询、9,085 个图库条目、53 种受控损坏条件（涵盖图像与文本扰动）以及人工标注的配对基准；（2）系统评测 16 种多模态检索器，覆盖双塔编码器与基于嵌入的视觉语言模型（VLM）；（3）提出 MOOR（Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting），一种简单、自适应的模态融合方法，对模态进行可靠性感知的校准。
AI.result: 实验表明：图像损坏会大幅降低检索性能，而文本损坏主要影响纯文本检索、对联合检索（joint retrieval）影响有限；在干净输入下纯图像检索的表现常优于联合检索，暴露出"粗糙文本拖累"问题以及噪声输入下缺乏跨模态回退（cross-modal fallback）机制的缺陷。MOOR 证明了可靠性感知的模态校准在 snap-and-ask 检索中的必要性。
AI.conclusion: SnapBench 为 snap-and-ask 场景下的鲁棒检索提供了受控测试平台，并揭示出现有模型在噪声输入下性能退化的关键瓶颈；MOOR 验证了基于可靠性的模态校准方向，为构建更鲁棒的多模态检索系统提供了基准和方法支撑。

title: Detecting Hidden Chain-of-Thought in Large Language Models with Linguistic, Behavioral, and Mechanistic Indicators
summary: Large language models often answer complex reasoning questions without revealing intermediate steps, raising whether they reason latently or complete patterns. We propose the Hidden CoT Detection Score (HCDS), a comparative behavioral and mechanistic signal measuring whether neutral-prompt behavior aligns more closely with explicit CoT or explicit no- CoT. Here, hidden CoT operationally denotes this neutral-prompt CoT-like alignment; HCDS does not directly observe or prove an unexposed reasoning trace. On GSM8K, HCDS is significantly positive for both Qwen3-4B variants (Thinking $+1.87$, $p = 1.2 \times 10^{-7}$; Instruct $+1.41$, $p = 1.9 \times 10^{-4}$), replicates across a different inference stack and quantization within $0.08$ ($+1.80$ and $+1.45$), and is not significantly positive in seven of eight length-adjusted calibration-control cells. The unadjusted score produces large positive scores on single-step arithmetic and numeric factual lookup. The variants also respond differently to no-CoT instructions: Instruct complies from the prompt alone, whereas Thinking continues reasoning and requires intervention. These findings show stronger, less prompt-conditional CoT-like behavior in the reasoning-tuned model, consistent with but not proof of latent reasoning. HCDS thus investigates latent reasoning without relying on models' self-reported traces.

AI.tldr: 提出隐藏思维链检测分数（HCDS），通过比较中性提示行为与显式CoT/显式no-CoT行为的一致性来判断模型是否存在隐藏推理，无需依赖模型自述的推理轨迹。在GSM8K上，推理调优的Qwen3-4B Thinking变体显示出更强的、较少受提示条件影响的CoT-like行为，与潜在推理假设一致但并非证明。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在回答复杂推理问题时往往不展示中间步骤，这引发了模型是进行潜在推理（latent reasoning）还是仅完成模式补全（pattern completion）的问题。然而这一现象难以直接观测，且现有方法过度依赖模型自述的推理轨迹，因此需要一个不依赖自述轨迹、能检测隐藏CoT行为的信号。
AI.method: 提出隐藏CoT检测分数（HCDS），这是一个对比性的行为与机制信号，通过衡量中性提示（neutral-prompt）下的行为与显式CoT行为或显式no-CoT行为哪一个更一致来给出分数。操作上，隐藏CoT被定义为中性提示下表现出的CoT-like对齐，而非直接观测或证明未暴露的推理轨迹。实验在GSM8K上对Qwen3-4B的Thinking与Instruct两个变体进行测试，并进行跨推理栈、量化、长度调整的校准对照验证。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，HCDS对Qwen3-4B两个变体均显著为正（Thinking +1.87，p=1.2×10⁻⁷；Instruct +1.41，p=1.9×10⁻⁴）；在不同推理栈和量化下复现（+1.80与+1.45），差异在0.08以内；八个长度调整的校准对照单元中有七个未显著为正。未调整的分数在单步算术和数值事实检索上产生较大的正分数。两个变体对no-CoT指令反应不同：Instruct仅凭提示即遵从，而Thinking继续推理并需要干预。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明推理调优的模型（Thinking变体）表现出更强且更少受提示条件影响的CoT-like行为，这与潜在推理假设一致，但不足以作为其存在的直接证明。HCDS提供了一种不依赖模型自述轨迹来研究潜在推理的新途径。

title: Beyond Churn: Predicting Financial Fragmentation in Retail Banking with Temporal Machine Learning
summary: Retail banking attrition is usually represented as a terminal binary event, even though client relationships often weaken earlier through partial movements of deposits, investments, and recurring activity to external financial institutions. This paper defines that preceding state as financial fragmentation and presents an end-to-end temporal machine-learning system for predicting it before complete disengagement. Using anonymized multi-source data from a large retail bank, the framework predicts whether a valid external transfer or investment event will occur within 90 days. The study uses 595,220 client-month observations, with 346 engineered features combining monthly client profiles, balances, product relationships, prior flow-of-funds behavior, macroeconomic conditions, and competitor activity. A four-stage XGBoost cascade estimates (1) whether an external outflow will occur within 90 days, (2) the expected amount, (3) the originating product, and (4) the destination financial institution. The primary classifier achieved a test precision-recall area under the curve of 0.823. At the validation-selected threshold, it produced 86.4% precision, 75.1% recall, and an F1 score of 0.803. Ranking test observations in descending Stage 1 fragmentation score, the top 1% of clients yielded 95.3% precision, while the top 5% captured 78.7% of observed outflow cases. The amount model placed 94.9% of predictions within an adjacent amount bucket. Destination prediction reached a macro-F1 of 0.81 across 27 classes; source-product prediction achieved a weighted F1 of 0.92. By moving the analytical focus from terminal churn to earlier fund migration, the proposed approach provides a practical foundation for proactive, explainable, and economically informed client-retention decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"金融碎片化"概念，将零售银行客户流失从终态二元事件前移至资金部分外流的早期状态，并构建了一个基于XGBoost四阶段级联的端到端时序机器学习系统，用于在90天内预测外部转账/投资事件及其金额、来源产品和目的地机构。基于59.5万余条客户-月度观测和346个工程化特征，主分类器达到0.823的PR-AUC、0.803的F1，为主动式、可解释且具经济意义的客户挽留决策提供了实用基础。
AI.motivation: 传统零售银行流失建模将客户关系终结视为二元终态事件，却忽略了客户关系往往通过存款、投资和日常交易的逐步外流而提前弱化。这一"前流失"状态（即金融碎片化）未被充分建模，导致银行无法在客户完全脱离之前进行主动干预。因此，本文旨在将分析焦点从终态流失转向更早的资金迁移，以支持前瞻性的客户挽留。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端时序机器学习框架：采用大型零售银行匿名多源数据，构建595,220条客户-月度观测，包含346个工程化特征（月度客户画像、余额、产品关系、历史资金流向、宏观经济条件及竞争对手活动）。核心为四阶段XGBoost级联模型，依次估计(1)90天内是否发生外部流出、(2)预期流出金额、(3)流出起源产品、(4)目的地金融机构。
AI.result: 主分类器测试PR-AUC为0.823；在验证集选定阈值下，精确率86.4%、召回率75.1%、F1为0.803。按Stage 1碎片化得分降序排列，前1%客户精确率达95.3%，前5%客户覆盖78.7%的流出案例。金额模型94.9%的预测落入相邻金额桶；27类目的地预测macro-F1为0.81；来源产品预测加权F1为0.92。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分析视角从终态流失转向更早期的资金迁移，所提方法能够在客户完全脱离前识别碎片化风险并刻画其演变路径（金额、来源、去向），为主动式、可解释且兼顾经济信息的客户挽留决策支持提供了实用基础，验证了时序级联建模在该场景下的有效性与可扩展性。

title: EDGE: Engine for Deterministic Graph Evaluation through Conversation Simulation from Graph Structured DSL Configuration
summary: As agentic systems evolve into complex multi agent orchestration workflows, there is a growing and critical need for systematic frameworks that measures an agent's behavioral consistency and determinism. In this paper, we introduce a formal evaluation methodology that is grounded in AgentGraph, a planner powered by a domain specific language that represents agent reasoning through a dynamically adjustable directed graph. We leverage this structural formalism and utilize graph traversal algorithms that exhaustively enumerate conversational paths, forming a comprehensive evaluation set that captures the agent's complete behavioral space. We then systematically replay these reproducible trajectories to compare observed outputs and state transitions against the intended DSL specification. To quantify reliability, we define novel metrics that measure response and trajectory determinism, structural adherence and semantic consistency across both exact replays and their linguistic variants. Our system's results demonstrate that agents configured using frameworks like AgentGraph and LangGraph with explicitly structured node transitions show superior determinism over agents that are not configured with controlled transitions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于AgentGraph（由领域特定语言驱动的规划器，以动态可调有向图表示智能体推理）的形式化评测方法，通过图遍历算法穷举对话路径、重放可复现轨迹，并定义轨迹确定性、结构遵从度与语义一致性等新指标，以量化多智能体编排工作流中的行为一致性与确定性。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体系统演化为复杂的多智能体编排工作流，迫切需要系统化的框架来度量智能体的行为一致性与确定性，而现有方法缺乏此类形式化评测手段。
AI.method: 以AgentGraph为形式化基础，利用图遍历算法穷举对话路径，形成覆盖智能体完整行为空间的评测集；系统重放这些可复现轨迹，将观测到的输出与状态迁移同预期的DSL规范进行对比；并定义响应/轨迹确定性、结构遵从度及语义一致性等新指标，覆盖精确重放及其语言变体。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用AgentGraph和LangGraph等框架并以显式结构化节点转换配置的智能体，其确定性显著优于未采用受控转换配置的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 该形式化评测方法能够系统化地测量并量化多智能体编排工作流中的行为一致性与确定性，为评估智能体编排可靠性提供了有效框架。

title: nnMNet: Baseline for Martian Terrain Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation is a crucial task for understanding Mars, the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. However, it is challenging because the Martian surface is highly unstructured and complex, making accurate pixel-level prediction and fine-grained annotation difficult. Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous methods and datasets to address these challenges. Nevertheless, the field lacks a robust, publicly available, and reproducible baseline, as well as a unified benchmark to facilitate fair evaluations. In this work, we present nnMNet, a new baseline model designed for Martian terrain semantic segmentation. Building upon nnWNet, we integrate linear attention to better capture global context and employ lightweight convolutions to reduce computational overhead. To bridge the gap between local and global representations, we introduce the Spatially-Aware Fusion Block (SAFB), which augments and combines features with diverse characteristics. Furthermore, we establish a new benchmark by curating and standardizing three high-quality datasets for thorough evaluation. nnMNet achieves new state-of-the-art 86.61%, 83.25%, and 88.24% mIoU on SynMars-TW, SynMars-Air, and MarsScapes, respectively. Our code, models, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/dereklee0310/nnMNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 nnMNet，一个面向火星地表语义分割的新型基线模型。它基于 nnWNet 引入线性注意力以捕捉全局上下文，并使用轻量卷积降低计算开销；同时提出空间感知融合块（SAFB）来桥接局部与全局表征。作者还整合标准化了三个高质量数据集以建立统一基准，在 SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air 和 MarsScapes 上分别取得 86.61%、83.25% 和 88.24% mIoU 的最优结果，并公开了代码、模型与数据集。
AI.motivation: 火星地表高度非结构化且复杂，像素级预测与细粒度标注困难；尽管深度学习方法与数据集不断涌现，该领域仍缺少稳健、公开、可复现的基线和统一基准来进行公平评估。
AI.method: 以 nnWNet 为基础构建 nnMNet：集成线性注意力以更好捕捉全局上下文并降低复杂度，采用轻量卷积减少计算开销；提出空间感知融合块（SAFB）增强并融合具有不同特性的局部与全局特征，弥合两者之间的差距；同时整理并标准化三个高质量数据集，建立统一评估基准。
AI.result: nnMNet 在 SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air 和 MarsScapes 三个基准上分别达到 86.61%、83.25% 和 88.24% 的 mIoU，均取得新的最先进结果；代码、模型和数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: nnMNet 通过高效的注意力设计、轻量卷积以及局部-全局特征融合，并配合统一基准的建立，为火星地形语义分割提供了稳健、可复现且公开的基线，同时验证了其在该任务上的显著优越性。

title: Generative vs. Encoder Models for Multilingual NER: A Comprehensive Empirical Study on Naamapadam
summary: Language is humanity's most consequential technology, yet for over a billion speakers across India's twenty-two constitutionally recognised languages, its digital layer remains structurally incomplete. Named Entity Recognition (NER), the foundational step in transforming raw text into machine-interpretable knowledge, has been studied exhaustively for English but remains largely unsolved across most Indic languages. This paper presents a rigorous comparative study of generative and encoder-based neural architectures for NER on all eleven languages of the Naamapadam benchmark. We evaluate five classic model families spanning sequence-to-sequence transformers and multilingual encoders; four decoder-only large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA and 4-bit NF4 quantisation; and nine generative models in zero-to-5-shot inference. Under strict CoNLL span-level evaluation, encoder-based models (mBERT and XLM-R, both F1=0.675 on Hindi) substantially outperform every generative architecture in ten of eleven languages, with gaps of 7.5-40 percentage points against the strongest competitor (Gemma-2-2B: avg F1=0.427). The best few-shot result reaches only 28% of the encoder baseline. We identify three language clusters--encoder-dominant, partial-coverage, and failure-zone; and provide actionable deployment guidelines grounded in transfer learning and low-resource NLP principles.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了生成式与编码器类神经架构在Naamapadam基准上11种印度语言NER任务的表现，发现编码器模型（mBERT、XLM-R）在严格CoNLL跨度级评估中大幅胜过所有生成式架构（11种语言中10种占优，F1差距7.5-40个百分点），并据此划分语言簇、提出低资源部署建议。
AI.motivation: 印度22种宪法承认语言中超过十亿使用者的数字语言层在结构上仍不完整。NER是从原始文本转化为机器可读知识的基础步骤，但对英语研究透彻，对大多数印度语言仍基本未解决，亟需系统评估不同架构在该场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 在Naamapadam基准的全部11种语言上进行严格对比实验：(1) 五类经典模型族（序列到序列Transformer与多语言编码器）；(2) 四个仅解码器LLM，通过LoRA与4位NF4量化微调；(3) 九个生成式模型在零样本到5样本推理下的表现。评估采用严格的CoNLL跨度级指标。
AI.result: 编码器模型（mBERT和XLM-R，印地语F1=0.675）在11种语言中的10种显著优于所有生成式架构，较最强竞争者Gemma-2-2B（平均F1=0.427）高出7.5-40个百分点；最佳少样本结果仅达到编码器基线的28%。研究识别出三种语言簇（编码器主导型、部分覆盖型、失败区型）。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源印度语言NER任务中，编码器架构仍是当前最可靠的选择，而生成式LLM在少样本与微调场景下均远未达到实用水平。作者据此提出可操作部署指南，为低资源NLP实践提供了基于迁移学习的架构选型依据。

title: Mode Connectivity Beyond Classifiers: Evidence from Generative and Contrastive Models
summary: The loss landscape of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) exhibits highly complex and non-convex properties. Recent studies have revealed the phenomenon of mode connectivity, demonstrating that independently trained network modes can be connected via a continuous low-loss path. However, existing mode connectivity research is predominantly confined to classifier-based models, leaving it an open question whether similar geometric properties exist in modern complex models. In this paper, we extend the boundaries of mode connectivity to generative and contrastive domains (specifically DDPM and NanoCLIP). Addressing the unique architecture of DDPM and CLIP, we propose an architecture-aware connection building algorithm. Extensive empirical results demonstrate for the first time that we successfully discover mode connectivity between independently trained DDPM and NanoCLIP modes. Our work provides a novel perspective for understanding the geometric properties of the loss landscapes in modern generative and contrastive models.

AI.tldr: 本文将模式连通性（mode connectivity）研究从传统的分类器模型扩展至生成式（DDPM）与对比学习（NanoCLIP）领域，提出一种架构感知的连接构建算法，首次在独立训练的 DDPM 与 NanoCLIP 模型之间发现低损耗连通路径。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络的损失景观具有高度复杂且非凸的特性，已有研究表明独立训练的模型模式之间可通过连续低损耗路径连接（模式连通性）。然而，现有研究主要集中在分类器模型上，生成式和对比学习等现代复杂模型是否具有类似的几何性质仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 针对 DDPM 和 CLIP 的独特架构，提出一种架构感知（architecture-aware）的连接构建算法，用于在生成式与对比学习模型之间构建低损耗连通路径，并进行了大量实验验证。
AI.result: 大量实证结果表明，该算法首次成功地在独立训练的 DDPM 和 NanoCLIP 模型模式之间发现模式连通性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解现代生成式和对比学习模型损失景观的几何性质提供了新的视角，拓展了模式连通性的应用边界。

title: An Open-Source, Event-Driven Pipeline for Cryptocurrency Market Data: Ingestion, Forecasting, and On-Chain Fraud Detection
summary: Cryptocurrency markets generate high-frequency, multi-source data that is expensive to work with unless a team already has commercial-grade streaming and warehousing infrastructure in place. This paper describes a fully open-source pipeline that reproduces the behavior of a cloud-native, event-driven system -- file arrival triggering a message, a message triggering compute -- entirely on commodity hardware, using Apache Kafka and a filesystem-watching poller in place of managed cloud triggers. The pipeline partitions historical Gemini exchange data into hourly and minutely files, ingests them asynchronously through two independently grouped Kafka consumers (one for audit logging, one for Spark-triggered ETL), and lands cleaned output in a PostgreSQL warehouse with historical and aggregated schemas plus asset-specific data marts. We use the resulting Bitcoin data mart to compare a seasonal ARIMA model against a single-layer LSTM network for price forecasting, and separately apply Random Forest and Gradient Boosting classifiers, with additional engineered features, to the public Ethereum fraud detection benchmark introduced by Farrugia et al. We report the architecture, the modeling methodology, and the resulting metrics, and we are explicit about the limitations of comparing forecasts issued at different horizons and of evaluating fraud detection on a static, already-labeled dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了一套完全开源、运行于普通硬件上的加密货币数据处理流水线：用Apache Kafka和文件系统监视轮询器模拟云原生事件驱动系统，将Gemini交易所历史数据分区后异步消费，最终落地到PostgreSQL数仓，并基于该数据分别开展比特币价格预测（ARIMA vs LSTM）和以太坊欺诈检测（随机森林与梯度提升）实验。
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场产生高频、多来源的数据，处理这些数据通常需要商业级的流处理和仓储基础设施，成本高昂。作者希望验证：在无托管云触发器的情况下，能否用纯开源组件在普通硬件上复现云原生事件驱动架构（文件到达触发消息、消息触发计算）的行为，从而降低数据处理门槛。
AI.method: 构建开源流水线：将Gemini历史数据按小时/分钟分区；使用Apache Kafka和文件监视轮询器替代托管云触发器；两组独立分组的Kafka消费者分别负责审计日志和Spark触发的ETL；清洗后数据落入PostgreSQL数仓，包含历史表、聚合表及资产专属数据市（data mart）。验证环节：1) 用比特币数据市对比季节ARIMA与单层LSTM的价格预测；2) 在Farrugia等人的公开以太坊欺诈检测基准上，用带工程特征的随机森林和梯度提升分类器进行检测。论文明确报告架构、建模方法与指标，并说明跨不同预测期限比较及在静态已标注数据上评估欺诈检测的局限。
AI.result: 该开源流水线成功复现了云原生事件驱动系统的行为并可运行于商品级硬件；基于所构建的比特币数据市完成了ARIMA与LSTM的价格预测对比，并在以太坊欺诈检测基准上完成了随机森林与梯度提升分类评估，给出了相应指标与明确的局限性说明。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明完全开源、基于Kafka与轮询组件的方案足以在普通硬件上支撑加密货币的高频多源数据流水线，并可用于实际机器学习任务；同时提醒读者谨慎解读结果——不同预测期限的对比缺乏严格可比性，且静态已标注基准上的欺诈检测评估可能高估真实场景下的泛化能力。

title: See the Change, Keep the Flow: Unsupervised Action Segmentation via Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation aims to discover latent action categories and their temporal organization without action annotations. Optimal transport-based methods provide structured frame-to-action assignments, however, their pseudo-label quality is fundamentally conditioned on the representation space used to construct the transport cost. We argue that reliable OT pseudo-labeling requires a representation geometry that is simultaneously sensitive to discriminative action changes and coherent along local temporal progressions. Based on this insight, we propose SpecT-OT, a spectral-temporal representation learning framework built upon an unbalanced optimal transport pseudo-labeling concept. SpecT-OT introduces a Spectral Reparameterization Projector (SRP), which parameterizes projector weights with fixed Fourier bases and learnable coefficients to improve the modeling of rapidly varying discriminative features, and Temporal Affinity Regularization (TAR), which imposes distance-aware, label-free constraints on pairwise frame affinities to stabilize local temporal structure. The two components jointly produce more discriminative and temporally stable transport costs, yielding more reliable pseudo-labels for iterative representation learning. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. SpecT-OT achieves the best results on 13 of 15 metrics, including 4.1-point MoF and 7.4-point F1 gains over the baseline on Breakfast and Desktop Assembly, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpecT-OT，一种基于非平衡最优传输伪标签的谱-时间表征学习框架，用于无监督动作分割。它引入谱重参数化投影器（SRP）和时序亲和正则化（TAR），分别增强对快速变化的判别性特征的建模、稳定局部时序结构，从而生成更可靠的最优传输代价和伪标签，在四个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有最优传输方法虽能提供结构化的帧到动作分配，但伪标签质量从根本上受限于构建传输代价所用的表征空间。作者论证：可靠的OT伪标签要求表征几何同时具备对判别性动作变化的敏感性，以及对局部时序进展的连贯性，而现有方法难以兼顾这两点。
AI.method: SpecT-OT 包含两个核心组件：(1) 谱重参数化投影器（SRP），用固定傅里叶基和可学习系数来参数化投影器权重，以更好地建模快速变化的判别性特征；(2) 时序亲和正则化（TAR），对成对帧亲和力施加距离感知、无标签约束，以稳定局部时序结构。二者联合产生更具判别性且时序稳定的传输代价，用于迭代式表征学习的伪标签生成。
AI.result: 在四个基准上相较现有方法表现优异：在15项指标中的13项取得最佳结果，其中在 Breakfast 上 MoF 提升 4.1 个点、在 Desktop Assembly 上 F1 提升 7.4 个点（均相对基线）。
AI.conclusion: SRP 与 TAR 两个组件协同作用，能够生成更具判别性且时序更稳定的传输代价，进而得到更可靠的伪标签以支撑迭代表征学习，在无监督动作分割任务上显著超越最先进方法。

title: DataFoundry: Evolving Data Preparators via Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Domain adaptation of large language models increasingly depends on constructing high-quality training data, yet existing data-preparation pipelines typically address quality only after generation through post-hoc filtering. This creates a fundamental mismatch: data-quality issues often originate from the construction process itself, while quality control is applied only to its outputs. We introduce \textsc{DataFoundry}, a framework for \textbf{evolving data preparators through recursive self-improvement} before large-scale data production. \textsc{DataFoundry} represents a data preparator as an evolvable runtime specification and instantiates its evolution with a \textsc{Skills-as-Modules} architecture, in which a central \textsc{Controller} orchestrates modular skills to compile executable runtimes, diagnose deficiencies on small pilot sets using domain-appropriate criteria, and translate diagnostic feedback into adapters that revise individual preparation components while preserving stable interfaces. We evaluate \textsc{DataFoundry} on DataPrep-Bench across mathematics, finance, law, and medicine, and find that recursively evolved preparators produce training data with higher downstream utility than baselines. Experiments across different backbones further demonstrate that these improvements are not tied to a particular model, while analyses and case studies further reveal the framework's optimization dynamics and illustrate how its evolution unfolds in practice.

AI.tldr: DataFoundry 是一个在大规模数据生产之前，通过递归自我改进来演化数据准备器（data preparator）的框架。它采用 Skills-as-Modules 架构，由中心化的 Controller 编排模块化技能，将诊断反馈转化为适配器来修订各个准备组件，在数学、金融、法律和医学领域的 DataPrep-Bench 基准上验证了其生成的训练数据具有更高的下游效用。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型数据准备流水线通常在生成之后才通过事后过滤（post-hoc filtering）来保证质量，而数据质量问题往往源于构造过程本身。这种"质量问题出在构建环节、质量控制却只作用于输出"的错位，促使作者提出在规模化生产前先对数据准备器本身进行演化。
AI.method: DataFoundry 将数据准备器表示为一个可演化的运行时规范，并通过 Skills-as-Modules 架构实例化其演化过程：中心 Controller 负责编排模块化技能以编译出可执行的运行时；在小型试点集上使用领域适配的判据诊断缺陷；再将诊断反馈转化为适配器（adapter），在保持接口稳定的前提下修订各个准备组件，从而实现对准备器自身的递归自我改进。
AI.result: 在 DataPrep-Bench 的数学、金融、法律和医学四个领域上的实验表明，经过递归演化的数据准备器相比基线能生成具有更高下游效用的训练数据；跨不同骨干（backbone）模型的实验进一步证明这些改进并不依赖于特定模型；分析与案例研究还揭示了框架的优化动态和实际演化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将质量控制从"事后过滤"前移到"准备器演化的源头"是可行且有效的：通过在规模生产前递归改进数据准备流程，可以系统性提升训练数据质量并带来下游模型性能增益，且具有跨模型的通用性，为大模型领域适配中的数据工程提供了一种新范式。

title: Beat-Synchronous Tokenization for ECG Transformers
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026)
summary: Transformer-based electrocardiogram (ECG) models commonly tokenize waveforms into fixed temporal patches. Though convenient, fixed patching can split heartbeat structures across token boundaries. We study beat-synchronous tokenization as a physiologically grounded alternative, comparing fixed patches with three beat-aligned strategies: resampled beats, adaptive pooled beats, and resampled beats augmented with R--R interval information. Experiments span two settings: 10-second 12-lead diagnostic classification on PTB-XL after MIMIC-IV-ECG masked pretraining, and 60-second single-lead rhythm classification on Icentia11k after patient-level contrastive pretraining. On PTB-XL, resampled beat tokens achieve the highest mean macro Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC; 0.8945) and nearly match the best fixed-patch macro Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC; 0.7414), reducing average sequence length from 100 to 11.2 tokens. On Icentia11k, beat-synchronous tokenizers obtain comparable AUPRC to fixed patching with better stability across runs. These results suggest morphology-preserving beat tokenization is a compact, competitive alternative to fixed temporal patching.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了心电信号(ECG)Transformer模型的令牌化策略，提出以心跳同步(tokenization)替代传统的固定时间窗切分。在PTB-XL和Icentia11k两个数据集上，重采样心跳令牌在保持竞争力的同时大幅缩短序列长度，表明保留形态学的beats令牌化是固定时间切分的紧凑且有效的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的ECG模型通常将波形切分为固定时间片(patches)。这种固定切分方式虽然方便，但可能将心跳结构分割到不同的token边界，破坏生理结构的完整性。作者因此希望探索一种生理学上更合理的替代方案——心跳同步令牌化(beat-synchronous tokenization)。
AI.method: 将固定时间切分与三种心跳对齐策略进行对比：(1) 重采样心跳(resampled beats)；(2) 自适应池化心跳(adaptive pooled beats)；(3) 重采样心跳增强R-R间期信息。实验涵盖两个场景：PTB-XL上的10秒12导联诊断分类（使用MIMIC-IV-ECG掩码预训练），以及Icentia11k上的60秒单导联心律分类（使用患者级对比预训练）。
AI.result: 在PTB-XL上，重采样心跳令牌取得最高的平均宏AUROC（0.8945），并几乎追平最佳固定切分的宏AUPRC（0.7414），同时将平均序列长度从100个token减少到11.2个。在Icentia11k上，心跳同步令牌化取得与固定切分相当的AUPRC，且多次运行间的稳定性更好。
AI.conclusion: 保留形态学的心跳令牌化是一种紧凑且具有竞争力的替代方案，能够在保持性能的同时显著降低计算开销，优于固定时间切分。

title: AutoCRAT: Within-trajectory Joint Control of Stochasticity and Compute for LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, which depends critically on inference-time decisions. Yet these decisions are commonly handled by static, one-size-fits-all policies, limiting adaptation to diverse tasks and reasoning stages. Recent adaptive methods partially address this limitation, but they primarily adapt either decoding stochasticity (how the model explores) or reasoning compute (how long the model reasons) in isolation, leaving their interaction within a single reasoning trajectory unmodeled. To address this challenge, we shift toward a within-trajectory joint control view, and instantiate it in AutoCRAT, a decoder-side controller for frozen backbones. Using only signals available during decoding, AutoCRAT jointly adjusts sampling stochasticity and reasoning budget during generation. AutoCRAT operates over a discrete action space and updates control decisions only at semantic boundaries, improving stability while remaining responsive to the evolving reasoning process. Comprehensive evaluation across 6 benchmarks demonstrates that AutoCRAT (I) uses 13.8-52.7% fewer inference tokens on average than recommended static configurations, (II) surpasses recommended static and adaptive baselines by 1.5-4.5% in relative accuracy, and (III) enjoys strong cross-backbone transferability.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoCRAT，一个面向冻结大模型的解码端控制器，在生成过程中联合调整采样随机性与推理预算（即"如何探索"与"推理多久"），仅在语义边界更新离散控制决策，从而在6个基准上平均节省13.8-52.7%的推理token、相对准确率提升1.5-4.5%，并具备跨骨干模型的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: LLM的推理性能高度依赖推理时的决策，但现有策略多为静态的"一刀切"方案，难以适应多样任务与推理阶段。近来自适应方法要么只调整解码随机性（如何探索），要么只调整推理算力（推理多久），未在单条推理轨迹内对二者交互进行建模，存在适应性缺口。
AI.method: 从"轨迹内联合控制"视角出发，AutoCRAT作为冻结骨干模型的解码端控制器，仅利用解码过程中的可得信号，在生成期间联合调整采样随机性与推理预算。它工作在离散动作空间上，且只在语义边界处更新控制决策，既保证稳定性又对推理过程演化保持响应。
AI.result: 在6个基准上的综合评估表明：AutoCRAT（I）相较推荐静态配置平均节省13.8-52.7%的推理token；（II）相对准确率比推荐静态及自适应基线提升1.5-4.5%；（III）具备较强的跨骨干模型可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: AutoCRAT验证了在单条推理轨迹内对解码随机性与推理预算进行联合控制的有效性，相比孤立调节其中任一维度或静态配置，能在效率与准确率上同时取得更好表现，并为冻结LLM提供一种即插即用、可迁移的推理期控制范式。

title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. CineForge-Evolve applies Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution (CPPE) to review trajectory evidence, consolidate recurrent findings into bounded stage-local patches, and deploy validated updates through structural replay and confidence-controlled paired evaluation. To measure complete story realization, we introduce CineScope, which combines a 100-script CineScope-Data suite with a human-aligned, multiscale CineScope-Metric spanning causal state, directorial orchestration, pacing and resource allocation, and character arc. Across CineScope-Data and two public benchmarks, the evolved CineForge policy improves CineScope-Metric from 4.024 to 4.380, outperforms three long-video baselines with consistent gains under ScriptAgent, and reduces review LLM calls by 37.0% on new stories. These results establish production trajectories as actionable experience for video agents that improve cumulatively across long-form storytelling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CineForge，一个自进化的视频制作智能体框架，通过 CineForge-Produce 管理叙事、角色、空间和电影化状态来生成视频，并由 CineForge-Evolve 基于跨故事轨迹证据（CPPE）持续提炼策略补丁，使制作系统能跨长故事累积改进；配套 CineScope 基准在多项指标上验证了其优于现有长视频基线。
AI.motivation: 长时程故事驱动的视频生成需要在相互依赖的场景中协调叙事分解、状态跟踪、镜头设计、提示词构建、渲染与修订。现有自适应视频系统仅能优化用户请求或可复用技能，导致反复出现的制作失败无法与跨故事、分阶段、持续性的改进机制相连，缺乏从经验中累积进步的闭环。
AI.method: CineForge 由两个模块组成：CineForge-Produce 将每个源故事组织为类型化的叙事、角色、空间和电影化状态，据此协调资产与片段生成，并把过程记录为规范化的制作轨迹；CineForge-Evolve 采用 Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution（CPPE）审阅轨迹证据，将反复出现的发现整合为有界的阶段局部补丁，并通过结构重放与置信度控制的配对评估部署验证后的更新。配套引入 CineScope 评测体系（100 脚本的 CineScope-Data 与人类对齐的多尺度 CineScope-Metric）。
AI.result: 在 CineScope-Data 与两个公开基准上，进化后的 CineForge 策略将 CineScope-Metric 从 4.024 提升至 4.380，在 ScriptAgent 设置下一致性地优于三个长视频基线，并在新故事上将审阅 LLM 调用量降低 37.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将制作轨迹作为视频智能体可操作的经验来源，能够使其在长时程叙事任务中实现累积性的能力提升，为跨故事、阶段定向的自进化视频制作提供了有效范式。

title: Evolutionary Soups: Evolving Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Objective LLM Alignment
summary: Large language models are increasingly required to generate responses that satisfy multiple competing objectives. Since optimal trade-offs depend on both user preferences and input prompts, controllable multi-objective generation must dynamically adapt models at inference time without retraining. To address this, we propose Evolutionary Soups, a mixture-of-experts framework for fine-grained generation control, with gating networks trained via an evolutionary algorithm. The per-layer gating networks dynamically produce expert-merging coefficients from hidden-state representations, while the evolutionary algorithm incorporates greedy hypervolume contribution for effective evolution of these gating networks, achieving consistent improvements on large and noisy training datasets and broader coverage of the non-convex Pareto front. Experiments across three tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of Evolutionary Soups over baselines: it achieves the best hypervolume, linear utility, and Tchebyshev utility (~20% improvement) among controllable methods on all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Evolutionary Soups，一种基于演化算法的专家混合（MoE）框架，通过逐层门控网络从隐状态表示中动态生成专家合并系数，实现对多目标生成的细粒度控制，无需重训练即可在推理时动态适应不同用户偏好与输入提示，在三个任务上取得最优的超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用（约20%提升）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地需要生成满足多个相互竞争目标的响应，而最优权衡既取决于用户偏好又取决于输入提示，因此可控多目标生成必须在推理时动态适应模型而无需重训练，这是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Evolutionary Soups 框架：采用逐层门控网络（mixture-of-experts），根据隐状态表示动态生成专家合并系数；利用演化算法（结合贪心超体积贡献）来高效演化这些门控网络，从而在大型且含噪的训练数据集上取得一致改进，并实现对非凸帕累托前沿的更广覆盖。
AI.result: 在三个任务上的实验表明：Evolutionary Soups 在所有任务上均取得最优的超体积、线性效用和切比雪夫效用，相比其他可控方法约有20%的提升，优于各基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Evolutionary Soups 证明了基于演化算法训练的 MoE 式逐层门控机制能够在推理时动态控制多目标权衡，以更强的帕累托前沿覆盖和更高的综合效用实现无需重训练的细粒度生成控制。

title: Convergence rates for the RMSprop optimizer with full control of the hyperparameters
summary:
Popular adaptive stochastic gradient descent (SGD) methods to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems include the RMSprop, the Adam, and the AdamW optimizers, where the adaptivity parts in Adam and AdamW basically just coincide with RMSprop. Such adaptive methods involve several hyperparameters including the regularization parameter $ε$ (which ensures that one does not divide by 0 and is often chosen to be very close to zero such as $10^{-8}$ in PyTorch by default) and the second moment decay parameter $β$ (which is often chosen to be very close to $1$ such as 0.99 (RMSprop) and 0.999 (Adam and AdamW) in PyTorch by default). Despite the high relevance of such methods, it remains an open research problem to provide error estimates for such methods with the error constants being not exploding but uniformly bounded with the respect to the hyperparameters, even in the situation of convex stochastic optimization problems.
  It is the key contribution of this work to essentially solve this problem for RMSprop. Specifically, we bound the expectation of the stopped evaluation of the objective function at the RMSprop process from above by the sum of an initialization term that decays exponentially in the training time, a stochastic approximation remainder of order $γ_n$, and a memory error of order $( 1 - β)^2$ with the error constants being uniformly controlled over all admissible choices of the step sizes, the second moment decay parameter $β$ and the regularization parameter $ε\in[0,1]$ (also covering $ε=0$). Our non-asymptotic error estimates hold not just for all sufficiently large n but hold for every gradient step $n=1,2,3,...$ with all error constants being explicitly specified. The key innovative new feature in the proof of our analysis are suitable inverse moment bounds for the second moment process in RMSprop.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RMSprop优化器，在凸随机优化问题中建立了非渐近误差估计，其误差常数在所有超参数（步长、二阶矩衰减参数β及正则化参数ε∈[0,1]，包括ε=0）上一致有界，从而解决了自适应SGD方法误差常数随超参数爆炸这一开放问题。
AI.motivation: RMSprop、Adam、AdamW等自适应SGD方法广泛用于训练人工智能系统，其中Adam和AdamW的自适应部分本质上与RMSprop一致。这些方法涉及多个超参数，如正则化参数ε（通常接近0，如PyTorch默认10^{-8}）和二阶矩衰减参数β（通常接近1，如RMSprop的0.99、Adam/AdamW的0.999）。尽管这些方法高度重要，但即使在凸随机优化情形下，提供误差常数不爆炸、而是关于超参数一致有界的误差估计，仍是一个开放的研究问题。
AI.method: 本文的关键贡献在于从本质上解决了RMSprop的这一开放问题。其核心创新证明工具是适用于RMSprop二阶矩过程的适当的逆矩界（inverse moment bounds）。基于此，作者将RMSprop过程在停止时刻的期望目标函数值分解为若干项分别控制。
AI.result: 作者将RMSprop过程处目标函数停止评估的期望从上方界定为：随训练时间指数衰减的初始化项、阶为γ_n的随机逼近余项、以及阶为(1-β)^2的记忆误差之和，且误差常数在所有可允许的步长、二阶矩衰减参数β和正则化参数ε∈[0,1]（涵盖ε=0）上一致受控。非渐近误差估计不仅对所有充分大的n成立，而且对每一步n=1,2,3,...均成立，所有误差常数均被显式给出。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为RMSprop提供了首个误差常数关于超参数一致有界的完整非渐近收敛性分析，解决了该领域长期存在的开放问题，并为后续将类似分析推广至Adam和AdamW等算法奠定了基础。

title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages. Published in Learning Health Systems (2026)
summary: Introduction: NICE guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations for clinical care but remain largely in unstructured natural language. Existing approaches to converting them into computable representations often focus on individual diseases, require substantial manual encoding, and do not scale. Large language models (LLMs) may enable much of this translation to be automated. Methods: We present an end-to-end approach that converts textual clinical guidelines into executable models capable of generating explainable, patient-specific recommendations. A stepwise LLM-based transformation with in-context examples produces human-inspectable intermediate artifacts. We apply the approach to NICE pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines, use expert review to assess rule alignment, and evaluate the executable pancreatic cancer model on 20 patient vignettes. Results: Expert review showed strong alignment between the source guidelines and generated executable models. Most discrepancies were partial omissions rather than incorrect logic, while hallucinated or fundamentally incorrect rules were rare. On the patient vignettes, the executable model achieved an F1 score of 82.5%. Conclusion: LLMs can transform natural-language NICE guidelines into interpretable, executable models that preserve guideline structure, support transparent inspection and modification, and generate patient-specific recommendations. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable automated generation of computable clinical guidelines.

AI.tldr: 提出一个端到端的流程，利用大语言模型（LLM）将NICE自然语言临床指南自动转换为可执行、可解释的决策模型，并在胰腺癌和肺癌指南上验证了可行性，专家评审显示规则对齐良好，胰腺癌模型在20个患者案例上F1得分为82.5%。
AI.motivation: NICE指南为循证临床建议提供依据，但以非结构化的自然语言存在；现有将其转为可计算表示的方法往往聚焦单一疾病、需要大量人工编码且难以扩展。LLM有望自动化这一翻译过程。
AI.method: 提出端到端方法，将文本临床指南转换为可执行、能生成可解释且患者特异性建议的模型。采用基于LLM的分步转换，并结合上下文示例（in-context examples）生成可人工审查的中间产物。将该方法应用于NICE胰腺癌和肺癌指南，通过专家评审评估规则对齐度，并在20个患者案例上评估可执行的胰腺癌模型。
AI.result: 专家评审显示源指南与生成的可执行模型之间对齐良好，大多数差异是部分遗漏而非错误逻辑，幻觉性或根本性错误规则罕见；在患者案例上，可执行模型达到82.5%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够将自然语言的NICE指南转换为可解释、可执行的模型，该模型保留指南结构、支持透明检查和修改，并能生成患者特异性建议，证明了可扩展自动化生成可计算临床指南的可行性。

title: SPLG-Mamba: Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network for Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
summary: Salient object detection in optical remote sensing images (ORSI-SOD) requires dense predictions that preserve object completeness and structural continuity under complex backgrounds, scale variation, and irregular object shapes. Existing methods often localize salient regions, but their predictions may still suffer from structural degradation, including fragmented, incomplete, or locally missing foreground responses. This degradation is closely related to hierarchical feature propagation, where shallow details can introduce texture-induced background responses, deep semantics may over-smooth weak structures, and uncontrolled cross-scale fusion can disturb coherent regions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network, SPLG-Mamba, for ORSI-SOD. Specifically, SPLG-Mamba integrates Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR), hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba, and Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF). SDR recalibrates smoothed responses and detail residuals before state-space modeling, Local-Global Mamba assigns local modeling to shallow feature levels and global modeling to deep feature levels, and GCSF controls cross-scale detail injection during decoding. Experiments on ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 demonstrate state-of-the-art results and improved structural completeness and continuity. The code is available at https://github.com/yxu9910/SPLG-Mamba

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPLG-Mamba，一种用于光学遥感图像显著目标检测（ORSI-SOD）的结构保持局部-全局Mamba网络，通过平滑细节重校准（SDR）、层级感知的局部-全局Mamba和门控跨尺度融合（GCSF）解决预测中的结构退化（碎片化、不完整、局部缺失）问题，在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ORSI-SOD方法虽能定位显著区域，但预测常出现结构退化，包括前景响应碎片化、不完整或局部缺失。这种退化与层级特征传播密切相关：浅层细节会引入纹理引起的背景响应、深层语义会过度平滑弱结构、不受控的跨尺度融合会扰动连贯区域。
AI.method: 提出SPLG-Mamba网络，包含三个核心组件：1) Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR)，在状态空间建模前重校准平滑响应与细节残差；2) 层级感知的Local-Global Mamba，对浅层特征层级分配局部建模、对深层特征层级分配全局建模；3) Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF)，在解码过程中控制跨尺度细节注入。
AI.result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199三个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的结果，并改善了预测的结构完整性和连续性。
AI.conclusion: SPLG-Mamba通过针对性的结构保持设计（重校准、层级化建模和门控融合）有效缓解了显著目标检测中的结构退化问题，验证了其优越性和泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in Arabic-speaking markets, yet standard benchmarks overwhelmingly reward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) fluency while leaving dialectal and culturally grounded competence unmeasured. This gap is consequential: everyday Arabic is largely dialectal, and dialect encodes social meaning that MSA-centric evaluation cannot capture. We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical, and culturally-embedded phenomena, each paired with an expert-established ground truth. Our methodology separates evaluation into a model-agnostic phase, in which atomic, MECE positive criteria are derived solely from the ground truth, and a model-specific phase, in which four state-of-the-art systems -- Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.7, GPT-5.6, and Kimi K3 -- are scored against those criteria and penalised for errors they actively introduce. Across 124 model-prompt evaluations we catalogue 466 error instances under a nine-category taxonomy. The four systems cluster within a narrow macro-average band (42.7%-53.1%), with no model exceeding 55% and every model recording at least one negative-scoring prompt, confirming that Saudi dialectal competence remains broadly unsolved. Notably, Ambiguous Framing is the dominant failure mode (37.3% of errors) while outright Hallucination accounts for only 11.2%, indicating that models fail less by stating falsehoods than by distorting register and flattening pragmatic nuance. We further observe a consistency-versus-ceiling trade-off and model-distinctive error signatures.
