We release the full prompt set, ground truths, and scored rubrics to support reproducible dialectal evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对沙特阿拉伯方言的基于评分标准（rubric）的基准测试，包含31个由专家编写、覆盖习语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象的提示词。通过模型无关阶段（仅依据标准答案推导原子化、MECE的正面准则）和模型特定阶段（对Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6和Kimi K3四个系统评分）的两阶段方法，在124次模型-提示评估中记录了466个错误实例。结果显示四个系统宏平均分集中在42.7%-53.1%的狭窄区间，没有任何模型超过55%，且每个模型都有至少一个负分提示词，表明沙特方言能力总体上仍未解决；其中"模糊框架"是主导失败模式（占37.3%），而幻觉仅占11.2%，说明模型主要问题在于扭曲语域和抹平语用细微差别而非编造事实。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型正越来越多地部署在阿拉伯语市场，然而现有标准基准几乎只奖励现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的流利度，完全忽略了方言性和文化嵌入能力的测量。由于日常阿拉伯语主要以方言为主，且方言编码了MSA中心评价无法捕捉的社会意义，这一空白具有重要影响，因此需要构建专门评估沙特方言能力的基准。
AI.method: 方法分为两个阶段：一是模型无关阶段，仅从专家建立的标准答案中推导出原子的、MECE（相互独立、完全穷尽）的正面评分准则；二是模型特定阶段，将四个最先进的系统（Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.7、GPT-5.6、Kimi K3）依据这些准则进行评分，并对模型主动引入的错误进行扣分。基准包含31个专家撰写的提示词，覆盖习语、语用、词汇和文化嵌入现象，每项配以专家确立的标准答案，并使用九类错误分类法对全部错误进行归类。
AI.result: 在124次模型-提示评估中记录了466个错误实例。四个系统的宏平均分集中在42.7%-53.1%的狭窄区间内，没有模型超过55%，且每个模型都至少出现一个负分提示词。模糊框架是主导失败模式（占37.3%），而彻底的幻觉仅占11.2%，表明模型更多是因扭曲语域和抹平语用细微差别而失败，而非陈述虚假事实。此外还观察到一致性与上限之间的权衡以及模型特有的错误特征。
AI.conclusion: 沙特方言能力在现有最先进模型中仍未得到解决，所有系统都处于较低且相近的性能水平。模型失败的主要机制不是幻觉而是对语域和语用细微性的扭曲，这为未来方言评测和改进提供了方向。作者公开了完整的提示词集、标准答案和评分标准以支持可复现的方言评估。

title: RSLM: Training-Free Vector Quantization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
summary:
By introducing RSLM (Rotated Scaled Lloyd-Max), a family of training-free vector quantization codecs compressing embeddings to 1--4 bits per dimension, we reduce memory cost and memory bandwidth of a typical large-scale Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search system, while reducing its complexity and keeping or improving recall across multiple benchmark datasets. State-of-the-art systems filter candidates using coarse partitions, approximately score them to narrow the set, and then rescore the best with higher precision representations (often >=8 bits per dimension). Our relativized codecs can bring this down to 2--4 bits per dimension.
  We use the properties of the ANN system to encode residual vectors instead of full vectors, both for the approximate scoring phase and the rescoring phase. Since Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) is very sensitive to vector norms, we correct the $L_2$ norms of quantized vectors. Our major innovation is that we correct the $L_2$ norm of the final reconstructed vector rather than just the residual. Our rescaling replaces more complicated schemes, such as Anisotropic loss. The residualization scheme gives us a more favorable quality vs size trade-off than generic quantization methods.
  Our high-performance implementation leverages a block-wise cascaded Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) with linear-like complexity, AVX SIMD-optimized codebooks, and a steganographic encoding of scaling factors for perfect cache-line alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RSLM（Rotated Scaled Lloyd-Max），一种免训练的向量量化编解码器家族，可将嵌入压缩到每维 1–4 bit，用于大规模近似最近邻（ANN）搜索系统。它通过编码残差向量并校正最终重建向量的 L2 范数，替代了各向异性损失等复杂方案，在降低内存成本、带宽和系统复杂度的同时保持甚至提升多个基准数据集上的召回率，并借助分块级联 Fast Walsh-Hadamard 变换（FWHT）、AVX SIMD 优化码本和缩放因子的隐写编码实现高性能。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的 ANN 系统通常先用粗粒度分区过滤候选、以近似表示粗打分、再用高精度表示（常达每维 8 bit 以上）重打分，导致较大的内存开销和复杂度。作者希望将重打分阶段的精度降到每维 2–4 bit，同时利用 ANN 系统的性质（如 MIPS 对向量范数高度敏感）来提升量化质量与尺寸的权衡，并简化方案（免训练、免各向异性损失）。
AI.method: 提出免训练的 RSLM 码本族（1–4 bit/维），利用 ANN 系统特性对残差向量而非完整向量进行编码，同时用于粗打分和重打分两个阶段；针对 MIPS 对范数敏感的问题，量化后修正向量 L2 范数——关键创新是修正最终重建向量的 L2 范数而非仅修正残差，从而替代各向异性损失等复杂机制；实现上采用线性复杂度的分块级联 Fast Walsh-Hadamard 变换（FWHT）、AVX SIMD 优化的码本查找，以及将缩放因子隐写编码以保证缓存行完美对齐。
AI.result: RSLM 在多个基准数据集上可将典型大规模 ANN 系统的内存成本和内存带宽降低到每维 1–4 bit（重打分阶段可降至 2–4 bit），同时保持或提升召回率，并降低系统复杂度。残差化方案取得了比通用量化方法更优的质量-尺寸权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过编码残差并校正最终重建向量的范数，免训练的 RSLM 编解码器可以在极低比特率下高效支撑 ANN 的粗打分与重打分两阶段，显著节省内存与带宽、简化系统设计并维持甚至改善检索精度，为大规模向量检索系统的量化压缩提供了实用且高性能的解决方案。

title: Interpreting and Steering for Safe and Correct Code Generation
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate source code containing vulnerabilities, yet little work studies the internal mechanisms that distinguish safe from vulnerable generation in them. In this work, we systematically perform a mechanistic interpretation of LLMs, aiming at both understanding how code safety-vs-vulnerability is represented or driven by components in an LM and turning the insights into actionable steering strategies to encourage safer code generation. To this end, we introduce CodeSec-Pairs, a dataset of 9,342 Python safe-and-vulnerable contrastive code pairs, sampled from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Utilizing the dataset, we explore approaches to localize layers and attention heads that relate to code safety, and further experiment with different steering strategies for inference-time vulnerability reduction. In particular, we propose DuoSteer, a double-steering approach that simultaneously applies safety and code-correctness steering to attention heads. In experiments over five vulnerability types, DuoSteer leads to an average of -26.9% vulnerability rate reduction and +7.5% functional correctness improvement, which outperforms not only other steering variants but also prompting and supervised fine-tuning baselines. The advantage also replicates on Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with another 2,500 contrastive pairs sampled from that model.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地对大型语言模型（LLM）进行代码安全性的机制解释研究，构建了包含9,342对安全/易受攻击Python代码对比样本的数据集CodeSec-Pairs，提出双引导方法DuoSteer（同时引导安全性相关和代码正确性相关的注意力头），在五种漏洞类型上将漏洞率平均降低26.9%、功能正确性提升7.5%，优于提示工程和监督微调基线，并在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: LLM经常生成含有漏洞的源代码，但现有工作很少研究其内部机制如何区分安全与易受攻击的代码生成。作者旨在填补这一空白，既理解代码安全性在LM中如何被组件表示和驱动，又将机制洞察转化为可操作的推理时引导策略以促进更安全的代码生成。
AI.method: 首先引入CodeSec-Pairs数据集，包含从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct采样得到的9,342对Python安全/易受攻击对比代码对。利用该数据集定位与代码安全性相关的层和注意力头，并实验多种推理时引导策略以降低漏洞。核心贡献是DuoSteer——一种双引导方法，同时对与安全性和代码正确性相关的注意力头施加引导。此外还在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上额外采样2,500对比对以验证方法的可迁移性。
AI.result: 在五种漏洞类型上，DuoSteer平均实现漏洞率降低26.9%、功能正确性提升7.5%，优于其他引导变体以及提示工程和监督微调基线；该优势在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 通过机制解释定位出的安全性相关组件可用于有效的推理时引导，且联合代码正确性引导的双引导策略能同时降低漏洞率并提升功能性，证明机制层面的安全理解可以转化为可操作且可迁移的安全代码生成改进方案。

title: Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent
summary: Attributing an artwork to an artist has traditionally relied on detailed visual observations and descriptions, known as stylistic analysis in art history. By contrast, current artificial intelligence (AI) models used in the field offer only unexplained probabilistic classifications. To bridge this methodological gap, we present an AI framework that automates stylistic analysis of paintings, providing a foundation for enhancing evidence collection, discovery, and verification. By training a vision transformer (ViT) on a large corpus of paintings with metadata, our system encodes this art history-specific data as embeddings. These representations are factorized via sparse dictionary learning into a shared set of features that recur across the training set. A large language model (LLM) then interprets each feature by retrieving associated artworks and their accompanying curator-written texts, and synthesizes them into descriptions that reflect their stylistic attributes. Finally, an autonomous coordinator LLM applies a reasoning-and-action (ReAct) framework to weight, test, and refine these features into cohesive descriptions of an artwork, or comparisons of artworks. This approach converts detailed visual features into descriptive terms, addressing a key challenge in art history. It thus connects the use of images as data with the semantic concerns of humanists, establishing vision-based computational art history as an area for future growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将视觉Transformer嵌入、稀疏字典学习与大语言模型相结合的AI框架，把绘画的风格分析从传统艺术史中的视觉观察描述自动化，实现可解释的、基于证据的风格归因与作品比较。
AI.motivation: 传统艺术史中的风格分析依赖专家的细致视觉观察与文字描述，而当前AI模型仅提供无法解释的概率分类，无法弥合视觉数据与人文语义之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 在包含元数据的大规模绘画语料上训练视觉Transformer（ViT）以编码艺术史数据为嵌入；通过稀疏字典学习将这些嵌入分解为一组在训练集中重复出现的共享特征；大语言模型通过检索关联作品及策展人撰写的文本，将这些特征综合成反映风格属性的描述；最后，一个自主协调LLM采用推理与行动（ReAct）框架对这些特征进行加权、测试与细化，生成对单一作品或作品比较的连贯描述。
AI.result: 该方法成功将详细的视觉特征转化为描述性术语，为证据收集、发现与验证提供基础，并弥合了以图像作为数据与人文主义者的语义关注之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该框架建立了基于视觉的计算艺术史作为未来增长方向，将AI能力与传统艺术史方法论相衔接，为可解释的艺术归因分析开辟新途径。

title: Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA
summary: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate full vignettes substantially higher than zero-shot alternatives, and clinicians perceive them to be human-written 85% of the time, compared with 22% for zero-shot. FORMA also reduces demographic disparity in perceived quality by 1.5-7x. These results show that cognitive formulation can serve as an auditable specification for scalable synthetic clinical text generation. A repository with the data and code is available online: https://github.com/Amit-Oren/FORMA.

AI.tldr: FORMA 是一个理论驱动的框架，将疾病的认知模型编译为有向加权图，生成符合该图结构的人物特定临床病例小短文（vignette），并在 PTSD 场景中通过外部边恢复探针、临床专家、LLM 评委和100名执业医师的用户研究验证其保真度，证明认知表述可作为可审计的规范用于可扩展的合成临床文本生成。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型能生成流畅的临床病例小短文，但流畅性本身并不保证对可具体说明的临床结构的忠实度；缺乏一种能将理论认知模型转变为可验证、可审计的文本生成规范的方法。
AI.method: FORMA 框架包含三个步骤：将障碍的认知模型编译成有向加权图、从图中采样人物特定配置、验证生成的小短文是否保留指定的组件与因果链接。研究以 PTSD 为实例，使用 Ehlers 和 Clark 认知模型，在 500 个人物、11 个生成模型、3 种消融条件下生成 16,500 个小短文；评估采用外部边恢复探针、两名临床专家、缩放的 LLM 评审器以及 100 名持证医师的用户研究。
AI.result: 完整条件下生成的短文可以恢复认知图（MCC=+0.41, AUC=0.70），而零样本生成则无法恢复（MCC=+0.01, AUC=0.50）；专家对完整短文评分显著高于零样本；临床医师认为完整短文由人类撰写的比例为 85%，而零样本仅为 22%；FORMA 还将感知质量的人口统计差异降低了 1.5 至 7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 认知表述可以作为可审计的规范，支持可扩展的合成临床文本生成；FORMA 证明了在生成临床病例时兼顾流畅性与理论结构的可行性，代码和数据已开源。

title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving
summary: Hybrid linear-attention architectures have recently scaled to large open-weight models, offering quality competitive with full attention while substantially reducing key/value (KV) cache growth. However, their in-place recurrent-state updates complicate cache management: prefix reuse requires state checkpoints alongside full-attention KV, while storing state checkpoints in full increases memory pressure, leading to more evictions and repeated prefill. By analyzing the decay structure of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), we find that different heads and channels retain prefix information over markedly different timescales, which we term \emph{retention horizons}. This variation suggests substantial compression potential in persistent state checkpoints. Building on this observation, we introduce \emph{Decay-Aware State Compression} (DASC), which derives retention horizons from model weights, selects long-horizon state units, and packs them into a ragged state checkpoint layout. To integrate efficiently with tensor-parallel inference engines, DASC furtherly balances compressed state checkpoints across TP ranks. On reuse, DASC either zero-fills omitted units or refreshes them from a bounded suffix with additional compute cost. Across retrieval and end-to-end reasoning benchmarks on Kimi-Linear, conservative DASC configurations remain close to full caching while compressing KDA recurrent state checkpoints by $2.63\times$. Under fixed state checkpoint memory budgets, the resulting capacity gains reduce mean Time to First Token (TTFT) by 42.6\% and improve input throughput by 68.4\%. At larger compression ratio, suffix refresh recovers much of the accuracy lost to more aggressive omission, at the cost of additional replay computation. Qwen with GDN exhibits a similar quality--efficiency trend, showing that DASC extends from channel-wise KDA to head-wise GDN.

AI.tldr: 针对混合线性注意力架构（GDN、KDA）的持续循环状态检查点在KV缓存管理中带来内存压力的问题，本文提出Decay-Aware State Compression（DASC）：从模型权重推导出各头/通道的“保留时域”（retention horizons），仅选择长时域状态单元并以不规则（ragged）布局打包压缩持久状态检查点，同时兼顾张量并行（TP）下的负载均衡。实验表明，DASC在Kimi-Linear上将KDA循环状态检查点压缩2.63倍，在固定检查点内存预算下将平均TTFT降低42.6%、输入吞吐提升68.4%，并通过后缀刷新在更高压缩比下恢复精度；该方法同样适用于Qwen+GDN，可推广至通道级（KDA）与头级（GDN）两种状态结构。
AI.motivation: 混合线性注意力架构已扩展到大模型且质量接近全注意力，但其就地（in-place）循环状态更新使缓存管理复杂化：前缀复用需要同时保存循环状态检查点和全注意力的KV；而完整保存状态检查点会加剧内存压力，导致更多缓存驱逐与重复prefill。作者通过分析GDN与KDA的衰减结构，发现不同头/通道保留前缀信息的时域跨度差异显著（即retention horizons），这为持久状态检查点提供了可观的压缩潜力。
AI.method: 提出DASC：①由模型权重推导每头/通道的保留时域；②据此筛选长时域状态单元，并将其打包成不规则（ragged）的检查点布局；③为与张量并行推理引擎高效集成，在TP rank之间均衡分配压缩后的状态检查点；④在复用阶段，对省略单元采用零填充，或通过额外的计算从有界后缀（bounded suffix）中刷新这些单元。
AI.result: 在Kimi-Linear上，保守的DASC配置在接近全量缓存质量的同时将KDA循环状态检查点压缩2.63倍；在固定检查点内存预算下，平均Time to First Token（TTFT）降低42.6%，输入吞吐提升68.4%。更高的压缩比下，后缀刷新机制以额外的重放计算为代价，显著恢复因激进省略而损失的精度。Qwen+GDN呈现类似的“质量-效率”趋势，表明DASC既能用于通道级KDA，也能用于头级GDN。
AI.conclusion: DASC验证了利用模型固有的衰减/保留时域差异进行状态检查点压缩的有效性，能够在保持接近全量缓存精度的同时大幅降低内存开销、显著提升前缀复用的TTFT与吞吐，并可为KDA与GDN两种主流混合线性注意力架构提供统一的压缩方案。

title: Beyond Uncertainty: Multi-Solver Disagreement Rewards for Self-Evolving Reasoning Curricula
comment: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 07--11, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Self-evolving reasoning frameworks train a Challenger to generate questions exposing a Solver's weaknesses, creating adaptive curricula without human data. However, existing approaches use a single solver's sampling uncertainty as the Challenger's reward. This creates a fundamental bottleneck: as the solver grows confident on the Challenger's question distribution, all sampled answers converge identically, collapsing the reward to zero and starving the Challenger of learning signal. Critically, this single-model reward cannot distinguish genuinely easy questions from those that merely align with one solver's learned biases. We propose a multi-solver disagreement reward using a heterogeneous ensemble varying in model capacity and sampling temperature. A normalized Shannon entropy over the ensemble's per-question plurality answers explicitly rewards questions where solvers produce conflicting solutions---capturing difficulty as inter-model divergence rather than intra-model sampling variance. This richer gradient enables the Challenger to discover questions targeting true capability boundaries, producing a curriculum that forces downstream Solvers to develop robust reasoning strategies generalizing across problem types. Our approach is a drop-in reward function replacement requiring no framework modifications or additional data. Experiments with Qwen3-4B show that Solvers trained on disagreement-Challenger questions achieve +1.34 points average improvement on competition-math benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC, Olympiad), suggesting that multi-solver disagreement provides a complementary and scalable signal for curriculum generation in self-play reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多求解器分歧奖励（multi-solver disagreement reward），用异构模型集成（容量和采样温度各异）的归一化香农熵替代单一求解器的采样不确定性，作为自进化推理框架中 Challenger 的奖励信号，以解决单模型奖励坍缩问题，使 Challenger 生成针对真实能力边界的自适应课程。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化推理框架用单个 Solver 的采样不确定性作为 Challenger 的奖励，存在根本性瓶颈：当 Solver 对 Challenger 生成的问题分布逐渐自信时，所有采样答案趋于一致，奖励坍缩为零，Challenger 失去学习信号；且单模型奖励无法区分真正简单的问题与恰好符合某求解器学习偏见的问题。
AI.method: 提出多求解器分歧奖励：使用一个异构集成（在模型容量和采样温度上变化），对集成在每个问题上得到的 plurality 答案（多数答案）计算归一化香农熵，显式奖励求解器产生冲突答案的问题，将难度建模为模型间分歧（inter-model divergence）而非单模型内采样方差（intra-model sampling variance）。该方法是对奖励函数的即插即用替换，无需修改框架或额外数据。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 上的实验表明，使用分歧奖励 Challenger 问题训练的 Solver 在竞赛数学基准（MATH-500、AMC、Olympiad）上平均提升 +1.34 分。
AI.conclusion: 多求解器分歧为自对弈推理系统中的课程生成提供了互补且可扩展的信号，能够生成迫使下游 Solver 发展跨问题类型泛化的稳健推理策略的课程。

title: PhysVR: Vision-Language Model Guided Interference-aware Temporal Feature Refinement for Remote Physiological Measurement
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological measurement from facial videos, yet its subtle pulse-related variations are easily affected by illumination variation, head motion, facial blur, and region-of-interest instability. Existing methods mainly suppress interference during feature learning, while whether the learned temporal features remain affected by interference and how to further suppress such interference before rPPG estimation are rarely examined. To address this limitation, we propose PhysVR, a vision-language model guided interference-aware temporal feature refinement framework for rPPG estimation. Specifically, a physiological backbone produces global temporal features and a coarse rPPG prediction, from which signal-derived physiological reliability evidence is constructed from local temporal characteristics. In parallel, a frozen vision-language model processes sampled facial frames under an interference-oriented prompt, and an evidence head extracts visual interference evidence from the VLM output. Temporal cross-attention integrates the physiological and visual evidence with the global temporal features to construct interference-aware temporal context. Guided by this context, a shared temporal correction unit performs general refinement, while four interference-specific experts selectively suppress different interference through adaptive routing. The refined temporal features are then used for final rPPG estimation. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that PhysVR consistently outperforms representative methods under both intra-dataset and cross-dataset evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: PhysVR 是一个由视觉-语言模型引导的干扰感知时间特征精炼框架，用于 rPPG 估计。它利用冻结的视觉-语言模型从面部帧提取视觉干扰证据，并结合从信号中提取的生理可靠性证据，通过时间交叉注意力构建干扰感知的时间上下文，再由共享时间校正单元与四个干扰特异性专家进行选择性抑制，最终生成精炼特征用于 rPPG 估计。在五个公开基准上，PhysVR 在数据集内和跨数据集评估中均优于代表性方法。
AI.motivation: rPPG 能够通过面部视频实现非接触式生理测量，但其微弱的脉搏相关变化极易受到光照变化、头部运动、面部模糊和感兴趣区域不稳定等因素干扰。现有方法主要在学习特征过程中抑制干扰，却很少检验学到的时序特征是否仍受干扰影响，也缺少在 rPPG 估计前进一步抑制这类干扰的手段。本工作旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: PhysVR 框架由几个关键模块组成：一个生理主干网络生成全局时间特征和粗略的 rPPG 预测，并据此从局部时间特征构造基于信号的生理可靠性证据；一个冻结的视觉-语言模型在干扰导向提示下处理采样面部帧，由证据头从 VLM 输出中提取视觉干扰证据；时间交叉注意力将生理与视觉证据融合到全局时间特征中，构建干扰感知的时间上下文；在该上下文指导下，共享时间校正单元执行通用精炼，四个干扰特异性专家通过自适应路由选择性抑制不同干扰；最终精炼特征用于 rPPG 估计。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准上的大量实验表明，无论是在数据集内评估还是跨数据集评估协议下，PhysVR 都持续优于代表性方法。
AI.conclusion: PhysVR 通过引入视觉-语言模型作为干扰感知的辅助信号，在 rPPG 估计之前对时序特征进行显式精炼与干扰抑制，验证了"估计前抑制干扰"这一思路的有效性，为 rPPG 鲁棒性提升提供了新的范式。

title: Small Language Models as Judges for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends RL beyond tasks with exact answers or rule-based verifiers by scoring responses against instance-specific criteria. However, this makes reward computation expensive: training requires repeated rubric judging, often with proprietary APIs or local generative LLM judges with 7B parameters or more. We study whether smaller language models can serve as efficient and reliable rubric-based judges. To make this question measurable, we construct PointRubric and RaR-Science-Static, two pointwise rubric-based evaluation datasets with instance-specific criteria and itemwise satisfaction labels. We compare three ways of extracting criterion-level judgments from small models: Generative verdicts, Yes/No Logprob margins, and Probe judges. Across both datasets, the Qwen3-1.7B Probe judge achieves the strongest criterion-level agreement among these methods, outperforming Generative and Logprob judges. Used as a GRPO reward model, it trains a policy from 0.232 to 0.643 on RaR-Science rubric score, compared with 0.594 for an 8B Generative judge baseline, while the baseline requires 10.7$\times$ more reward-judge time. Task and domain transfer experiments further suggest that Probe judges preserve criterion-level reward structure across settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究小型语言模型能否作为高效且可靠的基于评分标准（rubric）的奖励判定器。作者构建了两个逐点评分数据集（PointRubric 和 RaR-Science-Static），比较了三种从小型模型提取标准级判断的方法（生成式裁决、Yes/No Logprob 边际、探针式判定器），发现 Qwen3-1.7B 探针判定器在标准级一致性上最优，将其用作 GRPO 奖励模型时，将策略从 0.232 提升至 0.643（优于 8B 生成式判定器基线的 0.594），且奖励判定时间仅为基线的 1/10.7，并在跨任务和跨领域迁移中保持奖励结构。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准的强化学习（Rubric-based RL）将 RL 扩展到没有精确答案或规则验证器的任务，但奖励计算非常昂贵：训练过程需要反复进行评分标准判定，通常依赖专有 API 或 7B 参数以上的本地生成式 LLM 判定器。作者希望研究更小的语言模型能否作为高效且可靠的评分标准判定器，以降低奖励计算开销。
AI.method: 构建两个带实例特定标准和逐项满足标签的逐点评分数据集（PointRubric 与 RaR-Science-Static）；比较三种从小型模型提取标准级判断的方法：生成式裁决（Generative verdicts）、Yes/No Logprob 边际、以及探针式判定器（Probe judges）；并在 GRPO 训练中作为奖励模型进行验证，同时开展跨任务与跨领域迁移实验。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，Qwen3-1.7B 探针判定器取得最佳标准级一致性，优于生成式与 Logprob 判定器。作为 GRPO 奖励模型，它将策略的 RaR-Science 评分从 0.232 提升到 0.643，而 8B 生成式判定器基线为 0.594；且基线所需的奖励判定时间是其 10.7 倍。迁移实验进一步表明探针判定器能跨设置保持标准级奖励结构。
AI.conclusion: 小型模型的探针式判定器能够在标准级奖励判定上达到超越大规模生成式判定器的效果，同时大幅降低计算成本，为基于评分标准的 RL 提供了一种高效、可靠且可迁移的奖励建模方案。

title: Uncertainty of Vision Medical Foundation Models
summary: Accurate uncertainty estimation is essential for machine learning systems de- ployed in high-stakes domains such as medicine. Traditional approaches primarily rely on probability outputs from trained models (point predictions), which provide no formal guarantees on prediction coverage and often require additional calibra- tion techniques to improve reliability. In contrast, conformal prediction (region prediction) offers a principled alternative by generating prediction sets with finite- sample validity guarantees, ensuring that the ground truth is contained within the set at a specified confidence level. In this study, we explore the impact of pre-training approach, dataset scale and domain on both point and region-level uncertainty quantification, by studying domain-specific vision medical foundation models vs. general domain vision foundation models. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation across foundation models trained on retinal, histopathological, and Chest X-Rays data, applying various calibration techniques. Our results demonstrate that (1) pre-training on higher-quality domain-specific datasets along with self-supervised learning leads to better-calibrated point predictions than general domain pre-training, (2) stan- dard re-calibration methods alone cannot fully mitigate uncertainty discrepancies across models trained on different data sources, (3) domain-specific foundation model can lead to more efficient conformal prediction. These findings highlight the importance of careful model selection and the inte- gration of both point and region prediction to enhance the reliability and trust- worthiness of medical AI systems. Our work underscores the need for a holistic approach to uncertainty quantification in recent development of medical vision foundation model, ensuring robust and interpretable AI-driven decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了医学视觉基础模型中的不确定性量化，对比领域特异与通用领域预训练，涵盖视网膜、病理和胸片数据，并结合校准技术与保形预测，发现领域特异预训练（结合自监督学习）能带来更优校准的点预测和更高效的保形预测集，主张将点预测与区域预测整合以提升医学AI可靠性。
AI.motivation: 高 stakes 医学场景中，传统基于点预测的概率输出缺乏覆盖率的正式保证，且常需额外校准；而保形预测能以有限样本有效性保证预测集覆盖。作者希望厘清预训练方式、数据集规模与领域对点级和区域级不确定性量化的影响，以指导医学视觉基础模型的选型。
AI.method: 针对分别训练于视网膜、组织病理和胸部X光数据的领域特异医学基础模型与通用领域视觉基础模型，开展全面评估；在点预测层面应用多种再校准技术，在区域预测层面采用保形预测，从而对比不同预训练来源和数据规模下的不确定性量化性能。
AI.result: (1) 在更高质量的领域特异数据上配合自监督学习预训练，其点预测校准优于通用领域预训练；(2) 标准再校准方法无法完全消除不同数据源训练模型间的校准差距；(3) 领域特异基础模型可生成更高效（更紧凑）的保形预测集。同时领域、数据尺度和预训练策略对两类不确定性量化均有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择至关重要，应将点预测与区域预测（保形预测）相结合，采取整体性视角进行不确定性量化，以增强医学AI系统的可靠性与可信度，并推动可解释、稳健的医学AI决策。

title: Balance of Benchmarks: Semantic Density Reweighting for Benchmark Multiplicity and Task-Conditioned Evaluation
summary: Language models are commonly compared by averaging scores across a benchmark list with equal weight. Such lists grow through publication outside an explicit measurement design, so equal weighting turns the density of published benchmarks into an implicit capability weight: densely benchmarked regions count repeatedly. We introduce Balance of Benchmarks (BoB), which embeds benchmark descriptions and assigns each benchmark an inverse-density semantic weight. Nearby entries share aggregate influence at a disclosed density scale. After equating heterogeneous scores onto a common latent scale, a residual field uses the same geometry to condition model rankings on a task query. The two components serve distinct empirical roles. On a snapshot of 586 models and 14 benchmarks, BoB predicts which models are unusually strong on a held-out task beyond their general ability, reaching a profile correlation of 0.462 compared with 0.049 under equal weighting. It also limits the influence of densely repeated benchmarks on the aggregate. After adding four copies of each benchmark in turn, the resulting rankings retain a Kendall tau of 0.995, compared with 0.936 under equal weighting. The residual field therefore provides task-conditioned prediction, and inverse-density weighting provides robustness to benchmark multiplicity. Together, they turn benchmark-list composition from an incidental property of evaluation suites into an explicit, controllable part of measurement design, providing a principled foundation for task-aware and multiplicity-robust model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Balance of Benchmarks (BoB)，一种将基准测试列表从隐式能力权重转化为显式、可控的测量设计组成部分的框架。BoB 对基准描述进行嵌入，赋予每个基准一个与密度成反比的语义权重，并将异质分数等化到共同的潜在尺度上，再利用同一几何结构通过残差场对任务查询进行条件化的模型排名预测。在 586 个模型和 14 个基准的实验中，BoB 在留出任务上的画像相关性达 0.462（等权仅 0.049），且在基准复制鲁棒性上 Kendall tau 达 0.995（等权为 0.936）。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型评测通常对基准列表取等权平均，但基准列表是通过出版过程不断累积的，缺乏明确的测量设计，导致等权加权把已发布基准的密度转化为隐式的能力权重——密度高的基准区域被反复计入，偏差了整体评估。因此需要一种能显式控制基准组成、并对任务有感知、对基准重复鲁棒的评测方法。
AI.method: BoB 包含两个核心组件：(1) 通过嵌入基准描述，给每个基准分配一个与语义密度成反比的权重，使得相近条目在公开的密度尺度下共享聚合影响力，从而实现反密度加权；(2) 将异质分数等化到共同的潜在量表后，利用残差场（residual field）借用相同几何结构，根据任务查询对模型排名进行条件化预测，识别模型在特定任务上超出其一般能力之外的强弱表现。
AI.result: 在包含 586 个模型和 14 个基准的快照上：BoB 预测模型在留出任务上的异常强弱画像相关性达 0.462，而等权加权仅为 0.049；在逐个向每个基准加入四份副本后，BoB 的排名 Kendall tau 保持 0.995，等权加权仅为 0.936。结果表明残差场提供了任务条件化预测能力，反密度加权提供了对基准多重性的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: BoB 将基准列表的组成从评测套件的偶然属性转变为测量设计中显式、可控的部分，为任务感知和多重性鲁棒的模型评估提供了原则性基础。两个组件各有分工：残差场负责任务条件化预测，反密度权重负责抵御基准密度失衡。

title: MedSegBenchmarker: A Raw-Count-First Framework for Controlled 2D Medical Image Segmentation Benchmarks
summary: Despite rapid advances in MIS, fair and reproducible comparisons of segmentation models remain challenging due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and rapidly evolving architectures. In particular, comparisons often implicitly assume that model rankings are invariant to data partitioning, preprocessing, metric aggregation, uncertainty estimation, and computational constraints. The lack of extensible and unified evaluation frameworks further limits systematic investigation of new models, datasets, and training paradigms. We present MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB), a configuration-driven framework for controlled benchmarking of 2D MIS. It integrates duplicate and near-duplicate image detection, group-aware data splitting, YAML study specifications, resumable training, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and checkpoint-based evaluation. Rather than retaining only aggregate performance measures, MSB exports sample- and class-level pixel counts and predictions together with the evaluation context. These elementary artifacts enable post-hoc analyses without repeated inference. We demonstrate MSB in a case study involving three heterogeneous 2D datasets and multiple MIS and general-purpose vision models evaluated at 256- and 512-pixel input resolutions. Reaggregation of identical predictions changes the top-ranked architecture in three of six dataset-resolution settings, despite high rank correlations between aggregation strategies. Increasing input resolution produces model- and dataset-dependent performance gains and losses that must be considered alongside empirically measured inference complexity. These results show that seemingly minor choices in evaluation and experimental setup can affect benchmark conclusions. MSB, available at GitHub, provides a practical and extensible basis for making benchmark conditions and evaluation choices explicit and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB)，一个配置驱动的2D医学图像分割（MIS）受控基准测试框架，集成了重复图像检测、分组感知数据划分、YAML研究配置、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和基于检查点的评估。MSB导出样本级和类别级的像素计数与预测结果及其评估上下文，支持无需重复推理的事后分析。在三个异构2D数据集上的案例研究表明：在六个数据集-分辨率设置中，对相同预测重新聚合会使三个设置的排名第一架构发生变化；提高输入分辨率会产生与模型和数据集相关的性能增减，必须结合实测推理复杂度一起考虑。结果显示评估和实验设置中看似微小的选择会影响基准结论，而MSB为明确、可复现的基准条件提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.motivation: 尽管MIS发展迅速，但由于数据集异构、评估协议不一致以及架构快速演进，分割模型的公平且可复现的比较仍具挑战性。比较往往隐含假设模型排名对数据划分、预处理、指标聚合、不确定性估计和算力约束具有不变性。缺乏可扩展且统一的评估框架进一步限制了对新模型、新数据集和训练范式的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出MSB，一个配置驱动的2D MIS受控基准测试框架。它集成了重复及近似重复图像检测、分组感知数据划分、YAML实验规格说明、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和基于检查点的评估。与仅保留聚合性能指标不同，MSB导出样本级和类别级的像素计数与预测结果，以及相应评估上下文，从而支持无需重复推理的事后分析。通过一个包含三个异构2D数据集、多种MIS与通用视觉模型、在256和512像素输入分辨率下评估的案例研究进行验证。
AI.result: 案例研究表明：在六个数据集-分辨率设置中，对相同预测结果进行重新聚合会改变其中三个设置的排名第一架构，尽管各聚合策略之间秩相关性很高；提高输入分辨率会产生模型和数据集相关的性能增益与损失，必须与实测推理复杂度一并考虑。这说明评估和实验设置中看似微小的选择可能影响基准结论。
AI.conclusion: 评估协议中看似次要的选择会对基准排序结论产生实质影响，因此必须将其显式化和可复现化。MSB（在GitHub上开源）为显式、可复现地记录基准条件和评估选择提供了实用且可扩展的基础，有助于推动MIS领域更公平、更可信的模型比较。

title: "Act Like a 5th Grader" is Not Enough: Bounding Knowledge in LLM-Based User Simulators
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior but frequently fail to exhibit realistic cognitive constraints, suffering from a "superhuman bias." Using a dataset of over 71,000 reading comprehension responses from 2,359 primary-school students (grades 4--6), we demonstrate that standard persona prompting yields near-perfect, deterministic performance, failing to capture the natural variance of developing readers. To address this, we introduce the Cognitively Bounded User Simulator (CBUS), an architectural framework that explicitly models the restricted working memory of young readers through an episodic bottleneck. Within this framework, we formalize two distinct test-taking strategies to emulate different reading behaviors. Our evaluation shows that explicitly modeling cognitive bounds significantly narrows the simulation gap across multiple LLM backbones, demonstrating that enforcing architectural constraints is more effective for high-fidelity simulation than simply scaling raw model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在模拟人类行为时的"超人偏差"问题，基于71,000余条小学生阅读理解作答数据，提出认知受限用户模拟器（CBUS），通过显式建模儿童读者的工作记忆限制（情景瓶颈）与两种应试策略，显著缩小了不同LLM骨干上的模拟差距，证明架构性约束比单纯扩展模型规模更能实现高保真行为模拟。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用于模拟人类行为，但容易出现"超人偏差"，即表现出不切实际的认知能力，无法捕捉真实人类（尤其是处于发展阶段的年幼读者）作答中的自然变异。标准persona提示得到的作答近乎完美且确定，与真实小学生（4-6年级）的阅读行为存在明显差距，因此需要显式建模认知约束以提升模拟保真度。
AI.method: 提出Cognitively Bounded User Simulator（CBUS）框架，通过情景瓶颈（episodic bottleneck）显式建模年幼读者的受限工作记忆。在该架构内形式化两种不同的应试策略以模拟不同阅读行为，并在多个LLM骨干上评估该框架的效果。
AI.result: 基于2,359名小学生（4-6年级）71,000余条阅读理解作答数据进行评估，结果表明显式建模认知约束能在多个LLM骨干上显著缩小模拟差距，即架构性约束比单纯扩大原始模型能力对高保真模拟更有效。
AI.conclusion: 在人类行为模拟中，强制施加架构性认知约束（如CBUS中的工作记忆瓶颈）比单纯提升模型规模更能实现高保真、贴近真实分布的模拟，为LLM作为人类模拟器的可靠使用提供了新的设计思路。

title: Foundation Models Meet Agriculture: Challenges Beyond Pretraining
summary: Global food security and sustainable climate action increasingly rely on robust, scalable agricultural monitoring. Earth observation foundation models have emerged as powerful, label-efficient tools across general remote sensing domains, yet early attempts to deploy them for agricultural applications have yielded surprisingly poor results. We hypothesize that this performance gap stems from the extreme heterogeneity of agricultural landscapes and the inherent inability of current earth observation foundation models to adapt to task-specific nuances. In this work, we systematically evaluate two critical bottlenecks hindering the deployment of foundation models in agricultural tasks, benchmarking two earth observation foundation models, a foundation model designed for tabular data, and conventional supervised baselines across seven real-world agricultural datasets spanning yield prediction, phenology estimation, and crop classification. First, we identify a pretraining-deployment modality gap: agricultural downstream tasks frequently require diverse, non-imagery data modalities that earth observation foundation models are architecturally unequipped to ingest, while a foundation model built for tabular data handles this heterogeneity more naturally. Second, we formalize the agricultural task space across five structural axes to demonstrate why current models fail to generalize reliably, resulting in highly unstable model rankings across evaluation settings. By characterizing these structural and modal gaps, our insights highlight the friction between general-purpose architectures and specialized agricultural downstream data, providing a strategic roadmap for developing the next generation of domain-aware foundation models.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了地球观测基础模型在农业任务中表现不佳的根本原因，识别出两大瓶颈：预训练-部署模态鸿沟（农业任务需要非影像数据模态，而EO基础模型架构无法处理）和农业任务空间的结构性不稳定性（模型排名在不同评测设定下高度不稳定），并据此提出面向领域感知基础模型的发展路线图。
AI.motivation: 全球粮食安全和可持续气候行动依赖于稳健、可扩展的农业监测。地球观测（EO）基础模型虽在通用遥感领域展现出强大且标签高效的能力，但在农业应用中早期尝试却表现不佳。作者假设该性能差距源于农业景观的极端异质性以及现有EO基础模型无法适应任务特定细节的能力缺陷，因此亟需系统性识别并诊断阻碍基础模型在农业任务中部署的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者系统性地评估了阻碍基础模型用于农业任务的两个关键瓶颈。实验设计包括：对两个地球观测基础模型、一个面向表格数据的基础模型以及常规监督基线进行基准评测；覆盖七个真实农业数据集，涉及产量预测、物候估计和作物分类三类任务。具体地：(1) 识别了预训练-部署模态鸿沟，即农业下游任务常需要多样化的非影像数据模态，而EO基础模型在架构上无法处理这些输入，相比之下面向表格数据的基础模型能更自然地处理这种异质性；(2) 从五个结构轴形式化定义了农业任务空间，用以阐明当前模型为何无法可靠泛化，导致跨评测设定下模型排名高度不稳定。
AI.result: 研究表明，EO基础模型在农业任务中的失败并非简单的精度不足，而是源于结构性缺陷：一是模态鸿沟问题，EO基础模型架构上无法摄取农业任务所需的多样化非影像数据；二是任务空间不稳定性问题，模型排名在七个数据集及不同评测设定间高度不稳定，无法可靠泛化。表格数据基础模型在应对数据异质性方面表现更自然，进一步印证了模态适配的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对结构与模态双重差距的表征，论文揭示了通用架构与专业化农业下游数据之间的摩擦，为开发下一代领域感知基础模型提供了战略性路线图，强调未来农业基础模型应具备多模态数据摄取能力，并针对农业任务空间的结构特性进行专门设计。

title: Can LLM Agents Discover? Evaluating Creativity on ML Engineering Tasks
summary: Recent AI systems promise autonomous scientific discovery, claiming to discover algorithms and produce research papers, yet understanding whether they exhibit creativity, the capacity to produce solutions that are both novel and useful, remains an open question. We present a framework for evaluating multi-turn LLM research agents' creativity using ML engineering tasks as a testbed, through three dimensions: P-Creativity (psychological novelty: novel relative to the agent's own prior solutions within a run), H-Creativity (historical novelty: novel relative to the corpus of human solutions), and Usefulness (task performance). Evaluating two agent frameworks, AIDE and AIRA-Dojo, on 10 Kaggle-style machine learning tasks from MLE-Bench, we develop an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline and verify its strong correlation with human creativity judgments, providing a reliable automated metric for P-Creativity evaluation at scale. Applying this pipeline to agent trajectories, we find: (1) all agents exhibit declining P-Creativity as they transition from exploration to exploitation; (2) LLMs exhibit greater H-Creativity than medal-winning humans, yet achieve lower performance. Our findings reveal that current agents can explore novel regions of the solution space but lack the capacity to convert this novelty into improved task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估多轮LLM研究智能体创造力的框架，以机器学习工程任务为测试平台，从P-创造力（个体新颖性）、H-创造力（历史新颖性）和有用性（任务性能）三个维度进行衡量。基于MLE-Bench的10个Kaggle式任务评估AIDE和AIRA-Dojo两个智能体框架，并开发了与人类创造力判断高度相关的LLM-as-a-Judge流水线。研究发现：所有智能体在从探索转向利用阶段时P-创造力下降；LLM的H-创造力高于获奖人类但性能更低，表明当前智能体能探索解空间的新区域，却无法将新颖性转化为任务性能提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管近期AI系统声称能够实现自主科学发现（如发现算法、撰写论文），但其是否真正具备创造力——即产出既新颖又有用的解决方案的能力——仍是一个开放问题。现有研究缺乏系统化的框架来评估多轮LLM研究智能体的创造力，因此需要一种可靠、可扩展的评测方法。
AI.method: 以ML工程任务（MLE-Bench中的10个Kaggle式任务）为测试平台，构建三维度评估框架：P-创造力（相对智能体自身运行内先前解决方案的心理新颖性）、H-创造力（相对人类解决方案语料的历史新颖性）和有用性（任务性能）。评估AIDE与AIRA-Dojo两个智能体框架，并开发LLM-as-a-Judge流水线，通过验证其与人类创造力判断的强相关性来确保评测自动化与可靠性。
AI.result: （1）所有智能体在从探索阶段转向利用阶段时均表现出P-创造力的持续下降；（2）LLM智能体展现出比获奖人类更高的H-创造力，但任务性能更低。总体表明当前智能体能够探索解空间中的人类未见区域，却缺乏将这种新颖性转化为任务性能提升的能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前LLM研究智能体在创造力上的关键局限：尽管它们具备探索新颖解的能力（高H-创造力），但创造力与实用性之间存在脱节，无法将新颖性有效转化为更好任务表现；同时智能体在运行后期倾向于过早收敛到利用模式，造成P-创造力衰退。这为未来提升AI科学发现智能体"既新颖又有用"的创造力指明了改进方向。

title: GeoRay: Gauge-Aware Feed-Forward Satellite 3D Reconstruction in the Geodetic Frame
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct perspective scenes in one pass. Satellite photogrammetry needs a different product, one that domain adaptation alone does not deliver: dense surface height in an absolute geodetic frame under non-central rational polynomial cameras (RPCs). Perspective-pretrained features are not reliably observable along RPC height rays, absolute elevation carries a low-order height--datum gauge exchangeable with sensor bias to first order, and monocular and multi-view cues fail in different regions. \method{} treats all three. Lightweight ray-consistent adapters make a frozen backbone matchable along native RPC rays. An explicit datum mechanism separates relief from absolute level and is equivariant to the vertical origin by construction, so one trained model serves zero-, one-, and sparse-control inference. Calibrated inverse-variance fusion combines the two relief streams. \bench{}, our absolute-frame benchmark of eighteen systems across in-domain, cross-dataset, and cross-city tiers, scores absolute placement without registration or test-reference leakage. On 26 held-out US3D tiles, \method{} attains $2.99$\,m absolute MAE at $91.9\%$ coverage, improves completeness-aware accuracy by $46.4$ points over the strongest compliant feed-forward baseline, remains the most accurate such system under both transfer shifts, and runs in $24$\,s model-forward time per tile. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/HIT-SIRS/GeoRay

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoRay，一种面向卫星摄影测量的前馈三维重建方法：通过轻量级光线一致适配器将冻结的透视预训练骨干特征对齐到非中心RPC本征光线，引入显式基准机制将地形起伏与绝对高程解耦并对垂直原点等变（一套模型同时支持零、一、稀疏控制点推理），并用校准的逆方差融合整合单目与多视角两条起伏流；同时在所提出的绝对坐标系基准GeoBench（18个系统、域内/跨数据集/跨城市三档）上，于26个US3D保留tile上达到2.99 m绝对MAE、91.9%覆盖率，完整性感知精度较最强合规前馈基线提升46.4个百分点，且在下游迁移中仍保持最优。
AI.motivation: 前馈三维基础模型针对透视相机场景单次重建，但卫星摄影测量需要不同的产物：在非中心理性多项式相机（RPC）下重建绝对大地坐标系的稠密地表高程。作者指出三个核心障碍：透视预训练特征在RPC高度射线上不可靠、绝对高程存在与传感器偏差一阶可交换的低阶高程-基准规范自由度（datum gauge）、单目与多视角线索在不同区域各自失效——仅靠域自适应无法解决这些根本问题。
AI.method: 方法（GeoRay）三管齐下：(1) 轻量光线一致适配器使冻结骨干的特征沿原生RPC射线可匹配；(2) 显式基准机制将地形起伏与绝对高程分离，按构造对垂直原点等变，因而单一训练模型可同时服务零、一、稀疏控制点推理；(3) 校准的逆方差融合将单目与多视角两条起伏流结合。同时构建绝对坐标系评测基准GeoBench，包含18个系统、域内/跨数据集/跨城市三档，在无需配准或测试参考泄漏的情况下评估绝对位置精度。
AI.result: 在26个保留的US3D tile上，GeoRay达到2.99 m绝对MAE、91.9%覆盖率，在完整性感知精度上比最强合规前馈基线提升46.4个百分点；在两种迁移偏移（跨数据集、跨城市）下仍是最准确的前馈系统；每个tile模型前向推理仅需24秒。代码与模型将开源。
AI.conclusion: 在绝对大地框架下进行卫星高程重建需要超越透视基准模型与域自适应的专门设计：利用原生RPC射线对齐的适配器、与垂直基准等变的显式datum机制以及校准的逆方差融合，可以在不损失通用前馈效率的前提下，显著超越合规前馈基线并获得可靠的绝对高程精度，且具备跨数据集与跨城市的泛化能力。

title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
comment: We introduce Pak3H, a human-validated Urdu benchmark for helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty. Zero-shot evaluations show LLM performance degrades across all three dimensions in low-resourced contextualized settings
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H) alignment in English-centric settings, but these gains transfer poorly to low-resource languages due to cultural mismatches. Existing multilingual 3H benchmarks rely predominantly on automated translation or LLM based synthesis, propagating source-language biases while sacrificing local relevance. To address this gap, we introduce Pak3H1, the first human-validated, culturally contextualized Urdu benchmark suite for 3H alignment, comprising PakAlpaca (helpfulness), PakBeaverTails (harmlessness), and PakTruthfulQA (honesty). Our multi-stage pipeline integrates manual cultural adaptation and dictionary-guided post editing to prioritize native speaker judgment, ensuring both semantic fidelity and contextual authenticity. Zero-shot evaluations across multiple open and proprietary LLM architectures reveal systematic cross-lingual alignment gaps: helpfulness win rates decline under localized contexts, harmlessness guardrails break down against regional safety risks, and composite honesty metrics degrade substantially due to localized factual constraints. These findings expose structural limitations in current alignment approaches, underscoring the necessity of human-guided localization for equitable multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Pak3H1——首个经人工验证、具有文化语境化的乌尔都语 3H（有用性、无害性、诚实性）对齐基准套件，包含 PakAlpaca、PakBeaverTails 和 PakTruthfulQA 三个子基准。通过人工文化改编与词典引导的后编辑流水线，零样本评测发现多种 LLM 在乌尔都语语境下存在系统性跨语言对齐缺陷，凸显了人工引导本地化对公平多语评测的必要性。
AI.motivation: LLM 在英语中心化场景下展现出较强的 3H 对齐能力，但这些优势难以迁移到低资源语言，且存在文化错配。现有多语 3H 基准多依赖自动翻译或 LLM 合成，既传播源语言偏见又牺牲本地相关性，导致低资源语言的对齐评估失真。
AI.method: 构建了包含人工文化改编（manual cultural adaptation）和词典引导后编辑（dictionary-guided post editing）的多阶段流水线，以母语者判断为核心，兼顾语义保真度与语境真实性；并基于此构建 Pak3H1 套件，涵盖有用性（PakAlpaca）、无害性（PakBeaverTails）和诚实性（PakTruthfulQA）三个维度，随后对多种开源与专有 LLM 架构开展零样本评测。
AI.result: 零样本评测揭示系统性跨语言对齐缺口：本地化语境下有用性胜率下降；针对区域安全风险的无害性护栏失效；受本地化事实约束影响，综合诚实性指标明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 当前对齐方法在文化与语言适配方面存在结构性缺陷，仅靠翻译或合成式基准无法充分保障低资源语言的安全与效用；必须引入人工引导的本地化流程，才能实现公平、可靠的多语对齐评测。

title: TopGQ: Fast GNN Post-Training Quantization Leveraging Topology Information
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
summary: Existing GNN quantization methods suffer from considerable quantization overhead, which severely limits their practical usage in real-world scenarios. To this end, we present TopGQ, an accurate post-training GNN quantization framework, alleviating redundant quantization overhead. We propose dual-axis scale absorption, which enables activation quantization along both the outer and inner dimensions by merging one into the adjacency matrix. On top of that, we introduce TopPIN, a proxy for nodes' local structure, and use it to group nodes with similar topology during quantization. Experimental results show that TopGQ reduces quantization time by an order of magnitude while preserving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopGQ，一个针对图神经网络的准确后训练量化框架，通过双轴尺度吸收实现激活量化的快速处理，并引入 TopPIN 结构代理按局部拓扑对节点分组，在将量化时间降低一个数量级的同时保持精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 GNN 量化方法存在严重的量化开销，极大限制了其在真实场景中的实际应用。因此需要一种能够降低冗余量化开销、同时保持准确率的后训练量化方案。
AI.method: 提出 TopGQ 后训练量化框架，包含两个关键技术：一是双轴尺度吸收（dual-axis scale absorption），通过将激活量化尺度合并到邻接矩阵中，从而在外部与内部两个维度上实现激活量化；二是 TopPIN，即节点局部结构的代理指标，在量化过程中依据该指标将拓扑结构相似的节点进行分组。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TopGQ 在保持准确率的前提下，将量化时间降低了一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: TopGQ 通过消除冗余量化开销，在保证 GNN 量化精度的同时显著加速量化过程，为 GNN 模型在真实场景中的高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Spec2Twin-Chain: Orchestrating Bi-Level Optimization with LLMs for Blockchain Digital Twin Construction
summary: Building a blockchain digital twin largely requires translating domain knowledge and specific system descriptions into a simulator architecture, calibrating its parameters against behavioral evidence, and validating the constructed twin. These steps are commonly performed through application-specific modeling efforts that can be difficult to reuse across systems and downstream decision problems. We consider automating this process through Spec2Twin-Chain, a framework that formulates blockchain digital-twin construction as a bi-level optimization problem. At the upper level, a large language model proposes and revises structurally admissible architectures using system specifications, behavioral evidence, and feedback from evaluated designs. At the lower level, a simulation-based optimizer calibrates the architecture-conditioned parameters under explicit objectives and guardrail constraints. The two levels iterate. The evaluated candidates at lower levels are retained in a global archive and used to guide subsequent proposals at upper levels. We conduct controlled experiments involving twin calibration, feedback-driven recovery, stress analysis, downstream policy optimization, and policy updating. The results demonstrate that the framework can construct behaviorally accurate twins, improve initial designs through iterative feedback, and reuse calibrated twins to support downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Spec2Twin-Chain 框架，将区块链数字孪生构建形式化为双层优化问题：上层由大语言模型依据系统规格与行为证据提出并修订架构，下层由基于仿真的优化器校准参数，两层迭代并借助全局档案复用候选设计，从而自动化构建可供下游决策复用的数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 构建区块链数字孪生通常需要将领域知识和具体系统描述转化为仿真器架构、依据行为证据校准参数并验证孪生，而这些环节常依赖特定应用的人工建模，难以在不同系统与下游决策问题之间复用，因此希望将该过程自动化。
AI.method: 提出 Spec2Twin-Chain 框架，将数字孪生构建建模为双层优化问题。上层由大语言模型依据系统规格、行为证据和已评估设计的反馈，提出并修订结构上可行的架构；下层由基于仿真的优化器在显式目标与护栏约束下，对架构条件化的参数进行校准。两层不断迭代，下层评估得到的候选方案被保留在全局档案中，用于引导上层的后续提案。
AI.result: 在孪生校准、反馈驱动的恢复、压力分析、下游策略优化与策略更新等受控实验中，该框架能够构建行为准确的孪生模型，通过迭代反馈改进初始设计，并复用已校准的孪生支持下游决策。
AI.conclusion: Spec2Twin-Chain 证明可以自动化区块链数字孪生的构建与校准流程，生成的孪生不仅行为准确、可随反馈迭代改进，还能被复用支撑下游决策，从而提升建模过程的通用性与可复用性。

title: A Calibration Audit of Confidence in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models emit a per-pixel confidence that downstream systems read as a reliability signal. It is trained as a loss weight, not as an uncertainty magnitude, and whether it can be used as an error prediction has not been measured. We audit seven released backbones on thirteen datasets and score the confidence on four properties, how well it ranks error, whether its level is right on average, whether it holds across the confidence range, and whether its intervals cover the truth. The confidence ranks error well, but the predicted uncertainty is too low when it is read under conditions that are not exactly those of training. The median case is off by 2.4x across all seven models, and the error prediction is further off the more confident the model is. We show that this phenomenon can appear even though the loss's optimum is reached. A released model resumed under its own loss reaches that optimum on its training data within a few hundred updates and stays overconfident on unseen frames. A power law with two constants per backbone and dataset corrects the overall magnitude of the predicted uncertainty and leaves the ranking untouched. What no rescaling reaches is the scene, which we attribute to the model's missing knowledge of scale across predictions. Every correction we tried is close to right on average and still leaves two thirds of held-out scenes outside a five-point band, because what a scene is missing is a shape rather than a shift. We release the audit protocol, its results, and the fitted constants per model and dataset. Fitted with the target dataset held out, the constants bring the median case from 2.4x off to 1.35x, and a refit on a few labelled scenes of that dataset reaches 1.12x.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了七个前馈3D重建骨干网络在十三个数据集上的逐像素置信度，发现其误差排序能力良好，但置信度大小被系统性低估（中位数偏差2.4倍），且模型越自信偏差越大。作者提出每个骨干和数据集带两个常数的幂律校准以修正量级，但无法修复场景级误差，因为场景欠缺的是形状而非平移。他们公开了审计协议与拟合常数，可在保留排序的同时将中位偏差降至1.35x（重拟合后1.12x）。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型输出的逐像素置信度被下游系统当作可靠性信号阅读，但它实际是作为损失权重训练的，而非不确定性量级；其能否用作误差预测从未被量化衡量。作者通过大规模审计填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对七个已发布骨干网络在十三个数据集上进行审计，从四个性质打分：误差排序质量、平均量级正确性、跨置信度区间的稳定性、区间对真实值的覆盖率。采用每骨干、每数据集带两个常数的幂律校准来修正不确定性量级，并尝试多种重缩放以修复场景级误差；最后在目标数据集排除在外的条件下拟合常数，或在目标数据集少量标注场景上重拟合。
AI.result: 置信度的误差排序表现良好，但在非训练条件下预测的不确定性系统性偏低，七个模型的中位偏差为2.4倍，且模型越自信误差预测偏差越大。该现象在损失达到最优时仍可出现。幂律校准可修正整体量级且不改变排序，但任何重缩放都无法修复场景级偏差——平均上接近正确，仍有三分之二留出场景落在五点带之外。排除目标数据集拟合时中位偏差从2.4x降至1.35x，在少量标注场景重拟合后达1.12x。
AI.conclusion: 前馈3D重建模型的置信度适合作为相对可靠性排序信号，但不能直接作为绝对不确定性量级；需要按模型和数据集校准。量级/场景的偏差源于模型缺乏跨预测的尺度知识，属于形状性缺失而非平移性偏差，故简单重缩放无法彻底解决。作者公开审计协议、结果与拟合常数以支持后续研究。

title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
summary: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在单张NVIDIA GPU上部署70B参数大语言模型的问题，将其建模为一个在内存、长上下文吞吐和工程集成成本三个维度上的预算感知设计问题，系统探究了剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩之间的相互作用，并据此构建了一套实用流水线，将70B模型压缩至约33GB，在单张A40上实现10k token提示下约57 tokens/s的推理速度，同时将绝对精度损失控制在5%以内。
AI.motivation: 在单张GPU上部署70B参数大语言模型面临设备内存不足、长上下文吞吐受限以及工程集成成本高等多重约束，现有方法往往孤立地看待剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩，缺乏对三者协同作用的系统理解和可复现的评估协议，因此需要将单卡推理形式化为预算感知的设计问题，并研究各压缩手段在真实执行条件下的交互关系。
AI.method: 作者首先将单GPU推理建模为内存、长上下文吞吐和集成成本三个轴上的预算感知设计问题；随后通过受控消融实验系统研究剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩的组合效应，揭示层间剪枝提升权重量化鲁棒性、KV缓存稀疏化与INT8 KV量化互补等耦合规律；最后依据这些规律并借助显式预算跟踪组装出实用流水线，并提供了联合报告质量、内存和端到端速度的可复现评估协议。
AI.result: 所构建的流水线将70B模型压缩至约33GB，在单张A40 GPU上、10k token长提示条件下达到约57 tokens/s的持续吞吐，且在常见和推理基准上的绝对精度保持在5%以内；同时发现静态向量量化器与动态缓存存在冲突，KV缓存稀疏化在不损失解码速度的前提下减少内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 本文总结出面向单GPU70B模型部署的设计规则与可复现评估协议，证明多种压缩技术可以在真实执行条件下有效耦合以同时满足内存、速度和精度约束，并为未来在真实单卡约束下进行自动化流水线搜索奠定了坚实基础。

title: Locally-Guided Actor-Critic: Training a Goal-conditioned Actor with a Subgoal-aware Critic
summary: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning struggles with long horizons when rewards are sparse. While a planner can provide subgoals to guide a low-level policy, its use at test time may introduce practical subgoal management difficulties. An alternative paradigm utilizes a high-level planner to assist learning, while the policy remains conditioned only on the final goal, enabling planner-free deployment. Among these methods, Reinforcement Learning with Imagined Subgoals (RIS) introduces a regularization term that encourages the policy to take the same actions for the final goal as it does for an intermediate goal. This regularization, however, may lead to goal-chaining issues when intermediate goals are low-dimensional. Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) translates plans into an additional reward while ensuring that the optimal policy remains unchanged. Yet, it can generate deceptive rewards in terminal states. We study these failure cases and first propose an alternative reward shaping method (RS) that removes these deceptive rewards at the expense of theoretical guarantees of PBRS. Similar to this RS variant, we then propose another method named Locally-Guided Actor Critic (LG-AC) that rewards the agent for reaching intermediate goals. Unlike RS, where intermediate rewards are implicit in the shaping signal, we explicitly condition a value estimator on the full sequence of intermediate goals but represent the value function as a sum of subgoal-conditioned value functions, enabling dense hindsight relabeling. We evaluate all these methods in tasks with challenging goal-chaining requirements and empirically highlight specific cases in which either action regularization or reward shaping yield low performance, while LG-AC achieves the best overall performance across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于目标的强化学习在稀疏奖励长时程任务中的问题，指出RIS的动作正则化会导致目标链失效，而基于势能的奖励塑形（PBRS）可能在终止状态产生欺骗性奖励。作者先提出一种去除欺骗性奖励的奖励塑形方法（RS，但牺牲了PBRS的理论保证），再进一步提出LG-AC方法：显式地用完整中间目标序列条件化一个值估计器，但将值函数表示为子目标条件值函数之和，从而实现密集的后验重标注。实验表明在具有挑战性目标链需求的任务中，动作正则化或奖励塑形在某些情形下性能低下，而LG-AC整体性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 基于目标的强化学习在稀疏奖励与长时程条件下难以学习；现有范式有三类问题：1）测试时使用规划器会带来子目标管理的实际困难；2）RIS这类方法通过动作正则化让策略只依赖最终目标，但中间目标维度较低时会发生目标链（goal-chaining）失效问题；3）PBRS虽可保证最优策略不变，但在终止状态可能产生欺骗性奖励。作者希望同时避免这些失败情况。
AI.method: 首先提出一种修正的奖励塑形方法（RS），移除PBRS在终止状态引入的欺骗性奖励，但相应地失去了PBRS的最优策略不变性理论保证。随后提出LG-AC：在训练时以规划器辅助学习但部署时不依赖规划器，将完整的中间目标序列显式条件化于一个值估计器，同时把值函数分解为若干子目标条件值函数之和，从而能够进行密集的后验重标注（hindsight relabeling）并奖励智能体到达中间目标。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性目标链任务上的实验表明：动作正则化（如RIS）或奖励塑形（PBRS/RS）在特定情形下会造成性能低下，而LG-AC在各任务上均取得了最佳的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: LG-AC通过显式建模中间目标序列并分解值函数、结合密集后验重标注，在避免测试时依赖规划器的前提下，解决了RIS的动作正则化目标链失效与PBRS终止状态欺骗性奖励问题，成为整体性能最优的方法；同时指出RS与LG-AC是理解这些失败案例、走向更稳健的规划辅助学习的关键中间方案。

title: Mitigating Over-Optimization in PRM-Guided Search in Mathematical Reasoning by Optimizing the Guide
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) provide dense step-level guidance for search-based reasoning, enabling inference-time compute to be allocated toward promising partial solutions. However, recent evidence suggests that PRM-guided search can over-optimize imperfect process rewards, pruning viable trajectories while expanding spurious ones. In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become more likely to receive spuriously high scores as reasoning depth increase. Therefore, we formulate the PRM-guided search as a robust optimization problem over plausible reward perturbations, termed maximin PRM-guided search, leading to a training-free robust process supervision method that preserves promising alternatives when step-level scores are noisy. Maximin PRM-guided search mitigates this failure mode by reducing sensitivity to over-optimized PRM outliers. Without fine-tuning or online adaptation, maximin search consistently improves the PRM-guided search by 17-35\% on average, outperforming outcome- and step-level baselines in 14 out of 16 settings. Our source code is available at https://github.com/tjoo512/maximin-search.

AI.tldr: 本文指出过程奖励模型（PRM）引导的搜索会因验证器噪声而过度优化，提出了一种无需训练的鲁棒搜索方法——maximin PRM-guided search，在14/16设置中平均提升17-35%。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）能提供密集的步级奖励以引导推理搜索，但近期证据表明PRM引导的搜索会过度优化不完美的过程奖励，剪除可行轨迹同时扩张虚假轨迹。本文从理论上揭示，直接利用PRM分数存在极值效应：随着推理深度增加，不可行前缀更可能获得虚假的高分，因此需要更稳健的搜索策略。
AI.method: 将PRM引导的搜索形式化为对合理奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题，即maximin PRM-guided search（最大最小化搜索），在步级分数有噪声时保留有希望的备选轨迹，从而降低对过度优化的PRM异常值的敏感性；该方法无需微调或在线自适应。
AI.result: 在不进行微调或在线自适应的条件下，maximin搜索在平均上持续改进PRM引导搜索17-35%，并在16个设置中的14个优于结果级和步级基线。
AI.conclusion: maximin PRM-guided search是一种有效且训练自由的鲁棒过程监督方法，通过针对奖励噪声的鲁棒优化显著缓解了PRM引导搜索的过度优化失效模式，且代码已开源。

title: XDG: Accelerated Visual Disambiguation
summary: Visual aliasing, also known as the doppelganger problem, remains a key challenge for structure-from-motion (SfM): visually similar but physically distinct surfaces can produce incorrect image matches and degrade reconstruction quality. Previous work mitigates this issue with geometry-aware foundation-model features, but places a heavy transformer classifier on top of the backbone, making large-scale disambiguation expensive. We introduce XDG, an efficient visual disambiguation model designed for scalable SfM. Our key observation is that a 3D foundation model already performs the cross-view geometric reasoning necessary for visual disambiguation, so doppelganger classification should adapt the backbone representation directly rather than relearn pair reasoning in a separate heavy decoder. XDG fine-tunes Depth Anything 3 with lightweight LoRA adapters and repurposes its camera tokens as compact pair-level classification tokens. A compact MLP head predicts whether a candidate image pair observes the same 3D surface. Extensive experiments show that XDG provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff: it remains competitive with the state-of-the-art disambiguation method across pairwise and reconstruction benchmarks and delivers more than a 3x inference speedup. On individual LaMAR scenes containing thousands of images, XDG saves more than 10 hours of visual disambiguation processing. Code is available at https://github.com/xtcpete/xdg.

AI.tldr: XDG 是一种面向大规模 SfM 的高效视觉消歧模型：通过对 3D 基础模型 Depth Anything 3 进行轻量 LoRA 微调，并将其相机 token 复用为成对分类 token，配合紧凑 MLP 头完成全局歧义判断，在保持与 SOTA 相当的消歧精度下实现了 3 倍以上推理加速，并在大规模场景中节省大量处理时间。
AI.motivation: 视觉混叠（即"分身问题"）会使结构从运动（SfM）中产生错误的图像匹配并降低重建质量。先前方法虽利用几何感知的基础模型特征，但需在骨干网络上堆叠重型 transformer 分类器，导致大规模消歧成本高昂。
AI.method: 核心观察是 3D 基础模型本身已具备跨视角几何推理能力，因此消歧分类应直接适配骨干表征，而非在独立的重解码器中重新学习成对推理。XDG 使用轻量 LoRA 适配器微调 Depth Anything 3，将其相机 token 重新用作紧凑的成对分类 token，由一个紧凑 MLP 头预测候选图像对是否观测到同一 3D 表面。
AI.result: 在成对匹配与重建基准上，XDG 与最先进的消歧方法精度相当，同时推理速度提升超过 3 倍；在包含数千张图像的 LaMAR 场景中，单个场景即可节省超过 10 小时的视觉消歧处理时间。
AI.conclusion: XDG 在精度与效率之间取得了良好权衡，证明利用 3D 基础模型内建的跨视图几何推理并配以轻量适配，是替代重型消歧分类器的有效方案，可实现大规模、可扩展的 SfM 视觉消歧。

title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
summary: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将拟合分类器与大语言模型（LLM）结合用于信用违约预测，区分了"让LLM模仿分类器"与"用分类器构建提示"两种方式。实验表明，仅靠少样本LLM虽召回率和F1最高但排序能力弱于随机森林；将分类器预测概率加入提示可将LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72提升至0.78（匹配随机森林），同时保持更高召回率，而提示剪枝、反向组合及多分类器均无额外收益。最终推荐简单的分类器引导提示方案。
AI.motivation: 信用违约预测是金融决策中的重要任务，传统方法在表格特征上使用逻辑回归、随机森林等拟合分类器，而LLM近年开始通过提示(prompting)用于该任务。作者希望研究拟合分类器与LLM如何有效结合，并假设拟合分类器能提供LLM提示所缺乏的排序(ranking)能力，弥补单靠LLM提示的不足。
AI.method: 在Default of Credit Card Clients数据集上开展实验，区分两种组合方式：让LLM模仿分类器输出，以及用分类器来构建提示内容。评价指标包括召回率、F1、ROC曲线下面积（AUC-ROC）和PR曲线下面积（AUC-PRC），并给出bootstrap置信区间。比较了少样本LLM、随机森林、提示剪枝为分类器最重要的8个特征、将分类器预测概率加入提示、反向互补组合以及使用多种分类器等多种方案。
AI.result: 少样本LLM在单一模型中具有最高召回率（0.47）和F1（0.50），但排序能力逊于随机森林（AUC-ROC 0.72对0.79）。让LLM模仿分类器无显著变化；将提示剪枝为分类器最重要的8个特征使召回率提升0.071、F1提升0.032；将分类器预测概率加入提示使LLM的AUC-ROC从0.72升至0.78，追平随机森林，同时召回率仍高出0.118。反向组合和使用多个分类器均无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 作者推荐在LLM信用违约预测中使用简单的分类器引导提示（将分类器预测概率纳入提示），该方案在保持LLM较高召回率优势的同时，将排序能力提升至与传统随机森林相当的水平，为LLM与经典分类器在表格预测任务中的互补融合提供了实证依据。

title: No Equivariant Architecture Covers All Equivariant Attention
summary: We give a complete characterization of equivariant multi-head self-attention (MHSA): if an MHSA layer is equivariant to a symmetry group $G$, then $G$ can only act by permuting head-clusters, with QK and OV matrices satisfying an equivariance constraint tied to the group action. As a consequence, we prove that any fixed MHSA architecture that achieves exact equivariance by polynomially parameterizing unconstrained MHSA parameters inevitably leads to expressivity loss within the class of equivariant maps: the equivariance locus of unconstrained MHSA forms a union of extremely many Zariski-irreducible components in a reduced parameter space, and any single architecture covers at most one. For $G=D_4$ acting on $C$ copies of the regular representation as the token feature space, we show that there are $Ω(C^{64})$ components for eight attention heads.

AI.tldr: 本文完整刻画了等变多头自注意力（MHSA）的结构：等变 MHSA 层所对应的群 G 只能通过置换“头簇”来作用，且 QK 与 OV 矩阵需满足与群作用相关的等变约束。由此证明，任何通过多项式参数化无约束 MHSA 参数来获得精确等变的固定架构，都必然在等变映射类中造成表达力损失——这是因为无约束 MHSA 的等变轨迹在约化参数空间中构成大量 Zariski 不可约分支的并集，而单一架构最多只能覆盖其中之一；以 G=D4 作用在正则表示的 C 份拷贝上为例，8 个注意力头对应 Ω(C^64) 个分支。
AI.motivation: 等变多头自注意力在很多对称性相关任务中至关重要，但此前缺少对“什么样的 MHSA 架构能实现给定群 G 的等变性”这一问题的完整刻画。作者希望从理论上说明：为了获得精确等变性，常见的做法（在无约束 MHSA 参数空间中做多项式参数化）是否总能保持表达力，以及是否存在无法避免的表达力损失。
AI.method: 作者首先给出等变 MHSA 的完整分类刻画，证明群作用必须表现为对头簇的置换，并将 QK、OV 矩阵的等变约束与群作用联系起来；随后利用代数几何中的 Zariski 不可约分量与约化参数空间概念，分析无约束 MHSA 等变轨迹（equivariance locus）的几何结构，并考察单一固定架构在该轨迹上的覆盖能力，再以 D4 群作用在正则表示多拷贝上的具体情形给出分量数目的渐近下界。
AI.result: 证明出任何固定 MHSA 架构通过多项式参数化受限参数实现精确等变时，顶多覆盖等变轨迹众多 Zariski 不可约分支中的一个，因而必然在类内等变映射空间中丧失表达力；并对 G=D4、8 个注意力头的例子给出等变轨迹共有 Ω(C^64) 个分量。
AI.conclusion: 精确等变性与表达力之间存在根本性权衡：试图用单一多项式参数化的固定架构同时覆盖所有等变 MHSA 映射是不可能的，等变 MHSA 的空间本质上是高度分离（大量 Zariski 分支）的，这提示需要针对具体群与架构重新设计等变参数化方案，而不能指望一般性的固定参数化无损实现。

title: Game-Agnostic Value Functions through Automatic JSON Feature Extraction
comment: 4 pages, to be published in Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
summary: JSON Bag-of-Tokens (JSON-Bag) is a recently proposed method to generically represent game trajectories by tokenizing their JSON descriptions. We introduce JSON-Bag VF, a game-agnostic approach to training value functions for game-playing agents using JSON-Bag prototypes. We show that this approach can be enhanced with Random Forest-based feature selection and a method to select game-stage-specific features. We evaluate JSON-Bag VF with One-step-look-ahead (JSON-Bag OSLA) on six tabletop games over different combinations of prototype-tokenization and feature selections. JSON-Bag OSLA outperforms baseline OSLA agents in most games. Our analysis also shows that feature selection significantly improves JSON-Bag VF and that feature selection is the most important factor in JSON-Bag VF performance, over prototype-tokenization.

AI.tldr: 提出了 JSON-Bag VF，一种基于 JSON-Bag 原型的游戏无关价值函数训练方法，并结合基于随机森林的特征选择与游戏阶段特定特征选择，在六个桌游上验证其优于基线 OSLA 代理，且特征选择是影响性能的最关键因素。
AI.motivation: 最近提出的 JSON Bag-of-Tokens（JSON-Bag）方法可通过对游戏轨迹的 JSON 描述进行分词来通用地表示游戏轨迹，但如何利用该表示来训练可供游戏代理使用的价值函数尚未被充分探索；作者旨在构建一种游戏无关、不依赖特定游戏规则细节的价值函数训练方法，并研究特征选择与原型分词对其性能的影响。
AI.method: 将 JSON-Bag 原型用于价值函数训练，提出 JSON-Bag VF 框架；该方法以 JSON-Bag 分词表示状态，结合基于随机森林（Random Forest）的特征选择，并设计了一种选择游戏阶段特定（game-stage-specific）特征的机制；在评估时以 One-step-look-ahead 策略（JSON-Bag OSLA）为代理，在六种桌游上配对不同的原型分词方式与特征选择方案进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在六种桌游中，JSON-Bag OSLA 在大多数游戏上优于基线 OSLA 代理；消融分析表明，特征选择能显著提升 JSON-Bag VF 的性能，且相较于原型分词方式，特征选择是影响 JSON-Bag VF 性能的最重要因素。
AI.conclusion: JSON-Bag VF 是一种有效且游戏无关的价值函数训练途径，能够泛化到多种桌游；同时，研究结论强调了特征选择在基于 JSON-Bag 表示的学习中的核心地位，为未来改进该类通用游戏代理方法提供了方向。

title: Drift Calibration in Geometric Eye Tracking Systems
summary: Geometric eye trackers can provide the spatial accuracy required for gaze-based interaction and multimodal studies, but their measurements remain sensitive to residual session-specific calibration error. Research on correcting this error is difficult to compare because methods are typically evaluated with different devices, target layouts, and error definitions. We present a calibration-focused dataset containing 163 trials from 12 participants, with separate 18-point fitting and 32-point test grids, and use it to evaluate global, local, and composite correction functions under a common spatial-extrapolation protocol. We further introduce a lightweight neural refiner that combines ranked predictions from complementary calibrators. On this controlled dataset, post-vendor correction reduces the mean angular error from $1.53^\circ$ to $1.03^\circ$ with the strongest classical composite and to $0.96^\circ$ with the refiner. In a closed-loop gaze task, lower residual error is associated with higher performance across four online correction conditions. These results provide a reproducible data-quality benchmark for using gaze as a behavioral signal in interactive modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向几何眼动追踪器校准的公开数据集（12名参与者、163次试验、18点拟合网格与32点测试网格），并基于统一的空间外推协议系统比较了全局、局部与复合校正函数，同时引入一个轻量级神经细化器（neural refiner）融合互补校准器的排序预测。实验表明，经厂商后校正后，平均角误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合校正）和0.96°（神经细化器）；在闭环注视任务中，残余误差越低，在线校正表现越好，为交互建模中把注视作为行为信号提供了可复现的数据质量基准。
AI.motivation: 几何眼动追踪器具备交互和模态研究所需要的空间精度，但其测量对每次会话特有的残余校准误差十分敏感。现有针对该误差校正方法的研究难以比较，因为各方法通常在不同设备、不同目标布局和不同误差定义下评估。因此需要一个统一的、可复现的数据集和评估协议来系统衡量校正方法的性能。
AI.method: 构建了一个校准聚焦数据集（163次试验、12名参与者，包含独立的18点拟合网格和32点测试网格），在统一的空间外推协议下评估全局、局部和复合校正函数；并提出一个轻量级神经细化器，通过融合来自互补校准器的排序预测来进一步提升精度。
AI.result: 在该受控数据集上，厂商后校正将平均角误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强的经典复合校正）和0.96°（提出的神经细化器）。在闭环注视任务中，四个在线校正条件下的结果显示，残余误差越低，任务表现越高。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了首个可复现的数据质量基准，用于在校准校正背景下评估眼动校正方法，表明复合与神经细化方法能显著提升几何眼动追踪的精度，并为将注视作为交互建模中的行为信号奠定基础。重要的是，其统一协议和共享数据集有助于研究者公平比较不同校正方法。

title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
summary: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Arkios，一个从零预训练的10.4亿参数稠密Transformer模型，基于150B tokens的英-尼双语文本，采用自研C/CUDA训练栈与天城文感知的字节级BPE分词器。尽管训练数据量少一个数量级，其在ARC基准上超过三个同规模开源模型；论文还揭示了标准多项选择字母格式会让小模型在低资源语言评测中回到随机水平，并提出指令微调阶段的"清单条件化工具调用契约"。
AI.motivation: 针对低资源语言（尼泊尔语）环境下的小规模语言模型，论文关注两个核心问题：其一，如何在数据有限条件下高效预训练双语模型并获得有竞争力的常识推理能力；其二，揭示并纠正标准评测工具在低资源语言上产生的系统性误判——字母式选择题格式使模型在两个语言上都回到随机水平，导致朴素评测错误地否定模型真实的尼泊尔语能力。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 自研单文件C/CUDA训练栈，从零预训练1.04B参数稠密Transformer；(2) 专门为项目设计的天城文感知字节级BPE分词器；(3) 在ARC基准上按标准协议进行完整评测，并修正早前基于部分样本的错误估计；(4) 对比两种评测方式：字母选择题格式与直接对答案文本打分；(5) 指令微调阶段引入"清单条件化工具调用契约"——仅当上下文中声明工具清单时才允许工具调用，否则抑制；(6) 发布Apache-2.0许可的基座与指令微调权重。
AI.result: 在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上，Arkios在训练tokens少一个数量级的情况下仍超过Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B和OLMo-1B三个同规模开源模型（可能归因于其教育网页预训练数据与ARC小学科学题形式的匹配，而非通用能力优势）。在字母选择题格式下，两种语言均处于随机水平（尼泊尔语0.240、英语0.236，随机基线0.250）；改为直接对答案文本打分后，显示出真实的、偏向英语的理解能力（尼泊尔语0.306、英语0.387）。工具调用契约在部分场景成立、部分场景不成立。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为低资源语言小模型的评测需要警惕评测格式本身带来的偏差；不同提示格式（字母选择 vs 直接文本打分）对结论有决定性影响。论文公开了全部评测可复现内容，但训练代码及小部分私有来源的尼泊尔语语料未发布；基座与指令微调权重以Apache-2.0协议开源。

title: Confounding Masquerading as Improvement: A Systematic Evaluation of Offline Reinforcement Learning for Stroke Antithrombotic Treatment in a 129,000-Patient Registry
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) 2026; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), vol. 340
summary:
Recent offline reinforcement learning (RL) studies report policies that outperform physician decisions on clinical outcomes. We conduct a systematic, partially crossed evaluation of five offline RL algorithm families and 14 reward designs in 44,894 post-2018 acute ischemic stroke patients from a nationwide registry (N = 129,033).
  Standard Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) yields an apparent policy-improvement estimate of +0.0069; adding an Early Neurological Deterioration penalty increases it to +0.0101. We identify reward-embedded confounding, in which a proxy terminal reward encodes baseline severity and prognosis as well as treatment efficacy. A 2 x 2 factorial analysis finds that terminal reward confounding accounts for 218.6% of the observed signal change, so its removal overshoots the null.
  After DML-inspired GBM reward residualization, the FQE estimate attenuates to +0.0033 (p = 0.132), and full deconfounding yields +0.0025 (p = 0.291). FQE-based diagnostics, T-learner analyses, and direct recurrence analyses converge away from a clinically meaningful aggregate improvement. A 1-year mRS factorial analysis replicates the attenuation. We provide an empirically motivated six-step evaluation checklist. NIHSS-stratified heterogeneity is hypothesis-generating for prospective trial design; hospital-level disagreement does not persist after full reward deconfounding.

AI.tldr: 本文对44,894名急性缺血性卒中患者开展系统的离线强化学习评估（5个算法族×14种奖励设计），发现标准FQE估计的政策改进看似显著，但其中218.6%的信号变化源于"奖励内嵌混杂"（终端代理奖励同时编码了基线严重程度/预后与疗效）。经DML启发的GBM奖励残差化和完全去混杂后，估计衰减至不显著（+0.0025, p=0.291），多类分析一致表明缺乏临床意义的总体改进，并据此提出六步评估清单。
AI.motivation: 近期离线强化学习研究声称其策略在临床结局上优于医生决策，但此类结论可能受到评估方法学缺陷影响。本研究旨在系统检验离线RL在卒中治疗中的真实表现，识别并量化评估中的混杂来源（尤其是奖励内嵌混杂），避免对临床改善的虚假推断。
AI.method: 采用部分交叉设计，对5个离线RL算法族与14种奖励设计进行系统评估；使用标准Fitted Q-Evaluation（FQE）估计政策改进；通过2×2析因分析识别终端奖励混杂；引入DML启发的GBM奖励残差化及完全去混杂；辅以T-learner分析与直接复发分析作为验证，并进行1年mRS析因复现和NIHSS分层异质性分析。
AI.result: 标准FQE给出表观改进+0.0069，加入早期神经功能恶化（END）惩罚后升至+0.0101；但2×2析因分析显示终端奖励混杂解释了218.6%的信号变化，去混杂后过度矫正至负值。GBM奖励残差化后FQE估计衰减至+0.0033（p=0.132），完全去混杂为+0.0025（p=0.291）；多项分析一致收敛于无临床意义的总体改进；NIHSS分层差异仅为探索性发现，医院层面分歧在完全去混杂后消失。
AI.conclusion: 离线RL在卒中治疗中的表观政策优势主要由奖励内嵌混杂驱动，而非真实治疗效果；研究者应通过奖励残差化等去混杂手段并结合多重诊断验证，避免夸大RL的临床价值。论文提供六步评估清单，并指出NIHSS分层异质性可作为前瞻性试验设计的假设生成依据。

title: VERA: Authority-Preserving Edge Revocation for Federated AI-Agent Workflows
summary: Modern agent frameworks compose planners, tool agents, remote services, and shared specialists into runtime delegation graphs, but their revocation APIs still resemble token or subtree invalidation. When one delegation is withdrawn, the runtime must know which agents lose authority while independently authorized agents keep working. We study this authority consistency problem and introduce VERA (Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents), a verifier-checkable revocation contract and API emitted by agent-runtime adapters as signed evidence. Under disjunctive authority, revoking edge e invalidates exactly T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e}), the agents whose every authorizing root path used e. Used as a contract, this target exposes two runtime failures: tree cascades over-revoke shared agents, while deployer-scoped cascades under-revoke cross-domain descendants. In a LangGraph framework-replt cells repeated 20 times yield 500compiled-framework traces and 2,000 valid signed delegation decisions; 13/25 cells contain runtime multi-parsharing and 8/25 contain cross-deployer shies 500/500 target proofs, preserves all320 alternate-parent shared-agent cases that tree cascade revokes, and rejects unauthorized signers and omission attacks. Baseline replay over 1,9that holder/node and tree-style targetscannot express this behavior. We further validate schema portability on A2A, AutoGen, and CrewAI artifacts: nine traces, including five executable Cregned delegation events that pass schema and signature checks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体框架中委托撤销的"权限一致性"问题，提出 VERA（面向智能体的可验证边撤销）机制：由运行时适配器发出带签名证据的、验证者可检查的撤销契约与 API，精确定义撤销某条委托边时应失效的智能体集合，并在多个框架与基准上验证了正确性、可移植性及对共享/跨域场景的覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体框架将规划器、工具智能体、远程服务与共享专家组合成运行时委托图，但其撤销 API 仍停留在令牌失效或子树失效层面。当一条委托被撤销时，运行时必须区分"因此失去权限的智能体"与"仍拥有独立授权的智能体"；这一"权限一致性"问题缺乏精确定义与可验证的机制保障。
AI.method: VERA 引入验证者可检查的撤销契约与 API，由智能体运行时适配器以签名证据形式发布。在析取式权限（disjunctive authority）语义下，撤销边 e 恰好使 T_intent(e,G)=reach(G)\reach(G\{e}) 失效，即"所有授权根路径均经过 e"的智能体集合。将该目标作为契约可暴露两类运行时故障：树式级联对共享智能体过度撤销，部署者作用域式级联对跨域后代撤销不足。
AI.result: 在 LangGraph 框架实验中，20 个单元重复 20 次得到 500 条编译框架轨迹与 2,000 条有效签名委托决策；13/25 个单元含运行时多父共享、8/25 含跨部署者结构；500/500 目标证明通过，保留了树式级联所撤销的全部 320 个备选父级共享智能体案例，并拒绝未授权签名者与遗漏攻击。基线重放显示持有者/节点式与树式目标均无法表达该行为；在 A2A、AutoGen、CrewAI 工件上进一步验证了模式可移植性，九条轨迹（含五个可执行委托事件）通过模式与签名校验。
AI.conclusion: VERA 提供了一种精确、可验证且跨框架可移植的边撤销语义，弥补了现有智能体框架撤销 API 在权限一致性上的缺陷：既能避免树式级联的过度撤销，也能避免部署者作用域级联的跨域欠撤销，可作为智能体运行时的可验证撤销契约标准。

title: SynCrash: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Zero-Shot Accident Detection and Localization in Traffic Surveillance Video
comment: Accepted at the CVPR 2026 AUTOPILOT Workshop (non-archival)
summary: We present SynCrash, a multi-stage pipeline for zero-shot accident detection, spatial localization, and collision-type classification in fixed-view CCTV surveillance video. Our approach addresses the ACCIDENT at CVPR 2026 Challenge, which requires predicting when an accident occurs, where in the frame the impact happens, and what type of collision it is, all without access to labeled real-world training data. The pipeline operates in three decoupled stages: (1) Temporal localization via a VideoMAEv2-giant backbone fine-tuned on CARLA-based synthetic clips with metadata-aware embeddings and dense sliding-window inference; (2) Spatial localization using YOLO for object detection combined with a physics-informed hybrid heuristic that leverages bounding-box overlap and trajectory-based reasoning to predict the impact point; and (3) Collision-type classification using a lightweight rule-based strategy derived from the number and configuration of detected vehicles. The key insight is that temporal understanding benefits from supervised fine-tuning on synthetic data, whereas spatial understanding is better served by pretrained object detectors and physics priors that transfer naturally across domains.

AI.tldr: SynCrash 是一个面向固定视角 CCTV 监控视频的三阶段零样本事故检测流水线，通过 CARLA 合成数据微调的 VideoMAEv2 进行时间定位、YOLO 结合物理先验启发式进行空间定位、以及基于车辆数量与配置的轻量规则进行碰撞类型分类，无需任何真实世界标注数据。
AI.motivation: 针对 CVPR 2026 ACCIDENT Challenge 的要求——在没有任何真实世界标注训练数据的零样本设定下，同时预测事故发生的时刻、画面中的撞击位置以及碰撞类型。作者认为需要一种无需真实标注即可泛化的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出三个解耦的流水线阶段：(1) 时间定位：使用在 CARLA 合成片段上微调的 VideoMAEv2-giant 骨干网络，结合元数据感知嵌入和密集滑动窗口推理；(2) 空间定位：使用 YOLO 目标检测，结合基于边界框重叠与轨迹推理的物理信息混合启发式来预测撞击点；(3) 碰撞类型分类：采用由检测车辆数量与配置推导的轻量级规则策略。核心洞察是时间理解受益于合成数据的监督微调，而空间理解更适合利用预训练目标检测器与可跨域迁移的物理先验。
AI.result: 流水线成功应对 ACCIDENT@CVPR 2026 挑战赛的三个子任务（事故时间、撞击位置、碰撞类型），在无需真实标注数据的零样本条件下实现事故检测、空间定位与碰撞类型分类。
AI.conclusion: 针对不同感知任务应采用不同模型策略：时间维度的理解需通过合成数据上的监督微调获得判别能力，而空间维度的理解则应借助预训练检测器与物理先验实现跨域迁移；这种解耦设计在零样本设定下是有效的。

title: AtlasNLP: A Country-Aware Atlas of Dataset Representation in NLP
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Understanding which countries are represented in NLP datasets is essential for identifying gaps, targeting data collection, measuring progress, and informing AI policy. However, geographic metadata is very rarely available, and country-level representation is often hidden behind broad language-level claims. We introduce AtlasNLP, a country-aware atlas of over 13,000 NLP dataset records across normalized NLP task categories, tracking both the populations represented and where datasets are produced. AtlasNLP includes AtlasNLP-Gold, a human-curated reference set, and AtlasNLP-Core, an ACL-derived large-scale collection. Using this resource, we show that (1) dataset coverage is highly uneven across countries and tasks; (2) dataset production and representation are geographically asymmetric; and (3) language coverage does not imply geographic representation. These findings reveal blind spots in current dataset documentation practices and motivate more explicit geographic metadata for country-aware NLP evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AtlasNLP，一个覆盖超过 13,000 条 NLP 数据集记录、按国家维度追踪"人群代表"与"数据集产地"的资源库，包含人工整理的 AtlasNLP-Gold 和由 ACL 文献衍生的 AtlasNLP-Core。基于该资源，作者发现数据集覆盖在国家与任务间极不均衡、数据生产与代表性在地理上不对称、语言覆盖不能代表地理覆盖，进而指出当前数据集文档实践的盲区，并呼吁更明确的地理元数据。
AI.motivation: NLP 数据集缺乏地理元数据，国家层面的代表性常被笼统的语言描述所掩盖；而了解数据集代表哪些国家对于识别覆盖空白、指导数据收集、衡量进展和制定 AI 政策至关重要。
AI.method: 构建 AtlasNLP 资源库：对超过 13,000 条 NLP 数据集记录按归一化的 NLP 任务类别进行组织，同时追踪数据集所代表的人群（数据覆盖面）与数据集的生产地；包含人工筛选的参考集 AtlasNLP-Gold 和基于 ACL 文献的大规模集合 AtlasNLP-Core。
AI.result: 三项核心发现：(1) 数据集覆盖在不同国家和任务之间高度不均衡；(2) 数据集的生产产地与所代表的人群在地理上不对称；(3) 语言覆盖并不能推出地理代表覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 当前数据集文档实践中存在地理层面的盲区，需要更明确的地理元数据，以支撑面向国家维度的 NLP 评测与政策制定。

title: PRIME: Mitigating Subgroup Optimization Competition in Shared CTR Top Networks with Plug-in Residual Input-Conditioned Mixture of Expert
summary:
Click-through rate (CTR) models vary in feature-interaction design, yet their top networks usually remain a single multilayer perceptron shared by all examples. Heterogeneous user, item, and context subgroups therefore update the same parameters; weakly aligned learning signals make the aggregate gradient a compromise among competing directions. We study the competition on Avazu with 4 models and 4 semantic fields. Across all architectures, semantic subgroups show lower Top-NN gradient cosine similarity than random groups matched by sample size and label ratio, with reductions of 0.23-0.37.
  This competition motivates input-conditioned experts, but directly replacing an established Dense mapping changes its initial function, sharing pattern, and capacity, obscuring the source of gains. We introduce PRIME (Plug-in Residual Input-conditioned Mixture of Experts), a Dense-anchored mixture of low-rank residual experts. PRIME anchors the original prediction and uses zero-residual initialization to match the Dense baseline exactly at training onset. Input-dependent routing weights low-rank experts for example-specific logit corrections; multi-bag aggregation and EMA load biases stabilize conditional estimation.
  We evaluate PRIME on held-out Avazu and Criteo test sets across 13 CTR architectures and five paired seeds. Median paired AUC gains are +0.0022 and +0.0066, with LogLoss reductions of 0.0011 and 0.0081, respectively. On FiBiNET and DCNv2, PRIME outperforms APG in all ten seed-level AUC comparisons while using fewer parameters and lower inference latency on both backbones. These results show that function-preserving conditional residuals add input-dependent capacity while preserving the Dense path and its optimization stability. Code is available at https://github.com/YH-learning/PRIME.

AI.tldr: PRIME 是一种即插即用的残差条件混合专家（Mixture of Experts）模块，通过零残差初始化与 Dense 锚定，在不改变原模型初始行为和参数共享结构的前提下，为 CTR 模型按输入条件注入低秩专家残差，带来稳定的 AUC 提升与推理开销下降。
AI.motivation: CTR 模型虽然特征交互设计各异，但其顶层网络通常是一个所有样本共享的单层 MLP。异构的用户、物品与上下文子组共享同一组参数，导致弱对齐的学习信号使梯度聚合成为相互竞争方向的折中。作者在 Avazu 上对 4 个模型和 4 个语义字段的实验中观察到，语义子组的 Top-N 梯度余弦相似度显著低于按样本量与标签比例匹配的随机组（下降 0.23-0.37），说明梯度竞争确实存在。因此需要引入输入条件化的专家来缓解该问题，但直接替换成熟的 Dense 层会改变其初始函数、共享模式与容量，难以区分收益来源。
AI.method: 提出 PRIME（Plug-in Residual Input-conditioned Mixture of Experts），一种以 Dense 锚定的低秩残差专家混合模块。它锚定原始预测，并采用零残差初始化，使模型在训练开始时与 Dense 基线完全一致；输入相关的路由权重决定低秩残差专家的组合，为每个样本产生特定的 logit 修正；同时采用多袋聚合（multi-bag aggregation）与 EMA 载荷偏置稳定条件估计，从而在不改变原 Dense 路径的初始函数、共享模式与容量的情况下增加输入条件的表征能力。
AI.result: 在 Avazu 与 Criteo 留出测试集上，对 13 种 CTR 架构和 5 组配对种子评估，中位配对 AUC 增益分别为 +0.0022 与 +0.0066，LogLoss 分别降低 0.0011 与 0.0081。在 FiBiNET 与 DCNv2 上，PRIME 在全部 10 次种子级 AUC 对比中优于 APG，且参数更少、推理延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，函数保持的（function-preserving）条件残差能够在保留 Dense 路径及其优化稳定性的同时，为模型增加输入相关的容量，是一类可即插即用、可迁移到多种 CTR 骨干网络的通用改进方案。

title: A.X K2 Technical Report
summary: We introduce A.X K2, a 688B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance foundation for \emph{agentic} applications.
