Trained on approximately 8.5T tokens---fewer than its predecessor, A.X K1---on a smaller but higher-quality mixture with substantially expanded agentic and software-engineering data, it nonetheless improves over A.X K1 across the board, by over 30 percentage points on some benchmarks, reflecting large gains in token efficiency. To support long contexts efficiently, we introduce Sparse Gated Attention (SGA), which combines sparse attention with gated attention, and adopt Gated Norm (GN) to stabilize large-scale training. SGA is trained natively at 128K through a \emph{sparse} indexer warmup that optimizes the indexer against its own sparse top-$k$ selection rather than the dense attention distribution, making adaptation markedly cheaper: each query reads only 2,048 positions, yet long-context quality is unchanged and A.X K2 scores 94.6 on RULER out to 256K. The outlier suppression of GN in turn keeps 4-bit NVFP4 serving within one point of FP8 accuracy. A simple yet effective Think-Fusion recipe further lets users switch between thinking and non-thinking modes within a single unified model. Extensive evaluations show that A.X K2 performs competitively against strong open-weight baselines, matching or exceeding them on math and Korean-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 A.X K2，一个 688B 参数的混合专家（MoE）语言模型，专为智能体（agentic）应用从头训练。通过更少但更高质量的训练数据（约 8.5T tokens）和大幅扩充的智能体与软件工程数据，在各项基准上全面超越其前身 A.X K1（部分基准提升超 30 个百分点），展现出显著的 token 效率提升。模型引入稀疏门控注意力（SGA）与门控归一化（GN）两项技术，分别实现高效的长上下文支持（原生 128K 训练、RULER 256K 得分 94.6）和大规模训练稳定化（4-bit NVFP4 推理精度接近 FP8）。此外，Think-Fusion 方案允许在同一统一模型内切换思考/非思考模式，整体在数学与韩语基准上不逊于甚至超越主流开源权重模型。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在构建面向智能体（agentic）应用的高性能基础模型。相对于前代 A.X K1，希望在更少训练数据下获得全面性能提升（尤其增强 token 效率），同时解决长上下文的计算效率问题和大规模训练的稳定性问题，并降低部署推理成本。
AI.method: 1) 数据策略：使用更少（约 8.5T tokens）但质量更高的混合数据，大幅扩充智能体与软件工程数据；2) 稀疏门控注意力（SGA）：将稀疏注意力与门控注意力结合，采用稀疏索引器热身（sparse indexer warmup）——索引器针对自身稀疏 top-k 选择而非稠密注意力分布进行优化，使每个 query 仅读取 2,048 个位置；3) 门控归一化（GN）：通过门控机制抑制异常值（outlier）以稳定大规模训练，并利于低比特量化；4) Think-Fusion 方案：在单一统一模型中支持思考与非思考两种模式切换。
AI.result: A.X K2 在全部基准上超越 A.X K1，部分基准提升超过 30 个百分点；长上下文质量不降（RULER 256K 得分 94.6，原生 128K 训练）；4-bit NVFP4 推理精度与 FP8 相差 1 个百分点以内；在与强开源权重模型的对比中表现具有竞争力，并在数学与韩语基准上达到或超越对手。
AI.conclusion: A.X K2 证明通过高质量数据与针对性架构改进（SGA、GN）可以在训练 token 更少的情况下获得全面性能提升，实现高 token 效率；同时 SGA 支持高效的长上下文，GN 支持低成本量化推理，Think-Fusion 提供灵活的模式切换，使其成为面向智能体应用且兼顾部署效率的有力基础模型。

title: InspectorGPT: A Comparative Reasoning Enhanced VLM for Comprehensive Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection is a critical component of modern manufacturing. Most traditional unsupervised methods rely on modelling normal feature distributions, inherently limiting generalization to unknown categories. To improve generalizability, some recent methods incorporate vision-language models (VLMs) for zero-shot detection via text prompts. However, we observe that reasoning-oriented post-training can cause anomaly discrimination to collapse, with some fine-tuned models performing worse than their base VLMs. Existing methods also provide only textual decisions or coarse boxes, without pixel-level segmentation. A more explicit detection principle comes from human inspection: anomalies are identified by comparing a query image with a defect-free reference. Inspired by this, we propose InspectorGPT, a VLM framework centered on comparative reasoning. Given a normal reference and a query image, InspectorGPT compares them to identify discrepancies and perform multiple inspection tasks with detailed reasoning. We internalize this capability through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tailored, verifiable rewards. We further introduce InspectorGPT-Seg for pixel-level anomaly masks. Segmentation supervision improves anomaly discrimination but weakens semantic reasoning, while joint training fails to balance them. We therefore train the two branches separately and combine them through task-vector fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior multi-dimensional performance and generalization to unseen benchmarks, validating comparative reasoning for comprehensive industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InspectorGPT，一种基于比较推理的工业异常检测 VLM 框架：给定正常参考图像与查询图像，模型通过对比识别差异并完成多种检测任务。通过 CoT 微调和 GRPO 强化学习内化比较能力；针对像素级分割需求提出 InspectorGPT-Seg，并采用双分支独立训练+任务向量融合的方式兼顾分割监督与语义推理。实验表明其在多维度性能及跨域泛化上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督异常检测建模正常特征分布，泛化到未知类别受限；现有基于 VLM 的零样本方法依赖文本提示，且推理导向的后训练可能导致异常判别能力崩溃，同时只能给出文本判定或粗糙边界框，缺少像素级分割。受人类通过比对无缺陷参考图像来识别异常的检测原理启发，需要一种更明确、更全面且可分割的检测方案。
AI.method: 提出 InspectorGPT 比较推理框架：输入正常参考与查询图像，通过对比识别差异并执行多任务检测和详细推理。能力通过 CoT 微调与 GRPO（配以定制可验证奖励）内化。另提出 InspectorGPT-Seg 用于像素级异常掩码。由于分割监督提升判别却削弱语义推理、联合训练难以平衡，采用两分支分别训练并通过任务向量融合组合。
AI.result: 大量实验证明 InspectorGPT 在多项检测任务上取得优越的多维性能，并能泛化到未见过的基准数据集，验证了比较推理在综合工业检测中的有效性。同时解决了两分支融合后在分割与语义推理上的权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: 以正常参考对比为核心的比较推理是一种更贴近人类检测原理的显式范式，能够同时获得高精度的异常判别、详细的语义推理和像素级分割，且具备良好的跨类别泛化能力，为工业异常检测提供了新的技术路线。

authors: Shrinidhi Kumbhar Santosh Mashetty Divij Handa Kevin Coutinho
title: COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. Across two 3B-parameter models and two scientific domains (AI and Materials Science), COGTRL improves method quality by an average of 7.85 points over comparable 3B model baselines and achieves competitive performance relative to 70B parameter models. Moreover, analysis by domain experts shows a preference for methods generated by COGTRL over the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COGTRL，一个轨迹级强化学习框架，训练大语言模型在科学发现过程中生成并联合优化认知轨迹（如约束检查、失败备选方案、迭代决策）与科学步骤，从而显著提升其作为科学发现助手的表现。
AI.motivation: 大多数研究论文省略了真实科学家在特定约束下达成目标所需的细粒度认知过程（例如约束检查、失败备选方案和迭代决策），而这些认知过程对实际科研工作至关重要。仅用科研文献训练LLM不足以让其掌握这类推理能力，因此需要弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 提出COGTRL，一种轨迹级强化学习框架，以交错方式联合优化认知轨迹和科学步骤，训练LLM模拟具有认知根基的推理过程。
AI.result: 在两个3B参数模型和两个科学领域（AI与材料科学）上，COGTRL相较同等3B基线平均提升7.85个方法质量分，并达到与70B参数模型相当的竞争力；领域专家也更偏好COGTRL生成的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将认知轨迹纳入LLM训练（而非仅训练科研文献）能有效提升模型作为科学发现助手的表现，展示出以更小模型逼近超大模型的潜力。

title: Self-Supervised Pretext Tasks for Infant Cry Analysis: A Controlled Comparison and a Cautionary Result on Donateacry
summary: We compare six self-supervised pretext tasks for infant cry analysis under a fixed budget, meaning the same compact encoder of 1.17M parameters, the same 115 hours of license-verified public pretraining audio, and the same evaluation protocol for every candidate. On cry detection the reconstructive objectives dominate, and a linear probe over a masked-spectrogram encoder reaches 0.988 AUC with subject-wise splits even though the encoder never observed a cry during pretraining. On cry-reason classification over donateacry, the de facto public benchmark for cry reasons, every encoder performs at chance (0.38 to 0.54 macro AUC over 5 classes), and neither domain adaptation on 1.8 hours of real cries nor end-to-end fine-tuning moves the result. Since a frozen HuBERT-base with 80 times more parameters shows the same pattern, the bottleneck must sit in the labels and not in model capacity. We then reproduce the 90\%+ accuracies of the donateacry literature on our own system by changing nothing but the evaluation protocol: clip-wise splits raise accuracy to 85.2% (barely above the 83.8% majority-class baseline), and applying augmentation before splitting raises it to 97.9%, matching the reported state of the art, from the same model that measures 0.49 macro AUC under subject-wise splits. Under leakage-free splits, a twentyfold augmentation of the labeled set (vocoder speaker perturbation and noise mixing, 21 hours) leaves cross-subject AUC unchanged: for this task the effective sample size is the number of infants. We release code, seeds and per-clip license manifests.

AI.tldr: 本文在固定预算（1.17M参数编码器、115小时公开预训练音频、统一评测协议）下系统比较了六种自监督预训练任务用于婴儿哭声分析。结果表明：哭声检测任务上重建式目标占优（掩码频谱编码器线性探针达0.988 AUC）；但在哭声原因分类基准 donateacry 上所有编码器均接近随机水平（5类宏AUC 0.38–0.54），即便领域自适应或端到端微调也无济于事。作者证明文献中90%+的准确率完全源于评测协议的泄漏——仅改用clip-wise划分准确率即从随机水平升至85.2%（略高于83.8%的多数类基线），在划分前应用的增强则升至97.9%，与报道的SOTA一致。在无泄漏的按受试者划分下，即使对标注集做20倍增强，跨受试者AUC也保持不变，说明该任务的有效样本量是婴儿人数而非片段数。
AI.motivation: 婴儿哭声分析文献常报道极高的分类准确率，但可能因评测协议（如片段级随机划分造成数据泄漏）而虚高；同时自监督预训练在该领域的作用缺乏受控比较。作者希望在固定预算下公平评估多种自监督预训练任务，并厘清高准确率究竟是模型能力还是评测协议造成的假象。
AI.method: 在严格固定的预算下比较六种自监督前置任务：统一使用1.17M参数的紧凑编码器、相同的115小时经许可核验的公开预训练音频、以及相同的评测协议；在哭声检测与哭声原因分类两个任务上评测，并加入领域自适应与端到端微调对照；随后仅改变评测协议（clip-wise划分、划分前增强）复现文献结果，同时释放代码、随机种子和逐片段许可清单以保证可复现性。
AI.result: 哭声检测上重建式目标占优，掩码频谱编码器的线性探针在按受试者划分下达到0.988 AUC（预训练从未见过哭声）；哭声原因分类上所有编码器均为随机水平（0.38–0.54宏AUC），80倍参数的冻结HuBERT-base同样如此，说明瓶颈在标签而非模型容量。仅将评测协议改为clip-wise划分，同一模型准确率升至85.2%（多数类基线83.8%），加上划分前增强则达97.9%，复现了文献SOTA；而在无泄漏的按受试者划分下，20倍增强（声码器说话人扰动+噪声混合，21小时）不改变跨受试者AUC。
AI.conclusion: 哭声原因分类任务的有效样本量是婴儿个体数而非音频片段数，数据增强无法替代更多受试者；文献中90%+的准确率主要由评测协议泄漏造成，自监督预训练的作用在哭声检测上显著、在原因分类上受限。作者通过开放代码、种子与许可清单，倡导无泄漏的按受试者评测标准。

title: GridFlow: Structured Latent Flow for Seamless City-Scale 3D Point Cloud Generation
summary: Generating realistic 3D city environments from remote sensing data is important for simulation, urban planning, and mixed reality, yet existing point cloud generation methods are limited to single objects or bounded indoor scenes and cannot handle the scale, seamless tiling, and partial observability challenges of city-scale generation. We present \ours{}, a multi-stage framework that generates dense, colored point clouds ($10^5$ points per $150\text{m}{\times}150\text{m}$ tile) at city scale, conditioned on satellite imagery, semantic segmentation maps, and digital surface models (DSM). A \emph{Grid-Aligned VAE} encodes each tile into a topology-preserving latent grid where tokens correspond to fixed spatial regions, enabling spatially coherent multi-modal conditioning and compact latent-space edge consistency that implicitly aligns thousands of boundary points for seamless cross-tile generation. A conditional rectified flow model synthesizes geometry latents from the fused multi-modal conditions, and an orientation-aware diffusion colorizer separately handles satellite-visible horizontal surfaces and occluded vertical façades. To support standardized evaluation, we build on public 3D data sources to introduce \emph{City3D-MultiGen}, a benchmark of $163$K densely annotated tiles from Melbourne and London with aligned point clouds, satellite images, semantic maps, and elevation data. Experiments show that \ours{} outperforms adapted point cloud generation baselines across all geometry metrics and produces visually coherent colored point clouds with seamless boundaries over arbitrarily large urban extents. Our benchmark details are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/e32/City3D-MultiGen

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多阶段框架，用于从卫星影像、语义分割图和数字表面模型（DSM）生成城市尺度的高密度彩色点云（每150m×150m瓦片含10^5个点）。该框架采用Grid-Aligned VAE实现拓扑保持的潜在网格编码与跨瓦片无缝一致性，条件整流流模型合成几何潜在表示，方向感知扩散着色器分别处理可见水平面和遮挡垂直立面。作者还构建了包含16.3万个来自墨尔本和伦敦的密集标注瓦片基准City3D-MultiGen，实验表明其在几何指标上全面超越现有基线的点云生成方法。
AI.motivation: 从遥感数据生成逼真的3D城市环境对仿真、城市规划及混合现实至关重要，但现有点云生成方法仅适用于单物体或有界室内场景，无法应对城市场景生成中的大规模尺度、无缝瓦片拼接和部分可观测性三大挑战。
AI.method: 提出多阶段框架：1) Grid-Aligned VAE将每个瓦片编码为拓扑保持的潜在网格（token对应固定空间区域），实现空间一致的多模态条件融合以及紧凑的潜在空间边缘一致性，隐式对齐数千边界点以支持无缝跨瓦片生成；2) 条件整流流（rectified flow）模型从融合的多模态条件合成几何潜在表示；3) 方向感知扩散着色器分别处理卫星可见的水平表面（如屋顶）与被遮挡的垂直立面（如墙面）。基于公共3D数据源构建City3D-MultiGen基准，包含墨尔本和伦敦16.3万个密集标注瓦片，对齐了点云、卫星图、语义图和海拔数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架在所有几何指标上优于经过适配的点云生成基线方法，并能生成视觉连贯、跨任意大面积城市场景边界无缝的彩色点云。基准数据可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/e32/City3D-MultiGen获取。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现了城市尺度的无缝彩色点云生成，通过潜在网格的空间对齐设计解决了跨瓦片一致性和多模态条件注入问题，并提供了标准化评估基准，为大规模城市场景生成研究奠定了数据与评测基础。

title: Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
summary: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LiveMacroEval，一个实时、抗数据污染的基准测试，用于评估配备网络搜索的 LLM 智能体对 16 个美国主要宏观经济指标的逐小时 nowcasting（临近预测）能力。六个月实验表明，四个最先进的 LLM 智能体在总体准确度上与美联储地区储备银行、Bloomberg ECOS 专业共识及 auto-ARIMA 基线大致相当，但各指标间表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 对当前参考期的宏观经济指标进行 nowcasting（在官方发布前估算其数值）对货币政策与金融市场至关重要，各央行设有专门专家团队负责此工作。LLM 智能体因兼具广泛世界知识、实时网络搜索能力及高于机构预测的频率而成为有前景的候选方案，但对其进行评估存在挑战：GDP、CPI 等头条指标在预训练中被广泛报道、很可能被记忆，因此在历史数据上的评估容易受到数据污染影响。
AI.method: 引入 LiveMacroEval 实时基准：LLM 智能体在每次官方发布前的窗口内对 16 个美国宏观经济指标逐小时生成 nowcast。预测质量通过 LiveMacro Score（对照公告窗口内的股票收益）和 LiveBetting Score（基于模拟 Polymarket 式交易）评估，并以美联储地区储备银行 nowcast、Bloomberg ECOS 专业共识及 auto-ARIMA 基线作为对照。实验配置为四个配备网络搜索的最先进 LLM 智能体，持续六个月。
AI.result: 在六个月、四个 SOTA LLM 智能体（启用网络搜索）的实验中，聚合的 nowcast 准确度与机构及专业基准大致相当，但各个别指标上的表现差异很大，凸显 LLM 智能体作为宏观经济实时估计工具的潜力。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体能够达到与机构宏观预测（如美联储地区储备银行与 Bloomberg 专业共识）相当的实时 nowcast 准确度，有望成为宏观经济状况的实时估计器；但指标间表现的高度异质性提示未来需针对具体指标优化与更长期的验证。LiveMacroEval 提供的实时、抗污染评估框架为客观评测此类能力提供了基础。

title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry
summary: Multimodal geometry reasoning requires VLMs to extract precise visual relations and preserve them through multi-step deduction. Existing free-form traces obscure the decisions that determine the answer, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning distributes a single terminal signal across the entire response. We introduce credit-addressable reasoning, in which the semantic units exposed during inference also define where learning compares alternatives and assigns credit. We instantiate this principle with Code-CoT, which retains the diagram, represents visual relations as line-addressable executable code, and organizes reasoning into typed events, and CE-GRPO, which selects event boundaries using structural priors and type-normalized entropy, samples complete continuations from shared prefixes, and converts outcome differences into localized advantages. Across nine geometry benchmarks, CE-GRPO achieves an average accuracy of 76.04, outperforming Qwen3-VL-8B and trajectory-level GRPO by $8.09$ and 3.43 points, respectively. Its relative advantage increases with the number of intermediate events, demonstrating the value of representation--optimization co-design for long, dependency-heavy multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信用可寻址推理"（credit-addressable reasoning）框架，通过Code-CoT将多模态几何推理中的视觉关系表示为按行可寻址的可执行代码，并借助CE-GRPO在事件边界上局部化分配强化学习信用，在九个几何基准上平均准确率达76.04，分别超过Qwen3-VL-8B和轨迹级GRPO 8.09与3.43个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多模态几何推理要求VLM提取精确的视觉关系并在多步推理中保持它们。现有自由格式推理轨迹会模糊决定答案的关键决策，且轨迹级强化学习把单一终局信号均匀散布到整个响应中，导致信噪比低、学习效率差。因此需要一种能让"推理中暴露的语义单元"同时充当"学习时比较备选方案和分配信用"的位置的方法。
AI.method: 提出两项核心设计：(1) Code-CoT：保留图表，将视觉关系编码为按行可寻址（line-addressable）的可执行代码，并将推理组织为有类型的事件（typed events），使语义单元在推理与学习两端对齐；(2) CE-GRPO：利用结构先验和类型归一化熵来选择事件边界，从共享前缀采样完整续写，并把结果差异转化为局部化优势值，从而将信用分配到具体事件位置。
AI.result: 在九个几何基准上，CE-GRPO平均准确率达76.04，较Qwen3-VL-8B提升8.09个百分点，较轨迹级GRPO提升3.43个百分点；且相对优势随中间事件数量增加而增大，说明该框架在处理长链、强依赖的多模态推理时尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明"表示-优化协同设计"（representation–optimization co-design）——即让推理表示结构与强化学习信用分配粒度相互匹配——对长程、依赖密集的多模态推理任务具有重要价值，是提升VLM几何推理能力的一条有效路径。

title: SPARK: Skeleton-Guided Reasoning Synthesis from Large-Scale Scientific Literature
summary: Scientific reasoning remains challenging for open-source models, largely due to the lack of high-quality scientific reasoning data. Existing datasets are often dominated by factual recall or formulaic problem solving, with limited emphasis on mechanism understanding, evidence-grounded reasoning, and hypothesis evaluation. To address this, we introduce SPARK (Scientific Paper Abstracted Reasoning sKeleton), a paper-oriented synthesis framework built on Sci-Base, a large-scale corpus of research papers spanning 10 scientific disciplines. Instead of directly converting papers into question-answer pairs, SPARK treats the claim-evidence-derivation structure of a paper as the fundamental unit of reasoning synthesis. Specifically, SPARK (1) distills each paper into a compact reasoning skeleton capturing its central claims and supporting evidence, enabling self-contained question generation, and (2) synthesizes reasoning tasks from four scientific perspectives: mechanistic reasoning, hypothesis falsification, quantitative derivation, and boundary calibration. A final consistency verification stage further removes unsupported or contradictory outputs. Using this framework, we construct Spark-234K, a scientific reasoning dataset with substantially higher difficulty and diversity than existing resources. Experiments show that Spark-234K consistently outperforms existing scientific reasoning datasets while achieving stronger performance with significantly fewer training samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARK，一个基于科学论文论证结构（主张-证据-推导）的推理数据合成框架，将论文提炼为紧凑的推理骨架，从机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准四个视角合成高质量推理任务，并构建了Spark-234K数据集；实验表明该数据集在更少训练样本下优于现有科学推理数据集。
AI.motivation: 开源模型在科学推理上表现欠佳，主要原因是缺乏高质量的科学推理训练数据。现有数据集多被事实回忆或公式化解题所主导，缺乏对机制理解、证据支撑推理和假设评估的强调，难以支撑模型形成真正的科学推理能力。
AI.method: 提出基于论文的合成框架SPARK，构建于涵盖10个学科的大规模论文语料Sci-Base之上。核心思路是将论文的主张-证据-推导结构作为推理合成的基本单元：首先将每篇论文提炼为捕捉核心主张与支撑证据的紧凑推理骨架，实现自包含问题生成；然后从机制推理、假设证伪、定量推导、边界校准四个科学视角合成推理任务；最后通过一致性验证阶段剔除无依据或矛盾的输出，从而构建Spark-234K数据集。
AI.result: 构建了Spark-234K科学推理数据集，其难度与多样性显著高于现有资源。实验表明该数据集在训练效果上持续优于现有科学推理数据集，且仅需显著更少的训练样本即可取得更强的性能。
AI.conclusion: SPARK验证了以论文论证结构为核心单元的推理合成范式能有效产出高质量、多样化的科学推理数据，显著缓解了开源模型在科学推理训练数据上的稀缺问题，为科学推理数据构建提供了新思路。

title: Source-Dependent Deference in Medical Imaging Agents Under Falsified Findings: A Pilot Audit
summary: Tool-using agents are being proposed for medical imaging, and their behaviour when a tool returns a false finding is largely unmeasured. We audit whether a ReAct-style tool-calling agent abandons an answer it has already given correctly once a falsified finding arrives, and whether that depends on how the finding is presented. On 20 VQA-RAD closed questions across four vendor-designated model tiers, the agent commits to an answer from the image alone; a negated finding is then delivered either as JSON from an analyze_image tool the agent invokes itself, or as quoted prose attributed to a radiologist. Our outcome is the commission-error rate over cases answered correctly without any tool. Deference is much higher under the prose-attributed claim: at the strongest tier the agent revised its correct answer in 10 of 13 cases against 1 of 13 under the tool (exact McNemar p=0.0039, Holm-adjusted 0.012). We do not claim this isolates the source label. Attribution travels with the delivery channel in our design, and exposure differs because the tool claim reaches the agent only when it calls the tool. The finding is a joint source-and-delivery asymmetry from a small-scale pilot whose pre-specified stopping rule was not met.

AI.tldr: 针对医学影像工具调用智能体（ReAct风格）的审计研究。在20个VQA-RAD闭卷问题上，智能体先仅凭图像独立作答，随后获得一个被否定的（伪造）发现，该发现或以JSON形式来自其自身调用的analyze_image工具，或以带引号的散文形式归因于放射科医生。结果显示对散文归因说法的顺从率远高于工具JSON输出：最强模型层级中，智能体在13个答对案例里有10个被说服改答，而工具条件下仅1/13（exact McNemar p=0.0039, Holm校正0.012）。作者明确指出无法将差异单独归因于信息来源标签，因为来源标签与投递渠道（channel）捆绑在一起，且工具条件下智能体只有主动调用工具才能接触到该信息；该发现来自小规模试点，且预先设定的停止规则未满足。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型智能体正被引入医学影像领域，但它们在工具返回错误发现时的行为在很大程度上未被测量。作者想审计：当被伪造（否定）的发现到来时，ReAct风格的智能体是否会放弃它原本已经正确给出的答案，以及这是否取决于该错误发现以何种方式呈现。
AI.method: 在20个VQA-RAD闭卷问题上、跨四个由供应商划定的模型层级进行审计。流程：智能体先仅凭图像给出答案；随后一个否定性的发现以两种方式之一送达——(a) 作为JSON，来自智能体自行调用的analyze_image工具；或(b) 作为带引号的散文，归因于某位放射科医生。结局指标为"在未使用任何工具即答对的情况下发生改答（commission error）的比率"，并采用exact McNemar检验（含Holm校正）进行比较。
AI.result: 对散文归因（放射科医生）说法的顺从（deference）远高于工具JSON输出。在最强的模型层级，散文归因条件下智能体在13个答对案例中的10个修改了原本正确的答案，而工具条件下仅为1/13（exact McNemar p=0.0039，Holm校正后为0.012）。
AI.conclusion: 存在一个"来源+投递渠道"联合性的不对称效应：相对于来自自身工具的低信任度错误信息，智能体对以专家散文形式呈现的否定性发现表现出显著更高的顺从。但作者严谨地声明，该设计无法将来源标签与投递渠道解耦（归因随渠道一同变化），且工具条件下的暴露机会不同（只有智能体调用工具时才会收到工具声明），因此结果只是来自未达到预定停止规则的小规模试点研究，需谨慎解读、不可过度泛化。

title: Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model and a Tokenizer-Aware, Paired Evaluation
summary: Brazilian Portuguese remains under-served by open language models, and the few that exist are difficult to reproduce and are often compared without measures of uncertainty. We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics. We evaluate the model against nine open baselines on four Portuguese benchmarks under a single harness. Every comparison reports a standard error and a paired significance test, and the harness is validated against previously published numbers. On last-word prediction Manacá-1B is the strongest model below the 7B scale, exceeding both Tucano-1b1 and Tucano-2b4 on LAMBADA-PT with large paired margins; it is competitive on commonsense completion and near chance on multiple-choice reasoning, as are all small base models. Along the way we document a concrete evaluation pitfall: converting a SentencePiece tokenizer with case-folding normalization to the HuggingFace fast format silently drops the normalizer, routing every capitalized token to byte-fallback and depressing scores in a way that is invisible in aggregate metrics. The uncorrected tokenizer lowered LAMBADA-PT accuracy from 45.3 to 25.0; we quantify the effect and provide a one-line fix that reproduces the training tokenizer exactly. Code, raw training and evaluation logs, per-example prediction vectors, the model weights, and the corrected tokenizer are released so that every number in this paper can be recomputed.

AI.tldr: 本文发布 Manacá-1B，一个从零训练、含 17.2 亿参数的巴西葡萄牙语开源解码器模型，并配套完全容器化、可复现的预训练流程、完整日志与统一评测框架。作者在四个葡语基准上与九个开源基线对比，所有比较均报告标准误与配对显著性检验，并验证了评测框架与已发表结果一致。Manacá-1B 在 LAMBADA-PT 末词预测上成为 7B 以下规模的最强模型（超过 Tucano-1b1 与 Tucano-2b4），在常识补全上具有竞争力，在多选推理上接近随机水平（与所有小规模基础模型一致）。此外，论文揭示了一个评测陷阱：将带 case-folding 归一化的 SentencePiece tokenizer 转为 HuggingFace fast 格式时会静默丢失归一化器，导致所有大写 token 走 byte-fallback 并严重拉低分数（LAMBADA-PT 从 45.3 降至 25.0），作者量化了影响并给出了可精确复现训练 tokenizer 的一行修复。
AI.motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语在开放语言模型方面资源匮乏，现有的少数模型难以复现，且评测时通常不报告不确定性度量。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供可复现、可严格统计比较的开放模型。
AI.method: 从零预训练 17.2 亿参数的解码器模型 Manacá-1B，采用完全容器化的可复现流水线；预训练过程稳定（零跳过/NaN 步、损失尖峰可自恢复），并公开完整日志与动力学。在统一评测框架下，于四个葡语基准上与九个开放基线比较，每项比较均报告标准误与配对显著性检验，并对照已发表数字验证框架有效性。此外，诊断并量化了 tokenizer 转换缺陷（SentencePiece 的 case-folding 归一化在转为 HF fast 格式时静默丢失），提供一行修复代码。
AI.result: 在 LAMBADA-PT 末词预测上，Manacá-1B 是 7B 以下最强模型，以较大的配对显著性优势超过 Tucano-1b1 和 Tucano-2b4；在常识补全上具有竞争力；在多选推理上接近随机水平（与所有小规模基础模型一致）。tokenizer 缺陷使 LAMBADA-PT 准确率从 45.3 降至 25.0，修复后可以精确复现训练 tokenizer。代码、训练与评测日志、逐样本预测向量、模型权重及修正后的 tokenizer 全部公开，论文中的每个数字均可重算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过 Manacá-1B 显著改善了巴西葡萄牙语的开放模型生态，强调可复现性与统计严格性（标准误、配对显著性检验、评测框架验证）；同时揭示并修复了 tokenizer 转换中的隐性缺陷，提醒社区注意评测管线中的细节可能静默扭曲分数。作者通过开源全部资产，确保结果的完全可重算性。

title: ToxLens: A Reproducible Graph-Learning Framework for Leakage-Aware, Uncertainty-Calibrated Molecular Toxicity Prediction
summary: Molecular toxicity prediction is increasingly used to prioritise compounds before experimental testing, but conventional benchmark performance can overstate practical utility when structurally related molecules occur across training and test folds. We introduce ToxLens, a reproducible multi-task graph-learning framework for 11 toxicity endpoints spanning Ames mutagenicity, acute oral toxicity, hERG inhibition, and Tox21 nuclear-receptor and stress-response assays. The workflow combines conservative chemical curation, sphere-exclusion filtering, a leakage-aware UMAP-HDBSCAN split, parallel graph and global-feature encoders joined by late concatenation, temperature-scaled Monte Carlo dropout with conformal-style prediction sets, applicability-domain analysis, and SHAP-guided toxicophore discovery with occlusion controls. On the leakage-controlled test fold, a five-seed soft-voting ensemble achieved a Matthews correlation coefficient score of 0.44, an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve score of 0.83, and an area under the precision-recall curve score of 0.58. It exceeded four ECFP4-based shallow baselines on all 11 endpoints under the same split and validation-based threshold-selection protocol. Controlled ablations showed that the global pathway was important, whereas late concatenation outperformed the tested gated and feature-wise linear modulation fusion variants. Conformal-style prediction sets revealed substantial endpoint-specific variation in set efficiency, and discrimination and calibration improved with similarity to the training domain. Retraining on fixed published Tox21 Challenge and TDA folds produced competitive, but not uniformly state-of-the-art, performance. SHAP-guided occlusion and consensus subgraph mining yielded model-derived structural hypotheses, 44 of which contained at least one occurrence that passed the predefined counterfactual criteria.

AI.tldr: ToxLens 是一个可复现的多任务图学习框架，用于 11 个毒性终点预测。其核心贡献在于识别并解决传统基准评测因训练/测试集间结构相似分子导致的高估问题，通过泄漏感知的 UMAP-HDBSCAN 划分、并行图与全局特征编码器、温度缩放 Monte Carlo dropout 结合 conformal 风格的预测集、适用域分析与 SHAP 引导的毒效团发现，在泄漏受控的测试集上实现了稳健且可校准的预测性能，并产出可解释的结构假设。
AI.motivation: 分子毒性预测被广泛用于实验测试前的化合物优先级排序，但传统基准性能会因训练集与测试集之间存在结构相关的分子（数据泄漏）而夸大实际实用性，导致模型在真实场景中的可靠性被高估。
AI.method: 构建 ToxLens 多任务图学习框架：(1) 覆盖 Ames 致突变性、急性口服毒性、hERG 抑制及 Tox21 核受体和应激反应检测共 11 个终点；(2) 工作流包含保守化学整理、球面排除过滤、泄漏感知的 UMAP-HDBSCAN 划分、并行的图编码器与全局特征编码器经晚期拼接融合、温度缩放 Monte Carlo dropout 与 conformal 风格预测集、适用域分析，以及带遮挡对照的 SHAP 引导毒效团发现。
AI.result: 在泄漏受控的测试折上，五种子软投票集成取得 MCC 0.44、AUROC 0.83、AUPRC 0.58；在相同划分与基于验证集阈值选择协议下，全部 11 个终点上优于四种基于 ECFP4 的浅层基线。受控消融表明全局通路重要，晚期拼接优于所测的门控与 FiLM 融合变体。Conformal 风格预测集显示终点间集合效率差异显著，且判别与校准随训练域相似度提升。在固定已发表的 Tox21 Challenge 与 TDA 划分上重训性能具有竞争力但并非全面最优。SHAP 引导的遮挡与共识子图挖掘得到模型推导的结构假设，其中 44 个包含至少一个满足预定反事实判据的出现。
AI.conclusion: ToxLens 提供了一套泄漏感知、可复现且可解释的毒性预测方案，兼顾校准良好的不确定性量化与结构层次的毒效团假设，能够更真实地反映模型在化合物优先级排序中的实际应用价值，并为后续实验验证提供可操作的结构线索。

title: LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs
summary: Modular compression has enabled considerable parameter reduction in LLMs while preserving strong language understanding and downstream task accuracy. However, existing joint modular compression methods primarily rely on activation statistics, leaving loss-sensitivity information and its module-level characterization underexplored. We investigate addressing this gap with LaMoC, a loss-aware modular compression methodology that blends activation and Empirical Fisher statistics through gradient-error alignment. LaMoC improves joint compression by selecting compression statistics that better align local module reconstruction error with the downstream loss. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) We characterize the Empirical Fisher as a module-level loss-aware proxy that can be blended with the activation statistics required for compression. (2) We reformulate joint modular compression as a two-tiered optimization problem that minimizes module reconstruction error while tuning the activation and gradient information blending rate. (3) We implement an empirically driven methodology with statistical validation to solve the resulting compression problem. We evaluate LaMoC across four model families spanning eight models. On the 4-8B models, LaMoC achieves an average 2.5% reduction in perplexity and a 1% relative improvement in task accuracy over state-of-the-art modular compression methods.

AI.tldr: LaMoC 提出了一种损失感知的模块化压缩方法，通过梯度误差对齐将激活统计量与经验 Fisher 信息混合，将联合模块化压缩重构为两层级优化问题，在 4-8B 模型上平均降低困惑度 2.5%、任务准确率相对提升 1%。
AI.motivation: 现有联合模块化压缩方法主要依赖激活统计量，未充分利用损失敏感度信息及其在模块层面的刻画，导致压缩统计量与下游损失的关联不足。作者旨在通过融合损失敏感度信息弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 LaMoC：(1) 将经验 Fisher 信息刻画为模块级的损失感知代理，并与压缩所需的激活统计量进行混合；(2) 将联合模块化压缩重构为两层级优化问题，在最小化模块重构误差的同时调节激活与梯度信息的混合率；(3) 采用具有统计验证的经验驱动方法求解该压缩问题。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族、八个模型上评估。在 4-8B 模型上，相比最先进的模块化压缩方法，LaMoC 平均降低困惑度 2.5%，任务准确率相对提升 1%。
AI.conclusion: 将激活统计量与经验 Fisher 信息通过梯度误差对齐进行混合，能更好地使局部模块重构误差与下游损失对齐，从而在显著减少参数的同时在语言理解与下游任务精度上优于现有方法。

title: Foundation and Multimodal Large Language Models for Face Presentation and Morph Attack Detection
summary: Face recognition systems are increasingly deployed in security-critical applications, yet they remain vulnerable to presentation and morph attacks. Presentation attack detection (PAD) and morphing attack detection (MAD) are therefore essential components of trustworthy face biometrics. Despite advancements in PAD and MAD methods, existing detectors suffer from limited generalization and degrade in cross-dataset evaluation. In this paper, we systematically investigate whether general-purpose foundation models (FMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode PAD-relevant and MAD-relevant information, and how such models can best be deployed for both tasks. We study five approaches with increasing access to the internal information of the model: (i) zero-shot prompting of off-the-shelf MLLMs; (ii) training a shallow model on the next-token logit probabilities at the output of the MLLM; (iii) parameter-efficient fine-tuning on task-specific question-answer data, yielding two specialized MLLMs, called PADLLM and MADLLM, which additionally provide textual reasoning for their decisions; (iv) linear probing of frozen vision encoders; and (v) fine-tuning of vision encoders of FMs and MLLMs. We benchmark 16 open-weight MLLMs and 30 vision encoder backbones on four PAD datasets (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU) and four MAD datasets (FFHQ, FRGC, FRLL, and FERET). Our experiments show that FMs and MLLMs can achieve significant performance for PAD and MAD. In addition, the fine-tuned models achieve state-of-the-art detection performance in cross-dataset evaluation, indicating that general-purpose pretrained representations carry substantial attack-relevant information. Source code of all our experiments will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了通用基础模型（FMs）和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是否编码人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）与形态攻击检测（MAD）相关信息，通过在16个MLLM和30个视觉编码器骨干上、跨越4个PAD数据集和4个MAD数据集，按内部信息访问程度递增的五种部署方式（零样本提示、logit浅层分类、参数高效微调、线性探测、视觉编码器微调）进行基准评测，结果表明微调后的模型在跨数据集评估中达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别系统在安全关键应用中日益普及，但仍易受呈现攻击和形态攻击威胁，因此PAD和MAD是可信人脸生物识别的重要组成部分。现有检测器泛化能力有限，在跨数据集评估中性能显著下降，需要探索更强大、更具泛化性的检测范式。
AI.method: 提出五种按模型内部信息访问程度递增的部署策略：(i)对现成MLLM进行零样本提示；(ii)在MLLM输出的下一token logit概率上训练浅层模型；(iii)在任务特定问答数据上进行参数高效微调，得到两个专用MLLM——PADLLM和MADLLM，并附带文本推理；(iv)对冻结视觉编码器进行线性探测；(v)对FM和MLLM的视觉编码器进行微调。在4个PAD数据集（MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack、OULU-NPU）和4个MAD数据集（FFHQ、FRGC、FRLL、FERET）上对16个开源MLLM和30个视觉编码器骨干进行评测。
AI.result: 实验表明FMs和MLLMs在PAD和MAD任务上能达到显著性能；微调后的模型在跨数据集评估中达到最先进的检测性能，表明通用预训练表示蕴含大量与攻击相关的信息。
AI.conclusion: 通用基础模型和MLLM的预训练表示携带大量PAD/MAD相关判别信息，经适当微调即可在跨数据集场景下超越专用检测器，为可泛化的人脸攻击检测提供了新方向；全部实验源代码将公开发布。

title: Verification-Aware Training for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

AI.tldr: 提出验证感知训练（VAT），一种仅修改训练目标的即插即用框架，通过模拟推测解码的逐位置顺序验证过程，将接受/拒绝模式转化为草稿模型的监督信号，从而在不改变草稿架构、目标模型或推理流程的前提下提升平均接受长度和端到端加速比。
AI.motivation: 推测解码中，草稿模型生成的候选token由目标模型在前向传播中顺序验证，且从首个被拒绝位置起所有后续位置都会被丢弃。然而现有草稿模型训练仅采用固定的逐位置权重对目标模型进行token级模仿，既未反映验证的顺序特性，也未反映“首个拒绝点之后全部作废”的特性，导致训练目标与推理时的实际验证过程不匹配。
AI.method: VAT由两个组件构成：(i) 验证头（verification head）：一个轻量级、与草稿模型联合训练的二分类器，用于监督草稿模型判断每个位置能否在顺序验证中存活；(ii) 验证自适应加权（verification-adaptive weighting）：用“在样本首个拒绝点之前保持全权重、从该点起重新锚定并衰减”的加权方案取代固定的逐位置权重。VAT仅修改训练目标，可叠加于现有方法之上，无需改动草稿架构、目标模型或推理过程。
AI.result: 在EAGLE-3和DFlash上，针对Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B，VAT使平均接受长度最多提升11.4%，墙钟时间加速比最多提升8.7%，并在数学、代码和对话基准上均取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: VAT是一套与推理验证过程对齐的训练目标，通过模拟验证并据此调整监督信号与权重，能有效提升推测解码的token接受率和实际推理速度，且具有即插即用、架构无关的良好可迁移性。

title: Measuring Memory and Generalization as Separable Geometric Channels: The Topo^2 Framework
summary: Deep networks trained on noisy labels simultaneously generalize on clean data and memorize flipped labels. These are usually conflated as pressures on one capacity. We present Topo^2, a measurement framework that makes them causally separable, measurable, and law-governed. Persistent-homology H1 structure of the representation space separates into a within-class manifold channel (a function of the training stopping point) and a cross-class channel (a monotone readout of memorized flipped samples). An intervention, the FM0 prescription (zero loss on flipped samples from epoch 0), reaches each setting's generalization ceiling while memorizing essentially nothing. Within the framework we establish a law set with graded evidence: (L2) FM0 separation prescription (9/9); (L1) the within-channel as a training-position function (mid-rise 6/6; convergence-back CIFAR 3/3, SVHN 2/3); (L3) a ring-construction identity (definitional, not a law); and TLS (memory-generalization topological layering): memory is causally additive, anchored (silencing clean collapses the representation), invertible (stripping memory restores near-ceiling generalization), and quantitatively billable (the memorization cost law, effective slope coefficient C ~ 0.38 at the reference capacity: CIFAR-10 0.3801 / SVHN 0.3806 / CIFAR-100 0.384 / VGG 0.3715, capacity-dependent in general and traced to clean-sample feature displacement). We also publish the framework's boundaries: a falsification ledger of nine dead ends, and an instrument-vindication section that excludes six families of global statistics as explanations of the within-channel. The framework turns "memorization" from an ill-defined capacity into a measurable, separable, invertible topological layer.

AI.tldr: 提出 Topo² 测量框架，利用表示空间的持久同调 H1 结构将深度网络中的“泛化（干净数据）”与“记忆（翻转标签）”因果分离，证明记忆是一个可测量、可分离、可逆的拓扑层，并给出 FM0 处方及相关定律集。
AI.motivation: 在噪声标签下训练的深度网络会同时在干净数据上泛化并记忆翻转标签，但这两者通常被混为一谈、视为同一容量上的压力。作者旨在使二者在因果上可分、可测量，并受定律支配，从而把“记忆”从一个定义不清的容量概念转化为可量化的对象。
AI.method: 构建 Topo² 测量框架：利用表示空间的持久同调 H1 结构，将其分解为“类内流形通道”（作为训练停止点的函数）与“跨类通道”（对记忆翻转样本的单调读出）。提出干预处方 FM0（从第 0 个 epoch 起对翻转样本置零损失）。在此框架内建立定律集：L2（FM0 分离处方，9/9 数据集验证）、L1（类内通道作为训练位置函数，中途上升 6/6，收敛回退 CIFAR 3/3、SVHN 2/3）、L3（环构造恒等式，属定义性）以及 TLS（记忆-泛化拓扑分层律），并附九条死胡同的证伪账目与排除六类全局统计量的仪器印证部分。
AI.result: FM0 处方在每种设定下均达到泛化上限，同时几乎不记忆任何样本。证据分级：L2 9/9、L1（中途上升 6/6；收敛回退 CIFAR 3/3、SVHN 2/3）。TLS 表明记忆具有因果可加性、锚定性（清除干净样本会令表示坍缩）、可逆性（剥离记忆可恢复近上限泛化）与可定量计费性（记忆代价定律的有效斜率系数 C≈0.38，参考容量下 CIFAR-10 0.3801 / SVHN 0.3806 / CIFAR-100 0.384 / VGG 0.3715，一般随容量变化，并追溯到干净样本特征位移）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把“记忆”从定义不清的能力转变为可测量、可分离、可逆的拓扑层，并以证伪账目（九条死路）和排除性验证（六类全局统计量）划定框架边界，使记忆与泛化可在经验上被分开研究。

title: Rethinking the Test-Time Prompt Tuning Objective from the Perspective of Calibration
summary: Test-time prompt tuning (TPT) has emerged as a powerful paradigm, refining prompts for each test sample via entropy minimization (EM) over multiple augmented views. However, we identify a limitation in the standard EM-based adaptation: it inherently drives the model toward overconfident predictions disregarding sample-specific uncertainty, leading to significant calibration degradation. To address these limitations, we propose a new objective that replaces the conventional EM loss by aligning the original-view prediction with a target distribution derived from augmented views via cross-entropy, while adversarially incorporating the entropy of the target distribution to capture sample-specific uncertainty. Furthermore, to better construct this target distribution, we apply confidence-aware temperature scaling to each augmented-view prediction according to its confidence, sharpening confident predictions while softening uncertain ones. This formulation allows the model to increase confidence only when the target distribution is reliable, while preserving uncertainty when it reflects ambiguous or conflicting augmented-view predictions. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that our approach not only achieves state-of-the-art accuracy but also significantly improves model calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文针对测试时提示调优（TPT）中基于熵最小化（EM）的自适应会引发过度自信预测并导致校准退化的问题，提出用交叉熵将原视图预测对齐到由增强视图构建的目标分布上，并通过对抗式熵项捕捉样本级不确定性；同时引入置信度感知的温度缩放来构造更可靠的目标分布。实验表明该方法在取得最先进精度的同时显著改善了模型校准。
AI.motivation: 标准的熵最小化（EM）式测试时自适应存在局限：它内在驱使模型产生过度自信的预测，忽略了样本特定的不确定性，导致标定（calibration）严重退化。因此需要在保证测试时适应性能的同时，兼顾预测的置信度校准。
AI.method: 1）用交叉熵损失替代传统EM损失，将原始视图的预测与由增强视图生成的目标分布对齐；2）在目标分布熵上采用对抗式建模（最小化交叉熵的同时最大化目标分布熵）以捕获样本特定不确定性；3）通过置信度感知的温度缩放对每个增强视图预测进行处理，即对高置信预测锐化、对不确定预测软化，从而构造更可靠的目标分布。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法不仅取得了最先进的分类精度，还显著改善了模型校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 该目标函数使模型仅在目标分布可靠时提升置信度，而在目标分布反映模糊或冲突的增强视图预测时保持不确定性，从而在测试时自适应中实现精度与校准的双重提升。

title: Beyond Global Realism: Virtual Try-On Evaluation and Optimization with Dimension-wise Garment Fidelity Assessment
summary: Virtual try-on (VTON) requires not only realistic generation but also faithful preservation of garment characteristics. However, existing evaluation metrics such as PSNR, SSIM, KID and FID struggle to measure the consistency between the generated and reference garments, particularly in capturing the multi-dimensional characteristics of garment fidelity. To address this, we propose DAT: a Dimension-wise Assessment framework for virtual Try-on, which decomposes garment consistency into seven interpretable dimensions: silhouette, color, neckline and sleeve shape, major decoration and structure, material texture, fine-detail fidelity, and logo preservation, each formulated as a discrete attribute-level prediction task. To train this specialized assessment model, we adopt a two-stage learning paradigm comprising large-scale weak supervision on 50K samples, followed by refinement on 10K higher-quality annotations obtained via multi-model voting. Furthermore, we employ weighted cross-entropy loss to mitigate the severe label imbalance inherent across evaluation dimensions. Beyond its role as an evaluation framework, the assessment model can be integrated into reinforcement learning optimization of Qwen-Image-Edit for VTON, where dimension-wise rewards are adaptively aggregated to emphasize under-optimized aspects during training. Experimental results show that our method (8B parameters) achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of balanced accuracy, SROCC, and PLCC, outperforming strong proprietary models such as Gemini-3.1, Qwen3.7-plus, and GPT-5.5, while also serving as an effective optimization signal for reward-guided VTON generation

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAT，一个面向虚拟试穿（VTON）的维度级服装一致性评估框架，将服装保真度分解为七个可解释维度（轮廓、颜色、领口与袖型、主要装饰与结构、材质纹理、细节保真、Logo保留），并以两阶段学习（50K弱监督+10K多模型投票精标注）训练评估模型；该模型既能作为评估指标，也能作为奖励信号用于Qwen-Image-Edit的强化学习优化。实验表明方法在均衡准确率、SROCC和PLCC上超越Gemini-3.1、Qwen3.7-plus和GPT-5.5等模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VTON评估指标（PSNR、SSIM、KID、FID）无法准确衡量生成服装与参考服装之间的一致性，尤其在捕捉服装保真度的多维特性方面存在明显不足，因此需要一种能够细粒度、可解释地评估服装一致性的新框架。
AI.method: 将服装一致性分解为七个可解释维度（轮廓、颜色、领口与袖型、主要装饰与结构、材质纹理、细部保真、Logo保留），每个维度建模为离散的属性级预测任务；采用两阶段学习范式，先在50K样本上进行大规模弱监督，再在10K更高质量标注（通过多模型投票获得）上进行精调；使用加权交叉熵损失缓解各评估维度固有的标签不平衡问题；此外，可将该评估模型集成到Qwen-Image-Edit的VTON强化学习优化中，自适应聚合各维度奖励以突出训练中优化不足的方面。
AI.result: 该8B参数方法在均衡准确率、SROCC和PLCC上达到最先进性能，超越Gemini-3.1、Qwen3.7-plus和GPT-5.5等强专有模型，同时可作为有效的优化信号用于奖励引导的VTON生成。
AI.conclusion: DAT证明了将服装一致性分解为多维度可解释评估任务的有效性，既提供了超越传统指标和强专有模型的评估能力，又能反哺生成模型的强化学习优化，为VTON的评估与生成提供了闭环方案。

title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy optimization. CAST analyzes agent trajectories to synthesize structured rationales explaining action validity under partial observability. The resulting critique model is used to construct critique-aware training data for optimizing the policy model. Fine-tuning Qwen3-family models on dynamic tool-calling benchmarks, CAST improves reliability across domains, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B by over 10% pass^4 on Retail tasks and yielding an additional 9% improvement on Telehealth in an out-of-domain setting. These results demonstrate that critique-aware training improves the robustness of LLM agents in realistic dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAST，一个基于批判（critique）的训练框架，将长时程智能体任务中的稀疏结果转化为动作级监督信号，用于训练批判模型和优化策略模型，从而提升 LLM 智能体在多步骤、多轮动态环境中的可靠性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地部署在长时程、交互式、有状态的动态环境中，单个错误动作（如错误退款）可能造成不可逆失败且必须在执行前被拦截；此类失败并非每次运行都出现，而是在多次尝试中累积显现，因此跨步骤和跨试验的可靠性至关重要。然而前沿 LLM 也难以解释某动作为何有误，尤其在由领域策略约束的复杂交织轨迹中；现有基于提示（prompt）的批判代理方法能力有限，而基于优化的方法缺乏系统性生成丰富验证理由（rationale）用于训练的手段。
AI.method: CAST 是一种批判感知（critique-aware）的训练框架，先把稀疏的任务级结果转化为动作级监督信号，用于学习批判模型并优化策略；它分析智能体轨迹，在部分可观测性下合成结构化的理由，解释每一步动作的有效性；随后利用该批判模型构造批判感知的训练数据来优化策略模型，并对 Qwen3 系列模型在动态工具调用基准上进行微调。
AI.result: 在动态工具调用基准上，CAST 提升了跨领域可靠性：在 Retail 任务上比 GPT-OSS-120B 的 pass^4 指标高出超过 10%，并在 Telehealth 这一域外（out-of-domain）设置上额外提升 9%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，批判感知式训练能够显著提升 LLM 智能体在真实动态环境中的鲁棒性与可靠性，说明将动作级验证理由融入训练对解决长时程交互任务中的不可逆错误具有实际价值。

title: When the Martingale Never Stops Firing: Anytime-Valid Gating on Real Forecast Streams
summary: Machine learning systems are increasingly corrected while they run, and the decision of when to intervene is increasingly delegated to statistical monitors. Anytime-valid inference promises evidence that can be acted on at any moment, exactly the guarantee this setting needs, and it is moving from theory into deployed monitoring. Conformal test martingales are the change-detection instrument, and Ville's inequality caps their false-alarm probability on exchangeable data. The guarantee is conditional. A deployment inherits it only if the stream it monitors behaves exchangeably. The premise is hardest to satisfy where these monitors are most useful, on dependent data and inside loops where the monitor modifies the learner whose scores it reads. It is also rarely measured. We measure it in a pre-specified case study, where such a monitor gates the online updates of a Kalman adapter correcting frozen time-series foundation models on five forecasting streams. On exchangeable synthetic streams, the same implementation fires in at most 1 of 60 runs. On the real streams, at alpha = 0.05, 135 of 135 clean-stream runs fired. The construction does not explain the firing; the failure comes from the deployed score stream itself. Repeated fires hold the gate's drift response active, and the gated filter amplifies the very transient it was designed to prevent. The component worth keeping makes no validity claim. Huber-style gating of the filter's own updates cuts isolated-spike degradation by an order of magnitude with no dataset specific tuning. Anytime-valid methods proposed for dependent data should therefore be accompanied by null-calibration controls and mechanism traces.

AI.tldr: 本文考察"任意有效推断"（anytime-valid inference）中的一致性检验鞅（conformal test martingale）在真实部署中的可靠性。作者在一个预先设定的案例研究中实测发现：在可交换的合成数据流上该监测器在60次运行中至多误报1次（符合Ville不等式），但在5条真实时间序列流上，α=0.05时135/135次都发生报警，协议失败源于部署后的得分流本身不满足可交换性前提。重复报警还会使门控滤波器放大本应抑制的瞬变；而作者改用类似Huber的门控（作用于滤波器自身更新）后，无须数据集特定调参即将孤立尖峰造成的性能退化降低一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统在运行中不断被在线修正，何时干预正逐渐交由统计监测器决定。任意有效推断提供了"可在任意时刻作出判断"的证据保证，正从理论走向部署。但一致性检验鞅的保证（Ville不等式限定的误报概率）是条件性的——仅当被监测数据流满足可交换性才成立。该前提在最需要监测器的地方（依赖数据、以及监测器会修改学习器的闭环循环中）最难满足，且几乎从未被实测。作者因此要在预留案例中直接测量这一前提。
AI.method: 作者在一个预先指定的案例研究中实测协议的可交换性前提：用一致性检验鞅门控一个Kalman适配器的在线更新，该适配器修正冻结的时间序列基础模型在5条预测流上的输出。实验分两部分：一是在可交换的合成流上验证实现是否满足误报上限；二是在真实流上（α=0.05）观察干净运行的报警行为。同时对比了两类门控机制：基于统计监测器（鞅）的报警门控，与作用于滤波器自身更新的Huber式鲁棒门控，并记录重复报警对门控漂移响应及滤波器行为的机制性影响。
AI.result: 在可交换合成流上，同一实现60次运行至多报警1次，误报控制有效；但在真实流上α=0.05时135/135次干净运行全部报警，说明失败源于部署后的得分流本身，而非构造过程。重复报警使门控的漂移响应持续激活，被门控的滤波器反而放大了它本应防止的瞬变。相比之下，Huber式（作用于滤波器自身更新的门控）在不做任何数据集特定调参的情况下，将孤立尖峰造成的退化降低一个数量级，且该组件不作任何有效性声明。
AI.conclusion: 针对依赖数据提出的任意有效方法，在部署时其可交换性前提会被系统性地违背（尤其在有反馈闭环时），因此这类方法应配套"零假设校准控制"（null-calibration controls）和"机制追踪"（mechanism traces）来暴露和诊断前提失效。值得保留的是不声称任何有效性的鲁棒门控组件，其实际效果远好于带有效性声明但前提不成立的统计监测器。

title: CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding
summary: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD.

AI.tldr: CoLa-ICD 是一个知识增强的医学自动编码框架，旨在通过外部术语扩充、编码间依赖建模以及标签语义与临床证据的强对齐，解决长尾 ICD 编码预测的难题，并在 AUC、F1 和 P@k 指标上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 自动医学编码将医学文本分配给 ICD 代码，但面临长文档、标签分布不均衡和术语多样等挑战。尤其是罕见代码，训练样本极少且容易与语义相似的标签混淆，导致长尾预测性能不佳。
AI.method: CoLa-ICD 采用知识增强策略：用外部术语丰富 ICD 标签的语义表示；建模相关编码之间的依赖关系；并学习更强的标签语义与临床证据之间的对齐，以提升长尾编码的预测能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，CoLa-ICD 在更大、更稀疏的标签空间中长尾预测收益更为显著，并在 AUC、F1 和 P@k 等指标上取得最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: CoLa-ICD 通过融合外部知识与标签依赖建模，有效缓解了罕见编码的学习困难，为长尾医学编码预测提供了一种通用且高效的解决方案，并开源了代码以支持复现。

title: RegionCache: Semantic-Aware Region Reuse for Efficient Multi-Turn Image Generation
summary: Real-world image generation often involves multi-turn editing, where users iteratively modify small regions while most image content remains unchanged. However, existing diffusion transformer (DiT)-based editing pipelines recompute the entire image at every turn, causing substantial redundant computation. Existing DiT acceleration methods further ignore semantic correspondence across prompts, leading to unnecessary recomputation or unsafe reuse that harms editing quality. To address this, we propose RegionCache, a semantic-aware reuse framework for multi-turn image editing that selectively reuses diffusion states from unchanged regions. RegionCache detects reusable regions through semantic overlap between consecutive prompts and cross-attention localization, and adopts an adaptive reuse schedule based on prompt similarity and contextual consistency. Experiments on PixArt-alpha demonstrate that RegionCache achieves 1.43x--2.55x end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable image quality. Code is available at https://github.com/hebutBryant/RegionCache.

AI.tldr: 提出了面向多轮图像编辑的语义感知复用框架 RegionCache，通过检测连续提示间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位来选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态，并在 PixArt-alpha 上实现 1.43x–2.55x 端到端加速且保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的图像生成常涉及多轮编辑，用户只修改小区域而大部分内容保持不变；但现有基于扩散 Transformer（DiT）的编辑流程每轮都重算整张图像，造成大量冗余计算。已有的 DiT 加速方法又忽略了跨提示的语义对应关系，导致不必要的重算或可能损害编辑质量的不安全复用。
AI.method: 提出 RegionCache，一个用于多轮图像编辑的语义感知复用框架。它通过连续提示间的语义重叠和交叉注意力定位检测可复用区域，并基于提示相似度和上下文一致性采用自适应复用调度，选择性复用未变化区域的扩散状态。
AI.result: 在 PixArt-alpha 上的实验表明，RegionCache 实现了 1.43x–2.55x 的端到端加速，同时保持可比的图像质量。
AI.conclusion: RegionCache 证明通过语义感知地复用未变化区域的扩散状态，可以有效消除多轮编辑中的冗余计算，在不牺牲图像质量的前提下显著提升端到端速度。

title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual grounding before symbolic deduction. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS), which converts each symbolic program into heterogeneous reasoning traces, including executable Python scripts and CoT-augmented variants. We further propose Perception-Augmented (PA) training, which parses diagrams into structured semantic clauses before deduction, and Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE) for efficient self-adaptive inference. Experiments on three geometry benchmarks show that our method consistently improves PGP-solving across model scales and achieves strong performance against both general-purpose MLLMs and specialized geometry solvers. Under test-time scaling, CG-MTE achieves comparable accuracy to high-budget self-consistency while reducing sampling cost by up to 8x. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS.

AI.tldr: 本文针对平面几何问题（PGP）求解中测试时扩展（TTS）在符号程序范式下失效的问题，提出多迹合成（MTS）将符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹，结合感知增强（PA）训练将图形解析为结构化语义子句，并设计共识引导多迹集成（CG-MTE）实现高效自适应推理，在三个几何基准上持续提升跨模型规模的求解性能，并以最高8倍的采样成本缩减达到与高预算自一致性相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 平面几何问题求解是多模态推理的关键基准，需要准确的视觉感知和精确的多步符号演绎。尽管测试时扩展在通用数学推理中表现出色，但在符号程序范式下无法有效扩展，其根本原因在于：一是刚性符号程序导致的推理多样性受限；二是符号演绎之前缺乏显式的视觉接地（图形理解）。
AI.method: 提出三项技术：（1）Multi-Trace Synthesis (MTS)，将每个符号程序转换为异构推理轨迹，包括可执行Python脚本和CoT增强变体，以提升推理多样性；（2）Perception-Augmented (PA) 训练，在演绎前将图形解析为结构化语义子句，增强显式视觉接地；（3）Consensus-Guided Multi-Trace Ensemble (CG-MTE)，通过共识引导实现高效的自适应推理。
AI.result: 在三个几何基准上的实验表明，所提方法在多个模型规模上一致地提升了PGP求解性能，并与通用MLLM和专用几何求解器相比取得强竞争力。在测试时扩展下，CG-MTE达到与高预算自一致性相当的精度，同时将采样成本降低最高8倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入多迹异质推理、感知增强训练与共识引导集成，有效解决了符号程序范式下测试时扩展的多样性不足与视觉接地缺失问题，实现了更高效、更准确的平面几何问题求解，且代码与数据已公开。

title: Tensor Methods for Language Models: From Token Representation to Training, Adaptation, Inference, Compression, and Interpretability
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are built from structured high-dimensional objects such as token representations, weights, adaptation updates, caches, and activations, whose multilinear structure is underexploited by the conventional matrix-centric view. Tensor decompositions and tensor networks provide a principled algebraic language for this structure, yet the literature often treats them as isolated compression mechanisms. This survey organizes tensor methods for LLMs through two complementary views: a seven-stage lifecycle taxonomy covering tokenization, embeddings, pre-training, adaptation, compression, inference, and interpretability, and a component view covering embeddings, attention, and feed-forward networks. We provide unified notation and theoretical foundations, analyze tensorization strategies for individual Transformer components, and compare methods at each lifecycle stage while making differences in evaluation protocols and model scales explicit. We further connect tensor methods to neighboring efficiency techniques and probabilistic tensor networks. Finally, we synthesize open challenges and introduce $ρ_{\rm gap}$, a metric for the compression-realization gap between theoretical memory reduction and measured system-level speedup. By treating tensorization as a common structural principle, the survey provides a structured entry point to tensorized language models and clarifies when parameter savings can plausibly translate into memory efficiency, computational efficiency, or interpretability. The GitHub page dedicated to this paper is accessible at \href{https://github.com/ma-tt-a/awesome-tensor-methods-for-llms}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文系统性地组织了大语言模型（LLM）中的张量方法，通过两个互补视角进行分类：七阶段生命周期分类法（涵盖分词、嵌入、预训练、适配、压缩、推理和可解释性）和组件视角（涵盖嵌入、注意力与前馈网络）。论文提供统一符号与理论基础，分析Transformer各组件的张量化策略，比较各生命周期阶段的方法，并明确不同评估协议与模型规模的差异。此外，论文将张量方法与其他效率技术及概率张量网络联系起来，提出压缩-实现差距度量ρ_gap（衡量理论内存缩减与实际系统级加速之间的差距），作为理解张量化何时能真正转化为内存效率、计算效率或可解释性的结构化入口。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型由结构化高维对象（如token表示、权重、适配更新、缓存和激活）构建，其多线性结构被传统以矩阵为中心的视角所忽视。张量分解和张量网络为这种结构提供了原则性的代数语言，但现有文献往往将它们视为孤立的压缩机制，缺少系统性的统一组织框架。
AI.method: 论文采用双视角组织框架：一是七阶段生命周期分类法（tokenization、embeddings、pre-training、adaptation、compression、inference、interpretability）；二是组件视角（embeddings、attention、feed-forward networks）。提供统一符号与理论基矗分析各Transformer组件的张量化策略，在各生命周期阶段比较方法并明确评估协议与模型规模的差异，同时连接邻近的效率技术（如剪枝、量化、蒸馏等）和概率张量网络。
AI.result: 提出ρ_gap这一度量指标，用于量化压缩-实现差距（theoretical memory reduction与measured system-level speedup之间的差距），阐明参数节省何时能合理地转化为内存效率、计算效率或可解释性。提供了结构化的方法比较，揭示了不同阶段张量化方案的评估协议差异，并综合了开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 将张量化视为一种共同的结构性原则，该综述为张量化语言模型提供了结构化入口，明确了参数节省与内存、计算效率及可解释性之间的转化条件，并为该领域提供了开放挑战的展望和配套GitHub资源。

title: LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Completion Combining Discrete Structural Coding with Similar Entity Information
comment: Accepted by ISWC 26 Posters and Demos Track
summary: Knowledge graph completion requires models to use both textual descriptions and relational structure. Existing LLM-based methods either encode KG structure as discrete tokens or refine a restricted set of candidate entities, and these two directions have largely been studied separately. We propose CoSC for LLM-based KGC, which combines discrete structural coding with similar entity information. Specifically, an LLM generates an initial candidate entity ranking from discrete structural codes, after which information from entities with structures similar to that of the query entity refines the ranking. Experiments on FB15k-237 show that CoSC outperforms existing baselines on MRR and Hits@10 while remaining competitive on Hits@1.

AI.tldr: 提出CoSC框架，将知识图谱结构编码为离散token并利用相似实体信息进行重排序，结合两种此前分离的研究路线以提升基于LLM的知识图谱补全性能。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱补全需要同时利用文本描述与关系结构信息。现有基于LLM的方法要么将KG结构编码为离散token，要么仅对受限候选实体集进行精排，这两类方向此前被分开研究，缺乏统一框架来兼顾结构编码的全局性与候选精排的细粒度优化。
AI.method: 提出CoSC（Combines discrete Structural Coding with similar entity information）。分为两阶段：首先，LLM基于离散结构编码生成初始候选实体排序；然后，利用与查询实体结构相似的实体的信息对该排序进行精细化重排。该方法将离散结构编码与相似实体信息融合进一个统一的LLM框架中。
AI.result: 在FB15k-237数据集上的实验表明，CoSC在MRR和Hits@10指标上优于现有基线，在Hits@1指标上与基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CoSC证明了将离散结构编码与相似实体信息相结合能够更充分地利用知识图谱的结构与文本信息，为基于LLM的知识图谱补全提供了一种更优的融合方案，具备在多个指标上超越现有方法的潜力。

title: PhasorNet: Learning Structure from Frequency for Real-Time Stereo Matching
summary: Accurate stereo matching remains challenging in ill-posed regions such as fine structures, reflective, or transparent objects, where appearance cues are often ambiguous or unreliable. To tackle this, we propose PhasorNet, a lightweight yet powerful framework that boosts geometric discrimination via frequency-domain cues. At its core, the Phase-Augmented Transformer (PAT) injects Fourier-derived phase information into the attention mechanism, yielding photometrically robust, structure-preserving features that prioritize structural consistency in difficult areas. Additionally, we develop a Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module (GCFRM) that combines a full-resolution convolutional stream with a lightweight attention-based stream (leveraging WQA and CDGA blocks) to efficiently preserve fine details and object boundaries without excessive overhead. Training is further enhanced by a multi-scale Edge-guided High-Error Region (EHR) loss that adaptively focuses optimization on high-error and edge regions, guiding hierarchical cost volume refinement. With only 5.3M parameters, PhasorNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the challenging ETH3D benchmark while exhibiting excellent cross-domain generalization on KITTI, delivering an efficient and practical solution for accurate real-time stereo matching.

AI.tldr: PhasorNet是一个轻量级立体匹配框架，通过频域相位信息增强几何判别能力。其核心Phase-Augmented Transformer(PAT)将傅里叶相位信息注入注意力机制，提升困难区域的鲁棒性；Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module(GCFRM)结合全分辨率卷积流与轻量注意力流以保留细节和边界；同时采用多尺度边缘引导高误差区域(EHR)损失函数自适应聚焦优化。仅5.3M参数即在ETH3D上取得SOTA性能并在KITTI上展现出色的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 在细结构、反射或透明物体等不适定区域中，外观线索往往模糊或不可靠，导致精确的立体匹配仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在这些区域缺乏足够的几何判别能力，需要一种能利用更具鲁棒性的线索（如频域相位信息）来提升匹配性能的轻量高效方案。
AI.method: 提出PhasorNet框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) Phase-Augmented Transformer(PAT)将傅里叶派生的相位信息注入注意力机制，产生光度鲁棒、结构保持的特征；(2) Geometry-Context Fusion Refinement Module(GCFRM)结合全分辨率卷积流与基于WQA和CDGA块的轻量注意力流，高效保留精细细节与物体边界；(3) 多尺度边缘引导高误差区域(EHR)损失，自适应聚焦高误差和边缘区域，引导分层代价体细化。
AI.result: 仅用5.3M参数，PhasorNet在挑战性的ETH3D基准上达到最先进水平，并在KITTI上展现出优秀的跨域泛化能力，实现了高效实用的实时立体匹配。
AI.conclusion: 通过将频率域相位信息与注意力机制相结合、辅以轻量高效的精化模块和针对性的损失函数，PhasorNet在保持极小模型规模的同时，在困难区域（如细结构、反射、透明物体）显著提升了立体匹配的几何判别能力，并在标准基准及跨域场景中均验证了其有效性与实用性。

title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general capability, and selectively invoke the SFT expert only when domain-specific knowledge is required. Specifically, we propose CPR (Critical-Point Routing), a token-level routing framework between a base model and its expert derivative, based on critical tokens where the base model fails but the expert succeeds. We train a lightweight hierarchical router that estimates the expert-call probability per token, and pair it with a tailored inference procedure that combines momentum smoothing and threshold gating. Across diverse model-domain configurations, CPR achieves state-of-the-art across all settings, surpassing SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering its general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, with minimal overhead from invoking the expert on only one-third of tokens.

AI.tldr: 针对监督微调（SFT）导致的大模型灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出 CPR（Critical-Point Routing）令牌级路由框架，在基础模型与SFT专家模型之间按令牌路由，仅在"关键令牌"（基础模型失败而专家成功之处）调用专家，从而在不牺牲通用能力的前提下提升领域性能。
AI.motivation: SFT是让大模型适配目标领域的事实标准，但常导致模型通用能力退化（灾难性遗忘）。现有方法通过修改SFT损失来缓解遗忘，但本质仍受制于"领域性能-通用能力"的权衡取舍，无法真正跳出此困境。
AI.method: 从模型层面解耦两种能力：保留原始基础模型负责通用能力，仅选择性地调用SFT专家模型处理领域特定知识。具体包括三个要点：（1）以"关键令牌"（基础模型预测失败而专家预测成功）作为路由依据；（2）训练一个轻量级层次化路由器，估计每个令牌的专家调用概率；（3）配合定制推理流程，结合动量平滑（momentum smoothing）与阈值门控（threshold gating）来决定何时调用专家。
AI.result: 在多种模型-领域配置下均达到最新最优（SOTA）：领域性能较SFT专家提升1.4-5.5%；通用能力下降从3.4-14.5%恢复至最多仅0.5%；且仅在约三分之一的令牌上调用专家，开销极小。
AI.conclusion: CPR通过令牌级路由在模型层面解耦通用与领域能力，成功跳出传统的领域-通用权衡，在提升领域性能的同时几乎完全恢复通用能力，且推理开销可控，为缓解灾难性遗忘提供了新的范式。

title: Trajectory-Initialized Neural Double Q-Routing for Large-Scale Overhead Hoist Transport Systems
summary: Large-scale industrial robot fleets share constrained physical infrastructure, making vehicle travel times dependent on safety separation, intersection access, downstream blocking, and station contention. We study this problem in overhead hoist transport (OHT) systems, a representative ceiling-mounted material-handling system used in semiconductor fabs. Static shortest-path routing cannot account for these time-varying traffic costs, whereas tabular Q-routing adapts online but learns each destination--node--action value independently, limiting information sharing across sparsely visited routing contexts and making startup behavior sensitive to inaccurate value estimates. We propose Neural Double Q-routing, which replaces destination-indexed tables with a shared state--action value network. The network is warm-started through return-to-go regression on mixed simulator-generated routing trajectories and then refined online using Double-Q updates, local congestion correction, and event-stratified structured replay. Across nine matched fleet-size--arrival-rate settings with 100, 150, and 200 OHTs, the proposed framework reduces mean completion time relative to tabular Double Q-routing by $0.8\%$--$8.8\%$. It achieves the lowest mean completion time among all compared methods in the six 150- and 200-OHT settings, whereas Dijkstra remains best in the three 100-OHT settings. Completed-task counts remain within $1\%$ of tabular Double Q-routing in eight of nine settings, and 95th-percentile completion time decreases in eight settings. In two matched startup scenarios, offline initialization increases the number of completed tasks by up to $23\%$ and reduces tail completion time by up to $15\%$.

AI.tldr: 针对半导体晶圆厂中天花板吊挂运输（OHT）系统这类共享受限物理基础设施的车队路径规划问题，提出 Neural Double Q-routing：用共享的状态-动作价值网络取代以目的地索引的 Q 表，通过模拟轨迹的 return-to-go 回归离线热身并辅以在线 Double-Q 更新、局部拥塞修正和事件分层结构化回放。在 100/150/200 辆 OHT 的九组设定下，平均完成时间相对表格型 Double Q-routing 降低 0.8%–8.8%，并在六组高密度设定中取得最优。
AI.motivation: 大规模工业机器人车队共享受限物理基础设施，车辆行驶时间受安全间距、交叉口准入、下游堵塞和站点争用等因素影响，具有时变特征；静态最短路径路由无法刻画这些交通成本。表格型 Q-routing 虽能在线自适应，但对每个"目的地-节点-动作"组合独立学习价值，难以在稀疏访问的路由情境间共享信息，且启动阶段易受不准确价值估计影响。
AI.method: 提出 Neural Double Q-routing：以共享的状态-动作价值网络取代按目的地索引的价值表。网络先通过对混合模拟生成路由轨迹做 return-to-go 回归进行离线热身初始化，再在线通过 Double-Q 更新、局部拥塞修正以及事件分层结构化回放进行精炼调优。
AI.result: 在九个匹配的车队规模-到达率设定（100、150、200 辆 OHT）中，相对表格型 Double Q-routing 平均完成时间降低 0.8%–8.8%；在六个 150 和 200 辆 OHT 设定中获得最低平均完成时间，而 Dijkstra 在三个 100 辆 OHT 设定中仍最优。八个设定中完成任务数保持在表格型方法 1% 以内，八个设定的 95 分位完成时间下降。在两个匹配的启动场景中，离线初始化使完成任务数最多增加 23%，尾部完成时间最多降低 15%。
AI.conclusion: Neural Double Q-routing 通过离线价值网络初始化与在线自适应更新相结合，在保持完成任务数量的前提下，显著改善高密度 OHT 系统中的平均完成时间与尾部延迟，验证了用泛化价值网络替代表格型 Q-routing 在工业车队路由中的有效性。

title: Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs
summary: This paper addresses the problem of translating natural-language routing rules written by business administrators into executable workflow graphs for enterprise contact centers. Each target is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of conditional actions with parallel branches, hit-first fallback chains, and per-branch Boolean predicates, encoded in the JSON dialect of a commercial routing platform. We show that neuro-symbolic decomposition enables lower-cost, non-reasoning large language models to generate complex workflow DAGs at production-relevant quality without expensive extended-reasoning models. Our central diagnostic is an emission-density bottleneck: on a 635-rule benchmark of manufactured synthetic data, models select the correct graph nodes with high accuracy but increasingly misconfigure attributes and Boolean grouping as the number of interdependent nodes emitted in one pass grows. We therefore move combinatorial graph construction from the model into a deterministic compiler driven by a compact intermediate representation, with a learned registry-selection front end that focuses generation on relevant vocabulary. Across four models, the full system reaches approximately 89% LLM-judge validity, approximately 90% exact-match condition accuracy, and 99-100% valid JSON while using roughly half the per-rule prompt tokens of a monolithic prompt. On GPT-5.3-chat, the method improves judge validity by 24 percentage points and achieves statistical equivalence to a reasoning model's out-of-the-box quality, although an approximately 8-point frontier gap remains. We also present a deployment path and transferable lessons for structured-generation applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种神经-符号分解方法，将业务管理员用自然语言编写的路由规则翻译为面向企业联络中心的可执行工作流DAG（有向无环图）。核心诊断是"发射密度瓶颈"：在635条规则的合成基准上，模型选对图节点但配置属性和布尔分组出错。作者将组合图构建从模型迁移到由紧凑中间表示驱动的确定性编译器，并搭配学习式注册表选择前端。结果显示，四个模型达到约89%的LLM评审有效性、约90%的条件精确匹配准确率、99-100%的合法JSON，且每条规则的提示token约减半；在GPT-5.3-chat上将有效性提升24个百分点，并取得与推理模型开箱即用质量的统计等价，但仍存在约8个百分点的前沿差距。
AI.motivation: 企业联络中心需要把业务管理员写的自然语言路由规则自动编译成可执行的工作流图（含并行分支、hit-first回退链、逐分支布尔谓词的DAG）。目标是让低成本的普通大语言模型也能生成复杂工作流DAG，达到生产级质量，从而避免依赖昂贵的扩展推理模型。作者通过实验诊断出主要瓶颈：当一pass中发射的相互依赖节点变多时，模型对属性和布尔分组的配置错误率上升（即发射密度瓶颈），这成为推动方法设计的核心动因。
AI.method: 采用神经-符号分解架构：将组合图结构构建从LLM的生成过程中剥离，交由一个由紧凑中间表示（IR）驱动的确定性编译器负责；前端用一个学习式的注册表选择（registry-selection）模块聚焦于相关词汇，使生成更集中。整体流程可概括为：自然语言规则 → 紧凑中间表示 → 编译器生成DAG，其中编译器保证结构合法性和JSON有效性。实验在635条规则的人工合成基准上，对四个模型（含GPT-5.3-chat）进行系统评估，并与推理模型及单片提示（monolithic prompt）方案对比。
AI.result: 在四个模型上，完整系统达到约89%的LLM评审通过率、约90%的条件精确匹配准确率和99-100%的合法JSON率，同时每条规则的提示token约为单片提示方案的一半。在GPT-5.3-chat上，与单片方案相比评审有效性提升24个百分点，并达到与推理模型开箱即用质量在统计上等价的效果；不过与前沿推理模型相比仍存在约8个百分点的差距。
AI.conclusion: 神经-符号分解是让低成本非推理LLM以生产级质量生成复杂结构化工作流DAG的有效路径，其关键在于把组合结构交给确定性编译器、让模型只做小型生成任务，从而绕开发射密度瓶颈。论文还给出了部署路径与面向结构化生成任务的可迁移经验（如紧凑IR、注册表选择、编译器约束），表明该方法在节约成本的同时能逼近推理模型的质量，但前沿差距提示仍有进一步优化空间。

title: Null-Space Diffusion Restoration with Adaptive Uncertainty-Guided Fusion for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Access
summary: Ultrasound B-mode imaging commonly suffers from speckle noise and artifacts, requiring a delicate balance between contrast, resolution, and preservation of anatomical structures. Although recently developed despeckling methods have achieved some progress, supervised learning approaches remain fundamentally limited by the ground truth paradox, which arises from the absence of noise-free, ground truth reference images in in vivo scenarios. Existing unsupervised diffusion-based methods typically enforce data consistency directly in the nonlinear log-compressed domain, which can disproportionately amplify background artifacts when mapped back to the envelope domain. To overcome these limitations, we propose an uncertainty-guided null-space diffusion (UGNS) framework, a novel label-free solution that enforces consistency correction on a stabilized positive-envelope proxy obtained via inverse log compression. The proposed UGNS introduces several technical novelties: (a) extraction of a structural prior in the stabilized envelope domain to produce a robust signal envelope that preserves anatomical structure, (b) development of an adaptive range-null reconstruction mechanism that uses an adaptive weight mask to preserve tissue regions via range-space projection, and (c) introduction of uncertainty-guided fusion in an adaptive way to mitigate sampling variability. Extensive and comparative experiments were conducted using the PICMUS benchmark and in vivo datasets. The results demonstrate that UGNS achieves competitive generalized contrast-to-noise ratio (gCNR) values across diverse datasets. In addition, it is successfully validated that UGNS effectively suppresses speckle noise while preserving fine spatial resolution. Code is available at https://github.com/yousirong/UGNS.git.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无标签的超声B-mode图像去斑方法UGNS（不确定性引导的零空间扩散），通过在稳定正包络代理域中执行一致性校正，结合结构先验提取、自适应范围-零空间重建和不确定性引导融合，在无需干净参考图像的情况下同时抑制散斑噪声并保持空间分辨率与解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 超声B-mode成像常受散斑噪声和伪影影响，需要在对比度、分辨率与组织结构保留之间取得平衡。有监督去斑方法受制于"真实参考图像悖论"——在体场景中不存在无噪声的参考图像；现有的无监督扩散方法直接在非线性对数压缩域强制数据一致性，映射回包络域时会不成比例地放大背景伪影。因此需要一种无需标签、且能避免上述域失配问题的去斑框架。
AI.method: 提出UGNS（不确定性引导的零空间扩散）框架，是一种在稳定正包络代理域进行一致性校正的无标签解决方案。其技术要点包括：(a) 在稳定包络域提取结构先验，生成保留解剖结构的稳健信号包络；(b) 设计自适应范围-零空间重建机制，利用自适应权重掩码通过范围空间投影保留组织区域；(c) 引入自适应不确定性引导融合以缓解采样变异性。该框架通过逆对数压缩获得稳定正包络代理，并在代理域完成一致性校正。
AI.result: 在PICMUS基准数据集和in vivo数据集上进行了大量对比实验。结果表明UGNS在多种数据集上取得了具有竞争力的广义对比度噪声比（gCNR）值，并有效抑制散斑噪声同时保持精细的空间分辨率。
AI.conclusion: UGNS有效解决了有监督方法的地面真值悖论及现有无监督扩散方法在非线性对数压缩域施加一致性导致的背景伪影放大问题，在无标签条件下实现了散斑抑制与结构保持的兼顾，可作为超声B-mode去斑的可靠方案。代码已开源。

title: GPAgentBench-2K: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Complex Clinical Action Space
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great potential as clinical agents, yet existing benchmarks reduce clinical workflows to static predictions or unconstrained Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) with coarse action sets. To address this, we introduce GPAgentBench-2K, the first Constrained MDP (CMDP) LLM-agent benchmark for primary-care clinical decision-making, constructed from expert-validated records of real-world GP encounters. Our environment models a full spectrum of six foundational clinical actions, imposes a topological workflow prior over the action space, and operationalizes safety-informed abstention as a first-class outcome. Evaluating 16 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals a significant performance degradation as the action space scales. Crucially, we uncover a clinical quality-safety gap: even frontier models with the highest diagnosis accuracy violate safety constraints in over half of high-risk cases. Finally, we establish a reference point using Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization (C-GRPO), and show that while explicitly modeling constraints improves performance over unconstrained RL methods, it remains far from clinically acceptable safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GPAgentBench-2K，首个基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）的初级诊疗临床决策 LLM 智能体基准，由专家验证的真实全科就诊记录构建。评测 16 个 LLM 后发现：动作空间扩大导致性能显著下降，且存在"临床质量-安全差距"——诊断准确率最高的前沿模型仍会在超过半数高危病例中违反安全约束；基于约束组相对策略优化（C-GRPO）的约束显式建模虽优于无约束强化学习，但仍远未达到临床可接受的安全水平。
AI.motivation: LLM 在临床智能体方面潜力巨大，但现有基准存在明显不足：要么将临床工作流简化为静态预测任务，要么建模为动作集粗糙、无约束的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），无法真实反映临床决策中的约束与安全要求，因而难以衡量智能体在真实诊疗场景中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 GPAgentBench-2K：首个面向初级诊疗临床决策的 CMDP LLM 智能体基准，基于专家验证的真实全科（GP）就诊记录构建。环境覆盖六类基础临床动作的完整谱系，在动作空间上施加拓扑化工作流先验，并将"安全性知情的弃诊（abstention）"作为一等结果加以显式建模与评估。
AI.result: 对 16 个 SOTA LLM 的评测显示：(1) 随动作空间规模扩大，模型性能显著下降；(2) 发现"临床质量-安全差距"——即便诊断准确率最高的前沿模型也在超过一半的高危病例中违反安全约束；(3) 以 C-GRPO 作为参照点，显式建模约束的强化学习方法优于无约束 RL 方法，但仍远未达到临床可接受的安全水平。
AI.conclusion: GPAgentBench-2K 揭示了当前 LLM 临床智能体在安全约束遵循上的系统性缺陷：高诊断能力并不等同于安全决策。现有方法（包括显式约束建模的 C-GRPO）仍不足以满足临床安全要求，表明在安全约束下的临床决策智能体研究仍有很大提升空间，需要更严格的基准来推动安全、可靠的临床落地。

title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is used to improve the reasoning abilities of LLMs, while training data span heterogeneous tasks. However, most RL post-training pipelines rely on fixed or manually designed task mixtures, even though task usefulness changes as training progresses. Online curriculum methods often define learnability by update magnitude, ignoring whether the update translates into reward gains, which can misallocate rollout budget toward tasks with large but ineffective updates. We propose PAC, a Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for multi-task RL of LLMs that combines two task-level signals: advantage-derived learnability, which measures the magnitude of the policy update a task can induce, and recent reward gains, which show whether those updates have improved task performance. A Bayesian Thompson Sampling controller uses these signals to allocate rollouts across tasks during GRPO training. We evaluate PAC under two settings: a multi-level reasoning setting and a multi-domain reasoning setting. PAC improves sample efficiency and final performance: it reaches comparable validation scores with fewer rollout steps and achieves higher final averages than random sampling and advantage-based curriculum baselines in both settings. These results show that jointly tracking advantage signals and actual reward gains yields an effective online curriculum for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出PAC（Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum），一种面向LLM多任务强化学习后训练的在线课程学习方法。它结合基于优势的可学习性信号（衡量策略更新幅度）和近期奖励增益（衡量更新是否转化为性能提升），通过贝叶斯Thompson Sampling控制器在GRPO训练过程中跨任务分配rollout预算，在多层次推理和多领域推理两个设定中相比随机采样和纯优势课程基线提升了采样效率与最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务RL后训练管线大多依赖固定或手工设计的任务混合比例，但任务的有用性会随训练过程动态变化；在线课程方法常用更新幅度（优势）来定义可学习性，却忽略了更新是否真正转化为奖励增益，导致rollout预算被浪费在"更新幅度大但效果差"的任务上。
AI.method: 提出Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum（PAC），融合两类任务级信号：优势派生的可学习性（任务能诱导的策略更新幅度）与近期奖励增益（评估更新是否提升任务性能）；由贝叶斯Thompson Sampling控制器综合这两类信号，在GRPO训练中动态分配各任务的rollout资源。
AI.result: 在多层次推理与多领域推理两种设定下，PAC在更少的rollout步数内达到可比的验证分数，且最终平均性能均优于随机采样和基于优势的课程基线，验证了同时追踪优势信号与实际奖励增益能形成有效的LLM后训练在线课程。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用优势信号与真实奖励增益可构建高效的在线课程，避免固定混合比例和纯更新幅度标准导致的预算错配，为LLM多任务RL后训练提供更优的样本效率与最终性能。

title: SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning
summary: The unprecedented surge in Earth observation data volume and diversity has exposed a critical bottleneck for traditional manual workflows, catalyzing the emergence of Remote Sensing (RS) Agents. However, the practical deployment of these advanced agents is severely hindered by their heavy reliance on large-scale general-purpose LLMs, which lack deep domain expertise and impose prohibitive infrastructure demands. To resolve this, we propose SimCRAFT, a model-agnostic framework that distills sophisticated RS orchestration capabilities into a compact 7B-scale model. Addressing data scarcity, we first pair a multiagent synthesis engine with a Mock Execution Engine that checks schema correctness, inter-tool dependencies, and sensor/tool compatibility, producing SimRS-14k, a large-scale, constraint-validated workflow planning corpus. Second, we propose Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT) that finetunes the model to reason analogically by adapting retrieved Standard Operating Procedures to novel queries under a noise-robust objective, generalizing RAFT to multi-step RS workflow planning without mechanical copying. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SimCRAFT-7B significantly outperforms openweights LLMs and rivals advanced closedsource models and specialized RS agents, while reproducing across three 7B backbones. This work contributes a competitive open-weights baseline for lightweight RS intelligence, enabling efficient autonomous deployment under resource-constrained or resource-conserving conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 SimCRAFT，一个模型无关的框架，通过构建约束验证的工作流语料 SimRS-14k 和 Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT) 技术，将复杂的遥感任务编排能力蒸馏到 7B 规模轻量级模型中，使其性能显著超越开放权重 LLM、媲美闭源大模型和专用 RS 智能体，并可在三个 7B 骨干上稳定复现。
AI.motivation: 地球观测数据在体量和多样性上激增，使传统人工流程成为关键瓶颈，由此催生了遥感智能体（RS Agents）。然而其实际部署严重受限于对大规模通用 LLM 的依赖——这类模型缺乏深层领域知识且基础设施成本高昂，从而阻碍了资源受限场景下的落地应用。
AI.method: 提出模型无关框架 SimCRAFT，包含两大核心组件：(1) 面向数据稀缺问题，将多智能体合成引擎与 Mock Execution Engine（校验 schema 正确性、工具间依赖关系以及传感器/工具兼容性）配对，生成大规模、经约束验证的工作流规划语料 SimRS-14k；(2) 提出 Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning (CRAFT)，在噪声鲁棒目标下微调模型，使其通过类比推理将检索到的标准操作流程（SOP）适配到新查询，将 RAFT 推广到多步 RS 工作流规划，避免机械式复制。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SimCRAFT-7B 显著优于开放权重 LLM，可与先进闭源模型及专用 RS 智能体相抗衡，并在三个不同 7B 骨干上均可复现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为轻量级遥感智能提供了有竞争力的开放权重基线，使得在资源受限或资源节约条件下实现高效的自主部署成为可能。

title: ContextBias: Controlled Evaluation of Bias Persistence Under Context Shift in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image models learn associations between concepts - in the case of this paper, people's professions, which we refer to as roles - and visual attributes. These associations can underpin many observed forms of stereotypical bias. A key open question in this area is whether these associations are stable or change when visual representations of people in professional roles are placed in different prompted contexts. We introduce ContextBias, a controlled evaluation framework, and ContextBench, a benchmark spanning 92 roles and 1,656 semantically controlled prompts, designed to isolate the effect of contextual variation on role-linked visual representations. Evaluating four state-of-the-art models on 66,240 generated images, we find that placing a role in a semantically unrelated context does not suppress role-linked attributes; instead, cross-role attribute concentration increases (pooled BI $+0.047$). Demographic cues, characteristic garments, and role-specific tools remain highly prevalent across context-free, related, and unrelated conditions, and are robust to semantic prompt reformulation. Scene composition and camera framing show the greatest context-sensitivity. These findings reveal a form of stereotypical persistence that remains largely invisible to context-free evaluations, highlighting the need for controlled contextual variation in bias benchmarking. Code and dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shaghayegh/ContextBias , https://github.com/Sina-Emami/ContextBias

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContextBias评估框架与ContextBench基准（92种职业角色、1,656个语义受控提示），在四个SOTA文生图模型上对66,240张图像进行受控实验，发现职业角色相关的刻板属性（人口学特征、标志性服装、职业工具）在不同上下文条件下均持续存在，甚至在不相关上下文中跨角色属性集中度上升，揭示了文生图模型中一种"刻板印象持久性"现象。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型会在职业角色与视觉属性之间建立关联，进而产生刻板性偏见。既有评估多在无上下文（context-free）条件下进行，无法回答这些角色-属性关联在受试者被置于不同提示上下文时是否稳定或发生变化。因此需要一个能隔离上下文变量影响的受控评估方法。
AI.method: 提出ContextBias受控评估框架和ContextBench基准（覆盖92个职业角色、1,656个语义受控提示），将上下文分为无关（unrelated）、相关（related）与无上下文（context-free）三类以隔离上下文变化的影响，并在四个SOTA模型上生成66,240张图像进行系统评测。
AI.result: 实验表明：将角色置于语义无关上下文中并不会抑制角色关联属性，反而使跨角色属性集中度上升（合并偏差指数BI增加0.047）；人口学线索、标志性服装和职业工具在三种条件下都高度存在，且对提示语义改写具有鲁棒性；场景构成与镜头构图对上下文最敏感。
AI.conclusion: 刻板印象能在上下文变化中持续存在，而这一现象在无上下文的传统评估中几乎不可见，因此偏见基准测试必须引入受控的上下文变化，以更全面地揭示和衡量文生图模型中的刻板性偏见。

title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives
summary: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mechanisms can be unstable across domains and refusal-oriented steering often yields rigid refusals rather than constructive safe guidance.
