To address these limitations, we propose ALTSTEER, an inference-time framework that couples selective intervention with refusal-anchored constructive redirection within a single inference pass. ALTSTEER uses an internal refusal-relevant signal to decide when to steer, and applies staged steering to shift generation from refusal-oriented control toward constructive alternatives. Evaluations on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 show that ALTSTEER preserves benign utility while improving constructive safe-completion behavior, especially on models that otherwise tend to produce short refusals for harmful requests.

AI.tldr: 提出 ALTSTEER，一个无需训练的推理时安全对齐框架，通过耦合"何时干预"（基于内部拒绝相关信号的触发机制）与"如何塑形生成"（拒绝锚定的分阶段建设性重定向）两个决策维度，在单次推理内实现选择性干预与建设性安全引导，在 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 上既保持良性请求的效用，又提升有害请求的建设性安全完成行为。
AI.motivation: 激活引导虽然提供了免训练的推理时安全控制，但现有方法在"何时干预"与"干预后如何塑形生成"两个耦合维度上均有不足：触发机制在不同领域间不稳定，且以拒绝为导向的引导往往产生僵硬的拒绝而非建设性的安全指导，损害了良性请求上的有用性。
AI.method: ALTSTEER 在单次推理过程中耦合选择性干预与拒绝锚定的建设性重定向：利用模型内部的拒绝相关信号决定是否触发引导，并采用分阶段（staged）引导，将生成从以拒绝为导向的控制逐步转向建设性替代方案。
AI.result: 在 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 上的评估表明，ALTSTEER 在保持良性请求效用（benign utility）的同时，显著提升了对有害请求的建设性安全完成行为，尤其对倾向于生成简短拒绝的模型改善明显。
AI.conclusion: ALTSTEER 通过同时解决安全引导中"何时干预"与"如何塑形生成"两个维度，克服了现有激活引导方法的触发不稳定与僵硬拒绝局限，为推理时安全控制提供了一种兼顾安全性与有用性的有效框架。

title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
summary: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) assigns a different bitwidth to each linear layer of a large language model (LLM) to minimize the quantization-induced quality loss under a fixed budget, but Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models contain these layers in every expert of every MoE block, so the allocation space grows far larger than in a dense model. Existing methods either allocate within each block under a uniform per-block budget, or allocate across blocks through an additive proxy, and neither directly optimizes a model-level objective over the choices that couple the blocks. We propose Q-Strata, a bi-level allocator that ranks within-block assignments with a cheap proxy and allocates across blocks with a model-level objective evaluated on the assembled quantized model. Its inner stage caches a Pareto frontier of candidates per block over finely spaced budgets, leaving the outer stage to set one budget per block instead of a bitwidth for every linear layer. With the search reduced to one budget per block, the outer stage optimizes this model-level objective directly, capturing the inter-block coupling that additive proxies miss. On Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Q-Strata consistently achieves lower WikiText2 perplexity than uniform-bitwidth GPTQ and the state-of-the-art MoE MPQ methods MxMoE and GEMQ in the low-bit regime. The code is available at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Q-Strata/tree/main.

AI.tldr: Q-Strata 提出一种面向 MoE 大语言模型的双层混合精度量化比特位分配方法：内层用廉价代理为每个块预先缓存帕累托前沿候选，外层将搜索空间从“逐层比特位”压缩为“逐块预算”，并直接在组装后的量化模型上优化模型级目标，从而捕获跨块耦合，在低比特场景下优于统一位宽 GPTQ 以及 MxMoE、GEMQ 等既有 MoE 分配方法。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型在多个专家及多个 MoE 块中均包含线性层，使得混合精度量化的分配空间远大于稠密模型。现有方法要么在统一逐块预算下于块内分配，要么通过加性代理跨块分配，二者都无法直接优化一个能够刻画块间耦合的模型级目标，导致分配结果次优。
AI.method: Q-Strata 采用双层分配器：(1) 内层阶段使用廉价代理对每个块内的分配进行排序，并在细化划分的预算格点上缓存每个块的帕累托前沿候选； (2) 外层阶段不再为每个线性层分配比特位，而是只为每个块设定一个预算，将搜索空间大幅压缩后，直接在组装完成的量化模型上优化模型级目标，从而显式捕捉加性代理所遗漏的跨块耦合。
AI.result: 在 Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 三个 MoE 模型上、低比特设定下，Q-Strata 在 WikiText2 困惑度上一致优于统一比特位宽 GPTQ 以及当前最先进的 MoE 混合精度量化方法 MxMoE 和 GEMQ。
AI.conclusion: 通过将逐层比特位分配重构为逐块预算分配，并以真实组装模型上的模型级目标为优化准则，Q-Strata 在显著缩减搜索空间的同时有效利用了 MoE 结构中跨块耦合的信息，为大规模 MoE 模型在低比特下的高效混合精度量化提供了更优且实用的方案。

title: Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents
summary: Professional agent tasks often depend on conventions that are absent from public corpora, yet benchmarks rarely control whether an agent has access to those conventions. We introduce a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates a task instruction from a compact artefact containing private conventions, reference tables, and utility operators. Construction-time provenance, byte-identical task instructions across the provided- and withheld-artefact conditions, leak audits, and executable witnesses make dependence on the artefact explicit and testable. Across fifteen calibration tasks, one frontier agent configuration achieves a 68.0% pass rate with the artefact and 0% without it; on one task, a plausible but incorrect artefact also yields 0% across five trials. Deterministic solvers and rule corpora provide exact ground truth for structured tasks, while named criterion-level rubrics support outputs that cannot be checked by a single executable oracle. A configuration-relative calibration screen retains seven tasks satisfying our five-trial empirical knowledge-gating screen. These experiments validate the behavior of the construction protocol; they do not establish that the retained tasks improve post-training. We publicly release part of the task suite and supporting tooling at https://github.com/DatagridsAI/Knowledge-Gated-Task-Construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"知识门控任务构建协议"（knowledge-gated task-construction protocol），将任务指令与包含私有约定、参考表和实用算子的紧凑工件分离，用于构建和筛选能够明确测试智能体是否依赖外部知识约定的基准任务。在15个校准任务上，一个前沿智能体配置在提供工件时通过率达68.0%，无工件时则为0%；最终保留7个通过五轮经验性知识门控筛选的任务，并公开了部分任务套件与工具。
AI.motivation: 专业智能体任务往往依赖公共语料中缺失的约定（conventions），但现有基准很少控制智能体是否能访问这些约定，导致基准无法区分模型能力与事先见过/不知晓的私有知识，评测结果缺乏可解释性和可验证性。
AI.method: 提出知识门控任务构建协议：将任务指令与包含私有约定、参考表和实用算子的紧凑工件分离；通过构建期溯源（construction-time provenance）、提供/扣留工件条件下字节级一致的任务指令、泄漏审计（leak audits）和可执行见证（executable witnesses）使对工件的依赖显式化且可测试。对结构化任务使用确定性求解器和规则语料提供精确真值，对无法由单一可执行预言机检查的输出采用命名标准级评分细则（named criterion-level rubrics）；并采用配置相对的校准筛选（configuration-relative calibration screen）按五轮经验性知识门控标准筛选任务。
AI.result: 在15个校准任务上，一个前沿智能体配置在提供工件时达到68.0%的通过率，无工件时为0%；在其中一个任务上，看似合理但错误的工件在五轮试验中也均为0%。配置相对的校准筛选保留了7个通过五轮经验性知识门控筛选的任务。实验结果验证了该构建协议的行为，但并未证明保留任务能改进训练后（post-training）性能。相关任务套件与工具已在GitHub公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 该知识门控任务构建协议能够有效构造和筛选出智能体确实依赖外部知识工件才能完成的任务（提供工件时性能显著、扣留或无正确工件的正确模仿时性能为零），从而为基准提供显式可测试的知识依赖度量；但作者强调这些结果只验证了协议本身的行为，尚不能证明这些保留任务能提升模型的后训练效果，后续需要进一步验证其训练价值。

title: MariSat: A Maritime Dataset for Instance Segmentation of Objects in Satellite and Aerial Images
summary: Automated maritime surveillance from satellite and aerial imagery requires large, precisely annotated datasets, which remain scarce for the instance-segmentation task, particularly for small vessels in cluttered port environments. We present MariSat, a new benchmark dataset of 1260 aerial and satellite images covering diverse port and coastal scenes, annotated at the pixel level for eight maritime object classes (sailboat, yacht, jet-ski, fishing boat, cruise ship, military vessel, tugboat and cargo ship). The dataset was produced through a semi-automatic annotation pipeline combining the textpromptable segmentation model SAM 3 with a cascade of geometric and colorimetric post-processing filters, followed by a manual correction and quality-control pass performed with the CVAT annotation platform. We describe the image-collection methodology, the annotation and correction process, and the resulting data organization. We also report class-wise statistics for the training, validation, and test splits. MariSat has already been used to fine-tune and benchmark segmentation and detection models (SAM 3 and YOLO11) for real-time maritime monitoring. We report detailed quantitative and per-class results for both tasks. The MariSat dataset is publicly available on GitHub : https://github.com/amirabbes/P2M-Maritime-Segmentation

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MariSat，一个包含 1260 幅航空与卫星图像、针对 8 类海上目标（帆船、游艇、摩托艇、渔船、邮轮、军舰、拖船、货船）的像素级实例分割基准数据集，通过结合 SAM 3 与几何/比色后处理滤波的半自动标注流程构建，并已在 GitHub 上公开。
AI.motivation: 卫星与航空影像的自动化海上监视需要大量精确标注的数据集，但实例分割任务的高质量标注数据稀缺，尤其是港口杂乱环境中针对小型船只的数据集几乎空白，限制了现有分割与检测模型在该场景下的训练与评测。
AI.method: 构建了包含 1260 幅覆盖多样化港口和海岸场景的航空/卫星图像数据集，对 8 类海事目标进行像素级标注；标注流程采用半自动流水线，即使用文本提示分割模型 SAM 3 结合级联的几何与比色后处理滤波，再通过 CVAT 平台进行人工修正与质量控制；并描述了图像收集、标注修正过程及数据组织方式，划分了训练、验证和测试集并给出逐类统计。
AI.result: MariSat 已被用于微调并评测实时海事监测中的分割与检测模型（SAM 3 与 YOLO11），并报告了两项任务的详细定量指标与逐类结果；数据集已在 GitHub 上公开发布。
AI.conclusion: MariSat 填补了海事小目标实例分割基准数据的空白，验证了半自动标注流水线（SAM 3 + 滤波 + 人工校正）在保证标注质量与效率方面的可行性，为实时海事监视的分割与检测研究提供了公开、可复现的基准资源。

title: When Errors Become Memories: Causal Pathway Tracing in Multi-Turn Memory-Augmented LLMs
summary: Long-term memory enables large language models (LLMs) to preserve and reuse information across interactions, but it can also turn localized errors into persistent risks. Existing work mainly evaluates whether memory systems store and retrieve information correctly, leaving limited understanding of how errors propagate across responses, memory states, and future interactions. We propose a structural causal model (SCM)-based framework for cross-turn error propagation in memory-augmented LLMs. We model user questions, model responses, and memory states as a dynamic causal process, and identify two entry pathways: internal memory updating and external question feedback. By intervening on these pathways, we construct four counterfactual trajectories and quantify their downstream effects and interaction. Error influence is evaluated at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, targeted diagnostic probing, and probability-level error preference. Experiments show that error influence generally decays with interaction distance, while the memory-update pathway contributes more persistent effects than question feedback; latent errors may remain even after disappearing from natural responses. Propagation patterns also vary across memory categories and memory mechanisms. Pathway-guided restoration further validates this decomposition: Question Repair reduces residual error by 27.5%, Memory Repair by 70.2%, and Joint Repair by 98.3%, nearly eliminating residual propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，用于分析记忆增强型大语言模型中跨轮次的错误传播机制，并通过路径干预与修复实验验证错误来源、传播模式及修复效果。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆能让LLM跨交互保留和复用信息，但也会把局部错误转化为持续风险。现有工作主要评估记忆系统存取信息的正确性，而对错误如何跨响应、跨记忆状态、跨未来交互传播的理解十分有限。
AI.method: 将用户问题、模型响应和记忆状态建模为动态因果过程，识别两条错误进入路径：内部记忆更新与外部问题反馈。通过对这些路径进行干预，构造四条反事实轨迹，量化错误的向下游传播效果及其交互；并在四个层面评估错误影响：记忆保持、自然响应、定向诊断探测以及概率级错误偏好。
AI.result: 错误影响通常随交互距离衰减，但记忆更新路径比问题反馈路径产生更持久的影响；潜在错误可能在自然响应中消失后依然残留。传播模式因记忆类别和记忆机制不同而有所差异。路径引导的修复验证了分解的有效性：问题修复减少27.5%的残余错误，记忆修复减少70.2%，联合修复减少98.3%，几乎消除残余传播。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了记忆增强LLM中错误传播的因果机制与路径差异，证明对记忆更新路径的干预比问题反馈更有效，且联合修复可近乎完全消除残余错误传播，为记忆系统设计中的错误控制提供了理论依据和可操作策略。

title: Collapsibility of Performance Metrics in Clinical Predictive AI
summary:
Background: Population level assessments of predictive artificial intelligence (AI) can conceal performance disparities across subgroups. Fairness evaluations commonly rely on performance analyses across subgroups. However, some performance metrics are non-collapsible, meaning that the overall population performance value does not equal the weighted average of subgroup specific values.
  Objective: To examine the collapsibility properties of commonly reported performance metrics in predictive AI, with a focus on the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC, also known as c-statistic).
  Methods: We investigate the collapsibility of 15 performance metrics, either by expressing each metric as a linear combination of its stratum specific values or, where non-collapsible, by providing a counterexample inspired by Simpson's paradox as a formal disproof.
  Results: Five performance metrics (AUC, calibration intercept, calibration slope, expected calibration error, and Nagelkerke R^2) are shown to be non-collapsible, and ten (O:E ratio, logloss, Brier score, accuracy, F1-score, true positive rate, true negative rate, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, and net benefit) are shown to be collapsible. The AUC is shown to be non-collapsible because it decomposes into within- and cross-group AUC terms when subpopulations coexist, such that its overall value may fall outside the range of subgroup specific AUCs.
  Conclusions: Non-collapsibility of performance metrics has important consequences for reporting, model appraisal, and fairness evaluation. It can generate spurious differences between subgroup and overall performance, which may mislead fairness evaluations. Explicitly acknowledging and reporting the collapsibility properties of performance metrics improves both the interpretability and transparency of fairness assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统考察了预测性人工智能中15个常用性能指标的科拉普西比（collapsibility）性质，证明AUC、校准截距、校准斜率、期望校准误差和Nagelkerke R²五项指标不可折叠，而O:E比、logloss、Brier分数等十项可折叠；并指出AUC因在亚群共存时分解为组内与组间项而导致总体值可能超出亚群值范围，从而对公平性评估造成误导。
AI.motivation: 人群层面的预测性AI性能评估可能掩盖亚群间的性能差异，而公平性评估通常依赖亚群性能分析。然而部分性能指标具有不可折叠性（non-collapsibility），即总体性能值不等于各亚群值的加权平均，这会影响公平性评估的可靠性。
AI.method: 研究考察了15个性能指标的折叠性质：对于可折叠指标，将其表示为各分层（stratum）特异值的线性组合；对于不可折叠指标，则提供一个受辛普森悖论启发的反例作为形式化反证。重点聚焦AUC（c统计量）。
AI.result: 结果显示：AUC、校准截距、校准斜率、期望校准误差和Nagelkerke R²这5项指标不可折叠；O:E比、logloss、Brier分数、准确率、F1分数、真阳性率、真阴性率、阳性预测值、阴性预测值和净获益这10项指标可折叠。AUC不可折叠的原因在于当亚群共存时其分解为组内和组间AUC项，导致总体值可能落在各亚群AUC范围之外。
AI.conclusion: 性能指标的不可折叠性对报告、模型评估和公平性评价具有重要影响，可能产生亚群性能与总体性能之间的虚假差异，从而误导公平性评估。明确承认并报告性能指标的折叠性质有助于提高公平性评估的可解释性和透明度。

title: Answer Probing-Guided Search for Diverse Solution Exploration of LLMs
summary: Generating multiple diverse and high-quality solutions is valuable for many applications, such as code-test generation and drug discovery. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to converge on a single high-confidence solution during inference, limiting exploration of alternative valid solution paths. Existing test-time methods promote diversity through tree-like search and prune semantically similar branches using response-level semantic embeddings. However, we find that such embeddings are easily confounded by linguistic and stylistic similarities, making it difficult to distinguish genuinely distinct solution paths. To address this, we introduce Answer Probing, which probes the potential answer an LLM would reach from an intermediate reasoning path. We demonstrate that the hidden states of probed answers more effectively differentiate distinct solution paths than semantic embeddings, and the perplexity of probed answers serves as a practical proxy for reasoning correctness. Based on these findings, we propose Answer Probing-Guided Tree Search (APTS), which guides the tree search by the probed answers' hidden state similarity and perplexity. Experiments on three reasoning tasks across two LLMs show that APTS consistently enhances solution diversity, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出了 Answer Probing（答案探测）技术，通过探测 LLM 从中间推理路径可达的最终答案，利用探测答案的隐藏状态相似度和困惑度来引导树搜索（APTS），从而在推理时生成更多样且高质量的多个解。
AI.motivation: LLM 在推理时容易收敛到单一高置信度解，限制了替代有效路径的探索；现有测试时方法虽用树搜索和基于语义嵌入的剪枝来提升多样性，但这类响应级语义嵌入容易被语言和风格上的相似性干扰，难以区分真正不同的解题路径。
AI.method: 提出 Answer Probing：从中间推理路径出发，探测 LLM 最终可能到达的答案；发现探测答案的隐藏状态比语义嵌入能更有效地区分不同解题路径，且探测答案的困惑度可作为推理正确性的实用代理；基于此提出 Answer Probing-Guided Tree Search (APTS)，以探测答案的隐藏状态相似度和困惑度引导树搜索。
AI.result: 在两个 LLM 上的三个推理任务实验中，APTS 一致地提升了解决方案的多样性，验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 探测答案的隐藏状态能更准确地刻画不同解题路径的差异，且其困惑度能反映推理正确性；APTS 为多样化高质量解生成提供了有效且稳健的测试时方法。

title: OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes
summary: Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.

AI.tldr: OptiGeo 提出一种偏差感知的训练框架，通过干净几何教师模型和残差修剪对齐来修复光学困难区域（透明、反射、镜面）中带偏差的真实深度监督，仅用小型针对性渲染集即可大幅修正透明物体的局部几何畸变，以30M参数超越300M级单目模型及十亿级多视角基线。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计在开放域泛化上表现优异，但在透明、反射和镜面环境中传感器常产生缺失或偏差的深度，部署困难。现有方法依赖针对场景的预处理、辅助模块或后处理微调，增加了架构冗余并使通用几何模型过度特化于狭窄光学场景。作者将该问题重新定义为基座模型训练中的局部失败模式，识别出传感器诱导的监督偏差（模型从有偏差的真实深度监督中学到传感器失败模式）是核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 OptiGeo 偏差感知训练框架：(1) 使用干净几何教师模型修复有偏差的真实监督，并结合残差修剪对齐； (2) 将面向透明目标的渲染重新定义为紧凑的干净光学几何来源，而非大规模领域微调数据集； (3) 仅用小型针对性渲染集，学习透明物体的几何结构并校正真实传感器无法可靠监督的局部几何畸变。
AI.result: 仅30M参数，OptiGeo 在透明场景基准上超越约300M规模的单目模型和十亿级多视角基线；在通用零样本深度和边界锐度上仍具竞争力；真实世界导航案例验证了其在光学挑战场景中作为高效感知模块的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 传感器诱导的监督偏差是光学挑战场景下深度估计失败的关键，通过偏差感知训练（干净几何教师+残差修剪对齐+紧凑渲染集）可在保持通用性能的同时高效修复局部几何畸变，为透明等困难场景提供轻量、实用的感知方案。

title: When Models Hear What They Expect: Diagnosing Prosodic Heuristics in Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) process speech and text jointly, yet whether they exploit prosodic cues for pragmatic inference or rely on surface acoustic patterns has received little systematic investigation. We address this through sarcasm detection, evaluating Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni on Mandarin Chinese and English under five modality conditions that decompose the contributions of lexical content, vocal semantics, and prosodic structure. Adding audio systematically inflates false positives without improving true positive detection. Acoustic error diagnosis reveals that model errors cluster on a shared stereotype of expressive prosody, namely elevated pitch and irregular pausing, that diverges from the actual cues marking sarcasm in both languages. Targeted manipulation of only these two dimensions causally confirms the heuristic, inducing false positive rates of up to 60%. Applying the same manipulation template to Gemini~3 Flash Preview without modification replicates the effect, suggesting that the stereotype extends beyond the Qwen Omni family rather than arising from a single model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是否利用韵律线索进行语用推理（以讽刺检测为测试任务），发现模型并未真正利用韵律语义，而是依赖一种"表现型韵律"（高音调+不规则停顿）的刻板启发式：添加音频只会系统性地抬高误报率而不提升真正例检测，针对性操纵这两个声学维度可将误报率提升至60%，且该刻板模式可迁移至Gemini 3 Flash Preview，说明其具有跨架构普适性。
AI.motivation: MLLMs能同时处理语音与文本，但现有研究鲜少系统考察它们究竟是利用真实韵律线索进行语用推理，还是仅依赖表层声学模式。由于讽刺检测高度依赖韵律特征，作者将其作为探针任务，以厘清模型在语音条件下是否具备真正的韵律感知能力。
AI.method: 以讽刺检测为任务，评估Qwen2.5-Omni与Qwen3-Omni在普通话和英语上的表现；设计五种模态条件以解耦词汇内容、声学语义与韵律结构的贡献；通过声学错误诊断聚类错误样本，定位模型所依赖的声学特征；随后对高音调与不规则停顿两个维度进行定向操纵，进行因果验证；并将相同的操纵模板不加修改地应用于Gemini 3 Flash Preview进行跨模型泛化测试。
AI.result: 加入音频系统性地抬高误报率而对真正例检测无益；模型错误集中在"表现型韵律"刻板印象（高音调、不规则停顿）上，与两种语言中讽刺的真实韵律标记不一致；定向操纵仅这两个维度即可将误报率推高至60%，因果确认了该启发式；相同操纵模板在Gemini 3 Flash Preview上重现该效应，表明该刻板印象不限于Qwen Omni家族。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs并未真正利用韵律进行语用推理，而是依赖一个跨模型、跨语言的"表现型韵律"刻板启发式（高音调+不规则停顿），这导致语音输入产生大量虚假的讽刺判定。该发现揭示了多模态模型在低层声学表层特征与高层语用理解之间的脱落，提示需要更严格的韵律感知训练与评估范式。

title: The Safety Relay in Roleplay Jailbreaks: A Component-Resolved Causal Analysis of Harm Recognition and Refusal
summary:
Large language models are trained to follow instructions while refusing harmful requests. Jailbreaks exploit this balance to elicit content a model would ordinarily reject. Roleplay jailbreaks are especially concerning: the harmful request can remain visible inside a roleplay wrapper made of a persona, scenario, and task, yet the model may comply. We use mechanistic interpretability to determine how this context reverses refusal and which elements contribute to the reversal. Across two benchmarks, three model families, and four authored wrappers, we compare matched harmful and benign requests with and without this wrapper. We trace hidden-state contrasts from the request to the final prompt state, isolate wrapper operations through controlled counterfactuals, intervene on their activation directions in held-out evaluation requests, and decompose effective directions geometrically.
  Our analysis yields three findings. (1) Successful attacks retain the measured harmful-versus-benign distinction at the request, while its refusal-associated expression weakens where the answer begins, a pattern we call safety-relay attenuation. (2) Constructing the complete roleplay around the request and framing it within the scenario contribute causally: removing the associated activation changes restores refusal. (3) These effects largely share internal structure, and most repair is reproduced by components aligned with the model's ordinary refusal of harmful requests without roleplay; scenario framing retains a smaller, model-dependent component. Together, these findings explain how roleplay can produce compliance despite retained evidence of harm and identify a concrete target for future safeguards: maintaining the connection from harm recognition to refusal.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制可解释性方法研究角色扮演越狱（roleplay jailbreak）如何让大语言模型在仍能识别有害内容的情况下产生顺从行为。作者在多个基准、模型家族和自编包装下，对比有害与良性请求在有/无包装时的隐藏状态，通过可控反事实、激活方向干预和几何分解，发现：成功攻击在请求处保留了有害与良性的区分，但在回答起始处拒绝相关表达减弱（称为“安全中继衰减”）；完整角色构建与场景框架在因果上促成顺从；这些效应大多与模型常规拒绝的最优组件对齐，场景框架保留较小的模型相关成分。研究将角色扮演违抗机制归因于“危害识别到拒绝”这一链条的断裂，并为未来防护提供具体靶点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的防护依赖“遵循指令”与“拒绝有害请求”之间的平衡，而角色扮演越狱可在保持有害请求可见（仅包裹以人设、场景和任务）的情况下诱导模型顺从，是目前尤为令人担忧的一类攻击。此前缺乏对“这种上下文包装如何逆转拒绝”以及“哪些元素在因果上起作用”的深入机制理解，因此作者希望用机制可解释性从内部表征层面阐明其原理。
AI.method: 作者在两个基准、三个模型家族和四种自编包装上，对比匹配的有害/良性请求在有/无角色扮演包装下的隐藏状态。具体方法包括：(1)追踪从请求到最终提示状态的隐藏状态对比；(2)通过受控反事实隔离包装中各要素的运算；(3)在留出的评测请求上对其激活方向进行干预；(4)对有效方向进行几何分解，以判断其与模型常规拒绝有害请求（无包装）时的内部结构是否重叠。
AI.result: 研究得出三点发现：(1)成功攻击在请求位置仍保留有害与良性的可测区分，但拒绝相关表达在回答起始处减弱，作者将此模式命名为“安全中继衰减”；(2)构建完整角色包装并在场景中框定请求均具有因果作用——移除相应激活变化可恢复拒绝；(3)这些效应在内部结构上大部分共享，绝大部分修复由与模型无角色扮演时常规拒绝有害请求所对齐的组件复现，而场景框架保留了一个较小且随模型变化的独立成分。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：角色扮演越狱之所以能导致顺从，并非因为模型丢失了对危害的证据，而是因为“危害识别”与“拒绝行为”之间的连接被削弱/衰减；这为未来防护提供了具体靶点——维持从危害识别到拒绝的链路。同时，多数效应复用现有拒绝机制的内部方向，暗示防护可以依托并强化既有的对齐结构，而非从零建立新机制。

title: Co-Annotator: Expert-Distilled ViT and VLM for Visual and Documentation Guidance in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
comment: 23 pages, 11 figures. To appear in UIST '26: Proceedings of the 39th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology, November 02-05, 2026, Detroit, MI, USA. DOI: 10.1145/3830398.3830722
summary: Clinical AI often optimizes predictive performance without engaging how clinicians decide where to look and what to write. We present Co-Annotator, which distills expert gaze and dictation into two guidance components: a gaze-aligned Vision Transformer producing fixation-aligned areas of interest (AOIs), and an ontology-bounded vision-language model (VLM) that pre-fills editable biomarker summaries for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT). We first collect expert gaze and dictations (US1) to train the models, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy and biomarker generation. We then deploy the system with ophthalmology residents: a controlled resident study (US2) confirmed each modality is safe and independently beneficial, with AOI guidance producing lasting perceptual efficiency gains through post-guidance carryover and VLM guidance more than doubling biomarker documentation breadth. In a combined deployment across two academic institutions (US3), providing both modalities simultaneously produced efficiency gains that substantially exceeded either modality alone: correct diagnoses per minute increased by 40% and comment editing time fell by 67%, without compromising diagnostic accuracy. Notably, neither modality improved efficiency during guidance in US2, which makes the in-guidance efficiency gain under combined guidance in US3 the more striking result. Expert-distilled multimodal guidance can remove two distinct clinical workflow bottlenecks at once (visual search overhead and documentation burden) without compromising the diagnostic accuracy clinicians already achieve.

AI.tldr: 提出Co-Annotator，通过蒸馏专家的注视轨迹与口述内容，为视网膜OCT分析提供两种引导组件（注视对齐的视觉Transformer生成关注区域AOI，以及基于本体约束的视觉语言模型VLM预填可编辑生物标志物摘要），在三个子研究中证明其能同时消除视觉搜索与文档记录两大工作流瓶颈，且不损害诊断准确率。
AI.motivation: 临床AI往往只优化预测性能，而没有考虑临床医生实际如何决定“看哪里”和“写什么”，导致AI与真实临床工作流的视觉搜索和文档记录环节脱节。
AI.method: 将专家注视和口述提炼为两个指导组件：(1) 注视对齐的Vision Transformer，生成与注视一致的关注区域（AOI）；(2) 本体受限的视觉语言模型（VLM），为视网膜OCT预填可编辑的生物标志物摘要。先收集专家注视和口述数据（US1）训练模型，再分别部署给眼科住院医师（US2）验证各模态的安全性与独立收益，最后在两所机构的联合部署中（US3）同时提供两种模态。
AI.result: US1中显著提升诊断准确率与生物标志物生成；US2中AOI引导通过引导后持续效应带来持久的知觉效率提升，VLM引导使生物标志物文档记录广度翻倍以上；US3中两种模态同时提供时，每分钟正确诊断数增加40%，注释编辑时间下降67%，且不牺牲诊断准确率。值得注意的是US2中单独引导时均未提升引导期间的效率，使US3联合引导下的效率提升更显突出。
AI.conclusion: 专家提炼的多模态引导能够同时消除两种不同的临床工作流瓶颈（视觉搜索开销与文档记录负担），而不会损害临床医生已有的诊断准确率。

title: MASQ: Mask-Aware Spatiotemporal Quantization for Unsupervised Skeleton Action Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised skeleton-based temporal action segmentation is a crucial task for understanding human behavior in long untrimmed sequences. Recent approaches often rely on discrete quantization to discover action boundaries from motion representations. However, when spatial masking is introduced for representation learning, it can introduce representation ambiguity, while discrete quantization further amplifies small fluctuations in the latent space. The interaction between these two factors often leads to unstable code switching and severe temporal jitter near action boundaries.To address these limitations, we propose a novel Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization (MASQ) framework. Our framework decouples the conflicting tasks of spatial feature inference and temporal smoothing.In the spatial dimension, we introduce a Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD) mechanism that masks the entire temporal trajectory of selected joints, to encourage the model to learn discriminative inter-joint coordination patterns. In the temporal dimension, we design a mask-aware velocity loss that enforces motion consistency only on visible joints, that prevents gradient conflicts caused by masked signals and stabilizing temporal predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used skeleton datasets, including HuGaDB, LARa, and BABEL, demonstrate that the proposed MASQ framework significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art unsupervised methods. In particular, our model establishes a comprehensive and substantial leading advantage in the Mean over Frames accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MASQ（Mask-aware Action Spatiotemporal Quantization）框架，用于无监督骨架时序动作分割。该框架通过解耦空间特征推断与时间平滑两个冲突任务，缓解离散量化在动作边界附近引发的码本切换不稳定与时间抖动问题，并在 HuGaDB、LARa、BABEL 三个数据集上超越现有无监督方法。
AI.motivation: 无监督骨架时序动作分割依赖离散量化发现动作边界；然而空间掩码表示学习会引入表示歧义，离散量化又会放大隐空间中的微小波动，二者相互作用导致边界附近码本切换不稳定和严重的时间抖动，准确分割动作边界困难。
AI.method: 提出 MASQ 框架，将空间特征推断与时间平滑解耦。空间维度采用 Joint-Level Structured Dropout (JLSD)，掩蔽选定关节的完整时间轨迹，促使模型学习判别性的关节间协调模式；时间维度设计掩码感知的速度损失，仅对可见关节施加运动一致性约束，避免被掩蔽信号引起的梯度冲突，稳定时间预测。
AI.result: 在 HuGaDB、LARa、BABEL 三个公开骨架数据集上的大量实验表明，MASQ 显著优于现有最先进的无监督方法，尤其在 Mean over Frames 准确率指标上建立了全面且大幅的领先优势。
AI.conclusion: 解耦空间推断与时间平滑能够有效解决空间掩码与离散量化相互干扰导致的边界不稳定问题，为无监督骨架动作分割提供了更稳健的方案。

title: Label Semantic Expansion via Label Guided Neural Topic Modeling
summary: Topic models are widely used for content analysis, where users often analyze corpora around predefined labels rather than unordered latent topics. Existing label-aware topic models mainly follow a labels-for-topics perspective, using labels to guide topic learning, while the learned topics are not directly usable for label-centered analysis. We explore the reverse topics-for-labels perspective and instantiate it as Label Semantic Expansion (LSE), which enriches sparse label representations with corpus-grounded descriptive topic words. To exploit topics in LSE effectively, we propose a Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM), which learns dedicated label-aligned topics, grounds them in lexical and document semantic spaces, and preserves consistency between topic structures and label structures. Experiments on label-topic alignment, label expansion, topic quality, and downstream classification demonstrate strong overall performance across complementary evaluation dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主题为标签服务"（topics-for-labels）的逆向视角，并实例化为标签语义扩展（LSE）与标签引导的神经主题模型（LGNTM），通过学习与标签对齐的主题来丰富稀疏标签表征，在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量和下游分类等多个维度上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有标签感知主题模型主要采用"标签用于主题"（labels-for-topics）视角，即用标签引导主题学习，但学到的主题无法直接用于以标签为中心的分析；而实际应用中用户常围绕预定义标签而非无序潜在主题分析语料。因此需要反向的"主题用于标签"视角。
AI.method: 提出Label Semantic Expansion (LSE)，利用语料中可解释的描述性主题词来扩充稀疏的标签表征；并设计Label-Guided Neural Topic Model (LGNTM)：学习与标签对齐的专用主题，将其嵌入词汇与文档语义空间，并保持主题结构与标签结构之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在标签-主题对齐、标签扩展、主题质量及下游分类任务上的实验表明，该方法在多个互补的评价维度上均展现出较强的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 逆向的"主题-标签"视角能更直接地支撑以标签为中心的分析，LGNTM将标签对齐主题与语义空间及结构一致性相结合，为标签感知主题建模提供了有效且全面的解决方案。

title: State of Health Estimation using Convolutional and Bidirectional LSTM Neural Networks tuned by Bayesian Optimization
summary: In this research, a novel framework is proposed for the SOH estimation, which employs a hybrid deep learning architecture of a concatenation of a Convolution Neural Network (CNN) and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) Neural Network (NN) with the integration of Bayesian Optimization-based hyperparameter tuning for the network. Three different deep learning architectures are being evaluated: standalone recurrent models, CNN-RNN architectures and CNN-RNN combinations enhanced with intermediate Fully Connected (FC) layers. Among the three, the model with the intermediate FC layers demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy. A comprehensive feature engineering approach combines capacity (Q), voltage (V), Incremental Capacity Analysis (ICA), and Differential Voltage Analysis (DVA), with systematic evaluation of multiple combinations to identify the optimal input representation. To validate the proposed method, three publicly available datasets were utilized, ensuring reproducibility of the results, two from external sources and one developed by the author of this study using a unique experimental setup. The comparison study was performed using the Mean Absolute Error (MAE), the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and the FLoating-point OPerations (FLOPs) as evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于电池健康状态（SOH）估计的新型混合深度学习框架，将CNN与BiLSTM网络拼接，并结合基于贝叶斯优化的超参数调优；通过对比三种网络结构（独立循环模型、CNN-RNN结构、带中间全连接层的CNN-RNN组合），发现带中间FC层的模型预测精度最高，并利用多特征工程（容量、电压、ICA、DVA）和多公开数据集验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 电池健康状态（SOH）的准确估计对电池管理系统（BMS）的安全运行和寿命预测至关重要。现有深度学习方法在特征表示和超参数选择上存在局限，需要一种兼具高精度、可复现且计算效率合理的混合深度学习框架来提升SOH估计性能。
AI.method: 提出CNN与BiLSTM拼接的混合深度学习架构，并集成基于贝叶斯优化的超参数自动调优；系统评估三种架构（独立循环模型、CNN-RNN、CNN-RNN加中间全连接层）；采用综合特征工程，将容量（Q）、电压（V）、增量容量分析（ICA）和差分电压分析（DVA）进行多组合系统性评估，以确定最优输入表示；使用三个公开数据集（两个外部来源、一个作者自制）验证方法，并以MAE、RMSE和FLOPs作为评价指标。
AI.result: 在三种评估的深度架构中，带中间全连接（FC）层的CNN-RNN组合模型取得了最高的预测精度；通过多特征组合的系统评估确定了最优输入表示，且方法在多个公开数据集上验证了可复现性与良好性能，并以MAE、RMSE和FLOPs进行了全面对比。
AI.conclusion: 提出并验证了一种结合CNN-BiLSTM混合架构与贝叶斯优化超参数调优的SOH估计方法，其中加入中间全连接层的模型在精度上最优，综合特征工程与多数据集验证表明该方法具有较高的预测精度、可复现性及合理的计算成本，为电池SOH估计提供了一种有效方案。

title: Will the User Ever Know? Covert Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents take real-world actions through tools, indirect prompt injection (IPI) has emerged as a serious threat. The standard metric, Attack Success Rate (ASR), counts whether an injection succeeds but ignores what the user notices in the agent's final response. Looking at successful injection traces, we find two distinct outcomes: the agent executes the injection while returning an otherwise normal response, or reports the injected action in its final response, giving the user a chance to notice. We call these covert and overt successes. From the user's perspective, we decompose ASR into the Covert Success Rate (CSR), counting successes leaving no trace in the final response, and the Overt Success Rate (OSR), counting successes the user can detect. To understand what drives the gap, we analyze successful trajectories and find that the agent's behavior after the injection separates covert from overt: covert traces hand control back to the user task before ending, while overt traces end at the attack itself. This split follows from the ReAct format, where the final response summarizes the most recent action. Building on this observation, we propose ICoA (Induced Covert Attack), an IPI attack designed to induce covert outcomes by steering the agent back to the user task after executing the injection. Across four target models on AgentDojo, ICoA achieves the highest CSR, with gains of 3.79-12.01 percentage points over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了针对LLM智能体的间接提示注入（IPI）威胁评估，指出现有ASR指标忽略了用户能否在最终响应中察觉注入。作者将成功注入分为隐秘成功（Covert）与公开成功（Overt），提出CSR与OSR两个分解指标，发现ReAct格式下智能体注入后的行为决定了结果归属，并据此设计ICoA攻击，在AgentDojo四个模型上将CSR较最强基线提升3.79-12.01个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过工具执行真实世界动作时，间接提示注入（IPI）已成为严重威胁。现有标准指标ASR只统计注入是否成功，却忽略用户在智能体最终响应中能否察觉。分析成功注入轨迹发现存在两种截然不同的结果——隐秘成功（智能体执行注入但返回正常响应）与公开成功（智能体在最终响应中报告注入动作，用户有机会察觉），需要从用户视角重新定义评估指标并理解其成因。
AI.method: 首先将ASR从用户视角分解为CSR（最终响应无痕迹的成功）与OSR（用户可察觉的成功）。通过分析成功轨迹，发现智能体注入后的行为是区分两者的关键：隐秘轨迹在注入后把控制权交回用户任务再结束，而公开轨迹则以攻击本身结束；这一分裂源于ReAct格式下最终响应只总结最近一次动作。基于该观察，提出ICoA（Induced Covert Attack），一种通过在执行注入后将智能体引导回用户任务以诱导隐秘结果的IPI攻击。在AgentDojo的四个目标模型上评估。
AI.result: ICoA在AgentDojo四个目标模型上取得最高CSR，相比最强基线提升3.79-12.01个百分点，验证了对IPI成功结果进行隐秘/公开区分的必要性以及基于ReAct行为模式诱导隐秘攻击的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的ASR指标高估了IPI的实际风险或掩盖了其可被用户察觉的部分；将成功注入按用户可检测性分解为CSR和OSR能更准确刻画威胁。由于ReAct格式中最终响应仅总结最近动作，攻击者可通过在执行注入后引导智能体返回用户任务来系统性地制造隐秘成功，ICoA证明了这类威胁是可被工程化诱导的，提示防御方应关注智能体轨迹级行为而非仅最终响应。

title: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr
summary: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr.

AI.tldr: 提出 Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR)，一种推理时方法，通过在调度好的中间 ODE 步骤中把世界模型（V-JEPA 2.1）的惊奇能量梯度直接注入单条采样轨迹，在不训练生成器、不生成多个候选、不反复解码/重编码的情况下提升视频的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 现代视频生成器在物理动力学上系统性失败（物体漂浮、轨迹违反重力、接触消失），因为标准去噪与 flow-matching 目标只拟合视觉数据分布，并不显式惩罚物理违规。现有补救手段要么（如候选选择、梯度世界模型引导）带来高昂的推理或训练成本，要么（如生成器内部精炼、后训练）需要额外的扰动重去噪循环或策展数据与优化。
AI.method: OMR 在推理期间于调度好的中间 ODE 步骤，用适配器空间的 V-JEPA 2.1 惊奇能量的梯度来增强生成器速度。该外部修正可将潜在状态移出未修正的采样轨迹，推向被冻结预测器判定为更物理合理的区域，随后生成器从修正后的状态继续渲染。为保证推理时梯度可计算，训练了一个小型 latent-to-embedding 适配器，且视频生成器与世界模型全程保持冻结。
AI.result: 在固定 400 提示词的 VideoPhy-2 详细子集上，OMR 将联合“语义一致性与物理常识”指标从 47.0% 提升至 52.0%（+5.0pp 绝对，+10.6% 相对），优于基础 Wan2.2-T2V-A14B 采样器；在固定 50 提示词效率子集上仅需 1.71 倍基础运行时，远低于奖励/搜索类替代方案的多倍成本。
AI.conclusion: OMR 表明，将冻结世界模型的反馈直接注入单条采样轨迹，可在近乎恒定的推理开销下显著改善物理一致性，同时保持生成器和世界模型均冻结，是一种轻量、扩展性好的物理校正范式。

title: The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate structured product data in e-commerce, but early deployment often begins as a cold-start problem: only limited pre-launch labels are available, the value of expensive reasoning is unknown, and human review is needed before the system can be trusted at scale. This challenge is especially common in rule-based annotation workflows, where each item must satisfy multiple business rules and both model errors and ambiguous rule boundaries affect final decisions. We introduce the Differential Reasoning Router (DRR), a cost-aware framework for cold-start LLM annotation that jointly optimizes model selection and human escalation. Rather than treating a reasoning model as a default fallback, DRR estimates separate success probabilities for a direct model and a reasoning model at both the sample and business-rule levels, enabling adaptive routing: easy cases are handled directly, reasoning is reserved for cases where it is expected to improve the decision, and likely double-failure or rule-disagreement cases are escalated to human annotators. The resulting labels provide targeted ground truth for prompt engineering, supervised fine-tuning, calibration, and rule refinement, enabling a gradual shift from human-heavy cold-start annotation toward high-confidence automated routing. In a production e-commerce workflow, DRR reaches accuracy parity with the strongest confidence-based router while achieving more than 60\% reasoning-token cost savings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出差分推理路由器（DRR），一种面向冷启动场景的、成本感知的 LLM 标注框架，通过联合优化模型选择与人工升级，在电商结构化产品数据标注中实现与最强置信度路由器相当的精度，同时节省超过60%的推理token成本。
AI.motivation: 电商领域用LLM标注结构化产品数据时，早期部署常面临冷启动问题：上线前标注样本有限、昂贵推理的价值未知、系统在规模上被信任前需要人工审核。尤其在基于规则的标注流程中，每条条目需满足多条业务规则，模型错误与规则边界模糊共同影响最终决策。现有方法常把推理模型当作默认回退，缺乏成本感知的自适应路由。
AI.method: DRR在样本级和业务规则级分别估计直接模型与推理模型的独立成功概率，实现自适应路由：简单样本直接处理；推理仅用于预期能改善决策的情况；疑似双重失败或规则分歧的样本升级给人工标注员。由此产生的高质量标签进一步用于提示工程、监督微调、校准与规则细化，推动从人力密集的冷启动标注逐步过渡到高置信度自动化路由。
AI.result: 在生产电商工作流中，DRR在精度上与最强的置信度路由器持平，同时实现了超过60%的推理token成本节省。
AI.conclusion: DRR验证了在冷启动LLM标注中，通过细粒度（样本级+规则级）的概率估计和成本感知路由，可以在不损失精度的前提下大幅降低昂贵的推理开销，并为标注系统的自动化演进提供有针对性的真值反馈。

title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026; Code is available at https://github.com/VennTum99/PLC-DPO
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies alignment through pairwise comparisons but assumes all observed preferences are reliable. Real data often violates this assumption, leading to reversed, weak, or ambiguous labels that cause harmful policy updates. To address this, we propose Posterior Label Correction DPO (PLC-DPO) to robustly optimize preferences by routing each pair's training signal as a clean, flip, or tie case. The key idea is to use the calibrated policy-reference margin as online evidence to take appropriate correction actions. This reframes noisy preference learning as actively correcting supervision direction and strength rather than merely filtering suspicious examples. Across 57 dataset-model-benchmark cells, PLC-DPO obtains the best mean win rate against DPO (60.5 vs. 55.5 for the next-best method). Injected-noise and tie stress tests, human disagreement analysis, and self-confirmation diagnostics further show that the routing remains stable and distinguishes flipped from weakly directional pairs.

AI.tldr: 提出PLC-DPO（后验标签校正直接偏好优化），通过将每个偏好对的训练信号路由为干净、翻转或平局三种情况，利用校准后的策略-参考模型边际作为在线证据来校正噪声标签的方向与强度，从而在噪声偏好数据下实现比DPO更稳健的优化。
AI.motivation: DPO依赖两两比较进行对齐，但假设所有观测到的偏好都是可靠的。真实数据常违反这一假设，出现反向、弱或有歧义的标签，导致有害的策略更新。已有方法多采用过滤可疑样本的思路，但作者认为应更主动地对监督方向与强度进行校正。
AI.method: 核心是用校准的策略-参考模型边际作为在线证据，将每个偏好对的训练信号路由为三种情形：clean（干净标签，正常优化）、flip（翻转标签，反转梯度方向）、tie（平局，弱化或降低更新强度），据此主动校正监督方向与强度，而非仅过滤可疑样本。
AI.result: 在57个数据集-模型-基准组合上，PLC-DPO相对DPO取得最佳平均胜率（60.5%，次优方法为55.5%）。注入噪声与平局压力测试、人类分歧分析及自确认诊断均表明路由保持稳定，且能区分翻转对与弱方向对。
AI.conclusion: PLC-DPO将噪声偏好学习重新定义为对监督方向与强度的主动校正，而非简单过滤，在广泛的实验规模下一致超越DPO及对比方法，并展现出良好的鲁棒性与稳定性，验证了基于边际的路由机制的有效性。

title: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence
comment: To appear in ACM UIST 2026. 30 pages, 23 figures
summary: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EEG) to provide timely guidance, continuously adapting a frozen vision-language model's inference on which items are task-relevant by jointly estimating per-source reliability without manual labels or offline training. Through three user studies, including two live deployments of an assistive agent driven by OLIVE in XR, we show that OLIVE Pareto-dominates prior test-time adaptation frameworks, achieving the highest convergence rate at comparable convergence speed. Combining implicit physiological and explicit behavioral signals, the OLIVE agent produces the largest and most reliable within-session improvement to a user's ability to detect and engage targets, largely independent of the individual's skill. When the target switches silently, the agent that uses both behavioral and physiological signals reconverges significantly faster than the behavior-only agent (1.27 times faster on average, p = .008), restoring trustworthy guidance at the moment the task changes, precisely when reliable assistance matters most.

AI.tldr: 提出OLIVE框架，将被动EEG与行为证据在线融合，实时适应冻结的视觉-语言基础模型，为时间紧迫、高风险的动态任务（如XR第一人称射击游戏）提供辅助，无需人工标注或离线训练；通过三项用户研究证明其帕累托优于现有测试时适应方法，且结合生理与行为信号的智能体收敛速度显著快于仅依赖行为的智能体。
AI.motivation: 在时间紧迫、高风险、动态变化的任务中，用户受限于自身行为带宽，难以检测和应对所有目标。现有基础模型适应方法未利用隐式生理信号，且依赖手动标注或离线训练，难以实现实时、游戏内自适应的辅助。因此需要一种能在线融合多源证据、无需人工干预的实时辅助框架。
AI.method: 提出OLIVE框架：在XR第一人称射击游戏中，在线融合显式行为信号（用户击落的目标）与隐式生理信号（注视锁定EEG），联合估计各信号源的可靠性，在没有人工标签和离线训练的情况下持续适配冻结的视觉-语言模型的推理，判断哪些物品与任务相关，从而提供及时引导。
AI.result: 通过三项用户研究（含两次XR中的实时部署），OLIVE在帕累托意义上优于现有测试时适应框架，以相近收敛速度达到最高收敛率。融合生理与行为信号的智能体带来最大的会话内检测与交互能力提升，且基本不受个体技能影响；当目标无声切换时，双信号智能体比仅行为智能体平均快1.27倍重新收敛（p=.008）。
AI.conclusion: 被动EEG与行为证据的在线融合能有效扩展用户超出自身行为带宽的目标检测与交互能力；OLIVE证明了无需标注和离线训练的测试时基础模型适应在实时辅助中的可行性，并在任务动态变化的关键时刻提供更快速、更可靠的信任重建，为高动态高风险场景的人机协同辅助提供了实用方案。

title: OrnaStyler: Ornament-Aware Latent Editing for Content-Preserving 3D Stylization
summary: Text-guided style editing of 3D assets is essential for adapting existing objects to diverse visual aesthetics in digital content creation. Despite rapid progress in 3D shape modeling, faithfully stylizing an existing asset remains challenging when the desired stylization involves fine-grained structural ornamentation, which requires the model to preserve the source geometry and object identity, while coherently integrating new style-specific details. We propose \textbf{OrnaStyler}, a zero-shot framework for text-guided ornament-aware 3D stylization. Built upon rectified flow-based generative modeling, OrnaStyler introduces an inversion-guided editing strategy that recovers content-aware latent representations at both geometry and appearance levels in a staged manner to facilitate faithful editing. Our core idea is to explicitly model the spatial configuration of stylistic elements, thereby mitigating the fundamental tension between content preservation and style expression in the voxel space. Specifically, at the geometry level, we manipulate voxel representations through flow inversion to synthesize ornament-enhanced structures while preserving the spatial identity of the source asset. Then, at the appearance level, we introduce an adjacency-aware feature inpainting mechanism to harmonize newly generated ornaments with the original content, yielding coherent geometry-appearance integration. Our approach operates solely in the inference phase and enables selective editing over geometric augmentation or appearance stylization. Extensive experiments on both generated and real-world 3D assets against prior methods demonstrate that OrnaStyler achieves state-of-the-art editing performance in terms of content preservation, style fidelity, and overall visual realism. Code is available at: https://github.com/tomohiro0427/OrnaStyler

AI.tldr: OrnaStyler 是一个基于整流流（rectified flow）生成模型的零样本框架，用于文本引导的3D资产装饰风格化编辑（ornament-aware stylization）。它通过分阶段的流反转（flow inversion）在几何层和外观层恢复内容感知的隐表示，显式建模风格元素的空间配置，并引入邻域感知特征修补（adjacency-aware feature inpainting）机制，在不破坏源资产空间身份的前提下合成装饰增强结构并实现几何-外观的协调整合。
AI.motivation: 现有3D资产风格化方法在涉及细粒度结构装饰时难以保持源几何与对象身份的一致性，同时无法将新的风格细节连贯地融入。核心难点在于“内容保留”与“风格表达”之间的根本性张力，即在体素空间中既要保留原始形状的空间身份，又要合成装饰增强的结构。
AI.method: 1) 采用整流流生成模型，通过反转引导的编辑策略分阶段恢复几何层与外观层的内容感知隐表示；2) 在几何层面，通过流反转操纵体素表示，合成装饰增强结构同时保持源资产的空间身份；3) 在外观层面，引入邻域感知特征修补机制，协调新生成的装饰与原始内容，实现几何-外观的连贯整合；4) 仅在推理阶段运行，支持选择性编辑（几何增强或外观风格化）。
AI.result: 在生成资产与真实世界3D资产上进行的广泛实验表明，OrnaStyler 在内容保留、风格保真度与整体视觉真实感方面优于现有方法，达到了最先进的编辑性能。
AI.conclusion: OrnaStyler 通过显式建模风格元素的空间配置，有效缓解了内容保留与风格表达之间的冲突，提供了一种无需训练、仅需推理的零样本3D装饰风格化方案，兼具选择性编辑能力与优秀的编辑质量。

title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
summary: Korean introduces an additional typographical perturbation level not captured by ordinary character-level edit models: because syllable blocks are internally composed of sub-character units called jamo, keyboard-level errors can occur within a syllable, either producing a valid but semantically altered character or exposing raw jamo on the surface. Both outcomes disrupt sub-word tokenization and are not reliably corrected by existing grammatical error correction pipelines, leaving LLMs directly exposed to corrupted inputs. To quantify this vulnerability, we apply five jamo-level perturbation types to the KMMLU benchmark and evaluate four language models, finding that accuracy declines monotonically with perturbation intensity and that parameter scaling does not confer robustness against intra-syllabic noise. We further show that typo-corrupted inputs induce a distinct shift in internal representations that is not reducible to ordinary answer incorrectness, and that a simple linear probe trained on these representations detects unseen perturbation types with high AUROC. Motivated by this signal, we propose Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought (TACoT), which routes inputs to chain-of-thought inference only when the probe detects a likely typo, recovering a substantial portion of the CoT accuracy gain at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示韩语文本中独有的"jamo（字母）级"键盘输入错误对LLM构成的威胁：由于韩语音节块由jamo子字符组成，键误可在音节内部产生语义改变或暴露原始jamo，破坏子词分词且不被现有语法纠错管道修复。作者在KMMLU基准上施加五种jamo级扰动并评估四个LLM，证明准确率随扰动强度单调下降、参数规模扩大不带来鲁棒性；进一步发现拼写错误会引发内部表征的独特偏移，线性探针能以高AUROC检测未见过的扰动类型，并据此提出Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought（TACoT）——仅在探针判定可能含错时启用CoT推理，以极小推理代价恢复大部分CoT增益。
AI.motivation: 韩语引入了普通字符级编辑模型无法覆盖的额外拼写扰动层级：音节块内部由jamo子字符组成，键盘级错误可发生在音节内部，产生语义改变的合法字符或在表层暴露原始jamo。这两类结果都会干扰子词分词，且现有语法纠错管道无法可靠修复，使LLM直接暴露于被破坏的输入。现有研究缺乏对此类"音节内噪声"漏洞的系统量化和缓解。
AI.method: 1) 构造五类jamo级扰动类型并施加于KMMLU基准；2) 评估四个不同规模的语言模型，考察准确率与扰动强度的关系及参数规模的影响；3) 分析被拼写错误破坏的输入所引发的内部表征偏移，训练简单线性探针检测扰动；4) 提出Typo-Aware Chain-of-Thought（TACoT），利用探针信号将输入路由到CoT推理，仅在检测到疑似错别字时启用。
AI.result: 实验发现：准确率随扰动强度单调下降；参数规模扩大并未带来对音节内噪声的鲁棒性；被错字破坏的输入会引发内部表征的独特偏移，且这种偏移不能归约为普通的答错情形；线性探针在检测未见过的扰动类型时达到高AUROC；TACoT以极小推理成本恢复了CoT准确率增益中的大部分。
AI.conclusion: jamo级扰动是韩语LLM面临的一种本质性、且与模型规模无关的漏洞；内部表征中蕴含可用且可泛化的错字信号；基于探针的"仅在必要时启用CoT"的路由策略是兼顾准确率与推理成本的有效方案。

title: MolLedger: An Additive Graph Neural Network with Chemically Grounded ADME Attributions
summary: Optimizing absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) is an important part of small molecule drug discovery. Many machine learning models have been built to predict ADME properties to facilitate this optimization process, but explaining model predictions is challenging. We propose a new graph neural network architecture with built-in meaningful per-atom attributions. Our model MolLedger outputs predictions that are the sum of per-atom scores. MolLedger's additive framework obtains exact interpretability at no cost to performance because the global context vector gives the additive head enough context to produce good per-atom scores. Furthermore, MolLedger produces attributions that are more faithful to chemical properties than other interpretability methods because the auxiliary loss in MolLedger anchors the atom scores to chemical properties. Our case studies comparing interpretations from multiple methods on molecular pairs reveal that MolLedger is much better at producing sensible explanations for predicted property changes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 MolLedger 的图神经网络架构，通过将预测结果分解为逐原子分数之和实现内置的精确可解释性，在保持与现有方法同等性能的同时，借助全局上下文向量和辅助损失使原子级归因更忠实于化学性质。
AI.motivation: 优化吸收、分布、代谢、排泄（ADME）特性是小型分子药物发现的重要环节，许多机器学习模型已被用于预测 ADME 性质，但解释模型预测结果具有挑战性，因此需要一种既能保持良好预测性能又能提供有意义、可解释归因的模型。
AI.method: MolLedger 是一种新的图神经网络架构，其核心设计是加性框架：模型输出的预测值为各原子分数之和。全局上下文向量为加性头部提供足够上下文，使逐原子分数在零性能损失下获得精确可解释性；此外，辅助损失将原子分数锚定到化学性质上，使归因比其它可解释性方法更忠实于化学特征。
AI.result: MolLedger 在获得精确可解释性的同时不损失预测性能；其产生的归因比其他可解释性方法更忠实于化学性质；在分子对案例研究中，MolLedger 对预测性质变化的解释明显更加合理。
AI.conclusion: MolLedger 通过加性设计将可解释性内置于图神经网络中，实现了预测性能与精确归因的兼得，并为面向 ADME 性质预测的分子解释提供了一种更忠实、更合理的方法。

title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
summary: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NavMCP，一个将 VLM 推理智能体与导航基础模型（NFM）执行器耦合的智能体脚手架框架，用于长时域物理世界探索。该框架通过意图、观测、记忆三个通道实现两者协作，在不重训练任一模型的前提下将孤立的导航轨迹转化为持久的具身交互，并在多个评测基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 长时域物理世界智能体必须同时具备远距离目标推理能力和可靠的闭环行为基础。然而现有基础模型能力割裂：VLM 能推理缺失信息、调整高层计划，但在重复导航落地（grounding）上脆弱低效；NFM 能稳健执行语义目标，但只能进行有界回合，缺乏持久的任务级推理。因此需要一个框架将两者的互补能力整合。
AI.method: NavMCP 是一种智能体脚手架框架：VLM 负责决策需要寻找什么证据、在哪里搜索以及何时停止，NFM 负责将每个语义子目标落地为闭环导航。两者通过三个通道协作：意图（intent）将证据需求转化为导航调用；观测（observation）将轨迹转化为带来源依据的轨迹证据；记忆（memory）跨调用累积发现、负面证据与未解决目标。该设计无需重训练任一模型，将孤立的导航回合转变为持久的具身交互。
AI.result: 在具身问答任务上，NavMCP 在 HM-EQA、MT-HM3D 和 EXPRESS-Bench 上取得最先进结果；在匹配的智能体与执行器主干下，相比回合制接口在 HM-EQA 上提升 14.9 个百分点。在 Unitree Go2 实体机器人上达到 78.3% 成功率，且随任务时域增长，其相对最强基线的优势从 10 个点扩大到 45 个点。
AI.conclusion: NavMCP 展示了将互补的基础模型通过脚手架式编排组合为长时域物理世界智能体的巨大潜力，通过结构化协作通道实现了持久推理与稳健闭环执行的统一。

title: PaperBanana-Interact: Scientific Diagram Refinement with Multi-Turn Human Feedback
summary: Recent efforts have aimed to automate scientific diagram generation from paper content (Lin et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026a). However, fully satisfying an author's visual and communicative preferences in a single turn is challenging: in our formative user study (N = 14), all participants requested further revisions after viewing an initial draft, and 86% of them rated the refined diagrams as more satisfactory. Despite the clear demand, the multi-turn workflow remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present MTPaperBananaBench, a benchmark for multi-turn diagram generation containing 292 images annotated with 3,518 user requirements. To reduce expensive human studies and enable scalable benchmarking, we construct a user simulator that, at each turn, identifies unsatisfied requirements and converts k of them into natural language feedback. Evaluating both requirement satisfaction and overall diagram quality reveals two key failure modes shared across baseline multiturn systems: (1) quality drift, where diagram quality progressively declines over turns, and (2) forgetting, where previously implemented features are lost in subsequent turns. To address these issues, we introduce PaperBanana-Interact, a multi-agent system that refines diagrams via an internal critique-and-refine loop. PaperBanana-Interact consistently improves rather than degrades diagram quality across turns, outperforming baselines by 11.9-18.6 points in quality score and reducing forgetting by 3.7-6.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MTPaperBananaBench，一个包含 292 张图像、3,518 条用户需求的多轮科学图表生成基准，并引入用户模拟器以可扩展方式评估多轮迭代效果；同时提出 PaperBanana-Interact 多智能体系统，通过内部“批评-精炼”循环解决现有基线存在的质量漂移与需求遗忘两大缺陷，在质量分数上超越基线 11.9–18.6 分，并将遗忘现象降低 3.7–6.2 分。
AI.motivation: 现有自动生成科学图表的工作多为单轮生成，难以在一次交互中完全满足作者的视觉与沟通偏好。形成性用户研究（N=14）显示所有参与者都要求进一步修改，且 86% 认为精炼后的图表更令人满意，说明多轮迭代需求强烈，但该流程尚未被充分探索，也缺乏相应的可扩展评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 MTPaperBananaBench 多轮图表生成基准（292 张图像、3,518 条用户需求），并设计一个用户模拟器：在每轮中识别未满足的需求，并将其中的 k 条转换为自然语言反馈，以减少昂贵的人工研究、支持大规模基准评测。在此基础上提出 PaperBanana-Interact 多智能体系统，通过内部评判-精炼循环（critique-and-refine loop）迭代改进图表。
AI.result: 评测发现所有基线多轮系统均存在两类关键失败模式：(1) 质量漂移——图表质量随轮次逐渐下降；(2) 遗忘——先前已实现的特征在后续轮次中丢失。PaperBanana-Interact 则能跨轮次持续提升而非降低图表质量，在质量分数上超越基线 11.9–18.6 分，并将遗忘降低 3.7–6.2 分。
AI.conclusion: 多轮交互是满足作者图表偏好的必要途径，而“内部批评-精炼”机制能够有效缓解质量漂移与需求遗忘问题，为多轮图表生成提供了可靠的评测基准与改进方法，指向更具交互性的科学图表自动化生成方向。

title: Three Steps at a Time: Learning Representations from Action Sequences in Contrastive RL
summary: While self-supervised approaches to reinforcement learning have achieved strong results by learning representations of states and actions, a key open question is the time scale over which actions should be modeled. Departing from the standard formulation relying on single-step actions, we extend contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL), a prototypical self-supervised method, to operate over action chunks, and find that this results in large, pervasive gains across established offline and online benchmarks: +31.7% and +93.1% across 18 and 11 environments respectively. While action-chunking-driven gains are generally explained through the ability to model non-Markovian, temporally extended policies, and to propagate unbiased multi-step returns, interestingly, we find that these arguments only partially apply to CRL. Our empirical studies suggest that, in the context of CRL, an action chunk carries more information about the goal than a single action, measurably improving the critic's representations, and rendering the algorithm significantly more effective.

AI.tldr: 本文将对比强化学习（CRL）从单步动作建模扩展为对动作块（action chunks）进行建模，并在离线与在线基准上分别取得+31.7%（18个环境）和+93.1%（11个环境）的大幅提升；研究发现传统解释（非马尔可夫时序策略与无偏多步回报）仅部分适用于CRL，其增益主要源于动作块比单步动作携带更多关于目标的信息，从而显著改善critic的表征。
AI.motivation: 自监督强化学习方法通过学习状态和动作的表征取得了不错的效果，但一个关键开放问题是动作应该在什么时间尺度上建模。标准方法仅对单步动作建模，作者希望探究在对比强化学习（CRL）这类典型自监督方法中，对更长时间尺度的动作块建模是否能带来性能提升。
AI.method: 作者将对比强化学习（CRL）扩展为对动作块（action chunks）进行操作，即在对比学习的表征学习过程中以多步动作序列而非单步动作作为建模单元，并在多种离线与在线强化学习基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 动作块建模在18个离线环境中带来+31.7%的提升，在11个在线环境中带来+93.1%的提升。进一步的经验研究表明，虽然动作块增益通常被归因于建模非马尔可夫、时间上延展的策略以及传播无偏多步回报，但这些解释对CRL仅部分成立；实际原因是动作块相比单步动作携带更多关于目标的信息，能量化地改善critic的表征，使算法显著更有效。
AI.conclusion: 在CRL的语境下，动作块带来的增益主要由信息更丰富的目标表征驱动，而非传统上认为的非马尔可夫策略建模或多步无偏回报传播，这一发现为自监督时序表征学习中动作时间尺度的选择提供了新的理解。

title: Dense Clinical Contrasts Enhance Medical Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models
summary: Medical knowledge changes continually, making large language models vulnerable to relying on outdated yet clinically plausible information. We study whether the format of supervision affects medical knowledge updating under a matched training-budget setting. We introduce SEER-Bench, a temporally anchored oncology-staging benchmark curated from the latest versioned SEER Research Data release, and render identical medical update events from NCCN oncology guidelines into four supervision formats: EMQ, MSQ, FITB, and SAQ. Across SEER-Bench and HealthBench Professional, EMQ gives the most stable external transfer and retention among same-budget SFT variants. With EMQ supervision, the updated 4B model produces competitive results on temporally anchored oncology staging, reaching 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on SEER-Bench. Diagnostic analyses suggest that EMQ exposes denser clinical contrast signals while preserving discriminative representations with smaller movement from the base model. These results show that medical knowledge updating depends not only on the update algorithm, but also on how knowledge is structured as supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在固定训练预算下，监督数据格式是否影响大语言模型的医学知识更新效果，并为此构建了基于最新版SEER研究数据的时间锚定肿瘤分期基准SEER-Bench，将NCCN指南中的相同医学更新事件渲染为四种监督格式（EMQ、MSQ、FITB、SAQ）进行系统比较。
AI.motivation: 医学知识不断更新，大语言模型容易依赖过时但临床看似合理的信息。已有研究多聚焦于更新算法本身，但监督格式（知识如何被结构化）对医学知识更新的影响尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 引入时间锚定的肿瘤分期基准SEER-Bench，数据来自最新版本化SEER研究数据发布；将NCCN肿瘤学指南中的相同医学更新事件渲染为四种监督格式：EMQ（扩展多选题）、MSQ（多选题）、FITB（填空）和SAQ（简答题）；在相同训练预算下对4B模型进行SFT更新，并在SEER-Bench和HealthBench Professional上评估外部迁移与知识保留。
AI.result: 在相同预算的SFT变体中，EMQ表现出最稳定的外部迁移和知识保留；使用EMQ监督的更新后4B模型在SEER-Bench上达到64.8%答案准确率和59.6%推理准确率；诊断分析表明EMQ提供更密集的临床对比信号，同时使模型相对基座模型保持较小的表征移动，即保留更具区分度的表征。
AI.conclusion: 医学知识更新不仅取决于更新算法，还取决于知识如何被结构化作为监督信号；EMQ格式是监督格式设计上的较优选择，可为医疗领域知识更新提供更可靠、更稳定的方案。

title: FoundYou: A Unified Model for Personalized Segmentation and Retrieval
summary: Personalized segmentation and personalized retrieval both aim to identify the same physical object across different images. While the former localizes the object within a target image, the latter retrieves images where it appears. Despite this shared instance-level objective, the two tasks have largely evolved separately and are addressed with distinct solutions. In this work, we introduce FoundYou, a unified framework built on the observation that Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), trained to preserve object identity across video frames, inherently captures instance-level cues. We leverage this property to match objects across independent images, enabling segmentation and retrieval to emerge as two outcomes of the same instance alignment process. This unified view unlocks new capabilities beyond traditional benchmarks, including few-shot personalized retrieval and promptable personalized segmentation with flexible prompts. Extensive experiments show consistent gains over unified and task-specific methods, including +18.4 mIoU on PerMIS and +17.8 mAP on ILIAS. Performance scales with additional references and remains robust to weaker prompts. Beyond personalization, FoundYou achieves state-of-the-art results on category-level retrieval benchmarks. Notably, our approach keeps the SAM 2-small model entirely frozen and adds only 5.9 M trainable parameters, yielding a 52 M-parameter model that is over 75x faster and 20x smaller than the only prior unified solution. Code is available at https://github.com/ga1i13o/FoundYou .

AI.tldr: FoundYou 是一个基于 SAM 2 的统一框架，利用 SAM 2 在视频帧间保持物体身份的能力来匹配跨图像中的同一物理对象，从而将个性化分割与个性化检索统一为同一实例对齐过程的两个输出，且只需 5.9 M 可训练参数（SAM 2-small 保持冻结），在多个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 个性化分割和个性化检索本质上都旨在跨不同图像识别同一物理对象，前者在目标图像中定位对象，后者检索包含该对象的图像。尽管两者共享实例级目标，但这两个任务长期独立发展，采用不同的解决方案。作者希望找到一个统一框架，让分割与检索能作为同一过程的结果自然产生，并解锁超越传统基准的新能力。
AI.method: 核心观察是：为在视频帧间保持对象身份而训练的 Segment Anything 2（SAM 2）天然蕴含实例级线索。据此，FoundYou 利用这一属性在独立图像之间进行对象匹配，使分割和检索作为同一实例对齐过程的两个输出同时涌现。该统一视图还支持小样本个性化检索和可提示的个性化分割（灵活的提示）。模型仅增加 5.9 M 可训练参数，SAM 2-small 完全保持冻结。
AI.result: 实验表明 FoundYou 相对统一方法与任务专属方法均取得一致增益：在 PerMIS 上 +18.4 mIoU，在 ILIAS 上 +17.8 mAP；性能随额外参考图像增加而提升，且对较弱的提示保持鲁棒。在类别级检索基准上达到最先进水平。最终模型为 52 M 参数，比此前唯一的统一方案快 75 倍以上、小 20 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示分割与检索共享的实例级本质，FoundYou 证明一个基于 SAM 2 的轻量统一框架即可同时胜任两项任务，并在性能、效率、可扩展性上全面超越现有方法，同时开辟了小样本个性化检索和灵活提示可提示分割等新能力。

title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such as operators and predicates, are difficult to systematically manipulate in natural language. We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems. Our method operates on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks, enabling targeted modifications to logical operators and other structural components before translating them back into natural language. Using this framework, we evaluate various LLMs under cumulative and individual operator edits and analyze their behavior in response to these changes. Our quantitative and qualitative analyses show that LLM reasoning behavior under controlled operator edits is inconsistent, regardless of model size or family: models sometimes adapt correctly to structural changes but often fail to track their logical consequences. The results from this automated stress test enable an evaluation of language models across different dimensions and help measure the reliability of their reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于工具的框架，对一阶逻辑和约束满足问题任务的符号表示进行受控且保持标签不变的编辑（如修改逻辑算子），再将其转换回自然语言，以系统化地压力测试大语言模型的逻辑推理能力。实验表明，无论模型规模或家族如何，LLM在受控算子编辑下表现出不一致的推理行为。
AI.motivation: LLM的逻辑推理能力至关重要，但其推理常对问题表述的表面细微变化敏感，引发对模型是否真正遵循底层逻辑结构的质疑。由于自然语言中逻辑算子、谓词等符号成分难以系统化操纵，研究这一现象面临挑战，因此需要一种能生成受控、标签保持编辑的自动化框架。
AI.method: 提出工具驱动的框架：在一阶逻辑和约束满足问题任务的符号表示上执行有针对性的编辑（如逻辑算子及其他结构组件的修改），保持标签不变，然后将编辑后的符号表示翻译回自然语言。基于该框架，对多种LLM施加累积式与单算子式编辑，并进行定量与定性分析。
AI.result: 定量和定性分析表明，LLM在受控算子编辑下的推理行为不一致，且与模型规模或家族无关：模型有时能正确适应结构变化，但经常无法追踪这些变化带来的逻辑后果。该自动化压力测试支持从不同维度评估语言模型，并帮助衡量其推理的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的逻辑推理在符号结构（尤其是算子）编辑下并不可靠，即使模型能识别结构变化也常常无法正确推导其逻辑影响；该框架可作为评估不同维度下模型推理可靠性的有效压力测试工具，为提升LLM逻辑推理的稳健性提供依据。

title: Season-Aware Hybrid Convolutional-Transformer for Antarctic Sea Ice Concentration Forecasting
summary: Antarctic sea ice concentration (SIC) forecasting is an important yet challenging task due to the coexistence of complex spatial structure, long-range temporal dependencies, and strong seasonal variability. Conventional convolution-based models are effective at capturing local spatial patterns, but often have limited ability to model long-term temporal evolution. To address these challenges, we build on a hybrid Convolutional-Transformer forecasting framework for monthly Antarctic SIC forecasting. This framework combines convolutional encoding for spatial feature extraction with factorised self-attention for spatio-temporal dependency modelling. We further introduce two seasonal prior mechanisms: a month-aware positional encoding that injects calendar-month information into the token representation, and a seasonal temporal bias that encourages attention to periodically related historical states. Experimental results show that the proposed framework achieves better performance than convolutional and recurrent baselines across both classification and regression metrics. Ablation studies further indicate that the seasonal prior mechanisms provide consistent additional gains in both short- and long-horizon prediction. These results demonstrate the value of combining convolutional structures, attention mechanisms, and periodic prior information for Antarctic SIC forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合卷积-Transformer框架用于逐月南极海冰密集度（SIC）预测，通过卷积编码提取空间特征、因子化自注意力建模时空依赖，并引入月感知位置编码与季节时间偏置两种季节先验机制，在分类与回归指标上均优于卷积和循环基线。
AI.motivation: 南极海冰密集度预测因兼具复杂空间结构、长程时间依赖和强季节变化而颇具挑战；传统基于卷积的模型擅长捕捉局部空间模式，但难以建模长期时间演化，需要更强大的时空建模方案。
AI.method: 构建混合卷积-Transformer预测框架：以卷积编码进行空间特征提取，采用因子化自注意力建模时空依赖；并设计两种季节先验机制——月感知位置编码（将日历月份信息注入token表示）和季节时间偏置（促使注意力关注周期性相关的历史状态）。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在分类与回归指标上均优于卷积和循环基线；消融研究显示两种季节先验机制在短期与长期预测中均带来一致的性能增益，证明了组合卷积结构、注意力机制与周期先验信息的价值。
AI.conclusion: 将卷积结构、注意力机制与周期性先验信息相结合，能有效提升南极海冰密集度预测性能，其中季节先验机制是稳定有效的增益来源。

title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and inheritance reasoning, with formally verified ground truth at every turn, enabling controlled measurement of how models respond to confirming and disconfirming evidence. This controlled generation process creates a testbed for experimental designs that isolate specific reasoning demands. Applying this capability to the study of confirmation bias, we evaluate nine open and proprietary large language models and find that nearly all exhibit a systematic tendency to accept congruent evidence while resisting incongruent updates, with several models correctly identifying a weakening update yet failing to revise their conclusion. We believe our work and findings will facilitate future research on evaluating language models in defeasible reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeReLab，一个基于参数化图结构生成多轮信念更新对话的生成式框架，覆盖默认推理与继承推理，每轮都有形式化验证的真实标签；用其评测九个开源与专有大语言模型，发现几乎所有模型都存在确认偏差——倾向接受一致证据、抗拒不一致更新，且多个模型能识别削弱性更新却未修正结论。
AI.motivation: 以往关于大语言模型可废止推理的研究使用的数据集是静态的，且缺乏对非单调推理类别的广泛覆盖，难以对模型在证据确认与反驳下的信念更新行为进行受控测量。
AI.method: 提出 DeReLab 生成式框架，从参数化图结构生成多轮信念更新对话，覆盖默认推理和继承推理；每一轮均具有形式化验证的地面真值，从而可控地分离特定的推理需求，为实验设计提供测试平台。
AI.result: 对九个开源和专有大语言模型的评测显示，几乎所有模型都表现出系统性的确认偏差倾向：接受一致证据、抗拒不一致更新；部分模型虽能正确识别削弱性更新，却未能据此修正结论。
AI.conclusion: DeReLab 及其评测发现为未来在可废止推理场景下评估大语言模型提供了可控的基准工具与实证基础。

title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Entropy Sensitivity-Guidance in Strict Online Setting
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) promises robustness under distribution shift by updating a pretrained model on unlabeled test data, but strict online TTA with batch size one and no access to source data is especially prone to drift or collapse. We introduce Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation (SEGA), a method for strict online continual TTA (CTTA) on corruption-style streams. SEGA uses a small number of structured erasures to probe how predictive entropy changes as information is removed, and uses the resulting per-sample sensitivity trajectories to coordinate recovery and sample selection rather than relying on raw entropy or batch statistics. This yields a practical feedback signal for long-horizon batch-size-one adaptation without periodic resets or model reservoirs. In experiments on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10/100-C, and corruption-generated aquaculture streams treated as controlled corruption-style proxies, SEGA yields consistent robustness and stability gains over strong CTTA baselines while reducing backward passes through sensitivity-based gating.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SEGA（Sensitivity-Guided Erasing Adaptation），一种面向严格在线持续测试时适应（CTTA）的方法，通过在测试样本上施加少量结构化擦除来探测预测熵如何随信息移除而变化，并利用逐样本的敏感性轨迹来协调模型恢复与样本选择，从而在批量大小为 1、无源数据的严格在线设置下避免漂移或崩溃。
AI.motivation: 测试时适应（TTA）通过在无标注测试数据上更新预训练模型来应对分布偏移，但严格在线 TTA（batch size 为 1、无法访问源数据）对漂移或模型崩溃尤为敏感。现有方法依赖原始熵或批量统计量，且常需周期性重置或模型库来维持长期稳定性，缺乏在长时程、单样本流上的可靠反馈信号。
AI.method: SEGA 使用少量结构化擦除来探测预测熵随信息移除的变化，得到逐样本的敏感性轨迹；基于该轨迹进行协调性恢复（recovery）和样本选择（sample selection），而非直接依赖原始熵或批量统计量。该方法无需周期性重置或模型储备库，并通过基于敏感性的门控机制减少反向传播次数。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-C、CIFAR10/100-C 以及作为受控腐蚀风格代理的生成式水产养殖数据流上，SEGA 相比强 CTTA 基线在鲁棒性和稳定性上取得了一致的提升，同时通过敏感性门控降低了反向传播负担。
AI.conclusion: SEGA 为长时程、批量大小为 1 的严格在线 CTTA 提供了一种实用且有效的反馈信号，在不依赖重置或模型库的前提下显著改善鲁棒性与稳定性，为腐蚀风格分布偏移下的持续适应提供了新思路。

title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization
summary: Neurosymbolic reasoning has shown promising success in addressing complex reasoning tasks by combining large language models (LLMs) and symbolic solvers. While this approach shows promise, a fundamental challenge remains: improving the accuracy of translations from natural language to logical formulas. Current methods predominantly rely on prompt engineering, which is difficult to scale across different domains and input formats. Drawing inspiration from the success of fine-tuning in other model adaptation and alignment applications, we propose a fine-tuning-based Stratified Consistency Distillation approach: (1) We generate K logical translations per input using a frontier LLM and cluster them by semantic equivalence (2) Based on the entropy level, we apply majority voting (low entropy), LLM-as-a-Judge (medium entropy), or unification/abstention (high entropy), and (3) fine-tune a smaller model using the selected pseudo-labels. Our experiments show significant and consistent improvements in both Pass@K and our novel Equivalent Logical Similarity metrics, demonstrating the potential of advancing logical translation through consistency distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于分层的（Stratified）一致性蒸馏方法，用于微调小型模型，将自然语言更准确地翻译为逻辑公式，以提升神经符号推理的性能。
AI.motivation: 神经符号推理通过结合大语言模型与符号求解器在复杂推理任务上表现良好，但从自然语言到逻辑公式的翻译准确性仍是一个根本性挑战。现有方法主要依赖提示工程（prompt engineering），难以在不同领域和输入格式间扩展。作者希望借鉴微调在其他模型适配与对齐任务中的成功经验，解决该可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 提出基于微调的分层一致性蒸馏（Stratified Consistency Distillation）方法，包含三步：(1) 对每个输入使用前沿LLM生成K个逻辑翻译，并按语义等价性对其进行聚类；(2) 根据熵水平分层选择伪标签：低熵时采用多数投票，中熵时采用LLM-as-a-Judge，高熵时采用统一化或弃权（unification/abstention）；(3) 使用选出的伪标签对小型模型进行微调。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在Pass@K以及新提出的等效逻辑相似度（Equivalent Logical Similarity）指标上均取得显著且一致的改进，验证了通过一致性蒸馏推进逻辑翻译的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 基于熵分层选择伪标签的一致性蒸馏可以有效提升小型模型的逻辑翻译质量，为神经符号推理中的自然语言到逻辑公式转换提供了一种可扩展、可微调的方案，优于依赖提示工程的传统方法。

title: CoMPASS: Collaborative Molecular Property Prediction via Adaptive Small-Large Model Synergy
summary: Accurate molecular property prediction requires both statistical reliability and chemical reasoning. Graph neural networks can be calibrated directly on labeled assays but remain limited by the coverage of their training data. Large language models (LLMs) can compare molecular evidence and articulate chemical rationales, yet are unreliable as standalone quantitative predictors. The central challenge is therefore to determine when an LLM should influence a calibrated model and by how much. Here we present CoMPASS, a retrieval-calibrated framework for small-large model collaboration. CoMPASS retains a graph attention network (GAT) as the predictive anchor, retrieves locally relevant training molecules, provides attention-grounded evidence to an LLM, and converts its proposal into a bounded correction through an agreement-aware gate. Across six classification and two regression benchmarks, CoMPASS improves the GAT anchor in regions of correctable uncertainty while limiting LLM intervention in high-confidence regimes. Ablations show that the gains arise from validation-calibrated retrieval and bounded fusion rather than prompting alone. These results suggest that generative reasoning should augment calibrated prediction through evidence-grounded, controlled corrections rather than direct output replacement. Code is available at https://github.com/littlepeachs/CoMPASS.

AI.tldr: CoMPASS 是一种检索校准的小-大模型协作框架，用于分子性质预测。它以图注意力网络（GAT）作为预测锚点，检索局部相关的训练分子，向大语言模型（LLM）提供基于注意力的证据，并通过一致性感知门控将 LLM 的建议转化为有界修正，从而在可修正的不确定区域提升 GAT 性能，同时在高置信区域限制 LLM 干预。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测需要同时具备统计可靠性与化学推理能力。图神经网络可在标注实验上校准，但受限于训练数据覆盖范围；大语言模型能比较分子证据并阐述化学依据，但作为独立定量预测器不可靠。核心挑战在于决定 LLM 何时应影响已校准模型、影响程度多大。
AI.method: CoMPASS 保留 GAT 作为预测锚点；检索局部相关训练分子；向 LLM 提供基于注意力机制的证据；通过一致性感知的（agreement-aware）有界门控将 LLM 提议转化为有界修正。增益来源于验证集校准的检索和有界融合，而非单纯的提示工程。
AI.result: 在六个分类和两个回归基准上，CoMPASS 在可修正不确定区域显著改进 GAT 锚点，同时在高置信度区域限制 LLM 干预；消融实验表明增益来自验证校准的检索与有界融合。
AI.conclusion: 生成式推理应通过基于证据的、受控的修正来增强校准预测，而不是直接替代模型输出。该结果表明小-大模型协作在分子性质预测上的可行范式。

title: From Metaheuristics to Exact Methods: A CP-SAT Approach for Multi-Objective Healthcare Workforce Scheduling
comment: 13 pages, 10 tables. Accepted at MODeM Workshop, IJCAI-ECAI 2026. Extends arXiv:2607.05177
summary:
Healthcare workforce scheduling is an NP-hard optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and cost objectives. Existing approaches (genetic algorithms, integer programming, constraint programming) model 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and cannot guarantee regulatory compliance. They also lack support for multi-role, multi-skill heterogeneity, mandatory break scheduling with midpoint control, acuity-weighted workload equity, sub-shift granularity, inter-week stability, and cross-midnight shifts.
  This paper presents CP-SAT: a Constraint Programming formulation for multi-role, multi-skill healthcare scheduling. CP-SAT enforces 14 hard constraints guaranteeing zero regulatory violations, while optimizing 15 soft objectives via a unified weighted penalty function. Contributions include a shift-window decomposition enabling break scheduling with centrality control, acuity-weighted workload equity, multi-granularity resolution from 15 minutes to 1 day, inter-week stability, and grid-offset preprocessing mapping cross-midnight shifts into a single scheduling day without solver changes.
  CP-SAT is evaluated on 18 instances: five synthetic hospital units (10-33 nurses), 10 INRC-II benchmarks (5-80 nurses, up to 8-week horizons) and 3 NRP-23 compatible instances (10-25 nurses) with cross-midnight Night shifts. Results: zero hard-constraint violations across all 18 instances by construction; proven optimality on INRC-II n005w4 (objective 118, gap 0.0%, 104s); feasible schedules scaling to 179,800 variables and 351,425 constraints (80 nurses); service quality improved 50-67% over MOGA; and model size scaling near-linearly at approximately 4,400 variables per employee. The formulation enforces 29 total constraints (14 hard, 15 soft), nearly three times the industry average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于约束规划（CP-SAT）的多角色、多技能医疗人员排班方法，通过14条硬约束保证法规合规，并以统一加权惩罚函数优化15个软目标；在18个实例上实现零硬约束违反，且计算规模可扩展至80名护士、179,800个变量。
AI.motivation: 医疗排班是NP-hard优化问题，需同时满足劳动法规、覆盖需求、员工偏好与成本目标。现有方法（遗传算法、整数规划、约束规划）仅建模6-12条约束且停留在班次粒度，无法保证法规合规；同时缺乏对多角色/多技能异构、带中点控制的强制休息排班、按 acuity 加权的工作量公平、亚班次粒度、跨周稳定性及跨午夜班次的支持。
AI.method: 提出 CP-SAT 约束规划模型：以14条硬约束强制实现零法规违规，通过统一加权惩罚函数优化15个软目标。关键技术包括：移位窗口分解（shift-window decomposition）以支持带中心性控制的休息排班；acuity 加权工作量公平机制；从15分钟到1天的多粒度求解；跨周稳定性约束；以及网格偏移预处理（grid-offset preprocessing），将跨午夜班次映射到单一排班日而无需修改求解器。
AI.result: 在18个实例上评估：5个合成医院单元（10-33名护士）、10个INRC-II基准（5-80名护士、最长8周）、3个含跨午夜夜班的NRP-23实例（10-25名护士）。结果显示：全部18个实例按构造实现零硬约束违反；在INRC-II n005w4上证明最优（目标值118，gap 0.0%，耗时104秒）；可扩展至80名护士的可行排班（179,800个变量、351,425条约束）；服务品质较MOGA提升50-67%；模型规模近似线性扩展，约每名员工4,400个变量。
AI.conclusion: 该公式共强制29条约束（14条硬约束、15条软约束），约为行业平均水平的三倍，在法规合规性、粒度精细度、可扩展性与解质量方面全面超越现有方法，为多角色医疗排班提供了可行且可证明最优的通用求解方案。

title: Towards Continual Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) relies on vision-language alignment to recognize arbitrary text-defined categories, yet this alignment is fragile under continual test-time distribution shift. Our diagnostic analysis reveals that entropy minimization drives patch-level class collapse, continual updates erode vision-language alignment, and redundant gradients from low-shift samples waste computation. We propose Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF), a stabilization framework that augments entropy-based adaptation with a marginal diversity loss that resists collapse, a cross-modal anchor consistency loss that constrains feature drift relative to a frozen source model, and feature salience filtering that skips low-value backward passes to offset part of the source-anchor overhead. We evaluate on five datasets spanning natural scenes, autonomous driving, underwater imagery, and remote sensing with their corrupted variants. Across the evaluated continual shifts, DAF remains stable where entropy minimization collapses, improving mIoU by over 8 points on Pascal VOC20-C, over 9 points on LoveDA, and over 3 points on Foggy Cityscapes compared to the source model, and is robust to aggressive adaptation and learning rate choices.

AI.tldr: 提出 DAF 稳定化框架，解决开放词汇语义分割在持续测试时分布偏移下熵最小化导致的类别坍缩、视觉-语言对齐退化与冗余梯度浪费问题，在五个数据集上提升 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇语义分割依赖视觉-语言对齐来识别任意文本定义的类别，但该对齐在持续测试时分布偏移下非常脆弱。诊断分析发现三个关键问题：熵最小化导致 patch 级类别坍缩、持续更新侵蚀视觉-语言对齐、低偏移样本产生的冗余梯度浪费计算资源。因此需要一种能稳定退化过程的适应方法。
AI.method: 提出 Diversify, Anchor, and Filter (DAF) 框架，包含三个组件：1) 边际多样性损失（marginal diversity loss），通过增强熵基适应来抵抗类别坍缩；2) 跨模态锚定一致性损失（cross-modal anchor consistency loss），约束特征相对于冻结源模型的漂移；3) 特征显著性过滤（feature salience filtering），跳过低价值的反向传播以抵消源锚定的部分开销。
AI.result: 在覆盖自然场景、自动驾驶、水下影像和遥感五个数据集及其损坏变体上评估。在熵最小化失效的持续偏移场景中，DAF 保持稳定：相比源模型，在 Pascal VOC20-C 上 mIoU 提升超过 8 点，在 LoveDA 上超过 9 点，在 Foggy Cityscapes 上超过 3 点，并且对激进的适应策略和学习率选择具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DAF 通过多样性与锚定约束缓解熵最小化在持续测试时分布偏移下的不稳定性，并通过过滤机制控制计算开销，从而在保持视觉-语言对齐的同时实现稳定且鲁棒的开放词汇语义分割适应。

title: Using Prosody to Predict Syntactic Structure
summary: While it is well-established that prosody carries crucial cues for syntactic structure, the degree and nature of correspondence between these two domains remains contested. We investigate the syntax-prosody interface through an information-theoretic lens, quantifying the interaction between prosodic features and syntactic representations as their mutual information. We provide a general-purpose framework for estimating this quantity over large speech-text corpora using multimodal language models. Our framework is structure-agnostic and modular, insofar as it can be used to measure the contributions of individual prosodic features or components of structure. We evaluate the syntax-prosody relationship for two features (word duration and inter-word pauses) across two domains--read audiobooks and spontaneous conversations--both in English. Our results demonstrate that prosody contains measurable syntactic information, with prosodic features reducing syntactic uncertainty in spontaneous conversations by up to 10.2%. Our findings offer new empirical support for several theoretical accounts of the syntax-prosody interface.

AI.tldr: 本文通过信息论视角，利用多模态语言模型在大规模语音-文本语料上估算韵律特征与句法表征之间的互信息，评估了词时长和词间停顿两种韵律特征在朗读有声书和自发对话两个领域（均为英语）中携带句法信息的程度，发现韵律特征最高可将自发对话中的句法不确定性降低10.2%。
