AI.result: 三类核心发现：(i) 文本安全可定位，约88个神经元（<0.01%）的定向消融即可显著降低拒答；(ii) 文本安全神经元构成主导拒答通路，消融它们是唯一能跨全部模型一致、显著降低拒答的干预方式；(iii) 视觉安全在单神经元层面是高维且弥散的——文本安全集中于约5个子空间方向，而视觉安全至少需要50个方向。该差距在不同架构中普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 视觉与文本安全在神经元层面的可定位性/维度差异是结构性的，跨架构一致存在，这从根本上解释了当前对齐方法为何无法弥合视觉安全缺口；研究为VLM安全对齐提供了神经元级因果证据与基准工具（项目页面已公开）。

title: TuringLLM: Efficiently Scaling Foundation Models Toward Physical AI
summary: We present Turing-20B-A2B, a 20B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model that activates approximately 2B parameters per token, designed for long-context and latency-sensitive physical AI applications. The model adopts Quantile Routing in a dynamic top-k configuration, enabling token-adaptive expert allocation while maintaining balanced expert utilization and a controlled average compute budget. During deployment, we further apply capacity-constrained routing to prompt prefill for more regular and efficient expert execution, while retaining dropless routing during pretraining. Turing-20B-A2B also employs a hybrid attention architecture that combines Lightning Attention with a small number of full-attention layers for efficient long-context modeling. The model is pretrained with a progressive three-stage curriculum and extended to a native context length of 128K through continued pretraining, with further inference-time extension to 512K using YaRN. Despite its compact active-parameter budget, Turing-20B-A2B achieves, at the base-model stage, overall general capability exceeding Qwen3-8B Base and approaching Qwen3.5-9B Base, while maintaining strong long-context performance and favorable prefill-latency scaling. These results demonstrate an effective balance among model capability, long-context scalability, and practical inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: Turing-20B-A2B 是一个20B参数的混合专家（MoE）语言模型，每个token仅激活约2B参数，通过量化路由（Quantile Routing）、动态top-k配置、混合注意力架构（Lightning Attention与少量全注意力层）及三阶段渐进式预训练，实现了128K原生上下文（可经YaRN扩展到512K），在基础模型阶段的综合能力超越Qwen3-8B Base并接近Qwen3.5-9B Base，同时兼顾长上下文建模与低预填充延迟，为延迟敏感的物理AI应用提供了能力、长上下文可扩展性与推理效率之间的有效平衡。
AI.motivation: 面向长上下文且对延迟敏感的物理AI（physical AI）应用，现有稠密模型在推理成本和延迟上难以满足需求。作者旨在设计一个既保持较强综合能力、又能高效支持长上下文和低预填充延迟的模型，克服MoE专家分配不均、长上下文计算开销大以及训练/部署阶段路由策略不一致等挑战。
AI.method: 提出Turing-20B-A2B：1) 采用动态top-k配置下的量化路由（Quantile Routing），实现token自适应的专家分配，同时维持专家负载均衡并控制平均计算预算；2) 在部署阶段对prompt预填充施加容量受限路由以获得更规则高效的专家执行，而预训练阶段保留无丢弃（dropless）路由；3) 采用Lightning Attention与小量全注意力层结合的混合注意力架构，实现高效长上下文建模；4) 通过渐进式三阶段课程进行预训练，并持续预训练扩展至128K原生上下文，推理时利用YaRN进一步扩展到512K。
AI.result: 在基础模型阶段，Turing-20B-A2B的整体通用能力超过Qwen3-8B Base并接近Qwen3.5-9B Base；同时保持了强大的长上下文性能，并展现出有利的预填充延迟扩展特性，即在更少的活跃参数预算下实现了较强的综合表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的活跃参数预算与精心设计的路由、注意力及训练策略相结合，可以在模型能力、长上下文可扩展性和实际推理效率之间取得有效平衡，验证了面向延迟敏感长上下文场景的高效MoE模型设计路线。

title: FIS-OT: Feature-Induced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation is a challenging task. It involves finding action categories and boundaries in videos without labels. Existing Optimal Transport (OT) methods use global constraints. This causes them to overlook the use of local information. Furthermore, existing Optimal transport architectures are prone to confirmation bias because they overly trust the pseudo-labels they generate. This causes models to learn from noise in the early training stages. To address these issues, we propose FIS-OT. It is a novel Feature-Induced Structured Optimal Transport framework. First, we introduce a Feature Enhanced Generator (FEG) module. It serves as an internal regularizer. By using triplet loss, FEG captures local consistency. It provides robust supervision that is independent of noisy pseudo-labels. Second, we propose a Feature-Induced Residual Structural Prior. This combines a fixed temporal backbone with dynamic feature similarities. This design ensures temporal continuity. It also allows the solver to adapt to complex action structures. Finally, we establish a cyclic optimization loop. This aligns local feature learning with global structural alignment. Extensive experiments on the three datasets show the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出FIS-OT（特征诱导结构化最优传输）框架，用于无监督动作分割。通过特征增强生成器（FEG）结合三元组损失捕获局部一致性，引入特征诱导残差结构先验以结合固定时间骨干与动态特征相似性，并建立循环优化环路对齐局部特征学习与全局结构对齐，在三个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督动作分割中的最优传输（OT）方法使用全局约束，忽略了局部信息的利用；同时现有OT架构过度信任自身生成的伪标签，在训练早期易出现确认偏差，导致从噪声中学习。
AI.method: 提出FIS-OT框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 特征增强生成器（FEG）模块，作为内部正则化器，利用三元组损失捕获局部一致性，提供独立于噪声伪标签的稳健监督；(2) 特征诱导残差结构先验，将固定时间骨干与动态特征相似性相结合，保证时间连续性并让求解器适应复杂动作结构；(3) 循环优化环路，对齐局部特征学习与全局结构对齐。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该方法在无监督动作分割任务上具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时利用局部信息与全局结构先验，并缓解伪标签确认偏差问题，FIS-OT为无监督动作分割提供了有效且稳健的求解方案。

title: PRACTICE: From Experience to Expertise in Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
summary: Recent studies have shown that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can serve as embodied agents, translating language instructions and visual observations into executable plans. However, building agents that can continually improve through interaction and rapidly adapt to their environments remains challenging. Summing up experience from past interaction trajectories provides a promising solution, but existing experience-based methods often rely on manually designed prompting workflows to extract and update skills. Such fixed procedures may struggle to learn updated skills from new and diverse experiences. We introduce PRACTICE, which trains a skill learner to discover and maintain a persistent skill library from past interaction trajectories while keeping the task executor frozen. Given the historical accumulated skills and incoming trajectories, the skill learner produces structured batch-edits that add, refine, merge, or remove skills, and then hierarchical consolidate all collected edits into a consistent updated skill library. We train the learner with a two-stage curriculum. First, it learns basic skill generation and library maintenance from oracle trajectories. Then, by contrasting successful and failed trajectories from heterogeneous executors on the same tasks, it learn to identify invalid action patterns and recovery strategies. Finally, we apply online skill-edit distillation to align the skill learner with a stronger teacher on its current edit distribution to further improves the policy. Experiments demonstrate that a compact skill learner delivers consistent performance improvements across successive library-update rounds for multiple frozen executors. On EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat, PRACTICE further outperforms the strongest experience-based baselines. Project resources are publicly available at: https://baai-agents.github.io/PRACTICE

AI.tldr: PRACTICE 提出一种训练"技能学习者"的方法，从历史交互轨迹中自动发现并维护持久技能库（支持新增、细化、合并、删除技能的批量编辑），同时保持任务执行器冻结，并通过两阶段课程学习与在线技能编辑蒸馏，使多个冻结执行器在连续技能库更新中持续提升性能，在 EB-ALFRED 和 EB-Habitat 上超越现有基于经验的最强基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型可作为具身智能体，但持续通过交互改进并快速适应环境仍具挑战。现有基于经验的方法依赖人工设计的提示工作流来提取和更新技能，固定流程难以从新的多样化经验中学习更新技能，因此需要一种能自适应地从轨迹中维持和更新技能库的机制。
AI.method: PRACTICE 训练一个技能学习者，在冻结任务执行器的前提下，从过往交互轨迹中发现并维护持久技能库：技能学习者产出结构化批量编辑（添加、细化、合并、移除技能），并分层整合所有编辑形成一致的更新技能库。训练采用两阶段课程：第一阶段从 oracle 轨迹学习基础技能生成与库维护；第二阶段通过对比异构执行器在同一任务上的成功与失败轨迹，学习识别无效动作模式与恢复策略。最后应用在线技能编辑蒸馏，将技能学习者与更强教师在其当前编辑分布上对齐以进一步提升策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，紧凑的技能学习者在连续多轮技能库更新中，为多个冻结执行器带来一致的性能提升；在 EB-ALFRED 和 EB-Habitat 基准上，PRACTICE 优于最强的基于经验的方法。
AI.conclusion: PRACTICE 验证了通过可学习的技能编辑机制代替人工设计的技能提取流程，能够在冻结执行器的条件下持续积累与更新技能，为 MLLM 具身智能体的自主经验总结与持续改进提供了有效且可扩展的范式。

title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural language queries about a policy's behavior, lack the structure needed for systematic test case generation. We address both. Probabilistic model checking provides the test oracle, computing exact reference results against which LLM answers are graded automatically. A taxonomy of post hoc query categories structures the input space around the environment-level facts from which policy explanations are composed; test cases generated from it are prioritized by question-specific diagnostic difficulty scores. Across seven MDP environments, the testing separates three open-weight LLMs: a reasoning model passes 85% of test cases, a mid-size model 70%, and a 1B model falls below the random baseline, while prioritization surfaces significantly harder cases than random selection. Our results indicate how trustworthy LLM-generated explanations are in model-free settings, where the same LLMs are used but no oracle exists to verify them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自动化测试框架，用概率模型检验作为测试预言机（oracle）、以事后查询分类法结构化输入空间，并依据问题专属诊断难度分数对测试用例排序，从而系统地检验LLM生成的策略解释是否忠实于底层MDP环境。在七个MDP环境中对三个开放权重LLM的测试显示，推理模型通过85%测试用例，中型模型通过70%，1B模型低于随机基线，且优先级排序能筛选出比随机选取更难的用例。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用作序列决策策略的事后解释器，但会生成看似合理实则错误的陈述；现有方法缺乏测试预言机来判断解释正确性，且自然语言查询缺乏结构化形式，无法进行系统的测试用例生成。这两个经典软件测试难题阻碍了对解释忠实性的验证。
AI.method: 用概率模型检验为每个查询计算精确参考结果，据此自动评判LLM回答（充当测试预言机）；构建事后查询类别的分类法，围绕构成策略解释的环境级事实来结构化输入空间；从分类法生成测试用例，并依据面向具体问题的诊断难度分数对用例进行优先级排序。测试涉及七个MDP环境。
AI.result: 在七个MDP环境中，三个开放权重LLM被显著区分：推理模型通过85%测试用例，中型模型通过70%，1B模型低于随机基线；按诊断难度排序能比随机选择暴露显著更难的测试用例，从而更有效地揭示解释错误。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以环境事实为基准评估了解释的忠实性，结果表明LLM解释的可靠性随模型规模/能力显著变化；这些发现可用于推断在无预言机可验证的model-free场景中，LLM生成解释的可信度上限，为事后可解释性的评测提供了一条可扩展、自动化的路径。

title: SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models
comment: Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at: https://github.com/hcu-cml/citydb-SVI2LoD3-ai.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端、智能体驱动的立面开口LoD3重建流水线，采用零样本分割策略替代需大量人工标注的监督式语义分割，并通过强制部件层级关系生成符合CityGML规范的LoD3建筑模型，同时引入基于视觉Transformer高层特征空间的Facade Feature Distance（FFD）评估指标，用于更全面衡量立面重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有立面重建方法依赖监督式语义分割，需要大量人工标注的训练数据，标注成本高；同时，传统方法难以保证生成符合CityGML规范的LoD3模型；此外，mIoU、FRDS等传统评估指标主要基于像素级重叠，无法充分反映语义正确性与建筑布局。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端、智能体驱动的重建流水线：1）采用零样本分割策略，避免大规模人工标注；2）在重建过程中强制实施正确的部件层次（partonomic hierarchy），以获得CityGML规范的LoD3建筑模型；3）提出新的评估指标FFD，在视觉Transformer的高层特征空间中度量重建结果与真实值之间的距离，同时捕捉语义正确性与建筑布局。
AI.result: 在eTRIMS数据集基准上取得了强性能，同时大幅降低标注工作量；FFD指标相比传统像素级指标能更合适地评估立面重建质量，兼顾语义准确性与建筑布局合理性。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线与评估策略为语义丰富的3D城市模型的自动化生成与分析提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，代码已公开在GitHub上以供复现和进一步研究。

title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
summary: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals: temporal curvature that captures the directional consistency of turn-to-turn updates, and variance slope which measures the expansion or contraction of the exploration space. Across four tasks and three underlying LLMs, we observed that these geometric signals distinguish between correct and incorrect episodes prior to completion. We further decompose each episode into three-action chains formed from four actions (Read, Write, Respond, Transfer) and show that separability is action-dependent, with different signals distinguishing various chain patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that trajectory geometry can identify critical turns in the reasoning process, increasing task success rates on $τ$-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用隐藏状态轨迹的几何特征（时间曲率与方差斜率）刻画LLM Agent在多轮推理中的表征漂移，并据此在推理完成前区分正确与错误的回合，识别关键轮次以提升任务成功率（τ-Bench上从24.1%提升至39.6%）并降低11.2%的token成本。
AI.motivation: 多轮上下文的累积会扰乱底层LLM对早前回合任务相关信息的内在表征，产生"表征漂移"，模糊了建设性推理与漂移的界限；现有方法缺乏一种在学习/任务完成之前就能监测推理质量、识别关键轮次的几何信号。
AI.method: 将多轮推理形式化为底层LLM的隐状态轨迹，用两种互补几何信号刻画：时间曲率（衡量回合间更新的方向一致性）和方差斜率（衡量探索空间随轮次的扩张或收缩）。在四个任务和三种底层LLM上，将回合分解为四种动作（Read、Write、Respond、Transfer）构成的三动作链，分析信号可区分性与动作依赖关系。
AI.result: 几何信号能在推理完成之前区分正确与错误回合；可区分性依动作链模式而不同（动作依赖）。利用轨迹几何识别关键轮次后，τ-Bench任务成功率从24.1%提升至39.6%，同时token成本降低11.2%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹几何可作为低成本、任务无关的在线监测信号，用于早期预判Agent推理质量、定位关键动作轮次，进而提升长程多轮推理在资源受限条件下的性能与效率。

title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we introduce PURGE (\underline{P}artition-aware \underline{U}nlearning for \underline{R}emoving spurious-correlation \underline{G}enerated \underline{E}rrors), a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious-correlation-induced failures in LVLMs. The framework consists of: -- (1) Structured dataset construction wherein we develop three complementary structured data construction strategies that partition examples by object-relevant evidence and spurious background cues, enabling controlled diagnosis of shortcut reliance; and -- (2) Partition-aware unlearning, which uses these partitions to selectively remove spurious object-background associations while preserving object-based reasoning. We evaluate the \algo~framework across multiple LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.6-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with CLIP as a vision-language encoder, on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, Causal-HalBench, MM-SpuBench, AMBER, MMHal, and Waterbirds. Our results show that PURGE consistently reduces hallucinations and spurious-correlation-driven errors while maintaining or improving overall performance in most evaluated settings, providing both a reusable evaluation protocol and an effective mitigation framework for more reliable LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 PURGE 框架，用于构建、评测和缓解大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中因对象-背景虚假相关（spurious correlation）导致的预测偏差与幻觉。该框架包含三类互补的结构化数据构造策略用于受控诊断，以及基于分区（partition-aware）的遗忘（unlearning）方法用于选择性移除虚假关联。在多种 LVLM/CLIP 及 CHAIR、POPE、Causal-HalBench、MM-SpuBench、AMBER、MMHal、Waterbirds 等基准上验证，PURGE 能一致降低幻觉与虚假相关错误，同时保持或提升大多数场景的整体性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型虽然表现强劲，但常利用对象与背景间的虚假相关（即上下文捷径）进行预测，而非依靠目标对象本身的视觉证据。现有幻觉与鲁棒性评测基准对“预测是依据目标对象还是背景线索”这一区分缺乏足够控制，难以精准诊断和缓解这类问题。
AI.method: PURGE 框架由两部分组成：(1) 结构化数据构造，提出三种互补的数据构造策略，按对象相关证据与虚假背景线索对样本进行分区，从而支持对捷径依赖的受控诊断；(2) 分区感知遗忘（partition-aware unlearning），利用这些分区选择性移除对象-背景的虚假关联，同时保留基于对象的推理能力。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-1.6-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-9B 以及作为视觉-语言编码器的 CLIP 上，结合 CHAIR、POPE、Causal-HalBench、MM-SpuBench、AMBER、MMHal、Waterbirds 等多个基准进行评估。结果表明 PURGE 一致地降低了幻觉和虚假相关驱动的错误，并且在大多数评测场景中维持或提升了整体性能。
AI.conclusion: PURGE 提供了一套可复用的评测协议和有效的缓解框架，有助于构建更可靠的 LVLM，减少其依赖上下文捷径而产生的虚假相关错误。

title: Quantitative Evidence Mining for Plausibility-Aware Biomedical AI
summary: Biomedical artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly extract, organize, and reuse scientific claims from literature, clinical trials, and regulatory documents. But automatic extraction alone does not make a claim reliable evidence: a claim becomes useful only when it can be traced to its source, linked to the quantitative details that support it, and read within its biomedical context and uncertainty. This matters as large language models (LLMs) and increasingly autonomous systems drive evidence synthesis, knowledge graph (KG) construction, and decision support. Many text-mining and LLM pipelines remain relation-centric: they capture entities and relations such as Drug--TREATS--Disease, but drop the dose, effect size, population, comparator, uncertainty, and conditions under which a claim holds. Such relations can look actionable yet remain hard to verify, compare, or reuse. In this perspective, we argue for a shift toward quantitative evidence mining---extracting values, units, measured entities and properties, context, uncertainty, provenance, and plausibility as structured evidence units that populate evidence-aware KGs and can be checked for source grounding, unit consistency, completeness, and biological plausibility. We outline a framework for plausibility-aware AI that treats extracted claims not as final answers but as auditable evidence objects, making clear what was measured, how much it changed, in which setting, with what uncertainty, and from which source. The central risk is not only incorrect extraction, but claims that look like evidence while lacking the structure needed to trust them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生物医学AI应从“关系中心主义”的文本挖掘转向“定量证据挖掘”，将数值、单位、测量实体、上下文、不确定性、来源和合理性抽取为结构化证据单元，构建“证据感知知识图谱”，使AI产出的声明成为可审计、可验证的证据对象而非最终答案。
AI.motivation: 生物医学AI系统越来越多地从文献、临床试验和监管文档中提取、组织和复用科学声明，但自动提取本身并不能使声明成为可靠证据。现有文本挖掘与大语言模型流程多为关系中心式，仅捕获如“药物—治疗—疾病”之类的实体与关系，却丢失了剂量、效应量、人群、对照、不确定性和成立条件等定量细节。这类关系看似可操作，实则难以验证、比较和复用；尤其在LLM及自主系统日益驱动证据综合与决策支持的背景下，这一问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 本文提出向“定量证据挖掘”转变：提取数值、单位、被测量的实体与属性、上下文、不确定性、来源和合理性，构成结构化证据单元，填充“证据感知知识图谱”，并支持来源溯源、单位一致性、完整性和生物学合理性检查。作者概述了一个“合理性感知AI”框架，将抽取出的声明视为可审计的证据对象而非最终答案，明确说明测量了什么、变化了多少、在何种场景下、具有何种不确定性以及来自哪个来源。
AI.result: 该框架使AI抽取的声明可被审计、可验证，具备来源锚定、单位一致、信息完整和生物学合理的检查能力；能够让下游系统清楚地回答“测了什么、变化多少、何种场景、多大不确定性、出自何处”，从而降低把表面像证据但缺乏可信结构的声明当作可靠证据的风险。
AI.conclusion: 核心风险不仅在于错误抽取，更在于产出表面上像证据、却缺乏可信任结构的声明。因此，证据必须能够溯源到来源、关联到支撑它的定量细节，并在其生物医学上下文与不确定性中被解读；推动证据感知KG与合理性感知AI是提升证据可靠性的关键方向。

title: TrainSDC: Characterizing and Mitigating Silent Data Corruption in Large Language Model Training
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with additional experiments
summary: LLM training is increasingly vulnerable to silent data corruption (SDC), yet existing protection methods largely treat Transformer computations uniformly because their vulnerability remains poorly understood. We present the first systematic characterization of SDC vulnerability across major computation interfaces in both the forward and backward passes of Transformer training. Our analysis reveals two distinct error propagation mechanisms: forward-pass vulnerability is highly location dependent, with faults on the Q/K path producing persistent training deviations, whereas backward-pass vulnerability is largely governed by gradient exponent distributions rather than computation locations. Motivated by these observations, we propose TrainSDC, a characterization-guided protection framework consisting of Q/K-path recomputation, residual-gain monitoring, and exponent-aware gradient scaling. Experiments on Llama 3.2-1B and Qwen3-0.6B show that TrainSDC maintains training behavior close to fault-free execution under both sparse and dense fault injection while introducing only 1.65%-6.76% runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统刻画了Transformer训练在正向与反向传播中各类计算接口对静默数据损坏（SDC）的脆弱性，发现前向传播脆弱性高度依赖位置（Q/K路径故障导致持续性训练偏差），而反向传播脆弱性主要由梯度指数分布决定。据此提出TrainSDC框架，包含Q/K路径重计算、残差增益监控和指数感知的梯度缩放，在Llama 3.2-1B和Qwen3-0.6B上仅引入1.65%-6.76%运行时开销即可接近无故障训练行为。
AI.motivation: LLM训练日益容易受到静默数据损坏（SDC）的影响，但现有保护方法因对Transformer各计算界面的脆弱性理解不足，基本将所有计算统一对待，缺乏针对性的保护策略。
AI.method: 1) 系统性地刻画Transformer训练前向和反向传播中主要计算接口的SDC脆弱性；2) 揭示两种不同的错误传播机制：前向脆弱性依赖位置（Q/K路径）、反向脆弱性由梯度指数分布决定；3) 基于此提出TrainSDC保护框架，包含三个组件：Q/K路径重计算、残差增益监控、指数感知的梯度缩放。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.2-1B和Qwen3-0.6B上的实验表明，在稀疏和密集故障注入下，TrainSDC都能使训练行为接近无故障执行状态，且仅引入1.65%-6.76%的运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: Transformer训练各计算接口的SDC脆弱性并非均匀分布，具有可刻画的结构：前向脆弱性由计算位置主导（Q/K路径为关键），反向脆弱性由梯度数值分布主导。据此设计的位置感知与数值感知混合保护框架TrainSDC，能以极低开销实现接近无故障的训练鲁棒性，为LLM训练提供了一种高效、可解释的SDC防护方案。

title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
summary: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. To address this gap, we introduce PyKEEN-NSX, an extension of PyKEEN, the popular KGE framework, that provides a modular engineered abstraction for negative sampling. The proposed architecture separates the generation of candidate negative pools, conditioned on an explicit context, from the selection strategy, enabling the development and integration of static, schema-aware and dynamic approaches within a consistent framework. Based on this abstraction, we implement six negative samplers, while remaining fully compatible with existing PyKEEN workflows and pipelines. As a proof of concept, we study negative availability across four datasets, showing that constrained pools frequently fall below the requested number of negatives, so that the encoded criterion is to a large extent replaced by the random fallback that supplements them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PyKEEN-NSX，一个基于 PyKEEN 的扩展，通过将"候选负样本池生成"与"选择策略"解耦的模块化抽象，为知识图谱嵌入（KGE）提供统一的负采样框架，并实现六种负采样器，同时通过实验揭示约束负样本池经常不足、随机回退占据主导的问题。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱嵌入模型的训练依赖人为生成的负样本，但现有主流 KGE 库（如 PyKEEN）只支持基础的负采样策略，缺乏统一的框架来开发和集成更先进、可定制的负采样方法（如结构感知、语义感知、嵌入信息感知等），阻碍了高级负采样器的设计与实现。
AI.method: 提出 PyKEEN-NSX 扩展：其架构将"候选负样本池的生成"（可基于显式上下文约束）与"选择策略"分离，从而在统一的框架内支持静态、schema-aware（模式感知）和动态负采样方法；基于该抽象实现了六种负采样器，并保持与现有 PyKEEN 工作流和流水线完全兼容。
AI.result: 作为概念验证，在四个数据集上研究了负样本可用性，发现受约束的负样本池经常低于所需负样本数量，导致编码的约束准则在很大程度上被补充它们的随机回退机制所取代。
AI.conclusion: PyKEEN-NSX 提供了一个模块化、可扩展的负采样统一框架，降低了高级负采样器开发门槛；同时负样本可用性分析表明，在实际数据集中约束池的稀缺性会削弱高级策略的实际效果，这为负采样方法的有效性评估与改进提供了重要启示。

title: Discrete Diffusion Bridges for Spatiotemporally Aligned Image Translation and Generation
summary: We propose Discrete Diffusion Bridges (DDB), a novel framework designed to resolve the fundamental spatiotemporal misalignment of standard discrete diffusion in image translation and generation. By corrupting data into a pure mask state via a random schedule, the conventional forward process induces a twofold misalignment: spatially, this pure-mask destination entirely discards the rich structural priors of the source image; temporally, the random masking order inherently contradicts the ``easy-first, hard-last'' decoding mechanism used during inference. To address this, DDB constructs a direct and efficient trajectory between domains. Spatially, we introduce a hybrid absorption mechanism that redefines the absorbing state to a stochastic mixture of mask and source tokens, effectively injecting source prior as spatial anchors into the latent space. Temporally, we design an information-guided noise schedule that quantifies semantic variation to prioritize the corruption of high-information regions at earlier timesteps. This ensures the model learns to resolve difficult semantic changes using robust context from invariant regions. Extensive experiments validate the versatility and robustness of our framework across diverse generative paradigms. DDB effectively balances edit alignment with structural fidelity across both text-guided semantic manipulation and pure structural image translation, while inherently complementing text-to-image generation and guaranteeing robust high-quality decoding under extremely low sampling steps. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离散扩散桥（DDB）框架，通过混合吸收机制和信息引导的噪声调度，解决标准离散扩散在图像翻译与生成中存在的空间和时间双重错位问题，在文本引导语义操作、纯结构图像翻译及文本到图像生成等范式上均验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准离散扩散通过随机调度将数据破坏为纯掩码状态，导致双重错位：空间上，纯掩码目标完全丢弃了源图像丰富的结构先验；时间上，随机掩码顺序与推理时"先易后难"的解码机制相矛盾。这些根本性错位制约了离散扩散在图像翻译与生成任务中的表现。
AI.method: DDB在域之间构建直接高效的轨迹。空间上，引入混合吸收机制，将吸收态重新定义为掩码与源token的随机混合，从而将源先验作为空间锚点注入潜在空间；时间上，设计信息引导的噪声调度，通过量化语义变化优先在较早时间步破坏高信息区域，使模型能利用不变区域的稳健上下文解决困难的语义变化。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了框架在不同生成范式下的通用性与鲁棒性。DDB在文本引导语义操作与纯结构图像翻译中有效平衡编辑对齐与结构保真，同时天然补充文本到图像生成，并在极低采样步数下保证稳健的高质量解码。
AI.conclusion: DDB通过空间锚定与时间调度两个层面的协同设计，从根本上化解了离散扩散中源先验丢失与掩码顺序-解码机制冲突的问题，为多种图像生成/翻译范式提供了一种兼具对齐性、保真度与高效解码的统一框架。

title: HiRS-Agent: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving
summary: Recent advances in large language models and multimodal models have pushed remote sensing (RS) processing from simple perception models to agentic systems designed to tackle complex, long-horizon RS tasks. However, existing systems often rely on monolithic decision-making frameworks, which fail to accommodate the multi-stage, interdependent nature of RS tasks. This centralized approach leads to challenges such as unstable task execution, incorrect tool usage, and error propagation across stages. To address these issues, we propose HiRS-Agent, a hierarchical multi-agent system for long-horizon RS task solving. HiRS-Agent adopts a two-level collaborative architecture: the Manager Layer handles dynamic routing, step-level verification, replanning, and termination control, while the Specialist Layer organizes domain-specific tools according to the RS workflow and is responsible for subtask reasoning and tool execution. To further enhance the system's capability, we introduce a two-stage supervised tuning strategy and a verification-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning stage to jointly optimize coordination and tool-use policies. Experiments on Earth-Agent Benchmark and ThinkGeo show that HiRS-Agent substantially improves long-horizon tool-use capability and final-task correctness, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured multi-agent collaboration for reliable RS agents. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/IntelliSensing/HiRS-Agent.

AI.tldr: HiRS-Agent 是一个面向长时程遥感任务的分层多智能体系统，采用"管理者层+专家层"的两级协作架构，结合两阶段监督微调与验证引导的分层强化学习，在 Earth-Agent Benchmark 和 ThinkGeo 上显著提升了长时程工具调用能力与最终任务正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感智能体系统通常依赖单一的整体式（monolithic）决策框架，难以适应遥感任务多阶段、强耦合的特性，导致任务执行不稳定、工具误用以及错误在阶段间传播等问题。
AI.method: 提出分层多智能体系统 HiRS-Agent：(1) 两级协作架构——Manager Layer 负责动态路由、步骤级验证、重新规划与终止控制，Specialist Layer 按遥感工作流组织领域工具并负责子任务推理与工具执行；(2) 两阶段监督微调策略；(3) 验证引导的分层强化学习阶段，用于联合优化智能体间的协调策略与工具使用策略。
AI.result: 在 Earth-Agent Benchmark 与 ThinkGeo 基准上，HiRS-Agent 大幅提升了长时程工具使用能力和最终任务正确率，验证了结构化多智能体协作对构建可靠遥感智能体的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、层次化的多智能体协作能有效克服整体式决策框架的缺陷，是实现可靠、稳定的长时程遥感任务求解的关键途径；将任务规划（管理者）与领域工具执行（专家）解耦，并结合验证式强化学习可显著改善复杂任务的最终正确性。

title: OPAL: Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning for Interpretable Image Classification
summary: Prototypical part-based models provide explainable predictions by comparing input regions to learned prototypes. However, current approaches are burdened by complex, multi-stage training pipelines and heavily rely on auxiliary regularization to prevent prototype collapse. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning (OPAL), a single-stage, end-to-end framework that simplifies interpretable classification. Our approach anchors the latent space using predefined orthonormal bases, embedding each class within a dedicated subspace spanned by fixed part-prototypes. To achieve precise part localization, OPAL enforces spatial competition across feature maps. This mechanism isolates sparse, discriminative regions, directing each prototype to consistently attend to the same semantic concept across different images. By framing classification as a direct representation alignment task, our method eliminates the need for auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that OPAL outperforms both its non-interpretable counterparts and state-of-the-art part-prototype methods, delivering granular visual explanations by explicitly revealing the specific image regions driving every prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/ilancarretero/OPAL.

AI.tldr: OPAL 是一个单阶段、端到端的可解释分类框架，通过预定义正交基锚定潜在空间，并结合空间竞争机制实现精确的部件定位，无需辅助损失即可超越现有 part-prototype 方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于原型部件的可解释模型存在两大痛点：训练流程复杂且多为多阶段，以及严重依赖辅助正则化来防止原型坍缩（prototype collapse）。作者旨在克服这些限制，设计更简洁且同样可解释的分类框架。
AI.method: OPAL 采用单阶段端到端训练：1) 用预定义的正交基锚定潜在空间，将每个类别嵌入由固定部件原型张成的专用子空间；2) 通过跨特征图的空间竞争机制约束特征图，隔离稀疏且有判别性的区域，使每个原型在不同图像中一致关注同一语义概念；3) 将分类视为直接的表示对齐任务，从而彻底消除对辅助损失的依赖。
AI.result: 在细粒度基准上，OPAL 同时超越了非可解释的对应方法及最先进的 part-prototype 方法，并能通过显式揭示驱动每个预测的具体图像区域，提供细粒度的视觉解释。
AI.conclusion: OPAL 证明通过正交原型对齐与空间竞争，可在保持甚至提升分类精度的同时，以单阶段训练简化可解释分类流程，为可解释 AI 提供了一种无需辅助正则化的高效范式。

title: MedAgent-R1: Faithfulness-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Medical Reasoning
summary: When medical AI systems hallucinate clinical reasoning, the consequences extend beyond incorrect answers: fabricated justifications that superficially reference retrieved evidence can mislead clinicians into unsafe treatment decisions. Medical reasoning agents must therefore produce not only correct answers but also faithful justifications that clinicians can verify against cited evidence. We identify a systematic failure mode in RL-trained retrieval agents: outcome-only rewards improve accuracy while degrading faithfulness, a phenomenon we term confident hallucination. The agent learns to answer from parametric memory and backfill plausible but unsupported justifications; citation fabrication rates rise from 16.5% to 31.8% even as accuracy improves by 5 points over the supervised baseline. We address this with a faithfulness-gated reward design: accuracy credit is conditioned on evidence grounding via a hard gate, complemented by retrieval validity and conciseness signals that close exploitation paths unique to agentic retrieval. The resulting system, MedAgent-R1, reduces citation fabrication from 31.8% to 4.7% and raises evidence completeness from 58.7 to 82.6 while maintaining 75.1% accuracy, with 13.2-point gains on HealthBench Safety. Under the same agentic retrieval setup, MedAgent-R1 outscores GPT-4o on faithfulness-specific dimensions (Factual Support 4.55 vs. 4.25; Overclaiming 4.40 vs. 4.15) while remaining below GPT-4o in overall accuracy, suggesting that explicit faithfulness training yields evidence-grounding gains not achieved by scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 针对医学推理智能体在强化学习（RL）训练中出现的"自信幻觉"（confident hallucination）——仅优化结果奖励会提高准确率但降低推理忠实度、导致引用捏造率上升——提出基于忠实度门控的奖励设计 MedAgent-R1，将引用捏造率从 31.8% 降至 4.7%，证据完整性从 58.7 提升至 82.6，同时维持 75.1% 的准确率，并在忠实度维度上超越 GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 医学 AI 系统在临床推理中发生幻觉的后果远超错误答案本身：表面引用检索证据却无实质支持的理由（fabricated justifications）可能误导临床医生做出不安全决策。作者识别出 RL 训练检索智能体的系统性失败模式：仅使用结果奖励（outcome-only rewards）在提升准确率的同时损害推理忠实度，导致模型从参数记忆中作答并用看似合理但不被证据支持的引用回填理由——引用捏造率从 16.5% 升至 31.8%，即使准确率比监督基线提高 5 个点。
AI.method: 提出忠实度门控的奖励设计（faithfulness-gated reward design）：准确率奖励以证据基础（evidence grounding）为硬门控前提（hard gate），即只有在答案确实由检索证据支撑时才给予准确率信用；同时引入检索有效性（retrieval validity）和简洁性（conciseness）信号，以封堵代理式检索（agentic retrieval）独有的奖励利用路径。由此构建 MedAgent-R1 系统。
AI.result: MedAgent-R1 将引用捏造率从 31.8% 降至 4.7%，证据完整性从 58.7 提升至 82.6，同时保持 75.1% 的准确率，并在 HealthBench Safety 上取得 13.2 分的增益。在相同 agentic 检索设置下，MedAgent-R1 在忠实度专属维度上超过 GPT-4o（Factual Support 4.55 vs 4.25；Overclaiming 4.40 vs 4.15），但在整体准确率上仍低于 GPT-4o。
AI.conclusion: 显式的忠实度训练能够带来仅靠模型规模扩展无法获得的证据支撑收益，证明准确率与推理忠实度可以被解耦优化；端到端 RL 中仅强调答案正确性的奖励设计是"自信幻觉"的根源，必须通过面向证据基础的门控机制加以约束，才能让医学推理智能体既正确又可被临床医生核验。

title: Input-Adaptive Gating of a Dehazing Front-End for On-Device Perception in Smoke-Obscured Environments
summary: Two-stage vision pipelines often place an enhancement network before a task network, on the assumption that a cleaner input produces a better output. We evaluate this in a firefighter assistance pipeline, where a dehazer precedes an edge detector that renders smoke-filled rooms as structural outlines. Both were designed for a Raspberry Pi 4, at 355K and 23K parameters, and quantized to UINT8 via TensorFlow Lite. The float dehazer reaches 18.60 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on held-out real smoke against 13.60 dB unprocessed and 17.08 dB for an AOD-Net trained on the same data, and the edge detector reaches an F-measure at optimal dataset scale (ODS) of 0.738, outperforming an optimized Canny's result of 0.692. Dehazing improves edge extraction under dense smoke but degrades it on clear and lightly hazed frames, where the dehazer discards more detail than the haze obscures. We therefore run the dehazer only when a dark channel haze estimate exceeds a threshold, a 10.1 ms test that lets the pipeline save 469.6 ms on the dehazing stage. Averaged over four haze levels, gating is more accurate than either fixed decision, at 0.675 mean ODS against 0.664 for always dehazing and 0.630 for never dehazing. It reduces the mean per-frame time on the Raspberry Pi from 569 ms to 321 ms, and on clear frames increases the frame rate fivefold, from 1.8 to 9 frames per second.

AI.tldr: 本文研究消防员辅助场景中"去雾网络+边缘检测网络"的两阶段视觉流水线，发现在浓烟下先去雾能提升边缘提取精度，但在清晰或轻雾画面上反而会损失细节；为此提出基于暗通道雾度估计的阈值门控机制，仅在需要时运行去雾器，从而在提升准确率的同时大幅降低树莓派上的推理耗时。
AI.motivation: 两阶段视觉流水线通常默认"更干净的输入必然带来更好的任务输出"，即先增强后处理的范式。作者希望在消防员辅助场景（去雾器+边缘检测器）中检验这一假设是否成立，并探究去雾在何种雾度条件下真正有益，从而避免不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: 构建由去雾网络（355K参数）与边缘检测网络（23K参数）组成的两阶段流水线，两者均通过TensorFlow Lite量化为UINT8并部署于树莓派4上。关键创新是门控机制：仅在暗通道雾度估计超过阈值时才运行去雾器（该判定仅耗时10.1ms），并对比始终去雾与始终不去雾两种固定策略，同时以AOD-Net作为去雾基线、以优化Canny作为边缘检测基线。
AI.result: 浮点去雾器在真实烟雾测试集上达到18.60dB PSNR（未处理13.60dB，AOD-Net 17.08dB）；边缘检测器ODS F值为0.738，优于优化Canny的0.692。去雾在浓烟下提升边缘提取，但在清晰/轻雾画面中反而丢失细节。门控策略平均ODS为0.675，优于始终去雾（0.664）和从不去雾（0.630）；平均每帧耗时由569ms降至321ms，清晰画面上帧率从1.8fps提升至9fps（提升约5倍）。
AI.conclusion: 固定"先去雾再处理"的假设并不总是成立，去雾在低雾度条件下可能弊大于利。基于暗通道阈值的门控策略不仅在四个雾度等级上平均精度最高，还显著节省了去雾阶段的计算开销，验证了按需增强的流水线设计思路在资源受限边缘设备上的有效性。

title: ATLAS: Dual-Horizon Diagnostic Evaluation for Industrial Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in user-facing services that require iterative tool use under dynamic business conditions. Reliable evaluation is essential for sustained improvement: it must reveal capability deficiencies, inform priorities, and assess interventions. Yet industrial agent service unfolds both through the iterative trajectory of a current request and through continued user interaction. Final-outcome assessment can therefore obscure where deficiencies arise and whether later service remains aligned with context from earlier exchanges. We propose ATLAS, a dual-horizon diagnostic evaluation framework for industrial tool-use agents. At the request horizon, trajectory-wise diagnostic signals relate deficiencies to execution locations and capability concerns. At the interaction horizon, user-wise signals assess whether service remains responsive across continued interaction. Together, these views provide structured diagnostic evidence for analyzing execution deficiencies and sustained service behavior. ATLAS instantiates them as executable signals with explicit evidence scopes and decision boundaries. LLM judge interfaces are calibrated against high-confidence references from real business logs; when needed, their decision behavior is distilled into efficient diagnostic models for lower-latency, lower-cost evaluation. The resulting feedback supports policy optimization. We evaluate ATLAS on Meituan Xiaotuan production traffic. Offline experiments assess diagnostic-signal fidelity and replay-based policy improvement, while online A/B experiments show concurrent gains in user engagement, downstream business outcomes, and sampled human-audit quality.

AI.tldr: 提出ATLAS，一个面向工业工具使用型大语言模型智能体的双视野诊断式评测框架，通过请求轨迹层面与用户交互层面的可执行诊断信号，定位执行缺陷与持续服务问题，并在美团小团真实流量上验证了其离线保真度与在线业务增益。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益部署于需要迭代式工具调用和动态业务条件的用户服务中，需要可靠评测来揭示能力缺陷、指导优先级并评估干预措施。然而工业智能体服务既包括当前请求的迭代轨迹，也包含持续的用户交互；仅以最终结果评估会掩盖缺陷产生的位置以及后续服务是否仍与更早交互的上下文保持一致，导致诊断信息不足。
AI.method: 提出ATLAS双视野诊断评测框架：(1) 请求视野（request horizon）：在轨迹层面提供诊断信号，将缺陷关联到执行位置与能力关注点；(2) 交互视野（interaction horizon）：在用户层面提供信号，评估跨持续交互的服务响应性。两者共同构成结构化诊断证据，并实例化为具有明确证据范围与决策边界的可执行信号。LLM裁判接口基于真实业务日志中的高置信参考进行校准，必要时将其决策行为蒸馏为高效诊断模型，以降低延迟与成本；产生的反馈支持策略优化。
AI.result: 在美团小团生产流量上评估。离线实验验证了诊断信号保真度与基于重放（replay）的策略改进效果；在线A/B实验显示用户参与度、下游业务结果和抽样人工审计质量均获得同步提升。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS表明，将评测从最终结果扩展到请求轨迹与用户交互两个时间视野，能够提供更细粒度的结构化诊断证据，进而有效支持策略优化，在真实工业场景中带来用户参与与业务收益的显著改善。这也验证了利用高置信参考校准LLM裁判并蒸馏高效诊断模型这一评测构建路径的可行性与实用性。

title: TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film
summary: Films communicate through deliberate creative choices, including lighting, color, composition, editing, dialogue, music, and sound. Humans naturally interpret these signals as directorial intent, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evaluated almost exclusively on understanding what happens rather than why it is presented that way. We introduce TAKE 85, the first benchmark for directorial-intent understanding, comprising 398 short films (85 hours) with expert-verified question-answer pairs spanning global and fine-grained visual and audio intent. Through controlled modality ablations, TAKE 85 enables systematic evaluation of multimodal reasoning. Experiments on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between perceptual recognition and intentional understanding: while models accurately describe events and narratives, they consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions. Our results establish directorial intent as a previously overlooked dimension of multimodal understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 58 out of 100, and our ablations show that no input modality is sufficient on its own. All code, Q&As, and models are publicly available from https://github.com/KaiShinozakiConefrey/Take-85

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAKE 85，这是首个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）导演意图理解能力的基准，包含398部短片（85小时）及专家验证的问答对，覆盖全局和细粒度的视觉与音频意图。实验表明当前最强模型仅得58分，且感知识别与意图理解之间存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 电影通过灯光、色彩、构图、剪辑、对白、音乐和声音等刻意创作选择传达信息，人类会自然地将这些信号解读为导演意图，但现有MLLM评测几乎只关注"发生了什么"而非"为什么以这种方式呈现"，忽视了导演意图这一多模态理解维度。
AI.method: 构建了首个导演意图理解基准TAKE 85，包含398部短片（85小时）和专家验证的问答对，涵盖全局与细粒度视觉及音频意图；通过受控模态消融实验系统评估多模态推理能力，并在多种最先进的MLLM上进行评测。
AI.result: 实验揭示了感知识别与意图理解之间的显著差距：模型能准确描述事件和叙事，但始终无法推断电影制作决策的沟通作用；最强模型仅达58/100分，且消融实验表明没有任何单一输入模态足以独立完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 导演意图是多模态理解中被忽视的重要维度；即便是最先进的MLLM在该任务上表现也远低于人类水平，且需要多模态协同而非单一模态，表明该方向仍需进一步研究。

title: Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal Prototype Optimization for Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) is a fundamental component of affective computing that aims to decipher complex emotional states by integrating verbal content with non-verbal cues including vocal intonation and facial micro-expressions. While recent disentanglement-based approaches have advanced the field, their potential is hindered by two methodological challenges. First, static computation graphs process all samples indiscriminately regardless of semantic complexity, which leads to suboptimal representation for diverse emotional expressions and contextual scenarios. Second, generic contrastive objectives often neglect the intrinsic ordinal hierarchy of sentiment intensities. To systematically address these limitations, we introduce Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal prototype optimization (MAESTRO), a novel framework designed to dynamically orchestrate and refine multimodal representations. Drawing inspiration from an orchestra conductor, we design a Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Unlike static fusion, this module utilizes linguistic context as a routing signal to dynamically activate specific audio-visual experts, thereby resolving cross-modal ambiguity through adaptive feature enhancement. Furthermore, to capture fine-grained sentiment gradations, we propose an Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (O-PCL). By incorporating distance-based penalties into the prototype learning objective, O-PCL enforces a structured latent space that preserves the natural order of emotion. Extensive experiments on the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that MAESTRO achieves state-of-the-art performance, and qualitative analysis further confirms the interpretability of our dynamic routing paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAESTRO框架，通过文本引导的混合专家（MoE）动态路由机制和序数感知原型对比学习（O-PCL），解决多模态情感分析中静态计算图忽略样本语义复杂性和通用对比学习忽视情感强度内在序数层级的问题，在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析在情感计算中至关重要，但现有的基于解纠缠的方法存在两大缺陷：一是静态计算图对所有样本不加区分地处理，忽略了语义复杂性，导致对多样化情感表达的表征次优；二是通用对比学习目标往往忽略了情感强度固有的序数层级结构。
AI.method: 提出MAESTRO框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)机制，以语言上下文作为路由信号动态激活特定音视频专家，通过自适应特征增强解决跨模态歧义；(2) Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (O-PCL)，通过向原型学习目标引入基于距离的惩罚，强制构建保持情感自然顺序的结构化潜在空间。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI基准上的大量实验表明MAESTRO取得了最先进的性能；定性分析进一步证实了动态路由范式的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MAESTRO通过将静态融合转变为动态专家路由、将通用对比学习升级为序数感知原型学习，有效解决了现有方法的两大局限，既提升了多模态情感分析的精度，又增强了模型的可解释性，为情感计算中的动态建模和序数表征提供了新的思路。

title: The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning
comment: 16 pages, accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Unlearning and Model Editing (U&ME)
summary: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了基于人脸条件生成器的身份遗忘（identity unlearning）方法，发现通过重定向条件嵌入来遗忘身份可能静默失败，且失败与否取决于重定向目标在识别空间中离被遗忘身份的距离：最近邻目标最易失败，而越远的重定向目标遗忘越干净。在硬邻居压力测试下，干净遗忘组数从最近硬目标下的9/30单调升至最不相似目标下的30/30，遗忘身份平均重识别率从51.9降至0.0，且重定向确实到达目标身份而非输出不可验证，经独立识别器AdaFace复核（r=0.94）排除验证器伪影。结论是目标分离度应作为身份遗忘中一阶、可报告的设计变量。
AI.motivation: 现有通过重定向条件嵌入实现身份遗忘的方法可能静默失败——即重定向输出仍被识别为原始人物。作者想找出这种失败的关键决定因素，并纠正"最近邻是最直觉、最合理重定向目标"这一默认假设。
AI.method: 以Arc2Face为被审计生成器，采用锁定的ArcFace协议及一个投影适配器在生成前重定向身份条件。构建硬邻居压力测试（取最难的0.5%合格身份），比较四种目标选择策略（按与遗忘身份在识别空间中的距离从最近到最远），并用独立识别器AdaFace对相同图像重新验证以排除单一验证器伪影。
AI.result: 四种目标选择策略呈现单调响应：干净遗忘组数从最近硬目标下的9/30升至最不相似目标下的30/30；遗忘身份平均重识别率从51.9降至0.0，而保留（retention）均值保持平稳。720个最不相似硬目标生成中710个到达所选目标身份，无泄漏到无关身份；AdaFace对相同图像的复核保持相同趋势（r=0.94）。
AI.conclusion: 重定向目标与遗忘身份在识别空间中的分离程度是身份遗忘成败的一阶、可报告的设计变量：选择最近邻作为目标最易导致静默失败，而选择足够远的目标可实现干净、可验证且无泄漏的遗忘，同时不影响对其他身份的保留。

title: Generative Models Enhanced by Sequence Labelling and Aspect-Code Switching Improve Cross-lingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
comment: Accepted for The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Cross-lingual aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) transfers knowledge from a source language with annotated data to a target language, enabling fine-grained sentiment analysis without annotated target-language data. While monolingual ABSA has seen significant progress, cross-lingual ABSA remains underexplored, especially for complex tasks involving multiple sentiment elements like target-aspect-sentiment detection (TASD). In this paper, we propose a novel SeqLab framework that enhances cross-lingual ABSA using a sequence-to-sequence model with an auxiliary sequence-labelling task performed by the encoder, enhancing aspect term recognition and sentiment predictions. Additionally, we incorporate aspect-code switching (ACS), a translation-based technique that swaps aspect terms between source and translated sentences, generating additional training data to enhance the model's cross-lingual understanding. We evaluate our approach across eleven languages, three domains, and two backbone models, surpassing previous state-of-the-art results for the commonly studied E2E-ABSA task. Unlike most prior work that relies solely on English as the source language, we systematically assess different source-target language pairs and extend our evaluation to the more challenging, yet underexplored TASD task in cross-lingual settings. Finally, we provide a detailed error analysis highlighting key challenges and limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SeqLab 框架，结合序列到序列模型与编码器端辅助序列标注任务，并引入基于翻译的方面词代码切换（ACS）数据增强技术，以提升跨语言基于方面的情感分析（ABSA）性能，在 11 种语言、3 个领域和 2 种骨干模型上超越了现有最优结果。
AI.motivation: 跨语言 ABSA 虽有研究，但相比单语 ABSA 进展不足，尤其在涉及多个情感要素的复杂任务（如目标-方面-情感检测 TASD）上探索甚少；同时多数现有工作仅以英语为源语言，缺乏对不同源-目标语言对的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出 SeqLab 框架：采用序列到序列模型，由编码器执行辅助序列标注任务以增强方面词识别和情感预测；此外引入方面词代码切换（ACS）技术，通过机器翻译将源句与译句中的方面词互换，生成额外训练数据以提升模型的跨语言理解能力。
AI.result: 在 11 种语言、3 个领域和 2 种骨干模型上的实验表明，SeqLab 在常用的 E2E-ABSA 任务上超越前人最先进结果；系统评估了不同源-目标语言对，并扩展到了更具挑战性的跨语言 TASD 任务，最后提供了详细的错误分析。
AI.conclusion: SeqLab 通过辅助序列标注与方面词代码切换有效提升了跨语言 ABSA 性能，并拓宽了评估范围至多种语言对和 TASD 任务，同时错误分析揭示了关键挑战与局限性，为该领域后续研究提供了方向。

title: Fine-Tuning Low-Bit Models with Gradient in Quantized Code Space
summary: Fine-tuning Low-bit models aims to adapt a quantized model while keeping the final deployed checkpoint in the same low-bit form. This setting is practically important as it reduces memory and inference cost for storage and deployment. Under this constraint, adaptation becomes an optimization problem over quantization codes and scales. Existing continuous low-bit training is efficient, but it can be distorted by straight through estimation error or by post-quantize gap; discrete search is deployment-faithful, but it is often too inefficient under a finite training budget. We propose code surrogate gradient as the first order signal in deployable code space to acceleate optimization, and performing guided search to preserve deployment faithfulness. Experiments across arithmetic reasoning, instruction following, and structured language understanding show that GradCodes consistently improves fine-tuning low-bit models across different quantization datatypes. Code is provided at https://github.com/ovo67/GradCodes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GradCodes 方法，用于低比特量化模型的微调（fine-tuning）。核心思想是以“码代理梯度”（code surrogate gradient）作为可部署码空间中的一阶优化信号来加速优化，并结合引导搜索（guided search）保持部署保真度，从而在保证最终部署模型仍为低比特形式的同时，兼顾训练效率和部署一致性，在算术推理、指令跟随和结构化语言理解等任务上一致提升效果。
AI.motivation: 低比特模型微调要求最终部署的检查点仍保持在同等低比特形式，以降低存储和推理的显存/计算开销。该约束下，适应过程变成了对量化码（codes）与缩放因子（scales）的优化问题。现有方法存在缺陷：连续低比特训练效率高，但会因直通估计器误差或后量化间隙而失真；离散搜索则部署保真，但训练预算有限时效率过低。因此需要一种兼顾效率与部署保真度的优化方案。
AI.method: GradCodes 提出两个关键组件：1) 码代理梯度（code surrogate gradient），作为可部署码空间中的一阶信号，用于加速优化过程；2) 引导搜索（guided search），在码空间中进行受引导的搜索，以保留部署保真度（即规避连续低比特训练中 STEE 误差和后量化间隙带来的失真）。二者结合使得在有限训练预算下既高效又部署一致。
AI.result: 在算术推理、指令跟随和结构化语言理解三类任务上的实验表明，GradCodes 在不同量化数据类型下均能一致地改善低比特模型微调的效果，优于现有的连续低比特训练和离散搜索方法。
AI.conclusion: GradCodes 证明可以通过在可部署码空间中引入码代理梯度和引导搜索，在有限训练预算下同时保证优化效率与部署保真度，为低比特模型微调提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案，并开源了代码。

title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.

AI.tldr: 提出AM-Bench基准，将文本与代码训练的LLM的2D空间能力拆分为"几何转码"与"开放式布局"两个维度，发现模型在几何转码上均可靠，但开放式布局差异显著且受输出媒介（SVG优于过程式代码）影响，激活探针显示生成前的粗略布局仅反映提示中的布局，生成过程中模型跟踪不断演化的几何状态而非执行固定计划。
AI.motivation: 仅用文本和代码训练的LLM有时能生成可识别图像的代码，但不清楚这是否反映其内部具有2D空间布局的表征，还是仅仅能完成"将空间描述翻译成代码"。现有研究无法区分这两种能力，因此需要一种能分离"几何转码"与"开放式构图"的评测方法。
AI.method: 引入Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench)基准，包含两类任务：1) 翻译任务：给模型一个完全指定的几何描述作为提示，要求生成能产出该图片的代码；2) 布局任务：仅给模型一个欠指定（underspecified）的提示，要求其自行构图。在8个开放权重、仅文本与代码训练的模型上进行评测，并进行输出媒介消融（过程式代码 vs. 原始SVG）以及激活探针分析。
AI.result: 所有模型都能可靠地将指定几何翻译为代码，但开放式布局表现差异显著，说明这些差异不能仅用代码生成能力解释；将输出媒介从过程式代码换成原始SVG可提升所有模型的布局得分；激活探针显示生成前已存在粗略布局计划，但只反映提示中隐含的布局；生成过程中模型跟踪演化的几何状态，而非执行最初固定的计划。
AI.conclusion: 文本型LLM的2D空间表现同时取决于模型本身和输出媒介，不能仅由代码生成能力解释；AM-Bench有效分离了布局生成与代码翻译两类能力，揭示了文本建模下空间表征的机制性特征。

title: A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation
summary: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MambaPop，一种基于序列建模（sequence modeling）的行政区划级人口估算方法：将每个普查区（tract）渲染为单张多边形掩膜的卫星影像，并借助基于 MambaVision（混合状态空间+注意力）骨干网络，直接从该影像预测该区人口，完全跳过传统的人口栅格化/分解（disaggregation）步骤。在全美约 84,000 个 2020 年普查区上，MambaPop 达到每区平均绝对误差（MAE）1,141 人，与最强卷积基线 YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）相当。
AI.motivation: 人口估算对基础设施规划、公共卫生和灾害响应至关重要，但现有的主流系统（如 WorldPop、LandScan）仍依赖辅助数据构建权重面，将普查人口分解到均匀栅格单元上，这一过程会引入系统性空间偏差，且卷积神经网络逐栅格预测的方式丢弃了普查数据实际采集时所在的行政区划结构。作者希望通过直接面向行政区划单元建模，消除分解步骤带来的偏差。
AI.method: 提出 MambaPop：将每个行政单元（普查区）表示为一张带多边形掩膜的卫星影像，把该区人口估算建模为影像块上的序列建模问题；每个区影像与其人口标签直接配对，完全去除分解/降尺度环节。模型基于混合状态空间-注意力架构 MambaVision 骨干网络构建，据作者所述，这是首个直接从行政单元自身影像学习人口的方法，也是首个将 Mamba 混合架构应用于人口估算任务的方法。
AI.result: 在 2020 年美国人口普查的全部约 84,000 个连续本土普查区上，MambaPop 达到每区 MAE 1,141 人，与最强卷积基线 YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）持平，展示出序列模型在该任务上不逊于强卷积基线的精度。
AI.conclusion: MambaPop 以直接、端到端的方式将序列模型架构（特别是 Mamba 混合架构）引入行政区划级人口估算，证明移除栅格分解步骤后仍能达到与强卷积基线相当的性能，为该任务提供了新的建模范式，并可能为后续改进（如扩展至更细粒度或更大规模区域）奠定基础。

title: Which Rules Matter Now? Policy-Centroid Routing Before an Intelligent System Acts
comment: Theory and research-program paper; 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Includes a synthetic worked example; reports no empirical efficacy result
summary:
Before an intelligent system can decide whether an action is allowed, it must first know which rules the action has approached. A single proposed action can implicate several policy regimes at once. Their requirements may stack, overlap, or qualify one another, yet many remain written in natural language while the action itself arrives as an incomplete description of intent. The first problem is not judgment. It is attention.
  Policy-centroid routing creates a layer before adjudication. It compresses expressions within each policy regime into one or more representative centroids, places the proposed action in the same semantic space, applies a declared measure, and routes every regime crossing a declared threshold to authoritative review. Several regimes may trigger at once. The output is a review agenda, not permission, prohibition, legality, breach, compliance, certification, or enforcement.
  The paper develops six falsifiable propositions and seven follow-on studies comparing the hypothesis with structured workflows, lexical and semantic retrieval, hierarchical and direct classification, and selective prediction under matched review burden. The studies are designed to identify where policy geometry recovers applicable regimes, where compression loses rare or overlapping obligations, and where the mechanism should abstain. The paper includes a synthetic worked example and reports no empirical efficacy result.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"策略质心路由"机制，在裁决之前将拟议动作与各政策体制的语义质心比较，把所有超过阈值的政策体制路由至权威审查，输出一份"审查议程"而非裁决结论。论文提出六条可证伪命题及七项后续对照研究设计，附合成示例，但没有经验性效能结果。
AI.motivation: 智能系统在判断动作是否被允许之前，必须首先知道该动作触及了哪些规则。一个动作可能同时牵涉多个政策体制，其要求可能叠加、重叠或相互限定，且许多规则仍以自然语言书写，而动作本身只是意图的不完整描述。因此首要问题不是裁决（判断），而是注意力（发现适用的规则）。
AI.method: 在裁决之前增加"策略质心路由"层：将每个政策体制内的表达式压缩为一个或多个代表性质心，将拟议动作映射到同一语义空间，应用声明的度量，并将所有超过声明阈值的政策体制路由至权威审查。多个体制可能同时触发，输出为"审查议程"而非许可、禁止、合法性、违约、合规、认证或执法决定。论文还提出六条可证伪命题和七项后续研究设计，用于与结构化工作流、词法/语义检索、分层/直接分类以及匹配审查负担下的选择性预测进行对比。
AI.result: 论文给出六条可证伪命题、七项后续对照研究以及一个合成工作示例；研究设计旨在识别策略几何何时能找回适用体制、压缩何时会丢失稀有或重叠义务、以及机制何时应弃权。论文明确报告"无经验性效能结果"。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出的是一种机制与评估蓝图而非已验证的方案：先解决"注意力"问题，将相关体制的识别与最终裁决分离；结论是方法的有效性需通过后续对照研究检验，论文本身不宣称实证效果。

title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的VLA驾驶框架，通过将增强轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻域流形上、以Pareto最优性替代聚合评分过滤冲突样本，并引入可行性优先优势分配与动态蒸馏机制，缓解GRPO策略梯度偏差。在NAVSIM v1/v2上分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS，并恢复658个初始失败场景中的440个。
AI.motivation: VLA驾驶方法越来越多地将多轨迹模仿学习与GRPO结合，轨迹选择对最终性能至关重要。然而，一些高评分轨迹虽能改善模仿学习，却会使优势估计与当前策略的可行行为分布不一致，从而在后续GRPO中诱导偏差，将更新推向不安全、不合规的行为。
AI.method: 提出一个对齐多轨迹监督与策略优化的框架：(1) 将增强轨迹约束在真实可行区域的邻近流形上，抑制可行区域外的不可行噪声轨迹带来的策略梯度偏差；(2) 以Pareto最优性准则替代传统聚合评分，仅保留非支配候选，从源头过滤冲突样本；(3) 提出可行性优先优势分配，根据每个rollout组的可行性构成调整Pareto信用，并引导完全不可行的组朝向安全参考；(4) 引入动态蒸馏，在精炼轮次中更新教师轨迹以持续传递有效监督。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1和v2上，单轨迹推理下分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS；恢复658个初始失败场景中的440个，比原始GRPO基线提升11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过对轨迹监督进行源端过滤（Pareto非支配筛选）与目标端适配（可行性优先优势分配、动态蒸馏），该框架能将扩展监督的收益逐步转化为策略改进，同时保证驾驶行为的安全性与合规性，优于原始GRPO基线。

title: Selection-Aware Stress Testing for Interactive Agents
summary: Agent evaluations often use one benchmark to choose a workflow and then search for task types where its advantage weakens, so both conclusions are selected from the same data. We introduce Selection-Aware Semantic Stress Testing (\SASST{}), which learns a task reweighting from pre-execution features on discovery tasks and evaluates the same paired comparison on separate confirmation tasks. The protocol checks support and stability, uses joint bounds for all planned claims, and can return no claim. We prove conditional asymptotic validity under stated cluster assumptions. A forty-cluster audit finds Gaussian undercoverage and conservative Bonferroni $t$ bounds. In one 480-episode $τ$-bench study, a $3.75$ point discovery gain vanished on confirmation. A second-model study likewise confirmed neither a workflow benefit nor a stable stress rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出选择感知语义压力测试（SASST），将基准测试的“发现”与“确认”阶段分离，通过在独立确认任务上评估配对比较，并采用联合界与稳定性检验，解决了在单一基准上既选择工作流又寻找其弱点所导致的结论选择偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估常在同一份基准数据上先选择工作流、再搜索其优势减弱的任务类型，两个结论均来自同一数据，存在严重的选择偏差（selection bias）。这种流程得出的结论缺乏统计保证，可能产生虚假的优势或压力规则。
AI.method: SASST 从预执行特征中在发现任务上学习任务重加权，然后在独立的确认任务上评估同一个配对比较；协议检验支持性与稳定性，对所有计划内的结论使用联合界，并在证据不足时拒绝给出结论；作者证明了在既定聚类假设下结论具有条件渐近有效性。
AI.result: 四十簇审计显示高斯方法存在欠覆盖，而 Bonferroni t 界偏保守；在 480 集 τ-bench 研究中，发现阶段 3.75 分的优势在确认阶段消失；第二个模型的研究同样既未确认工作流收益，也未确认稳定的压力规则。
AI.conclusion: SASST 提供了一种可验证的协议，能够区分真实的工作流优势与数据选择导致的假象；实证研究表明许多被发现的优势与压力规则无法在独立确认中成立，强调了在智能体评估中将结论选择与结论验证分离的必要性。

title: Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention
summary: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出了 Lapis，一种基于线性注意力与像素空间的一步扩散生成框架，通过粗到细的层级结构（Patch 级一致性模块 + 像素级细化模块）与直接 x-预测策略，实现高效且高保真的单目深度估计，在 1080P 和 1440P 下推理延迟分别降低至多 7.6× 和 10.9×，并达到 SOTA 精度与边界锐度。
AI.motivation: 生成式框架在单目深度估计上取得了优越的细节保真度，但标准注意力的 O(N²) 复杂度以及多步去噪过程在扩展到高分辨率图像时带来高昂的计算成本。虽然线性注意力与一步预测在直觉上可行，但直接应用会导致结构一致性差、细节丢失和噪声问题。
AI.method: 采用粗到细的层级结构：先通过 Patch 级一致性模块（整合语义与空间先验）恢复结构连贯性；再通过像素级细化模块（基于跳跃连接的像素对应）恢复锐利的几何边界；同时利用流形假设并采用直接 x-预测策略以对准干净数据流形，缓解一步扩散固有的采样噪声。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，Lapis 在不同分辨率下均取得 SOTA 精度与边界锐度，相比此前 SOTA 生成式模型，在 1080P 下推理延迟降低至多 7.6 倍，在 1440P 下降低至多 10.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: Lapis 证明了将线性注意力与一步扩散结合，并通过粗到细的层级设计加以修正，能够在保持高保真细节的同时大幅提升高分辨率单目深度估计的效率，实现高精度边界与低延迟的兼顾。

title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
summary: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when their own answers are likely to be wrong. Building on this observation, we introduce HSRM, a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the generator's internal representations rather than re-processing its text. HSRM extracts hidden states from a frozen generator at reasoning-step boundaries and uses a small Transformer encoder to rank candidates. It is trained from self-generated trajectories with outcome labels, requiring neither human-written process supervision nor a large pretrained verifier. Across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, HSRM matches or outperforms a 55M-parameter text-only energy verifier in 15 of 16 generator--dataset settings while using only about 2M parameters, providing an efficient alternative to text-only verification by reusing representations already computed during generation.

AI.tldr: 提出HSRM，一种轻量级隐状态奖励模型，它通过直接读取冻结生成器在推理步骤边界的内部表征来验证候选数学解答，而非重新处理文本，仅用约2M参数即在15/16个生成器-数据集设置中持平或超越55M参数文本验证器，并避免额外的推理开销。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常能生成看似合理的数学推理轨迹，但可靠地识别多个候选中正确解答仍是关键挑战。现有测试时推理管线通常依赖基于文本的验证器逐一重读候选解答，使验证成为推理中昂贵的开销；而先前研究表明LLM内部表征已编码与正确性相关的信号（包括对自身答案可能出错的意识），因此可利用这些表征实现高效验证。
AI.method: HSRM从冻结的生成器中提取推理步骤边界处的隐状态，用一个小型Transformer编码器对候选解答进行排序；训练数据来自自生成轨迹及结果标签，既不需要人工过程监督也不需要大型预训练验证器。
AI.result: 在四个数学推理基准上，HSRM在16个生成器-数据集设置中的15个上匹配或超越了55M参数文本能量验证器，同时仅使用约2M参数，验证更高效。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用生成期间已计算好的表示，HSRM提供了一种经济高效的文本验证替代方案，证明了轻量级隐状态验证在数学推理测试时验证中的可行性与优势。

title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study
summary: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文表征了一台消费级手持式结构光扫描仪用于获取三维创面几何描述符时的测量误差：基于9个刚性创面护理体模、23次重复扫描，发现重建表面积的重现性界限高达4.8倍（95%置信区间3.0–7.0），45个描述符中有44个的组内相关系数低于0.50，且248种描述符×处理管线组合无一达到0.75；误差预算显示误差主要来自操作者捕获表面范围而非传感器本身，且整体测量噪音远超临床采用的四周面积缩减比值这一下限。
AI.motivation: 创面三维几何描述符的测量误差直接影响临床愈合评估，但消费者级手持式扫描仪的测量变异性尚不明确；创面又难以用刚性体模复现，且创面随时间变化导致误差难以隔离，因此需要一个可重复扫描、不随形变改变的体模方案来独立表征扫描仪链路的测量误差。
AI.method: 使用单一扫描仪单元对9个固定创面护理体模的位点进行23次重复扫描，将每次重复间的差异视为纯测量误差；对45个几何描述符及多种处理管线组合计算95%重现性界限和组内相关系数；通过固定分析区域、保留传感器与重建环节来构建误差预算，区分操作者捕获表面范围与仪器环节对总方差的贡献；并以临床使用的四周面积缩减比（约2.1）作为未分割管线须克服的噪声下限进行对照。
AI.result: 重建表面积95%重现性界限为4.8倍（置信区间3.0–7.0），即重扫可使读数从减少79%变为增加377%；45个描述符中44个ICC低于0.50，248种组合无一达到0.75；误差预算显示操作者捕获表面占比最高达75%（表面积）、91%（包络面积）、95%（包围盒对角线），仅包络体积以48%为仪器主导；统计异常值剔除引入了约11%的系统性面积亏缺；标准化分析区域可将界限降至2.13，但仍未低于2.1的临床变化阈值。
AI.conclusion: 该扫描仪链路的测量噪声过大，且误差主要由操作者捕获的表面积范围决定而非传感器精度，因此更换更优传感器收效甚微；当前整条管线（尤其缺乏自动创面分割）的变异性仅能作为未分割管线需克服的噪声下限，不能视为创面面积重现性的真实度量，必须优先标准化分析区域与分割流程。

title: VFR-Audit: Verdict-Level Reliability for Fairness Audits in Hospital Length-of-Stay Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Fairness audits in clinical Artificial Intelligence convert continuous fairness metrics into binary pass-or-fail verdicts against operational thresholds, where hospital governance boards, payers, and regulators act on the resulting verdicts. Such audits are repeated over time and across hospital sites, thus the same verdict can flip between pass and fail across audits. Existing uncertainty methods such as Bayesian posteriors, bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests address verdict instability only at the continuous-metric level. Converting metric-level uncertainty into a verdict-stability claim remains a manual step that scales poorly across the (model, metric, attribute) cells an audit covers. Existing uncertainty methods also leave open whether bias-mitigation steps, such as reweighing or per-group threshold shifts, yield a stable passing verdict at the cost of model discrimination measured as AUROC or AUPRC.To address this verdict-stability gap, we propose VFR-Audit, a framework built around the Verdict Flip Rate (VFR), a scalar bounded between 0 and 0.5 that measures the probability of verdict reversal under stratified bootstrap resampling. VFR-Audit reports VFR alongside three reliability axes, namely within-cohort resampling stability, audit-size sensitivity, and cross-hospital verdict agreement via Fleiss' kappa.

AI.tldr: 提出VFR-Audit框架，用Verdict Flip Rate（VFR，0到0.5之间）在分层自助重采样下量化临床AI公平性审计中通过/失败裁决反转的概率，并辅以三个可靠性维度（队列内重采样稳定性、审计规模敏感性、跨医院裁决一致性Fleiss' kappa），弥补现有不确定性方法仅停留在连续指标层面、无法规模化得到裁决稳定性结论的空白。
AI.motivation: 临床AI公平性审计将连续公平性指标按运营阈值转化为二元的通过/失败裁决，供治理委员会、支付方和监管者使用；审计在时间维度和多个医院站点重复进行，导致同一裁决可能反复翻转。现有方法（贝叶斯后验、bootstrap置信区间、置换检验）仅处理连续指标层面的不确定性，将指标不确定性转为裁决稳定性结论需要人工介入且难以在（模型、指标、属性）单元格上规模化；同时这些方法也无法回答偏见缓解步骤（如重加权、分组阈值调整）是否以牺牲AUROC/AUPRC模型判别能力为代价换来了稳定的通过裁决。
AI.method: 提出VFR-Audit框架，核心是Verdict Flip Rate（VFR）——一个取值在0到0.5之间的标量，用于度量在分层bootstrap重采样下裁决反转的概率。VFR-Audit在报告VFR的同时给出三条可靠性轴：队列内重采样稳定性（within-cohort resampling stability）、审计规模敏感性（audit-size sensitivity）、以及基于Fleiss' kappa的跨医院裁决一致性（cross-hospital verdict agreement）。
AI.result: VFR-Audit直接给出裁决级的翻转概率（VFR），并同时输出三个可靠性层面的量化指标（队列内稳定性、规模敏感性、跨站点一致性），从而将裁决稳定性从人工、逐单元格的低效流程变为自动化、可规模化的审计输出，并可用于检验偏见缓解措施在获得稳定通过裁决时是否损害模型判别能力（AUROC/AUPRC）。
AI.conclusion: VFR-Audit为临床AI公平性审计提供了裁决级别的可靠性度量，把裁决翻转风险显式量化并纳入审计报告，为治理主体基于稳定裁决做决策提供了依据，同时能评估偏见缓解策略的稳定通过裁决与判别性能之间的权衡。

title: CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests
summary: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22168721.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 CedarCypress3D，一个公开的、人工标注的日本柳杉与日本扁柏人工林 UAV-LiDAR 点云数据集，包含两个地点的 34 个圆形样地、1,627 棵实测并标注的树木、野外调查测量数据、其中 22 个样地还配有地面 LiDAR 点云及树干/非树干的语义标签，用于支持单体树木实例分割、语义分割、树木属性预测和多平台 LiDAR 分析等研究。
AI.motivation: UAV-LiDAR 获得的单木测量数据对森林清查、生态系统监测和可持续森林经营很有价值，而机器学习方法的进步增加了对标注点云数据集的需求，尤其是用于单木分割的标注数据。然而，温带森林中公开可用的标注 UAV-LiDAR 数据集十分有限，这制约了相关方法的发展与评估。
AI.method: 作者构建并公开了 CedarCypress3D 数据集：在日本的柳杉和扁柏人工林中采集 UAV-LiDAR 点云并进行野外调查；数据集覆盖两个地形特征不同的地点的 34 个圆形样地，其中 22 个样地还提供地面 LiDAR 点云；共 1,627 株树经野外实测并人工标注，使其与 UAV-LiDAR 点云中的对应树木匹配；对于有地面 LiDAR 数据的样地，另为 UAV-LiDAR 中的树点赋予语义标签（树干与非树干）。数据集通过 Zenodo（DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22168721）公开。
AI.result: CedarCypress3D 提供了高质量的标注 UAV-LiDAR 数据，可用于开发和评估温带人工林中的单体树木实例分割与语义分割方法，并支持树木属性预测和多平台 LiDAR 分析方面的研究。
AI.conclusion: CedarCypress3D 填补了温带森林公开标注 UAV-LiDAR 数据的空白，有望推动单木分割等点云分析方法在人工林经营与生态系统监测中的研究与应用，并为多平台 LiDAR 数据融合相关研究提供支撑。

title: Predicting Residential Rents in Dakar Using Machine Learning
summary: Dakar's residential rental market remains poorly documented despite its economic and social importance: 54.4% of households are renters, compared to 23.3% nationally. This study develops a complete machine learning pipeline to predict residential rents in Dakar, from data collection to model interpretation. An original dataset of 1,507 rental listings was built through systematic web scraping and a documented cleaning pipeline, then enriched with four purpose-built features, including a luxury score and a keyword-based quality score. Five models were compared: linear regression, Random Forest (baseline), XGBoost, and LightGBM optimized through Bayesian optimization with Optuna, using leakage-free KFold target encoding for location. The optimized XGBoost model achieved the best performance with an $R^2$ of 0.847, an MAE of 210,902 XOF, and an RMSE of 324,195 XOF. Feature importance was assessed using native XGBoost gain and SHAP values, revealing a substantial difference in the ranking of location, which appears as a minor predictor by gain but as the second most influential variable by SHAP. This result carries methodological implications for hedonic studies using target-encoded categorical variables. This study provides an interpretable benchmark for Dakar's rental market and highlights several avenues for improvement, including the integration of geospatial features and conformal prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一条完整的机器学习流水线，用于预测达喀尔住宅租金：通过网页爬取建立1,507条租赁房源数据集，经清洗与特征工程（含奢华度评分、关键词质量评分）后比较五种模型，经贝叶斯优化的XGBoost取得最佳性能（R²=0.847，MAE=210,902 XOF，RMSE=324,195 XOF）。通过XGBoost增益与SHAP值评估特征重要性，发现位置变量在增益法下排名靠后、但在SHAP下位居第二，揭示了目标编码分类变量在特征重要性解释中的方法论差异。
AI.motivation: 达喀尔的住宅租赁市场虽然具有重要的经济和社会意义（54.4%的家庭为租房者，远高于全国23.3%的水平），但相关数据与研究记录严重匮乏，缺乏可靠的租金预测基准与可解释分析。
AI.method: 采用完整的机器学习流水线：通过系统化网页爬取构建1,507条房源租赁榜单的原始数据集，配以文档化的数据清洗流程；构建四个自定义特征（包括奢华度评分和基于关键词的质量评分）；比较五种模型——线性回归、随机森林（基线）、XGBoost和LightGBM（后者通过Optuna进行贝叶斯优化），并使用无泄漏的K折目标编码处理位置特征；特征重要性分别采用XGBoost原生增益和SHAP值进行评估。
AI.result: 优化后的XGBoost模型表现最佳，取得R²为0.847、MAE为210,902 XOF、RMSE为324,195 XOF。特征重要性分析显示，位置变量在增益法下为次要预测因子，但在SHAP值下却成为影响第二大的变量，两种方法排序存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为达喀尔租赁市场提供了可解释的基准模型，并对使用目标编码分类变量的特征重要性（hedonic）研究提出了方法论启示；未来改进方向包括引入地理空间特征和共形预测（conformal prediction）。

title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale
summary: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了一套低成本玉米果穗3D表型高通量管线：利用消费级单反相机在电动转台上拍摄20秒视频，通过COLMAP初始化相机位姿并训练NeRF重建水密3D网格，借助已知直径的圆柱托架实现自动度量尺度标定和质量控制。在300个穗（83.3%通过）上，骨架长度与卡尺测量高度一致（R²=0.964，RMSE=4.68 mm），凸包体积与排水法体积一致（R²=0.982，RMSE=5.26 mL）；硬件成本约607美元，人工操作从约5分钟降至1分钟/穗。
AI.motivation: 玉米果穗几何性状（长度、宽度、弯曲度、体积）与产量及籽粒灌浆密切相关，但现有高通量表型管线受限于成本高、劳动密集和专用硬件需求，缺乏低成本、自动化、适合育种规模的3D果穗表型方案。
AI.method: 构建一套低成本3D重建管线：用消费级DSLR在电动转台上、均匀LED光照下拍摄单段20秒视频；以多种子COLMAP流程估计相机位姿初始化NeRF，重建果穗水密3D网格；利用每帧可见、直径已知的圆柱托架实现自动度量缩放与下游几何质量控制。对长度与体积测量分别以卡尺和排水法进行验证。
AI.result: 在300个来自多样化玉米自交系群体的果穗上，250个（83.3%）通过自动化处理与质量控制。骨架长度与卡尺测量在250个穗上R²=0.964、RMSE=4.68 mm；凸包体积与排水法体积在15个覆盖全尺寸范围的穗上R²=0.982、RMSE=5.26 mL。长度残差随弯曲度增大而增大，但记录与卡尺相同直线弦长的包围盒高度无此趋势，说明差异源于测量定义（卡尺测弦长，骨架长度测测地弧长）。硬件成本约607美元，人工从约5分钟降至1分钟/穗，下游处理全自动。
AI.conclusion: 该平台在低成本、低人工投入和自动化的条件下实现了与人工测量高度一致的果穗3D重建与几何量化，为育种规模的3D果穗表型鉴定提供了基础；同时厘清了骨架长度与卡尺测量在弯曲果穗上的系统性差异来源，提示选择与卡尺定义一致的度量指标。

title: CAER: Causal Action Effect Reweighting for World Model Training
summary: World models are becoming core infrastructure for embodied intelligence, with action-conditioned video generation providing controllable predictions of how scenes evolve after agent interventions. Yet existing models are commonly trained with space-time-uniform mean squared error, allowing abundant background tokens to dominate the gradient while sparse interaction dynamics remain under-optimized; such uniform fitting rewards reconstructing appearance rather than learning how actions change the world. We introduce Causal Action Effect Reweighting (CAER), a general training paradigm that redistributes supervision toward the tokens whose predicted future is causally affected by the action. CAER contrasts the model's own predictions with and without action conditioning to localize these tokens online, then normalizes the resulting effect map into a weight that preserves the total coefficient mass and changes only where it is spent. This online signal requires no external annotations or offline preprocessing, avoids additional data-processing time, and scales naturally with model and dataset size. Experiments across heterogeneous action-conditioned world-model tasks show that CAER converges to better solutions than uniform MSE training, with consistent improvements in the physical consistency, controllability, and visual quality of generated videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果动作效应重加权（CAER），一种用于动作条件世界模型训练的通用范式：它通过对比模型自身在有/无动作条件下的预测，在线定位受动作因果影响的token，并将效果图归一化为权重，在保持总系数质量不变的前提下把监督信号重新分配到动作真正影响的位置，从而替代均匀MSE训练，提升生成视频的物理一致性、可控性与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 世界模型正成为具身智能的核心基础设施，动作条件视频生成能提供可控的未来场景预测。但现有模型普遍使用时空均匀的均方误差（MSE）训练，大量背景token主导梯度，而稀疏的交互动力学却得不到充分优化；这种均匀拟合奖励的是重建外观而非学习动作如何改变世界。因此需要一种能聚焦于受动作因果影响的token的训练范式。
AI.method: CAER（Causal Action Effect Reweighting）：对比模型自身在有动作条件和无动作条件下的预测，在线定位受动作因果影响的token；将得到的效果图归一化为权重，在保持总系数质量不变的前提下，仅改变监督权重在何处分配。该在线信号无需外部标注或离线预处理，不增加数据处理时间，并能随模型与数据集规模自然扩展。
AI.result: 在多个异构的动作条件世界模型任务上，CAER 相比均匀 MSE 训练能收敛到更优的解，并在生成视频的物理一致性、可控性和视觉质量上取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: CAER 是一种通用、无额外标注开销且可扩展的训练范式，通过重新分配监督信号到动作因果影响的token，显著提升了世界模型的物理一致性、可控性与生成质量，为动作条件世界模型训练提供了更优的替代方案。

title: Responsible Integration of AI in Cancer Genomics: Barriers, Risks, and Pathways to Trustworthy Clinical Translation
