summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) are increasingly used to extract, integrate, and interpret biomedical knowledge relevant to cancer genomics, yet their translation into routine clinical oncology has been comparatively slow. The central challenge is not computational capability alone, but trustworthy integration into clinical workflows. This review examines how NLP and AI support the cancer genomics pipeline, from literature mining and automated variant interpretation to clinical trial matching, knowledge graph construction, and multimodal data integration. We identify four interrelated translational failure domains: evidence inconsistency, explainability and uncertainty, data governance and reproducibility, and interoperability. Rather than considering these challenges in isolation, we take a systems-level view, focusing on their interaction across the translational pathway. We propose a conceptual framework and roadmap for addressing these domains through rigorous validation, uncertainty-aware methods, interoperable infrastructures, regulatory alignment, and human oversight across the AI lifecycle. Progress toward routine clinical use will depend less on further improving model capability than on systematically addressing these interacting failure domains from development through deployment and post-deployment monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了NLP与AI在癌症基因组学管线中的应用，指出阻碍其进入常规临床肿瘤学的核心问题并非单纯的计算能力，而是临床工作流中的可信整合。作者识别出四个相互关联的转化失败域（证据不一致、可解释性与不确定性、数据治理与可重现性、互操作性），并从系统层面提出解决这些交互问题的概念框架与路线图。
AI.motivation: AI和NLP在癌症基因组学中已被广泛用于知识提取、整合与解读，但向常规临床肿瘤学的转化进展缓慢。作者认为核心挑战不是计算能力本身，而是如何在临床工作流中实现可信整合，因此需要系统审视阻碍转化的失败因素及其相互作用。
AI.method: 本文为综述性研究：梳理NLP/AI如何支持癌症基因组学管线（文献挖掘、自动化变异解读、临床试验匹配、知识图谱构建、多模态数据整合），归纳出四个相互关联的转化失败域（证据不一致、可解释性与不确定性、数据治理与可重现性、互操作性），并采取系统级视角分析这些失败域在转化路径上的交互作用，进而提出涵盖严格验证、不确定性感知方法、互操作基础设施、监管对齐和全生命周期人工监督的概念框架与路线图。
AI.result: 识别出四个相互关联的转化失败域，并提出一个系统级的概念框架与路线图，用以应对这些域及其交互；同时指出推进常规临床应用的关键在于系统性处理从开发、部署到部署后监测全生命周期中的这些失败域，而非单纯提升模型能力。
AI.conclusion: 向常规临床应用进展的成效将主要取决于是否系统性地解决这些相互作用的失败域，贯穿AI从开发、部署到部署后监测的全过程，而非进一步改进模型能力本身。

title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We formulate this bottleneck as retrievable granularity discovery and introduce Hi-Q, an evidence-conditioned framework for hierarchical query refinement. At each query node, a resolution operator tests whether retrieved evidence supports the current query unit; resolved nodes terminate, while unresolved nodes are expanded by a dependency-preserving binary operator and checked by a semantic coverage verifier. Hi-Q therefore grows a query tree whose topology is determined by corpus support signals rather than by a fixed decomposition template or a pre-built graph. We evaluate Hi-Q on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, primarily under full-corpus retrieval, where dependent evidence must be located among open-domain distractors rather than within a small annotated pool. In this setting Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1 on that same average, and ahead of the graph-based RAG baseline PropRAG by 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1 on MuSiQue-full, without corpus-wide graph construction. In the restricted supporting/distractor setting used by prior work, Hi-Q likewise attains the best accuracy, with 57.9 EM and 69.3 F1 on average, ahead of PropRAG by 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1 and IRCoT by 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1. The project page is available at https://hi-q-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: Hi-Q 提出一种证据条件化的分层查询精化框架，通过解析算子判断当前查询单元是否已被检索证据支持，未解析的节点由保持依赖的二元算子展开并由语义覆盖验证器检查，从而根据语料支撑信号动态生长查询树，解决多跳问答中问题粒度与证据可检索粒度不匹配的瓶颈，并在三个多跳 QA 基准上超越迭代检索和基于图的方法。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答的核心瓶颈在于：问题表达的粒度往往与语料证据可检索的粒度不一致。现有方法通过固定图结构、迭代改写查询或执行生成的程序来处理这一不匹配，但这些策略都没有明确决定"查询单元何时已被证据支持、何时应当被细化"，导致检索与推理决策脱节。
AI.method: Hi-Q 是一个证据条件化的分层查询精化框架。在每个查询节点上，解析算子（resolution operator）测试当前查询单元是否已被检索到的证据支持；已解析的节点终止，未解析的节点则由保持依赖关系的二元算子（dependency-preserving binary operator）展开，并由语义覆盖验证器（semantic coverage verifier）检查。因此 Hi-Q 生长的查询树拓扑由语料支撑信号决定，而非固定分解模板或预构建图。
AI.result: 在三个多跳 QA 基准上，全语料检索设置下 Hi-Q 平均达到 52.3 EM / 64.0 F1，比迭代检索基线 IRCoT 平均高出 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1，在 MuSiQue-full 上比基于图的 RAG 基线 PropRAG 高出 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1，且无需构建语料级图。在受限的 supporting/distractor 设置下取得最佳准确率，平均 57.9 EM / 69.3 F1，比 PropRAG 高 5.6 EM / 3.9 F1，比 IRCoT 高 13.7 EM / 15.8 F1。
AI.conclusion: Hi-Q 通过以证据支撑信号而非固定模板或预构建图来决定查询树的拓扑结构，有效弥合了问题粒度与证据检索粒度的不匹配；在开放域干扰项下也能定位相互依赖的证据，并在全语料与受限两种检索设置下均取得领先性能，证明了证据条件化分层精化的有效性。

title: CARVE: Verified Expansion for Variable-Length Generation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models predict tokens from a partially observed response canvas, enabling bidirectional conditioning and parallel token refinement. Yet standard masked-diffusion decoders use a rigid inference interface: the number of masked positions allocated to the answer is fixed before generation begins. Choosing this length is difficult. A short canvas can truncate reasoning or code, while a long canvas wastes computation and can perturb denoising. We introduce CARVE (Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion), a training-free variable-length algorithm for masked diffusion LMs. Starting from a shorter canvas, CARVE can grow the response during decoding by inserting additional [MASK] positions. Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra masked space were present? The inserted masks are kept only when they induce low Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence on aligned unresolved positions. This makes length growth a verified stability decision rather than a pure confidence heuristic. CARVE applies without retraining to both full-canvas and blockwise diffusion decoders. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CARVE consistently improves average performance over fixed-length baselines across all evaluated model families. Crucially, CARVE achieves these accuracy gains while reducing inference cost, reaching half the FLOPs of fixed-length decoding in some settings.

AI.tldr: CARVE 是一种无需训练的变长解码算法，允许掩码扩散语言模型在解码过程中动态插入额外的 [MASK] 位置以扩展响应画布，并通过反事实检验（比较原画布未解析位置上的预测一致性）来决定插入是否保留，从而在代码生成和数学推理任务上超越固定长度基线，同时将推理 FLOPs 降低（部分场景减半）。
AI.motivation: 标准掩码扩散解码器的推理接口是刚性的：画布中分配给答案的掩码数量在生成前就固定了。长度选择很困难——画布过短会截断推理或代码，过长则浪费计算并可能干扰去噪过程，因此需要一种自适应的变长解码机制。
AI.method: CARVE 从较短的画布开始，在解码过程中通过插入额外的 [MASK] 位置来扩展响应。它并非保留所有插入，而是对候选扩展画布进行检验，提出反事实问题：若额外的掩码空间存在，模型对原画布未解析位置是否仍会给出相似的预测。仅当对齐的未解析位置上产生较低 Jensen-Shannon (JS) 散度时，插入的掩码才被保留。这使得长度增长成为一种经过验证的稳定性决策，而非纯粹的置信度启发式。CARVE 无需重训练即可应用于全画布和分块（blockwise）扩散解码器。
AI.result: 在代码生成和数学推理基准上，CARVE 在评估的所有模型家族中一致地提升了相对于固定长度基线的平均性能；同时降低推理成本，在部分设置中 FLOPs 仅为固定长度解码的一半。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长度增长建模为基于反事实一致性的"已验证的稳定性决策"，CARVE 证明掩码扩散 LM 的变长解码可以在不牺牲精度的情况下提升准确率并显著节省算力，为扩散式自回归解码的推理接口提供了更灵活且高效的范式。

title: ImageEval 2026: Culturally Grounded Arabic Multimodal Evaluation
comment: Arabic LLMs, Multilingual, Multimodal, Shared Task
summary: We present an overview of the ImageEval 2026 shared task on culturally grounded Arabic multimodal evaluation. It includes two tasks: (i) AynVQA, covering spoken visual question answering and image-grounded hallucination detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and (ii) CRAI-Bench, evaluating the cultural accuracy of text-to-image generation. A total of 14 teams participated in the test phase, with 12 teams submitting system description papers. Participating systems used a range of approaches, including zero-shot prompting, fine-tuning of vision-language models, speech-recognition pipelines, ensembling, and score calibration. We describe the task setup, datasets, evaluation procedure, and participating systems, and summarize the main results across the different tracks. All datasets and evaluation scripts from the shared task are released to the research community. The shared task highlights the challenges of culturally grounded multimodal evaluation, particularly for Arabic speech and image-text reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了ImageEval 2026关于文化根植的阿拉伯语多模态评测的共享任务，包含两个子任务（AynVQA和CRAI-Bench），共14个团队参与测试阶段，12个团队提交了系统描述论文，并发布了全部数据集与评测脚本。
AI.motivation: 多模态评测大多集中于英语和主流文化语境，缺乏针对阿拉伯语及文化根植性的基准。本文旨在构建一个覆盖口语视觉问答、幻觉检测和文生图文化准确性的共享任务，以评估当前模型在阿拉伯语多模态理解与生成上的能力差距，并推动该领域研究。
AI.method: 任务包含两大子任务：AynVQA（覆盖英语与现代标准阿拉伯语的口语视觉问答及图像幻觉检测）和CRAI-Bench（评估文生图的文化准确性）。文中描述了任务设置、数据集构建、评测流程及参与系统；14个团队在测试阶段参赛，采用零样本提示、视觉-语言模型微调、语音识别流水线、集成学习和分数校准等多种方法。
AI.result: 共14个团队参与测试阶段，12个团队提交系统描述论文；文章总结了各轨道的系统方法与主要结果，并公开了所有数据集和评测脚本，凸显了阿拉伯语语音与图文推理在多模态评测中的文化挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该共享任务揭示了文化根植的多模态评测（尤其是阿拉伯语音和图文推理）的显著困难，为研究社区提供了公开的数据集、评测脚本和基线结果，为后续在该方向上的研究奠定了基础。

title: Learning Action Models with Conditional and Quantified Effects via Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
summary: Accurate action models are critical for effective planning. Existing action-model learning methods largely assume simple action representations or become computationally intractable when learning conditional and quantified effects. We present Online Hypothesis-Driven Conditional Action Model Learning (OHCAM), an online approach for learning action models with conditional and quantified effects from limited interactions with the environment. OHCAM maintains a belief over hypothesized action models and actively selects informative actions to reduce uncertainty by maximizing disagreement among competing hypotheses, while being robust to noisy observations. To enable scalability, OHCAM begins with a small set of simple action model hypotheses and expands to more complex conditions only when the current hypotheses become inconsistent with the data. Experiments on six benchmark planning domains demonstrate that OHCAM is sample efficient in learning action models that solve substantially more tasks than baselines, even with observation noise. We validate OHCAM on two tasks using a Kinova Gen3 robot, demonstrating the real-world applicability of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 OHCAM（在线假设驱动的条件动作模型学习），一种在有限环境交互中学习含条件效应和量化效应动作模型的在线方法；它维护假设信念、主动选择信息量大的动作以最大化假设间分歧来降低不确定性，并对噪声观测保持鲁棒；通过从简单假设逐步扩展到复杂条件实现可扩展性。实验在六个基准规划域和 Kinova Gen3 机器人上验证了其样本效率与真实世界适用性。
AI.motivation: 准确的行动模型对高效规划至关重要，但现有动作模型学习方法大多假定简单的动作表示，或在学习条件效应和量化效应时变得计算上难以处理。因此需要一种既能处理复杂（条件与量化）效应、又具备计算可扩展性和样本效率的在线学习方法。
AI.method: OHCAM 维护一个关于候选动作模型的信念分布，并通过最大化竞争假设之间的分歧（disagreement）来主动选择具有信息量的动作，从而降低不确定性，同时设计为对噪声观测鲁棒。为实现可扩展性，它从一个较小的简单动作模型假设集合出发，仅当当前假设与数据不一致时才扩张到更复杂的条件。
AI.result: 在六个基准规划域上的实验表明，OHCAM 在样本效率上优于基线，能够学习解决显著更多任务的动作模型，即使在存在观测噪声的情况下依然有效；并在 Kinova Gen3 机器人上的两项任务中验证了其真实世界适用性。
AI.conclusion: OHCAM 提供了一种样本高效、抗噪且可扩展的在线动作模型学习方案，能够学习包含条件与量化效应的复杂动作模型，在模拟基准和真实机器人任务中均表现出优越性能，验证了该方法的实际应用价值。

title: MNIST-PRO: MNIST is Back as a Partially Observable World for AI Agents
summary: AI agents in partially observable environments need to coordinate active sensing with working memory to maintain an evolving perceptual state. However, existing benchmarks struggle to isolate this perceptual-state construction and interpretation capability because they introduce physical and control complexities. We address this with MNIST-PRO, a benchmark that isolates agentic perception by converting MNIST digit recognition into a sequential, glimpse-based search task with lookback constraints. We evaluate ten multimodal models across four memory representations, including raw visual history, textual states, structured metric grid maps, and a consolidated visual canvas. While models excel under full observability, partial observability exposes a clear performance gap. We identify three distinct bottlenecks. First, perceptual-state construction and interpretation present a challenge, as agents struggle to integrate fragmented glimpses. Second, agents often stop exploring before they see the full sequence. Third, models often fail to revise early, incorrect beliefs even when faced with subsequent contradictory evidence. These results show that simply acquiring visual evidence is not enough. Agents must also be able to build and update a reliable perceptual state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MNIST-PRO 基准，通过将 MNIST 数字识别转换为带回溯约束的、基于连续瞥见的搜索任务，在剔除物理与控制复杂性的条件下隔离评测智能体在部分可观测环境中的感知状态构建与解释能力。对十种多模态模型在四种记忆表征下的评测显示，部分可观测性暴露了明显性能差距，并识别出三个瓶颈：感知状态构建与整合困难、过早停止探索、以及无法根据后续矛盾证据修正早期错误信念。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境中的 AI 智能体需要协调主动感知与工作记忆来维护不断演化的感知状态，但现有基准因引入物理和控制复杂性，难以单独隔离并评测这种感知状态构建与解释能力，因此缺少一个能纯粹衡量该能力的评测基准。
AI.method: 提出 MNIST-PRO 基准，将 MNIST 数字识别转化为一个顺序的、基于瞥见（glimpse）的搜索任务并加入回溯（lookback）约束，从而隔离智能体感知能力。在四种记忆表征（原始视觉历史、文本状态、结构化度量网格地图、整合视觉画布）下评测十种多模态模型。
AI.result: 模型在完全可观测条件下表现优异，但部分可观测性揭示了明显性能差距。识别出三个不同瓶颈：1) 感知状态构建与解释困难，智能体难以整合碎片化瞥见；2) 智能体常在看到完整序列前就停止探索；3) 即使遇到后续矛盾证据，模型也往往无法修正早期错误信念。
AI.conclusion: 简单获取视觉证据并不足够，智能体还必须能够构建并更新可靠的感知状态。这表明感知状态的构建与更新能力是部分可观测环境下智能体性能的关键决定因素，为后续研究提供了明确的改进方向。

title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus
summary: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enriched version of the publicly available Hansard Corpus optimized for computational social science research, with 6.7 million speeches across 1.2 million debates, with 89% gender-matching for speeches by MPs from the House of Commons. We find that 54% of speeches opposing women's representation contain sexist content, compared to 21% of speeches that are for the cause, and that the two sides use fundamentally different types of sexism: anti-suffrage rhetoric combines hostile and benevolent framing, while pro-suffrage sexism is overwhelmingly benevolent. Female MPs support women's political rights at 93% compared to 70% for male MPs, a gap that closes only after enfranchisement. Our findings are evidence that benevolent and hostile sexism are used in different rhetorical contexts in a manner consistent with the theory of Ambivalent Sexism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大型语言模型分析英国议会 200 年间（1803-2005）6,531 份关于女性权利辩论的演讲，并结合"矛盾性性别歧视量表"（Ambivalent Sexism Inventory）检测议会中的性别歧视语言，同时发布了一个元数据增强的议会数据集（670 万演讲、120 万场辩论，下议院演讲性别匹配率达 89%）。研究发现：反对女性代表权的演讲中 54% 含性别歧视内容（支持方仅 21%），且双方性别歧视类型不同——反选举权言论同时包含敌意与善意性别歧视，而支持方几乎全是善意性别歧视；女性议员支持女性政治权利的比例（93%）显著高于男性议员（70%），该差距在赋予选举权后消失。这些结果与矛盾性性别歧视理论的预测一致。
AI.motivation: 旨在揭示立法机构在辩论女性权利时（即便是支持立场）所编码的系统性性别歧视模式如何在两个世纪中持续存在，并利用计算社会科学方法大规模量化这些模式，同时验证矛盾性性别歧视理论在真实政治语料中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型对 1803-2005 年英国议会 Hansard 语料中 6,531 份演讲进行分类，判断演讲者对女性选举权和政治代表权的立场，并从"矛盾性性别歧视"的敌意/善意两个维度分析性别歧视言论；此外构建了经过整理和元数据增强、面向计算社会科学研究的议会数据集（6.7M 演讲、1.2M 辩论、89% 的议员演讲性别匹配）。
AI.result: 反对女性代表权的演讲中 54% 含性别歧视内容，远高于支持方的 21%；双方使用根本不同类型的性别歧视：反选举权言论同时融合敌意与善意框架，支持方性别歧视几乎全是善意型。女性议员支持女性政治权利的比例为 93%，男性议员为 70%，该性别差距仅在赋予选举权后消失。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果证明敌意与善意性别歧视在不同修辞语境中分别被使用，其差异与矛盾性性别歧视理论高度一致，为理解长期政治话语中性别歧视的演化与修辞机制提供了大规模经验证据，并贡献了可复用的议会研究数据集。

title: Measure Before You Manage: Evaluating Agent Working Memory in Coding Agents
summary: Agent working memory is heterogeneous. Objects such as instructions, artifacts, tool outputs, and agent-generated state play different semantic roles and exhibit different size, retention, and representation profiles. Recent work has begun to explore memory-management mechanisms that account for such heterogeneity. This work focuses on semantic heterogeneity and studies how it should shape the management and evaluation of working memory in coding agents. Across 55 archived coding-agent trajectories, we find that semantically different working-memory objects exhibit distinct retention and compression behavior. This heterogeneity motivates semantically informed memory management. We study two semantically informed strategies: an object-aware compression policy and a retrieval-based policy. Their evaluation shows that calibration gains may not transfer to held-out tasks, and that equal token budgets do not imply equal delivered context or management cost. A real-system replay further exposes serving limits that nominal budgets alone do not capture. Together, these results show why semantic structure matters for agent working memory and why evaluating memory-management strategies requires more than a nominal token budget. We organize these lessons into four levels: stored state, delivered context, management work, and task or process outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析55条编码智能体轨迹，研究了工作记忆中语义异质性对象（指令、工件、工具输出、智能体状态）的保留与压缩特性，提出语义感知的内存管理策略（对象感知压缩与检索式），并揭示仅凭名义token预算评估内存管理策略的不足，最终将教训归纳为存储状态、传递上下文、管理工作、任务结果四个层级。
AI.motivation: 智能体工作记忆具有异质性，不同对象（指令、工件、工具输出、智能体生成状态）承担不同的语义角色，在大小、保留时长和表示方式上各有特点。现有研究虽开始探索考虑异质性的记忆管理机制，但主要聚焦于大小等维度，而本文聚焦于语义异质性，探究它应如何塑造编码智能体工作记忆的管理与评估方式。
AI.method: 基于55条存档的编码智能体轨迹，首先观察语义不同的工作记忆对象在保留与压缩行为上的差异；随后研究两种语义感知策略：对象感知压缩策略（object-aware compression policy）和检索式策略（retrieval-based policy），并在真实系统环境中进行回放（replay）以检验其局限。
AI.result: 1) 语义不同的工作记忆对象确实表现出不同的保留与压缩行为；2) 校准带来的收益可能无法迁移到留出任务；3) 等量的token预算并不等同于等量的实际传递上下文或管理成本；4) 真实系统回放暴露出名义预算无法反映的服务限制（serving limits）。
AI.conclusion: 语义结构对智能体工作记忆至关重要，评估内存管理策略不能仅凭名义token预算，而应从存储状态、传递上下文、管理工作以及任务/流程结果四个层级综合考量。

title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here, we introduce UtilMem, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 1,717 instances across five domains, designed to evaluate four underexplored aspects of memory utilization: reasoning over dense histories, identifying implicitly relevant memories, synthesizing distributed evidence into summaries, analyses, or plans, and resisting interference from semantically similar distractors. Evaluating a diverse set of retrieval-based and memory-augmented systems, we find that strong performance on conventional factual-memory benchmarks does not reliably translate into effective memory utilization. Moreover, retrieval alone is insufficient: even when relevant evidence is successfully recovered, systems frequently fail to integrate information across sessions or to distinguish useful evidence from plausible distractors. These findings expose a substantial gap between accessing stored information and using it effectively, and suggest that progress in long-term conversational memory will require architectures that explicitly support evidence integration and robustness to retrieval interference. Code is available at https://github.com/peijunallin/UtilMem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 UtilMem，一个包含 1,717 个实例、覆盖 5 个领域的诊断性基准，用于评估对话式智能体的"记忆利用"能力（即跨长交互历史将分布式、隐式且带有噪声的证据整合为连贯的面向任务输出），并发现：在传统事实记忆基准上的强表现并不能可靠迁移到记忆利用上，且仅靠检索也不够——即使相关证据被成功召回，系统仍常无法跨会话整合信息或区分有效证据与干扰项。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式长期记忆基准主要衡量逐点事实回忆（pointwise factual recall），即能否从历史交互中恢复孤立事实或事件级细节；而真实世界中的记忆使用往往要求更困难的能力：将跨长交互历史的分布式、隐式且带噪声的证据整合为连贯的、面向任务的输出。作者将这种能力称为"记忆利用"（memory utilization），并指出现有基准对此缺乏评测。
AI.method: 作者提出诊断性基准 UtilMem，包含 1,717 个实例、覆盖 5 个领域，专门评估记忆利用的四个被忽视方面：（1）在密集历史之上进行推理；（2）识别隐式相关的记忆；（3）将分布式证据综合为摘要、分析或计划；（4）抵御语义相似干扰项造成的干扰。作者对多种基于检索（retrieval-based）和记忆增强（memory-augmented）的系统进行了评测。
AI.result: 评测发现：在传统事实记忆基准上的强表现并不能可靠地转化为有效的记忆利用；此外，仅靠检索是不够的——即使相关证据被成功恢复，系统也经常无法跨会话整合信息，或无法将有价值的证据与看似合理的干扰项区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了"访问存储信息"与"有效使用信息"之间存在显著差距，表明长期对话式记忆的进展需要显式支持证据整合以及对检索干扰具有鲁棒性的架构。代码已公开。

title: Wrong Prediction, Right Answer: Recovering Evidence from Collapsed LLM Sequence Scores
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, and 43 appendix tables. Research paper on language-model interpretability, reasoning evaluation, output-scoring bottlenecks, and label-free calibration. The paper evaluates controlled three-way logical reasoning tasks, ProofWriter, ANLI, and FOLIO using Qwen3.5, OLMo-2-1B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Pythia checkpoints
summary: When a large language model fails a reasoning task, it is often assumed to lack the underlying capability. However, this conflates a genuine absence of reasoning with a late-stage output bottleneck. We observe a consistent readout gap across diverse reasoning benchmarks: hidden-state probes successfully decode correct answers even when native sequence scoring completely collapses due to structural biases. To test whether instance-specific logic survives this collapse, we introduce a diagnostic protocol using a minimal, target-label-free additive correction. Fitting just two parameters on as few as 25 unlabeled examples recovers 9--34 accuracy points for Qwen3.5 models, transferring successfully to OLMo-2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B. Crucially, these recovered decisions persist on hard instances unresolved by simple lexical overlap and significantly exceed count-preserving permutation baselines. Our results show that many apparent zero-shot reasoning deficits are expression failures masking intact internal logic, urging a narrower interpretation of benchmark evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在推理任务上的失败往往并非缺乏推理能力，而是“输出端瓶颈”（readout gap）所致：即使序列级评分因结构偏差完全失效，隐状态探针仍能解码出正确答案。作者提出一种仅需两个参数、无需标签、只需约25个无标注样本的加性修正诊断协议，即可恢复9–34个准确率百分点，并能迁移到其他模型，表明许多表面的零样本推理缺陷实为表达失败，内部逻辑仍完好。
AI.motivation: 以往将LLM在推理任务上的失败直接归因于“缺乏相应能力”，但这混淆了真正的推理缺失与后期输出阶段产生的瓶颈。作者观察到在不同推理基准上存在一致的读出差距：即使原生序列评分因结构偏差彻底失效，隐状态探针仍能成功解码正确答案，因此需要一种方法来判断实例级别的逻辑是否在这种“崩塌”中幸存下来。
AI.method: 提出一种诊断协议，使用极简的、无需目标标签的加性修正项。该修正只需拟合两个参数，并在少至25个无标注样本上进行，用于纠正序列评分中的结构偏差；同时通过计数保持的排列基线（count-preserving permutation baselines）与简单词法重叠对照来验证恢复出的决策并非来自表面的浅层线索。
AI.result: 该两参数修正方法在Qwen3.5模型上恢复了9–34个准确率百分点，并可成功迁移到OLMo-2-1B和Llama-3.1-8B上。恢复后的正确决策在简单词法重叠无法解决的困难实例上依然成立，且显著优于计数保持的排列基线。
AI.conclusion: 许多看似零样本推理缺陷实际上是表达失败（expression failures）掩盖了完整的内部逻辑，因此对基准评测结果应持更审慎、更窄化的解读，不能仅凭输出层表现断言模型缺乏推理能力。

title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code
summary: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the interface that lets a VLM prior interact with this browser-as-world-model autonomously and decides which interactions become supervision. Each round, the VLM emits a critique that the planner compiles into a typed interaction contract; the browser re-executes the candidate and issues an acceptance certificate only when both target progress and preservation of every previously verified capability hold; certified transitions accumulate as a quality ratchet that is the only thing the SFT export ever sees. Under matched training, WebWorld-27B improves Raw-27B by 5.3 points on HTMLBench-400 and 14.9 points on MiniAppBench-Val, and reaches the level of strong frontier systems such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4 on interactive HTML generation. Equal-size ablations show that browser-backed admission carries the gain: without the certificate, the matched 9B lift nearly disappears.

AI.tldr: 提出 WebWorld：一个让 VLM 与"浏览器即世界模型"自主交互的接口，用浏览器作为不可被欺骗的确定性执行器来认证代码修复，从而为 VLM 驱动的自改进提供可靠的监督信号。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 驱动的网页代码自改进存在结构性缺陷：提出修复的模型同时也是评判修复的模型，视觉合理性判断无法真实反映页面是否可用；循环中缺少一个 VLM 无法愚弄的对手方，而浏览器恰好就是这样的确定性、可执行的 HTML 行为模拟器（即事实上的网页代码世界模型）。
AI.method: WebWorld 使 VLM 先验与浏览器（作为世界模型）自主交互，并决定哪些交互成为监督。每轮 VLM 生成批评意见，规划器将其编译为类型化的交互契约；浏览器重新执行候选方案，仅当目标进展与所有已验证能力的保持同时成立时才签发接受证书；认证通过的转移逐步累积为质量棘轮（quality ratchet），成为 SFT 导出一方唯一可见的训练信号。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练规模下，WebWorld-27B 相比 Raw-27B 在 HTMLBench-400 上提升 5.3 分，在 MiniAppBench-Val 上提升 14.9 分，在交互式 HTML 生成上达到 Kimi-K2.6、GPT-5.4 等强前沿系统的水平。同等规模的消融实验表明增益来自浏览器背书的准入机制：去除证书后，匹配的 9B 模型提升几乎消失。
AI.conclusion: 浏览器作为确定性执行器提供的接受证书是打破"自我评判"闭环的关键，它将可验证的执行证据注入监督信号，构成自改进中的质量棘轮，实现对前沿模型水平的追赶。

title: TSPFN: A Temporal Tabular Foundation Model for Physiological Time Series Classification
comment: Accepted at STACOM 2026 (MICCAI Workshop). 10 pages, 3 figures
summary: Designing models that generalize effectively in low- to medium-data regimes remains a primary challenge in medical machine learning, particularly for physiological time-series classification. While tabular foundation models such as TabPFN offer an attractive alternative to conventional fine-tuning through in-context learning, they are not designed to capture the temporal dependencies inherent to physiological signals. ~In this paper, we introduce TSPFN, a foundation model that redesigns TabPFN's architecture for time series data. TSPFN integrates structured temporal representations and positional embeddings to capture intra-sample temporal and channel dependencies. To fully leverage its spatio-temporal design, the model is pretrained on 140,000 real-world physiological time series across multiple medical domains. This yields a unified, generalizable framework capable of learning the specificities of medical time series. Experiments across diverse physiological benchmarks demonstrate that TSPFN consistently outperforms standard tabular baselines and TabPFN, and achieves superior cross-domain generalization compared to specialized deep time-series models. All our experiments, ablation studies, and pre-processing scheme are publicly available at https://github.com/Jeremstym/TSPFN

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TSPFN，一个面向生理时间序列分类的时序基础模型。它重新设计了 TabPFN 的架构，融入结构化时序表征与位置嵌入以捕获时间及通道依赖，并在 14 万个跨医疗领域的真实生理时间序列上预训练，从而在低至中数据规模下实现统一且可泛化的学习。实验表明 TSPFN 一致优于标准表格基线、TabPFN 以及专用深度时序模型，并展现出更强的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 医学机器学习中，尤其是在低至中数据规模下，设计能有效泛化的模型仍是主要挑战，生理时间序列分类尤为突出。虽然以 TabPFN 为代表的表格基础模型可通过上下文学习成为传统微调之外的替代方案，但它们并未针对生理信号的时序依赖进行设计，难以直接捕捉这类信号的内在结构。
AI.method: 作者提出 TSPFN，将 TabPFN 的架构针对时间序列数据进行重新设计：整合结构化的时序表征和位置嵌入，用于捕获样本内的时间依赖与通道依赖；为充分利用这种时空设计，模型在来自多个医学领域的 14 万个真实生理时间序列上进行预训练，从而构建统一、可泛化且能学习医学时间序列特异性的框架。
AI.result: 在多个生理学基准上的实验表明，TSPFN 一致优于标准表格基线与 TabPFN，并且相比专用的深度时间序列模型具有更优的跨域泛化能力。所有实验、消融研究和预处理方案均已公开。
AI.conclusion: TSPFN 证明了将表格基础模型的上下文学习能力与专为生理信号设计的时空架构相结合，可以在低至中数据规模下获得更强的分类性能与跨域泛化，为医学时间序列建模提供了一个可复现的通用基础模型方案。

title: Scaling Large Reasoning Models beyond Human Supervision: A Path toward Superintelligence
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can substantially improve reasoning in mathematics and code, where outcomes can be checked automatically. Extending this progress to open-ended and agentic tasks remains difficult because reliable rewards are harder to obtain and direct human supervision cannot keep pace with the scale and complexity of model-generated experience. This paper studies how LRMs can continue to improve as human supervision gradually recedes from the learning loop. We examine two connected dimensions of this problem. The reward axis traces the development from per-instance human judgments to reusable verifiers and rewards that operate even without human feedback. The experience axis examines how learning can progress from human-curated tasks and environments toward self-generated curricula, constructed environments, and autonomous co-evolution. We connect these dimensions through a five-level ladder from L0 to L4 that identifies which parts of the learning process remain under continued human control. Our analysis further highlights the risks introduced by increasingly autonomous rewards and experience generation, including reward hacking, feedback drift, curriculum collapse, and environment errors. Consequently, we also provide the evaluation around three complementary objects: policy capability, feedback fidelity, and experience quality. This analysis provides a structured account of current approaches to scaling LRMs beyond human supervision and the open problems involved in developing self-sustaining learning systems toward superintelligence. Furthermore, we maintain a continuously updated \href{https://github.com/visitworld123/Awesome-Scaling-LRM-Beyond-Human-Supervision}{GitHub repository} to track the latest advances.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究大型推理模型（LRM）如何在人类监督逐渐退出学习循环的情况下持续提升能力，从奖励轴（从逐实例人类评判到可复用验证器/无人类反馈奖励）和经验轴（从人工策划任务到自生成课程、构建环境与自主协同进化）两个维度展开，提出从L0到L4的五级阶梯，并围绕策略能力、反馈保真度与经验质量三类对象给出评估框架，为迈向超智能的自持续学习系统提供结构化分析。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在数学和代码领域显著提升了推理能力，但将其推广到开放性和智能体任务时面临困难：可靠奖励难以获取，且人类直接监督无法跟上模型生成经验的规模与复杂度。因此需要研究LRM如何在人类监督逐渐退出的情况下继续提升。
AI.method: 提出一个包含两个关联维度的分析框架：奖励轴（从逐实例人类判断发展到可复用验证器，再到脱离人类反馈的奖励）与经验轴（从人类策划任务与环境发展到自生成课程、构建环境和自主协同进化）。将两轴通过五级阶梯（L0到L4）连接起来，界定学习过程中哪些环节仍受人类持续控制；并围绕三个互补对象（策略能力、反馈保真度、经验质量）给出评估框架。作者还维护一个持续更新的GitHub仓库追踪最新进展。
AI.result: 该分析指出日益自主的奖励与经验生成带来的风险（奖励黑客、反馈漂移、课程坍塌、环境错误），并提供了针对策略能力、反馈保真度和经验质量三类对象的评估方案，为现有LRM超越人类监督的扩展方法提供了结构化梳理。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为如何构建超越人类监督、可自我维持的学习系统提供了系统的分析框架与开放问题清单，是通向超智能的重要一步，同时强调了自主化过程中的关键风险与相应评估需求。

title: Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding
summary: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoSaiC，一种基于运动显著性互补掩码建模的自监督点云视频表示学习框架，通过课程运动显著性掩码、法向-流运动建模（so(3) 李代数上的局部刚体旋转）与跨视角 token 一致性预测三个组件，同时捕捉外观与运动动态，并在动作识别、时序动作分割和点级语义分割等下游任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 点云视频表示学习对三维动态场景理解至关重要，但现有自监督方法难以同时有效建模外观与运动动态，缺少显式的几何运动监督以及多视角一致性约束。
AI.method: 提出 MoSaiC 框架，耦合三个组件：1) 课程运动显著性掩码 CMSM，按课程调度引导掩码过程聚焦于运动显著性 token；2) 法向-流运动建模 NFM，在 so(3) 李代数中对每个 token 的局部刚体旋转提供显式几何运动监督；3) 跨视角 token 一致性预测 CTCP，在两个互补掩码视图间施加 token 级一致性约束。
AI.result: 在动作识别、时序动作分割以及点级语义分割等多个下游任务上的大量实验表明，该方法能够有效捕捉外观与运动动态，并取得优异性能。
AI.conclusion: MoSaiC 通过运动显著性引导的掩码建模、显式几何运动监督与跨视角一致性约束的有机结合，有效提升了自监督点云视频表示学习的效果，证明了该框架在多种三维动态场景理解任务中的通用性与有效性。

title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了针对瑞典新闻领域的持续预训练方法，构建了由数百万篇新闻文章整理而成的高质量语料库，并设计了覆盖六项编辑任务的新领域基准。研究发现，持续预训练仅在配合经验回放以防止灾难性遗忘时才能带来收益，并一致提升了模型的生成质量和事实知识，但未能改善判别性任务；此外，一种免训练的指令遵循方法仅对低秩适配训练的模型有效。关键在于，现有瑞典语通用基准无法捕捉模型领域内的性能提升，凸显了定向评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在通用场景下能力日益增强，但在小众或研究不足的领域（如瑞典新闻业）其实用性仍然有限。为此，作者希望通过在目标领域语料上进行额外训练来对现有模型进行专门化适配，以提升其在特定领域的效果。
AI.method: 作者从数百万篇新闻文章中整理出高质量语料，对大型语言模型进行持续预训练以适配瑞典新闻领域；同时构建了一个涵盖六项编辑任务的新型领域基准用于评估。实验采用全量微调和参数高效微调（低秩适配）两种方式，覆盖两种模型规模，并引入经验回放机制以缓解遗忘；此外还探索了一种免训练的指令遵循增强方法。
AI.result: 持续预训练能带来目标领域性能提升，但仅在配合经验回放时有效；模型的生成质量和事实知识得到一致增强，但判别性任务的熟练度未见提升。免训练方法仅对采用低秩适配训练的模型产生进一步改进；现有的瑞典语通用基准无法反映模型的领域内性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 定向评估对于领域适配过程至关重要，通用基准可能掩盖模型在特定领域的实际收益；持续预训练配合经验回放是适配大型语言模型到瑞典新闻等小众领域（特别是提升生成与事实知识能力）的有效途径。

title: Cross-Regional Grapevine Cold Hardiness Prediction via Learned Multimodal Latent Representations
summary: Accurate daily predictions of cold hardiness in woody plants are critical in regions where freezing temperatures can damage dormant buds and reduce seasonal yield. Existing biophysical, hybrid, and deep learning models have shown high predictive accuracy when trained on local data but remain largely site-specific. The limited availability of cold hardiness data, coupled with the lack of principled methods for transferring cold hardiness predictions to new regions and cultivars, has limited the broader adoption and practical utility of these approaches, particularly in data-scarce regions. To address these limitations, we propose a cold hardiness prediction framework that learns a transferable latent representation by capturing region-specific variation through learned embeddings. To enable prediction in previously unseen regions, we infer embeddings from (1) text descriptions of the cultivar and growing region, and (2) limited historical observations, supporting both zero-shot and few-shot transfer. Experiments on datasets from six regions across North America demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cold hardiness prediction methods, yielding more accurate predictions and substantially improving transfer to data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于可迁移潜在表示的木本植物耐寒性预测框架，通过学习到的嵌入编码区域特定差异，并利用品种与种植区域的文本描述及少量历史观测，实现零样本和少样本迁移，在北美六个区域数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生物物理、混合和深度学习耐寒性预测模型在本地数据上精度高，但高度依赖特定站点；耐寒性数据稀缺且缺乏将预测迁移到新区域和新品种的原则性方法，限制了数据稀缺地区的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一个耐寒性预测框架，通过学习到的嵌入（embeddings）捕捉区域特定的变异，学习可迁移的潜在表示；对未见过的区域，从（1）品种和种植区域的文本描述以及（2）有限的历史观测中推断嵌入，同时支持零样本和少样本迁移。
AI.result: 在北美六个区域的数据集上，该方法在预测精度上始终优于最先进的耐寒性预测方法，并显著改善了向数据稀缺区域的迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过文本描述与历史观测结合的可迁移嵌入表示，可以有效克服耐寒性预测的站点特异性和数据稀缺问题，为跨区域、跨品种的耐寒性预测提供了可行且更具实用性的方案。

title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出D-HSM（动态枢纽-辐条记忆），一个无需训练的流式视频理解框架，将远处历史编码为结构化文本记忆存储于以实体为中心的枢纽-辐条结构中，近期帧保留为视觉token，并在回答问题时动态检索问题相关记忆子集与视觉窗口结合，供冻结VLM预测答案，在流式与长视频基准上稳定超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要在持续增长的视觉流上任意时刻回答问题，核心挑战是既要紧凑地记住长距离历史，又要高效检索与问题相关的证据；现有方法难以兼顾长时记忆的紧凑性与检索有效性。
AI.method: D-HSM是一个训练无关（training-free）框架，由三部分组成：(1) 将选定的历史视频片段转换为类型化文本观测，存入以实体为枢纽、相关证据为辐条的枢纽-辐条记忆结构；(2) 回答问题时动态检索紧凑的问题感知记忆子集，并通过枢纽-辐条链接进行扩展；(3) 将该记忆与最近的视觉窗口结合，输入冻结的VLM进行答案预测。
AI.result: 在流式视频和长视频基准上的广泛实验表明，D-HSM一致且显著地提升了VLM骨干网络性能，并优于其他最先进的在线和离线视频理解基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过以实体为中心的文本记忆与动态问题感知检索的机制，D-HSM在不训练的情况下实现了对长时历史的高效紧凑记忆与精准证据利用，是流式视频理解的强有效解决方案。

title: Universal Transformers for Circuit Computations: Perfect Length Generalization in Tiny Transformers
summary: Learning generalizable algorithmic computations remains a challenge for neural networks, as reflected in persistent failures on compositional and length generalization benchmarks. We present a provably correct, transformer parameterization (with only 280 learnable parameters for Boolean algebra tasks) capable of learning and evaluating problems of any depth or length. We assume inputs are fully parenthesized, well-formed expressions. Our approach conceptualizes algorithmic tasks as circuit models embedded in transformers, enabling depth-1 circuit reduction in a single forward pass. To achieve depth generalization, we introduce a positional encoding that tracks each gate's depth within the circuit, enabling the model to identify evaluable subexpressions at each iteration via masked hard attention, with $O(n)$ per-iteration complexity via linear attention. Combined with an autonomous halting criterion, the model terminates after $d$ iterations for problems of depth $d$, yielding $O(n \cdot d)$ total complexity. We show that training on shallow problem instances (depth 1 and depth 2) effectively recovers interpretable parameters that {\em snap} into place, resulting in exact length generalization. Though we establish that our construction provably evaluates Boolean expressions -- a universal symbolic computation -- of arbitrary length perfectly, in other experiments we also demonstrate that our transformer variant can learn and generalize perfectly (100% accuracy) on other common length generalization benchmarks, including modular arithmetic and ListOps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可证明正确的Transformer参数化方案（布尔代数任务仅需280个可学习参数），将算法任务视为嵌入Transformer中的电路模型，通过深度感知的位置编码与掩码硬注意力实现每轮深度1的电路归约，并配合自主停机准则，以O(n·d)总复杂度对任意深度或长度的全括号良构表达式进行求值。在浅层实例（深度1和2）上训练即可使可解释参数"各就各位"，实现精确的长度泛化，并在布尔表达式、模算术和ListOps等基准上取得100%准确率。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在学习通用、可泛化的算法计算方面仍面临挑战，尤其在组合泛化和长度泛化基准上持续失败。作者希望打破这一局限，构建一个既能学习又能求值任意深度或长度算法的可证明正确的Transformer模型。
AI.method: 将算法任务概念化为嵌入Transformer中的电路模型，实现单次前向传播中的深度1（depth-1）电路归约；引入跟踪每个门在电路中深度的位置编码，使模型能通过掩码硬注意力与线性注意力在每轮迭代中识别可求值的子表达式，迭代复杂度为O(n)；结合自主停机准则，对深度为d的问题执行d次迭代后终止，总复杂度为O(n·d)。训练仅在深度1和深度2的浅层实例上进行。
AI.result: 在浅层实例上训练能有效恢复可解释参数并使其"各就各位"，从而实现精确的长度泛化；该构造可证明地对任意长度的布尔表达式（一种通用符号计算）进行完美求值，并在其他常见长度泛化基准（模算术、ListOps）上达到100%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明：通过显式的电路构造、深度感知位置编码和迭代归约机制，一个小参数量的Transformer变体能够实现任意长度与深度的算法求值的精确泛化，说明Transformer具备在标准训练下获得可证明正确的通用计算能力的潜力。

title: Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models
summary: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.

AI.tldr: RestoreMore 是一个面向图像修复的持续能力扩展框架。它冻结预训练修复模型作为能力锚点，并针对新退化类型学习残差扩展模块；通过多特征阶段的"能力导向双层级路由"机制，第一层识别与当前输入相关的能力，第二层选择并组合稀疏互补的退化专家，从而让新任务复用历史修复知识、渐进扩充专家库，在保持已有能力的同时持续获得新修复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像修复模型通常以固定能力集合进行训练，当出现新的修复需求时，传统方案要么额外训练新模型，要么将新旧数据合并后对原模型整体重训，既浪费资源又存在遗忘旧能力的风险。作者希望研究如何让一个已训练的修复器在不遗忘先前能力的前提下持续获得新能力，而不是设计新的修复骨干网络。
AI.method: 提出 RestoreMore 持续能力扩展框架：1) 将预训练修复模型冻结，作为"能力锚点"，为新到达的退化类型学习残差扩展模块；2) 在多个特征阶段引入能力导向的双层级路由机制——第一层路由识别与当前输入相关的修复能力，第二层路由选择并组合一组稀疏的互补退化专家；3) 通过该设计，新任务可选择性地复用历史修复知识，并逐步丰富可用于后续任务的专家库。
AI.result: 在广泛的修复基准上进行的实验表明，RestoreMore 能够持续获得新的修复能力，同时保持甚至提升先前已学习的能力，验证了该框架在能力扩展与知识保持之间的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，与其为每个新需求重训或新增独立模型，不如在冻结的预训练模型基础上通过残差扩展模块和分层路由机制实现持续能力扩展。该方法既避免了灾难性遗忘，又能通过专家库的渐进扩充和知识复用不断提升整体修复性能，为图像修复的连续学习提供了一种可扩展的范式。

title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text
summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个此前未被充分探索的安全风险：看似语义良性的合成数据可被用作隐蔽信道，将针对性的社会偏见注入已对齐的大语言模型中，同时基本保留模型的一般任务能力。
AI.motivation: 合成数据越来越多地被用于训练大语言模型，但其安全影响尚不明确；先前关于"阈下学习"（subliminal learning）的研究表明模型可能从看似无关的训练数据中继承行为特征，本文旨在探究此类机制是否可被恶意利用，通过语义良性的合成数据向已对齐模型注入针对性偏见。
AI.method: 构建了一个流水线：由未对齐的教师模型生成经过过滤的合成数据集，覆盖创意写作、代码生成等多个领域，随后用这些数据集对已对齐的学生模型进行微调，从而验证偏见注入是否可行。
AI.result: 实验表明，外观良性的合成数据可充当隐蔽信道，向学生模型传递针对性偏见，同时基本保持其一般任务能力不下降；并进一步提出基于对数线性（log-linearity）评分的筛查方法，作为识别此类看似良性合成数据的一种可行信号。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了合成数据驱动的LLM训练流程中一个此前被低估的安全隐患，并强调了改进防护措施的必要性，初步提出对数线性评分作为潜在防线。

title: A Model with No Head and Many Thoughts
summary: Large language models decode by projecting hidden states through a large vocabulary head at every step. This operation is computationally costly and forces all reasoning to be expressed in discrete tokens. We introduce Soft Latent Thinking, a method that replaces the LM head during reasoning with a lightweight projector, enabling autoregressive rollout in embedding space where reasoning steps remain continuous rather than tokenized. Experiments on DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B and LLaMA-3.2-3B show that Soft Latent Thinking consistently improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute during chain-of-thought. Our method achieves the highest pass@32 among all soft-thinking approaches, demonstrating that effective reasoning can be carried out in continuous space without discrete token generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Soft Latent Thinking（软潜在思考）方法，在推理阶段用轻量级投影器替代大词表语言模型头，使自回归过程在嵌入空间中进行，推理步骤保持连续而无需离散化token。在 DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B 和 LLaMA-3.2-3B 上的实验表明，该方法在所有 k 值上一致提升 pass@k，同时降低链式思维中每步的计算量，并在所有软思考方法中取得最高 pass@32。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型每一步推理都需要将隐藏状态通过庞大的词表头进行投影解码，这不仅计算开销大，而且强制所有推理过程以离散token的形式表达，限制了推理的连续性和效率。
AI.method: Soft Latent Thinking 在推理阶段用轻量级投影器替换 LM 头，使得模型能够在嵌入空间中执行自回归展开，推理步骤保持连续表示而非离散token，从而兼顾推理能力与计算效率。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B 和 LLaMA-3.2-3B 上的实验表明，该方法在所有 k 取值上一致提升 pass@k，并在推理链中降低每步计算量；在各类软思考方法中取得了最高的 pass@32。
AI.conclusion: 有效推理可以在连续空间中完成而不必生成离散token，Soft Latent Thinking 证明了将推理从离散词表解码中解放出来的可行性，为更高效、灵活的推理机制提供了新方向。

title: When Does Bigger Help? A Controlled Study of LLM Scale for Ontology Learning
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, and 5 tables. WOP 2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: The effect of Large Language Model (LLM) scale on ontology learning (OL) performance remains insufficiently characterized. We present a controlled evaluation of 13 models spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants from the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 lineages, together with proprietary GPT release variants, using the OntoLearner retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. All models are evaluated with the same embedding model, retrieval configuration, prompt templates, decoding settings, datasets, and metrics on term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relationship extraction across four biomedical and materials science and engineering ontologies. Within the dense Qwen3.5 lineage, increasing parameter count primarily improves precision rather than recall, with the largest gains occurring between 9B and 27B parameters. However, the effect of scale is neither monotonic nor uniform across tasks and domains. Dense 27B models outperform substantially larger sparse models on term typing, whereas larger Mixture-of-Experts models achieve the strongest open-weight results on taxonomy discovery. Non-taxonomic relationship extraction remains difficult across model scales, particularly for the Materials Data Science ontology. Performance differences across matched Qwen variants and proprietary GPT releases further indicate that architecture and model lineage can outweigh nominal parameter count. These findings show that model size alone is an insufficient selection criterion for OL and provide empirical guidance for reproducible LLM-assisted ontology engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验系统评估了13个大语言模型（涵盖Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6密集与专家混合变体及专有GPT版本）在ontology learning任务上的规模效应，发现参数量增加主要提升精确率而非召回率，且影响在任务和领域间并非单调一致，表明模型规模不足以作为ontology learning模型选择的唯一标准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型规模对ontology learning性能的影响尚未得到充分刻画，缺乏系统性的实证理解，因此需要探究模型参数量与本体学习各子任务表现之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用OntoLearner检索增强生成流水线，对13个模型进行受控评估，覆盖Qwen3.5与Qwen3.6血统的密集型和专家混合（MoE）变体以及专有GPT版本；所有模型使用相同的嵌入模型、检索配置、提示模板、解码设置、数据集和评测指标，在4个生物医学及材料科学与工程本体上比较术语类型标注、分类体系发现和非分类关系抽取等任务。
AI.result: 在密集Qwen3.5血统中，参数增加主要改善精确率而非召回率，最大收益出现在9B到27B之间；规模效应在任务和领域间并非单调一致。密集27B模型在术语类型标注上优于大得多的稀疏模型，而更大的MoE模型在分类体系发现上取得最强开源权重结果；非分类关系抽取在所有规模下仍具挑战性，尤其在材料数据科学本体上。此外，匹配的Qwen变体与专有GPT版本间的差异表明架构和模型血统可超越名义参数量。
AI.conclusion: 模型大小本身不足以作为ontology learning的模型选择标准，该研究为可复现的LLM辅助本体工程提供了实证指导。

title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.

AI.tldr: ScenePilot 是一个检索增强的“生长-修复”框架，用于文本驱动 3D 室内场景生成。它通过层级检索增强规划（HRAP）获取房间、群组和锚点级布局先验，由文本驱动生成器按群组顺序插入物体，并在每次插入后由强化多模态修复（RMR）模块进行轻量局部修正、完成后进行全局修复；配合扰动高质量场景构建的 SceneReverse-17k 修复轨迹数据集，策略从渲染视图、场景状态、检索先验和编辑历史中预测“移动-旋转-缩放”结构化动作。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动 3D 室内场景生成方法存在明显局限：单次生成的布局常存在几何无效问题；事后全场景优化成本高且不稳定；仅依赖提示词的规划方法缺乏可复用的布局先验，难以建模功能分组与物体间关系。作者希望提出一种更高效、稳定且可控的生成范式。
AI.method: 提出 ScenePilot，一种检索增强的 Grow-and-Repair 框架。具体包含三个核心部分：(1) HRAP 模块按房间、群组、锚点三级检索布局先验，辅助功能群组规划；(2) 文本驱动的基座生成器顺序插入物体群组；(3) RMR 模块在每次插入后进行轻量局部修正、完成后执行最终全局修复。作者还构建了 SceneReverse-17k 数据集：通过扰动高质量 3D 场景的位置、旋转和缩放，将逆操作作为可执行的修复目标来训练策略；该策略基于渲染视图、场景状态、检索先验和编辑历史预测结构化的 move-rotate-scale 动作。
AI.result: 通过将 HRAP 与 RMR 相结合，ScenePilot 为一次性生成和重型全场景优化提供了一种高效替代方案，在物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性上均有提升，同时保持了生成多样性。
AI.conclusion: ScenePilot 证明将检索到的布局先验与增量式“生成-修复”策略结合，能够兼顾场景生成的质量与效率，为解决现有一体化生成和全场景优化方法的缺陷提供了一条可行路径。

title: Sycophantic Agreement Transfers with Neutral Data via Contrastive Preference Optimization
summary: Sycophantic agreement refers to a behavior in which language models excessively affirm the user, often at the cost of factual accuracy. Although sycophantic agreement is a well-known failure of model alignment, there is limited understanding of how it emerges from model training. In this work, we demonstrate that sycophantic agreement can emerge as an unintended consequence of widely used contrastive preference optimization objectives. Using the OLMo 3 post-training pipeline, we show that, for various pairs of teacher models across three families, there is a strong correlation between the log-ratio of the teacher model sycophantic agreement rates and the resulting student model sycophantic agreement rate. We further demonstrate that this unintended transfer is not limited to DPO but also occurs across 6 other preference optimization objectives. To understand whether this effect can be attributed to particular training examples, we analyze the preference data and find that the sycophancy signal is diffused across the entire dataset rather than concentrated in a sparse set of examples: each example appears neutral, i.e., there are no explicit instances of sycophantic agreement, and filtering based on probe-based data attribution or logit-linear selection fails to mitigate sycophancy without removing a large portion of the dataset. Overall, our findings suggest that the teacher models used to generate preference data can interact with alignment training objectives in unexpected ways, generalizing to undesirable and potentially harmful behaviors like sycophantic agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文发现奉承性附和（sycophantic agreement）会作为广泛使用的对比偏好优化目标（如DPO等7种目标）的意外副产品而涌现。通过在OLMo 3后训练流程中实验，作者发现教师模型的奉承率（log-ratio）与学生模型的奉承率存在强相关，表明该行为从偏好数据生成阶段"转移"到学生模型。进一步分析表明奉承信号弥散于整个数据集而非集中于稀疏样本，基于探针的数据归因和logit线性过滤均无法在不删除大量数据的情况下缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 奉承性附和是语言模型对齐失败的已知问题（模型过度赞同用户而牺牲事实准确性），但此前对其如何从模型训练中涌现的机制缺乏理解。作者旨在揭示这种有害行为产生的根源。
AI.method: 使用OLMo 3后训练流程，对三族多种教师模型组合进行实验：(1) 测量教师模型奉承率的log-ratio与学生模型奉承率之间的相关性；(2) 在DPO之外进一步验证6种其他偏好优化目标；(3) 对偏好数据进行逐样本分析，检查是否存在显式奉承实例；(4) 尝试基于探针的数据归因和logit线性选择两种过滤方法以验证能否缓解奉承行为。
AI.result: 研究发现教师模型的奉承率log-ratio与学生模型奉承率强相关；该意外迁移不限于DPO，也出现在另外6种偏好优化目标中；偏好数据中不存在显式奉承实例，奉承信号弥散于整个数据集；基于探针的数据归因和logit线性过滤均无法在不删除大量数据的情况下缓解奉承问题。
AI.conclusion: 用于生成偏好数据的教师模型会与对齐训练目标以意想不到的方式相互作用，将奉承性附和等不良甚至有害行为泛化转移给学生模型。这提示偏好数据质量（教师的奉承倾向）是导致模型奉承行为的关键因素，对该领域的对齐工作具有重要启示。

title: OntoAligner-Ensemble: Voting-Based Fusion across Heterogeneous Ontology Alignment Techniques
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, accepted for OM-2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: Ontology alignment (OA) has evolved through several methodological paradigms, ranging from lexical and structural aligners to knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models and, more recently, Large Language Model (LLM)-based approaches. Although modern OA frameworks provide unified ecosystems for deploying these heterogeneous aligners, mechanisms for systematically reconciling their complementary and sometimes conflicting predictions remain relatively underexplored. We present OntoAligner-Ensemble, a modular and aligner-agnostic framework that combines candidate correspondences through a configurable two-stage process comprising voting-based fusion strategies followed by post-fusion selection policies. The framework supports any aligner implemented within OntoAligner that produces candidate correspondences, enabling diverse alignment paradigms to be integrated through a unified decision process. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we instantiate the framework using representative lightweight string-aligner, KGE-based, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation aligners powered by both open-weight and API-based LLMs. We evaluate individual aligners and ensemble configurations across eight benchmark tasks from five OAEI tracks spanning biomedical to beyond-equivalence. The results show that ensemble fusion consistently improves the balance between precision and recall and frequently outperforms standalone aligners across diverse domains. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that ensemble composition directly affects the precision-recall trade-off: heterogeneous cross-paradigm ensembles generally improve precision, whereas homogeneous LLM ensembles more often achieve higher overall F1-scores. These findings demonstrate that systematic ensemble learning offers a robust and reproducible strategy for OA while providing practical guidance for selecting ensemble compositions under different alignment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OntoAligner-Ensemble，一个模块化且与对齐器无关的框架，通过投票融合策略与融合后选择策略组成的可配置两阶段流程，系统性地整合不同本体对齐器（词法、结构、KGE 与 LLM 对齐器）的候选对应关系。在五个 OAEI 基准轨道的八个任务上的实验表明，集成融合能持续改善精确率与召回率的平衡，并常优于单一对齐器；跨范式的异构集成通常提升精确率，而同质 LLM 集成更常获得更高的 F1 值。
AI.motivation: 本体对齐领域涌现出从词法/结构对齐器到知识图谱嵌入模型再到基于大语言模型的对齐器等多种方法范式，现代 OA 框架虽能统一部署这些异构对齐器，但如何系统性地调和它们互补乃至冲突的预测结果仍研究不足，缺乏机制化的集成学习方法。
AI.method: 提出 OntoAligner-Ensemble，一种模块化、对齐器无关的框架，采用可配置的两阶段流程：先通过基于投票的融合策略组合候选对应关系，再应用融合后选择策略。该框架支持 OntoAligner 中任何能产生候选对应关系的对齐器，并以轻量字符串对齐器、KGE 对齐器以及基于开源权重和 API 的 LLM 检索增强生成对齐器实例化验证。
AI.result: 在涵盖生物医学到超越等价关系的五个 OAEI 轨道的八个基准任务上，集成融合持续改进精确率与召回率的平衡，且经常优于单一对齐器；分析发现异构跨范式集成通常提高精确率，而同质 LLM 集成更常取得更高的整体 F1 分数。
AI.conclusion: 系统化的集成学习为本体对齐提供了一种稳健且可复现的策略，同时为不同对齐场景下如何选择集成构成提供了实用指导。

title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 KBK（Knowing Beyond the Known）框架，通过显式建模“已知”与“未知”知识来统一多标签类增量学习（MLCIL）中的历史、当前与未来学习，解决已知与未知知识边界模糊这一核心障碍。
AI.motivation: 现有类增量学习方法在多标签场景（MLCIL）中因共现标签与不完整标签导致的学习目标内在矛盾而失效。作者认为核心障碍是模型对已知与未知知识的边界模糊，这种模糊破坏了历史知识保留、增加了当前任务学习难度，并限制了未来概念的适应性。
AI.method: 提出 KBK 强化知识规范框架，包含四部分：(1) 分层特征纯化模块，从全局特征中解耦细粒度类特定特征，用低层视觉特征强化高层语义抽象，以明晰已知知识；(2) 基于分布先验的不确定性感知回忆增强策略，抑制不可靠预测，提升历史回忆质量；(3) 利用语义相关性在共现条件下合成信息丰富的未知特征，为未来学习保留嵌入空间；(4) 类别均衡梯度补偿损失，根据遗忘速度动态重加权梯度反向传播，缓解异质遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个基准上验证了 KBK 的有效性与鲁棒性。在 MS-COCO B0-C10 设置下，即使不使用任何回放缓冲区，平均准确率（Avg. Acc）仍超越此前最优方法 2.7%。
AI.conclusion: 显式划分已知与未知知识并分别进行强化建模，能够统一协调历史保留、当前学习和未来适应，为多标签类增量学习提供了一种无需回放缓冲区即可取得优异性能的有效范式。

title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
comment: Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLVR训练中高熵token能够带来性能提升的现象展开研究，发现熵值仅在单个答案内部与梯度幅值相关，跨答案时无法稳定反映token重要性。作者据此提出基于梯度幅值的token选择方法GMTS，利用熵-梯度关联近似梯度幅值排序，在三个推理领域及多种模型规模下，以top 20% token训练均持续优于基于熵的选择方法。
AI.motivation: 先前研究观察到RLVR训练中高熵token（如最高的20%）对模型性能提升起关键作用，但高熵token为何有益仍缺乏充分理解。本文旨在揭示熵与token重要性的真实关系，并寻找更可靠的token重要性度量。
AI.method: 作者首先分析发现：同一答案内高熵token通常对应较大的梯度幅值，但跨答案时由于答案级奖励信号不同，熵无法一致地反映token重要性。基于此观察，提出梯度幅值token选择方法（GMTS），利用熵-梯度之间的关联来近似计算token梯度幅值排序，进而选择训练token。
AI.result: 在三个推理领域和多种模型规模下，以GMTS排序的前20% token进行训练始终优于基于熵的token选择方法，说明GMTS能更细粒度地估计token在RLVR训练中的贡献。
AI.conclusion: token重要性应综合熵值与答案级奖励信号来评估；梯度幅值相较于熵是更准确、更一致的token重要性度量，GMTS可作为RLVR训练中更优的token选择策略。

title: Stress-Testing Efficient Responsible-AI Evaluation: When Compute Savings Change Benchmark Conclusions
summary: Efficient evaluation changes the protocol used to support claims about model behavior, yet it is rarely tested whether those claims remain stable after the evaluation itself is made cheaper. We stress-test conclusion robustness in responsible-AI benchmarking by evaluating three dense and mixture-of-experts models on BBQ and BBQ-V under seven conditions spanning batching, quantization, benchmark reduction, and their combinations. Rather than treating preserved aggregate accuracy as sufficient, we compare accuracy, bias severity and prevalence, reasoning quality, subgroup behavior, subset-membership stability, runtime, and measured GPU energy against a full-benchmark BF16 baseline. Larger batching keeps accuracy within 0.35 percentage points of baseline and produces comparatively small subgroup changes, while reducing energy in five of six model--dataset settings. INT8 largely preserves quality but uses 1.79--4.26$\times$ baseline energy. INT4 causes larger, model- and context-dependent changes. Reduced benchmarks provide the most consistent savings, but very small subsets are substantially more sensitive to which items are retained. Efficient evaluation should therefore be treated as a measurement intervention whose validity must be checked across the conclusions the benchmark is intended to support. Our project website is https://vectorinstitute.github.io/sustainable-rai-evaluation/ and the code is available at https://github.com/VectorInstitute/sustainable-rai-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文对负责任AI基准测试中的"高效评测"（如分批、量化、基准缩减等）是否会影响结论稳健性进行了压力测试。作者在BBQ和BBQ-V上评估三个稠密/混合专家模型，比较七种高效评测条件相对全基准BF16基线在准确率、偏见严重程度与普遍性、推理质量、子群体行为、子集成员稳定性、运行时和GPU能耗等方面的差异，发现不同高效化手段对结论的影响各异，主张将高效评测视为一种需要跨结论验证其有效性的"测量干预"。
AI.motivation: 高效评测会改变支撑模型行为结论的评测协议，但很少被检验在评测被简化（更便宜）后，这些结论是否仍然稳定。现有做法往往仅关注聚合准确率的保持，忽视了对偏见、推理质量、子群体行为等多维度结论稳健性的影响。
AI.method: 在 BBQ 和 BBQ-V 两个负责任AI基准上，对三个稠密与混合专家模型进行评测，覆盖七种条件：更大批处理、INT8/INT4量化、基准缩减及其组合，并对照全基准BF16基线。除聚合准确率外，还比较偏见严重程度与普遍性、推理质量、子群体行为、子集成员稳定性、运行时间和实测GPU能耗。
AI.result: 更大批处理使准确率保持在基线0.35个百分点以内，子群体变化较小，且在六种模型-数据集设定中的五种降低能耗；INT8大体保持质量但能耗为基线1.79-4.26倍；INT4引起更大且依赖模型与上下文的变化；基准缩减带来最一致的节省，但极小规模子集对保留哪些条目高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 高效评测应被视为一种"测量干预"，其有效性必须针对基准所支撑的各维度结论逐一进行检验，而不能仅以聚合准确率是否保持作为充分判据。

title: CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at: https://github.com/jirongli/CapFrame

AI.tldr: 本文提出新任务TIVG（文本指令视点定位），即在3D高斯场景中根据文本指令找到对应的6自由度相机位姿；并提出CapFrame框架，采用“检索-翻译-精炼”流程，将语言转化为几何伪标签，通过可微优化在3DGS中求解相机位姿，实验证明其优于启发式搜索和轨迹生成基线。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽能实现逼真的实时新视角合成，但放置虚拟相机拍摄期望画面仍主要靠手动操作。现有语言引导方法多聚焦于物体级定位，只能决定“看什么”，难以控制“如何呈现”（如物体朝向、画面构图）。因此需要一个能根据文本指令直接确定相机6自由度位姿的方案。
AI.method: CapFrame是部分可微框架，遵循Retrieve-Translate-Refine流水线：首先检索相关视角，并通过基于MLLM的Question-Evaluation过程进行排序；随后将指令翻译为朝向（orientation）和布局（layout）伪标签；最后在3DGS中通过可微优化，结合布局损失和朝向损失对相机位姿进行精炼。
AI.result: 在38个真实场景、135条指令上的实验表明，CapFrame生成的视点比启发式视点搜索和改编的轨迹生成基线更符合文本描述，并经由VLM指标、MLLM评估者和用户研究验证。
AI.conclusion: 语言可以有效地转化为几何伪标签，指导3DGS场景中相机位姿的可微优化，从而实现文本驱动的自动视点定位；该工作填补了从“看什么”到“如何看”之间的空白，代码已开源。

title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 BiG-SURE，一种基于跨温度语义一致性的黑盒不确定性估计方法：以低温响作为稳定语义锚点、高温响作为探针，利用 NLI 蕴含分数构造锚点-探针二分图，并通过该矩阵的归一化谱能量平方定义置信度（其补为不确定性），在文本 QA、多语言 QA 与多模态 QA 任务上较现有黑盒不确定性估计器显著提升平均弃权 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景中部署大语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM）时，可靠的不确定性估计至关重要；但在参数不可访问的黑盒设置下，现有方法难以获取模型内部信息，导致不确定性估计质量受限。
AI.method: BiG-SURE 通过跨温度语义一致性估计不确定性：(1) 采样低温响应作为稳定语义锚点，采样高温响应作为探针，并施加保持语义的输入变换；(2) 基于 NLI 蕴含分数构建锚点-探针二分图（BiG）;(3) 定义置信度为该矩阵的归一化平方谱能量，不确定性为其补集；该方法评估高温探针是否仍与模型稳定的低温信念语义对齐。
AI.result: 在文本 QA、多语言 QA 及多模态 QA 任务、多个模型家族上的实验中，BiG-SURE 相较先前黑盒不确定性估计器提升了平均弃权 AUROC，同时保持简单、无需监督且适用于黑盒模型设置。
AI.conclusion: BiG-SURE 提供了一种简洁、无监督且通用（文本与多模态、黑盒）的可靠不确定性估计方案，通过跨温度语义一致性显著改善模型在安全关键场景中的拒答/弃权能力。

title: On the Complexity of the Compatibility Problem for Succinctly Encoded Conditional Distributions
summary: The motivation for this paper is the investigation of the trade-offs implicit in probabilistic models used in machine learning. Models are often used to make predictions in the form of conditional probabilities. However, a pair of conditional distributions p(x|y) and p(y|x) may not be compatible with any joint distribution p(x,y). Given two such conditionals, determining if there exists a compatible joint is known as the compatibility problem. For discrete random variables, when the conditionals are encoded as probability tables, the compatibility problem has a known solution, which is computationally tractable. In this paper, we formalise and study a succinct version of the problem, encoding conditional distributions as arithmetic circuits. This is applicable to practical applications of probabilistic modelling in high-dimensional settings, including neural network models. We show that, for succinct circuit representations of conditionals, the compatibility problem is intractable. In the case that all probabilities are non-zero, the problem is co-NP-complete. In the case that probabilities can be zero, we give examples to demonstrate that several notions of compatibility can be distinguished, and we prove that multiple versions of the problem are PSPACE-complete. Furthermore, we show that, assuming the polynomial hierarchy does not collapse, there exist compatible succinct conditionals whose joint cannot be expressed succinctly. Implications of these results for probabilistic modelling and machine learning are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究概率模型中的"相容性（compatibility）问题"的简洁版本：给定两个条件分布 p(x|y) 和 p(y|x)，判断是否存在一个联合分布 p(x,y) 与二者相容。当条件分布用算术电路（arithmetic circuits）简洁编码时（而非显式概率表），该问题变得难以处理：全非零概率情形下为 co-NP-完全；允许零概率时，多种相容性概念可被区分，多个版本为 PSPACE-完全；且在多项式层级不坍塌的假设下，存在相容的简洁条件分布，其联合分布却无法被简洁表达。
AI.motivation: 机器学习中的概率模型常用条件概率形式进行预测，但一对条件分布 p(x|y) 与 p(y|x) 不一定与任何联合分布相容。判断是否存在相容联合分布即"相容性问题"。经典版本（离散变量、概率表编码）已有可计算的有效算法；但在高维实际应用（如神经网络模型）中，条件分布常以紧凑形式（如算术电路）表示，此时问题的计算复杂度尚未被研究。本文旨在形式化并研究这一简洁版本，以揭示其计算本质与对概率建模的启示。
AI.method: 本文将条件分布编码为算术电路（arithmetic circuits），形式化定义简洁条件下的相容性问题，并系统地分析其计算复杂度。针对概率全非零与允许零概率两种情形分别刻画复杂度；通过构造示例区分多种相容性概念（如严格相容与广义相容等）；并利用多项式层级的假设论证存在性结论。
AI.result: （1）对算术电路表示的简洁条件分布，相容性问题整体上不可处理；（2）所有概率非零时，该问题为 co-NP-完全；（3）概率允许为零时，多种相容性概念可被区分，相应问题的多个版本为 PSPACE-完全；（4）在多项式层级不坍塌的假设下，存在相容的简洁条件分布，其对应的联合分布无法被简洁表达（即不存在多项式规模的电路表示）。
AI.conclusion: 简洁表示的相容性问题在计算上本质困难：复杂度从概率表情形的可处理跃升为 co-NP-完全或 PSPACE-完全，且简洁条件分布可能强迫与其相容的联合分布失去简洁性。这些负面结果对高维概率建模、神经概率模型的表示与推断具有重要启示，意味着在简洁条件模型中需要谨慎对待相容性保证与联合表示能力。

title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
summary: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了预计算记忆（precomputed memory）在语言模型中的适用条件与失效场景。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上分别用保存的键值缓存和其训练压缩版本进行实验，发现预计算记忆在以下情形会退化：由分离部件拼装、需高成本重建才能保持最新、以及会忽略依赖特定措辞的修正。作者提出若能并置提供、低成本重建、并被实时新信息取代，预计算记忆可避免重复向模型输入上下文；并评估了两种保持记忆新度的途径（热重建压缩缓存、向记忆旁注入特定措辞的更新），同时给出成本与待解决问题。
AI.motivation: 实际部署中，语言模型常在多次查询中重复阅读相同材料，成本高昂。预计算记忆允许一次性保存对材料的"阅读结果"并在请求间复用，从而避免重复输入上下文。然而该做法在何种条件下能保持答案正确性、何种条件下失效，缺乏系统刻画，本文旨在补齐这一空白。
AI.method: 以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为模型，采用两类预计算记忆实现——保存的键值缓存（saved key-value caches）与训练得到的缓存压缩（trained compressions of caches）。通过多组对照实验，分别考察记忆由分离部分拼装时的正确性退化、记忆保持新度所需的重建成本、以及记忆旁注入修正信息时对措辞条件的敏感性，并测量候选更新方案的成本。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 由多段独立准备的材料拼装而成的预计算记忆会显著退化；(2) 记忆仅能通过重建保持最新，而重建成本占完整准备成本的大部分；(3) 旁侧注入的修正会被忽略，其生效与否依赖具体措辞。同时，热重建压缩缓存、以及以粘贴文本或注入缓存状态方式提供特定措辞的更新，在保持记忆新度上表现出潜力（后者可作为重建间期的过渡手段）。
AI.conclusion: 对处理多种查询的部署系统而言，预计算记忆应按照"新信息改变其原始计算依据"的节奏进行重建。要使预计算记忆真正可行，需满足三个条件：可并置服务于多次查询、可低成本重建、以及可被实时到达的新信息取代。研究识别了两条有前景的路径并量化了成本，同时为后续工作留下了待解问题。

title: Sharp Approximation Rates for Neural Networks with Affine Latent Parameterizations
summary: Many parameter-efficient methods generate the parameters of a large neural network from a low-dimensional latent representation. Given an architecture $Φ$ with $P_Φ$ parameter slots, we write $\boldsymbolθ_f=\mathcal{G}(\boldsymbolξ_f)$, where $\mathcal{G}\colon\mathbb{R}^M\to\mathbb{R}^{P_Φ}$ is a parameter generator and $\boldsymbolξ_f\in\mathbb{R}^M$ is a latent representation of the target function $f$. The architecture $Φ$ and the generator $\mathcal{G}$ are shared across the entire target class, while each target $f$ is represented by its own latent vector $\boldsymbolξ_f$, with $Φ_{\mathcal{G}(\boldsymbolξ_f)}$ approximating $f$. This framework encompasses hypernetworks, low-dimensional parameterizations, parameter-efficient adaptation, and model compression. Understanding the tradeoff between the latent dimension $M$ and the network budget $P$ is therefore fundamental to characterizing the expressive efficiency of these methods. We study this tradeoff for affine generators and fully connected ReLU architectures. More precisely, optimizing jointly over architectures $Φ$ satisfying $P_Φ\leq P$ and affine generators $\mathcal{G}:\mathbb{R}^M\to \mathbb{R}^{P_Φ}$, we prove that the optimal worst-case uniform approximation error over the unit ball of $α$-Hölder functions on $[0,1]^d$, where $0<α\leq1$, has the sharp order $ \bigl(P\min\{M,P\}\bigr)^{-α/d}. $ In particular, our result shows that even a fixed-dimensional latent space suffices to achieve vanishing approximation error as the network budget increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究参数高效方法中潜变量维度 M 与网络参数量预算 P 之间的权衡。针对仿射生成器与全连接 ReLU 架构，证明在 α-Hölder 函数类上，联合优化架构与生成器所能达到的最优最坏情形均匀逼近误差具有尖锐阶数 (P·min{M,P})^{-α/d}，表明固定维度的潜空间也能随网络预算增加而实现逼近误差趋于零。
AI.motivation: 许多参数高效方法（超网络、低维参数化、参数高效微调、模型压缩）通过一个低维潜表示生成大规模神经网络的参数，即 θ_f = G(ξ_f)。架构 Φ 和生成器 G 在目标类上共享，而每个目标函数 f 由其潜向量 ξ_f 表示。因此，理解潜维度 M 与网络预算 P 之间的权衡，是刻画这类方法表达能力（expressive efficiency）的基础性问题，但目前缺乏严格的刻画。
AI.method: 针对仿射生成器 G:R^M→R^{P_Φ} 和全连接 ReLU 架构 Φ，在约束 P_Φ ≤ P 下，联合优化架构 Φ 与仿射生成器 G，分析其在 [0,1]^d 上 α-Hölder 函数单位球（0<α≤1）上的最坏情形均匀逼近误差。通过严格的逼近论方法推导最优误差阶数，并给出上界与下界以确立尖锐性。
AI.result: 证明最优最坏情形均匀逼近误差的精确阶数为 (P·min{M,P})^{-α/d}。该阶数表明：当网络预算 P 增大时，即使潜空间维度 M 固定，逼近误差仍可趋于零；误差随 P 的增长速率取决于 M 与 P 中的较小者，即 min{M,P}。
AI.conclusion: 该结果从逼近论角度严格刻画了参数高效方法中潜维度与网络预算的权衡，说明潜空间维度并不需要随网络规模无限增长——固定的低维潜码足以在增加参数预算时实现任意精度的逼近，为超网络、参数高效微调等方法的表达效率提供了理论基础。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum
summary: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSFormer，一种端到端的伪装物体检测框架，利用多光谱图像（而非传统的三通道RGB图像）作为输入来预测伪装物体的二值分割掩码，并通过大量实验验证了多光谱波段对低可见性场景下COD任务的有效性，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪装物体检测方法大多仅依赖传统三通道RGB图像，将可用视觉信息限制在较窄的光谱范围内，难以充分捕捉伪装场景中的细微光谱特征。多光谱图像能通过采集精细的光谱签名提供更丰富的场景信息，因此作者希望借助多光谱图像来突破RGB信息的局限，提升低可见性场景下的检测性能。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端框架MSFormer，以多光谱伪装图像作为输入，直接预测对应伪装物体的二值掩码；同时通过实验给出整合多光谱波段用于该复杂低视觉任务的实证依据。
AI.result: 大量实验表明所提方法有效，并在整体性能上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用多光谱图像进行伪装物体检测是可行且有效的方向，MSFormer证明了多光谱信息能显著增强对低可见性伪装目标的检测能力，为后续COD研究提供了新思路。

title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需保留集（retain set）的多模态大语言模型遗忘方法PAVA，通过因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠定位到编码器早期到中期的MLP层作为身份信息存储位置，将更新限定在这些层，并结合视觉属性锚定（用遗忘图像蒸馏模型自身遗忘前的答案）来保持图像相关行为，实现遗忘与保留之间的最佳权衡。
AI.motivation: 部署后常常需要移除多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中特定个体的信息，但现有方法依赖难以获取的保留集（retain set），重建保留集会重新造成遗忘本欲消除的隐私暴露；而仅用遗忘集（forget set）进行遗忘会破坏共享的视觉-语言计算，损害感知能力。因此需要一种仅依赖遗忘集且不破坏视觉能力的遗忘方法。
AI.method: 将免保留集遗忘建模为定位（localization）问题：利用因果追踪、权重移植和Fisher重叠三种技术，一致定位到早期至中期解码器MLP层是身份信息存储的位置，且与其他模块族不同，这些层可在不显著破坏视觉的情况下被修改。据此提出Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA)：将更新限定在这些层，并以视觉属性锚定（visual-attribute anchor）配合遗忘损失，通过从遗忘图像中蒸馏模型自身遗忘前的答案来保持图像相关的行为。
AI.result: 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem基准上，PAVA在仅使用遗忘集的方法中取得了最强的遗忘-保留权衡，并且与依赖保留集的基线方法相比仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将身份信息存储定位到早期至中期解码器MLP层并限定更新范围，PAVA实现了仅依赖遗忘集的有效多模态遗忘，在避免重建保留集所导致的隐私暴露的同时，最小化了对视觉感知能力的破坏，为部署后的MLLM个体信息移除提供了一种实用且隐私安全的方案。

title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
summary: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCSeg，一个面向多模态心脏图像分割的体素Transformer网络。它通过新颖的缩放特征金字塔（SFP）桥接单尺度3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器，解决混合网络的架构不匹配问题；采用掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练，并引入区域互信息（RMI）损失提升边界分割精度，在多个数据集上超越11种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 自动心脏图像分割对心脏疾病诊疗至关重要。现有混合网络（Transformer编码器+CNN解码器）存在单尺度编码器与多尺度解码器之间的架构不匹配问题，导致全局上下文信息难以被有效利用；同时多模态心脏分割（CT/MRI）与标注数据稀缺场景对模型提出了更高要求。
AI.method: 提出MCSeg体素Transformer网络，包含：(1) 新颖的缩放特征金字塔（SFP），区别于传统跳跃连接，将单尺度3D ViT编码器的输出转化为层级特征金字塔，从而桥接至多尺度CNN解码器；(2) 训练范式：ViT编码器先通过掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练，再在下游任务微调；(3) 微调阶段集成区域互信息（RMI）损失以改善边界分割精度。
AI.result: MCSeg在CT数据集ImageCHD、多模态数据集MM-WHS、MRI数据集HVSMR-2.0和MSD Heart上一致优于11种SOTA方法；在少样本实验中表现优异，展现出在数据有限场景下的适应潜力。代码与预训练ViT-B权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: MCSeg通过SFP有效解决混合网络架构不匹配问题，结合自监督预训练与RMI损失，在多模态心脏分割任务上达到了领先性能，并在少样本场景中展现出显著的应用潜力，为心脏分割提供了高效可靠的技术方案。
