summary: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion most clearly under DEMAND noise. The collapse and explosion degradation signatures previously reported for RVQ codecs concentrate in RVQ cells under white and DEMAND noise, respectively; explosion also occurs in non-VQ codecs, and single-codebook VQ codecs shift in occupancy and distribution shape without either signature. These results provide architecture-conditioned conventions for applying language-statistical analysis to NAC tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了13种神经音频编解码器（NAC）在干净、白噪声和真实DEMAND噪声三种条件下产生的离散token统计特征，使用Zipf/Heaps参数、单字熵、码本占用率和JSD等度量，发现语料库影响很小，而声学条件和量化器元类别起主导作用；RVQ码本在噪声下出现"坍缩/爆炸"退化特征，单码本VQ仅发生偏移，并据此为NAC token的语言统计分析了提供架构条件的约定。
AI.motivation: 神经音频编解码器（NAC）将语音转换为离散token序列，已有工作报道这些序列遵循类似语言的统计规律。然而缺乏对跨架构、跨噪声条件的系统性分析，不清楚架构类型（多码本RVQ、单码本VQ、非VQ）和声学条件如何影响这些语言统计指标及其退化特征。
AI.method: 对13种NAC（涵盖多码本残差矢量量化RVQ、单码本VQ和非VQ设计）在三个语料库上、三种声学条件（干净、白噪声、真实DEMAND噪声）下进行token统计分析。从匹配的token样本中估计Zipf与Heaps参数、单字熵、码本占用率及Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），并采用显式拟合有效性保障和族条件n-gram阶数。通过方差分析考察语料库、声学条件与量化器元类别对各度量的影响。
AI.result: 语料库身份对各度量几乎不解释方差，而声学条件与量化器元类别以度量相关的方式起主导作用；单字熵是与元类别关联最强的度量。在共同单字阶下计算的干净到噪声JSD与mel-cepstral失真在DEMAND噪声下关联最清晰。先前报道的RVQ"坍缩"和"爆炸"退化特征分别集中出现在白噪声和DEMAND噪声下的RVQ单元中；爆炸也出现在非VQ编解码器中，而单码本VQ仅发生占用率与分布形状的偏移，不存在上述任一特征。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果提供了按架构条件约定的NAC token语言统计分析规范，阐明不同量化器元类别在噪声条件下产生不同的token统计退化模式，为后续在该领域应用语言统计方法提供了架构感知的基准与指导。

title: ChessQueries: Toward Better Chess Board Recognition
summary: Chess board recognition is the task of mapping the image of a chess board to the information of which piece is on which square. So far this task has two established benchmarks: ChessCog is synthetic, and ChessReD comes from smartphone pictures of a single chess board setup. We introduce ChessQueries, a new method combining a ViT encoder with a DETR-style decoder, which outperforms existing methods. On the ChessReD benchmark, we improve the state of the art from 15.3% to 99.2%, and demonstrate strong capabilities on out-of-distribution datasets. Our method saturates the task on the two datasets, with an average 0.01 wrong squares per board (vs. SotA: 3.4 / 0.15 respectively). We also share a new, harder public dataset, parsed from broadcasted top-level chess tournaments. Code, model weights and the SLCC data will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChessQueries，一种结合 ViT 编码器与 DETR 风格解码器的国际象棋棋盘识别方法，在 ChessReD 基准上将 SOTA 从 15.3% 提升至 99.2%，每棋盘平均仅 0.01 个错误格子，并发布了更难的新数据集 SLCC（源自顶级赛事直播）。
AI.motivation: 国际象棋棋盘识别任务（将棋盘图像映射为各格子上的棋子信息）已有两个基准，但 ChessCog 为合成数据，ChessReD 仅来自单一棋盘设置的手机照片，现有方法性能有限（在 ChessReD 上 SOTA 仅 15.3%），且缺乏具有挑战性、接近真实场景（如直播赛事）的公共数据集。
AI.method: 提出 ChessQueries 方法，采用 ViT（Vision Transformer）编码器与 DETR 风格（基于 Transformer 的端到端检测）解码器相结合的网络架构，用于棋盘的端到端识别。
AI.result: 在 ChessReD 基准上将 SOTA 从 15.3% 提升至 99.2%；在 ChessCog 与 ChessReD 两个数据集上均达到饱和（每棋盘平均 0.01 个错误格子，对比 SOTA 分别为 3.4 和 0.15）；在分布外（OOD）数据集上展现出强泛化能力；此外发布了更难的公共数据集 SLCC（parsed from broadcasted top-level chess tournaments）。
AI.conclusion: ChessQueries 显著超越了现有棋盘识别方法并基本饱和现有两大基准，同时证明了其在分布外真实场景下的鲁棒性；作者将开源代码、模型权重以及新的 SLCC 数据集，以推动该任务的进一步研究。

title: Type-Balanced Contextual Learning for Incremental Named Entity Recognition
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Incremental Named Entity Recognition (INER) stands as a pivotal task in information extraction, emphasizing the successive identification of new entity types within unstructured text. Faced with the continuous influx of entity types, INER grapples with two significant challenges: the widespread issue of catastrophic forgetting and the unique shift issue of the non-entity type semantics. While pseudo-labeling-based INER methods have proven effective in addressing these challenges, a previously overlooked issue arises: the biased context problem. Our analysis shows that, in new sentences, the contextual associations of tokens representing old entity types exhibit a significantly stronger bias towards new entity types compared to their contexts in old sentences. This tendency intensifies the degradation of old knowledge while promoting the overfitting of new knowledge. To solve this biased context, we propose a Type-Balanced Contextual Learning (TBCL) method, featuring a sentence-duplet learning scheme and a contextual consistency loss. This approach offers a fresh perspective for INER through context analysis. Extensive experiments across ten INER settings on three highly recognized datasets showcase the efficacy of our TBCL method, highlighting its proficiency in resolving the biased context issue inherent in pseudo-labeling based INER approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文针对增量命名实体识别（INER）中伪标签方法存在的"偏置上下文"问题，提出了一种类型平衡上下文学习（TBCL）方法，包含句子对学习机制和上下文一致性损失，在三个公开数据集的十种INER设置上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: INER面临灾难性遗忘和非实体类型语义漂移两大挑战，伪标签方法虽有效但存在被忽视的偏置上下文问题：新句子中旧实体类型token的上下文关联显著偏向新实体类型，加剧旧知识退化并促进新知识过拟合。
AI.method: 提出类型平衡上下文学习（TBCL）方法，包含两个核心组件：句子对学习方案（sentence-duplet learning scheme）和上下文一致性损失（contextual consistency loss），通过上下文分析为INER提供新视角。
AI.result: 在三个高认可数据集上的十种INER设置中进行了广泛实验，证明了TBCL方法的有效性，展示了其在解决伪标签INER方法固有偏置上下文问题方面的能力。
AI.conclusion: TBCL通过上下文分析视角有效解决了INER中伪标签方法导致的偏置上下文问题，在缓解灾难性遗忘和防止新知识过拟合方面取得了显著成效。

title: CORAL: A Benchmark for Structure-aware and Brain-wide Neuron Reconstruction in Light Microscopy
summary: Automatic neuron reconstruction from light microscopy images is a central problem in computational neuroanatomy. While recent methods have achieved encouraging results on local image blocks, it remains unclear whether such progress translates to reconstruction that is both structurally accurate and scalable to the whole-brain scale. We present CORAL, the first benchmark for structure-aware evaluation of automatic neuron reconstruction from light microscopy images at both local and whole-brain scales. Built on a high-quality whole-brain fMOST dataset with carefully curated annotations, CORAL establishes two progressive tasks: block-level reconstruction, which evaluates reconstruction methods under limited spatial context, and brain-wide reconstruction, which assesses complete neuron reconstruction at the whole-brain scale. To account for topological correctness beyond geometric distance similarity, we introduce a structure-aware metric based on fiber prediction. To further achieve complete neuron reconstruction across the entire brain, we develop a brain-wide neuron tracing framework that extends arbitrary local reconstruction methods to the whole-brain scale through an iterative local-to-global process. Using this benchmark, we provide the first structure-aware comparison of mainstream methods for local neuron reconstruction and further evaluate their performance in brain-wide reconstruction. Our results underscore the importance of structure-aware evaluation and the need for more robust methods for complete neuron reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CORAL，这是首个面向光显微图像自动神经元重建的结构感知基准，涵盖局部（block）与全脑（brain-wide）两个尺度。基于高质量 fMOST 全脑数据集与精细标注，CORAL 设计了块级重建和全脑重建两个渐进任务，并引入基于纤维预测的结构感知指标来评估拓扑正确性。作者还开发了将任意局部重建方法扩展至全脑的迭代式局部到全局追踪框架，并在此基准上首次对主流方法进行了结构感知比较，结果显示结构感知评估的必要性及现有方法在全脑完整重建上的不足。
AI.motivation: 自动神经元重建是计算神经解剖学的核心问题，但现有方法大多只在局部图像块上取得较好结果，缺乏能同时兼顾结构准确性和全脑规模扩展性的评估手段，导致局部进展能否转化为全脑尺度的可靠重建仍是未解之谜。
AI.method: 构建基于高质量 fMOST 全脑数据集和精心标注的 CORAL 基准，设置块级重建与全脑重建两个渐进任务；提出基于纤维预测的结构感知评价指标以衡量拓扑正确性；并开发一种脑-wide 追踪框架，通过迭代的局部到全局过程将任意局部重建方法扩展至全脑尺度。
AI.result: 在该基准上完成了对主流局部重建方法的首次结构感知比较，并评估了它们在脑-wide 重建中的表现；结果表明结构感知评估至关重要，同时现有方法在完整神经元重建方面仍需更鲁棒的方案。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知评估应成为神经元重建的标配；现有方法的性能尚未达到全脑完整重建的要求，需要进一步发展更稳健的重建方法，CORAL 可为该方向提供标准化测试平台。

title: Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries
summary: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820 optimized questions to support a broader shift in information extraction research toward treating question design as a first-class problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在信息抽取失败时不应只优化抽取模型，还应优化提问设计。作者提出LoQ（针对文档生成特定问题集）和FeedQ（基于抽取结果的反馈驱动迭代优化方法），仅改进问题设计即在四个临床基准和五个LLM上提升18.6个F1点，超过使用更大抽取模型的收益；微调后的4B参数轻量模型可匹配或超越专家基线，并大幅超过更大的未调优模型。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为信息抽取失败应归因于抽取模型本身（如扩大规模或改进推理），但作者指出查询（问题设计）同样是影响抽取性能的关键环节，且往往被忽视。已有研究中问题设计多为手工或启发式，缺乏系统化、可学习的方法，因此需要将问题设计作为一等公民来对待。
AI.method: (1) List of Questions (LoQ)：为每个文档生成文档特定的问题集合； (2) FeedQ：一种反馈驱动的优化方法，根据抽取结果迭代地精炼问题； (3) 利用优化后的问题训练轻量级问题生成器，并通过微调使4B参数模型达到专家级基线水平； (4) 发布包含12,820条优化问题的数据集以支持后续研究。
AI.result: 在四个临床基准和五个LLM上，仅改进问题设计便提升18.6个F1分数点，收益大于使用更大抽取模型；经微调后，4B参数模型匹配或超越专家衍生基线，并显著超过更大的未调优模型。
AI.conclusion: 问题设计是信息抽取管道中与模型同等甚至更重要的环节，应被当作一等的、可学习的研究问题处理；通过反馈驱动的自动优化和轻量级生成器训练，可以在不依赖更大模型的情况下显著提升抽取性能，并推动信息抽取研究范式向重视问题设计转变。

title: PixelIR: Fidelity-Perception Decoupling via Pixel-Space Image-Residual Flow Matching for Efficient One-Step Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) aims to preserve structures supported by the degraded observation while reconstructing perceptually realistic details. However, existing Real-ISR methods largely optimize fidelity and perceptual quality within a shared network, causing the two objectives to interfere throughout training and making their balance difficult to control. Recent one-step methods reduce sampling steps, yet often inherit both this coupled optimization behavior and the expensive high-resolution backbone of their multi-step predecessors. We argue that efficient Real-ISR requires not only a shorter sampling trajectory, but also specialized modeling of faithful reconstruction and perceptual detail synthesis. Based on this insight, we propose PixelIR, a fidelity-perception decoupling framework built upon pixel-space image-residual flow matching. PixelIR first learns an image flow that maps the degraded observation to a faithful reconstruction. Then, a residual flow synthesizes the missing perceptual details from noise without repeatedly relearning or overwriting the complete restoration solution. We further distill the teacher into a deployment-oriented one-step student within a coarse-to-fine pyramid architecture. Extensive experiments show that PixelIR achieves leading PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on both RealSR and DRealSR. The final model completes pixel-space restoration in a single evaluation with only 32.9M parameters, 89.7G MACs, and 8.5ms latency, demonstrating a strong practical fidelity-perception-efficiency balance.

AI.tldr: PixelIR 是一个面向真实图像超分辨率的保真度-感知解耦框架，基于像素空间图像-残差流匹配。它先学习图像流将退化观测映射为忠实重建，再用残差流从噪声合成缺失的感知细节，并通过粗到细金字塔架构蒸馏出单步学生模型，在 RealSR 和 DRealSR 上取得领先的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，同时仅需 32.9M 参数、89.7G MACs 和 8.5ms 延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有 Real-ISR 方法在共享网络内同时优化保真度和感知质量，导致两个目标在训练中相互干扰、平衡难以控制；一步式方法虽减少采样步数，但继承了耦合优化行为和昂贵的超高分辨率骨干。作者认为高效的 Real-ISR 不仅需要更短的采样轨迹，还需要对忠实重建和感知细节合成进行专门建模。
AI.method: 提出基于像素空间图像-残差流匹配的保真度-感知解耦框架 PixelIR。首先学习图像流将退化观测映射为忠实重建，随后残差流从噪声合成缺失的感知细节，而无需重复学习或覆盖完整恢复解。最后在粗到细金字塔架构中将教师模型蒸馏为面向部署的一步学生模型。
AI.result: 在 RealSR 和 DRealSR 基准上，PixelIR 在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 指标上均达到领先水平。最终模型以单次评估完成像素空间恢复，仅用 32.9M 参数、89.7G MACs 和 8.5ms 延迟，实现了强实用的保真度-感知-效率平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了将保真重建与感知细节合成解耦建模是高效 Real-ISR 的关键，流匹配与知识蒸馏的结合可在降低计算开销的同时兼顾两种目标，展示了实际部署的可行性。

title: Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. Building on this view, we propose \textsc{MIST} (Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression), which defines token importance along two complementary axes: \emph{necessity}, the drop in answer likelihood when a token's internal contribution is removed, and \emph{sufficiency}, the gain in answer likelihood when that contribution alone is provided. Combining the two yields a unified importance score for pruning. Across four reasoning benchmarks and four models, \textsc{MIST} consistently outperforms baseline methods, suggesting that model-internal saliency provides an effective proxy for reasoning-token importance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出模型内部显著性方法 MIST（Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression），通过在残差流（即“思维流”）中测量每个推理 token 对答案计算产生的“涟漪”幅度，从必要性与充分性两个互补维度定义 token 重要性，并融合为统一重要性分数用于 CoT 压缩剪枝，在四个推理基准和四个模型上持续优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 链式思维（CoT）推理虽能提升多步问题求解能力，但冗长的推理轨迹显著增加推理成本。现有 token 级 CoT 压缩方法依赖外部评分器或仅与被模型内部答案计算间接相关的启发式信号，token 选择成为核心难题。作者希望从模型内部视角出发，更直接地度量每个推理 token 对答案计算的贡献，以提升压缩质量。
AI.method: MIST 采用模型内部视角：当模型形成答案时，每个推理 token 都会在残差流（即模型的“思维流”）中留下“涟漪”，该涟漪的幅度反映了 token 对答案计算的贡献。MIST 沿两条互补轴定义 token 重要性：必要性与充分性。必要性衡量移除某 token 的内部贡献后答案似然度的下降幅度；充分性衡量仅提供该 token 的贡献时答案似然度的增益。二者结合得到统一的剪枝重要性分数。
AI.result: 在四个推理基准和四个模型上，MIST 一致地优于基线方法，表明模型内部显著性可作为推理 token 重要性的有效代理，在显著压缩推理链的同时保持推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部残差流的 saliency 信号为 token 级 CoT 压缩提供了比外部评分器或启发式信号更直接、更有效的依据；必要性-充分性的双轴框架为推理 token 重要性估计提供了统一且稳健的度量方式。

title: Camera trap classification with deep learning under ground truth uncertainty
summary: Supervised deep learning methods enable the rapid processing of ecological image data, but depend on a costly annotation process. Consequently, training labels are commonly derived from volunteer citizen science projects. However, disagreement among volunteers introduces uncertainty in the "ground truth" data that are assumed to be correct for model training and validation. Using two datasets containing camera trap images with associated volunteer and expert classifications, we investigated the effects of training under higher ground truth uncertainty. We observed improved overall test accuracy, particularly for images that were more difficult for volunteers. Species-level accuracy also generally improved, but generalisation to a different dataset did not. The benefits of ground truth uncertainty were enhanced by pre-training on ImageNet. Pre-training also reduced the number of training epochs required; further reductions in computational cost, but not gains in accuracy, resulted from additional pre-training on other camera trap images. With unbalanced training data, we still observed a clear benefit of increased ground truth uncertainty for overall accuracy, especially on difficult images. Class imbalance improved accuracy for common species, reduced rare species accuracy, and changed patterns of misclassification to more closely resemble mistakes made by volunteers. Our findings have implications for applying deep learning across ecological image types with multiple labels. Practitioners can improve accuracy, especially on difficult examples, by including moderate levels of label disagreement during training and using models pre-trained on general image data. In addition to improving the use of citizen science-derived labels in model training, our study suggests avenues for more effectively integrating human and deep learning classifications in combined workflows. (abridged)

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在公民科学项目产生的带有标签分歧（不确定性的"真实标签"）数据上训练深度学习模型的效果，发现适度引入标签不确定性可提升整体测试精度（尤其对志愿者认为困难的图像），但会损害跨数据集泛化能力；ImageNet预训练可增强此收益并减少训练轮次。
AI.motivation: 生态图像数据的监督式深度学习依赖昂贵的人工标注，因此常用公民科学志愿者的标注作为训练标签；但志愿者之间存在分歧，导致"真实标签"充满不确定性，而传统训练和验证假设这些标签是正确无误的。作者希望探究在这种高不确定性真实标签下进行训练的影响。
AI.method: 使用两个包含相机陷阱图像及对应的志愿者与专家分类的数据集，通过控制训练标签的不确定性水平来训练模型；同时检验ImageNet预训练、额外的相机陷阱图像预训练以及非平衡训练数据对结果的影响，并评估物种级精度、跨数据集泛化与误分类模式。
AI.result: 引入更高的真实标签不确定性提升了整体测试精度，尤其对志愿者难以辨认的图像；物种级精度总体改善，但对不同数据集的泛化变差。ImageNet预训练增强了该收益并减少了训练轮数，额外相机陷阱图像预训练进一步降低计算成本但不提升精度。在非平衡数据下，不确定性仍对整体精度有利（尤其困难图像），类不平衡提升常见物种精度、降低稀有物种精度，并使误分类模式更接近志愿者的错误。
AI.conclusion: 从业人员可通过在训练中纳入适度水平的标签分歧并采用基于通用图像数据的预训练模型来提高精度，尤其对困难样本；研究为更好地利用公民科学标签、以及在混合工作流中整合人类与深度学习分类提供了指导。

title: Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents
summary: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).

AI.tldr: AutoSciRub 是一个"评估优先"（evaluation-first）框架，通过在执行科学研究任务之前生成任务特定的可执行评分细则（rubric），将模糊的开放式研究指令分解为原子科学目标，并用于指导执行、准则级验证和迭代修订。实验表明，该框架在 ResearchClawBench 和 AstaBench E2E Discovery 等基准上，跨多种骨干 LLM 和智能体框架均带来一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 开放式科学研究任务通常不会明确指定所需的分析、方法和成功标准，导致自主科研智能体可能遗漏重要分析、使用不恰当的方法，或得出缺乏证据充分支持的结论。
AI.method: AutoSciRub 是一个评估优先框架：在执行研究之前先诱导出任务特定的可执行评分细则，再用其指导执行、准则级验证以及迭代修订。具体地，它将欠指定的指令分解为原子科学目标，在相关文献和任务可见数据上进行落地（grounding），并综合出具体、可操作且可验证的准则。在修订阶段，细则引导的验证识别未满足的准则，从而对研究报告及其支撑产物进行针对性改进。
AI.result: 在 ResearchClawBench 上，AutoSciRub 在所有测试配置下均取得一致提升：在固定 Codex 框架下三种骨干 LLM 平均提升 2.08 分，在固定 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 骨干下三种智能体框架平均提升 2.95 分；在 AstaBench E2E Discovery 随机抽样的 20 任务子集上，三种智能体框架平均提升 16.8 分，同时保持或增加了成功完成的任务数量。
AI.conclusion: 评估优先的指导（evaluation-first guidance）为自主科学研究提供了一种有效且可泛化的控制机制，能够将隐含的实验与证据要求显式化，显著提升开放研究任务中智能体的表现。

title: A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation models have emerged as state-of-the-art methods for downstream Earth observation tasks. However, existing pretraining methodologies process imagery through a single-concept lens, failing to capture the highly compositional nature of complex satellite scenes. We propose a composition-aware pretraining framework that explicitly encodes fractional land-cover mixtures. Each satellite image cell is mapped to a histogram representing its fractional land-cover distribution, which we term the "composition target". These targets serve as the primary prediction objective and are distilled into the backbone using Earth Mover's Distance. Experimental evaluation shows that composition-aware pretraining yields substantial gains on region-level understanding tasks requiring semantic similarity judgment, including zero-shot image retrieval and scene classification, while remaining competitive on tasks requiring fine-grained spatial precision, such as segmentation and object detection. With a 36.8M-parameter backbone, our framework outperforms SatMAE and Prithvi-EO-2.0, which contain 303M and 600M parameters, respectively, in most retrieval and scene classification settings. On the fine-grained ForestNet-12 dataset, a rigorous testbed for compositional discrimination, our method boosts baseline mAP@10 from 0.279 to 0.434, a 55.6% relative improvement, providing direct evidence for the effectiveness of explicit composition modeling. The code implementation can be found at https://github.com/05kashyap/GFM_Composition_Pretraining

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向地理空间基础模型的成分感知预训练框架，通过将每个卫星图像单元映射为表示地物成分分布直方图的"composition target"，并利用推土机距离（Earth Mover's Distance）将其蒸馏到骨干网络中，显式建模卫星场景中复杂的混合地物组成，从而在下游任务（尤其是区域级语义理解）中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间基础模型的预训练方法仅通过单一概念视角处理影像，无法捕捉复杂卫星场景的高度组合性（compositional）特征，即一个像元或区域往往包含多种地物类别的混合。这种单一概念的预训练范式限制了模型对区域级语义相似性的判别能力，因此需要一种能够显式编码混合地物组成（fractional land-cover）的预训练方法。
AI.method: 提出成分感知（composition-aware）预训练框架：1) 将每个卫星图像单元映射为表示其地物成分分布（fractional land-cover distribution）的直方图，称为"composition target"；2) 将这一成分目标作为主要预测目标，利用推土机距离（Earth Mover's Distance）作为损失函数将成分信息蒸馏到骨干网络的特征表示中。
AI.result: 实验表明：成分感知预训练在区域级理解任务（零样本图像检索、场景分类）上带来显著提升，同时在高空间精度任务（分割、目标检测）上保持竞争力。仅36.8M参数的框架在多数检索和场景分类设置中优于含303M参数的SatMAE和600M参数的Prithvi-EO-2.0。在强调成分区分的ForestNet-12数据集上，基线mAP@10从0.279提升至0.434，相对提升55.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式成分建模对地理空间基础模型是有效的：将分数地物组成作为预训练目标，能以极小的参数量获得超越更大规模模型在区域级理解任务上的性能，为"组合性"遥感场景的表征学习提供了直接证据。

title: The First Token Is a Clue: Verbalizing Multi-Token Concepts from the J-lens
summary: The Jacobian Lens (J-lens) is a recent tool for interpreting LLMs. It reads a hidden state as a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, leaving multi-token concepts without a representation of their own. The original J-lens work addresses this limitation with Template Lens, which precomputes vectors for a fixed phrase vocabulary, and Oracle Lens, which fine-tunes components to propose phrases and reconstruct phrase vectors. We ask whether multi-token concepts and their vectors can instead be recovered directly from J-lens and the frozen model. We find that the first token of a multi-token concept is about as readable as a single-token concept. Given the correct first token and source prompt, the frozen model recovers the second token in 88.3% of two-token cases. We show that a vector for the complete concept can be recovered from subsequent hidden states in a single forward pass. We therefore use J-lens to propose first tokens and let the frozen model complete candidate concepts. We then recover a vector for each candidate and score it alongside the complete vocabulary. Across 496 multi-hop clozes on Gemma-3-12B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-14B, our method achieves an average $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ of 43.1%, compared with 27.6% for Template Lens. Without the J-lens clue, performance drops to 21.6%, showing that the first-token clue substantially improves readout. Causal concept swaps using the recovered vectors achieve an average $\mathrm{succ}@10$ of 61.4%, compared with 26.2% for Template Lens under the same intervention. These results show that first-token clues can guide multi-token concept recovery, while subsequent hidden states provide vectors for readout and intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需微调、仅利用冻结模型与Jacobian Lens（J-lens）的隐状态恢复多词元（multi-token）概念及其向量的方法：先用J-lens读取第一个词元作为线索，再由冻结模型自动补全候选概念，并从后续隐状态中恢复完整概念向量用于读出与干预，在多个模型上显著优于Template Lens。
AI.motivation: J-lens虽然能将隐状态解读为按词汇表排序的词元列表，但无法为多词元概念提供独立表示；此前的Template Lens需预计算固定短语向量，Oracle Lens则需微调组件，二者都有额外成本或灵活性限制。作者想知道能否在不微调、不预计算的情况下，直接从J-lens和冻结模型中恢复多词元概念及其向量。
AI.method: 作者首先验证多词元概念的首个词元与单token概念同样可读；给定正确首token和源提示，冻结模型在88.3%的双token情形下恢复出第二个token。随后利用J-lens提出首token候选，让冻结模型补全候选概念，再在单次前向传播中从后续隐状态恢复每个候选概念的向量，并将其与完整词汇表一同打分。
AI.result: 在Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-14B上的496个多跳完形任务中，该方法平均Rank@10达43.1%，而Template Lens为27.6%；去掉J-lens线索后降至21.6%，说明首token线索显著提升读出。使用恢复向量进行因果概念替换时，平均succ@10为61.4%，而Template Lens在相同干预下为26.2%。
AI.conclusion: 首token线索能够有效引导多token概念的恢复，而后续隐状态则可提供用于读出和干预的概念向量；这证明无需训练或预计算即可从冻结模型中恢复多词元概念，为LLM解读提供了一种更灵活、更通用的工具。

title: RealOOB: A Definition-Consistent Real-World Oriented Occlusion Boundary Benchmark
summary: Occlusion boundaries (OBs) are pixel-level image boundaries corresponding to surface visibility discontinuities caused by occlusion. Through precise boundary localisation and occlusion orientation, OBs encode local surface layout and depth ordering, providing geometry-driven mid-level cues for scene understanding. However, progress in pixel-level OB estimation has been limited by fragmented supervision: Existing benchmarks often suffer from limited coverage, category-specific designs, missing self-occlusion annotations, or inconsistent annotation definitions. Meanwhile, modern edge detectors and monocular depth estimators have become strong boundary and geometry predictors, yet their relationship to definition-consistent OBs remains underexplored. We introduce RealOOB, a carefully annotated real-world benchmark with 4.26M definition-consistent, geometry-grounded OB labels covering both inter-object and self-occlusion boundaries, together with validity-aware occlusion-orientation maps that restrict supervision to pixels whose cross-boundary depth ordering is reliably measurable. Based on RealOOB, we evaluate forty OB estimators and edge detectors alongside six monocular depth estimators. Our evaluation reveals a clear gap in occlusion reasoning: modern edge detectors perform competitively with OB methods in localisation, whereas orientation prediction remains challenging for all evaluated methods. Meanwhile, even strong depth estimators often fail to exhibit measurable geometry at true OBs. We believe RealOOB provides a strong reference benchmark for the OB estimation community and a real-world testbed for assessing depth discontinuities and geometry fidelity in broader low-level vision tasks. Dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RealOOB，一个包含426万个定义一致、几何驱动的真实世界遮挡边界（OB）标注基准，覆盖物体间与自遮挡边界，并附带有效性感知的遮挡方向图。基于该基准评估了40种OB/边缘检测器与6种单目深度估计器，发现边缘检测器在定位上与OB方法相当，但方向预测对所有方法仍是难点，且深度估计器在真实OB处缺乏可测的几何信息。
AI.motivation: 遮挡边界作为像素级的中层几何线索对场景理解至关重要，但其估计进展受制于碎片化的监督：现有基准存在覆盖有限、类别特定设计、缺少自遮挡标注、标注定义不一致等问题。同时，现代边缘检测器与单目深度估计器已成为强大的边界和几何预测器，但它们与定义一致的遮挡边界之间的关系尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建RealOOB真实世界基准，提供4.26M条定义一致、几何驱动的遮挡边界标注，同时覆盖物体间遮挡与自遮挡边界；设计有效性感知的遮挡方向图，将监督限制在跨边界深度排序可可靠测量的像素上。基于该基准系统评估了40种遮挡边界/边缘估计器以及6种单目深度估计器，并对定位精度与方向预测进行对比分析。
AI.result: 评估发现遮挡推理存在明显差距：现代边缘检测器在边界定位上与专门的OB方法表现相当，但遮挡方向预测对所有被评估方法都具挑战性；此外，即使是强大的深度估计器也常在真实遮挡边界处缺乏可测量的几何准确度。
AI.conclusion: RealOOB为遮挡边界估计社区提供了强参考基准，并可作为评估深度不连续性与几何保真度的真实世界测试平台，有望推动定义一致的遮挡推理研究和低层视觉任务的几何质量评估。

title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. It therefore remains unclear whether an agent can actively test its behavior, judge the resulting experience, and use that experience to improve future decisions. We introduce \textbf{S\textsuperscript{3}Gym}, an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities: \textbf{Self-Testing}, \textbf{Self-Judging}, and \textbf{Self-Improvement}. S$^3$Gym separates permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation and instantiates this protocol in seven text-based games with executable environment verifiers. We evaluate three pathways for incorporating interaction experience: direct History ICL, score-conditioned Summary Memory, and parameter Training.
  Our experiments reveal that self-improvement is neither automatic nor uniform. Context-level experience improves performance for several model--game pairs, but the most effective pathway depends strongly on the task structure: summaries are beneficial when experience can be compressed into reusable strategic rules, yet often underperform raw history when success depends on precise, state-contingent information. Parameter training produces substantial gains on some tasks, but also exhibits unstable improvement and severe negative transfer on others. These findings show that recognizing successful actions is insufficient; agents must also transform feedback into executable and transferable policies. S$^3$Gym provides a unified framework for diagnosing this process and identifying the bottlenecks that prevent agents from translating interaction experience into reliable self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 S³Gym，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体自我改进能力的交互式基准。该基准围绕三个耦合能力（自我测试、自我评判、自我改进）设计，将宽松的探索环境与严格的留出评估分离，并在七个可执行环境验证器的文字游戏中实例化。实验比较了历史上下文 ICL、得分条件摘要记忆和参数训练三条经验整合路径，发现自我改进既非自动也非统一，最优路径高度依赖任务结构，且存在不稳定改进与严重负迁移现象，表明智能体必须将反馈转化为可执行、可迁移的策略。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准大多将 LLM 作为固定策略进行评估，忽视了其在真实交互中不断积累行为经验的事实。因此，一个关键问题悬而未决：智能体能否主动测试自己的行为、评判经验结果，并利用这些经验改进未来的决策。为回答这一问题，需要一个能够系统评估 LLM 自我改进全过程的基准框架。
AI.method: 作者引入 S³Gym 基准，通过三个耦合能力（Self-Testing、Self-Judging、Self-Improvement）评估自我改进。协议设计上将宽松的（permissive）探索与严格的留出（held-out）评估相分离，并在七个具有可执行环境验证器的文字游戏中实例化。同时设计并评估三条整合交互经验的路径：直接历史 ICL（History ICL）、基于得分条件的摘要记忆（Score-conditioned Summary Memory）以及参数训练（Parameter Training）。
AI.result: 实验表明自我改进既非自动也非均匀。上下文级经验能提升部分模型-任务组合的性能，但最优路径取决于任务结构：当经验可压缩为可复用策略规则时摘要更有效，而当成功依赖精确的状态条件信息时摘要常不如原始历史。参数训练在部分任务上带来显著增益，但也表现出不稳定改进，并在其他任务上出现严重负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 识别成功行动本身并不足以实现自我改进；智能体还必须将反馈转化为可执行且可迁移的策略。S³Gym 提供了一个统一框架，用于诊断这一转化过程，并识别阻碍智能体将交互经验转化为可靠自我改进的瓶颈。

title: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
summary: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. Existing pipelines decompose the task into three steps---parse the observations into instances, generate an asset for each, and place each asset back---but every step presumes an input that a cluttered capture rarely provides: accurate instance geometry, unoccluded views, and assets that accurately match the observations. We propose Lucida, which keeps this order but redistributes the requirements, so each step consumes only what a real capture reliably provides and precision is reached at the end of the pipeline rather than demanded at its start. Lucida parses the video into a scene graph whose nodes carry per-instance multi-view evidence, generates a complete asset for each instance from its evidence, and places assets with GizmoAct, a VLM policy that casts placement as multi-turn GUI interaction, manipulating the object's gizmo in a closed loop and deciding itself when alignment is reached. Across scene-level 3D object detection, object pose estimation, and scene reconstruction, Lucida improves mAP over Boxer by 69% on R2S-Scene, raises ADD-SB@0.05 from 57.8% to 83.4% on CA-1M, and increases scene F-Score from 0.794 for SAM3D to 0.924.

AI.tldr: 提出 Lucida，一种可组合场景建模框架，将“解析实例—生成资产—放置资产”的三步流程重新分配需求，使每步只依赖真实抓拍可靠提供的信息，并通过场景图、逐实例多视角证据生成与基于 VLM 的 GizmoAct 放置策略，在场景级检测、位姿估计和场景重建上均显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有可组合场景建模管线假设每个步骤都能获得杂乱扫描很少能提供的输入：准确的实例几何、无遮挡视图以及与观测精确匹配的资产，导致在真实场景中难以成立。因此需要重新分配各步骤的要求，让精度在管线末端达成而非在起点就强求。
AI.method: Lucida 保持“解析—生成—放置”的顺序但重新分配需求。它将视频解析为场景图，节点携带逐实例的多视角证据；随后从每个实例的证据生成完整资产；最后用 GizmoAct（一种 VLM 策略）将放置建模为多轮 GUI 交互，闭环操纵物体的 gizmo，并由策略自行决定对齐是否达成。
AI.result: Lucida 在 R2S-Scene 上场景级 3D 目标检测 mAP 较 Boxer 提升 69%；在 CA-1M 上 ADD-SB@0.05 从 57.8% 提升至 83.4%；场景重建 F-Score 从 SAM3D 的 0.794 提升至 0.924。
AI.conclusion: 通过把精度要求转移到管线末端而非各步骤起点，Lucida 能以杂乱视频捕获为输入完成高精度的可编辑场景重建，在检测、位姿与重建三项指标上均取得大幅提升，验证了重新分配管线需求这一思路的有效性。

title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
summary: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPIRE, a benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution. ASPIRE provides only a natural-language capability goal while downstream evaluation tasks remain hidden. The agent must operationalize the goal by choosing data and update methods, constructing training and validation signals, and deciding when to evaluate. ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals. Our experiments show that vague goals redirect search effort toward goal interpretation. Current agents routinely complete training and harness-editing loops, but weight-level gains remain sparse and unstable, and the strongest evolved harness remains below the engineered Qwen-Agent reference. Agents often train on mismatched data and trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation and continued search and training can erase earlier improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ASPIRE，一个以模糊自然语言能力目标驱动的 LLM 自进化基准测试。与现有工作依赖人类指定任务和指标不同，ASPIRE 只给智能体一个模糊目标（如"成为更好的物理学家"），隐藏下游评测任务，要求智能体自行解读目标、选择数据与更新方法、构建训练和验证信号并决定何时评测。在 520 个专家撰写、覆盖 6 个目标的隐藏评测上，实验发现当前智能体普遍在目标解读上浪费搜索，权重级收益稀疏且不稳定，最强进化出的 harness 仍低于工程化 Qwen-Agent 基线，局部收益难以迁移且持续搜索会抹去已有进步。
AI.motivation: 人类学习常始于模糊目标（如"改进研究能力"），需要自行解读目标、识别能力缺口、决定学习方法并判断是否进步；而现有 LLM 自进化工作通常由人类预先指定任务和评测指标，把自进化退化为优化显式目标，忽略了"学什么、怎么学"的决策过程。
AI.method: 设计 ASPIRE 基准：仅提供自然语言能力目标，隐藏下游评测任务；智能体需在统一交互式环境中自主完成目标操作化（选择数据与更新方法、构建训练/验证信号、决定评测时机），支持模型权重进化和智能体 harness 进化两种模式；最终在专家撰写、涵盖六个目标的 520 个隐藏条目上评测。
AI.result: 实验表明模糊目标会把搜索努力引向目标解读：现有智能体能完成训练与 harness 编辑循环，但权重级收益稀疏且不稳定；最强进化 harness 仍低于工程化的 Qwen-Agent 基线；智能体常在不匹配数据上训练并过度信任狭窄的自评，导致局部收益无法迁移到隐藏评测，持续搜索与训练甚至会抹除早期改进。
AI.conclusion: ASPIRE 揭示了当前 LLM 自进化在"模糊目标驱动"场景下的关键短板——目标诠释、数据匹配、自评可靠性与持续学习的稳定性均不足；该基准为未来研究提供了可复现的评测环境，呼吁更稳健的自我评估与学习决策机制。

title: Whole-Body MRI Classification via Prompt-Based Clinical Conditioning
summary: Combining whole-body magnetic resonance imaging (WB-MRI) with clinical variables has the potential to improve systemic disease diagnosis by leveraging complementary sources of patient information. However, structured clinical variables are often incomplete or missing, limiting the applicability of conventional multimodal fusion methods that assume fixed inputs. In this work, we propose TACTIC (Tabular-Attribute Conditioned Transformer for Image Classification), a prompt-based multimodal framework that integrates WB-MRI and structured clinical data through conditional visual feature learning. By encoding clinical attributes as prompts, TACTIC supports an arbitrary number of tabular inputs and naturally handles missing data without requiring imputation or fixed input structures. We evaluate TACTIC on five WB-MRI classification tasks spanning systemic and oncologic applications, including diabetes, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), breast cancer, prostate cancer, and metastasis diagnosis. Across all tasks, TACTIC consistently improves performance over image-only baselines when clinical information is available while maintaining strong predictive capability under incomplete tabular inputs. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-based models as a flexible approach for improving WB-MRI analysis using clinical context. The model weights and code are available at https://github.com/lauradaza/TACTIC

AI.tldr: 提出 TACTIC（Tabular-Attribute Conditioned Transformer for Image Classification），一种基于提示（prompt）的多模态框架，将全身磁共振成像（WB-MRI）与结构化临床数据整合。通过将临床属性编码为提示词，TACTIC 支持任意数量的表格输入并自然处理缺失数据，无需插补或固定输入结构。在糖尿病、慢阻肺、乳腺癌、前列腺癌和转移瘤诊断五项 WB-MRI 分类任务中，TACTIC 在临床信息可用时均优于仅图像基线，并在表格输入不完整时保持强预测能力。
AI.motivation: WB-MRI 与临床变量的结合有望通过利用互补的患者信息改善全身性疾病诊断，但结构化临床变量往往不完整或缺失，限制了假设固定输入的传统多模态融合方法的适用性。因此需要一个能灵活处理任意数量表格输入及缺失数据的融合框架。
AI.method: 提出基于提示的多模态框架 TACTIC，通过将临床属性编码为提示（prompt）来实现条件视觉特征学习，从而整合 WB-MRI 与结构化临床数据，天然支持任意数量的表格输入并在无插补或固定输入结构的条件下处理缺失数据。
AI.result: 在糖尿病、慢阻肺、乳腺癌、前列腺癌和转移瘤诊断五项 WB-MRI 分类任务上，TACTIC 在临床信息可用时相较于仅图像基线持续提升性能，并在表格输入不完整时仍保持较强的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于提示的模型是一种灵活的、利用临床上下文改进 WB-MRI 分析的有效方法。模型权重与代码已公开于 GitHub。

title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/PaperGym. Project page: https://zju-real.github.io/PaperGym. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CabbageWyh/PaperGym-Data. Model: https://huggingface.co/CabbageWyh/PaperGym-Model
summary: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privileged context for OPSD's self-teacher, then as the reward for GRPO. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, this schedule outperforms supervised fine-tuning, either stage alone, and the reverse ordering, improving five-benchmark averages by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points. With the recipe held fixed, models trained on PaperGym-20k win 58.1% of three-way comparisons, against 28.2% for RubricHub Science. The trained Qwen3-8B reaches 73.48 on ResearchQA, above the far larger Kimi K2.6. We release the pipeline, the 20,000-instance corpus PaperGym-20k, and the benchmarks PaperGym-Innov and PaperGym-Design.

AI.tldr: PaperGym 是一个将科研论文转化为完整强化学习训练环境的统一框架：从论文的研究目标与背景合成问题、从方法与实验部分推导评估准则（rubric），解决了以往数据集中"问题与准则同源导致可通过改写获得奖励"的漏洞，并将准则泄漏率降至 3.7%。训练采用两阶段使用 rubric 的调度（先作为 OPSD 自教师的特权上下文，再作为 GRPO 的奖励），在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 上全面优于 SFT、单阶段或反向排序，五基准平均分提升 +5.6/+5.0/+4.8，训练出的 Qwen3-8B 在 ResearchQA 上达到 73.48，超过更大的 Kimi K2.6。
AI.motivation: 研究规划是 AI 科学家的决定性能力，但研究计划没有可验证的答案，导致强化学习缺乏"任务+评判器"配对的训练环境。现有方案虽然能利用论文提取的 rubric 充当评判器，但存在两个致命缺陷：(1) 问题与评估准则来自同一内容，模型可通过改写/复述原论文而骗取奖励；(2) rubric 被压缩为每次 rollout 的单一标量，信息大量丢失。
AI.method: PaperGym 利用论文的结构化信息构建训练环境：问题由研究目标与背景合成，评估准则由方法与实验部分推导，准则覆盖方法论创新性与实验设计两个维度，使准则与问题解耦。训练阶段将 rubric 使用两次：先作为 OPSD 自教师的特权上下文辅助生成，再作为 GRPO 的奖励信号进行强化学习。该两阶段调度与数据构建流程共同构成完整框架。
AI.result: 准则泄漏率降至 3.7%，远低于现有数据集的 11.90%–34.10%。在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 上，该训练调度优于监督微调、任一单独阶段及反向顺序，五基准平均分分别提升 +5.6、+5.0、+4.8。固定训练配方下，PaperGym-20k 训练的模型在三方对比中胜率 58.1%，而 RubricHub Science 仅 28.2%。Qwen3-8B 在 ResearchQA 上取得 73.48 分，超过参数量远大于它的 Kimi K2.6。
AI.conclusion: PaperGym 验证了"rubric 双重使用"训练调度在数据泄漏抑制与科研规划能力提升上的有效性，并发布了完整训练流水线、包含 2 万实例的语料库 PaperGym-20k 以及两个基准 PaperGym-Innov 与 PaperGym-Design，为该方向提供了可复现的开源基础设施。

title: Reliable Benchmarking of Artifact Detection in Computational Pathology: A Reproducibility and Uncertainty Analysis
summary: Background and Objective: Quality control is a prerequisite for whole-slide image analysis, yet the benchmarks on which quality-control methods are compared share four properties that make their reported differences hard to interpret: few independent slides, annotation concentrated in a minority of them, pooled ratio metrics with no closed-form standard error, and a single inherited train/test partition. We propose a reliability protocol for such benchmarks. Methods: The protocol quantifies four sources of variability - test-set sampling, training stochasticity, partition composition, and undocumented preprocessing - a claim is reportable only if it survives all four; three of the four cost minutes of compute. We apply it to an independent reconstruction of a published diffusion-based artifact detector, evaluated on the original 24-slide partition and against a supervised baseline. Results: The method's central mechanism reproduces: the auxiliary contrastive term improves pooled F1 from 0.673 to 0.688 and replicates under a second seed (+0.0156, p = 0.031; +0.0190, p = 0.005), although it acts on pen marking rather than the artifact types cited to motivate it. Its comparative claims do not: differences between design variants, and against the supervised baseline, fall inside the uncertainty of the evaluation. Four of 24 slides carry 70% of scored annotated pixels, giving an effective sample size of 6.2, and the inherited partition sits at the 7th percentile. An unreported tissue-restriction step excludes 41.4% of out-of-focus annotation against 2.6% of air bubble; such a gate is confounded with blur by construction. Conclusions: Small-cohort benchmarks support far weaker conclusions than current reporting implies. The four checks are cheap enough to accompany any evaluation on such a resource and separate reproducible effects from differences the evaluation cannot resolve.

AI.tldr: 针对全切片图像分析中质量控制方法的基准评测，提出一个可靠性协议，量化测试集采样、训练随机性、划分组成和未记录预处理四类变异来源；通过复现一个扩散模型伪影检测器证明，其核心机制可复现但比较性结论在评测不确定性之内，表明小队列基准仅能支撑远弱于当前报告方式的结论。
AI.motivation: 现有的全切片图像（WSI）质量控制方法基准存在四个共同缺陷：独立切片数量少、标注集中于少数切片、使用无闭合形式标准误的合并比率指标、以及单一继承的train/test划分。这些特性使各方法之间报告的差异难以解释，因此需要一套评估此类基准可靠性的协议。
AI.method: 提出一个可靠性协议，量化四类变异来源：测试集采样、训练随机性、划分组成和未记录的预处理步骤；一项声明只有同时经受住这四类检验才可报告，其中三类检验仅需少量计算（数分钟级）。将该协议应用于一个独立重建的、基于扩散模型的伪影检测器，在原始24张切片的划分上评测，并与监督基线对比。
AI.result: 该方法的中央机制得到复现：辅助对比项将合并F1从0.673提升至0.688，且在第二个随机种子下重复（+0.0156, p=0.031；+0.0190, p=0.005），不过其作用对象是笔迹标记而非论文所述用于动机的伪影类型。但其比较性结论不成立：设计变体间的差异以及相对监督基线的差异均落在评测不确定度范围内。24张切片中有4张承载了70%的已评分标注像素，有效样本量仅6.2；继承的划分处于第7百分位。一个未报告的切片组织限制步骤排除了41.4%的失焦标注却仅排除2.6%的气泡标注，该门控在构造上与模糊相混淆。
AI.conclusion: 小队列（small-cohort）基准仅能支撑远比当前报告所暗示的弱得多的结论。所提出的四项检验成本足够低廉，可伴随此类资源上的任何评测使用，并能区分可复现的效果与评测本身无法分辨的差异。

title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: DIASENTINEL 是一个完全本地化部署的多智能体系统，用于从电子健康记录（EHR）中进行一年期2型糖尿病（T2DM）风险筛查，并生成有指南依据的报告，通过校准风险预测、确定性临床信号提取、针对ADA指南的倒数排名融合以及结合规则检查与LLM蕴含的混合验证层，解决了LLM在临床辅助决策中的幻觉、无依据建议和引用错误问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持方面具有潜力，但仍易出现幻觉事实、无依据的建议和引用错误，这严重限制了其在医疗场景中的可靠性与可信度，因此需要一个可审计且隐私安全的解决方案。
AI.method: 系统集成了四个核心组件：校准的风险预测模型、确定性的临床信号提取、基于美国糖尿病协会（ADA）指南的倒数排名融合（RRF）检索，以及结合规则检查与LLM蕴含判断的混合验证层，并以完全本地化（on-premise）多智能体架构实现。
AI.result: 系统提供了实时批量筛查仪表盘和交互式患者报告界面，报告中包含带引用的建议、验证结果以及原始电子健康记录对照，展示了在可靠、可审计且保护隐私前提下实现基于LLM的临床决策支持的实用框架。
AI.conclusion: DIASENTINEL为LLM应用于临床决策支持提供了一种实际的框架方案，兼顾可靠性、可审计性与隐私保护，验证了通过多智能体集成与混合验证机制可以应对幻觉和引用错误等核心挑战。

title: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling
summary: Thermal Infrared detection is widely used in autonomous driving, medical AI, etc., but its security has only attracted attention recently. We propose infrared adversarial clothing designed to evade thermal person detectors in real-world scenarios. The design of the adversarial clothing is based on 3D modeling, which makes it easier to simulate multiangle scenes near the real world compared to 2D modeling. We optimized the black patch layout pattern of 3D clothing based on the adversarial example technique and made physical adversarial clothing using the aerogel. The idea is to paste a set of square aerogel patches, which display black squares in thermal images, in the inner side of clothing at specific locations with specific orientations. To enhance realism, we propose a method to build infrared 3D models with real infrared photos and develop texture maps for 3D models to simulate varied infrared characteristics over time and location. In physical attacks, we achieved an attack success rate of 80.11\% indoors and 76.85\% outdoors against YOLOv9. In contrast, randomly placed patches yielded much lower success rates (26.53\% indoors and 23.03\% outdoors). The adversarial clothing also showed good transferability to unknown detectors with an ensemble attack method, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于3D建模与气凝胶补丁设计的红外对抗服装，通过在服装内侧特定位置粘贴方形气凝胶补丁（热像中呈黑色方块），实现对YOLOv9等热成像行人检测器的物理对抗攻击，室内/室外攻击成功率分别达80.11%和76.85%，并通过集成攻击实现向未知检测器的良好迁移性。
AI.motivation: 热红外检测在自动驾驶、医疗AI等领域被广泛使用，但其安全性近年来才引起关注。本文旨在研究真实场景下针对热成像行人检测器的物理对抗攻击，探索其安全漏洞。
AI.method: 基于3D建模设计对抗服装，相比2D建模更易模拟接近真实世界的多角度场景；利用对抗样本技术优化3D服装的黑色补丁布局；使用气凝胶制作物理对抗服装，将一组显示为黑色方块的气凝胶方形补丁以特定位置和朝向粘贴于服装内侧；提出用真实红外照片构建红外3D模型，并开发纹理图模拟随时间地点变化的红外特征；采用集成攻击方法增强对未知检测器的迁移性。
AI.result: 物理攻击中，对YOLOv9的攻击成功率室内为80.11%、室外为76.85%；随机放置补丁的成功率仅为室内26.53%、室外23.03%；对抗服装通过集成攻击对未知检测器表现出良好的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，所提出的基于3D建模和气凝胶补丁优化的红外对抗服装在真实物理场景中能有效规避热成像行人检测器，远优于随机补丁方案，并具备跨检测器迁移能力，验证了方法的有效性与实用性。

title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. However, it relies on fixed-size chunking which can fragment semantic evidence. We propose a configurable semantic chunking framework that addresses this limitation by combining entity-preserving windows, trigger-centered chunking, proposition-first extraction, tiered trigger prioritization, and hierarchical relation resolution. The framework integrates with BioMedRAG by replacing only the chunk construction stage while preserving the embedding model, learned chunk scorer, generator, and evaluation protocol. We evaluate the framework on biomedical relation extraction benchmarks (GM-CIHT, DDI, ChemProt) and adverse event classification (ADE). On GM-CIHT, the full hybrid configuration achieves 82.6% F1, improving over the fixed-size baseline (74.2% F1) by 8.4 points under our experimental setup. Cross-dataset analysis shows that semantic chunking improves extraction datasets with explicit relation cues, such as GM-CIHT and DDI, while fixed chunking remains competitive or stronger for dense biochemical extraction and binary classification settings such as ChemProt and ADE. By externalizing chunking logic into configuration files, the framework provides an interpretable and adaptable alternative to rigid fixed-size chunking for biomedical RAG pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可配置的语义分块框架，通过结合实体保留窗口、触发词中心分块、命题优先抽取、分层触发词优先级和层级关系解析，替代BioMedRAG中固定大小分块，在不改动嵌入模型、学习型分块评分器、生成器与评估协议的前提下提升生物医学关系抽取与不良事件分类性能，在GM-CIHT上相对固定分块基线提升8.4个F1点，并将分块逻辑外置于配置文件以提高可解释性与可适应性。
AI.motivation: BioMedRAG借助检索增强生成和学习型分块评分器在生物医学信息抽取中表现良好，但其依赖固定大小的分块方式，容易切断跨句或跨段落的语义证据，造成语义片段被割裂，从而限制信息抽取的准确性。作者旨在通过更符合语义边界的可配置分块策略来解决该局限。
AI.method: 框架包含五大语义分块策略：实体保留窗口（entity-preserving windows）、触发词中心分块（trigger-centered chunking）、命题优先抽取（proposition-first extraction）、分层触发词优先级（tiered trigger prioritization）以及层级关系解析（hierarchical relation resolution）。框架仅替换BioMedRAG的分块构建阶段，保留其嵌入模型、学习型分块评分器、生成器与评估协议，并将分块逻辑外部化为配置文件。评估覆盖生物医学关系抽取基准（GM-CIHT、DDI、ChemProt）和不良事件分类（ADE）。
AI.result: 在GM-CIHT上，完整混合配置取得82.6%的F1分数，较固定大小分块基线（74.2% F1）在实验设置下提升8.4个百分点。跨数据集分析表明：语义分块在具有明确关系线索的抽取数据集（GM-CIHT、DDI）上表现更好；而在密集生化抽取及二分类场景（ChemProt、ADE）中，固定分块仍具竞争力甚至更强。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分块逻辑外部化为配置文件，该框架为生物医学RAG管道提供了一种可解释、可适配的替代方案，克服了刚性固定大小分块的局限；但需根据任务类型选择分块策略，语义分块更适合显式关系抽取，固定分块在密集生化文本与二分类任务中仍具优势。

title: Pretrained, Curriculum-Tuned, and Ensembled: A Tracer-Aware Interactive Segmentation Pipeline for AutoPET V
summary: Interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT requires a model to provide a strong initial prediction while also responding efficiently to sparse corrective scribbles during inference. This setting is particularly challenging because tracer distributions, physiological uptake patterns, lesion appearance, and acquisition characteristics differ substantially between FDG and PSMA studies. We present TRIAGE, Tracer-aware Refinement via Interactive Anatomy-Guided sEgmentation. The core backbone is a 3D STU-Net initialized through masked autoencoding pre-training with an asynchronous masking strategy, aiming to learn transferable anatomical and cross-modal representations before task-specific fine-tuning. In parallel, we train an auxiliary organ segmentation model whose predictions provide explicit anatomical context and help distinguish physiological uptake from malignant lesions. A dedicated tracer classifier first routes each study to an FDG- or PSMA-specific branch. Within each branch, a first-stage segmentation model consumes CT, PET, and organ context to generate an initial lesion mask. The initial prediction is then combined with cumulative foreground/background scribbles and refined by a second interactive segmentation network. The FDG and PSMA branches share the same overall processing pipeline but are trained independently to account for tracer-specific appearance and error modes. We additionally employ curriculum-style training and model ensembling to improve robustness across interaction steps and heterogeneous cohorts. Experiments are conducted using the official AutoPET V data and ten-fold split; quantitative results, ablations, and final test-set performance are left as placeholders to be completed after the challenge evaluation. Code: https://github.com/Liiiii2101/AUTOPET2026-MEDAI.

AI.tldr: TRIAGE 提出了一种基于示踪剂感知的交互式全身 PET/CT 病灶分割框架：通过掩码自编码预训练 3D STU-Net 骨干网络，利用辅助器官分割模型提供解剖上下文，并由示踪剂分类器将影像路由到 FDG 或 PSMA 专用分支；每个分支采用两阶段流程（初始分割 + 基于前后景涂抹的交互式细化），并结合课程式训练与模型集成提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 全身 PET/CT 的交互式病灶分割要求模型既能提供较强的初始预测，又能在推理时高效响应稀疏的修正涂抹。由于 FDG 与 PSMA 两种示踪剂在示踪剂分布、生理性摄取模式、病灶外观和采集特性上差异显著，现有单一模型难以同时胜任两类影像，因此需要一个能够感知示踪剂差异并利用解剖上下文进行交互细化（区分生理摄取与恶性病灶）的框架。
AI.method: TRIAGE 的具体方法包括：(1) 骨干网络采用 3D STU-Net，并通过异步掩码策略的掩码自编码预训练初始化，以学习可迁移的解剖与跨模态表示；(2) 并行训练辅助器官分割模型，其预测提供显式解剖上下文，帮助区分生理摄取与恶性病灶；(3) 专用示踪剂分类器先将影像路由至 FDG 或 PSMA 分支；(4) 各分支内，第一阶段分割模型融合 CT、PET 与器官上下文生成初始病灶掩膜；(5) 将初始预测与累积的前景/背景涂抹结合，由第二个交互分割网络进行细化；(6) FDG 与 PSMA 分支共享相同整体流程但独立训练，以适配各自的外观与错误模式；(7) 采用课程式训练与模型集成以增强跨交互步骤和异质队列的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验基于官方 AutoPET V 数据及十折划分进行；定量结果、消融实验和最终测试集性能在摘要中明确标注为占位符，需在挑战赛评估完成后补充。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE 通过示踪剂路由分支、解剖上下文与交互式细化相结合，为跨 FDG/PSMA 异质性数据构建了鲁棒的交互式病灶分割方案；其有效性尚待挑战赛评估后以定量的消融与测试结果证实。

title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX
summary: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. By using VAD-derived segment boundaries, our algorithm stabilizes Whisper's text conditioning, allowing us to safely maintain continuous historical context across batched audio segments. As demonstrated on long-form audio benchmarks, this approach reduces Word Error Rate (WER) and improves proper noun transcription, all while maintaining high-throughput inference speeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文感知交错批处理（Context-Aware Interleaved Batching），通过基于VAD的片段边界稳定Whisper的文本条件，在批量音频片段间保持连续历史上下文，从而兼顾WhisperX的高吞吐推理与标准Whisper的上下文连贯性，降低WER并改善专有名词转录。
AI.motivation: WhisperX通过音频内部批处理加速转录，但隔离了音频片段，丢失了生成连贯标点和术语所需的历史上下文；而标准Whisper虽逐序保留上下文，却推理缓慢且易陷入幻觉循环。现有方案无法同时获得高吞吐与上下文连贯性，因此需要一种兼顾两者的批处理算法。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知交错批处理（Context-Aware Interleaved Batching）算法：利用VAD（语音活动检测）导出的片段边界来稳定Whisper的文本条件（text conditioning），从而在批量处理音频片段时安全地维持连续的历史上下文，实现批量解码与上下文保留的协同。
AI.result: 在长音频基准测试上，该方法降低了词错误率（WER），改善了专有名词转录的准确性，同时保持了高吞吐量的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知交错批处理成功融合了批处理加速与顺序上下文建模的优势，证明基于VAD的片段边界可用于稳定文本条件，在不牺牲推理效率的前提下提升长音频转录质量。

title: TAMI: Temporally Aligned, Missingness-Aware, and Interpretable Multimodal Fusion for Mental Health Assessment in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
comment: 19 pages, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
summary: Depression and anxiety in older adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) are frequently underdiagnosed due to limited access to care. Multimodal analysis of remote clinical interviews is a scalable screening approach, but existing methods have three limitations. First, they do not correct temporal misalignment across multimodal features extracted at different resolutions, inducing spurious cross-modal associations. Second, remote recordings exhibit uneven modality dropout, but missing values are often zero-filled, making them indistinguishable from valid near-zero measurements. Finally, they do not jointly attribute predictions to modalities, questions, and interview moments, limiting fine-grained clinical interpretation. We propose a Temporally-Aligned, Missingness-Aware, Interpretable (TAMI) multimodal fusion framework. TAMI aligns speech, language, facial, and physiological features within question-answer segments on a shared timeline, encodes modality-level missingness over time, and conditions fusion on question context. In interviews with 49 older adults with MCI, TAMI achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) scores of 0.68 (depression) and 0.69 (anxiety). Fine-grained temporal alignment of multimodal features produced the largest performance gain ($Δ{\geq}0.1$). Multi-level interpretability analysis revealed that depression classification relied on eyegaze and open-ended questions, while anxiety classification depended on eyegaze and head pose, with attribution uniformly distributed across questions. Using only responses to the open-ended questions (5.1min), the depression model achieved an AUROC score of 0.67, which was not significantly different from using the full interview (19min) ($p>0.05$). Our findings support designing interview protocols centered on open-ended questions for depression screening in older adults with MCI.

AI.tldr: 针对轻度认知障碍（MCI）老年人中抑郁和焦虑常被漏诊的问题，提出TAMI（时间对齐、缺失感知、可解释）多模态融合框架，用于远程临床访谈的自动筛查。TAMI对语音、语言、面部和生理特征在问答片段中进行时间对齐，编码模态级缺失模式，并以问题上下文为条件进行融合。在49名MCI老年人的访谈中，抑郁和焦虑分类的AUROC分别达0.68和0.69；精细时间对齐带来最大性能提升（Δ≥0.1）；多层级可解释性分析表明抑郁分类依赖眼动注视与开放式问题，焦虑分类依赖眼动注视与头部姿态。仅用开放式问题回答（5.1分钟）即可达到与完整访谈（19分钟）相当的抑郁筛查性能。
AI.motivation: MCI老年人中的抑郁和焦虑常因就医渠道受限而被漏诊，远程临床访谈的多模态分析是一种可扩展的筛查手段。但现有方法存在三大缺陷：一是未校正不同分辨率多模态特征间的时间错位，产生虚假的跨模态关联；二是远程录音存在不均匀的模态缺失，而缺失值常被零填充，与有效的近零测量无法区分；三是无法将预测共同归因到模态、问题和访谈时刻，限制细粒度临床解释。
AI.method: 提出TAMI多模态融合框架：1）在问答片段内的共享时间线上对齐语音、语言、面部和生理特征；2）编码模态级缺失随时间的变化模式；3）以问题上下文为条件进行融合。并配套多层级（模态-问题-时刻）可解释性分析。
AI.result: 在49名MCI老年人的访谈中，抑郁AUROC为0.68，焦虑AUROC为0.69。多模态特征的精细时间对齐带来最大性能增益（Δ≥0.1）。多层级可解释性显示：抑郁分类依赖眼动注视和开放式问题，焦虑分类依赖眼动注视和头部姿态，且归因在各问题间均匀分布。仅使用开放式问题回答（5.1分钟）时抑郁AUROC达0.67，与使用完整19分钟访谈相比无显著差异（p>0.05）。
AI.conclusion: TAMI验证了时间对齐、缺失感知和可解释多模态融合对远程访谈筛查的有效性，并支持为MCI老年人设计以开放式问题为核心的抑郁筛查访谈协议，从而缩短访谈时长、提高可扩展性与临床可解释性。

title: VCAR: Training-Free 3DGS Segmentation via View Completeness and Axis-Aware Boundary Refinement
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). 16 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Semantic segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is crucial for advancing 3D scene understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on feature distillation, which incurs substantial per-scene training overhead and often yields blurred segmentation boundaries. We identify that these boundary artifacts are driven in part by insufficient viewpoint coverage and boundary overflow of anisotropic Gaussian primitives. To address these challenges, we propose VCAR, a training-free coarse-to-fine segmentation strategy based on View Completeness and Axis-aware Boundary Refinement. In the coarse stage, a visibility-based weighted multi-view voting scheme rapidly localizes the target. In the fine stage, an object-centric sphere derived from the coarse result generates supplementary viewpoints via Spherical Spiral Sampling (SSS), allowing multi-view voting on the augmented views to precisely refine object boundaries and suppress irrelevant 3D Gaussians. Moreover, we introduce Axis-aware Boundary Refinement (ABR) to mitigate artifacts from anisotropic primitives. By decomposing the projected 2D covariance into per-axis contributions, ABR identifies the dominant axis responsible for boundary leakage and applies targeted anisotropic compression exclusively along that axis. Extensive experiments on NVOS and LERF demonstrate that VCAR achieves state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy and efficiency without training. Our code is available at https://github.com/DDKK0526/VCAR.

AI.tldr: 提出VCAR，一种基于视图完整性和轴感知边界细化的免训练粗到细语义分割方法，通过可见性加权的多视图投票粗定位目标，并用球面螺旋采样补充视图、轴感知边界细化来消除3DGS中由视角覆盖不足和各向异性高斯原语导致的边界伪影。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS语义分割方法大多依赖特征蒸馏，存在逐场景训练开销大、分割边界模糊的问题。作者指出边界伪影部分源于视角覆盖不足以及各向异性高斯原语的边界溢出，因此希望在不训练的前提下实现精确高效的分割。
AI.method: VCAR采用训练无关的粗到细分割策略。粗阶段使用基于可见性的加权多视图投票快速定位目标；细阶段由粗结果生成以物体为中心的球体，通过球面螺旋采样(SSS)生成补充视角，在增强视角上进行多视图投票以精确细化边界并抑制无关高斯。同时引入轴感知边界细化(ABR)，将投影二维协方差分解为各轴贡献，识别导致边界泄漏的主轴，仅沿该轴进行定向各向异性压缩。
AI.result: 在NVOS和LERF数据集上的大量实验表明，VCAR无需训练即达到最先进的语义分割精度与效率。
AI.conclusion: VCAR验证了通过精心设计的免训练粗到细投票与轴感知压缩机制可以有效解决3DGS分割中的边界伪影问题，为3D场景理解提供了一种高效且无需训练的新方案，代码已开源。

title: SurgSkill-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Surgical Skill Assessment
summary: Objective assessment of surgical technical skill is important for surgical training and structured feedback, but current workflows remain dependent on labor-intensive expert review. Existing automated approaches primarily focus on visual inputs and provide limited support for jointly studying operative performance, structured skill scores, and evaluator feedback. We introduce SurgSkill-Bench, an initial video-score-text benchmark-style dataset containing 214 surgical training simulation videos, six-dimensional OSATS scores, and expert free-text comments. We define two evaluation settings: video-only OSATS prediction for automated assessment and post hoc expert-comment-assisted prediction, where evaluator comments are available as auxiliary information. We provide controlled baseline experiments using representative frozen visual backbones, content-adaptive key-frame sampling, and a simple video-text co-attention fusion module. Under internal video-level validation, content-adaptive sampling improves video-only performance in this dataset, while evaluator comments provide additional score-related signal in the assisted setting. The best mean AUROC reaches 0.88 under dataset-specific median dichotomization. We further discuss evaluation constraints related to dataset scale, metadata completeness, and the interpretation of comment-assisted prediction. Code will be released publicly at a later date.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SurgSkill-Bench，一个包含 214 个手术培训模拟视频、六维 OSATS 技能评分和专家自由文本评论的视频-评分-文本基准数据集，并定义视频-only OSATS 预测与专家评论辅助预测两种评估设定；通过内容自适应关键帧采样和视频-文本协同注意力融合模块进行基线实验，最佳平均 AUROC 达 0.88。
AI.motivation: 现有手术技能客观评估依赖劳动密集型专家评审，自动化方法主要基于视觉输入，难以联合研究操作表现、结构化技能评分与评估者反馈三者之间的关系。
AI.method: 构建 SurgSkill-Bench 基准数据集，包含手术模拟视频、OSATS 多维评分和专家评论；定义两种评估任务（纯视频预测与评论辅助预测）；采用代表性冻结视觉骨干、内容自适应关键帧采样，以及简单的视频-文本协同注意力融合模块作为可控基线。
AI.result: 在内部视频级验证中，内容自适应采样提升了纯视频预测性能；评估者评论在辅助设定中提供了额外的评分相关信号；在数据集特有中位数二值化下最佳平均 AUROC 达到 0.88。
AI.conclusion: 该基准初步验证了视觉与文本信息融合用于手术技能自动评估的可行性，同时指出数据集规模、元数据完整性和评论辅助预测解读等方面的评估约束，后续将公开代码。

title: A Controlled Evaluation of Model Rankings and Input Reliance in Surface Water Segmentation
summary: Performance evaluation for surface-water segmentation commonly uses an aggregate metric such as global intersection-over-union (IoU) to rank model configurations. However, a configuration ranking does not by itself establish why one system performs better, whether a close ordering is stable, or how strongly predictions rely on individual inputs. We examine these distinctions primarily on Sen1Floods11 through repeated configuration comparisons, paired test-chip analysis, fixed-checkpoint input stress tests, and geographic reweighting, with a targeted secondary evaluation of supervised input configurations on GEOID-Flood. The cross-modal student achieves the highest three-seed mean IoU on Sen1Floods11, but close orderings vary across seeds and geographic weighting, while ancillary-input rankings differ between Swin-UNet and U-Net. The GEOID-Flood evaluation shows substantial agreement in supervised ancillary-input effects, although the exact architecture ordering remains configuration dependent. Fixed-checkpoint tests further establish reliance on terrain and WorldCover without establishing a clean-input performance benefit, while target semantics and the later WorldCover prior restrict the evaluation to retrospective all-water segmentation. These results show that aggregate metrics remain useful for ranking complete configurations, but ranking stability, component attribution, input reliance, and deployment scope require distinct evidence. Performance evaluation should therefore match the evidence reported to the claim being made.

AI.tldr: 该论文批评性地审视了仅用全局IoU等聚合指标对地表水分割配置进行排名的做法，指出排名本身无法说明系统优劣原因、排名稳定性或对个别输入的依赖。作者在Sen1Floods11上通过多次配置比较、配对测试芯片分析、固定检查点输入压力测试和地理重加权，并结合GEOID-Flood上的次要评估，发现跨模态学生模型在三种子平均IoU上最高，但紧密排名随种子和地理加权而变化，辅助输入排名在Swin-UNet与U-Net之间也不同，从而强调评估证据必须与论断相匹配。
AI.motivation: 地表水分割的性能评估通常仅使用全局IoU等聚合指标来对模型配置排序，但一个配置排名并不能说明系统为何表现更好、紧密排序是否稳定，以及预测在多大程度上依赖个别输入。作者希望厘清这些被聚合指标掩盖的评估维度，并指出评价方法与所声称结论之间的脱节问题。
AI.method: 在Sen1Floods11上进行了重复配置比较、配对测试芯片分析、固定检查点输入压力测试以及地理重加权分析，并在GEOID-Flood上对受监督的输入配置进行了针对性次级评估，涉及跨模态学生模型、Swin-UNet与U-Net等不同架构和输入配置。
AI.result: 跨模态学生在Sen1Floods11上取得最高的三种子平均IoU，但紧密排名会随种子和地理加权而变化；辅助输入排名在Swin-UNet和U-Net之间不一致。GEOID-Flood评估显示受监督辅助输入效应总体一致，但精确架构排序仍依赖配置。固定检查点测试确认模型依赖地形和WorldCover数据，但未显示干净输入带来性能收益；目标语义及较早的WorldCover先验将评估限制在回顾性全域水域分割。
AI.conclusion: 聚合指标对完整配置的排名仍然有用，但排名稳定性、成分归因、输入依赖性和部署范围需要不同类别的证据来支撑。性能评估应与所报告的证据类型和研究论断相匹配，即“声称什么，就提供相应的证据”。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Forecasting from Imperfect Tracking
summary: Most trajectory forecasting models are trained on clean annotated histories, and are often evaluated under the same idealized assumption, although practical deployments rely on trajectories produced by imperfect multi-object trackers. The real-world observations exhibit localization jitter, missed or unstable detections, and data-association ambiguity, which are usually either ignored or removed through denoising. This paper instead treats tracking-derived reliability cues as an informative signal to be propagated to the predictor. We propose a plug-in uncertainty-aware formulation in which each observed state is encoded as an uncertain state representation, modeled by a Gaussian distribution whose covariance combines detection-level localization uncertainty and association-level ambiguity through the law of total variance. Existing backbones are adapted with minimal architectural changes: input trajectories are represented as Gaussian observations, and predicted trajectories are produced as Gaussian forecasts rather than deterministic coordinates. To train predictors that remain robust under structured observation noise, we combine temporally correlated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck perturbations with response-based knowledge distillation from a teacher trained on clean trajectories. Experiments on Oxford Town Centre and VIRAT using real tracker outputs, together with a complementary ETH/UCY pseudo-detection protocol, show that the proposed formulation improves displacement accuracy and the reliability-sharpness trade-off of probabilistic forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种即插即用的不确定性感知轨迹预测框架，将多目标跟踪产生的观测不确定性（定位抖动、关联歧义）显式编码为高斯观测，并以高斯分布形式输出预测，通过Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扰动与基于响应的知识蒸馏训练，在真实跟踪输出和伪检测协议下同时提升位移精度与概率预测的可靠性-锐度权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹预测模型多在干净标注轨迹上训练与评测，而实际部署依赖不完美的多目标跟踪器输出，存在定位抖动、漏检/不稳定检测和数据关联歧义。以往研究要么忽略这些噪声，要么通过去噪移除，本文则认为跟踪派生的可靠性线索本身是有信息量的信号，应传递给预测器而非被丢弃。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的不确定性感知公式：将每个观测状态编码为高斯分布表示的不确定状态，其协方差通过全方差定律融合检测级定位不确定性与关联级歧义；对现有主干网络仅做最小架构改动——输入轨迹表示为高斯观测，预测轨迹输出为高斯预测而非确定性坐标。训练时结合时间相关的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扰动（模拟结构化观测噪声）与基于响应的知识蒸馏（从干净轨迹训练的教师模型学习），以保持对结构化噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Oxford Town Centre和VIRAT数据集上使用真实跟踪器输出进行实验，并辅以ETH/UCY的伪检测协议，结果表明所提公式在位移精度以及概率预测的可靠性-锐度权衡上均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 将跟踪不确定性作为显式信号编码进观测和预测，可使轨迹预测器在中度缺失、噪声和关联模糊的真实跟踪环境下更稳健，兼顾确定性精度与概率预测质量。

title: Audio-Driven Adversarial Defense for 3D Talking Face Generation with totally Visual Fidelity Preservation
summary: The rapid development of generative portrait models has raised growing concerns about privacy leakage and identity misuse. In particular, audio-driven 3D talking face generation can reconstruct a reusable 3D portrait of a target person from a monocular video and animate it with arbitrary speech, making realistic identity impersonation alarmingly practical. Existing proactive defenses mainly operate in the visual domain by injecting subtle perturbations into acial regions to disrupt identity acquisition. However, such perturbations often compromise visual quality due to the strong structural priors and social sensitivity of human faces, and are easily weakened by common real-world transformations such as resizing. To overcome these limitations, we propose an imperceptible audio defense for audio-driven 3D talking face generation by shifting protection from the visual modality to the audio modality. Specifically,we exploit psychoacoustic masking to hide protective perturbations within perceptually masked frequency regions of the speech signal, thereby reducing perceptual distortion while suppressing reliable facial animation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method effectively degrades 3D talking face generation while preserving favorable perceptual quality. These findings highlight psychoacoustically guided audio perturbations as a practical and promising direction for privacy-preserving portrait protection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对音频驱动的3D说话人脸生成技术带来的隐私泄露与身份冒充风险，提出了一种从视觉模态转向音频模态的不可感知防御方法，利用心理声学掩蔽将保护性扰动隐藏在语音信号的可感知掩蔽频区内，在降低感知失真的同时抑制可靠的面部动画生成。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动的3D说话人脸生成技术可以从单目视频重建目标人物的可复用3D肖像，并配合任意语音驱动动画，使身份冒充变得非常容易。现有防御方法主要在视觉域向面部区域注入细微扰动，但人脸具有强结构先验和社会敏感性，扰动容易损害视觉质量，且易被常见真实世界变换（如缩放）削弱。
AI.method: 提出一种不可感知的音频防御方法，将保护从视觉模态转移到音频模态：利用心理声学掩蔽效应，将保护的扰动隐藏于语音信号中被感知屏蔽的频率区域，在减少感知失真的同时扰乱3D面部动画的生成可靠性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法能有效削弱3D说话人脸生成效果，同时保持良好的感知质量，验证了心理声学引导的音频扰动在隐私保护方面的实用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 心理声学引导的音频扰动是面向隐私保护的肖像防护中一个实用且有前景的方向，为绕过视觉域防御局限提供了新的思路与证据。

title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still struggle on tasks requiring complex visual understanding. We argue that the core issue is not high-level reasoning, but instead failing to locate critical details in the image. Due to this shortcoming, VLMs generate often plausible but incorrect reasoning based on flawed perceptual grounding. To address this, we propose Locator-Critic (LOCI), a training-free framework that decouples visual search from evidence verification. LOCI employs a Locator agent to propose candidate visual evidence and a separate Critic agent to evaluate its relevance and sufficiency. These agents engage in an iterative refinement loop, progressively improving the evidence until it is adequate to answer the given question. This decoupled, self-correcting process yields substantial performance gains, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple complex visual benchmarks. LOCI improves accuracy for both open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (+12.1 on V*, +5.8 on HR-Bench and +11.2 on VisualProbe-Hard) and proprietary models like Gemini 2.5 Pro (+8.9 on V*, +4.3 on HR-Bench, +4.8 on VisualProbe-Hard).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Locator-Critic (LOCI)，一个无需训练的框架，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦，通过定位器（Locator）与批评者（Critic）两个智能体的迭代细化循环，逐步改善视觉证据直至足以回答问题，从而解决VLM在复杂视觉理解中因忽视关键细节而产生错误推理的问题，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在需要复杂视觉理解的任务上仍然表现不佳。作者认为核心问题并非高层推理能力不足，而是模型无法定位图像中的关键细节；这种感知缺陷导致VLM生成看似合理但基于错误感知依据的推理。因此需要一种机制来显式地引导模型找到关键视觉证据。
AI.method: 提出LOCI，一个训练无关（training-free）的框架，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦。具体包含两个角色：（1）Locator智能体，负责提出候选的视觉证据；（2）Critic智能体，负责评估证据的相关性与充分性。两者通过迭代细化循环不断改进证据，直到证据足以回答给定问题为止。该过程无需额外训练，可即插即用地应用于现有VLM。
AI.result: LOCI在多个复杂视觉基准上取得显著提升并达到SOTA：开源模型如Qwen3-VL在V*上+12.1、HR-Bench上+5.8、VisualProbe-Hard上+11.2；闭源模型如Gemini 2.5 Pro在V*上+8.9、HR-Bench上+4.3、VisualProbe-Hard上+4.8。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦并引入自纠正式的迭代证据细化，是一种有效且通用的改进路径，能够同时提升开源与闭源VLM在复杂视觉理解任务上的准确率，验证了"问题不在于推理本身而在于感知定位"的核心论断。

title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
summary: Pretrained vision embeddings are increasingly used as general-purpose representations for modelling how people appraise urban scenes, and are validated almost entirely by how well they predict human ratings. High predictive accuracy does not establish that these embeddings organise scenes as human perception does. We test the two properties separately against brain data. Using openly released EEG from 63 adults who viewed and rated 56 Berlin street scenes, we estimate the representational geometry of the scenes over time, the proportion of that geometry that is explainable at all, and its correspondence with seventeen feature spaces spanning language-supervised, self-supervised, category-supervised and dense-prediction training, two orders of magnitude of scale, and interpretable controls. Correspondence is low throughout: the best representation, DINOv2 ViT-B, reaches 29.6% of the lower bound of the noise ceiling, the panel spans 11.0% to 29.6%, and a Gabor energy descriptor is indistinguishable from the best model while outperforming every language-supervised model tested. Within a model, deeper layers still match later neural responses, so the hierarchical correspondence found for object recognition survives even at this low overall level. The same embeddings predict held-out appraisal ratings well, up to r = 0.87, and the two measures do not track each other across models; reweighting features towards the neural geometry lowers appraisal prediction for every model tested, against a control of matched dimensionality. Predicting how a street is appraised is therefore weak evidence that a model represents the street as the brain does. The benchmark uses only public data and requires no training, so evaluating a new representation needs only its embeddings for 55 images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预训练视觉嵌入在预测城市街景人类评分方面的能力，并测试了这些嵌入是否真正按照人类感知的方式组织场景。通过使用63名成年人观看56个柏林街景的公开EEG数据，研究者估计了场景的表示几何结构，并与17个特征空间进行比较。结果显示，最好的表示DINOv2 ViT-B仅达到噪声天花板下限的29.6%，且Gabor能量描述符与最佳模型无法区分，却优于所有语言监督模型。尽管这些嵌入能很好地预测评分（r=0.87），但预测评分与神经几何对应度之间不相关，且向神经几何方向重新加权特征会降低所有模型的评分预测能力。结论是：预测街景评分并不能证明模型像大脑一样表征街景。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉嵌入被广泛用作通用表征来建模人们对城市街景的评价，且几乎完全通过预测人类评分的准确率来验证。但高预测准确率并不能证明这些嵌入像人类感知那样组织场景。作者希望区分"预测评分"和"按人类感知方式组织场景"这两个性质，并分别用脑数据加以检验。
AI.method: 利用公开的EEG数据（63名成年人观看并评分56个柏林街景），估计场景随时间变化的表征几何结构、该几何结构可解释的比例，以及它与17个特征空间的对应关系。这些特征空间涵盖语言监督、自监督、类别监督和密集预测训练，跨越两个数量级的规模，并包含可解释的对照（如Gabor能量描述符）。同时比较了模型深层与浅层与神经反应的对应关系，并进行特征重加权实验检验评分预测与神经表征一致性之间的权衡。
AI.result: 所有模型的神经对应度都很低：最佳表示DINOv2 ViT-B达到噪声天花板下限的29.6%，整个模型系列范围在11.0%至29.6%之间；Gabor能量描述符与最佳模型无法区分，且优于所有语言监督模型。模型内部，更深层与更晚的神经反应更匹配，说明物体识别中的层级对应关系在低总体水平下依然存在。同时，这些嵌入能很好地预测留出样本的评分（最高r=0.87），但两种度量在模型间不相关联；对所有模型而言，将特征向神经几何重加权都会降低评分预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 预测街景如何被评价，只是模型像大脑那样表征街景的弱证据。评估新表示只需55张图片的嵌入，且基准仅使用公共数据、无需训练，可用于标准化的表示评估。

title: MR-JEPA: A General Purpose Video Foundation Model for Cardiac MRI
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) produces rich sequential data such as temporal cine videos and spatial LGE/mapping stacks, yet most deep learning approaches process individual 2D slices, discarding this context. We present MR-JEPA, a self-supervised video foundation model for CMR that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs through tubelet tokenization, spatiotemporal masking augmentation, and initialization from a 2D CMR foundation model. Unlike prior CMR video models limited to cine data, MR-JEPA is pretrained on multi-sequence data (cine, LGE, mapping) from 10,505 patients across two centers without annotations. We evaluate the frozen encoder on six downstream tasks using a unified multi-view gated attention architecture: LV ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction, three myocardial strains (GLS, GCS, GRS), and four-class disease detection. MR-JEPA outperforms other compared methods on all five regression tasks, including both a domain-specific CMR model pretrained on more data with text supervision and a natural-video foundation model, achieving an LV EF MAE of 4.79% (r =0.764) and a GLS MAE of 1.87 (r=0.805), with 21-27% MAE reductions over baselines on strain tasks. For disease detection, MR-JEPA achieved a macro AUG of 0.868, remaining competitive with the domain-specific baseline despite using a fully self-supervised pretraining objective. These results demonstrate the potential of a unified video encoder for robust, multi-view utilization of diverse CMR sequences in clinical cardiac quantification and diagnosis.

AI.tldr: MR-JEPA 是一种面向心脏磁共振成像（CMR）的 3D 时空自监督视频基础模型，通过 tubelet 分词、时空掩码增强和 2D CMR 基础模型初始化，在 10,505 名患者的多序列（cine、LGE、mapping）无标注数据上预训练，冻结编码器在六项下游任务上以统一的多视图门控注意力架构评估，在全部五项回归任务上优于对比方法，并验证了统一视频编码器用于多样 CMR 序列临床量化和诊断的潜力。
AI.motivation: CMR 产生丰富的序列化数据（如时间维的电影视频和空间维的 LGE/mapping 堆叠），但大多数深度学习方法只处理单个 2D 切片，丢弃了这些时空上下文；此外，已有的 CMR 视频模型仅限于 cine 数据。因此需要一种能够统一利用多序列、完整 3D 时空上下文的自监督视频基础模型。
AI.method: MR-JEPA 将 LeJEPA 扩展到 3D 时空输入：采用 tubelet 词元化、时空掩码增强，并从 2D CMR 基础模型初始化；在来自两个中心、10,505 名患者的多序列（cine、LGE、mapping）无标注数据上进行自监督预训练；评估时冻结编码器，并使用统一的多视图门控注意力架构进行下游任务适配。
AI.result: 在 LV EF、RV EF 及三种心肌应变（GLS、GCS、GRS）等全部五项回归任务上均优于对比方法（包括基于更多数据和文本监督的领域专属 CMR 模型以及自然视频基础模型）：LV EF MAE 为 4.79%（r=0.764），GLS MAE 为 1.87（r=0.805），应变任务相对基线 MAE 降低 21-27%；四类疾病检测 macro AUC 达 0.868，与领域专属基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: MR-JEPA 证明了在完全自监督目标下，单一的统一视频编码器能够对多样 CMR 序列进行鲁棒的多视图利用，在临床心脏定量和疾病诊断任务上展现出广阔潜力。

title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification
summary: Reflective smartphone cover glass is challenging to inspect from a single fixed viewpoint because defect visibility varies with viewing geometry and specular reflections. This gives rise to two practical challenges: defects may be weakly observable from certain viewpoints, while the available visual evidence may remain spatially ambiguous. To address these issues, we propose a multi-view inspection framework in which each RGB observation is processed by a shared per-view expert. A vision-language model (VLM) produces class-aware semantic boxes, while a normal-reference reconstruction branch provides class-agnostic saliency. Their spatial agreement is used as supporting evidence to rank semantic proposals without modifying their coordinates or treating saliency as ground truth. The resulting evidence records are combined at product level without cross-view registration. On 282 production-line images, semantic-saliency association improves $AP_{50}$ from 52.6% to 62.6% by re-ranking fixed semantic proposals. Across 94 products, cross-view evidence recall $R_{\rm prod}@0.5$ increases from 75.5% for the best single view to 88.3% using all three views. These results support the complementary roles of semantic-saliency cross-verification and additional optical observations in reflective-surface inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向反射性智能手机盖板玻璃的多视角缺陷检测框架。每个视角的RGB图像由共享的视角专家处理：视觉语言模型(VLM)生成类别感知的语义框，法向参考重建分支生成类别无关的显著性图；两者空间一致性作为支持证据对语义候选进行重排序（不修改坐标、不将显著性作为真值），并在产品层面无跨视角配准地融合证据。实验显示语义-显著性关联使AP50从52.6%提至62.6%，多视角证据召回率从75.5%（最佳单视角）提升至88.3%（三视角）。
AI.motivation: 反射性智能手机盖板玻璃难以从单一固定视角进行缺陷检测，因为缺陷可见性随观测几何和镜面反射而变化，导致两个实际挑战：某些视角下缺陷可观测性弱，且可用的视觉证据在空间上存在歧义。
AI.method: 提出多视角检测框架：每个RGB观测由共享的per-view专家处理。VLM生成类别感知的语义框，法向参考重建分支提供类别无关的显著性图；利用两者的空间一致性作为支持证据对语义候选进行重排序，既不修改其坐标，也不将显著性视为真值。证据记录在产品层面合并，无需跨视角配准。
AI.result: 在282张产线图像上，语义-显著性关联通过重排序固定语义候选使AP50从52.6%提升至62.6%；在94个产品上，跨视角证据召回率R_prod@0.5从最佳单视角的75.5%提升至三视角的88.3%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实了语义-显著性交叉验证与额外光学观测在反射表面检测中的互补作用。

title: From Intent to Evidence: Policy-Steered Multi-Strategy Retrieval for Long-Video Agents
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables (main paper with appendix)
summary: Existing long-video agents acquire evidence through one uniform behavior, ignoring whether the required evidence is concentrated, requires broad occurrence coverage, or must discriminate competing hypotheses---which can cause failure before substantive reasoning begins. Prescribing a fine-grained solution procedure for every question is not a satisfactory remedy, as it restricts autonomous exploration. We propose VESTA, a training-free long-video agent organized as a route-conditioned acquire--verify--consolidate loop. Before exploration, an intent router infers an evidence-acquisition policy---focused, recall, or contrastive retrieval over a shared visual--speech scene index---together with an evidence-accounting policy that configures the evidence view maintained during exploration. Policy-steered retrieval yields provisional references that multimodal evidence operations convert into observations, while the Reasoner remains free to verify them, re-query using intermediate findings, or inspect regions outside the retrieved set. A temporal evidence ledger consolidates observations into an adaptive, compressed view of temporal location, provenance, coverage, conflicts, verification outcomes, and hypothesis support, exposing missing and unresolved evidence to guide subsequent acquisition; finalization prioritizes verified observations. On Video-MME-v2, VESTA improves average accuracy by 2.7 points over VideoARM and gains across all six reported metrics. On LongVideoBench, EgoSchema, and LVBench under shared query-time models, it improves by 6.9 points on the LongVideoBench long subset and 1.5 on LVBench, and matches VideoARM on EgoSchema.

AI.tldr: VESTA 是一种无需训练的长期视频智能体，采用路径条件化的“获取-验证-整合”循环。通过意图路由器在探索前推断证据获取策略（聚焦、回忆或对比检索）和证据核算策略，并由时间证据账本自适应地整合观察结果，暴露缺失/未解决的证据以指导后续获取，最终优先采用已验证观察结果。在 Video-MME-v2 上较 VideoARM 平均准确率提升 2.7 点，在 LongVideoBench 长集、LVBench 上分别提升 6.9 和 1.5 点，在 EgoSchema 上与 VideoARM 持平。
AI.motivation: 现有长期视频智能体以统一行为获取证据，忽略了所需证据是集中分布、需要广泛出现的覆盖范围、还是必须区分竞争性假设——这可能在实质性推理开始前就导致失败。为每个问题规定细粒度的求解流程又不可取，因为它限制了自主探索。因此需要一种能依据问题类型自适应调整证据获取策略的机制。
